guides.title: 師傅導讀：從水頭到電力，別漏掉能量損失
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: From hydraulic head to electricity, account for losses
guides.concept: 水力發電把水的能量經水輪機轉成軸功，再由發電機轉成電能。可用功率與淨水頭、流量和總效率有關；壩高不是自動等於淨水頭，裝置容量也不是所有時間的實際輸出。
guides.conceptEn: Hydropower converts hydraulic energy to shaft work and then electricity. Output depends on net head, flow and combined efficiency. Dam height is not automatically net head, and installed capacity is not continuous output.
procedure: 觀看電站原理影片，自繪水流與能量兩條路徑，標出進水、壓力水道、水輪機、發電機與尾水。
寫出學習模型 P = ρgQHη，逐一標示密度、重力加速度、流量、淨水頭與總效率的單位。
自行選一組標為「虛構練習」的 Q、H、η，比較流量或水頭改變時功率的趨勢；不得把結果標成三峽實測。
把水道損失、機械損失、電氣損失列成三欄，指出各自需取得的量測；缺乏效率曲線時保留不確定性。
procedureEn: Draw separate water and energy paths after watching the plant film. Identify intake, pressure conduit, turbine, generator and tailwater.
Write the learning model P = ρgQHη and label the units of density, gravity, flow, net head and overall efficiency.
Choose explicitly fictional Q, H and η values. Compare the output trend as flow or head changes; never label the result as measured Three Gorges performance.
Separate hydraulic, mechanical and electrical losses. Specify the measurements needed for each and retain uncertainty when efficiency curves are unavailable.
evidence: 水流路徑與能量轉換圖。
單位一致、假設清楚的功率估算表。
解釋毛水頭、淨水頭、額定容量與實際輸出的差異。
evidenceEn: Water-path and energy-conversion diagrams.
A dimensionally consistent power estimate with explicit assumptions.
A distinction between gross head, net head, rated capacity and actual output.
pitfalls: 用壩頂至河床高度代替工作淨水頭。
把效率設為百分之百卻未標成理想模型。
只追求流量，忽略水輪機允許運轉範圍。
pitfallsEn: Substituting dam height for operating net head.
Using 100% efficiency without identifying an ideal model.
Increasing flow without considering the turbine operating envelope.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：水庫削峰不是把洪水消失掉
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Flood attenuation stores water; it does not erase it
guides.concept: 水庫調度改變洪水通過的時間與流量，但水量仍須守恆。入流大於出流會增加蓄水；已被占用的庫容會限制後續洪峰的緩衝空間。下游支流洪峰與預報誤差也必須納入判斷。
guides.conceptEn: Reservoir operation changes the timing and magnitude of a flood hydrograph while conserving water. Inflow above outflow increases storage and uses space needed for later inflows. Downstream tributary peaks and forecast uncertainty also matter.
procedure: 由官方調度案例分列攔洪、削峰與錯峰三種目的，不將任何一個案例的流量直接套用到別的事件。
自製虛構入流與出流時序表，統一時間步長與單位，用 ΔS = (Qin − Qout)Δt 逐步更新蓄水量。
為模型設定明確標示為教學假設的庫容上限，比較提前釋放、延後釋放對剩餘空間與下游流量的影響。
再加入「支流較早洪峰」或「入流預報偏低」情境，記錄原方案何時失效及需要更新的資訊。
procedureEn: Separate retention, peak reduction and peak-timing objectives in official dispatch cases. Do not transfer event-specific releases to another flood.
Create fictional inflow and outflow time series with consistent units and time steps. Update storage using ΔS = (Qin − Qout)Δt.
Set an explicitly educational storage limit. Compare early and delayed releases in terms of remaining storage and downstream flow.
Add an earlier tributary peak or an underestimated inflow forecast. Identify when the original plan fails and what information must be updated.
evidence: 逐時段水量平衡表，累計誤差可回查。
兩種釋放方案的蓄水與下游流量比較。
標示預報不確定性及生態、航運、供水需求的決策註記。
evidenceEn: A time-step water balance with traceable cumulative error.
A comparison of storage and downstream flow under two release scenarios.
Decision notes covering forecast uncertainty, ecology, navigation and water supply.
pitfalls: 把瞬間流量與累計水量直接相比。
只算壩址出流，忽略下游區間來水。
將課堂模型的「最佳解」稱為實際調度命令。
pitfallsEn: Comparing instantaneous flow directly with accumulated volume.
Considering only dam releases while ignoring downstream inflows.
Presenting a classroom optimum as an operational dispatch order.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：移動閉塞仍然需要停得下來的證據
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Moving block still requires evidence of stopping capability
guides.concept: 更頻繁取得位置資訊，有助於細緻管理列車間隔，但無法消除煞車距離。通訊延遲、位置不確定度、坡度與黏著條件都會影響保護範圍。用簡化模型理解依存關係，不能據此設定真實號誌參數。
guides.conceptEn: More frequent position information supports finer separation management but does not remove braking distance. Latency, position uncertainty, gradient and adhesion affect the protective envelope. A simple model explains dependencies, not operational signalling settings.
procedure: 以官方 CBTC 影片畫出列車、軌旁與控制中心的資訊交換，標出位置、速度與移動授權的不同角色。
在紙上建立兩列車位置圖，分別畫出前車占用範圍、後車位置誤差與後車可用停止距離。
使用理想化 d = v²/(2a) 比較同一減速度下速度加倍的影響；另以 vτ 表示示意延遲距離，所有數值明列為教學假設。
討論一筆位置回報過期時，哪些條件不能再確定；把保守限制與重新取得可信位置證據寫成狀態轉換。
procedureEn: Map train, wayside and control-centre communication from the official CBTC film. Distinguish position, speed and movement authority.
Draw two trains with the leading train’s occupied extent, following-train position uncertainty and available stopping distance.
Use idealised d = v²/(2a) to compare doubled speed at constant deceleration; add illustrative latency travel vτ. Label all numerical inputs as teaching assumptions.
Identify what becomes unknown when a position report is stale. Describe conservative restrictions and the evidence needed to restore a trusted position state.
evidence: 不重疊的占用與保護範圍示意。
呈現速度平方關係的紙上計算。
說明位置更新率改善不能取代煞車能力與安全驗證。
evidenceEn: A sketch distinguishing occupied and protected extents.
A calculation demonstrating the square-of-speed relationship.
An explanation of why update rate cannot replace braking capability or safety validation.
pitfalls: 把發出煞車命令當成列車已經停止。
把通訊中斷等同軌道上沒有列車。
把簡化等減速模型當成核准的安全煞車曲線。
pitfallsEn: Treating a brake command as proof the train has stopped.
Treating lost communication as an unoccupied track.
Using a constant-deceleration exercise as an approved safe braking curve.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：列車能動，不代表整套捷運已驗證
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: A moving train does not prove an integrated metro
guides.concept: 車輛、號誌、月台與電力之間的介面，往往決定系統是否能安全而穩定地營運。單機功能合格不等於整合情境合格。LTA 的號誌模擬設施提供一個公開例子：在受控環境先測軟體與營運場景。
guides.conceptEn: Interfaces among rolling stock, signalling, platforms and traction power determine system behaviour. Passing a component test does not establish integrated performance. LTA’s simulation facilities illustrate testing software changes against operational scenarios before mainline use.
procedure: 為「列車到站、停妥、開門、關門、允許發車」自繪狀態表，列出每次轉換必需的確認資訊。
依 LTA 公開情境，加入臨時速限、列車留站及班距調整；記錄其對車輛命令與號誌授權的不同影響。
每個情境建立預期結果、觀察量與失敗條件；再加入一個介面回報延遲，檢查系統是否仍有清楚的限制狀態。
把軟體版本、設定、模擬器版本與測試紀錄綁成同一組，說明重測與正式線路驗證還缺哪些證據。
procedureEn: Draw a state table for arrival, verified stop, door opening, door closure and departure permission. List the confirmations required at each transition.
Add the published LTA scenarios: temporary speed restriction, holding at a platform and headway regulation. Separate their effects on commands and authority.
Define expected results, observable signals and failure conditions. Introduce delayed interface feedback and check for a clearly restricted state.
Bind software version, configuration, simulator version and test records together. List the evidence still needed for regression and mainline validation.
evidence: 狀態轉換與允許條件矩陣。
至少三個營運情境與一個介面異常的測試表。
能由結果回溯軟體與設定版本的測試紀錄。
evidenceEn: A state-transition and permission matrix.
A test sheet with three operational scenarios and one interface anomaly.
Test records traceable to software and configuration versions.
pitfalls: 只驗證正常旅程而忽略異常回報。
把模擬成功直接宣稱可載客營運。
測試時更動設定，卻沒有留下版本紀錄。
pitfallsEn: Testing only a normal journey and ignoring abnormal feedback.
Declaring readiness for passenger service from simulation alone.
Changing configuration during testing without preserving version history.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：分清煙氣、鍋爐水與做功蒸汽
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Separate combustion gas, boiler water and working steam
guides.concept: 蒸汽機車看似一個大型鍋爐，實際上至少有三條不同流路。煙氣把熱傳給水，產生的蒸汽進入汽缸做功，再經排汽系統離開。輪子轉動來自壓力差與連桿機構，而不是煙直接推動車輪。
guides.conceptEn: A steam locomotive contains distinct gas, water and steam paths. Combustion gases transfer heat to water; steam then expands in cylinders and exhausts. Pressure differences and mechanical linkages turn the wheels, rather than smoke driving them directly.
procedure: 觀看 NPS 蒸汽原理解說，以三種線型自繪煙氣、給水與蒸汽流路，交會處僅代表換熱時不得畫成流體混合。
把熱量傳入、汽缸做功與機械傳動分成三段，為每段列出輸入與輸出。
在不加壓的紙上模型中，畫出活塞前後兩端壓力不同時的受力方向；再連到連桿與曲柄。
依博物館剖面解說，指出圖上看不到或尚未查證的部件，將它們列為待查而不是補造配置。
procedureEn: Watch the NPS explanation and draw gas, feedwater and steam routes with different line styles. Do not show fluid mixing where only heat transfer occurs.
Separate heat input, cylinder work and mechanical transmission. List the input and output of each.
In an unpressurised paper model, draw the force direction caused by different pressures across a piston and connect it to the rod and crank.
Use the museum cutaway explanation to identify missing or unverified components. Mark them for research instead of inventing an arrangement.
evidence: 三條不混淆的流路示意。
能量轉換與損失位置的標註。
能用自己的話說明鍋爐、汽缸與連桿各自的作用。
evidenceEn: A schematic with three distinct fluid paths.
Annotations locating energy conversions and losses.
An independent explanation of the boiler, cylinder and connecting-rod roles.
pitfalls: 把火管內煙氣與管外水混成一條路徑。
把高壓當成無限能量來源而忽略熱輸入。
將博物館原理介紹當成壓力容器製造或點火程序。
pitfallsEn: Merging gases inside fire tubes with water outside them.
Treating pressure as unlimited energy without heat input.
Using museum interpretation as pressure-vessel fabrication or firing instructions.
guides.sourceNote: 依官方來源的工程原理原創編寫之學習活動；示例與驗收證據是學習要求，並非業主施工計畫、現場試驗資料或本網站已提供的量測資料。

guides.title: 師傅導讀：從駕駛室儀表建立機械狀態判讀
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Read mechanical state through cab instruments
guides.concept: 儀表顯示的量、閥件改變的量與機器真正的反應不一定相同。駕駛室導覽可以用來練習「控制—量測—回應」對照；Big Boy 4012 的靜態展示也提醒我們，外觀完整不等於已具備動態運轉資格。
guides.conceptEn: An indicated quantity, a valve’s commanded change and the machine’s response are different kinds of evidence. Use the cab tour to map control, measurement and response. Big Boy 4012’s static display also distinguishes appearance from operational readiness.
procedure: 觀看 NPS 駕駛室導覽，把確認名稱的儀表與控制件列成表；聽不清楚的項目保留待查。
每列寫下它量測或控制的物理量、操作者希望知道的狀態，以及還需要哪些獨立觀察。
設計一個純紙上案例：指示值不動，但其他相關跡象改變；提出儀表失靈與系統狀態不變兩個假說，避免先指定原因。
比較 NPS 對靜態展示與完成運轉整修機車的說明，整理外觀修復、功能檢查與運轉驗證屬於不同證據層級。
procedureEn: Watch the NPS cab tour and tabulate instruments and controls whose names you can verify. Leave uncertain items unresolved.
For each, state the physical quantity, the condition the crew needs to infer and any independent observation required.
Create a paper case where one indication stays fixed while related signs change. Compare a faulty instrument with an unchanged process as competing hypotheses.
Compare NPS descriptions of static display and operational overhaul. Separate cosmetic restoration, functional checks and operating validation as distinct evidence levels.
evidence: 含已確認與待查項目的儀表功能表。
一項指示異常的兩個假說及區分方法。
說明為何看見閥件或輪子就不能判定機車可投入運轉。
evidenceEn: An instrument-function table separating verified and unresolved items.
Two hypotheses and discriminating evidence for an anomalous indication.
An explanation of why visible controls or wheels do not establish operating readiness.
pitfalls: 認為所有機車的閥件配置與操作邏輯相同。
把儀表讀值直接視為完整機械狀態。
忽略靜態展車與動態運轉機車的不同驗證要求。
pitfallsEn: Assuming all locomotives share the same valve arrangement and operating logic.
Treating one indication as the full mechanical state.
Ignoring the different evidence required for static display and operation.
guides.sourceNote: 依官方來源的工程原理原創編寫之學習活動；示例與驗收證據是學習要求，並非業主施工計畫、現場試驗資料或本網站已提供的量測資料。
guides.sourceNoteEn: Original learning activities based on principles in official sources. Examples and evidence are learning requirements, not an owner-approved method statement, field test data, or measurement datasets supplied by this website.

guides.concept: 原型出廠、首次飛行與量產是不同的證據階段。公開研製史可以練習系統工程追溯，不能推導未公開性能或製造細節。
guides.conceptEn: Prototype rollout, first flight and production are different evidence stages. Public history supports traceability exercises, not inference of undisclosed performance or manufacturing details.
procedure: 從漢翔經國號頁面摘錄事件名稱與日期，各自保留來源位置。
把事件分類為組裝完成、功能展示或生產里程碑；分類屬教學判讀。
為每一類寫出它能證明與不能證明的事項，例如首飛不等於所有可靠度驗證完成。
用原創時間軸連結事件，未知試驗項目明確留白。
procedureEn: Record event names and dates from the AIDC IDF page with source locations.
Classify assembly completion, functional demonstration and production milestones as a teaching interpretation.
State what each can and cannot establish; first flight does not prove every reliability test.
Draw an original timeline and leave undisclosed tests unknown.
evidence: 事件、日期、來源的對照表。
至少兩項沒有被公開事件充分支持的主張。
evidenceEn: A table linking events, dates and sources.
At least two claims not established by the public events.
pitfalls: 把單一成功展示當作整套工程取證完成。
由照片比例反推敏感或未公開結構參數。
pitfallsEn: Treating one demonstration as complete qualification.
Inferring sensitive or undisclosed dimensions from image proportions.

guides.titleEn: Aircraft parts: choosing measurement and inspection methods
guides.concept: 尺寸量測和缺陷檢測回答不同問題。漢翔公開品質頁列出的三次元量測、雷射追蹤與無損檢測可作為分類素材。
guides.conceptEn: Dimensional metrology and defect detection answer different questions. AIDC publicly lists coordinate measurement, laser tracking and nondestructive inspection as useful classification examples.
procedure: 畫一個非飛行用途的簡化接頭，標出孔位、外形與假想內部缺陷。
把每個問題寫成可觀察量：孔中心位置、形狀誤差或缺陷指示。
依官方公開方法建立候選量測表，不填入不存在的設備解析度。
解釋為何尺寸合格仍不足以排除內部缺陷，列出尚缺的檢驗依據。
procedureEn: Draw a nonflying conceptual joint with holes, shape and hypothetical internal flaws.
Express each question as an observable: hole center, form error or flaw indication.
Map candidates from the publicly listed methods without inventing instrument resolution.
Explain why dimensional acceptance does not exclude internal damage and list missing evidence.
evidence: 幾何問題、材料缺陷與候選工具的三欄表。
量測基準、尺度與未知能力的紀錄。
evidenceEn: A table separating geometry, material flaws and candidate tools.
Records of datums, scale and unknown capabilities.
pitfalls: 把沒有檢出當作已證明沒有缺陷。
把教育分類當作可執行的軍機檢修程序。
pitfallsEn: Equating nondetection with proven absence.
Treating the exercise as an executable military-aircraft maintenance procedure.
guides.sourceScope: 來源支持公開背景或原理；以下步驟與驗收是原創教學推演，不是原廠SOP。使用自行繪製的示意或自行取得的合法資料，未附實測數據。

guides.title: 旋翼推力與反扭矩的概念平衡
guides.titleEn: Conceptual rotor thrust and reaction-torque balance
guides.concept: 旋翼盤推力、重量與機身反扭矩是不同的量。使用FAA通用直升機原理，建立沒有武器或特定機型參數的力與力矩圖。
guides.conceptEn: Rotor thrust, weight and fuselage reaction torque are distinct quantities. Use general FAA helicopter principles to draw forces and moments without weapon systems or model-specific parameters.
procedure: 畫出理想懸停示意，分別標記重力、推力與旋翼扭矩。
以符號而非真機數字檢查力平衡與力矩平衡。
比較改變總推力與改變推力方向的概念差異。
列出示意沒有涵蓋的非定常氣動、結構彈性及控制限制。
procedureEn: Draw an ideal hover and label gravity, thrust and rotor torque separately.
Use symbols rather than aircraft values to check force and moment balance.
Compare changing total thrust with changing its direction.
List omitted unsteady aerodynamics, flexibility and control limits.
evidence: 單位一致的受力與力矩示意。
對模型適用範圍的清楚說明。
evidenceEn: Force and moment diagrams with consistent units.
A clear statement of model applicability.
pitfalls: 把扭矩與升力直接相加。
把民用概念公式用作阿帕契性能改良或飛控設計。
pitfallsEn: Adding torque directly to lift.
Using the concept exercise to optimize Apache performance or flight controls.

guides.title: 把安全觀察變成可追溯的檢查紀錄
guides.titleEn: Turn safety observations into traceable inspection records
guides.concept: 本練習只建立桌面檢查紀錄格式。可見異常、原因假設與處置是三個不同欄位，不能從短片直接取得實機操作資格。
guides.conceptEn: This is a desk exercise in inspection records. Visible anomalies, causal hypotheses and disposition belong in separate fields; a short video does not qualify someone to operate an aircraft.
procedure: 選擇影片提到的一個通用安全情境，只記錄片中實際說明。
建立觀察、時間、來源、假設與待確認事項欄位。
把可直接觀察與需要合格人員判讀的項目分開。
用第二人複核紀錄是否能重現觀察，不對實機執行檢修。
procedureEn: Select one generic safety situation and record only what the video states.
Create fields for observation, time, source, hypothesis and unresolved questions.
Separate visible evidence from matters requiring qualified personnel.
Have another person reproduce the observation from the record without working on an aircraft.
evidence: 有來源時間位置的桌面紀錄表。
每項未知皆有明確待確認標記。
evidenceEn: A desk record with source time locations.
Explicit pending-verification flags for unknowns.
pitfalls: 把原因猜測寫成已確認故障。
省略影片未涵蓋事項而假裝完整檢查單。

guides.concept: 靜水壓概念可寫為p=p0+ρgh，但這不是耐壓殼安全公式。WHOI的Alvin改建報導顯示壓力艙需經專業試驗；本練習不設計可載人的殼體。

procedure: 用示意圖定義水面基準、深度與內外壓力。

讀取WHOI公開試驗敘述，列出仍未知的設計與認證資料。

Compare two depths symbolically at assumed constant density, without naval specifications.
Explain why pressure load, material strength and instability are different questions.
Read the public WHOI test account and list design or certification evidence still unknown.
evidence: 有假設與單位的壓力示意。

Treating one pressure test as proof of unlimited life.

guides.title: 用授權決策表理解零信任

guides.concept: NIST將政策引擎、政策管理與執行點分成邏輯角色。教學重點是每個資源請求的明確授權與撤銷，不是把VPN改名。

procedure: 用虛構使用者、裝置與文件建立小型資源清單，不使用真實憑證。
寫出身分、角色、裝置狀態與資源敏感度的判定欄位。
為允許、拒絕和撤銷各做一個紙上案例，標出PE、PA與PEP的角色。
記錄決策理由與事件ID，確認無權限者不能僅因在內網而通過。
procedureEn: Create fictional users, devices and documents without real credentials.
Define identity, role, device posture and resource sensitivity fields.
Work one allow, deny and revoke case on paper, identifying PE, PA and PEP roles.
Record reasons and event IDs; network location alone must not authorize access.
evidence: 三種決策的輸入、輸出與理由表。
可指出每個執行點保護的資源。
evidenceEn: Input, output and reasoning for three decisions.

pitfallsEn: Equating authentication with universal authorization.

guides.concept: 備份完成訊息不等於可恢復。以無敏感資料的獨立測試資料夾，驗證完整性、復原順序與負責人，呼應CSF 2.0 Recover。
guides.conceptEn: A successful backup message does not prove recoverability. Use an isolated folder of nonsensitive test files to verify integrity, restoration order and ownership, consistent with CSF 2.0 Recover.
procedure: 先建立可重新產生的假資料與預期檔案清單。
在獨立測試位置恢復副本，保留原始檔，不覆寫正式資料。
比較檔名、雜湊及必要開啟測試；有差異就記錄原因。
記錄恢復所需時間、缺少的權限或金鑰，以及下一次改善項目。
procedureEn: Create reproducible dummy files and an expected inventory.
Restore to an isolated location, preserving originals and production data.
Compare names, hashes and required open tests; record discrepancies.
Record elapsed recovery time, missing permissions or keys, and improvements.
evidence: 可重跑的假資料清單與比對結果。
含責任人與未決事項的演練紀錄。
evidenceEn: A reproducible dummy-data inventory and comparison.
An exercise record with ownership and unresolved issues.

只驗檔案存在而未驗內容完整。

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：防禦性資訊安全網路

guides.concept: 以身分、資源與復原證據連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。 原有步驟及進度識別完整保留。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect identity, resources and recovery evidence through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation. Existing steps and progress identities are preserved.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「資產身分」的資料、控制與時間關係。IP 可能改變，資產鍵需維持穩定。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「合併兩次假想盤點並查重。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「風險排序」的資料、控制與時間關係。風險需同時考慮影響與暴露條件。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較相同分數但不同損失案例。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「政策決策」的資料、控制與時間關係。政策決策點與執行點有不同失效邊界。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「模擬政策服務不可用的結果。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「遙測覆蓋」的資料、控制與時間關係。缺少感測器與沒有事件不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「將資料缺口與零值分開呈現。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「證據保全」的資料、控制與時間關係。摘要證明位元一致，不證明內容真實。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「記錄取得時間、來源與雜湊。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「控制審查」的資料、控制與時間關係。控制需可追溯至責任與證據。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立例外到期與重審清單。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for asset identity. IPs may change; asset keys must remain stable. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Merge two synthetic inventories and check duplicates. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for risk ranking. Risk combines impact and exposure conditions. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare equal scores with different losses. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for policy decisions. Decision and enforcement points fail differently. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Model policy-service unavailability. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for telemetry coverage. Missing sensors differ from absent incidents. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Separate gaps from zero-valued events. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for evidence preservation. Hashes show byte identity, not factual truth. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Record acquisition time, source and hash. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for control review. Controls need accountable owners and evidence. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Create exception expiry and review records. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「備份復原」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「以虛構資料驗證還原及權限。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「控制審查」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「控制需可追溯至責任與證據。」。
提交「控制審查」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立例外到期與重審清單。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit backup recovery input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit control review two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit control review input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：高告警數必定代表高精確率。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: More alerts necessarily mean higher precision. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.title: 車身焊裝的定位與尺寸追溯
guides.titleEn: Body joining: locating and dimensional traceability
guides.concept: 車門間隙與外板位置受前段定位、接合及活動件調整共同影響。這是公差鏈的概念練習，不重建Ferrari治具或使用其產品尺寸。
guides.conceptEn: Door gaps and panel position reflect locating, joining and moving-part adjustment. This is a tolerance-chain exercise, not a reconstruction of Ferrari fixtures or product dimensions.
procedure: 畫出車身開口與車門的簡化輪廓，指定共同基準。
用符號誤差表示治具定位、接合變形與裝配調整。
比較一致偏移和局部變形對四周間隙的不同影響。
製作量測點表，說明為何只看一個間隙不足以定位原因。
procedureEn: Draw a simplified body opening and door with shared datums.
Represent fixture error, joining deformation and adjustment symbolically.
Compare uniform displacement with local deformation around the opening.
Create a measurement-point table and explain why one gap cannot locate a cause.
evidence: 有基準、方向與量測點的原創示意。
能區分整體偏移與局部形變的判讀。
evidenceEn: An original schematic with datums, directions and measurement points.
A diagnosis separating rigid shift from local deformation.
pitfalls: 把外觀合格等同於接頭強度合格。
將來源文章特定車型數值當通用放行標準。
pitfallsEn: Equating cosmetic acceptance with joint strength.
Applying an article’s model-specific dimensions as universal limits.
guides.sourceScope: 來源支持公開背景或原理；以下步驟與驗收是原創教學推演，不是原廠SOP。使用自行繪製的示意或自行取得的合法資料，未附實測數據。
guides.sourceScopeEn: The source supports public context or principles. Procedures and checks are original educational exercises, not a manufacturer SOP. Use self-drawn models or lawfully obtained evidence; no measured dataset is bundled.

guides.title: 從鑄造到整車的交接證據
guides.titleEn: Handoff evidence from casting to vehicle assembly
guides.concept: Ferrari的2022永續報告介紹鑄造、機加工、塗裝與總裝等生產功能。可據此練習每個工站必須交出什麼證據，不能當作當前所有車型流程。
guides.conceptEn: Ferrari’s 2022 report outlines functions including casting, machining, painting and assembly. Use them to study handoff evidence, not to claim the current route of every model.
procedure: 依報告畫出功能流程，註明資料年份。
挑選一個自創的非產品專屬零件，列出毛坯、加工與檢查介面。
為每個交接點指定尺寸、表面或追溯證據之一。
加入一個假想不合格案例，畫出隔離與原因回查，而不是任意返工。
procedureEn: Map production functions and label the report year.
Choose a fictional generic part and define blank, machining and inspection interfaces.
Assign dimensional, surface or traceability evidence to each handoff.
Add one hypothetical nonconformance with quarantine and investigation rather than arbitrary rework.
evidence: 帶年份與假設標籤的工站圖。
每個交接點都有明確輸入輸出。
evidenceEn: A station map labeled with year and assumptions.
Explicit input and output at each handoff.
pitfalls: 把不同世代車型的流程拼成一條實際產線。
缺乏資料仍自行填入加工公差。
pitfallsEn: Combining vehicle generations into a claimed actual line.
Inventing machining tolerances when evidence is absent.
guides.sourceScope: 來源支持公開背景或原理；以下步驟與驗收是原創教學推演，不是原廠SOP。使用自行繪製的示意或自行取得的合法資料，未附實測數據。
guides.sourceScopeEn: The source supports public context or principles. Procedures and checks are original educational exercises, not a manufacturer SOP. Use self-drawn models or lawfully obtained evidence; no measured dataset is bundled.

guides.title: 從工廠影像建立物流與節拍假設
guides.titleEn: Build material-flow and takt hypotheses from factory visuals
guides.concept: 短片可支持工站與搬運方式的觀察，不能可靠量得實際產能。把可見事實與教學假設分開，才能用來理解瓶頸。
guides.conceptEn: A short film supports observation of stations and handling, not reliable throughput measurement. Separate visible facts from teaching assumptions before reasoning about bottlenecks.
procedure: 從影片選三個可辨識工站，以自己的文字記錄畫面。
畫出物料流與人員活動區，不臆測封閉區域。
自行設定明確標示為假設的三站週期，用最慢站討論理想瓶頸。
加入停機或重工的概念影響，說明為何影片剪輯長度不能當週期時間。
procedureEn: Choose three identifiable stations and describe visible evidence in your own words.
Map material flow and human areas without guessing hidden regions.
Assign explicitly hypothetical cycle times and discuss the slowest ideal station.
Discuss downtime or rework and explain why shot duration is not cycle time.
evidence: 事實與假設分欄的流程圖。
可重算的假設節拍表，未宣稱Tesla實測產能。
evidenceEn: A flow map separating observation and assumption.
A reproducible hypothetical timing table, not measured Tesla capacity.
pitfalls: 用快轉或剪輯片段推導真實UPH。
把一座工廠畫面套用所有車型及工廠。
pitfallsEn: Deriving real UPH from edited or accelerated footage.
Applying one factory’s visuals to all plants and models.

guides.title: 電池熱管理：散熱、均溫與故障隔離
guides.titleEn: Battery thermal management: cooling, uniformity and isolation
guides.concept: 電池熱管理同時關注溫度、溫差與異常傳播。Tesla的公開說明描述分層設計；本練習只用低風險的符號熱網路，不拆電池或進行失效試驗。
guides.conceptEn: Battery thermal management concerns temperature, gradients and fault propagation. Tesla describes layered design publicly; this exercise uses symbolic thermal networks without dismantling packs or inducing failures.
procedure: 畫出電芯、介面、冷卻端的R-C概念網路。
以自定但清楚標示的假設比較單顆高溫與全包均溫。
把主動冷卻、溫度偵測與被動隔離分成不同功能。
列出真實驗證仍需的材料、邊界條件與感測位置，未知不自行補值。
procedureEn: Draw an R-C concept network for cells, interfaces and cooling.
Use clearly labeled assumptions to compare one hot cell with pack-wide uniformity.
Separate active cooling, sensing and passive isolation functions.
List material data, boundaries and sensor locations needed for real validation; leave unknowns unresolved.
evidence: 功能分明的熱網路與假設表。
能說明平均溫度不足以代表局部安全。
evidenceEn: A thermal network and explicit assumptions.
An explanation of why average temperature cannot establish local safety.
pitfalls: 把概念計算當作電池包安全認證。
對真實電芯短路、穿刺或拆解。
pitfallsEn: Treating a concept calculation as battery-pack certification.
Shorting, puncturing or disassembling real cells.
guides.sourceScope: 來源支持公開背景或原理；以下步驟與驗收是原創教學推演，不是原廠SOP。使用自行繪製的示意或自行取得的合法資料，未附實測數據。
guides.sourceScopeEn: The source supports public context or principles. Procedures and checks are original educational exercises, not a manufacturer SOP. Use self-drawn models or lawfully obtained evidence; no measured dataset is bundled.

guides.title: 低軌網路的資料路徑與子系統
guides.titleEn: Data paths and subsystems of a low-orbit network
guides.concept: 使用者無線鏈路、衛星間光鏈路與地面網路是不同介面。Starlink官方技術頁可支援功能分類，但不同代衛星的數量及性能不能混用。
guides.conceptEn: User radio links, optical intersatellite links and ground networking are distinct interfaces. Starlink’s technology page supports functional classification, but hardware generations must not be mixed.
procedure: 畫出終端、衛星、地面接入與網際網路的概念路徑。
為光鏈路與無線鏈路使用不同線型，將可選路徑標示為概念。
另外畫電力、姿態與通訊載荷的功能關係，不加入衛星建造參數。
將每項硬體主張標註來源日期與世代；無世代資訊就不填精確數量。
procedureEn: Draw a conceptual path through terminal, satellite, ground access and internet.
Distinguish optical and radio links and label optional paths conceptual.
Map power, attitude and communication-payload functions without build parameters.
Label hardware claims by source date and generation; omit exact counts when generation is unclear.
evidence: 兩種鏈路與各介面的功能表。
沒有把不同衛星世代數據合併的來源紀錄。
evidenceEn: A functional table of links and interfaces.
A source record that keeps satellite generations separate.
pitfalls: 把軌道高度直接當完整連線延遲。
把所有資料流都假定經同一種鏈路。
pitfallsEn: Equating orbital altitude with complete network latency.
Assuming all traffic takes the same link type.

guides.title: 安全地點的天空遮擋評估
guides.titleEn: Assess sky obstruction from a safe location
guides.concept: 移動中的低軌衛星需要合適天空視野。遮擋評估與通訊故障診斷不同；本練習使用地面安全位置或自備示意，沒有高處安裝要求。
guides.conceptEn: Moving low-orbit satellites need suitable sky visibility. Obstruction assessment differs from diagnosing every network fault. Use safe ground-level locations or your own diagram, with no elevated installation required.
procedure: 依官方支援頁辨識遮蔽物類型與終端視野。
若已有相容裝置，在安全地面位置依官方App指引比較候選地點；否則畫示意。
記錄同一視角下的樹木、屋簷與其他遮擋，避免以手機位置替代不同終端位置。
把遮擋發現與網路擁塞、供電或線材問題分開，不把所有中斷歸同一原因。
procedureEn: Identify obstruction types and terminal field of view from official support.
If a compatible setup is available, compare safe ground-level sites using the official app; otherwise draw a diagram.
Record trees, eaves and obstructions from a consistent viewpoint.
Separate obstruction findings from congestion, power or cable issues rather than assigning one cause to every interruption.
evidence: 候選位置與一致觀察條件的紀錄。
可區分遮擋與其他故障假設的比較表。
evidenceEn: Records of candidate locations and consistent observation conditions.
A comparison separating obstruction from other fault hypotheses.
pitfalls: 假定任何地區均已提供相同服務。
為了取得視野自行攀爬或改裝天線。
pitfallsEn: Assuming identical service availability everywhere.
Climbing or modifying antennas merely to obtain a view.

guides.title: 相位移光罩工程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Phase-shift mask engineering: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「以複數平面表示兩束等振幅光」建立判讀邊界。相位差決定相長或相消干涉。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Represent equal-amplitude fields in the complex plane to define the interpretation boundary. Phase difference controls constructive or destructive interference. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜以複數平面表示兩束等振幅光：相位差決定相長或相消干涉。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜對密集與孤立線比較成像對比：一種相位配置不會同等改善所有圖形。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查：設計可印性與光罩可製造性需共同成立。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Represent equal-amplitude fields in the complex plane: Phase difference controls constructive or destructive interference. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Compare imaging contrast for dense and isolated lines: One phase scheme does not improve every pattern equally. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Review phase assignment and imaging window together: Printability and mask manufacturability must both hold. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「對密集與孤立線比較成像對比」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Compare imaging contrast for dense and isolated lines: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review phase assignment and imaging window together to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「只需把兩束光強相加。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「最佳焦點改善代表所有焦距都改善。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Simply add the two intensities.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Better best-focus imaging proves improvement at every focus.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 極紫外曝光製程整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: EUV exposure process integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出光源至晶圓的反射路徑」建立判讀邊界。EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Sketch the reflective source-to-wafer path to define the interpretation boundary. Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure:
觀察站 1｜畫出光源至晶圓的反射路徑：EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
用乘積得到 24.01 與 20.58，不可把反射率直接相加。
觀察站 2｜建立焦距劑量矩陣的取樣順序：隨機化順序有助於分離漂移。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜提出具缺陷、尺寸與電性證據的整合評審：整合成熟度需要多種獨立證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn:
Observation station 1 | Sketch the reflective source-to-wafer path: Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Use products to obtain 24.01 and 20.58; do not add reflectivities.
Observation station 2 | Design sampling order for a focus–dose matrix: Randomized order helps separate drift. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Review integration with defect, dimensional and electrical evidence: Integration maturity requires several independent evidence types. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建立焦距劑量矩陣的取樣順序」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提出具缺陷、尺寸與電性證據的整合評審」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Design sampling order for a focus–dose matrix: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review integration with defect, dimensional and electrical evidence to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「EUV 可直接套用透射玻璃鏡頭。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「套刻合格就不會發生隨機斷線。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "EUV can directly use transmitting glass lenses.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Good overlay prevents stochastic breaks.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 套刻誤差量測與補償：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Overlay metrology and compensation: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出上下兩層的相對位置向量」建立判讀邊界。套刻需要共同座標與方向定義。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw relative-placement vectors between two layers to define the interpretation boundary. Overlay needs common coordinates and sign conventions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出上下兩層的相對位置向量：套刻需要共同座標與方向定義。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜以重複量測估計再現性：重複性不代表對真值的準確度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付模型係數與不確定度報告：可追溯補償需要資料、模型及限制。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw relative-placement vectors between two layers: Overlay needs common coordinates and sign conventions. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Estimate repeatability from repeated measurement: Repeatability is not accuracy relative to truth. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver model coefficients and uncertainty: Traceable correction needs data, model and limitations. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「以重複量測估計再現性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付模型係數與不確定度報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Estimate repeatability from repeated measurement: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver model coefficients and uncertainty to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「線寬合格就能證明套刻合格。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「量測工具不會產生系統偏差。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Passing linewidth proves acceptable overlay.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Metrology tools cannot introduce systematic bias.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 平面 CMOS 製程整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Planar CMOS process integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「互補反相器」建立判讀邊界。NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw a complementary inverter to define the interpretation boundary. NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜互補反相器：檢查結果是否能支持「NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜矽化物形成：檢查結果是否能支持「導電接觸反應也會消耗表面矽。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜整合流程審查：檢查結果是否能支持「步驟可單獨合格仍可能在相互作用後失敗。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw a complementary inverter: Check whether the evidence supports: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Assess silicide formation: Check whether the evidence supports: Conductive contact reactions also consume surface silicon. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Review the integrated flow: Check whether the evidence supports: Individually acceptable steps can fail through integration interactions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「矽化物形成」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合流程審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Assess silicide formation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review the integrated flow to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「互補反相器」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「矽化物形成」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw a complementary inverter and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess silicide formation and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 鰭式電晶體製造：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: FinFET fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「三面閘控制」建立判讀邊界。閘對鰭側壁與頂面的控制不同於平面元件。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw three-sided gate control to define the interpretation boundary. Gate control over fin sides and top differs from planar devices. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜三面閘控制：檢查結果是否能支持「閘對鰭側壁與頂面的控制不同於平面元件。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜三維介電覆蓋：檢查結果是否能支持「頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜FinFET 整合驗收：檢查結果是否能支持「靜電、電阻、變異與標準元件效能需一起審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw three-sided gate control: Check whether the evidence supports: Gate control over fin sides and top differs from planar devices. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Assess 3D dielectric coverage: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept FinFET integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Review electrostatics, resistance, variability and cell performance jointly. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「三維介電覆蓋」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「FinFET 整合驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Assess 3D dielectric coverage: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept FinFET integration to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「三面閘控制」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「三維介電覆蓋」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw three-sided gate control and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess 3d dielectric coverage and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

procedure: 觀察站 1｜垂直互補配置：檢查結果是否能支持「CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜前側底層接觸：檢查結果是否能支持「底層接觸需穿越或繞過上層結構。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜CFET 證據地圖：檢查結果是否能支持「隔離、雙極性、接觸、電路與重現性需分層報告。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw vertical complementary stacking: Check whether the evidence supports: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Trace frontside bottom contacts: Check whether the evidence supports: Bottom contacts from the front must pass or bypass upper structures. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Assemble a CFET evidence map: Check whether the evidence supports: Report isolation, both polarities, contacts, circuits and repeatability separately. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.title: 奈米片內側間隔層製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Nanosheet inner-spacer fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「內外間隔差別」建立判讀邊界。內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate inner and outer spacers to define the interpretation boundary. Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜內外間隔差別：檢查結果是否能支持「內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜低介電材料：檢查結果是否能支持「低介電常數不保證機械與化學耐受。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜間隔模組放行：檢查結果是否能支持「尺寸、覆蓋、低電容及釋放後存活須共同成立。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate inner and outer spacers: Check whether the evidence supports: Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Compare low-k materials: Check whether the evidence supports: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the spacer module: Check whether the evidence supports: Dimensions, coverage, capacitance and post-release survival must all hold. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「低介電材料」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「間隔模組放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare low-k materials: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release the spacer module to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「內外間隔差別」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「低介電材料」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate inner and outer spacers and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare low-k materials and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 微影隨機缺陷分析：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Lithographic stochastic-defect analysis: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「區分線邊粗糙度與離散失敗事件」建立判讀邊界。連續變異與罕見事件需要不同指標。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish line-edge roughness from discrete failures to define the interpretation boundary. Continuous variation and rare failures need different metrics. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜區分線邊粗糙度與離散失敗事件：連續變異與罕見事件需要不同指標。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜以相同線寬比較不同劑量條件：幾何改變會混淆純劑量效應。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付帶信賴區間與限制的缺陷報告：明確分母與不確定度才使結果可比較。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish line-edge roughness from discrete failures: Continuous variation and rare failures need different metrics. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Compare doses at matched linewidth: Geometry changes confound dose-only effects. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a defect report with confidence intervals and limits: Explicit denominators and uncertainty enable comparison. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「以相同線寬比較不同劑量條件」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付帶信賴區間與限制的缺陷報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare doses at matched linewidth: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a defect report with confidence intervals and limits to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「零觀察缺陷就表示缺陷率為零。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「所有缺陷都只由光子數決定。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Zero observed defects means zero defect probability.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Photon count alone determines every defect.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 晶圓廠自動搬運系統：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Automated material handling in fabs: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識載具與批號」建立判讀邊界。載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify carriers and lots to define the interpretation boundary. Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識載具與批號：檢查結果是否能支持「載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜瓶頸利用率：檢查結果是否能支持「高平均車速不能證明最繁忙路段不塞車。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜搬運系統驗收：檢查結果是否能支持「產能、錯送防護、故障恢復及潔淨度均需證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify carriers and lots: Check whether the evidence supports: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Measure bottleneck utilization: Check whether the evidence supports: High average speed does not exclude congestion on a busy segment. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept the transport system: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs throughput, misdelivery prevention, recovery and cleanliness evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「瓶頸利用率」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「搬運系統驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure bottleneck utilization: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept the transport system to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。 應回到「辨識載具與批號」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：已派工與已送達可使用同一狀態。 應回到「瓶頸利用率」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify carriers and lots and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Assigned and delivered can share one state. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure bottleneck utilization and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with One-transistor one-capacitor storage: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜1T1C 儲存：建立模型：讀出擾動儲存電荷並需要恢復；位元線電容影響電荷共享電壓。
觀察站 2｜機械支撐：建立模型：高度增加同時提高機械整合難度；乾燥表面力可拉倒高柱結構。
觀察站 3｜電容整合審查：故障判讀與驗證：電性與結構證據需相互對應；電容結構合格不等於整個感測放大器合格。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | One-transistor one-capacitor storage: construct and analyze: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration; Bitline capacitance affects charge-sharing voltage.
Observation station 2 | Mechanical support: construct and analyze: Greater height also raises mechanical integration difficulty; Drying forces can collapse tall structures.
Observation station 3 | Capacitor integration review: diagnose and verify: Electrical and structural evidence must correspond; Capacitor quality does not qualify sense amplifiers.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「機械支撐：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「電容整合審查：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Mechanical support: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Capacitor integration review: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把 DRAM 讀取當成完全不改變電容電荷」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「只加高電容而忽略結構支撐」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating DRAM read as entirely nondisturbing", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Increasing height without considering support", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.title: 由三張 DRIE 顯微圖區分深寬比、側壁波紋與失敗原因
guides.titleEn: Separate aspect-ratio effects, scallops and failures in three DRIE micrographs
guides.concept: 同樣是深反應式離子蝕刻，開口幾何、側壁鈍化與循環條件會在影像中留下不同證據。把影像觀察和原因假說分開，才能避免看到缺陷就直接猜一組設備參數。
guides.conceptEn: Opening geometry, sidewall passivation and process cycles leave different evidence in DRIE images. Separate observations from causal hypotheses before proposing changes.
procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。
在原圖上辨認開口寬度、深度、側壁角與波紋；使用同張圖的比例尺換算，不能直接比較縮圖像素。
把可直接觀察到的事實寫在左欄，深寬比傳輸限制、鈍化不足等假說寫在右欄。
為每項假說列出缺少的實驗紀錄，例如循環歷程、材料、遮罩與取樣位置；這些資料未隨照片提供。
設計一個控制變因的比較計畫，先訂觀察指標與停止條件；交付教學分析，不操作未受訓的蝕刻設備。
procedureEn: Open the full etch-depth, micropillar and DRIE-failure images. Record author, specimen and scale bar.
Identify opening width, depth, sidewall angle and scallops. Calibrate within each image using its scale bar; do not compare thumbnail pixels directly.
Place direct observations in one column and hypotheses such as transport limitation or insufficient passivation in another.
List missing records for each hypothesis: cycle history, materials, mask and sampling location. These records are not supplied with the photographs.
Design a controlled comparison with observation metrics and stop conditions. Deliver an educational analysis; do not operate etch tools without training.
evidence: 交付三張圖的觀察表與至少兩個可被額外量測推翻的假說。
標註同一張照片不代表不同製程條件的對照實驗。
evidenceEn: Deliver an observation table and at least two hypotheses falsifiable by additional measurements.
State that a single photograph does not constitute a controlled comparison across process conditions.
pitfalls: 把影像中亮暗直接當成材料成分。
把代表照片當成本站每一步的實拍結果。
pitfallsEn: Equating image brightness directly with composition.
Treating representative photographs as measured outcomes of every site activity.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Defect units: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects. procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Defect units: construct and analyze: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects; One defect may appear on several layers.
Observation station 2 | Spatial patterns: construct and analyze: Spatial patterns suggest causes without proving uniqueness; Edge exclusion changes visible patterns.
Observation station 3 | Improvement verification: diagnose and verify: Inspection-sensitivity changes can mimic process improvement; Improvement reviews need comparable products/pattern mixes.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Use Improvement verification: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Equating detection count with failed-die count", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.title: 製程統計管制系統：影像判讀與證據工作簿

guides.concept: 先用「規格與控制：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：控制線描述製程行為，規格線描述需求。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。

guides.title: 晶圓表面清洗：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer surface cleaning: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「污染分類」建立判讀邊界。粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Classify contaminants to define the interpretation boundary. Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜污染分類：檢查結果是否能支持「粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜沖洗置換模型：檢查結果是否能支持「僅靠出口平均值可能漏掉滯留區。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜潔淨交接單：檢查結果是否能支持「移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Classify contaminants: Check whether the evidence supports: Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Model rinse displacement: Check whether the evidence supports: Outlet averages can miss stagnant regions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Complete the cleanliness handoff: Check whether the evidence supports: Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「沖洗置換模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「潔淨交接單」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Model rinse displacement: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete the cleanliness handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「污染分類」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

觀察站 3｜污染控制報告：檢查結果是否能支持「來源、傳輸、沉積與電性後果應分層呈現。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Map contamination sources: Check whether the evidence supports: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Audit container extractables: Check whether the evidence supports: Chemical purity depends on packaging and contact duration. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Compile the control dossier: Check whether the evidence supports: Report source, transport, deposition and electrical consequence separately. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「容器浸出物」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「污染控制報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Audit container extractables: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Compile the control dossier to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「建立污染源地圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：濾膜截留尺寸等同所有污染物去除率。 應回到「容器浸出物」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map contamination sources and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Membrane retention size equals removal efficiency for every contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for audit container extractables and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Fab and supply chain: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜工廠與供應鏈：建立模型：GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方；廠區公開位置不等於內部設備座標。

觀察站 3｜公開案例審查：故障判讀與驗證：公開績效不能反推出專有控制配方；廣告目標與已量測成果應分開。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Fab and supply chain: construct and analyze: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe; Public fab locations do not expose tool positions.
Observation station 2 | Redundancy and switching: construct and analyze: Duplicated equipment may share failure causes; Shared controllers can be single failure points.
Observation station 3 | Public-case review: diagnose and verify: Public performance does not reveal proprietary control recipes; Separate announced targets from measured achievements.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「冗餘與切換：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Redundancy and switching: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Public-case review: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「用企業名稱推斷所有內部製程完全相同」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Inferring identical internal flows from a company name", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assuming two devices guarantee complete fault tolerance", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。

把可直接觀察到的事實寫在左欄，深寬比傳輸限制、鈍化不足等假說寫在右欄。

guides.concept: 先用「質量彈簧：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Mass and spring: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Static approximation needs operation below resonance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜質量彈簧：建立模型：靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。
觀察站 2｜沾黏：建立模型：表面力可能勝過微結構回復力；防沾黏表面也需相容性驗證。
觀察站 3｜溫漂校正：故障判讀與驗證：零偏溫漂與比例溫漂是不同校正項；溫度遲滯需要往返循環檢查。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Mass and spring: construct and analyze: Static approximation needs operation below resonance; Dynamics also include damping and inertia.
Observation station 2 | Stiction: construct and analyze: Surface forces can exceed microstructure restoring force; Anti-stiction surfaces need compatibility checks.
Observation station 3 | Temperature calibration: diagnose and verify: Offset drift and scale drift are different corrections; Thermal hysteresis needs heating/cooling cycles.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「沾黏：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「溫漂校正：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Stiction: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Temperature calibration: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「元件重量很小就不可能被表面力拉住」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assuming low weight prevents surface-force sticking", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.title: 銅柱微凸塊製作：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Copper-pillar microbump fabrication: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 銅柱、焊帽及金屬間化合物不是同一層。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Distinguish copper pillar, solder cap and intermetallic layers. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：銅柱、焊帽及金屬間化合物不是同一層。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：需要截面元素分析與高度分布才能確認組成和共面性。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Distinguish copper pillar, solder cap and intermetallic layers. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Composition and coplanarity require cross-sectional composition and height data. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「需要截面元素分析與高度分布才能確認組成和共面性」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Composition and coplanarity require cross-sectional composition and height data, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「焊墊與凸塊座標」建立判讀邊界。焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Pad and bump coordinates to define the interpretation boundary. Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜焊墊與凸塊座標：疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜阻障與焊料帽：量測分層截面及帽體積，將金屬間化合物與未反應焊料分開。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜組裝交接與抽樣：交付可追溯晶粒地圖及不確定度，挑選邊緣條件樣本進行接合驗證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Pad and bump coordinates: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 2 | Barrier and solder cap: Measure layer-resolved cross-sections and cap volume; distinguish intermetallic from remaining solder. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 3 | Assembly handoff and sampling: Deliver traceable die maps with uncertainty and include edge-condition samples in bonding validation. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「阻障與焊料帽」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「組裝交接與抽樣」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Barrier and solder cap: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Assembly handoff and sampling to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：總凸塊高度能代替各層組成檢查。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

Avoid: Using total bump height instead of layer-composition checks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.concept: 壓力、溫度與接合時間共同影響接點。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Pressure, temperature and time jointly affect a joint. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：壓力、溫度與接合時間共同影響接點。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較接合前後的接點高度與四線電阻。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Pressure, temperature and time jointly affect a joint. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare joint height and four-wire resistance before and after bonding. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較接合前後的接點高度與四線電阻」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare joint height and four-wire resistance before and after bonding, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 熱壓接合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Thermocompression bonding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「接合堆疊剖面」建立判讀邊界。上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Bond-stack cross-section to define the interpretation boundary. Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜接合堆疊剖面：畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜氧化與潤濕證據：比較接合面、開路位置與良品對照，避免只用一张低倍率截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜接合窗口的轉移限制：列變更矩陣與保留條件，至少含幾何、電性、界面和熱循環證據。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Bond-stack cross-section: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 2 | Oxide and wetting evidence: Compare bond faces, open-site maps and good controls rather than one low-magnification section. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 3 | Limits of process-window transfer: Document changes and holds using geometric, electrical, interface and thermal-cycle evidence. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「氧化與潤濕證據」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「接合窗口的轉移限制」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Oxide and wetting evidence: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Limits of process-window transfer to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：高電阻一律表示加熱不足。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Attributing every high resistance to insufficient heating. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces to define the interpretation boundary. Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding. procedure: 觀察站 1｜銅與介電界面區分：畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 2 | Grain orientation and interface migration: Compare multisite sections or orientation analysis with electrical data and note sampling bias. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 3 | Interface qualification handoff: Assemble lot evidence and declare untested area or stress ranges. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
