guides.title: 晶圓對晶圓混合接合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 整片接合要同時管理局部對準及全域形變。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Whole-wafer bonding combines local alignment and global deformation. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：整片接合要同時管理局部對準及全域形變。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：繪出中心至邊緣的套刻誤差向量。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Whole-wafer bonding combines local alignment and global deformation. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Plot overlay-error vectors from center to edge. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「繪出中心至邊緣的套刻誤差向量」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Plot overlay-error vectors from center to edge, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.titleEn: Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「界定混合接合的兩種功能」建立判讀邊界。混合接合把介電層連接與嵌入金屬互連結合在同一界面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define the two functions of hybrid bonding to define the interpretation boundary. Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜界定混合接合的兩種功能：整片看似貼合，並不表示每個銅接點已導通。
觀察站 2｜區分粗糙度、凹陷與全片翹曲：教學例：1 µm 視窗的 0.2 nm RMS 與全片 20 µm bow 可同時存在；兩者不矛盾，也不能互相替代。
觀察站 3｜交付 W2W 資格證據封包：官方 2026 年 200 nm W2W 研究展示是有日期和試片範圍的里程碑；本課 1 µm 方墊算例不能被標為該流程複製。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define the two functions of hybrid bonding: Apparent full-area attachment does not prove continuity through every copper contact.

Observation station 2 | Distinguish roughness, recess and wafer bow: Teaching example: 0.2 nm RMS over a 1 µm window can coexist with 20 µm whole-wafer bow; neither contradicts nor replaces the other.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a W2W qualification-evidence package: The official 2026 200 nm W2W study is a dated test-vehicle milestone; this course's 1 µm square-pad examples are not reproductions of that flow.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「區分粗糙度、凹陷與全片翹曲」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付 W2W 資格證據封包」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Distinguish roughness, recess and wafer bow: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a W2W qualification-evidence package to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若把介電層畫成導線，重新檢查電流路徑與材料標記。
小區域很平不代表整片能無缺陷接觸。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If dielectric is drawn as a wire, revisit the current path and material labels.
A locally smooth area does not guarantee defect-free whole-wafer contact.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜已知良品置信度：比較前測、接合後測與失效定位。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜接合波與局部接觸：比較空洞形狀與接觸起點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜熱與資料交接：提交前後測配對資料及未驗證熱範圍。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Known-good-die confidence: Compare pre-bond, post-bond and localization data. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Bond-wave contact: Compare void shapes with contact initiation points. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Thermal and data handoff: Submit paired tests and unverified thermal ranges. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接合波與局部接觸」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「熱與資料交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Bond-wave contact: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Thermal and data handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：把前測通過當成永久良品。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：只看最終位置即可判斷接合完整。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating a pretest pass as permanently good. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Inferring bond completeness from final position. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 晶粒對晶粒堆疊：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Die-to-die stacking: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 垂直晶粒堆疊改變熱路徑與可測性。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Vertical die stacking changes heat paths and test access. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。以實際多晶片排列比較封裝幾何；不是 Foveros、SoIC 或混合接合剖面。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：垂直晶粒堆疊改變熱路徑與可測性。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：標示每一層的電源、訊號、熱及測試連接。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Compare physical multi-chip geometry; this is not a Foveros, SoIC or hybrid-bond cross-section.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Vertical die stacking changes heat paths and test access. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Mark power, signal, heat and test paths for each layer. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「標示每一層的電源、訊號、熱及測試連接」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Mark power, signal, heat and test paths for each layer, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 晶粒對晶粒堆疊：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Die-to-die stacking: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「面向與拓撲」建立判讀邊界。面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Orientation and topology to define the interpretation boundary. Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜面向與拓撲：畫每層訊號、電源和背面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜接合界面抽樣：列每一界面的可測量與盲區。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜失效拆解順序：制定先後順序及保留對照片。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Orientation and topology: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Interface sampling: List measurable quantities and blind spots per interface. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Failure-analysis order: Plan analysis order and retained controls. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接合界面抽樣」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「失效拆解順序」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Interface sampling: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Failure-analysis order to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：最上層影像可代表所有埋藏界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Reusing one net map for every orientation. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Using top-layer images for every buried interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 暫時膠層提供機械支撐但必須能移除。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: A temporary adhesive supports a wafer but must be removable. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：暫時膠層提供機械支撐但必須能移除。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用薄化前後翹曲及解接合後殘膠量評估。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

Mark this question on your own diagram: A temporary adhesive supports a wafer but must be removable. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Evaluate warpage around thinning and residue after debonding. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「用薄化前後翹曲及解接合後殘膠量評估」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Evaluate warpage around thinning and residue after debonding, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 晶圓暫時接合與解接合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Temporary wafer bonding and debonding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「載板材料選擇」建立判讀邊界。透明度、CTE、剛性和清潔相容性決定載板用途。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Carrier selection to define the interpretation boundary. Transparency, CTE, stiffness and cleaning compatibility determine carrier suitability. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜載板材料選擇：按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜化學與真空相容性：用見證件比質量、厚度和污染。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜完整轉移證據：提供三類資料與後段驗證保留點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Carrier selection: Build a material matrix against processing and release needs. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Chemical and vacuum compatibility: Compare witness mass, thickness and contamination. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Transfer evidence: Deliver all three evidence types and downstream hold points. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「化學與真空相容性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完整轉移證據」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Chemical and vacuum compatibility: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Transfer evidence to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：玻璃載板可自動相容所有雷射波長。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：外觀無裂紋即證明材料相容。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Assuming glass is compatible with every laser wavelength. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Using crack-free appearance as compatibility proof. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

建立量測計畫：外觀切縫不足以證明內部裂縫路徑。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。

Mark this question on your own diagram: Stealth dicing modifies material inside the wafer. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Visible kerfs alone do not establish the internal fracture path. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.

guides.conceptEn: Separate pickup/release error from optical registration error. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.

建立量測計畫：使用放置後位置分布與晶粒損傷率。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

guides.title: 模封材料與翹曲控制：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Molding compounds and warpage control: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 模封後曲率反映材料與固化歷史。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Post-mold curvature depends on material and cure history. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：模封後曲率反映材料與固化歷史。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測室溫及升溫翹曲而非只看平面外觀。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Post-mold curvature depends on material and cure history. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Measure room- and elevated-temperature warpage rather than appearance. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測室溫及升溫翹曲而非只看平面外觀」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Measure room- and elevated-temperature warpage rather than appearance, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 模封材料與翹曲控制：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Molding compounds and warpage control: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「材料組成」建立判讀邊界。樹脂、填料及界面決定流動與熱機性質。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Material composition to define the interpretation boundary. Resin, fillers and interfaces determine flow and thermomechanics. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜材料組成：將材料批次連到實測曲線。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜層合不對稱：比較上下對稱及偏置晶粒截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜模型校準與交接：保留一種厚度或溫度歷程作盲測。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Material composition: Link material lots to measured curves. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Laminate asymmetry: Compare symmetric and offset-die sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Model calibration and handoff: Hold out a thickness or thermal history for validation. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「層合不對稱」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「模型校準與交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Laminate asymmetry: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Model calibration and handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：相同填料百分比必有相同模數。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：總厚度相同必有相同翹曲。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Equating filler percentage with modulus. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Equating total thickness with warpage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 扇出型面板級封裝：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Fan-out panel-level packaging: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 面板尺度的形變不能直接套用晶圓補償。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Panel deformation is not automatically corrected by wafer models. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。晶圓照片只供圓形基材與尺度比較，不是面板級封裝製程的實拍。 辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：面板尺度的形變不能直接套用晶圓補償。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較全域尺度、局部形變及邊緣區良率。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The wafer photo provides circular-substrate/scale context, not footage of panel-level packaging. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Panel deformation is not automatically corrected by wafer models. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare global scale, local deformation and edge-region yield. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較全域尺度、局部形變及邊緣區良率」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare global scale, local deformation and edge-region yield, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 扇出型面板級封裝：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Fan-out panel-level packaging: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「格式與設備邊界」建立判讀邊界。面板尺寸須同曝光、鍍膜、搬運和檢測設備相容。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Format and tool boundaries to define the interpretation boundary. Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜格式與設備邊界：建立所有站點有效處理面積表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜曝光拼接：跨接縫設計線阻與套刻見證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜規模化經濟：比較每良品成本及尾端風險。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Format and tool boundaries: List effective process areas at every station. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Exposure stitching: Use resistance and overlay witnesses across seams. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Scale economics: Compare cost per good unit and tail risks. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「曝光拼接」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「規模化經濟」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Exposure stitching: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Scale economics to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：單一設備可容納就代表整線可用。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：每場內 DRC 通過便無拼接問題。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Equating one tool's capacity with line compatibility. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Assuming within-field DRC excludes stitching defects. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: Embedded-die packaging: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 嵌入晶粒的接觸開口與樹脂層要可追溯。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Trace contact openings and resin layers in embedded die. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：嵌入晶粒的接觸開口與樹脂層要可追溯。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：查對晶粒傾斜、覆蓋厚度與導通圖。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Trace contact openings and resin layers in embedded die. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Check die tilt, cover thickness and continuity maps. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「查對晶粒傾斜、覆蓋厚度與導通圖」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check die tilt, cover thickness and continuity maps, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Via-to-pad alignment: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Testing and failure analysis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：名義腔深較大就不需公差分析。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：外框標記對準即可保證所有埋藏墊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Skipping tolerances when nominal cavity depth is larger. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Using frame alignment to guarantee every buried pad. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 矽穿孔金屬填充：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Through-silicon-via metal filling: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: TSV 金屬填充不能由表面封口判斷。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: A sealed TSV top does not prove void-free fill. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。圖中為外露焊料互連，不顯示 TSV 孔內部或其填充完整性。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：TSV 金屬填充不能由表面封口判斷。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用內部空洞分布、電阻及熱循環資料。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Exposed solder interconnects do not show TSV interiors or fill integrity. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.
Mark this question on your own diagram: A sealed TSV top does not prove void-free fill. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Use internal void distributions, resistance and cycling data. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「用內部空洞分布、電阻及熱循環資料」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Use internal void distributions, resistance and cycling data, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 矽穿孔金屬填充：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Through-silicon-via metal filling: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「導體選擇」建立判讀邊界。Cu 與 W 的電阻、成膜方式和热失配不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Conductor selection to define the interpretation boundary. Cu and W differ in resistivity, deposition and thermal mismatch. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜導體選擇：比較電阻與應力的雙目標表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜傳質與圖形：按密度區比較空洞與厚度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜放行與露出：交付深度對位圖與缺陷界限。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Conductor selection: Compare resistance and stress objectives. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Transport and pattern: Compare voids/thickness by density region. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Release to reveal: Deliver depth-registered maps and defect bounds. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「傳質與圖形」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「放行與露出」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Transport and pattern: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release to reveal to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：最低電阻材料必是每種 TSV 最佳選擇。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：流場均勻就代表所有孔內傳質相同。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Assuming lowest resistivity is always best. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Equating uniform bulk flow with equal in-via transport. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 玻璃穿孔製作：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Through-glass-via fabrication: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 玻璃通孔與矽通孔的材料破壞不同。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Glass and silicon vias have different fracture behavior. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。圖中為矽微柱，不是玻璃通孔 TGV，也不能據此推定玻璃加工形貌。 觀察側壁波紋與錐度；圖片沒有提供可複製的完整設備配方。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：玻璃通孔與矽通孔的材料破壞不同。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以裂紋、錐角及金屬附著力驗證。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. These are silicon micropillars, not through-glass vias, and do not establish glass-processing morphology. Observe scallops and taper; the image does not supply a reproducible complete tool recipe.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Glass and silicon vias have different fracture behavior. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Verify cracks, taper and metal adhesion. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以裂紋、錐角及金屬附著力驗證」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Verify cracks, taper and metal adhesion, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 玻璃穿孔製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Through-glass-via fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「玻璃組成」建立判讀邊界。玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Glass composition to define the interpretation boundary. CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜玻璃組成：指定材料牌號和量測頻率。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜種子覆蓋：檢查入口、中央和出口截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜整合放行：保存孔群位置和失效類型。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Glass composition: Specify material grade and measurement frequency. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Seed coverage: Inspect entrance, middle and exit sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Integration release: Retain array location and failure class. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「種子覆蓋」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Seed coverage: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integration release to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有玻璃具有相同介電與熱性質。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：雙面表面有種子即可證明孔壁相連。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating all glass as one material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Inferring wall continuity from seeded faces. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 有機中介層製作：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Organic-interposer fabrication: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 有機中介層的材料各向異性不可忽略。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Organic-interposer anisotropy matters. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：有機中介層的材料各向異性不可忽略。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：檢查走線方向、堆疊及溫度對幾何的影響。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Organic-interposer anisotropy matters. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Check routing direction, stack-up and temperature effects on geometry. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「檢查走線方向、堆疊及溫度對幾何的影響」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check routing direction, stack-up and temperature effects on geometry, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 有機中介層製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Organic-interposer fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「劃分晶粒與中介層」建立判讀邊界。中介層把高密度晶粒互連轉接到較大尺度封裝，需定義兩端焊墊。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Partition dies and interposer to define the interpretation boundary. An interposer translates dense die connections to package scale; both pad interfaces need definition. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜劃分晶粒與中介層：觀察焦點：畫出晶粒、RDL、C4 及基板的層次。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜分析順應性：觀察焦點：比較剛性與順應中介層的受力路徑。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜完成中介層交接：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：列明不能由公開架構圖推定的製造參數。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Partition dies and interposer: Observation focus: Draw die, RDL, C4 and substrate levels. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Analyze compliance: Observation focus: Compare load paths in rigid and compliant interposers. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Complete interposer handoff: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List manufacturing parameters not inferable from public architecture diagrams. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分析順應性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完成中介層交接：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Analyze compliance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete interposer handoff: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：有機材料柔軟所以沒有熱應力。本步先檢查「劃分晶粒與中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到中介層把高密度晶粒互連轉接到較大尺度封裝，需定義兩端焊墊。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：有機材料柔軟所以沒有熱應力。本步先檢查「分析順應性」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到聚合物可分散某些應力，但也帶來蠕變和翹曲變化。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress. First check whether evidence for partition dies and interposer actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: An interposer translates dense die connections to package scale; both pad interfaces need definition.

Misinterpretation to reject: Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress. First check whether evidence for analyze compliance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Polymers redistribute some stress but introduce creep and warpage variation.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義核心與增層：觀察焦點：將核心和增層分色標示。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define core and build-up: Observation focus: Color core and build-up separately. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Assess research maturity: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Label demonstrated and unresolved claims from public evidence. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

guides.title: 嵌入式互連橋整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Embedded interconnect-bridge integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 局部互連橋不等於完整矽中介層。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: A local bridge is not a full silicon interposer. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：局部互連橋不等於完整矽中介層。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：畫出橋區與有機基板區的訊號邊界。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.
Mark this question on your own diagram: A local bridge is not a full silicon interposer. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Draw the signal boundaries of bridge and organic regions. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「畫出橋區與有機基板區的訊號邊界」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Draw the signal boundaries of bridge and organic regions, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 嵌入式互連橋整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Embedded interconnect-bridge integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「比較局部與全面中介層」建立判讀邊界。局部橋只在需要高密度連線處配置矽互連。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Compare local and full interposers to define the interpretation boundary. A local bridge places silicon routing only where dense links are needed. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜比較局部與全面中介層：觀察焦點：畫兩晶粒間的橋及其餘有機基板。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜追蹤回流與供電：觀察焦點：按所研究世代畫獨立供電路徑。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付局部橋方案：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：寫出相較完整中介層的兩項限制。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Compare local and full interposers: Observation focus: Draw a bridge between two dies and the surrounding substrate. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Trace returns and power: Observation focus: Draw separate power paths for the generation studied. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver bridge proposal: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: State two limitations relative to a full interposer. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「追蹤回流與供電」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付局部橋方案：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Trace returns and power: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver bridge proposal: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：矽橋等於覆蓋整包的矽中介層。本步先檢查「比較局部與全面中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到局部橋只在需要高密度連線處配置矽互連。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：矽橋等於覆蓋整包的矽中介層。本步先檢查「追蹤回流與供電」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到資料經橋不代表全部供電也走同一路徑。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A silicon bridge equals a full-package silicon interposer. First check whether evidence for compare local and full interposers actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A local bridge places silicon routing only where dense links are needed.

Misinterpretation to reject: A silicon bridge equals a full-package silicon interposer. First check whether evidence for trace returns and power actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Data crossing a bridge does not imply all power follows that route.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate PHY and protocol: Observation focus: Draw boundaries from protocol to pads. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

guides.concept: HBM 堆疊中的熱、供電及測試路徑不同。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: HBM heat, power and test paths differ. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。去封裝後的晶粒表面；照片本身無法解析每個儲存電容的三維結構。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：HBM 堆疊中的熱、供電及測試路徑不同。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：逐層標出可測接點與資料通道。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. A decapsulated die surface; the photograph alone does not resolve the 3D geometry of every storage capacitor.
Mark this question on your own diagram: HBM heat, power and test paths differ. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Mark test-access points and data channels layer by layer. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「逐層標出可測接點與資料通道」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Mark test-access points and data channels layer by layer, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.conceptEn: A 3D-stack hotspot need not lie next to its cooling surface. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。用外置冷板比較對流表面與流阻；不是蝕刻在晶片內部的微流道。

建立量測計畫：以分層熱阻模型對照埋藏接面溫度。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。

Mark this question on your own diagram: A 3D-stack hotspot need not lie next to its cooling surface. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Map layer heat sources to define the interpretation boundary. Functional regions have unequal power density; averages hide peaks. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜標出每層熱源：觀察焦點：建立各層位置相對應的功率圖。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜比較單面與雙面冷卻：觀察焦點：用雙分支熱路重解層溫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付效能熱權衡：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：報告性能、功耗、溫度及未驗證情境。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Map layer heat sources: Observation focus: Build registered power maps for all layers. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Compare single and double cooling: Observation focus: Resolve layer temperatures with dual branches. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver performance-thermal tradeoff: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Report performance, power, temperature and untested scenarios. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「比較單面與雙面冷卻」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare single and double cooling: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver performance-thermal tradeoff: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：各層溫升都只用自己的功率乘同一熱阻。本步先檢查「標出每層熱源」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到不同功能區的功率密度不均，不能以整片平均代表局部峰值。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：各層溫升都只用自己的功率乘同一熱阻。本步先檢查「比較單面與雙面冷卻」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到新增冷端會重分配熱流，不是簡單把所有溫度除二。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Each layer rises only by its own power times the same resistance. First check whether evidence for map layer heat sources actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Functional regions have unequal power density; averages hide peaks.

Misinterpretation to reject: Each layer rises only by its own power times the same resistance. First check whether evidence for compare single and double cooling actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: An added sink redistributes heat; it does not simply halve every temperature.

guides.title: 封裝訊號完整性設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package signal-integrity design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 訊號完整性包含串音與返回電流。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Signal integrity includes crosstalk and return current. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：訊號完整性包含串音與返回電流。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較插入損耗、反射與近遠端串音。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Signal integrity includes crosstalk and return current. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare insertion loss, reflection and near/far-end crosstalk. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較插入損耗、反射與近遠端串音」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare insertion loss, reflection and near/far-end crosstalk, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 封裝訊號完整性設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Package signal-integrity design: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義端到端參考面」建立判讀邊界。驅動器、焊墊、封裝與接收器都屬通道環境。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define end-to-end planes to define the interpretation boundary. Driver, pads, package and receiver all belong to the channel environment. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義端到端參考面：觀察焦點：標注量測模型的起終端。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜檢查近遠端串音：觀察焦點：保持間距，改變共行長度比較。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜提交通道接受範圍：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：列出尚未包含的封裝轉接。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define end-to-end planes: Observation focus: Mark start/end planes of measurement and model. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Check near/far crosstalk: Observation focus: Keep spacing fixed and vary parallel length. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver channel acceptance range: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List package transitions not yet included. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「檢查近遠端串音」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提交通道接受範圍：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Check near/far crosstalk: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver channel acceptance range: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：只要 DC 連通就沒有訊號完整性問題。本步先檢查「定義端到端參考面」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到驅動器、焊墊、封裝與接收器都屬通道環境。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：只要 DC 連通就沒有訊號完整性問題。本步先檢查「檢查近遠端串音」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到電容和電感耦合共同决定串音，長平行段提高互扰。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: DC continuity eliminates signal-integrity problems. First check whether evidence for define end-to-end planes actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Driver, pads, package and receiver all belong to the channel environment.

Misinterpretation to reject: DC continuity eliminates signal-integrity problems. First check whether evidence for check near/far crosstalk actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Capacitive and inductive coupling jointly govern crosstalk; parallel length matters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認功率模組外殼與引腳；封裝內部陶瓷、銀燒結及雙面冷卻結構沒有顯露。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：封裝內轉換器同時帶來熱及電磁耦合。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：分離開關損耗、導通損耗及雜訊回路。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify housing and pins; internal ceramics, silver sintering and double-sided cooling are not visible.

Mark this question on your own diagram: In-package converters add thermal and electromagnetic coupling. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Separate switching loss, conduction loss and noise loops. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「分離開關損耗、導通損耗及雜訊回路」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。

An actionable measurement plan for: Separate switching loss, conduction loss and noise loops, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

Use Define module acceptance matrix: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：電感移到封裝裡就沒有磁芯損耗。本步先檢查「分解負載工作模式」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到待機、突發與持續負載對效率和瞬態要求不同，單一滿載數值不足。所指出的物理限制。

官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Moving the inductor into the package removes core loss. First check whether evidence for separate load operating modes actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Idle, burst and sustained loads impose different efficiency and transient requirements.

觀察站 2｜先辨粗漏：觀察焦點：列出示蹤注入與量測延遲造成的偏差。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜建立氣密證據鏈：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：讓同學重算一份漏率報告。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define hermetic boundary: Observation focus: Mark each seam and electrical crossing. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Build hermetic evidence chain: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Have a peer reconstruct one leak report. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

guides.title: 功率模組銀燒結接合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Silver-sintered power-module bonding: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 銀燒結接合層的孔隙不能由外殼觀察。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Silver-sinter joint porosity is hidden by the housing. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認功率模組外殼與引腳；封裝內部陶瓷、銀燒結及雙面冷卻結構沒有顯露。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：銀燒結接合層的孔隙不能由外殼觀察。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：需要孔隙率、剪切強度及熱阻的對照。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify housing and pins; internal ceramics, silver sintering and double-sided cooling are not visible.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Silver-sinter joint porosity is hidden by the housing. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Correlate porosity, shear strength and thermal resistance. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「需要孔隙率、剪切強度及熱阻的對照」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Correlate porosity, shear strength and thermal resistance, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 功率模組銀燒結接合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silver-sintered power-module bonding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識固態燒結」建立判讀邊界。顆粒間形成頸部及緻密化，不等同焊料液相凝固。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify solid-state sintering to define the interpretation boundary. Particle necking and densification differ from solder solidification. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識固態燒結：觀察焦點：畫顆粒、頸部及殘餘孔隙。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜分離體與界面熱阻：觀察焦點：把接合層與兩界面分成三項。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜制定接合放行：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：提出一組強度高但熱阻異常的調查路徑。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify solid-state sintering: Observation focus: Draw particles, necks and residual pores. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Separate bulk and interface resistance: Observation focus: Separate bond bulk and both interfaces into three terms. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Define bond acceptance: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Plan an investigation for high strength but abnormal thermal resistance. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分離體與界面熱阻」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「制定接合放行：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate bulk and interface resistance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Define bond acceptance: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：銀燒結一定完全無孔隙。本步先檢查「辨識固態燒結」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到顆粒間形成頸部及緻密化，不等同焊料液相凝固。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：銀燒結一定完全無孔隙。本步先檢查「分離體與界面熱阻」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到高體導熱不能消除上下界面未接合造成的熱阻。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Silver sintering is always pore-free. First check whether evidence for identify solid-state sintering actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Particle necking and densification differ from solder solidification.

Misinterpretation to reject: Silver sintering is always pore-free. First check whether evidence for separate bulk and interface resistance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: High bulk conductivity cannot remove resistance from unbonded interfaces.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

建立量測計畫：比較剝離、熱阻與絕緣測試而非只看銅色。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。

Mark this question on your own diagram: DBC ceramic provides insulation and thermomechanical constraint. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare delamination, thermal resistance and insulation tests. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

guides.concept: 先用「辨識 DBC 結構」建立判讀邊界。陶瓷提供電氣隔離，銅層提供導電與橫向熱擴散。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify DBC structure to define the interpretation boundary. Ceramic provides isolation; copper provides conduction and lateral heat spreading. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識 DBC 結構：觀察焦點：畫銅陶瓷銅截面並標功能。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜驗算厚度熱阻：觀察焦點：重算 0.63 mm 算例並加倍厚度。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付基板選型：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：對候選基板列出適用與不可外推條件。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify DBC structure: Observation focus: Draw a copper-ceramic-copper section and label functions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Calculate thickness resistance: Observation focus: Recalculate the 0.63 mm example at double thickness. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver substrate selection: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List validity and non-extrapolation conditions for each candidate. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「驗算厚度熱阻」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
