evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Calculate thickness resistance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver substrate selection: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：所有陶瓷基板都使用同一覆銅機制。本步先檢查「辨識 DBC 結構」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到陶瓷提供電氣隔離，銅層提供導電與橫向熱擴散。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：所有陶瓷基板都使用同一覆銅機制。本步先檢查「驗算厚度熱阻」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到增加陶瓷厚度改善某些電氣邊界，卻增加一維熱阻。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: All ceramic substrates use the same copper-bonding mechanism. First check whether evidence for identify dbc structure actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Ceramic provides isolation; copper provides conduction and lateral heat spreading.

Misinterpretation to reject: All ceramic substrates use the same copper-bonding mechanism. First check whether evidence for calculate thickness resistance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Thicker ceramic can improve some electrical margins while increasing 1D thermal resistance.

guides.title: 封裝濕氣敏感度分析：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package moisture-sensitivity analysis: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 吸濕量與回焊中的內部壓力是不同觀察。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Moisture uptake and reflow-induced pressure are different observations. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：吸濕量與回焊中的內部壓力是不同觀察。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以重量變化、分層圖及回焊條件串起因果。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Moisture uptake and reflow-induced pressure are different observations. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Link mass change, delamination maps and reflow conditions. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以重量變化、分層圖及回焊條件串起因果」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Link mass change, delamination maps and reflow conditions, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 封裝濕氣敏感度分析：影像判讀與證據工作簿

guides.concept: 先用「辨識吸濕材料」建立判讀邊界。聚合物的平衡含水量與擴散速率是不同參數。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify moisture-absorbing materials to define the interpretation boundary. Equilibrium moisture uptake and diffusion rate are distinct polymer properties. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識吸濕材料：觀察焦點：將容量與速度分列材料表。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜區分爆米花與腐蝕：觀察焦點：列出能辨別兩者的影像及電性證據。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付適用範圍：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：列出任何變更需要重新評估的材料與幾何。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify moisture-absorbing materials: Observation focus: Tabulate capacity and rate separately. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Separate popcorning and corrosion: Observation focus: List imaging and electrical evidence distinguishing them. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver scope of qualification: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List material and geometry changes requiring reassessment. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「區分爆米花與腐蝕」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付適用範圍：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate popcorning and corrosion: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver scope of qualification: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：吸水重量相同代表局部水分分布相同。本步先檢查「辨識吸濕材料」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到聚合物的平衡含水量與擴散速率是不同參數。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：吸水重量相同代表局部水分分布相同。本步先檢查「區分爆米花與腐蝕」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到機械開裂與電化學腐蝕具有不同條件與時間尺度。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Equal absorbed mass means identical local moisture distribution. First check whether evidence for identify moisture-absorbing materials actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Equilibrium moisture uptake and diffusion rate are distinct polymer properties.

Misinterpretation to reject: Equal absorbed mass means identical local moisture distribution. First check whether evidence for separate popcorning and corrosion actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mechanical cracking and electrochemical corrosion need different conditions and timescales.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 聲學回波受界面與閘門深度影響。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Acoustic echoes depend on interfaces and gate depth. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。此為實體 BGA 截面的光學照片，不是超音波 A-scan 或 C-scan 檢測資料。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：聲學回波受界面與閘門深度影響。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較 A-scan、C-scan 與截面確認缺陷。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. This optical photograph of a physical BGA section is not ultrasonic A-scan or C-scan data. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Acoustic echoes depend on interfaces and gate depth. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare A-scans, C-scans and sections to verify a defect. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.

針對「比較 A-scan、C-scan 與截面確認缺陷」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare A-scans, C-scans and sections to verify a defect, including units and sources of uncertainty.

由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。

Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify impedance interfaces to define the interpretation boundary. Reflection depends on density-times-sound-speed mismatch, not just hardness. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識聲阻抗界面：觀察焦點：標示封裝各層聲阻抗差異。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜辨識相位反轉：觀察焦點：對照原始波形與顏色圖。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜完成缺陷報告：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：為未能看清的深層標記未確定。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify impedance interfaces: Observation focus: Mark impedance changes through package layers. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Identify phase inversion: Observation focus: Compare raw waveforms against color maps. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Complete defect report: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Mark obscured deeper layers as unresolved. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

以「完成缺陷報告：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Identify phase inversion: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete defect report: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：C-scan 像素大小就是實際空間解析度。本步先檢查「辨識聲阻抗界面」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到反射由密度乘聲速的差異決定，不只由材料硬度。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：C-scan 像素大小就是實際空間解析度。本步先檢查「辨識相位反轉」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到氣隙與實體界面可產生不同回波相位，幅值圖不保留全部資訊。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: C-scan pixel spacing equals true spatial resolution. First check whether evidence for identify impedance interfaces actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Reflection depends on density-times-sound-speed mismatch, not just hardness.

Misinterpretation to reject: C-scan pixel spacing equals true spatial resolution. First check whether evidence for identify phase inversion actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Air gaps and solid interfaces can differ in echo phase; amplitude maps lose information.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Choose operating band: Observation focus: Mark operating and possible absorption bands. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

guides.title: 光柵耦合器設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Grating-coupler design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 光柵耦合的角度、偏振與波長交互影響。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Grating coupling couples angle, polarization and wavelength. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：光柵耦合的角度、偏振與波長交互影響。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較波長角度二維效率圖。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Grating coupling couples angle, polarization and wavelength. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare two-dimensional wavelength-angle efficiency maps. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較波長角度二維效率圖」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare two-dimensional wavelength-angle efficiency maps, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光柵耦合器設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Grating-coupler design: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「設定光纖與偏振」建立判讀邊界。耦合目標是特定纖模，不能以任意高斯光斑代替所有纖種。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Specify fiber and polarization to define the interpretation boundary. The target is a specific fiber mode, not any Gaussian beam. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜設定光纖與偏振：觀察焦點：記錄模場直徑及偏振定義。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜使用漸變光柵：觀察焦點：將目標包絡連到每段散射變化。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付耦合容差：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：交付峰值、頻寬與位置容差。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Specify fiber and polarization: Observation focus: Record mode-field diameter and polarization. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Use apodization: Observation focus: Relate target envelope to segment scattering. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver coupling tolerances: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Deliver peak efficiency, bandwidth and positional tolerance. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「使用漸變光柵」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付耦合容差：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Use apodization: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver coupling tolerances: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：光柵向上輻射效率就是光纖耦合效率。本步先檢查「設定光纖與偏振」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到耦合目標是特定纖模，不能以任意高斯光斑代替所有纖種。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：光柵向上輻射效率就是光纖耦合效率。本步先檢查「使用漸變光柵」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到漸變散射可塑形出射場，但新增製造容差與最小特徵限制。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Upward radiation efficiency equals fiber coupling efficiency. First check whether evidence for specify fiber and polarization actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: The target is a specific fiber mode, not any Gaussian beam.

Misinterpretation to reject: Upward radiation efficiency equals fiber coupling efficiency. First check whether evidence for use apodization actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Apodized scattering shapes output fields but adds tolerance and feature constraints.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：邊緣模式轉換與端面品質共同決定耦合。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：掃描橫向偏移與端面間隙的插入損耗。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Mode conversion and facet quality jointly set edge coupling. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Scan insertion loss against lateral offset and facet gap. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「掃描橫向偏移與端面間隙的插入損耗」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Scan insertion loss against lateral offset and facet gap, including units and sources of uncertainty.

由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。

guides.title: 晶片邊緣耦合器設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Edge-coupler design: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「比較晶片與光纖模場」建立判讀邊界。模式尺寸差異會限制耦合，即使幾何中心完全重合。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Compare chip and fiber modes to define the interpretation boundary. Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜比較晶片與光纖模場：觀察焦點：畫同功率正規化的兩模場。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜建立橫向容差：觀察焦點：重算 1 μm 偏移的 1.09 dB 例。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付耦合器規格：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：把模場半徑與直徑寫成兩個不同欄位。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Compare chip and fiber modes: Observation focus: Draw two equal-power normalized fields. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Build lateral tolerance: Observation focus: Recalculate 1.09 dB loss at 1 μm offset. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver coupler specification: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Record mode radius and diameter as separate fields. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建立橫向容差」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付耦合器規格：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Build lateral tolerance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver coupler specification: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「比較晶片與光纖模場」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到模式尺寸差異會限制耦合，即使幾何中心完全重合。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「建立橫向容差」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到較大模場可增加偏移容忍，但也改變封裝尺寸需求。所指出的物理限制。

pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A narrower taper tip always gives lower loss. First check whether evidence for compare chip and fiber modes actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers.

guides.title: 光纖陣列主動對準：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Active alignment of fiber arrays: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義光功率參考面：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。輸出讀值同時含雷射、纖線、耦合與晶片路徑；搜尋目標須先正規化。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define optical power reference planes: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Output includes source, fiber, coupling and chip paths; normalize the objective before searching. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義光功率參考面：模型與設計：使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。
觀察站 2｜設定陣列目標函數：模型與設計：以一強一弱通道比較總和最大與最差通道最大兩解。
觀察站 3｜交付可重複定位結果：量測與判別：重複卸載重裝並比較每通道分布，不只報一次最佳值。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define optical power reference planes: model and design: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change.
Observation station 2 | Set an array objective: model and design: Compare maximum sum and maximum worst-channel solutions for unequal channels.
Observation station 3 | Deliver repeatable alignment results: measurement and diagnosis: Repeat unload/reload and compare channel distributions, not one best result.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「設定陣列目標函數：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付可重複定位結果：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Set an array objective: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver repeatable alignment results: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「輸出變亮一定表示位置更準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「總功率最大即每通道都最佳」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Higher output always means better position" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Maximum total power means every channel is optimum" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 光纖陣列被動對準：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Passive alignment of fiber arrays: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 被動對準依靠機械基準與統計容差。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Passive alignment depends on datums and statistical tolerances. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：被動對準依靠機械基準與統計容差。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測裝配後分布並与耦合容差窗口比較。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Passive alignment depends on datums and statistical tolerances. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare assembly distributions with coupling tolerance windows. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測裝配後分布並与耦合容差窗口比較」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare assembly distributions with coupling tolerance windows, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光纖黏著固定與熱漂移：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Fiber adhesive attachment and thermal drift: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 固化收縮及熱膨脹會讓最佳對準點漂移。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Cure shrinkage and thermal expansion shift the optimum alignment. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：固化收縮及熱膨脹會讓最佳對準點漂移。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測固化前後與熱循環後的光功率。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Cure shrinkage and thermal expansion shift the optimum alignment. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Measure power before/after cure and after thermal cycling. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測固化前後與熱循環後的光功率」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Measure power before/after cure and after thermal cycling, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光纖黏著固定與熱漂移：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Fiber adhesive attachment and thermal drift: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「選擇黏著位置：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。光路內膠需評估吸收與折射率，機械固定膠則仍會透過應力影響光路。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Choose adhesive placement: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. In-path adhesive needs absorption/index evaluation; out-of-path adhesive still affects optics through stress. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜選擇黏著位置：模型與設計：分開光學窗口與固定支點，標示每處膠的功能。
觀察站 2｜比較釋放前後：模型與設計：將固化終點與卸載終點分開存檔，量同一自由度。
觀察站 3｜交付附著壽命證據：量測與判別：保留每通道完整歷程與失效分類，避免只報平均。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Choose adhesive placement: model and design: Separate optical windows and mechanical anchor points and label each adhesive role.
Observation station 2 | Compare before and after fixture release: model and design: Archive cure completion and unloading separately using the same coordinates.
Observation station 3 | Deliver attachment-life evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Retain complete channel histories and failure classes rather than only averages.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「比較釋放前後：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付附著壽命證據：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Compare before and after fixture release: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver attachment-life evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「膠不在光路內就完全不影響光學」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「固化完成後夾具已不再影響位置」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Out-of-path adhesive cannot affect optical behavior" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "A fixture ceases to affect position once cure ends" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: Polarization splitter-rotators: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 偏振分光與偏振旋轉是兩種功能。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Polarization splitting and rotation are distinct functions. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. guides.concept: 方向耦合器間隙與耦合長度相互關聯。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Gap and coupling length are linked in directional couplers. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。

建立量測計畫：對製程偏差做參數掃描而非只驗證標稱點。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Gap and coupling length are linked in directional couplers. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Sweep process deviations rather than only the nominal point. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。

evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.

pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.

guides.title: 方向耦合器製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Directional-coupler fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義波導與間隙：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。耦合由倏逝場重疊決定，間隙是側壁之間距離而非中心距離。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define guides and gap: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Coupling follows evanescent-field overlap; gap means sidewall spacing, not center spacing. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義波導與間隙：模型與設計：在截面圖分開寬度、中心距和側壁間距。
觀察站 2｜納入接近與離開區：模型與設計：比較只含直段與含 S 彎的模態傳輸。
觀察站 3｜交付有效模型範圍：量測與判別：在模型邊界重建場解並檢查反射、功率和相位。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define guides and gap: model and design: Mark width, center spacing and sidewall gap separately.
Observation station 2 | Include approach and departure sections: model and design: Compare straight-only transfer with the full S-bend geometry.
Observation station 3 | Deliver model validity bounds: measurement and diagnosis: Reconstruct field solutions at model bounds and check reflection, power and phase.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「納入接近與離開區：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付有效模型範圍：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Include approach and departure sections: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver model validity bounds: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「中心距和間隙可以互換使用」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「只有平行直段才會產生耦合」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Center spacing and gap are interchangeable" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Only the parallel straight section couples" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 微環調變器：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Microring modulators: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 微環小尺寸以窄頻及熱敏感性為代價。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: A compact microring trades against bandwidth and thermal sensitivity. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：微環小尺寸以窄頻及熱敏感性為代價。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用透射頻譜、線寬及溫度漂移評估。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: A compact microring trades against bandwidth and thermal sensitivity. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Evaluate transmission spectrum, linewidth and temperature drift. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「用透射頻譜、線寬及溫度漂移評估」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Evaluate transmission spectrum, linewidth and temperature drift, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.titleEn: Microring modulators: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「建立回程相位：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。共振要求回程相位為整數 2π，幾何周長與有效折射率共同決定位置。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Establish round-trip phase: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Resonance requires integer-2π round-trip phase, set jointly by circumference and effective index. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立回程相位：模型與設計：比較加長環與增加有效折射率造成的共振移動。
觀察站 2｜選擇調變工作點：模型與設計：在固定雷射波長比較三個偏壓位置的動態響應。
觀察站 3｜交付頻譜與調變證據：量測與判別：以獨立溫度和輸入功率條件檢驗模型外推。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Establish round-trip phase: model and design: Compare resonance shifts from longer circumference and higher effective index.
Observation station 2 | Choose a modulation operating point: model and design: Compare dynamic response at three bias positions with fixed laser wavelength.
Observation station 3 | Deliver spectral and modulation evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Test predictions at independent temperature and input-power conditions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「選擇調變工作點：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付頻譜與調變證據：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Choose a modulation operating point: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver spectral and modulation evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「只要半徑相同共振波長一定相同」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「共振最深點一定是最高線性調變效率」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Equal radii guarantee equal resonance wavelengths" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "The deepest point always maximizes linear modulation efficiency" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.title: 薄膜鈮酸鋰異質整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Heterogeneous thin-film lithium-niobate integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 異質薄膜鈮酸鋰需處理材料軸向與界面。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Heterogeneous lithium niobate requires crystal-axis and interface control. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：異質薄膜鈮酸鋰需處理材料軸向與界面。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：查對光模態重疊、電極方向及接合空洞。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Heterogeneous lithium niobate requires crystal-axis and interface control. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Check mode overlap, electrode orientation and bond voids. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「查對光模態重疊、電極方向及接合空洞」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check mode overlap, electrode orientation and bond voids, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 薄膜鈮酸鋰異質整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Heterogeneous thin-film lithium-niobate integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「晶軸與偏振：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。鈮酸鋰的電光響應是張量；晶切面、光偏振與電場方向共同決定有效係數。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Crystal axes and polarization: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Lithium niobate has a tensor electro-optic response; cut, optical polarization and field direction determine the effective coefficient. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜晶軸與偏振：模型與設計：旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。
觀察站 2｜光電速度匹配：模型與設計：從射頻相位斜率與光群延遲分別萃取兩個速度，列出頻率相依性。
觀察站 3｜封裝交接：量測與判別：在相同校正面比較裸晶與封裝曲線，保存去嵌入檔與偏壓條件。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Crystal axes and polarization: model and design: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.
Observation station 2 | Velocity matching: model and design: Extract velocities independently from RF phase slope and optical group delay, including frequency dependence.
Observation station 3 | Package handoff: measurement and diagnosis: Compare bare-die and packaged curves at matched calibration planes and retain de-embedding files and bias conditions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「光電速度匹配：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「封裝交接：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Velocity matching: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Package handoff: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.title: 微轉印雷射晶粒整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Micro-transfer-printed laser integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 微轉印的拾取、釋放與鍵合要各有證據。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Micro-transfer pickup, release and bonding require separate evidence. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認雷射裸晶尺度；這不是矽上量子點雷射或微轉印製程的實拍。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：微轉印的拾取、釋放與鍵合要各有證據。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：追蹤印章接觸、晶粒位置及最終導通。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Orient laser-die scale; this is not a quantum-dot-on-silicon laser or a micro-transfer-printing process photograph.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Micro-transfer pickup, release and bonding require separate evidence. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Track stamp contact, die position and final continuity. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「追蹤印章接觸、晶粒位置及最終導通」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Track stamp contact, die position and final continuity, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。

guides.concept: SOA 增益會飽和並引入放大自發輻射。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: SOA gain saturates and introduces amplified spontaneous emission. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認雷射裸晶尺度；這不是矽上量子點雷射或微轉印製程的實拍。

建立量測計畫：量測增益對輸入功率與光學雜訊密度。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Orient laser-die scale; this is not a quantum-dot-on-silicon laser or a micro-transfer-printing process photograph.

Mark this question on your own diagram: SOA gain saturates and introduces amplified spontaneous emission. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Measure gain versus input power and optical noise density. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。

evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Amplifier versus laser: model and design: Compare spectra with and without input to separate broad ASE from narrow self-oscillation peaks.

Observation station 3 | System acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Build gain, BER and thermal matrices across routes and channel loads.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for ASE spectrum: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use System acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.concept: 微環濾波器通道需對應熱調諧範圍。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Ring-filter channels must match available thermal tuning. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：微環濾波器通道需對應熱調諧範圍。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較 FSR、線寬及相鄰通道隔離。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Ring-filter channels must match available thermal tuning. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare FSR, linewidth and adjacent-channel isolation. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較 FSR、線寬及相鄰通道隔離」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.

由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。

guides.title: 相干光接收器整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Coherent optical-receiver integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 同調接收要同時維持振幅、相位及偏振資訊。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Coherent receivers preserve amplitude, phase and polarization. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察光學平台和量測鏈的組織；不是某一課的同調接收器、光達或頻率梳實測。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：同調接收要同時維持振幅、相位及偏振資訊。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較 I/Q 不平衡、雜訊與星座圖。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe the organization of an optical bench and measurement chain; not a measured coherent receiver, lidar or frequency-comb dataset for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Coherent receivers preserve amplitude, phase and polarization. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Compare I/Q imbalance, noise and constellations. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較 I/Q 不平衡、雜訊與星座圖」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare I/Q imbalance, noise and constellations, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Coherent-receiver boundary: model and design: Draw signal, LO and I/Q outputs, marking frequency difference and phase.

Observation station 3 | Packaged test corners: measurement and diagnosis: Choose corners that jointly squeeze dynamic range and record lock loss and recovery.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.conceptEn: FMCW beat frequencies mix range and Doppler. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察光學平台和量測鏈的組織；不是某一課的同調接收器、光達或頻率梳實測。

建立量測計畫：以已知目標距離與速度驗證掃頻模型。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。

Build a measurement plan: Validate the chirp model with known target range and velocity. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Round-trip delay: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Reflective ranging has round-trip delay τ=2R/c; a one-way delay cannot replace it. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜往返延遲：模型與設計：畫發射、目標及回波時間線並標出兩段傳播。

觀察站 3｜系統放行：量測與判別：建立反射率、距離、速度及環境光矩陣，報告失敗樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Round-trip delay: model and design: Draw transmit-target-return timelines with both propagation segments.

Observation station 3 | System acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Build reflectivity, range, velocity and ambient-light matrices and report failed cases.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

以「系統放行：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Doppler separation: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use System acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.concept: 中紅外材料吸收窗口與感測波段相匹配。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Mid-IR transparency must match the sensing band. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認雷射裸晶尺度；這不是矽上量子點雷射或微轉印製程的實拍。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：中紅外材料吸收窗口與感測波段相匹配。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較樣品吸收、背景水氣及光路基線。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Orient laser-die scale; this is not a quantum-dot-on-silicon laser or a micro-transfer-printing process photograph.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Mid-IR transparency must match the sensing band. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare sample absorption, background water vapor and optical baseline. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較樣品吸收、背景水氣及光路基線」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare sample absorption, background water vapor and optical baseline, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 中紅外積體光子感測：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Mid-infrared integrated-photonic sensing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「波段與化學指紋：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。中紅外分子吸收能提供化學資訊，但重疊譜線與背景會造成歧義。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Wavelength and chemical fingerprint: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Mid-IR molecular absorption carries chemical information, but overlapping lines and backgrounds create ambiguity. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜波段與化學指紋：模型與設計：選兩條可區分假想成分的吸收帶，另設無吸收參考帶。
觀察站 2｜吸收與基線：模型與設計：量空白與樣本光譜後再求比值，保留暗訊號扣除順序。
觀察站 3｜長期漂移：量測與判別：規劃定期空白與已知標樣，分開可清潔漂移和不可逆損傷。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Wavelength and chemical fingerprint: model and design: Choose two bands distinguishing hypothetical species plus a nonabsorbing reference band.
Observation station 2 | Absorption and baseline: model and design: Measure blank/sample spectra before forming ratios and retain dark-subtraction order.
Observation station 3 | Long-term drift: measurement and diagnosis: Plan periodic blanks and known standards, distinguishing cleanable drift from irreversible damage.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「吸收與基線：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「長期漂移：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Absorption and baseline: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Long-term drift: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：近紅外透明材料在所有中紅外波段也透明。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：近紅外透明材料在所有中紅外波段也透明。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Near-IR-transparent materials are transparent throughout mid-IR. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.title: 光子晶片量子光源：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Quantum light sources on photonic chips: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 量子光源要驗證光子統計與多光子機率。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Quantum sources require photon-statistics and multiphoton checks. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：量子光源要驗證光子統計與多光子機率。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測符合計數、背景與 g² 及不確定度。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Quantum sources require photon-statistics and multiphoton checks. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Measure coincidences, background and g² with uncertainties. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測符合計數、背景與 g² 及不確定度」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Measure coincidences, background and g² with uncertainties, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光子晶片量子光源：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Quantum light sources on photonic chips: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「自發與受激：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。自發四波混頻可產生相關光子對；經典增益或明亮光譜本身不是量子證據。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Spontaneous versus stimulated processes: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Spontaneous four-wave mixing can create correlated pairs; classical gain or bright spectra alone are not quantum evidence. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜自發與受激：模型與設計：將平均功率、單光子計數與符合計數分為三種不同觀察。
觀察站 2｜符合視窗：模型與設計：比較三種視窗的原始符合、旁窗背景及淨符合。
觀察站 3｜可擴展性證據：量測與判別：比較兩顆獨立源的干涉與跨晶片重複性，列尚未驗證的整合項。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Spontaneous versus stimulated processes: model and design: Separate mean power, singles and coincidences as three different observations.
Observation station 2 | Coincidence window: model and design: Compare raw, side-window background and net coincidences for three windows.
Observation station 3 | Scaling evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Compare interference from two independent sources and cross-chip repeatability, listing unverified integration items.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「符合視窗：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「可擴展性證據：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Coincidence window: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Scaling evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：觀測符合率一定等於光子對產生率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：觀測符合率一定等於光子對產生率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Observed coincidences always equal pair generation rate. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Wafer coordinates: model and design: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.titleEn: Thermomechanical analysis of photonic packages: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 熱機形變會同時改變對準與有效折射率。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Thermomechanical deformation changes alignment and effective index. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：熱機形變會同時改變對準與有效折射率。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：結合位移量測、溫度場及光譜漂移。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Thermomechanical deformation changes alignment and effective index. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Combine displacement, temperature and spectral-drift evidence. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「結合位移量測、溫度場及光譜漂移」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Combine displacement, temperature and spectral-drift evidence, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.

guides.title: 光路溫度漂移補償：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Optical-path thermal-drift compensation: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 漂移補償必須考慮感測雜訊及控制穩定度。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Drift compensation includes sensor noise and loop stability. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：漂移補償必須考慮感測雜訊及控制穩定度。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：對照開迴路漂移及閉迴路殘差。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Drift compensation includes sensor noise and loop stability. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Compare open-loop drift with closed-loop residuals. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「對照開迴路漂移及閉迴路殘差」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare open-loop drift with closed-loop residuals, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光路溫度漂移補償：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Optical-path thermal-drift compensation: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「受控量定義：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。功率、共振波長與相位不是同一受控量，鎖功率可能鎖在錯誤光譜位置。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Controlled quantity: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Power, resonance wavelength and phase differ; a power lock can select the wrong spectral point. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜受控量定義：模型與設計：在頻譜上標出工作點和誤差信號零點，列出可能的多解。
觀察站 2｜控制延遲：模型與設計：把延遲加入頻率模型，記錄階躍超越與振盪。
觀察站 3｜重新校準：量測與判別：建立版本化校正與安全回復設定，以未參與擬合的負載驗證。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Controlled quantity: model and design: Mark operating point and error-signal zeros and list ambiguous solutions.
Observation station 2 | Control delay: model and design: Include delay in the frequency model and record overshoot/oscillation.
Observation station 3 | Recalibration: measurement and diagnosis: Version calibration and fallback settings; validate on an unfitted load pattern.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「控制延遲：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「重新校準：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Control delay: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Recalibration: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：誤差為零一定代表雷射和光路正常。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：誤差為零一定代表雷射和光路正常。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Zero error proves the source and path are healthy. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
