guides.concept: 先用「多型與基板：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Polytype and substrate: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Equal chemistry does not imply identical stacking. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜多型與基板：建立模型：化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同；相同多型仍可能有不同晶面。
觀察站 2｜厚度均勻度：建立模型：一個中心點無法代表全片漂移層；厚度與摻雜分布可能相互相關。
觀察站 3｜磊晶放行：故障判讀與驗證：磊晶放行須連到後續元件需求；放行規格應固定所用缺陷定義。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Polytype and substrate: construct and analyze: Equal chemistry does not imply identical stacking; The same polytype can have different crystal faces.
Observation station 2 | Thickness uniformity: construct and analyze: One center point cannot represent the whole drift layer; Thickness and doping variations may correlate.
Observation station 3 | Epitaxy release: diagnose and verify: Epitaxy release must connect to downstream device needs; Release specifications need fixed defect definitions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「厚度均勻度：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「磊晶放行：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Thickness uniformity: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Epitaxy release: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「只看 Si:C 比就確認多型」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「中心厚度合格就代表全片耐壓一致」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Identifying polytype from Si:C ratio alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Inferring uniform blocking capability from center thickness", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Vertical device path: construct and analyze: Vertical MOSFET resistance has multiple regional contributions; Package leads contribute measured resistance.
Observation station 2 | Contact resistance: construct and analyze: Two-terminal resistance includes contact and channel terms; Contact models need verified linear ranges.
Observation station 3 | Die-to-module validation: diagnose and verify: Package and drive conditions alter actual device stress; Thermal cycling can alter package interfaces.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接觸電阻：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「晶片到模組：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Contact resistance: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Die-to-module validation: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把全部導通電阻都歸給通道」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「把二端總電阻直接當接觸電阻」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Attributing all on-resistance to the channel", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Calling total two-terminal resistance contact resistance", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 氮化鎵高電子遷移率電晶體：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Gallium-nitride high-electron-mobility transistors: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「異質接面：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Heterojunction: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜異質接面：建立模型：異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層；界面粗糙會影響通道散射。
觀察站 2｜場板：建立模型：場形塑可能同時增加寄生電容；增加寄生電容可能增加切換能量。
觀察站 3｜整合驗證：故障判讀與驗證：低壓研究示範不可直接當高壓產品認證；封裝寄生電感可能造成閘極過衝。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Heterojunction: construct and analyze: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer; Interface roughness affects channel scattering.
Observation station 2 | Field plates: construct and analyze: Field shaping may also increase capacitance; Added capacitance can increase switching energy.
Observation station 3 | Integration verification: diagnose and verify: Low-voltage demonstrations are not high-voltage qualification; Package inductance can cause gate overshoot.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「場板：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合驗證：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Field plates: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integration verification: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「場板只提升耐壓而完全沒有動態代價」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assuming field plates add blocking with no dynamic cost", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Direct bandgap: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Not all current becomes emitted light. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜直接能隙：建立模型：電流不會全部轉換成出射光；非輻射復合可轉為熱。
觀察站 2｜多重量子井：建立模型：多井不表示每井注入完全相等；井間傳輸受障壁和捕捉影響。
觀察站 3｜磊晶驗收：故障判讀與驗證：材料發光與注入發光提供不同資訊；EL 和 PL 的激發空間不同。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Direct bandgap: construct and analyze: Not all current becomes emitted light; Nonradiative recombination produces heat.
Observation station 2 | Multiple quantum wells: construct and analyze: Multiple wells do not imply equal injection per well; Inter-well transport depends on barriers and capture.
Observation station 3 | Epitaxy acceptance: diagnose and verify: Optical excitation and electrical injection provide different evidence; EL and PL have different excitation profiles.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「多重量子井：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「磊晶驗收：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Multiple quantum wells: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Epitaxy acceptance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「以注入電流直接等同光子流」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「將總電流平均分配便宣稱每井同效率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Equating injected current with photon flux", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assuming equal per-well efficiency by dividing current", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Dispersion model: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Report and limits: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把水平與垂直永遠當 p 和 s」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「同一透明模型適用所有波長」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating horizontal/vertical as universally p/s", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Applying one transparency model at every wavelength", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：CPU 管線與分支預測
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: CPU pipelines and branch prediction
guides.concept: 以指令相依、投機與精確提交連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect instruction dependencies, speculation and precise retirement through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「ISA 與微架構」的資料、控制與時間關係。相同指令集可用不同管線實作。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「管線深度」的資料、控制與時間關係。深管線可能提高時脈卻增加復原代價。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「固定程式比較延遲與週期數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「暫存器重新命名」的資料、控制與時間關係。重新命名消除名稱相依而非真資料相依。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「拆分 WAR、WAW 與 RAW。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「目標預測」的資料、控制與時間關係。方向正確仍可能得到錯誤目標。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分開記錄方向與目標命中。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「記憶體順序」的資料、控制與時間關係。投機讀取須驗證與先前寫入相容。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立相同位址的讀寫時序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「架構驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。效能改善不能犧牲可見程式語義。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比對提交軌跡與參考結果。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for isa and microarchitecture. The same ISA permits different pipelines. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare two schedules for one instruction sequence. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for pipeline depth. Deeper pipelines may raise clock and recovery cost. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare latency and cycle counts for one program. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for register renaming. Renaming removes name, not true data dependencies. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Separate WAR, WAW and RAW cases. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for target prediction. Correct direction may still have a wrong target. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Count direction and target hits separately. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for memory ordering. Speculative loads require checks against older stores. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Construct same-address load/store timing. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for architecture acceptance. Speedups must preserve visible program semantics. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare retirement traces with reference results. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「量測基準」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「固定輸入與暖機再比較。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「架構驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「效能改善不能犧牲可見程式語義。」。
提交「架構驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比對提交軌跡與參考結果。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit measurement baseline input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit architecture acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit architecture acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：寬解碼保證所有程式 CPI 同比下降。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Wider decode guarantees proportional CPI reduction. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：快取一致性多核心系統
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Cache-coherent multicore systems
guides.concept: 以一致性狀態、目錄與共享粒度連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect coherence states, directories and sharing granularity through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「快取一致性與記憶體順序」的資料、控制與時間關係。單一位址一致性不等於全域記憶體順序。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分類單位址與雙位址測試。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「寫入擁有權」的資料、控制與時間關係。修改通常需排除其他有效副本。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤一次讀後寫入。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「目錄追蹤」的資料、控制與時間關係。目錄追蹤共享者，避免總廣播。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較全位元圖與有限指標。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「真共享」的資料、控制與時間關係。填補不能消除共同資料的寫入競爭。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「區分共享鎖與分離計數器。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「協定不變量」的資料、控制與時間關係。單寫者與最新資料是不同不變量。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「對每個模擬狀態檢查兩者。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「擴展性」的資料、控制與時間關係。核心數增加可能先耗盡互連或目錄資源。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分別掃描核心數與共享比例。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for coherence and consistency. Single-address coherence is not global memory ordering. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify one- and two-address tests. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for write ownership. Writes usually invalidate other valid copies. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace a read followed by a write. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for directory tracking. Directories track sharers to reduce broadcasts. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare full bitmaps and limited pointers. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for true sharing. Padding cannot remove genuine shared-write contention. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Distinguish shared locks from separate counters. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for protocol invariants. Single-writer and latest-data are separate invariants. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check both invariants in each modeled state. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for scalability. More cores may exhaust links or directories first. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Sweep core count and sharing fraction separately. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「交通成本」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「以本課算例加上假想標頭。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「擴展性」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「核心數增加可能先耗盡互連或目錄資源。」。
提交「擴展性」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分別掃描核心數與共享比例。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit traffic costs input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit scalability two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit scalability input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：填補變數會消除所有真共享。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Padding eliminates all true sharing. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect simt execution, reuse and resource occupancy through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「執行階層」的資料、控制與時間關係。執行緒組成區塊，區塊映射到 SM。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫 grid、block 與 SM 的對應。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「區塊獨立」的資料、控制與時間關係。一般區塊不能假設其他區塊已執行。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「打亂區塊順序核對結果。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Bank 衝突」的資料、控制與時間關係。不同位址可能映射同一 bank。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較轉置前後的 bank 索引。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「屏障一致」的資料、控制與時間關係。需要參與的執行緒須遵守屏障契約。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對分支內屏障的路徑。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「算術強度」的資料、控制與時間關係。每位元組工作量限制可達運算率。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「重算本課向量頻寬上界。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「CPU 對照」的資料、控制與時間關係。相同輸入與語義才能比較兩架構。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對結果、傳輸與完整耗時。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for execution hierarchy. Threads form blocks mapped to SMs. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Map grid, blocks and SMs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for block independence. Ordinary blocks cannot assume others have run. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Shuffle block order and check results. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for bank conflicts. Different addresses can map to one bank. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare bank indices before and after transpose. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for barrier convergence. Required threads must obey barrier participation. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit barrier paths inside branches. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for arithmetic intensity. Work per byte bounds compute throughput. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Recalculate the vector bandwidth bound. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for cpu reference. Architectures need matching inputs and semantics. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check results, transfers and total time. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「數值誤差」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較絕對與相對誤差。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「CPU 對照」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「相同輸入與語義才能比較兩架構。」。
提交「CPU 對照」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對結果、傳輸與完整耗時。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit numerical error input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit cpu reference two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit cpu reference input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：原子操作會消除全部資料相依。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Atomics remove every data dependency. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：張量運算加速器
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Tensor-compute accelerators
guides.concept: 以脈動陣列、混合精度與編譯映射連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect systolic arrays, mixed precision and compiler mapping through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「張量維度」的資料、控制與時間關係。矩陣相乘的內維度必須相容。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對 M×K 與 K×N 形狀。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「資料平鋪」的資料、控制與時間關係。維度不整除會產生邊緣空槽。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較整齊與零補齊矩陣。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「雙緩衝」的資料、控制與時間關係。載入與運算重疊需要足夠緩衝。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較串列與重疊時程。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「累加精度」的資料、控制與時間關係。低精度輸入可配較高精度累加。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤長點積的捨入誤差。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「編譯映射」的資料、控制與時間關係。融合可減少交通但增加局部資源。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較融合前後暫存量。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「精度驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。速度提升需同時核對任務品質。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較基準誤差與吞吐變化。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for tensor dimensions. Matrix inner dimensions must agree. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check M×K and K×N shapes. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for data tiling. Nondivisible dimensions create edge waste. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare aligned and padded matrices. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for double buffering. Load/compute overlap needs sufficient buffering. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare serial and overlapping schedules. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for accumulation precision. Low-precision inputs may use wider accumulation. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace rounding in a long dot product. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for compiler mapping. Fusion saves traffic but consumes local resources. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare temporary storage before and after fusion. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for accuracy acceptance. Speedups require task-quality checks. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare reference error and throughput changes. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「輸入管線」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分離讀取、轉換與運算耗時。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「精度驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「速度提升需同時核對任務品質。」。
提交「精度驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較基準誤差與吞吐變化。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit input pipeline input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit accuracy acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit accuracy acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：峰值 FLOP/s 可直接當作端到端訓練吞吐。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Peak FLOP/s equals end-to-end training throughput. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.concept: 以HLS、串流管線與有限資源映射連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect hls, streaming pipelines and finite resource mapping through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「功能契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「介面握手」的資料、控制與時間關係。有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「展開迴圈」的資料、控制與時間關係。展開複製運算資源但仍受供料限制。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較倍增運算器與埠數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「FIFO 深度」的資料、控制與時間關係。深度需吸收突發及相位差。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤每週期佔用峰值。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「C/RTL 共模擬」的資料、控制與時間關係。共模擬驗證指定輸入而非所有情境。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「加入邊界長度與回壓。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「端到端比較」的資料、控制與時間關係。DMA 與主機整理可能主導耗時。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「把資料傳輸納入總帳。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for functional contract. Correct C output does not establish hardware timing. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Define input, output and completion. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for interface handshake. Valid and ready jointly determine transfers. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for loop unrolling. Unrolling duplicates compute but remains feed-limited. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare compute duplication and port count. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for fifo depth. Depth absorbs bursts and phase mismatch. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace peak cycle-by-cycle occupancy. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

先觀看師傅示意，辨識「交換仲裁」的資料、控制與時間關係。公平性與最大吞吐是不同目標。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較輪詢與固定優先權。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。

Plan validation using: Sweep injection and mean latency. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Deadline 契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。硬 deadline 與平均延遲要求不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「為假想控制迴路標示到期點。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「優先權排序」的資料、控制與時間關係。較高優先權就緒任務先獲排程。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「繪製三任務時間線。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「優先權繼承」的資料、控制與時間關係。繼承緩解特定反轉，不消除全部阻塞。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較有無繼承的等待界。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「環形緩衝」的資料、控制與時間關係。讀寫索引需要一致的擁有權。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查繞回與空滿辨識。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「利用率測試」的資料、控制與時間關係。RM 充分界失敗不等於不可排程。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「以本課負載計算界限。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「驗收軌跡」的資料、控制與時間關係。滿足平均值不證明全部 deadline。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對每筆任務的完成時間。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for deadline contracts. Hard deadlines differ from average latency goals. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark deadlines for a modeled control loop. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for priority ordering. Higher-priority ready tasks are selected first. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw a three-task timeline. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for priority inheritance. Inheritance mitigates inversion, not all blocking. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare waiting bounds with inheritance. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for ring buffers. Read/write indices need consistent ownership. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check wraparound and empty/full distinction. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for utilization tests. Failing the RM sufficient bound is not impossibility. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Calculate the course utilization bound. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for acceptance traces. Meeting averages does not prove every deadline. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check completion of every task. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「過載處理」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「定義捨棄非關鍵工作政策。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「驗收軌跡」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「滿足平均值不證明全部 deadline。」。
提交「驗收軌跡」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對每筆任務的完成時間。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit overload handling input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit acceptance traces two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit acceptance traces input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：平均延遲合格即證明硬即時合格。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Passing mean latency proves hard real-time compliance. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：安全啟動與韌體信任鏈
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Secure boot and firmware chains of trust
guides.concept: 以可信根、映像驗證與可復原更新連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。 原有步驟及進度識別完整保留。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect roots of trust, image verification and recoverable updates through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation. Existing steps and progress identities are preserved.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「信任起點」的資料、控制與時間關係。驗證公鑰本身需受可信邊界保護。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「標出可寫與唯讀儲存。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「信任擴展」的資料、控制與時間關係。下一階段必須受前階段授權。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對每個未受驗證的分支。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「映像範圍」的資料、控制與時間關係。未納入簽章的設定仍可能改變行為。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「標出映像與設定的覆蓋。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「金鑰輪替」的資料、控制與時間關係。新金鑰須透過既有可信政策授權。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「繪製正常與撤銷輪替。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「復原可信」的資料、控制與時間關係。復原路徑不能繞過原有授權。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較恢復模式與主模式政策。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「證據交接」的資料、控制與時間關係。驗證紀錄需對應實際執行映像。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比對映像摘要與啟動版本。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for trust anchor. Verification keys themselves need protection. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark writable and read-only storage. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for trust extension. A stage must be authorized by its predecessor. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit every unverified branch. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for image coverage. Unsigned configuration can still alter behavior. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark image and configuration coverage. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for key rotation. New keys need authorization by trusted policy. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw normal and revoked rotations. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for recovery trust. Recovery must not bypass authorization. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare recovery and main-mode policies. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for evidence handoff. Verification evidence must match the executed image. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Match image digest and boot version. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「啟動預算」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「重算本課 90 ms 假想案例。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「證據交接」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「驗證紀錄需對應實際執行映像。」。
提交「證據交接」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比對映像摘要與啟動版本。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit boot budget input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit evidence handoff two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit evidence handoff input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：Measured boot 必定拒絕不可信映像。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Measured boot necessarily rejects untrusted images. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.concept: 以啟動 ABI、平臺描述與核心基準連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect boot abi, platform description and kernel baselines through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「目標架構」的資料、控制與時間關係。CPU ISA、ABI 與浮點配置需一致。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對編譯目標與核心設定。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「啟動 ABI」的資料、控制與時間關係。入口暫存器與 MMU 狀態由契約定義。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對假想 bootloader 交接表。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「裝置樹節點」的資料、控制與時間關係。裝置樹描述硬體而非驅動實作。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「配對 compatible 與公開 binding。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「中斷路徑」的資料、控制與時間關係。中斷控制器、編號與驅動需相容。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤一個模擬中斷。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「驅動探測」的資料、控制與時間關係。資源未準備可能延後探測。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「區分錯 binding 與依賴未就緒。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「上游變更」的資料、控制與時間關係。維護補丁需說明硬體需求與證據。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「整理最小差異與失敗復現。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for target architecture. ISA, ABI and floating-point configuration must agree. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check compiler target and kernel configuration. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for boot abi. Contracts define entry registers and MMU state. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit a modeled bootloader handoff. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for devicetree nodes. Devicetrees describe hardware, not driver implementations. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Match compatible strings to bindings. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for interrupt paths. Controllers, interrupt IDs and drivers must agree. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace one simulated interrupt. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for driver probing. Missing resources can defer probing. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Distinguish bad bindings and unmet dependencies. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for upstream changes. Maintained patches need hardware rationale and evidence. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Collect minimal diffs and failure reproduction. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「回歸矩陣」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「列出啟動、SMP 與 suspend 用例。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「上游變更」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「維護補丁需說明硬體需求與證據。」。
提交「上游變更」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「整理最小差異與失敗復現。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit regression matrix input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit upstream changes two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit upstream changes input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：一次成功啟動證明所有核心配置都正確。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: One successful boot proves every kernel configuration. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：微核心作業系統架構

guides.concept: 以能力權限、IPC 與小可信計算基連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect capabilities, ipc and small trusted computing bases through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「微核心範圍」的資料、控制與時間關係。最小核心將多數服務移到使用者域。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫核心與服務的邊界。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「核心機制」的資料、控制與時間關係。機制與政策可分別放在不同層。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分類排程機制與分配政策。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「同步 IPC」的資料、控制與時間關係。呼叫與接收配對會形成等待。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查未有接收者的時序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「驅動隔離」的資料、控制與時間關係。使用者態驅動減少核心直接介入。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫故障影響與重啟邊界。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「形式規格」的資料、控制與時間關係。證明成立於規格及明示假設。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出硬體、啟動與 DMA 前提。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「錯誤處理」的資料、控制與時間關係。服務重啟需復原合法資源狀態。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「模擬服務死亡後的客戶回應。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for microkernel scope. A minimal kernel moves many services to user domains. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw kernel/service boundaries. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for kernel mechanisms. Mechanisms and policies may reside separately. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Separate scheduling mechanism and policy. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for synchronous ipc. Calls and receives pair and may wait. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Inspect timing without a receiver. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for driver isolation. User-mode drivers reduce direct kernel involvement. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw fault and restart boundaries. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for formal specification. Proofs depend on specifications and assumptions. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List hardware, boot and DMA premises. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for fault handling. Service restart must restore valid resource state. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Model client responses after service death. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「IPC 成本」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「重算本課每核心佔用。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「錯誤處理」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「服務重啟需復原合法資源狀態。」。
提交「錯誤處理」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「模擬服務死亡後的客戶回應。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit ipc costs input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit fault handling two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit fault handling input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：使用者態驅動無需考慮 DMA 權限。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: User-mode drivers need no DMA permission analysis. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.concept: 以裝置生命週期、DMA 與併發契約連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect device lifecycle, dma and concurrency contracts through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「裝置匹配」的資料、控制與時間關係。匯流排識別與驅動匹配分開於功能探測。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對虛構裝置與驅動表。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「裝置模型」的資料、控制與時間關係。父子裝置與 driver 關係有不同角色。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫裝置樹與綁定關係。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「一致 DMA」的資料、控制與時間關係。一致映射仍可能需要記憶體屏障。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對 descriptor valid 之前的順序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Ring 狀態」的資料、控制與時間關係。head/tail 與擁有位元需一致。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「模擬滿、空與繞回。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「錯誤復原」的資料、控制與時間關係。重設後軟體需重建有效裝置狀態。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比對重設前後 ring 內容。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「卸載驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。無功能錯誤不代表無資源洩漏。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對反覆取得與釋放計數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for device matching. Bus matching differs from functional probing. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Match fictional devices and driver tables. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for device model. Parent devices and drivers have distinct roles. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw device trees and bindings. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for coherent dma. Coherent mapping can still require barriers. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit ordering before descriptor validity. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for ring state. Head/tail and ownership bits must agree. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Model full, empty and wraparound. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for error recovery. Software rebuilds valid state after reset. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare ring contents across reset. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for unload acceptance. Functional success does not imply no leaks. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check repeated acquire/release counts. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「容量預算」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「擴充本課 100 格積壓例。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「卸載驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「無功能錯誤不代表無資源洩漏。」。
提交「卸載驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對反覆取得與釋放計數。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit capacity budgets input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit unload acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit unload acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Coherent DMA guarantees every descriptor update order. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：編譯器前端與中介表示
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Compiler front ends and intermediate representations
guides.concept: 以詞法、語義與可驗證 IR連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect lexing, semantics and verifiable ir through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「詞法契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。字元序列被分成帶位置的 token。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤數字、識別字與運算子。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「錯誤恢復」的資料、控制與時間關係。診斷需定位錯誤而非無限循環。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較缺括號與非法 token。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「型別檢查」的資料、控制與時間關係。型別錯誤應在明定階段拒絕。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出可轉換與不可轉換例。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「CFG」的資料、控制與時間關係。控制流邊與文本先後不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫入口到出口的可達邊。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「支配關係」的資料、控制與時間關係。定義需在適用路徑支配使用。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查分支內定義外部使用。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「回歸測試」的資料、控制與時間關係。正負用例需同時覆蓋語言契約。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立 token、AST 與結果對照。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for lexer contract. Characters become location-bearing tokens. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace numbers, identifiers and operators. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for error recovery. Diagnostics locate errors without endless loops. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare missing brackets and illegal tokens. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for type checking. Type errors are rejected at defined stages. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List permitted and forbidden conversions. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for cfg. Control-flow edges differ from textual order. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw reachable entry-to-exit edges. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for dominance. Definitions dominate uses on relevant paths. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check uses of branch-local definitions. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for regression tests. Positive and negative cases cover language contracts. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build token, AST and result comparisons. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「Undefined 邊界」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「明列除零與溢位語義。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「回歸測試」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「正負用例需同時覆蓋語言契約。」。
提交「回歸測試」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立 token、AST 與結果對照。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit undefined-behavior boundaries input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit regression tests two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit regression tests input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：Phi 的輸入與 CFG predecessor 無關。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Phi inputs are independent of CFG predecessors. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：即時編譯與程式最佳化
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Just-in-time compilation and optimization
guides.concept: 以最佳化合法性、JIT 編譯與去最佳化連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect optimization legality, jit compilation and deoptimization through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「JIT 與 AOT」的資料、控制與時間關係。編譯時間位置與可用資訊不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較啟動與穩態成本。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Profile 資料」的資料、控制與時間關係。過去熱門路徑不能保證未來相同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較訓練與驗收工作負載。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「迴圈不變」的資料、控制與時間關係。搬移運算需確保依賴與例外合法。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查零次迴圈的例外。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「去最佳化」的資料、控制與時間關係。退出特化需重建一般執行狀態。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對 locals 與控制位置。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「編譯回本」的資料、控制與時間關係。總節省需超過編譯成本。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核算本課 100 次回本。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「差分驗證」的資料、控制與時間關係。優化與未優化結果應對照相同語義。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「對邊界資料比較結果。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for jit and aot. Compilation timing and available information differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare startup and steady costs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for profile data. Past hot paths do not guarantee future behavior. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare profiling and acceptance workloads. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for loop invariance. Motion must respect dependencies and exceptions. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check exceptions in zero-iteration loops. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for deoptimization. Leaving specialization reconstructs generic state. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit locals and control position. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for compilation amortization. Savings must exceed compilation cost. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit the 100-call break-even. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for differential validation. Optimized and baseline outputs share semantics. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare outputs on boundary inputs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「數值合法」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較 NaN 與誤差容許契約。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「差分驗證」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「優化與未優化結果應對照相同語義。」。
提交「差分驗證」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「對邊界資料比較結果。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit numerical legality input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit differential validation two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit differential validation input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：每個函式高成本最佳化必定降低總耗時。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Expensive optimization always reduces total time. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.concept: 以命名空間、區塊放置與複製復原連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect namespaces, block placement and replica recovery through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「命名空間」的資料、控制與時間關係。檔案名稱與實際區塊位置分離。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫名稱到區塊的映射。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「讀寫語義」的資料、控制與時間關係。分散檔案介面不必等同所有 POSIX 語義。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出追加與任意覆寫需求。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「寫入管線」的資料、控制與時間關係。資料傳送與確認鏈需分別追蹤。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫三副本的寫入確認。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「區塊報告」的資料、控制與時間關係。存活訊號不等於完整區塊目錄。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對報告版本與遺失區塊。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「復原節流」的資料、控制與時間關係。全速重建可能搶佔使用者頻寬。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較服務與修復資源預算。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「還原演練」的資料、控制與時間關係。資料可讀與命名空間正確都需驗證。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比對完整性、權限與路徑。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for namespace. File names are separate from block locations. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw name-to-block mappings. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for read/write semantics. Distributed interfaces may differ from POSIX semantics. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List append and random-overwrite needs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for write pipeline. Data and acknowledgment chains are distinct. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw three-replica write acknowledgments. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for block reports. Liveness does not establish a complete block inventory. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check report versions and missing blocks. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for recovery throttling. Full-speed rebuild can steal user bandwidth. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare serving and repair budgets. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for restore exercises. Readable data and correct namespaces both matter. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare integrity, permissions and paths. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「小檔成本」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「計算每檔假想 metadata 成本。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「還原演練」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「資料可讀與命名空間正確都需驗證。」。

先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Multipart」的資料、控制與時間關係。分段上傳需完整提交與殘留清理。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤成功與未完成上傳。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「編碼池」的資料、控制與時間關係。資料編碼與 metadata 策略可不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較資料與索引復原責任。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「生命週期」的資料、控制與時間關係。到期政策需考慮法律保存與還原需求。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較資料與未完成段到期。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。

Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare prefixes and directory-move needs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for multipart. Multipart uploads need completion and residue cleanup. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace complete and incomplete uploads. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for coded pools. Data coding and metadata policy may differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare data and index recovery roles. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for lifecycle. Expiry policy accounts for retention and recovery. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare object and unfinished-part expiry. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for capacity headroom. Free space absorbs failures and rebuilds. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit the 20% headroom example. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for repair acceptance. Live object count cannot replace per-object digests. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare versions and digests across repair. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「流量費用」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立假想每月成本表。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「修復驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「存活物件數不能替代逐物件摘要。」。

Submit repair acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit repair acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：不同磁碟自然就有獨立故障概率。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Different disks automatically have independent failures. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.concept: 以ACID、MVCC 與可復原日誌連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect acid, mvcc and recoverable logging through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「ACID 分離」的資料、控制與時間關係。原子性、一致性、隔離與耐久是不同屬性。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「將假想失敗對應各屬性。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「異常分類」的資料、控制與時間關係。髒讀、不可重複讀與幻讀不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「用兩會話紙上時序分類。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Serializable」的資料、控制與時間關係。序列化失敗可能需要整個交易重試。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立不重複副作用的重試。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「提交確認」的資料、控制與時間關係。成功確認需符合選定耐久政策。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較同步與非同步承諾。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「崩潰重播」的資料、控制與時間關係。重播需處理已提交及未完成狀態。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「枚舉不同崩潰位置。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「不變量驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。資料庫提交不代表業務不變量正確。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for acid separation. Atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Map fictional failures to properties. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for anomaly classification. Dirty, nonrepeatable and phantom reads differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify paper traces of two sessions. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for serializable. Serialization failures may require whole-transaction retries. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Design retries without duplicate side effects. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for commit acknowledgment. Acknowledgment follows selected durability policy. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare synchronous/asynchronous promises. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for crash replay. Replay handles committed and unfinished state. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Enumerate crash points. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for invariant acceptance. Commit success does not establish business invariants. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check balance conservation and uniqueness. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

提交「不變量驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「資料庫提交不代表業務不變量正確。」。
提交「不變量驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit version cleanup input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit invariant acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

pitfalls: 常見誤判：資料頁先耐久而日誌後寫仍符合 WAL。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
