procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around constellation graph, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Node positions and link availability both vary over time. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix constellation and change routing-cost weights. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat space and ground edges as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around propagation bounds, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Geometric distance divided by light speed bounds propagation time. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix constellation and change routing-cost weights. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat contact prediction as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around load distribution, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Shortest-path concentration can create queuing congestion. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix load and remove one intersatellite edge. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat distributed state as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around congestion control, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Changing path delay affects transport-feedback interpretation. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare present-only and contact-aware routing. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat multipath tradeoffs as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around failure detours, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Detours require renewed capacity and latency checks. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model inconsistent route updates during handover. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat service priorities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around performance reports, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Report handover loss separately from steady-state throughput. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model inconsistent route updates during handover. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat constellation graph as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat bundle structure as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around convergence layers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Adapters carry bundles; their responsibility differs from routing algorithms. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat persistent storage as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around data lifetime, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Stored data is not valid merely because it remains after expiry. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat store-carry behavior as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around duplicates and retries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retransmission can duplicate data; applications need idempotent handling. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix contact plan and vary storage capacity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat routing responsibilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around timebase limitations, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Lifetime/age handling requires clock-reliability checks. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model intermediary restart with preserved versus lost persistent data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat storage occupancy as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around mission acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceptance tests disruptions, expiry and restart, not just continuous delivery. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model intermediary restart with preserved versus lost persistent data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat dtn overlay as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「量子與古典資源」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「不可複製原理」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around quantum/classical resources, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat no-cloning principle as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: Entanglement establishment needs defined success events and quality. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat coincidence measurements as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around detection efficiency, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: The product of endpoint efficiencies limits observed paired events. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix loss and vary dark counts/coincidence window. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat time tags as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around quantum memories, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Memory lifetime must cover waiting and protocol-feedback delay. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare records with/without classical time tags. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat swapping and repeaters as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around coexistence noise, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Classical optical channels can affect quantum channels through scattering noise. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model memory lifetime shorter than protocol waiting time. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat qkd versus quantum networks as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around testbed acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Report optical loss, timing error and state quality separately. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model memory lifetime shorter than protocol waiting time. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat quantum/classical resources as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「資源盤點」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先界定保護資源與動作，才有可審查的政策。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定使用者，只改裝置健康證據是否新鮮。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「主體身分」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Principle: Define protected resources/actions before reviewable policy. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat subject identities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Principle: Permission scope should match tasks rather than permanent total access. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat device evidence as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around network segmentation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Segmentation restricts reachability, not resource authorization. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix policy and vary resource sensitivity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat workload identities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around continuous evaluation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: State changes can trigger reevaluation beyond initial login. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare cached decisions before/after revocation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat revocation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around exception lifecycle, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Exceptions need scope, expiry and approval records. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat audit correlation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around migration acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Resource-by-resource migration checks closure of old bypass paths. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat resource inventory as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around identity proofing, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Separate claimed identity from evidence validating that claim. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix users and vary role sets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat stable identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around authentication/authorization, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Authentication identifies subjects; authorization permits actions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix users and vary role sets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat role models as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around separation of duties, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Conflicting-grant constraints limit single-person high-risk chains. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic tokens with correct/incorrect audiences. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat federation boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around oauth scopes, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Scopes constrain delegated access, not complete identity proof. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix organization and vary leaver-revocation timing. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat session lifecycle as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around access reviews, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reviews check necessity, not merely continued existence. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controlled recovery after identity-provider failure. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat recovery boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around leaver acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Login removal also checks tokens, keys and shared secrets. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controlled recovery after identity-provider failure. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat identity proofing as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: Knowledge, possession and biometrics are distinct factor categories. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare two knowledge factors with distinct factor categories. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat factor independence as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around one-time codes, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: One-time use needs lifetime, reuse rejection and guess limits. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare two knowledge factors with distinct factor categories. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat challenge freshness as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around rp id and origin, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Origin/RP checks prevent cross-site credential misuse. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix account and vary challenge freshness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat user verification as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around device binding, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Device-bound and synchronized credentials offer different tradeoffs. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic records with correct/incorrect RP IDs. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat server storage as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around loss recovery, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Recovery needs reviewable proof and alerts, not convenience alone. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controlled recovery after authenticator loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rate limits as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around revocation acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Removing an authenticator must invalidate its continuing verification. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controlled recovery after authenticator loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat factor categories as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around trust anchors, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Trust anchors come from policy configuration, not self-signing alone. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat roots and intermediates as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around path building, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Multiple paths may exist; construction and validation differ. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat signature validation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around validity time, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Clock errors affect NotBefore/NotAfter interpretation. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare correct/incorrect name constraints. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat basic constraints as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around name constraints, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Ancestor constraints remain effective down the path. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix certificates and vary trust-anchor sets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat revocation data as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around issuance audits, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Issuance requests/approvals must correlate concrete versions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model intermediate revocation affecting leaves. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat chain updates as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around validation matrix, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Test valid, expired, wrong-name and wrong-usage cases. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model intermediate revocation affecting leaves. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat trust anchors as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around key wrapping, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Model standby-module unavailability and approved recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat audit events as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around retirement verification, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retirement verifies secret clearing and backup disposition. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model standby-module unavailability and approved recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat module boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around asset associations, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat key state machine as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around entropy and generation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Key material needs suitable randomness, not predictable identifiers. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat distribution channels as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around version identifiers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Ciphertext must identify the correct key version. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare rotating data keys with wrapping keys. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat envelope encryption as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around revocation/destruction, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Disallowing new use and permanent destruction are distinct states. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix algorithms and vary data retention years. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat recovery policies as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around incident scope, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Trace which data a compromised key protects. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model historical reads after one key is revoked. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat backup consistency as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around destruction evidence, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Deleting an index does not clear every backed-up secret. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model historical reads after one key is revoked. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat asset associations as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「ACME 角色」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：客戶端、帳戶與 CA 之间有不同對象責任。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定域名，只改 challenge 回應是否正確。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「帳戶憑據」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around name coverage, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Certificate names must match deployed services. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare issued-but-undeployed versus deployed certificates. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat certificate chains as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around rate limits, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retries respect CA limits rather than unlimited repetition. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix validity and vary renewal-service outage duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat atomic deployment as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around expiry monitoring, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Expiry monitoring inspects certificates actually served. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model two nodes rotating inconsistent chain versions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat incident revocation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around tls-version checks, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: RFC 9846 supersedes 8446 in 2026; implementations need version-specific checks. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model two nodes rotating inconsistent chain versions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat acme roles as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「風險時間線」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：長保存秘密需考慮今天收集未來解密風險。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定安全目標，只改 KEM 與簽章用途。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「密碼盤點」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around risk timelines, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Long-lived secrets need harvest-now/decrypt-later risk analysis. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix goals and compare KEM versus signature roles. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat cryptographic inventory as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around signature roles, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Signatures verify origin/integrity, not data encryption. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix goals and compare KEM versus signature roles. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat ml-kem as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around slh-dsa, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: SLH-DSA uses stateless hash signatures with different size tradeoffs. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare legacy handshakes with larger key-material sizes. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat security categories as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around hybrid boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Combined schemes need explicit protocol and failure semantics. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix algorithms and vary required confidentiality lifetime. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat protocol interoperability as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around validation vectors, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Known-answer tests verify implementations, not every execution path. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controlled migration for clients lacking new formats. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat migration pilots as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around standard updates, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Production checks errata and pinned document versions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controlled migration for clients lacking new formats. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat risk timelines as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around acceptance datasets, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Datasets need benign business variants and synthetic anomalies. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：安全網頁應用程式防護
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Web-application protection systems
guides.concept: 以應用控制、防護規則與正常流量驗證串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect application controls, protection rules and benign-traffic validation through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「應用資產」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先界定資料與動作，才可驗證保護要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「信任邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「輸入格式」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：正規化與解析次序可能改變檢查結果。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「規則範圍」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「False positive」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：合法變體誤攔應以業務案例重現。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較有與沒有來源端授權檢查的本地模型。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Rate limiting」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「原站保護」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：入口防護需避免未受控旁路直達原站。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定流量，只改規則數量與處理成本。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「回應資料」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「檢測與封鎖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先觀察可協助調校，但不等於已阻止流量。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「規則版本」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「防護驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：正常、邊界與合成異常案例均需覆蓋。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「應用資產」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around application assets, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define data/actions before verifying protection requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat trust boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around input formats, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Normalization/parsing order can change inspection results. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rule scopes as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around false positives, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reproduce benign false blocks with business cases. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare local models with/without origin authorization. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rate limiting as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around origin protection, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Ingress protection needs closure of uncontrolled origin bypasses. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix traffic and vary rule count/processing cost. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat response data as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around detection versus blocking, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Observation aids tuning but does not imply blocking. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rule versions as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around protection acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceptance covers benign, boundary and synthetic anomaly cases. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat application assets as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「回滾決策」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for rollback decisions. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

pitfallsEn: Higher rejection rates necessarily mean greater security. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.concept: 以端點事件、偵測證據與核准回應串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect endpoint events, detection evidence and approved response through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「端點覆蓋」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：感測器缺失會產生不可觀測區域。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定事件，只改程序父子關係。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「程序事件」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「網路事件」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：連線紀錄不一定包含應用內容。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定事件，只改程序父子關係。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「時間排序」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「技術映射」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：ATT&CK 映射組織觀察，不替代具體規則。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較感測器啟用與離線時的證據缺口。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「規則資料需求」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「證據保存」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：調查前後需保持來源與完整性紀錄。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留規則，只改正常管理活動比例。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「告警分級」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Fix events and vary parent-child relationships. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat time ordering as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around technique mapping, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: ATT&CK mappings organize observations, not concrete rules. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare evidence gaps with active/offline sensors. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rule data requirements as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around evidence preservation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Maintain provenance/integrity records throughout investigation. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign administrative activity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat alert severity as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: Stopped events may indicate sensor failure, not normality. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model service impact after approved endpoint isolation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat privacy minimization as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around response acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Verify detection, decision, approval and recovery end to end. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model service impact after approved endpoint isolation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat endpoint coverage as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around source inventory, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat collection channels as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: Event occurrence time and collection time are distinct fields and must be recorded separately. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat timezone and skew as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Compare different name mappings for one subject. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat correlation windows as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around retention, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retention follows investigation, cost and privacy needs. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary ingestion delay. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around detection gaps, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Source outages need health-event handling. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model storage outage and buffered recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat incident workflow as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around observation points, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around reassembly assumptions, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reordering and missing packets limit parsable content. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary mirror placement. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat protocol decoding as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around rule conditions, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rules must match fields actually collected. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare flow summaries with complete synthetic protocol records. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat baseline models as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around detection thresholds, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Lower thresholds can raise recall and false positives. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary encrypted-traffic share. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat low base rates as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around alert correlation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Corroborate alerts with identity, endpoint and timing evidence. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model sensor packet loss and resulting evidence gaps. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat controlled data as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around blind-spot reporting, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Report unobserved regions rather than claiming complete protection. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model sensor packet loss and resulting evidence gaps. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat observation points as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

guides.concept: 以OT 區域、通道與不中斷的防禦證據串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect ot zones, conduits and non-disruptive defensive evidence through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「OT 資產邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：控制器、感測與工程站有不同安全需求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定設備，只改核准流矩陣。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「程序依賴」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「通道定義」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：跨區通道應對應必要業務流。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定設備，只改核准流矩陣。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「流矩陣」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「遠端維護」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：維護需批准、限時與可歸屬身分。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較管理與程序控制通道的權限。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「管理通道」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「協議限制」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：舊協議可能缺少身分與完整性保護。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留規則，只改維護例外期限。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「單向資料」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「補丁取捨」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：補丁需符合設備相容與程序驗證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬隔離失效與預先定義的安全降階。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「事件保存」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「離線驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：本課使用流矩陣模擬，不掃描真實工控設備。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬隔離失效與預先定義的安全降階。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「OT 資產邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around ot asset boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Controllers, sensing and engineering stations have different needs. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix equipment and vary approved-flow matrices. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat process dependencies as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around conduit definitions, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Interzone conduits should map required operational flows. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix equipment and vary approved-flow matrices. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat flow matrices as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around remote maintenance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Maintenance needs approval, time bounds and attributable identity. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare management/process-control conduit permissions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat management conduits as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around protocol limitations, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Legacy protocols may lack identity/integrity protection. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary maintenance-exception expiry. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat unidirectional data as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around patch tradeoffs, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Patches need equipment compatibility and process validation. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model isolation failure and predefined safe degradation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat event preservation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around offline acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: This course simulates flow matrices without scanning live OT equipment. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model isolation failure and predefined safe degradation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat ot asset boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

pitfalls: VLAN 名稱不同即證明所有跨區流量已受控。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：物聯網裝置身分驗證
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: IoT device authentication
guides.concept: 以裝置根信任、佈建與憑據更新串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect device roots of trust, provisioning and credential renewal through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「裝置識別」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「唯一憑據」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「安全佈建」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：初始身分需與實際裝置及所有者關聯。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「秘密儲存」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「DTLS 邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：資料報安全仍需處理重排與重傳。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較有效與已撤銷的合成憑據。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「時鐘限制」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「遠端證明」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：證明報告須檢驗新鮮度及預期測量。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留算法，只改裝置可用時鐘品質。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「佈建角色」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「撤銷傳播」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：離線狀態會延後裝置取得撤銷資訊。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬離線期間續期與受控恢復。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「裝置群峰值」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「證據驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：唯一性、時效、拒絕與復原都須測試。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬離線期間續期與受控恢復。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「裝置識別」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around device identifiers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat unique credentials as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around secure provisioning, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Initial identity must bind the device and owner. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat secret storage as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around dtls boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Datagram security still handles reordering/retransmission. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare valid/revoked synthetic credentials. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat clock limitations as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around remote attestation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Attestation checks freshness and expected measurements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix algorithms and vary device-clock quality. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat provisioning roles as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around revocation propagation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Offline states delay device receipt of revocation data. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model renewal during offline periods and controlled recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat fleet bursts as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around evidence acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Test uniqueness, freshness, rejection and recovery. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model renewal during offline periods and controlled recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat device identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「退役處置」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around vehicle function maps, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Powertrain, body and infotainment have different risks/deadlines. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frames and vary interarrival patterns. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat message identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: Related signals corroborate but need not be permanently linear. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare authorized/unauthorized synthetic diagnostic events. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat gateway boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: Update origin/version verification differs from download success. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary bus load. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat logs and privacy as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: False blocking can affect safety; review responses formally. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model monitor failure and alert-coverage effects. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat safety responsibilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Principle: This course analyzes authored records without connecting/injecting into vehicles. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model monitor failure and alert-coverage effects. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat vehicle function maps as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect memory protection, remote attestation and secret release through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「威胁模型」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「保護邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「受測工作負載」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：測量值須代表可審查版本及配置。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Attester」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around threat models, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat protection boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around measured workloads, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Measurements represent reviewable versions/configurations. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat attesters as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around relying parties, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Relying parties use appraisal results for concrete authorization. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare fresh/replayed attestation records. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat freshness as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around reference values, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Approved releases define trusted measurements, not self-declaration. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix evidence and vary trust-policy version. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat secret release as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around rollback limits, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Once-approved old versions may later be prohibited for vulnerabilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model application authorization flaws beyond the host-protection scope. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat i/o boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around deployment acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Test wrong measurements, stale reports and authorization rejection. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model application authorization flaws beyond the host-protection scope. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat threat models as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
