procedure: 先觀察師傅的「資產識別」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「優先序」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：利用證據、重要性與可補償控制共同決定順序。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用匿名情境比較同分不同暴露面的排序。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「變更視窗」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：可用性與風險會共同約束部署時間。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較有備援與單節點的停機預算。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「金絲雀部署」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：少量先行部署降低影響範圍但不代表所有負載。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較合成金絲雀與全量流量分佈。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「修補證據」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：更新成功日誌還需與執行版本交叉核對。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較假想安裝紀錄與重新啟動後版本。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「復原回顧」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：故障原因、版本與驗收證據應可重建。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用離線時間線重現失敗批次與回退決策。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for asset identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for prioritization. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Evidence, criticality and compensating controls jointly inform priority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Rank anonymous equal-score cases with different exposure. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for change windows. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Availability and risk jointly constrain deployment timing. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare downtime budgets with and without redundancy. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for canary rollout. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: A small canary limits impact but may not represent all workloads. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare synthetic canary and full traffic distributions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for patch evidence. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Update-success logs require running-version cross-checks. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare installation records and post-restart versions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for recovery review. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Causes, versions and acceptance evidence must be reconstructable. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Reconstruct a failed batch and rollback decision offline. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「覆蓋分母」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「未知資產不應計入任何風險討論。」為何不成立。
提交「復原回顧」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用離線時間線重現失敗批次與回退決策。」如何辨別它們。
提交「復原回顧」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「復原成功表示不需保留失敗資料。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for coverage denominators; explain why this claim fails: Unknown assets need no risk consideration.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for recovery review; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for recovery review; explain why this claim fails: Successful recovery removes the need to retain failure evidence.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：復原成功表示不需保留失敗資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Successful recovery removes the need to retain failure evidence. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect coordination of detection, containment and business recovery with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「授權範圍」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：演練的系統、資料與處置許可權應事先確定。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以玩具環境寫出允許和禁止的處置。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

先觀察師傅的「事件分級」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：分級需同時考慮影響與確定度。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較高影響低確定度與低影響高確定度。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「證據與復原」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：急速復原可能改寫尚未儲存的證據。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較先取樣與先重啟的資料保留情境。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「通知紀錄」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：通知應依已確認事實、時點與責任角色。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「撰寫匿名演練摘要並標示未證實項。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「修正追蹤」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：改善事項需負責人、到期與重演證據。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「將一項流程缺口轉成可觀察的再次演練。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for exercise authority. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Systems, data and response authority are defined before exercises. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify allowed and prohibited actions in a toy environment. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for exercise injects. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Injects distinguish expected behavior and uncertain branches. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Design fictional service disruption without attacking systems. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for incident severity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Severity accounts for impact and confidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare high-impact uncertain and low-impact certain cases. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for evidence and recovery. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rapid recovery can overwrite unpreserved evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare sampling-first and restart-first evidence retention. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for communication records. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Communication follows confirmed facts, timing and accountable roles. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Write an anonymous exercise brief with unconfirmed items marked. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for corrective-action tracking. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Actions need owners, deadlines and re-exercise evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Turn a process gap into an observable repeat exercise. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「復盤因果」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「故障後最後一個變更必然是原因。」為何不成立。
提交「修正追蹤」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「將一項流程缺口轉成可觀察的再次演練。」如何辨別它們。
提交「修正追蹤」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「寫下改善建議便等於風險已降低。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for review causality; explain why this claim fails: The last preceding change is necessarily the cause.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for corrective-action tracking; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for corrective-action tracking; explain why this claim fails: Writing a recommendation means risk is reduced.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：寫下改善建議便等於風險已降低。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Writing a recommendation means risk is reduced. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for authority and scope. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Evidence access is bounded by data, purpose and authority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Define analyzable areas on self-created test files. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for collection alteration. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Collection tools may themselves change observed state. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: List logs and timestamps a toy collector may change. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for hash integrity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Cryptographic hashes detect changes, not content truth. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Change one bit in a self-made copy and compare digests. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for files and sectors. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Allocated files and unallocated regions differ. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare directory entries with byte ranges in a self-made image. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for collection throughput. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Read/write bottlenecks and verification passes set duration. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate collection and verification time bounds. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for retention and deletion. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retention, access and compliance requirements are managed separately. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify retention, expiry and exceptions in a fictional workflow. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「報告重現」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只有截圖即可完整重現分析。」為何不成立。
提交「儲存與刪除」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在假想流程列出儲存、到期及例外批准。」如何辨別它們。

evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for report reproduction; explain why this claim fails: Screenshots alone fully reproduce analysis.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for retention and deletion; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for retention and deletion; explain why this claim fails: Keeping more evidence forever is always better.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：證據越多儲存越久永遠越好。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Keeping more evidence forever is always better. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：隱私保護資料分析
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Privacy-preserving data analytics
guides.concept: 以資料最小化與隱私效用權衡串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect data minimization and privacy–utility trade-offs with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「用途邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同一資料可因使用目的不同而形成不同隱私風險。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「信任邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：蒐集者、分析者與發布者可有不同許可權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「標示匿名架構每一層可見的欄位。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「聚合選擇」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：粗分群降低解析度但不自動給出正式隱私保證。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較不同分箱的偏差與最小群組數。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

先觀察師傅的「效用決策」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：隱私、誤差與服務目的需共同定義可接受範圍。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用本課算例寫出限用條件與未決風險。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for purpose boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: The same data creates different privacy risks under different purposes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for trust boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Collectors, analysts and publishers can have different privileges. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark fields visible at each layer of an anonymous architecture. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for aggregation choices. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Coarse grouping reduces detail without automatically giving formal privacy. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare bias and smallest groups under different binning. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for noise and error. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Randomized protection adds variance and does not guarantee every operation unbiased. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare error distributions with synthetic sampling. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for bias checks. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Overall utility can hide poor minority-group errors. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Report synthetic-group errors and missingness separately. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for utility decisions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Privacy, error and purpose jointly define acceptable performance. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: State limits and unresolved risk for the example. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「再現與稽核」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「重現必須向所有人公開原始個資。」為何不成立。
提交「效用決策」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用本課算例寫出限用條件與未決風險。」如何辨別它們。
提交「效用決策」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「選最小 ε 就必然得到最佳產品。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for reproduction and audit; explain why this claim fails: Reproduction requires sharing personal data with everyone.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for utility decisions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for utility decisions; explain why this claim fails: The smallest ε necessarily yields the best product.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：選最小 ε 就必然得到最佳產品。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: The smallest ε necessarily yields the best product. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for federation boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Local data retention does not prevent update or model leakage. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Trace raw data, updates and global-model flows. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for local backpropagation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: The chain rule propagates local loss gradients to parameters. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Check one tiny-network gradient with finite differences. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for non-iid data. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Label and feature shifts change aggregate gradient direction. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare gradient angles for two synthetic clients. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for secure aggregation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Canceling masks hide individual updates while revealing allowed aggregates. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Verify mask cancellation with three toy vectors. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for model validation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Global and client tests must avoid overlapping training data. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build client-isolated and time-isolated synthetic tests. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for delivery versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Released models link participation policies and privacy accounting. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Create a personal-data-free toy model card and settings digest. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「收斂診斷」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「損失升高只有學習率過高一個原因。」為何不成立。
提交「交付版本」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「產生無個資的玩具模型卡與設定摘要。」如何辨別它們。
提交「交付版本」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「保留最終權重便足以稽核聯邦訓練。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for convergence diagnosis; explain why this claim fails: Higher loss can only mean an excessive learning rate.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for delivery versions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for delivery versions; explain why this claim fails: Final weights suffice to audit federated training.

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for protected units. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: A record and a person may be different adjacency units. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare sensitivity with one versus many records per person. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for meaning of delta. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Delta is an additive approximate-DP allowance, not mean error. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark epsilon and delta separately in the probability inequality. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for gaussian mechanism. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Gaussian calibration needs epsilon, delta and sensitivity. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare calibrated methods only under stated assumptions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for parallel composition. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Parallel composition requires disjoint protected units. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare cross-partition people with truly disjoint people. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for utility intervals. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Noise tails may dominate relative error for small counts. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare relative errors for small and large counts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for release ledger. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Releases record mechanism, parameters, adjacency and version. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Create a fictional ledger without private random seeds. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for plain/cipher boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Homomorphic computation protects processing while allowing result decryption. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw data owner, evaluator and result recipient. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for security parameters. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Polynomial dimension and ciphertext modulus jointly affect security estimates. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Read standard tables without treating toy values as secure. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：搜尋引擎索引與排序
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Search-engine indexing and ranking
guides.concept: 以倒排索引、詞項評分與搜尋品質串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect inverted indexes, term scoring and search quality with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「檔案身分」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：索引檔案需穩定 ID、版本和來源。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把三個自製檔案的更新映到索引 ID。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「欄位語意」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：標題、內文與識別欄位需不同分析規則。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較工程型號作 keyword 與分詞的差別。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「長度正規化」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：長檔案的詞頻需依相對長度調整。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較相同 tf 的短文與長文。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

先觀察師傅的「搜尋驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：延遲、相關性、更新與授權需共同驗收。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在離線題集列出指標及失敗查詢。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for document identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Indexed documents need stable IDs, versions and origins. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Map updates of three self-made documents to index IDs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for field semantics. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Titles, bodies and identifiers need different analysis rules. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare keyword versus tokenized engineering model numbers. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for length normalization. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Long-document frequencies are adjusted by relative length. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare short and long documents with equal term frequency. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for phrase queries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Term positions affect phrase and proximity matches. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare toy texts with identical terms in different orders. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for shard statistics. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Different shard corpora can affect score comparisons. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare global and shard-level frequencies on paper. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for search acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Latency, relevance, freshness and rights are accepted jointly. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: List metrics and failed queries on an offline set. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「內容授權」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「網頁公開就可不限量重製全文。」為何不成立。
提交「搜尋驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在離線題集列出指標及失敗查詢。」如何辨別它們。
提交「搜尋驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「平均延遲最快的系統必然搜尋最佳。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for content rights; explain why this claim fails: Public webpages allow unlimited full-text copying.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for search acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for search acceptance; explain why this claim fails: The lowest mean latency guarantees the best search.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：平均延遲最快的系統必然搜尋最佳。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: The lowest mean latency guarantees the best search. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect retrieval, neural generation and evidence faithfulness with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「來源可用」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：來源需有版本、授權與可引用位置。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「為自製手冊建立來源 ID 與段落位址。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

先觀察師傅的「再排序模型」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：交叉編碼器比較查詢與檔案對，成本隨候選數增加。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫雙塔與交叉編碼器的計算路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「提示信任」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：來源內容是資料，不能自動提升為系統指令。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自製含無害錯誤指示的檔案驗證隔離。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「引用對齊」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：每項宣告需對應支援它的段落與條件。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「逐句檢查合成答案與手冊內容。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「迴歸題集」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：題集需包含矛盾、許可權、未知與數值邊界。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自製資料建立可重算的八題題集。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for source usability. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Sources need versions, rights and citeable locations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Assign source IDs and paragraph addresses to a self-made manual. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for data permissions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Candidates are permission-filtered before generation. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Verify fictional private chunks never enter unauthorized prompts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for reranking models. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Cross-encoders score query-document pairs with candidate-dependent cost. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw dual-encoder and cross-encoder computation paths. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for prompt trust. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Source content is data, not automatically system authority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Test separation using self-made harmless misleading text. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for citation alignment. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Each claim maps to supporting passages and conditions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Check each synthetic claim against the manual. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for regression queries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tests include contradictions, permissions, unknowns and numeric boundaries. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build eight reproducible questions from self-made data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「延遲拆解」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只看生成速度便代表整體服務速度。」為何不成立。
提交「迴歸題集」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用自製資料建立可重算的八題題集。」如何辨別它們。
提交「迴歸題集」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只測容易回答問題即可驗收 RAG。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for latency decomposition; explain why this claim fails: Generation speed equals total service speed.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for regression queries; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for regression queries; explain why this claim fails: Easy questions alone validate RAG.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：只測容易回答問題即可驗收 RAG。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Easy questions alone validate RAG. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

procedure: 先觀察師傅的「參數與啟用」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：權重、啟用與快取有不同生命週期。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫單請求與多請求的記憶體共享範圍。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「前饋層」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：逐 token 非線性變換可主導參數與運算量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「計算玩具 d×4d×d 兩層矩陣維度。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「因果遮罩」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：自迴歸 token 不能讀取尚未生成的未來位置。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫三 token 下三角可見矩陣。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

先觀察師傅的「Decode」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：decode 每步新增 token，常受權重讀取與快取存取約束。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用本地假模型分開計時 prefill 與 decode。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「連續批次」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：動態合批提高利用率但需處理請求生命週期。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「模擬短長請求加入退出的排程表。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「服務驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：首 token、每 token、尾延遲與品質應一起報告。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「建立合成請求矩陣並保留失敗案例。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for parameters and activations. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Weights, activations and caches have different lifetimes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw memory sharing for one and multiple requests. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for feed-forward layers. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Per-token nonlinear transformations can dominate parameters and compute. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate dimensions of a toy d-to-4d-to-d block. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for causal masks. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Autoregressive tokens cannot read future positions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw a three-token lower-triangular visibility matrix. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for decode. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Decode appends tokens and can be limited by weight and cache access. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Time prefill and decode separately with a local toy model. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for continuous batching. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Dynamic batching improves utilization while tracking request lifecycles. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Simulate short and long request arrivals and exits. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for service acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: First-token, per-token, tail latency and quality are reported together. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build a synthetic request matrix and retain failures. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「生成策略」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「temperature=0 就保證所有事實正確。」為何不成立。
提交「服務驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「建立合成請求矩陣並保留失敗案例。」如何辨別它們。
提交「服務驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只報每秒 token 就證明服務適合所有使用者。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for generation policies; explain why this claim fails: Temperature zero guarantees factual correctness.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for service acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for service acceptance; explain why this claim fails: Tokens per second alone proves universal service suitability.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：只報每秒 token 就證明服務適合所有使用者。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Tokens per second alone proves universal service suitability. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.concept: 以資料版本、管線相依與訓練重現串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect data versions, pipeline dependencies and training reproduction with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「資料身分」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「許可用途」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：訓練與公開散佈可能需要不同授權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「為自製和官方連結分別記錄允許用途。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「快取與去重」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：內容重用可減少複製但需驗證物件完整性。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重算本課理想儲存並標記不能共享部分。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「失效重算」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：輸入或參數變化需重算受影響的後續階段。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在玩具圖傳播一個參數變更。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「血緣記錄」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：模型版本需連線實際輸入、參數和程式。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「為玩具模型生成完整血緣摘要。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「交付驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：交付需驗證內容、執行與授權三種完整性。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓同學用無私人資料的封包重現小訓練。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for data identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for license purposes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Training and redistribution may need different permissions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Record separate permissions for self-made files and links. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for caching and deduplication. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Content reuse reduces copies but needs integrity checks. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate ideal storage and unshareable regions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for invalidation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Changed inputs or parameters invalidate downstream stages. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Propagate one parameter change through a toy graph. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for lineage records. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Model versions link actual inputs, parameters and code. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Produce a complete lineage digest for a toy model. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for delivery acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Delivery checks content, execution and rights integrity. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Have a peer reproduce toy training without private data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「留存策略」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「刪除舊資料不影響任何舊模型重現。」為何不成立。
提交「交付驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「讓同學用無私人資料的封包重現小訓練。」如何辨別它們。
提交「交付驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「ZIP 可以解壓就表示研究可重現。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for retention policies; explain why this claim fails: Deleting old data never affects old-model reproduction.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for delivery acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for delivery acceptance; explain why this claim fails: Unzipping proves research reproducibility.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：ZIP 可以解壓就表示研究可重現。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Unzipping proves research reproducibility. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

Watch the mentor demonstration for data assimilation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Prediction-observation fusion weights error models. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare high- and low-noise toy measurement weights. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Principle: Reading state, writing settings and managing policy are separated. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for job boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tasks, job steps and allocations are distinct entities. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw a toy job with two step types. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Track node-hours for anonymous toy accounts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare neighboring and scattered toy nodes. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for environment versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Compilers, libraries and inputs are pinned for reproduction. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Record toy environment versions and input digests. Watch the mentor demonstration for queue time. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Waiting and execution times are reported separately. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare short run/long wait total turnaround. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for failure classes; explain why this claim fails: More nodes solve every failure.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for delivery validation; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for domain decomposition. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for boundary conditions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical and interdomain boundaries are handled differently. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark both boundary types on a toy diffusion grid. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for nonblocking completion. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Buffers may remain in use after nonblocking calls return. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark buffer reuse only after completion on a toy timeline. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for reduction numerics. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Nonassociative floating addition makes reduction order affect low bits. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare two orders with large, small and negative-large values. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for strong/weak scaling. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Fixed total and per-rank problem sizes are different tests. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate both efficiencies from synthetic timings. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for result validation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Parallel results compare with serial, small-scale and conserved constraints. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate mass and errors on a self-made diffusion grid. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：IBM Heron 超導量子處理器
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor
guides.concept: 以可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制解析IBM Heron 超導量子處理器：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor through tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識transmon 能階。約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 建立超導電路與非諧性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Heron 耦合圖。原生可用的雙位元連線限制編譯；SWAP 路由增加深度與噪聲暴露。 建立耦合圖與路由的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識微波控制線。控制脈衝的頻譜可同時激發鄰近模態；閘錯誤不只是振幅偏差。 建立微波控制與串擾的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較單獨與同時操作的假想錯誤矩陣。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識色散讀出鏈。讀出將位元狀態映射到共振器響應；混淆矩陣與相干誤差是不同證據。 建立色散讀出與指派誤差的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由標籤資料重算讀出混淆矩陣並保留樣本數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多溫層熱路。每條控制線帶入熱與雜訊；低溫層的冷卻能力需按溫度分開預算。 建立低溫熱路與訊號負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。建立各溫層的負載、裕度與線數假想表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識邏輯錯誤證據。邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。 建立錯誤更正與邏輯證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify transmon levels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of superconducting circuits and anharmonicity, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify heron coupling graph in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Native two-qubit connectivity constrains compilation; SWAP routing increases depth and noise exposure. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of coupling graphs and routing, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify microwave control lines in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Control spectra can excite neighboring modes; gate error is not only amplitude error. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microwave control and crosstalk, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare hypothetical isolated and simultaneous-operation error matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify dispersive readout chain in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Readout maps states to resonator response; a confusion matrix differs from coherent-error evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of dispersive readout and assignment error, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate a labeled readout confusion matrix with sample counts. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify multistage heat paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Each control line carries heat and noise; cooling capacity is budgeted separately by temperature stage. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cryogenic heat paths and signal loads, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify logical-error evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Logical and physical error rates differ; threshold behavior requires comparisons across code distances under controlled conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of error correction and logical evidence, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交多溫層熱路的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交邏輯錯誤證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交邏輯錯誤證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for multistage heat paths.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for logical-error evidence.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for logical-error evidence.

pitfallsEn: Common misconception: More physical qubits necessarily reduce logical error.

procedureEn: Identify ankaa junctions and levels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of superconducting circuits and anharmonicity, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify square-lattice routing in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Native two-qubit connectivity constrains compilation; SWAP routing increases depth and noise exposure. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of coupling graphs and routing, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify fsim and iswap controls in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Control spectra can excite neighboring modes; gate error is not only amplitude error. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microwave control and crosstalk, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare hypothetical isolated and simultaneous-operation error matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify readout assignment matrix in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Readout maps states to resonator response; a confusion matrix differs from coherent-error evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of dispersive readout and assignment error, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate a labeled readout confusion matrix with sample counts. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify thermalization and shielding in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Each control line carries heat and noise; cooling capacity is budgeted separately by temperature stage. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cryogenic heat paths and signal loads, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify gate errors and logical evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Logical and physical error rates differ; threshold behavior requires comparisons across code distances under controlled conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of error correction and logical evidence, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

procedureEn: Identify yb ions and collective modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Electric fields confine charged ions; collective motion mediates some entangling gates. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ion traps and modes, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate internal states, motional modes and environmental noise. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify optical addressing and channels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Beam addressing localizes control, but sidelobes and drift can affect neighbors. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of laser addressing and spatial crosstalk, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare intended and unintended responses in an addressing matrix. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify motion-mediated gates in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of motion-mediated entanglement, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify gate-zone scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Logical all-to-all connectivity does not imply unlimited parallel gates; shared optical channels and modes constrain scheduling. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of connectivity and scheduling, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare serial and resource-limited schedules for the same gate set. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify racetrack qccd transport in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. QCCD connects zones by transport; rearrangement time and heating contribute to circuit cost. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ion transport and zoning, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw a two-zone transport graph and separate gates, transport and cooling. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify mid-circuit fluorescence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Readout uses photon-count statistics; reset, spectator qubits and duration affect mid-circuit measurement. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of fluorescence readout and reuse, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assignment errors for two count distributions and record the readout window. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

procedureEn: Identify forte ion-chain modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IonQ Forte optically addressed quantum core. Electric fields confine charged ions; collective motion mediates some entangling gates. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ion traps and modes, focusing on acousto-optic addressing and linear ion chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate internal states, motional modes and environmental noise. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify aod beam addressing in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IonQ Forte optically addressed quantum core. Beam addressing localizes control, but sidelobes and drift can affect neighbors. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of laser addressing and spatial crosstalk, focusing on acousto-optic addressing and linear ion chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare intended and unintended responses in an addressing matrix. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify laser entanglement and closed paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IonQ Forte optically addressed quantum core. Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of motion-mediated entanglement, focusing on acousto-optic addressing and linear ion chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify connectivity and shared optics in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IonQ Forte optically addressed quantum core. Logical all-to-all connectivity does not imply unlimited parallel gates; shared optical channels and modes constrain scheduling. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of connectivity and scheduling, focusing on acousto-optic addressing and linear ion chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare serial and resource-limited schedules for the same gate set. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify rearrangement and channel boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IonQ Forte optically addressed quantum core. Forte emphasizes optically configurable ion chains; QCCD transport is a contrasting architecture, not a claim that Forte implements a racetrack QCCD. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of linear chains versus qccd, focusing on acousto-optic addressing and linear ion chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare addressing reconfiguration/ion transport and label publicly supported functions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify fluorescence and sample distributions in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IonQ Forte optically addressed quantum core. Readout uses photon-count statistics; reset, spectator qubits and duration affect mid-circuit measurement. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of fluorescence readout and reuse, focusing on acousto-optic addressing and linear ion chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assignment errors for two count distributions and record the readout window. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.concept: 以可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬解析QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine through reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Aquila光鑷佔位。中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。 建立光鑷陣列與裝載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
