procedureEn: Identify aquila tweezer occupancy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of optical-tweezer arrays and loading, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify rydberg distance coupling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Rydberg interactions depend strongly on distance; common models use C6/r6 for pair shifts. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of rydberg blockade and distance, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare 1.0 and 1.1 separation at fixed assumed C6. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify analog drive and detuning in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Drive, detuning and geometry define a time-dependent model; analog evolution is not an arbitrary digital circuit. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of analog hamiltonians, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recompute small-system eigenvalues as control parameters change. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify aquila channel constraints in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Channels, timing and addressing bound sequences; emulator-valid controls may not be hardware-valid. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of pulse and hardware constraints, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check an assumed sequence field-by-field against public device constraints. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify atom-loss labels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Loss can arise during loading, evolution or readout; not every missing atom signifies excitation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of atom loss and measurement, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate pre/post occupancy from readout confusion tables. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify many-body spatial correlations in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Correlations are estimated from repeated shots; spatial structure and finite-sample bias both matter. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of correlators and finite samples, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare means/error bars for independent and correlated samples. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.concept: 以近接材料、奇偶讀出及拓撲宣稱審查解析Majorana 1 研發與奇偶量測證據：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。

procedure: 在「Majorana 1 研發與奇偶量測證據」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識InAs–Al近接結構。半導體與超導體的近接結構可能產生不同低能態；材料設計本身不是拓撲證據。 建立近接材料與能隙的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是近接材料、奇偶讀出及拓撲宣稱審查。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。列出拓撲與平庸模型都能解釋的觀測。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Majorana 1 研發與奇偶量測證據」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識指派分佈。讀出指派錯誤取決於分佈重疊與時間窗；信噪比不是邏輯位元精度。 建立信噪比與指派的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是近接材料、奇偶讀出及拓撲宣稱審查。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想分佈重算信噪比及錯誤率。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Majorana 1 研發與奇偶量測證據」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識論文與路線圖邊界。原始論文的適用範圍可能小於公司路線圖；應保存版本、數據與推論限制。 建立研究重現與版本的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是近接材料、奇偶讀出及拓撲宣稱審查。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。並排比較論文摘要與商業宣稱所需新增證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List observations compatible with both topological and trivial models. Identify capacitance and parity interference in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Majorana 1 research and parity-measurement evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of parity-measurement architecture, focusing on proximity materials, parity readout and review of topological claims. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw device, signal and inference as separate evidence layers. Identify assignment distributions in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Majorana 1 research and parity-measurement evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recompute SNR and error for assumed distributions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify trivial-state competing hypotheses in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Majorana 1 research and parity-measurement evidence. Alternative mechanisms can produce low-energy signals; discrimination needs independent observables and models. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of competing trivial-state hypotheses, focusing on proximity materials, parity readout and review of topological claims. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Choose measurements with different predictions for two hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify protected-operation evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Majorana 1 research and parity-measurement evidence. A protected-qubit claim needs encoding, operations and noise response; a device measurement differs from full logical computation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of protection and operation evidence, focusing on proximity materials, parity readout and review of topological claims. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate public demonstrations, inferred claims and unverified capabilities. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify paper/roadmap boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Majorana 1 research and parity-measurement evidence. A paper may support narrower claims than a roadmap; retain versions, data and inference limitations. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of research reproducibility and revisions, focusing on proximity materials, parity readout and review of topological claims. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare paper-supported claims with evidence still required for commercial claims. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.concept: 以殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵解析ResNet 殘差視覺網路：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore ResNet residual vision network through residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識卷積stem與shape。殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。 建立殘差映射與恆等路徑的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識F(x)+x殘差連接。堆疊卷積擴大理論感受野；stride改變解析度及對齊，不能只看kernel尺寸。 建立卷積感受野與解析度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。逐層追蹤stride、padding、特徵尺寸及感受野。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跨層梯度路徑。等形區塊雅可比含 I+JF，恆等項提供梯度路徑但不保證所有方向穩定。 建立殘差雅可比與梯度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以小矩陣比較JF、I+JF的特徵方向和有限差分。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識feature map記憶。參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 建立運算量與記憶體的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識羣組分割與資料洩漏。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識類別與移轉失效。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify convolutional stem and shapes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual maps and identity paths, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify f(x)+x residual connection in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Stacked convolutions expand theoretical receptive fields; stride changes resolution/alignment beyond kernel size alone. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of convolutional receptive field and resolution, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify cross-layer gradient paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. A same-shape block has Jacobian I+JF; the identity supplies a path without guaranteeing stability in every direction. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual jacobians and gradients, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare JF/I+JF directions and finite differences on small matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify feature-map memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify grouped splits and leakage in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify class and transfer failures in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

procedure: 在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識token與位置張量。QKᵀ/√d 經softmax形成逐query權重，再乘V；Q、K與V不是三個可任意互換的輸入。 建立縮放點積注意力的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用兩個token手算權重，核對每列和為1及輸出維度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識softmax(QKᵀ/√d)V。因果遮罩排除未來位置；padding遮罩處理無效token，兩者服務不同條件。 建立遮罩與資訊流的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在小型score矩陣分別畫兩種遮罩並檢查可見位置。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識殘差與層歸一化。無位置資訊的自注意力對置換具有對應性；位置表徵將順序條件加入token。 建立位置表徵與順序的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。交換token後比較有無位置表徵的輸出對應。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識L平方attention記憶。參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 建立運算量與記憶體的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識時間與來源切分。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

procedureEn: Identify token and position tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Softmax of QKᵀ/sqrt(d) forms per-query weights applied to V; Q, K and V are not arbitrary interchangeable inputs. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scaled dot-product attention, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Hand-calculate two-token weights, row sums and output dimensions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify softmax(qkᵀ/sqrt(d))v in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Causal masks exclude future positions; padding masks exclude invalid tokens and serve different conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of masks and information flow, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw both masks on a small score matrix and inspect visible positions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify residuals and layer normalization in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Self-attention without positions is permutation-equivariant; positional representations add order conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of position representations and order, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare permuted outputs with/without position representations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify quadratic attention memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify temporal/source splits in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify long-sequence distribution shift in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

procedureEn: Identify images and pixel labels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. The encoder gathers multiscale context and the decoder restores spatial outputs; upsampling creates no new original-image information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of contracting and expanding paths, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace scale shapes/output alignment and mark cropping/padding. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify multiscale encoding/decoding in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. U-Net skips often concatenate encoder/decoder features; spatial shapes/coordinates must align, unlike residual addition. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cross-scale skips and alignment, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare channels/alignment for concatenation versus addition. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify skips and boundary gradients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. Class imbalance can hide small objects; boundary reconstruction differs from mean pixel accuracy. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of pixel loss and object scale, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute confusion, overlap and regional errors for one small mask. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify skip-feature buffers in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify dice and small-object errors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

procedure: 在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識v5p TensorCore。資料與乘積沿矩陣陣列傳播；填充不足與不匹配shape可降低有效利用。 建立脈動矩陣與張量核的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較完整與不足批次的有效算術佔比。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識SparseCore embedding。矩陣算子外的向量、標量與稀疏存取可能成爲瓶頸。 建立向量純量與嵌入的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。拆分矩陣與embedding／逐元素的時間預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識張量佈局與分片。圖編譯與張量分片決定數據佈局；相同數學表達可形成不同通訊量。 建立編譯與分割的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較複製、資料分片及模型分片的bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識3D torus與ICI。mesh與torus具有不同的邊界連接與路徑；每chip頻寬不等於割頻寬。 建立3D 互連與拓撲的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對小型3D圖計算最大跳數及割邊。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跨slice集體傳輸。all-reduce同步更新或統計；通信可部分重疊但仍有尾端依賴。 建立集體通訊與計算重疊的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較全串行與可重疊時間線。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Pod與單作業上限。Pod總規模、單工作上限與可預約slice不同；配置能力不等於所有作業均可取全Pod。 建立Pod 與工作切片的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。將公開設備規模與支持的作業slice分開記錄。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify v5p tensorcore in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. Operands/products traverse matrix arrays; underfilling and mismatched shapes reduce effective use. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of systolic matrices and tensorcores, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare useful arithmetic fractions for full/underfilled batches. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify sparsecore embeddings in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. Vector, scalar and sparse work outside matrix operations can dominate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of vectors, scalars and embeddings, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate matrix and embedding/elementwise time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify tensor layout and sharding in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. Graph compilation/sharding set layouts; equivalent mathematics can yield different traffic. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compilation and partitioning, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare replicated, data-sharded and model-sharded bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify 3d torus and ici in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. Meshes/toruses differ in wraparound/routes; per-chip bandwidth differs from bisection bandwidth. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of 3d interconnects and topology, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute diameter and cut edges for small 3D graphs. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify cross-slice collectives in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. All-reduce synchronizes updates/statistics; communication may overlap while retaining tail dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of collectives and overlap, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare serial and overlapping timelines. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify pod and per-job limits in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. Pod size, job limits and reservable slices differ; configurations do not give every job the whole Pod. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of pods and job slices, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record device scale separately from supported job slices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交跨slice集體傳輸的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交Pod與單作業上限的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

pitfalls: 常見誤判：Pod總芯片數就是每個作業可直接預約的數量。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Every job can directly reserve the full Pod chip count.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: AWS Trainium and Neuron system
guides.concept: 以專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計解析AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore AWS Trainium and Neuron system through specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識NeuronCore算術路徑。專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。 建立矩陣核心與精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識vector與稀疏算子。矩陣算子外的向量、標量與稀疏存取可能成爲瓶頸。 建立向量純量與嵌入的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。拆分矩陣與embedding／逐元素的時間預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Neuron圖編譯。圖編譯與張量分片決定數據佈局；相同數學表達可形成不同通訊量。 建立編譯與分割的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較複製、資料分片及模型分片的bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識NeuronLink與EFA。高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。 建立節點內與節點間網路的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識集體傳輸與並行。all-reduce同步更新或統計；通信可部分重疊但仍有尾端依賴。 建立集體通訊與計算重疊的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較全串行與可重疊時間線。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識EC2資源與device分配。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify neuroncore arithmetic paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of matrix cores and precision, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify vector/sparse operators in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Vector, scalar and sparse work outside matrix operations can dominate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of vectors, scalars and embeddings, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate matrix and embedding/elementwise time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify neuron graph compilation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Graph compilation/sharding set layouts; equivalent mathematics can yield different traffic. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compilation and partitioning, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare replicated, data-sharded and model-sharded bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify neuronlink and efa in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of intranode and internode networks, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify collectives and parallelism in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. All-reduce synchronizes updates/statistics; communication may overlap while retaining tail dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of collectives and overlap, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare serial and overlapping timelines. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify ec2 resources and allocation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.concept: 以本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信解析Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster through local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識WSE本地core與SRAM。晶圓尺度將多核心與本地SRAM相連；避開部分離片搬運但仍有通信和容量限制。 建立晶圓網格與局部記憶的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較鄰近交換與跨片搬運的假想bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識MemoryX參數流。參數可存於獨立記憶系統並串流到計算；通信帶寬與更新一致性是關鍵邊界。 建立權重串流與分離的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫前傳、反傳及參數更新的方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識稀疏計算mapping。稀疏數據可減少算術，但不均勻分配可能形成局部瓶頸。 建立稀疏映射與負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較均勻與聚集稀疏分佈的最慢核心負載。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

guides.concept: 以異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連解析Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer through heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識GH200相干記憶。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識node內與Slingshot。高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。 建立節點內與節點間網路的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識異質partition選擇。串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。 建立工作分割與平行效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識scratch與archive。暫存、容量與歸檔層服務不同I/O；檢查點需考慮寫入和恢復成本。 建立儲存階層與檢查點的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較順序、隨機及metadata的假想時間預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識機櫃冷卻預算。設施功率包含IT與輔助；PUE不能單獨判定計算結果每單位能耗。 建立供電冷卻與設施的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對IT、總設施及作業時間的能量邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識分區作業復原。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify gh200 coherent memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify intranode and slingshot in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of intranode and internode networks, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify heterogeneous partition choice in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of work partition and parallel efficiency, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify scratch and archive in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Scratch, capacity and archive serve different I/O; checkpoints need write/recovery costs. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of storage tiers and checkpoints, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sequential, random and metadata time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify cabinet cooling budget in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Facility power includes IT/auxiliary loads; PUE alone does not specify energy per result. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of power, cooling and facilities, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check IT, facility and job-time energy boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify partition job recovery in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交機櫃冷卻預算的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cabinet cooling budget.

procedure: 在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識汽輪島淨電。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識餘熱與熱容。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識公開設計與建造驗證。設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。 建立建造證據與生命週期的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture
guides.concept: 以直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界解析ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture through direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識沸水與直接蒸汽路。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識汽輪轉換與輔機。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識餘熱概念預算。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識自然循環與重力路徑。重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 建立被動與主動支援的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識系統共因依賴。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識設計認證與廠址區別。設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。 建立建造證據與生命週期的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify bwr/direct steam paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify turbine conversion/auxiliaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify residual-heat concept budget in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture. Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify natural circulation/gravity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture. Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of passive and active support, focusing on direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify shared-system dependencies in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify design certification versus sites in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture. Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交系統共因依賴的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交設計認證與廠址區別的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交設計認證與廠址區別的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for shared-system dependencies.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for design certification versus sites.

pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Design approval means every plant is operating commercially.

guides.concept: 以複製設計、分離安全支援與工程驗證解析Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering through design replication, separated safety support and validation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識EPR核島與蒸汽迴路。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是複製設計、分離安全支援與工程驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識常規島熱電效率。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是複製設計、分離安全支援與工程驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識餘熱移除功能。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是複製設計、分離安全支援與工程驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識分離支援架構。重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 建立被動與主動支援的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是複製設計、分離安全支援與工程驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識複製與廠址界面。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是複製設計、分離安全支援與工程驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識設計施工階段追溯。設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。 建立建造證據與生命週期的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是複製設計、分離安全支援與工程驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify epr nuclear/steam loops in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on design replication, separated safety support and validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify conventional-island conversion in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on design replication, separated safety support and validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify residual-heat removal function in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering. Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on design replication, separated safety support and validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify separated support architecture in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering. Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of passive and active support, focusing on design replication, separated safety support and validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify replication/site interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on design replication, separated safety support and validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify design/construction traceability in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering. Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on design replication, separated safety support and validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交複製與廠址界面的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交設計施工階段追溯的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交設計施工階段追溯的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for replication/site interfaces.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for design/construction traceability.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for design/construction traceability.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：取得設計批准等同每個電廠已商轉。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Design approval means every plant is operating commercially.

在「NuScale US600 模組設計研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識池內餘熱路徑。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是整合式壓水模組與共用水池。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「NuScale US600 模組設計研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識自然循環概念。重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 建立被動與主動支援的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是整合式壓水模組與共用水池。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「NuScale US600 模組設計研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多個模塊共用池。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是整合式壓水模組與共用水池。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「NuScale US600 模組設計研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識US600文檔審查界面。設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。 建立建造證據與生命週期的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是整合式壓水模組與共用水池。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify integral-module fluid boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NuScale US600 modular design study. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify modules/net generation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NuScale US600 modular design study. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify pool residual-heat paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NuScale US600 modular design study. Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify natural-circulation concepts in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NuScale US600 modular design study. Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of passive and active support, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify shared multimodule pool in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NuScale US600 modular design study. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify us600 document-review boundary in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NuScale US600 modular design study. Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：ITER 國際磁約束研究工程

guides.concept: 以大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出解析ITER 國際磁約束研究工程：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering through large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「ITER 國際磁約束研究工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識tokamak真空與磁場。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「ITER 國際磁約束研究工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識超導coil公差。磁場幾何或光路誤差影響約束及能量耦合；平均指標不能代表所有區域。 建立磁體或光學精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較誤差地圖與受影響的物理邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ITER 國際磁約束研究工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識divertor熱負載。熱負載受面積、時間分佈及路徑控制；延長脈衝會增加系統熱量管理需求。 建立熱排出與表面負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

procedureEn: Identify tokamak vacuum/magnetic fields in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify plasma/facility q boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heating and gain, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify superconducting-coil tolerances in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Magnetic geometry/optical errors affect confinement/coupling; averages do not describe every region. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of magnet or optical precision, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error maps with affected physical boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify divertor heat loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat exhaust and surface loads, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify diagnostics/reconstruction in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Observations differ from inverse-model estimates; latency/occlusion changes control information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of diagnostics and control evidence, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify research/plant gaps in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of research-to-power-plant gaps, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

提交研究裝置與電廠差距的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：IEA 15 MW 參考風機
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine
guides.concept: 以開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計解析IEA 15 MW 參考風機：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine through open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識15MW風速功率包絡。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識參考blade氣動。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識參考傳動與generator。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識固定浮式support模型。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識陣列與export cable概念。上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。 建立陣列尾流與海纜的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識OpenFAST負載驗證。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify 15-mw wind/power envelope in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reference-blade aerodynamics in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reference drivetrain/generator in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify fixed/floating support models in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify array/export cable concepts in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify openfast load validation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交陣列與export cable概念的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交OpenFAST負載驗證的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交OpenFAST負載驗證的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for array/export cable concepts.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for openfast load validation.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for openfast load validation.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：容量因數與可用率是同一比例。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.

在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識陣列blade載荷。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識風機與海上集電。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識基礎與海況模態。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識尾流與出口海纜。上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。 建立陣列尾流與海纜的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海上可達窗口。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify hornsea-2 wind resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify array blade loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify turbines/offshore collection in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify foundations/sea-state modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify wakes/export cables in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify offshore access windows in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交尾流與出口海纜的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交海上可達窗口的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for wakes/export cables.

pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.

procedureEn: Identify scotland wind distribution in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify offshore rotor loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify turbine electrical conversion in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify spar/mooring in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify dynamic cable/array in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify long-term capacity/availability in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
