在「海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識示範至商業證據。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分期示範、近岸基礎與集電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify miaoli nearshore resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify different turbine blades in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify phased power conversion in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify nearshore foundations/sea states in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify collection/export routing in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify demonstration/commercial evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：胡佛水壩水力發電系統
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System
guides.concept: 以厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫解析胡佛水壩水力發電系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System through thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Hoover有效水頭。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水輪工況map。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓力水路暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識厚拱壩載荷路徑。壩體、基礎與水路承擔不同載荷；滲流與位移需聯合解釋。 建立土建機械與滲流的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識供水與發電調度。抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。 建立發電儲能與調度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水庫與泥砂邊界。泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。 建立泥砂環境與壽命的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify hoover effective head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify turbine operating maps in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify penstock transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify thick-arch load paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Dam, foundation and waterways carry different loads; seepage/displacement need joint interpretation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of civil works, mechanics and seepage, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify water/power scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of generation, storage and scheduling, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reservoir/sediment boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of sediment, environment and life, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant
guides.concept: 以地下洞室、可逆機組及電網彈性解析南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant through underground caverns, reversible units and grid flexibility: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識上下庫能量。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是地下洞室、可逆機組及電網彈性。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識pump turbine工況。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是地下洞室、可逆機組及電網彈性。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水路壓力暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是地下洞室、可逆機組及電網彈性。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識深埋洞室支撐。壩體、基礎與水路承擔不同載荷；滲流與位移需聯合解釋。 建立土建機械與滲流的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是地下洞室、可逆機組及電網彈性。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識往返效率與電網。抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。 建立發電儲能與調度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是地下洞室、可逆機組及電網彈性。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水位與長期性能。泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。 建立泥砂環境與壽命的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是地下洞室、可逆機組及電網彈性。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify reservoir energy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on underground caverns, reversible units and grid flexibility. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify pump-turbine envelopes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on underground caverns, reversible units and grid flexibility. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify waterway pressure transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on underground caverns, reversible units and grid flexibility. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify deep-cavern supports in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant. Dam, foundation and waterways carry different loads; seepage/displacement need joint interpretation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of civil works, mechanics and seepage, focusing on underground caverns, reversible units and grid flexibility. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify round-trip efficiency/grid in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant. Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of generation, storage and scheduling, focusing on underground caverns, reversible units and grid flexibility. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify levels/long-term performance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant. Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of sediment, environment and life, focusing on underground caverns, reversible units and grid flexibility. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交往返效率與電網的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for round-trip efficiency/grid.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for levels/long-term performance.

pitfallsEn: Common misconception: High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.

procedureEn: Identify egs heat/connectivity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify research-well integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify assumed-cycle choice in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of flash, dry-steam and binary cycles, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify transfer/mineral evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Scale reduces transfer/changes resistance; corrosion differs from mechanical wear. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat transfer, scaling and corrosion, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify tracer/thermal return in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Reinjection supports mass balance, while short paths can accelerate cold breakthrough. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify public microseismic catalogs in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Subsurface changes need site rules/monitoring; seismic, fluid and ecological data have distinct metrics. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microseismic monitoring and environment, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Analyze supplied public/assumed catalogs for spatiotemporal changes and uncertainty only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on volcanic heat, phased units and environmental integration. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Identify piping heat/corrosion in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Theistareykir geothermal engineering. Scale reduces transfer/changes resistance; corrosion differs from mechanical wear. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Identify condensation/heat transfer in the mentor diagram and primary sources for The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex. Scale reduces transfer/changes resistance; corrosion differs from mechanical wear. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. guides.conceptEn: Explore Boddington automated gold/copper mine through surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識金銅grade分佈。品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 建立資源品位與代表採樣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識露天autonomous haulage。露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。 建立開坑地下與搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識粒度與解離。粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。 建立粒徑解離與破碎的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識給料與精礦balance。密度、粒徑及形狀共同影響重力分離；精礦品位、產率與回收率不同。 建立重力選別與質量收支的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用給定假想給料與精礦計算金屬守恆。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識通信與人員隔離。地下通風與電力是支援系統；自動搬運需感測、通信與人員隔離。 建立通風電力與自動化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識礦水尾礦與覆育。尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。 建立尾礦水與復育的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify gold/copper grades in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify surface autonomous haulage in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of open-pit, underground and haulage, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify size/liberation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of particle size, liberation and comminution, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify feed/concentrate balance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Density, size and shape affect gravity separation; concentrate grade, yield and recovery differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of gravity separation and mass balance, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check metal balance from assumed feed/concentrate data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify communications/people separation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Ventilation/power support underground work; automated haulage needs sensing, communications and separation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ventilation, power and automation, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify mine water/tailings/rehabilitation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of tailings, water and rehabilitation, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交通信與人員隔離的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交礦水尾礦與覆育的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交礦水尾礦與覆育的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for communications/people separation.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mine water/tailings/rehabilitation.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mine water/tailings/rehabilitation.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：回收率高表示尾礦與礦水沒有影響。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.

Identify surface/underground paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Kibali large gold-mining engineering. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. Identify comminution/energy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Kibali large gold-mining engineering. Identify mine support/electricity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Kibali large gold-mining engineering. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify tailings/water/lifecycle in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Kibali large gold-mining engineering. Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints. guides.conceptEn: Explore Deep MLP and autoencoder through dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識MLP weight與bias。單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。 建立全連接層與參數的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識非線性與latent瓶頸。線性encoder-decoder組合的秩受瓶頸限制；非線性改變表達但不保證保留任務資訊。 建立線性瓶頸與非線性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用低秩矩陣與非線性小例比較可重建資訊。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識encoder-decoder梯度。低重建誤差可能保留背景而忽略小但關鍵訊號；latent表徵需用獨立任務驗證。 建立重建與任務效用的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。構造相同平均重建誤差但不同關鍵訊號保留的兩案例。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

procedureEn: Identify mlp weights/biases in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification. guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：ASML 微影投影光學工程
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: ASML lithography projection-optics engineering
guides.concept: 以 ASML TWINSCAN 的 4 倍縮小投影鏡頭為對象，從 CD = k₁·λ/NA 與景深出發，拆解熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片的面形預算、NA 1.35 折反射浸潤架構與偏振、原位波前量測與 Zernike 分解、鏡片熱漂移與操縱器校正，最後整合成套刻預算與成像驗收記錄。
guides.conceptEn: Taking the 4× reduction projection lens of an ASML TWINSCAN as the object, this course starts from CD = k₁·λ/NA and depth of focus, then works through figure budgets for fused-silica and CaF₂ elements, the NA 1.35 catadioptric immersion layout and polarization, in-situ wavefront metrology with Zernike decomposition, lens-heating drift and manipulator correction, and ends with the overlay budget and imaging acceptance record.
procedure: 投影光學把光罩圖形縮小 4 倍成像到晶圓，能印出的最小特徵由 Rayleigh 關係 CD = k₁·λ/NA 決定：λ 是曝光波長，NA 是像方數值孔徑，k₁ 是由照明、光罩與光阻製程共同決定的製程因子，物理下限為 0.25。景深則隨 NA 平方縮小，DOF ≈ k₂·λ/NA²，所以提高 NA 換來解析度的同時，晶圓平坦度、對焦控制與鏡頭場曲的預算都被壓縮。ArF 浸潤式以水的折射率 1.437 把 NA 推到 1.35，EUV 則以 13.5 nm 波長在 NA 0.33 與 0.55 上取得更小的 CD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

照明系統把雷射光整形成光瞳上的特定分佈，用 σ 表示照明 NA 與投影 NA 的比值；離軸照明（環形、雙極）讓零階與一階繞射光對稱落入光瞳，能把可解析間距推到 λ/(2NA)。投影鏡頭在像方必須遠心：主光線垂直於晶圓，否則離焦會轉成放大率變化與套刻位移。光罩側也接近遠心，以降低光罩高度變化造成的位移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「照明光瞳與部分同調」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

193 nm 可用的透鏡材料只有高純度熔融石英（n ≈ 1.560）與氟化鈣（n ≈ 1.501），兩者在深紫外的色散都很大，所以鏡頭幾乎無法消色差，必須靠雷射線寬窄化到 0.3 pm 等級來避免色像差。折射面的面形誤差 h 轉成波前誤差時乘上 (n − 1)，約為 0.56h，比反射鏡的 2h 寬鬆近四倍，但鏡頭有數十片元件，總波前預算仍須分配到次奈米。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NA 超過 1 時，光在像方介質中的角度極大，純折射設計需要巨大的鏡片直徑與難以修正的場曲，因此高 NA 鏡頭採用折反射架構：以凹面鏡提供負 Petzval 貢獻並壓縮鏡片尺寸。末端鏡片以平面接觸水膜，水的折射率 1.437 把像方 NA 提高。在這麼大的角度下，TM 偏振的兩束干涉對比隨 cos(2θ) 下降甚至反相，因此照明必須以 TE 偏振為主並由鏡頭保持偏振純度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「折反射浸潤式末端鏡組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

微影機在晶圓台上裝有干涉式波前感測器，以鏡頭本身的曝光光經過光罩側的針孔或光柵，在像方量測整個出瞳的波前，並分解成 Zernike 多項式係數 Z₂ 到 Z₃₇ 以上。低階的傾斜與離焦對應套刻位移與最佳焦面，彗差與球差造成圖形位移隨間距改變與 CD 隨焦距不對稱，像散造成水平與垂直線最佳焦面分離。每個場點都要量，因為像差隨場變化。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波前感測器與 Zernike 係數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

曝光光在鏡片材料與鍍膜中的微量吸收會讓鏡片升溫，熔融石英在 193 nm 的 dn/dT 約 2×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹，溫度分佈又跟照明光瞳形狀相關：雙極照明只加熱光瞳上的兩個區域，於是產生與時間相關的像散與高階像差。這種漂移在每批晶圓曝光期間以分鐘尺度變化，必須以熱模型預測並由鏡頭操縱器即時補償，誤差預算要同時包含量測不確定度與模型殘差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡片熱負載與熱透鏡效應」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鏡頭內有若干片可由致動器沿軸向移動、傾斜或橫向平移的元件，另有可變形或可加熱的波前操縱元件；每個自由度對各 Zernike 項的靈敏度在出廠時以干涉量測建立成矩陣。校正時把量測到的像差向量以最小平方法反解成操縱器動作，同時要控制交叉耦合：修正球差的軸向移動也會改變離焦與放大率，必須由其他自由度同時抵消。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

投影光學的最終驗收不是看鏡頭報告，而是看印出的結果：以測試光罩在整個場內量 CD 均勻性、H-V bias、通焦 CD 曲線與套刻畸變，並把鏡頭畸變、晶圓台、對準與光罩的貢獻合成一張套刻預算表。交接文件必須包含各場點的 Zernike 基準值、操縱器狀態、熱模型參數與允許的漂移範圍，讓後續維護能判斷鏡頭是否仍在預算內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「成像驗收與製程窗口報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The projection optics image the reticle pattern onto the wafer at 4× reduction, and the smallest printable feature follows the Rayleigh relation CD = k₁·λ/NA, where λ is the exposure wavelength, NA the image-side numerical aperture and k₁ a process factor set jointly by illumination, mask and resist with a physical floor of 0.25. Depth of focus shrinks with the square of NA, DOF ≈ k₂·λ/NA², so every gain in resolution from NA compresses the budget left for wafer flatness, focus control and lens field curvature. ArF immersion uses water with index 1.437 to reach NA 1.35, while EUV reaches smaller CD at 13.5 nm with NA 0.33 and 0.55. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Projection-lens NA and image space”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The illuminator shapes the laser beam into a chosen pupil distribution, with σ denoting the ratio of illumination NA to projection NA; off-axis schemes such as annular or dipole illumination place the zeroth and first diffraction orders symmetrically in the pupil, pushing the resolvable pitch toward λ/(2NA). The projection lens must be telecentric on the image side, with chief rays normal to the wafer, otherwise defocus turns into magnification change and overlay shift. The reticle side is also nearly telecentric to suppress placement errors from reticle height variation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Illumination pupil and partial coherence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Only high-purity fused silica (n ≈ 1.560) and calcium fluoride (n ≈ 1.501) transmit well enough at 193 nm, and both disperse strongly in the deep UV, so the lens can barely be achromatised and instead relies on a laser linewidth narrowed to the 0.3 pm level to avoid chromatic aberration. A refracting surface converts a figure error h into wavefront error (n − 1)h, about 0.56h, nearly four times more forgiving than the 2h of a mirror, but with tens of elements the total wavefront budget still has to be split into sub-nanometre shares. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fused-silica and CaF₂ lens elements”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Above NA 1 the ray angles in the image medium become extreme, and an all-refractive design would need huge element diameters and uncorrectable field curvature, so high-NA lenses use a catadioptric layout in which a concave mirror supplies negative Petzval contribution and shrinks the elements. The final element touches the water film with a flat face, and the water index of 1.437 raises the image-side NA. At such angles the two-beam interference contrast for TM polarization falls as cos(2θ) and can even invert, so illumination must be predominantly TE polarized and the lens must preserve that polarization purity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Catadioptric immersion final group”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The scanner carries an interferometric wavefront sensor on the wafer stage that uses the exposure light itself, passing through a pinhole or grating on the reticle side, to measure the full exit-pupil wavefront at the image and decompose it into Zernike coefficients from Z₂ up to Z₃₇ and beyond. Low-order tilt and defocus map to overlay shift and best-focus position, coma and spherical aberration produce pitch-dependent pattern shift and asymmetric CD through focus, and astigmatism separates the best focus of horizontal and vertical lines. Every field point must be measured because aberrations vary across the field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wavefront sensor and Zernike coefficients”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Weak absorption of the exposure light in element materials and coatings heats the elements, and fused silica has dn/dT of about 2×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ at 193 nm; because the heating pattern follows the illumination pupil, a dipole heats only two zones of a pupil-plane element and generates time-dependent astigmatism and higher-order aberrations. The drift evolves on a minute scale during each lot, so it must be predicted by a thermal model and compensated in real time by lens manipulators, with the error budget covering both measurement uncertainty and model residuals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lens thermal load and thermal lensing”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Several elements inside the lens can be moved axially, tilted or translated by actuators, and deformable or heated wavefront manipulators add further degrees of freedom; the sensitivity of each degree of freedom to every Zernike term is established interferometrically at the factory as a matrix. During correction the measured aberration vector is inverted by least squares into manipulator moves while cross-coupling is managed, because an axial move that corrects spherical aberration also changes focus and magnification and must be cancelled simultaneously by other degrees of freedom. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Final acceptance of projection optics is judged on printed results rather than the lens report: a test reticle is used to measure CD uniformity across the field, H-V bias, CD through focus and overlay distortion, and the contributions of lens distortion, wafer stage, alignment and reticle are combined into a single overlay budget table. The handoff record must contain the baseline Zernike values at every field point, manipulator states, thermal-model parameters and permitted drift ranges, so that later maintenance can judge whether the lens is still within budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Imaging acceptance and process-window record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若只按 CD 公式選 NA 而忽略景深縮小，晶圓高低差與對焦雜訊會吃掉整個製程窗口，結果是場邊緣線條隨機斷線或橋接，而鏡頭本身的像差數據卻完全合格。
若感測器與曝光座標的符號約定不一致，校正動作會把像差加倍而不是消除；若只在場中心量測，場邊緣的像散與彗差未被看到，CD 場內均勻性就會超差。
pitfallsEn: Choosing NA from the CD formula alone while ignoring the shrinking depth of focus lets wafer topography and focus noise consume the whole process window, so lines at the field edge randomly break or bridge even though the lens aberration data pass every specification.

If the sensor and exposure coordinate sign conventions disagree, the correction doubles the aberration instead of cancelling it; measuring only at field centre leaves edge astigmatism and coma unseen, so CD uniformity across the field fails.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：EUV 多層膜反射鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: EUV multilayer mirrors
guides.concept: 從 EUV 強吸收出發，理解 Mo/Si 多層膜為何能反射、週期與粗糙度如何決定反射率，再把面形、鍍膜應力、污染、熱負載與波前誤差預算整合成可驗收的反射鏡工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from strong EUV absorption to see why Mo/Si multilayers reflect, how period and roughness set reflectance, then integrate figure, coating stress, contamination, thermal load and wavefront budgets into an acceptable mirror engineering record.
procedure: 在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小；光在數十奈米內就被吸收，所以不能用透鏡折射成像，整個光路必須放在真空中並以多層膜反射鏡轉折與聚焦。空氣本身也會吸收 EUV，因此照明、光罩與投影光學都在真空腔內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反射式光路與真空腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Mo/Si 多層膜由約 40 到 50 組雙層構成，每組週期 d 約 6.9 nm，Mo 約佔週期的 0.4。各界面的微弱反射在正向入射時因為光程差等於一個波長而同相疊加，形成類似布拉格繞射的反射峰；由於材料吸收，週期數超過約 50 組後反射率不再提升。理論峰值約 74%，實際鍍膜約 70%。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鏡面誤差依空間頻率分成三段：低頻的面形誤差直接變成波前像差；中頻粗糙度（MSFR）把光散射到像點附近形成眩光（flare），降低影像對比；高頻粗糙度（HSFR）把光散射到視場之外，等效降低反射率。因為波長只有 13.5 nm，可接受的粗糙度是 0.1 nm 等級，比可見光光學嚴格兩個數量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基板面形與粗糙度頻譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
多層膜通常以磁控濺鍍或離子束濺鍍逐層沉積，並以石英晶體或原位反射率監控厚度；每層厚度誤差必須控制在 0.01 nm 等級。Mo/Si 多層膜通常帶有數百 MPa 的壓應力，會把基板彎曲並改變已拋光好的面形，因此需要應力補償層、退火或在設計階段預留變形量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「濺鍍腔與膜應力」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
EUV 光子與殘留碳氫化合物作用會在鏡面沉積碳；殘留水氣則使最上層 Si 氧化，氧化通常不可逆。因此多層膜頂部加上數奈米的 Ru 覆蓋層抗氧化，並以氫自由基清潔週期性移除碳膜。真空腔的殘氣分壓、材料除氣與光罩附近的清潔策略都屬於鏡面壽命工程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ru 覆蓋層與氫清潔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

投影光學由多片反射鏡組成，每片面形誤差在反射時加倍計入波前。影像品質以 RMS 波前誤差衡量，Maréchal 判準要求總 RMS 約小於 λ/14 才能維持 Strehl 比 0.8；在 13.5 nm 這相當於約 1 nm。各鏡的面形、鍍膜、對準與熱變形必須以均方根相加分配到次奈米等級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波前誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
每片鏡子吸收約 30% 的 EUV 以及光源帶來的紅外與帶外輻射，鏡面溫度會上升並隨曝光負載變化。基板採用 ULE 或 Zerodur 等超低膨脹玻璃陶瓷，熱膨脹係數在 ±20 ppb/K 以內，再配合主動溫控、熱感測與模型補償，才能把熱致面形漂移壓在次奈米。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱控與低膨脹基板」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
反射鏡以撓性或運動學支撐安裝，避免夾持應力並允許微米到奈米級的位置調整；每片鏡子的位移與傾斜對波前的靈敏度由光學設計的靈敏度矩陣給出。最後以成像或波前系統量測、眩光量測與壽命外推共同構成驗收，而不是只看元件各自合格。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「系統對準與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption; writing n = 1 − δ + iβ, both δ and β are a few percent or less, and the light is absorbed within tens of nanometers. Refractive lenses therefore cannot image EUV, so the whole optical train is folded and focused by multilayer mirrors inside a vacuum chamber, because air itself absorbs EUV as well. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4. The weak reflections from each interface add in phase at normal incidence because the round-trip path equals one wavelength, giving a Bragg-like reflectance peak; absorption makes additional bilayers beyond about 50 useless. The theoretical peak is about 74% and production coatings reach about 70%. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mo/Si multilayer stack”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Mirror errors are split by spatial frequency: low-frequency figure error becomes wavefront aberration; mid-spatial-frequency roughness (MSFR) scatters light near the image point as flare that reduces contrast; high-spatial-frequency roughness (HSFR) scatters light out of the field and acts like a reflectance loss. Because the wavelength is only 13.5 nm, acceptable roughness is of order 0.1 nm, two orders of magnitude tighter than visible optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Substrate figure and roughness spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Multilayers are deposited layer by layer by magnetron or ion-beam sputtering with quartz-crystal or in-situ reflectance thickness control; per-layer errors must stay near 0.01 nm. Mo/Si stacks typically carry several hundred MPa of compressive stress that bends the substrate and alters the polished figure, so compensation layers, annealing or pre-compensated figure are required. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sputter chamber and coating stress”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

EUV photons react with residual hydrocarbons to deposit carbon on the mirror, while residual water oxidises the top silicon layer, usually irreversibly. A few nanometres of ruthenium capping resists oxidation, and hydrogen-radical cleaning periodically removes carbon films. Residual-gas partial pressures, material outgassing and cleaning strategy near the reticle are all part of mirror-lifetime engineering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ruthenium capping layer and hydrogen cleaning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Projection optics use several mirrors, and each mirror's figure error enters the wavefront twice on reflection. Image quality is judged by RMS wavefront error; the Maréchal criterion asks for a total RMS below about λ/14 to keep a Strehl ratio of 0.8, which at 13.5 nm is about 1 nm. Figure, coating, alignment and thermal terms of every mirror must be allocated root-sum-square to sub-nanometre values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wavefront-error budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each mirror absorbs about 30% of the EUV plus infrared and out-of-band radiation from the source, so its temperature rises and varies with exposure load. Substrates use ultralow-expansion glass ceramics such as ULE or Zerodur with thermal expansion within ±20 ppb/K, combined with active temperature control, thermal sensing and model-based compensation, to keep thermal figure drift sub-nanometre. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thermal control and ultralow-expansion substrate”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Mirrors are held on flexure or kinematic mounts that avoid clamping stress and allow micrometre-to-nanometre adjustment; the wavefront sensitivity to each mirror's displacement and tilt comes from the optical design's sensitivity matrix. Acceptance combines system wavefront or imaging measurement, flare measurement and lifetime extrapolation rather than separate component passes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “System alignment and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。
若把 Si 當最外層，水氣氧化使反射率永久下降；若氫清潔過強，會侵蝕或起泡覆蓋層，同樣造成不可逆損失。
pitfallsEn: Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist; the real failure is light absorbed inside the element so that throughput at the wafer collapses.
Leaving silicon as the outermost layer lets water oxidation permanently lower reflectance; over-aggressive hydrogen cleaning erodes or blisters the cap, also irreversibly.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：EUV 光源錫滴控制概念
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts
guides.concept: 以 13.5 nm 雷射電漿（LPP）錫滴光源為對象，從錫離子的 4d–4f 發射帶與 CO₂ 雷射的臨界密度出發，建立從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈，再拆解錫滴產生器、前脈衝與主脈衝、錫滴偵測與雷射導向、劑量統計、氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔，最後以可用度與反射率衰減記錄完成驗收。本課為教學模型，不含任何操作程序。
guides.conceptEn: Taking the 13.5 nm laser-produced-plasma tin-droplet source as the object, the course starts from the 4d–4f emission band of tin ions and the critical density of CO₂ laser light, builds the power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus, then works through the droplet generator, pre-pulse and main pulse, droplet detection and laser steering, dose statistics, hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning, and closes with an availability and reflectance-decay acceptance record. It is a teaching model and contains no operating procedure.
procedure: 錫被加熱到約 30 到 40 eV 的電漿溫度時，Sn⁸⁺ 到 Sn¹³⁺ 離子的 4d–4f 躍遷形成密集的未解析躍遷陣列，發射峰正好落在 13.5 nm，而 Mo/Si 多層膜只反射 13.5 nm ± 1% 的 2% 頻寬，所以光源的品質指標是帶內轉換效率 CE：2π 立體角內帶內 EUV 能量除以雷射脈衝能量。雷射在電漿中只能傳到臨界密度面，10.6 µm 的 CO₂ 雷射臨界密度比 1.06 µm 固態雷射低一百倍，電漿較稀薄、自吸收較少，CE 能達到 5% 以上，而固態雷射通常只有 2% 到 3%。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光源輸出以中間焦點（IF）的帶內功率定義，IF 是光源與掃描機照明系統的交接面。功率鏈是乘法：雷射平均功率乘以 CE 得到 2π 立體角內的帶內 EUV，再乘以橢球集光鏡收集的立體角比例、多層膜反射率與氫氣透過率，才得到 IF 功率。每一項都小於 1，所以錫滴尺寸、雷射重複率與集光鏡狀態任何一項退化都會直接反映在晶圓產能上。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「中間焦點與功率鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

錫在 232 °C 熔化，產生器把熔融錫加壓後從微米級噴嘴射出高速液柱，液柱因表面張力的 Rayleigh–Plateau 不穩定而分裂成細小液滴；用壓電元件調制噴嘴可以鎖定分裂頻率與相位，使細滴在飛行中合併成直徑約 25 到 30 µm、頻率等於雷射重複率的目標錫滴。錫滴直徑決定可用的錫質量與電漿尺寸，頻率與速度決定錫滴間距，而噴嘴磨損或阻塞會直接改變這三個量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「錫滴產生器噴嘴」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驅動雷射採主振盪功率放大（MOPA）架構：種子雷射產生低能量脈衝，經多級 CO₂ 放大器放大到每脈衝數百毫焦，再以反射式光學聚焦到錫滴。先打一個能量較低的前脈衝，把球形錫滴推展成直徑數百微米的薄盤或霧團，使主脈衝能被更大的面積吸收且電漿密度接近最佳，CE 由約 2% 提升到 5% 以上。放大器還需要光隔離，因為錫滴像回射鏡會把光送回放大鏈。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CO₂ 驅動雷射與前脈衝」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每一發雷射都必須在正確時刻命中一顆直徑 27 µm、以 80 m/s 飛行的錫滴，所以光源用雷射光簾與高速光偵測器在錫滴抵達主焦點前量測其通過時刻，用相機或位置敏感偵測器量測橫向位置，再由控制器調整雷射觸發時刻與快速導向鏡的角度。回授迴路的頻寬要能跟上錫滴列的慢速漂移與噴嘴振動，同時以統計方式過濾單顆錫滴的隨機抖動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「錫滴位置偵測與雷射導向」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每發 EUV 脈衝能量會因錫滴尺寸、命中偏差與雷射能量而隨機波動，掃描機曝光時晶圓上每一點接收縫隙通過期間的 N 發脈衝，劑量誤差因平均而縮小為單發變異除以 √N。光源以帶內能量監測器逐發量測，並用前饋調整下一發雷射能量，同時掃描機可按即時能量調整掃描速度。劑量誤差直接轉成 CD 誤差，所以光源規格除了功率還包含劑量穩定度與脈衝能量的分佈。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「EUV 能量監測與劑量控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

電漿產生高速錫離子、中性原子與微滴，直接撞擊會濺蝕或覆蓋集光鏡多層膜，所以腔內充入低壓氫氣作為緩衝：氫分子碰撞使錫離子減速，EUV 光解離產生的氫自由基又能與沉積的錫反應生成氣態 SnH₄ 被抽走。氫氣壓力是權衡：壓力高抑制碎屑較好，但 EUV 被氫吸收的損失也增加。集光鏡反射率的衰減速率是光源壽命的核心指標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光源驗收不是一次量到額定功率就結束，而是以長時間運轉記錄證明：IF 帶內功率、劑量穩定度、錫滴產生器連續運轉時數、集光鏡反射率衰減速率與可用度都必須在規格內。可用度由平均故障間隔與平均修復時間決定，錫滴產生器更換與集光鏡更換是主要的計畫性停機。交接文件要包含每個子系統的基準曲線與允許漂移，讓現場工程師能從趨勢判斷何時該維護而非等待故障。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光源驗收與可用度記錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: When tin is heated to a plasma temperature of roughly 30 to 40 eV, the 4d–4f transitions of Sn⁸⁺ to Sn¹³⁺ ions form a dense unresolved transition array whose emission peaks right at 13.5 nm, and because Mo/Si multilayers reflect only the 2% band of 13.5 nm ± 1%, the figure of merit is the in-band conversion efficiency CE: in-band EUV energy into 2π steradians divided by laser pulse energy. Laser light penetrates a plasma only up to the critical-density surface, and the critical density for 10.6 µm CO₂ light is a hundred times lower than for 1.06 µm solid-state light, so the emitting plasma is more dilute with less self-absorption, giving CE above 5% versus typically 2% to 3% with solid-state drivers. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Source output is defined as in-band power at the intermediate focus (IF), the interface between the source and the scanner illuminator. The power chain is multiplicative: laser average power times CE gives in-band EUV into 2π steradians, and that is multiplied by the solid-angle fraction captured by the ellipsoidal collector, the multilayer reflectance and the hydrogen transmission before it becomes IF power. Every factor is below 1, so degradation in droplet size, laser repetition rate or collector condition shows up directly in wafer throughput. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Intermediate focus and power chain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Tin melts at 232 °C, and the generator pressurises molten tin through a micrometre-scale nozzle into a high-speed jet that breaks into fine droplets through the surface-tension-driven Rayleigh–Plateau instability; a piezoelectric modulation of the nozzle locks the breakup frequency and phase so the fine droplets coalesce in flight into target droplets of about 25 to 30 µm diameter at a frequency equal to the laser repetition rate. Droplet diameter sets the available tin mass and plasma size, frequency and velocity set the droplet spacing, and nozzle wear or clogging changes all three at once. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Droplet-generator nozzle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The drive laser is a master-oscillator power-amplifier (MOPA): a seed laser produces low-energy pulses that multi-stage CO₂ amplifiers raise to hundreds of millijoules per pulse, and reflective optics focus them onto the droplet. A weaker pre-pulse first flattens the spherical droplet into a disc or mist several hundred micrometres across, so the main pulse is absorbed over a larger area at a near-optimal plasma density, lifting CE from about 2% to above 5%. The amplifier chain also needs optical isolation because the droplet acts as a retro-reflector that sends light back into the amplifiers. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CO₂ drive laser and pre-pulse”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Every laser shot must hit a 27 µm droplet flying at 80 m/s at the right instant, so the source measures each droplet's passage time with laser curtains and fast photodetectors before it reaches the primary focus, measures lateral position with cameras or position-sensitive detectors, and lets the controller adjust the laser trigger time and the angle of fast steering mirrors. The feedback loop must track slow drift of the droplet train and nozzle vibration while statistically filtering the random jitter of individual droplets. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Droplet detection and laser steering”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each EUV pulse's energy fluctuates randomly with droplet size, hit offset and laser energy, and during a scan every wafer point receives the N pulses delivered while the slit passes, so the dose error averages down to the single-pulse variation divided by √N. The source measures in-band energy shot by shot and feeds forward a correction to the next laser pulse, while the scanner can also adjust scan speed to the real-time energy. Dose error converts directly into CD error, so the source specification includes dose stability and the pulse-energy distribution alongside power. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “EUV energy monitor and dose control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The plasma emits fast tin ions, neutrals and micro-droplets that would sputter or coat the collector multilayer, so the vessel is filled with low-pressure hydrogen as a buffer: collisions with hydrogen molecules slow the tin ions, and hydrogen radicals produced by EUV photolysis react with deposited tin to form gaseous SnH₄ that is pumped away. Hydrogen pressure is a trade-off, since higher pressure suppresses debris better but increases EUV absorption. The decay rate of collector reflectance is the central lifetime metric of the source. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Source acceptance is not a single reading of rated power but a long-run record showing that in-band IF power, dose stability, droplet-generator continuous running hours, collector reflectance decay rate and availability all stay within specification. Availability follows from mean time between failures and mean time to repair, with droplet-generator and collector replacement as the main planned downtimes. The handoff record must carry baseline curves and allowed drift for every subsystem so field engineers can schedule maintenance from trends instead of waiting for failures. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Source acceptance and availability record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfallsEn: If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics.

When tin contaminates the detector windows the signal weakens, timing measurement starts missing or false-triggering, the laser fires into the gap between droplets, and the symptom is intermittent zero in-band energy with dose-error alarms.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：微影晶圓台精密定位
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages
guides.concept: 以步進掃描微影機的雙台晶圓台為對象：先建立光罩台與晶圓台 4:1 同步掃描的 MA/MSD 誤差定義與 Abbe 原理，再拆解長短行程 Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量、雷射干涉儀與二維光柵編碼器的解析度與空氣折射率限制，接著以伺服頻寬、前饋精度、校正圖與隔振傳遞率建立奈米級誤差預算，最後整合成產能與套刻驗收記錄。
guides.conceptEn: Taking the dual wafer stage of a step-and-scan lithography system as the object, the course first defines the MA/MSD errors of 4:1 synchronised reticle and wafer scanning and the Abbe principle, then dissects long- and short-stroke Lorentz actuators with balance masses, the resolution and air-index limits of laser interferometers and two-dimensional grating encoders, builds a nanometre error budget from servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy, calibration maps and isolation transmissibility, and closes with a throughput and overlay acceptance record.
procedure: 步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。晶圓上任一點在縫隙通過期間累積曝光，所以位置誤差的影響分成兩類：這段時間的平均誤差（MA）直接變成套刻誤差，而誤差的移動標準差（MSD）讓影像模糊、降低對比與 CD 均勻性。因此規格不是單一的定位精度，而是對掃描時間窗平均後的 MA 與 MSD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Abbe 原理要求量測軸與被量測點共線，否則載台的微小旋轉會乘上偏置距離變成位置誤差。晶圓表面與干涉儀光束或編碼器讀頭之間總有數毫米的垂直偏置，所以晶圓台必須同時量測六個自由度，用俯仰與偏擺角把 Abbe 誤差算回去。所有量測都參照一個由 Zerodur 或碳化矽製成、與機架隔振的計量框架，投影鏡頭與感測器固定其上，使位置量測的參考零點與影像位置共用同一剛體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

晶圓台採雙層結構：長行程台以線性或平面馬達在整片晶圓範圍移動，精度在微米級；短行程台以六組 Lorentz 致動器相對長行程台做毫米級行程的六自由度微動，達到奈米級。Lorentz 致動器力與電流成正比且無接觸、無磁滯，重力由永磁補償器承擔以減少發熱。加速時的反作用力若傳到機架會激發振動，所以馬達定子裝在可自由滑動的平衡質量上，動量守恆讓反作用力留在平衡質量而不進入計量框架。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

傳統晶圓台以 HeNe 雷射外差干涉儀量測位置：平面鏡雙程架構使每條干涉條紋對應四分之一波長，再由相位內插得到次奈米解析度。它的弱點是光束在空氣中走過數百毫米，空氣折射率隨溫度、壓力與濕度變化，死程誤差與擾流成為主要誤差源。近代機台改用固定在計量框架下方的二維光柵板與載台上的編碼器讀頭，空氣光程縮短到毫米級，對環境的靈敏度下降兩個數量級，代價是光柵板本身的圖樣誤差必須被校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射干涉儀與光柵編碼器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

載台位置迴路通常用 PID 加上陷波濾波器，交越頻率在數百赫茲；更高的頻寬會被載台本體的第一個結構共振限制，經驗上共振頻率要高於頻寬的三到五倍，因此載台用碳化矽或陶瓷等高比剛度材料。掃描時的追蹤誤差主要不是靠回授壓低，而是用加速度前饋：把參考軌跡的加速度乘上質量直接送到致動器，回授只處理前饋的殘差與擾動。前饋的質量與延遲若估錯，殘差就直接以加速度為比例出現。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「伺服迴路與前饋控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

量測系統本身有系統性誤差：干涉儀反射鏡的平面度、光柵板的圖樣誤差、讀頭之間的非正交性與比例誤差，都要用自校正或交叉比對建成校正圖並在控制器中即時扣除。MA 誤差直接進入套刻預算，而 MSD 則像高斯模糊降低影像對比，對小間距的影響最大。誤差預算表把量測、致動、熱與振動的各項以均方根合成，並區分可校正的系統項與不可校正的隨機項。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正圖與誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

計量框架與投影鏡頭由三到四組氣浮或電磁隔振器支撐，形成約 1 Hz 的低頻彈簧質量系統，地面振動在遠高於共振的頻率被衰減；主動隔振再以加速度計回授增加阻尼並壓低共振峰，同時以載台反作用力與重心移動的前饋抵消可預測的擾動。晶圓廠地板的振動等級、幫浦與空調的窄頻擾動、以及載台本身的動量轉移，都必須納入整機振動預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動隔振與地面振動」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

載台的工程價值最後以兩個數字體現：每小時晶圓數與套刻。產能由每場的掃描時間、步進時間、整定時間與晶圓交換時間決定，雙台架構讓對準與高度量測在另一台上同時進行，把量測時間隱藏在曝光之後。驗收用同一片晶圓重複曝光量機台對自身套刻，用不同機台曝光量機台間套刻；交接文件包括校正圖版本、MA/MSD 基準曲線、熱穩定時間與所有感測器的校正日期。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one. Any wafer point accumulates exposure while the slit passes, so position error acts in two ways: its average over that window (MA) becomes overlay error, while its moving standard deviation (MSD) blurs the image and degrades contrast and CD uniformity. The specification is therefore not a single positioning accuracy but MA and MSD averaged over the scan time window. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The Abbe principle demands that the measurement axis pass through the point of interest, otherwise a tiny stage rotation multiplied by the offset distance becomes a position error. There is always a vertical offset of several millimetres between the wafer surface and the interferometer beams or encoder heads, so the wafer stage must be measured in all six degrees of freedom and the pitch and yaw angles used to compute the Abbe error back out. Every measurement refers to a metrology frame made of Zerodur or silicon carbide and isolated from the base frame; the projection lens and sensors are mounted on it so the position reference and the image share one rigid body. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Metrology frame and Abbe offset”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The wafer stage is a two-layer system: a long-stroke stage driven by linear or planar motors covers the whole wafer at micrometre accuracy, while a short-stroke stage rides on it with six Lorentz actuators providing millimetre-range six-degree-of-freedom fine motion at nanometre level. Lorentz actuators give force proportional to current without contact or hysteresis, and a permanent-magnet gravity compensator carries the weight to limit heating. Reaction forces during acceleration would excite the frame, so the motor stators sit on a freely sliding balance mass, and momentum conservation keeps the reaction in the balance mass instead of the metrology frame. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lorentz actuators and balance mass”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Conventional wafer stages are measured with HeNe heterodyne laser interferometers: a double-pass plane-mirror configuration makes each fringe correspond to a quarter wavelength, and phase interpolation yields sub-nanometre resolution. Their weakness is the beam path of several hundred millimetres through air, whose refractive index varies with temperature, pressure and humidity, so dead-path error and turbulence dominate. Modern systems instead use two-dimensional grating plates fixed under the metrology frame with encoder heads on the stage, shrinking the air path to millimetres and cutting environmental sensitivity by two orders of magnitude, at the cost of having to calibrate the grating pattern itself. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser interferometer and grating encoder”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The stage position loop is typically PID with notch filters and a crossover of a few hundred hertz; higher bandwidth is limited by the first structural resonance of the stage body, which by experience must lie three to five times above the bandwidth, hence stage bodies of silicon carbide or ceramics with high specific stiffness. Tracking error during scanning is suppressed mainly by acceleration feedforward rather than feedback: the reference trajectory's acceleration times the mass is sent straight to the actuators and the loop handles only feedforward residuals and disturbances. A wrong mass or delay in the feedforward produces an error proportional to acceleration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Servo loop and feedforward control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The measurement system has systematic errors of its own: flatness of interferometer mirrors, pattern errors of the grating plate, non-orthogonality and scale errors between heads, all of which must be captured by self-calibration or cross-comparison into calibration maps subtracted in real time by the controller. MA error enters the overlay budget directly, while MSD acts like a Gaussian blur that reduces image contrast, most severely at small pitch. The error-budget table combines measurement, actuation, thermal and vibration terms in quadrature and separates correctable systematic terms from uncorrectable random ones. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibration maps and error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The metrology frame and projection lens rest on three or four pneumatic or electromagnetic isolators forming a spring-mass system near 1 Hz, so floor vibration well above that resonance is attenuated; active isolation adds accelerometer feedback for damping and resonance suppression, plus feedforward to cancel predictable disturbances from stage reaction forces and centre-of-gravity shifts. The fab floor vibration class, narrowband disturbances from pumps and air handling, and momentum transfer from the stages themselves all enter the whole-tool vibration budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active isolation and floor vibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The stage's engineering value is finally expressed in two numbers: wafers per hour and overlay. Throughput follows from scan time, step time, settling time and wafer exchange per field, and the dual-stage architecture lets alignment and height mapping run on the other stage so that measurement time hides behind exposure. Acceptance measures machine-to-itself overlay by re-exposing the same wafer and machine-to-machine overlay across tools; the handoff record includes calibration-map versions, MA/MSD baseline curves, thermal stabilisation time and the calibration dates of every sensor. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfallsEn: If exposure starts before the acceleration phase has fully settled, the leading edge of every field carries a systematic MA offset and elevated MSD, seen as overlay deviation and rougher linewidth along one field edge, something a static positioning test never reveals.

Cable carriers or coolant hoses whose stiffness varies with position add a low-frequency resonance at certain locations, the fixed notch filters no longer match, and the stage shows limit-cycle oscillation of tens of hertz with MSD spikes at specific field positions.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：複消色差顯微物鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Apochromatic microscope objectives
guides.concept: 以 100×/1.4 油浸複消色差物鏡為對象：從 Abbe 解析度與軸向景深建立規格邊界，推導二級光譜如何由玻璃的部分色散差決定、為何需要螢石類異常色散材料，說明齊明半球前鏡組如何把 NA 1.4 的光線角逐級降低，再談鏡片偏心與增透膜、蓋玻片厚度球差與校正環，最後以多波長 PSF 量測與 Strehl 預算完成驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Taking a 100×/1.4 oil-immersion apochromat as the object, the course sets the specification boundary from Abbe resolution and axial depth of field, derives how secondary spectrum is fixed by the partial-dispersion difference of the glasses and why fluorite-type anomalous-dispersion materials are needed, explains how the aplanatic hemispherical front group steps the NA 1.4 ray angles down, covers element decentration, antireflection coatings, cover-glass spherical aberration and the correction collar, and closes acceptance with multi-wavelength PSF measurement and a Strehl budget.
procedure: 顯微物鏡能分辨的最小週期由 Abbe 條件決定：d = λ/(2NA)，NA = n·sinα 是物方介質折射率與半孔徑角正弦的乘積，油浸以 n = 1.515 把 NA 推到 1.4。軸向解析度隨 NA 的平方改善，但景深也跟著縮到 1 µm 以下，於是任何波長之間的焦點差都必須小於景深，否則不同顏色的影像無法同時清晰；這正是複消色差物鏡存在的理由，色差規格要用景深為尺度來訂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「物鏡出瞳與數值孔徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

消色差雙合鏡只能讓兩個波長（F 與 C 線）共焦，其餘波長的焦點偏離稱為二級光譜，大小由兩種玻璃的部分色散差 ΔP 與 Abbe 數差 Δν 的比值決定。普通玻璃的部分色散幾乎落在一條直線上，所以 ΔP/Δν 幾乎是常數，無法用普通玻璃消除；只有螢石、氟磷酸鹽冕玻璃或特殊短火石這類偏離正常線的材料，才能讓三個波長共焦並同時校正球差，這就是複消色差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「部分色散圖與二級光譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高 NA 物鏡的前端是一片半球或超半球透鏡，試樣與浸油的折射率相近，試樣位於球面的齊明點（距球心 R/n）時，球面既不產生球差也不產生彗差，但把光線的正弦角度除以 n，再接一片齊明彎月鏡可以再除一次。這樣把 NA 1.4 的陡峭光束降成後方鏡組容易處理的角度，之後的螢石與異常色散玻璃雙合、三合鏡才負責色差與剩餘球差的校正。螢石（CaF₂）的 Abbe 數約 95，但質地軟且易受熱衝擊，加工與鍍膜都需特別處理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「齊明半球前鏡組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

一支複消色差物鏡通常有 10 到 15 片鏡片，其中多組膠合；每片的曲率、厚度與折射率誤差都會改變色差與球差的平衡，所以組裝時以空氣間隙或選配鏡片作為補償項。鏡片對心是最敏感的公差：偏心產生與視場無關的彗差，用對心儀以反射像判定光軸後再修邊與膠合。每個玻璃空氣界面都要鍍寬頻增透膜，否則 30 個界面的反射損失會讓透過率與對比同時崩潰。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡片偏心公差與增透膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

物鏡的最終品質以點擴散函數（PSF）衡量：用直徑遠小於解析度的螢光珠或針孔作為點光源，記錄三維影像堆疊，從中取橫向半高寬、軸向半高寬、對稱性與 Strehl 比。多波長量測則揭露軸向色差與橫向色差；干涉儀測試能給出 Zernike 係數，但需要與物鏡匹配的參考球面與浸液。量測時蓋玻片厚度、浸油折射率與溫度都必須和設計條件一致，否則量到的是測試條件的像差而非物鏡的像差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多波長 PSF 量測台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

物鏡以特定蓋玻片厚度（通常 0.17 mm）與浸液折射率設計，任何厚度偏差或折射率失配都會引入與 NA 四次方成正比的球差，高 NA 乾式物鏡對此最敏感，因此配有校正環改變一組鏡片的間距來抵消。油浸物鏡在蓋玻片與油折射率匹配時對厚度不敏感，但觀察水性試樣深處時，水與油的折射率差會隨深度累積球差。誤差預算要把這些使用條件項與物鏡本身的殘差一起列入。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「蓋玻片厚度與校正環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

現代物鏡為無限遠校正：物鏡把試樣成像到無窮遠，由筒鏡（焦距依廠牌為 164.5、180 或 200 mm）成像到中間像面，標稱倍率等於筒鏡焦距除以物鏡焦距。物鏡與筒鏡是一組被整體設計的系統，橫向色差（放大率隨波長變化）可能在物鏡內校正，也可能留給筒鏡補償，因此混用不同廠牌會引入橫向色差。齊焦距離、螺紋規格、視場數與後焦面位置都是整合時必須一致的介面參數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「筒鏡、齊焦距離與視場數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

物鏡出貨前的驗收把所有量測整合成一份資料表：各波長的軸上 Strehl 與 Zernike 係數、軸向與橫向色差、視場平坦度、透過率曲線、工作距離與齊焦距離實測值，以及測試時的蓋玻片厚度、浸液與溫度。系統整合者再把物鏡殘差、筒鏡、對準與使用條件以均方根合成，判斷整機能否維持 Strehl 0.8。交接時必須連同測試條件一起移交，否則後續的現場量測無法與出廠值比較。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「物鏡驗收資料表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The finest period a microscope objective can resolve follows the Abbe condition d = λ/(2NA), where NA = n·sinα is the product of the object-space index and the sine of the half-aperture angle, and oil immersion with n = 1.515 pushes NA to 1.4. Axial resolution improves with the square of NA, but depth of field shrinks below 1 µm with it, so any focus difference between wavelengths must be smaller than that depth or the colours cannot be sharp simultaneously; this is exactly why apochromats exist, and chromatic specifications must be written in units of depth of field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Objective exit pupil and numerical aperture”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An achromatic doublet brings only two wavelengths (the F and C lines) to a common focus; the residual focus error of other wavelengths is the secondary spectrum, whose size is set by the ratio of the partial-dispersion difference ΔP to the Abbe-number difference Δν of the two glasses. Ordinary glasses have partial dispersions lying almost on a straight line, so ΔP/Δν is nearly constant and cannot be cancelled with ordinary glasses; only materials off the normal line such as fluorite, fluorophosphate crowns or special short flints allow three wavelengths to share a focus while spherical aberration is also corrected, which is the apochromatic condition. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Partial-dispersion diagram and secondary spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The front of a high-NA objective is a hemispherical or hyper-hemispherical lens; with specimen and immersion oil of nearly equal index, a specimen at the aplanatic point of the sphere (R/n from the centre) sees neither spherical aberration nor coma, while the sine of the ray angle is divided by n, and a following aplanatic meniscus divides it once more. This reduces the steep NA 1.4 beam to angles the rear groups can handle, after which fluorite and anomalous-dispersion doublets and triplets correct colour and residual spherical aberration. Fluorite (CaF₂) has an Abbe number near 95 but is soft and sensitive to thermal shock, so it needs special handling in polishing and coating. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aplanatic hemispherical front group”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An apochromat typically has 10 to 15 elements, several cemented; errors in radius, thickness and refractive index of every element shift the balance of chromatic and spherical correction, so an air gap or selected elements serve as compensators during assembly. Centring is the most sensitive tolerance: decentration produces field-independent coma, so each element's optical axis is located with a centring instrument from reflected images before edging and cementing. Every glass-air interface needs a broadband antireflection coating, otherwise the reflection losses of 30 interfaces collapse both transmission and contrast. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Element centring tolerance and antireflection coatings”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An objective's final quality is judged by its point-spread function (PSF): a fluorescent bead or pinhole far smaller than the resolution serves as a point source, a three-dimensional image stack is recorded, and lateral and axial full widths at half maximum, symmetry and Strehl ratio are extracted. Multi-wavelength measurement exposes axial and lateral colour; interferometric testing gives Zernike coefficients but needs a matched reference sphere and immersion. Cover-glass thickness, oil index and temperature during the test must match the design conditions, otherwise the measured aberration belongs to the test setup rather than to the objective. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multi-wavelength PSF measurement bench”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An objective is designed for a specific cover-glass thickness (usually 0.17 mm) and immersion index, and any thickness deviation or index mismatch introduces spherical aberration proportional to the fourth power of NA, to which high-NA dry objectives are most sensitive, hence a correction collar that shifts one lens group to cancel it. Oil objectives are insensitive to cover-glass thickness when oil and glass indices match, but imaging deep into aqueous specimens accumulates spherical aberration with depth from the water-oil index difference. The error budget must list these usage-condition terms alongside the objective's own residuals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cover-glass thickness and correction collar”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Modern objectives are infinity-corrected: the objective images the specimen to infinity and a tube lens (164.5, 180 or 200 mm focal length depending on the maker) forms the intermediate image, with nominal magnification equal to tube-lens focal length divided by objective focal length. Objective and tube lens are designed as one system, and lateral colour (magnification varying with wavelength) may be corrected inside the objective or left for the tube lens to compensate, so mixing makers introduces lateral colour. Parfocal distance, thread standard, field number and back-focal-plane position are the interface parameters that must agree during integration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tube lens, parfocal distance and field number”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Pre-shipment acceptance consolidates every measurement into one data sheet: on-axis Strehl and Zernike coefficients per wavelength, axial and lateral colour, field flatness, transmission curve, measured working and parfocal distances, and the cover-glass thickness, immersion and temperature used in testing. The system integrator then combines objective residual, tube lens, alignment and usage conditions in quadrature to judge whether the whole instrument keeps Strehl at 0.8. The test conditions must be handed over with the data, otherwise later field measurements cannot be compared with factory values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Objective acceptance data sheet”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若浸油折射率與設計值不符或油膜中有氣泡，有效 NA 下降，橫向解析度從 196 nm 退化到 250 nm 以上，而物鏡本身並無缺陷，使用者卻以為物鏡不良。
若用厚度 150 µm 的蓋玻片測試設計給 170 µm 的物鏡，球差讓軸向 PSF 不對稱並拉長 50% 以上，測試報告判定物鏡不良，實際上是測試條件錯誤。
pitfallsEn: If the immersion oil index deviates from design or the oil film contains bubbles, the effective NA drops, lateral resolution degrades from 196 nm to above 250 nm, and the user blames an objective that is actually faultless.

Testing an objective designed for a 170 µm cover glass with a 150 µm one introduces spherical aberration that makes the axial PSF asymmetric and over 50% longer, so the report condemns a good objective when the test condition was wrong.
