guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：非球面光學加工
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Aspheric-optics manufacturing
guides.concept: 以一片半徑 50 mm、口徑 50 mm 的拋物面為貫穿案例：先用矢高方程算出它與球面的偏離量與斜率，說明為何無法用標準球面工法與干涉儀直接處理，再拆解 CNC 研磨、磁流變等確定性次口徑拋光的去除率與收斂、單點鑽石車削的理論粗糙度與精密玻璃模造的收縮補償，接著以輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接量測建立誤差預算，最後以對心公差、熱穩定性與 ISO 10110 圖面完成驗收交接。
guides.conceptEn: Using a paraboloid of 50 mm radius and 50 mm aperture as the running case, the course first computes its departure from a sphere and its slope with the sag equation to show why standard spherical methods and interferometers cannot handle it directly, then dissects CNC grinding, the removal rate and convergence of deterministic subaperture polishing such as MRF, the theoretical roughness of single-point diamond turning and the shrinkage compensation of precision glass molding, builds an error budget from profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching, and finishes with centring tolerances, thermal stability and ISO 10110 drawing-based acceptance.
procedure: 球面只有一個自由度（曲率），無法同時滿足聚焦與消球差，所以 f 數小的鏡片必須多片組合；非球面以矢高方程 z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ 加入圓錐常數 k 與高次項，一面就能消除球差。代價是表面不再有旋轉對稱球面那種「任何方向都一樣」的性質：曲率隨半徑變化，傳統靠工具與工件互磨自然成形的球面工法失效，量測也不能直接用球面參考波前。偏離量與斜率的大小決定了加工與量測方法。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

非球面加工的誤差按空間頻率分成三段：低頻面形誤差對應像差，可由後續修形去除；中頻漣波（週期約 0.1 到 10 mm）是次口徑工具沿軌跡留下的週期結構，會把光散射到像點附近形成小角度的眩光與對比損失；高頻粗糙度造成大角度散射。球面全口徑拋光天然不產生中頻，而非球面依賴小工具，所以中頻誤差成為非球面特有的品質問題，必須用功率譜密度（PSD）而不是單一的 PV 或 RMS 數字來規範。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「表面誤差功率譜密度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

非球面先以 CNC 金剛石砂輪依矢高方程研磨成形，留下數微米的面形誤差與次表面損傷層，再進入確定性拋光：磁流變拋光（MRF）、氣囊拋光或小工具電腦控制拋光都以一個已校正的工具去除函數（TIF）在表面上移動，停留時間圖由誤差圖與 TIF 的反卷積求得，去除量與停留時間成正比。每次疊代把誤差降低一個收斂比，通常需要兩到三次量測與拋光循環；MRF 的剪切去除機制幾乎不施壓，因此不會引入新的次表面損傷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CNC 研磨與磁流變拋光頭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

金屬、紅外晶體與塑膠的非球面常以單點鑽石車削直接成形：工件在空氣主軸上旋轉，鑽石刀尖沿非球面軌跡以奈米級解析度進給，表面粗糙度由進給量與刀尖半徑決定，形狀精度由機台的定位精度與熱穩定性決定。大量生產的玻璃非球面則用精密玻璃模造：玻璃預形體加熱到轉變溫度以上，在碳化鎢或碳化矽模具之間壓製成形後緩慢冷卻；模具本身是以研磨拋光做出的非球面，並且必須預先補償玻璃冷卻收縮與折射率因冷卻速率下降的效應。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鑽石車刀與玻璃模具」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

非球面與球面參考波前干涉時，條紋密度由偏離斜率決定，超過相機解析度就無法量測，因此需要讓參考波前變成非球面的零位元件：電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生設計波前，或用折射式零位鏡；另一條路是不做零位而用次口徑拼接或傾斜波干涉儀。接觸式與光學輪廓儀逐點掃描剖面，不受斜率的條紋限制但速度慢、取樣稀，且探針半徑與斜率會產生系統性的量測誤差。工程上通常以輪廓儀做前段加工的量測，以 CGH 干涉做最終驗收。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輪廓儀探針與 CGH 零位鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

球面沒有軸，任何通過球心的直線都是對稱軸；非球面卻有唯一的對稱軸，它與鏡片的機械軸（外圓）或另一面的光軸若不重合，整個偏離量分佈就相對光瞳平移，產生與偏心量乘以局部斜率成正比的彗差型表面誤差。因此非球面的誤差預算除了面形、中頻與粗糙度，還要包含非球面軸的偏心與傾斜、中心厚度與頂點位置，這些量在球面鏡片上幾乎不需要關心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非球面軸與機械軸偏心」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

非球面鏡片裝入鏡筒時以邊緣與斜面定位，夾持力與黏著劑收縮都可能把面形壓變形；材料的選擇決定熱穩定性：玻璃的 dn/dT 與熱膨脹都很小，塑膠的 dn/dT 為負且數量級大一百倍，模造玻璃居中。整合時要用熱光系數估算焦距隨溫度的漂移，並決定是否需要被動無熱化（混合不同材料）或主動對焦。鏡筒材料的膨脹也會改變鏡片間距，與鏡片本身的效應同時計入。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡筒介面與熱膨脹」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

非球面的圖面依 ISO 10110 系列標示：非球面方程與係數、面形公差（PV、RMS 與斜率）、中頻 PSD 或帶限 RMS、粗糙度、對心公差與中心厚度，每一項都要指明量測方法與去除的擬合項（例如扣除傾斜與離焦）。驗收報告要附上量測不確定度，依慣例量測不確定度應小於公差的四分之一（量測比 4:1）；達不到時需要改進量測或用兩種獨立方法交叉驗證。交接文件還要包含實測的矢高表或面形圖檔，供光學設計做「實測重最佳化」。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ISO 10110 圖面與量測不確定度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A sphere has a single degree of freedom, its curvature, and cannot focus and cancel spherical aberration at once, so fast lenses need many elements; an asphere adds a conic constant k and higher-order terms through the sag equation z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ and removes spherical aberration with one surface. The price is losing the property of a sphere that every direction is alike: curvature varies with radius, so traditional spherical lapping in which tool and part grind each other into shape no longer works, and testing cannot simply use a spherical reference wavefront. The magnitude of departure and slope decides which fabrication and metrology methods apply. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Errors in aspheric fabrication fall into three spatial-frequency bands: low-frequency figure error maps to aberration and can be corrected by subsequent figuring; mid-spatial-frequency ripple (periods of roughly 0.1 to 10 mm) is the periodic structure left along the tool path by subaperture tools and scatters light close to the image point as small-angle flare with contrast loss; high-frequency roughness scatters at large angles. Full-aperture spherical polishing produces no mid-frequency content naturally, whereas aspheres depend on small tools, so mid-spatial-frequency error is a quality problem specific to aspheres that must be specified with a power spectral density rather than a single PV or RMS number. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Surface-error power spectral density”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An asphere is first ground to the sag equation with a CNC diamond wheel, leaving several micrometres of figure error and a subsurface damage layer, then enters deterministic polishing: magnetorheological finishing (MRF), bonnet polishing or computer-controlled small-tool polishing all move a calibrated tool influence function (TIF) over the surface, the dwell-time map is obtained by deconvolving the error map with the TIF, and removal is proportional to dwell time. Each iteration reduces the error by a convergence ratio, so two or three measure-and-polish cycles are usual; the shear-based removal of MRF applies almost no pressure and introduces no new subsurface damage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CNC grinding and MRF polishing head”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Aspheres in metals, infrared crystals and plastics are often shaped directly by single-point diamond turning: the part rotates on an air-bearing spindle while a diamond tool follows the aspheric path with nanometre feed resolution; roughness is set by feed and tool-nose radius, and form accuracy by the machine's positioning accuracy and thermal stability. High-volume glass aspheres use precision glass molding instead: a glass preform is heated above its transition temperature, pressed between tungsten-carbide or silicon-carbide molds and cooled slowly; the molds are themselves ground and polished aspheres and must pre-compensate the shrinkage of the glass on cooling and the refractive-index drop caused by the cooling rate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Diamond tool and glass mold”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When an asphere interferes with a spherical reference wavefront the fringe density is set by the departure slope, and beyond the camera's resolution nothing can be measured, so a null element must turn the reference into the aspheric wavefront: a computer-generated hologram (CGH) produces the design wavefront by diffraction, or a refractive null lens does; the alternative is to avoid a null and use subaperture stitching or a tilted-wave interferometer. Contact and optical profilometers scan profiles point by point, free of the fringe limit but slow and sparse, with systematic errors from stylus radius and slope. In practice profilometry serves the early fabrication stages and CGH interferometry the final acceptance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Profilometer stylus and CGH null”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A sphere has no axis, since any line through its centre is an axis of symmetry; an asphere has a unique symmetry axis, and if it does not coincide with the mechanical axis of the lens edge or the optical axis of the other surface, the whole departure map shifts relative to the pupil, producing a coma-like surface error proportional to decentration times local slope. The error budget of an asphere therefore includes, beyond figure, mid-frequency and roughness, the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis, the centre thickness and the vertex position, quantities that hardly matter for spherical elements. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aspheric axis versus mechanical axis”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An asphere is located in its barrel by its edge and a bevel, and clamping force or adhesive shrinkage can distort the figure; the material choice sets thermal stability, since glass has small dn/dT and expansion, plastic has a negative dn/dT a hundred times larger, and molded glass lies between. Integration uses the thermo-optic coefficients to estimate focal-length drift with temperature and to decide whether passive athermalisation by mixing materials or active focusing is needed. Barrel-material expansion also changes element spacing and must be counted together with the elements themselves. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Barrel interface and thermal expansion”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Asphere drawings follow the ISO 10110 series: the aspheric equation and coefficients, figure tolerance (PV, RMS and slope), mid-frequency PSD or band-limited RMS, roughness, centring tolerance and centre thickness, each with its measurement method and the fitted terms removed (for example tilt and defocus). The acceptance report must state measurement uncertainty, which by convention should be below a quarter of the tolerance (a 4:1 test-uncertainty ratio); when that cannot be reached, the metrology must improve or two independent methods must cross-validate. The handoff package also includes the measured sag table or figure map so the optical designer can re-optimise with as-built data. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ISO 10110 drawing and measurement uncertainty”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把非球面係數的符號約定或單位搞錯（例如把 A₄ 以 mm⁻³ 當成 mm⁻⁴），加工出的表面在邊緣偏離設計數十微米，量測時整片表面看似合格的球面卻完全不是設計的非球面。
CGH 若相對干涉儀偏心 20 µm，量到的面形會多出一個假的彗差項，修形機台照著去除後反而把真正合格的表面做壞，下一次量測又顯示相反方向的彗差。
pitfallsEn: A sign-convention or unit error in the aspheric coefficients (for example treating A₄ in mm⁻³ as mm⁻⁴) produces a surface tens of micrometres off design at the edge, and metrology shows a seemingly fine sphere that is simply not the asphere designed.

A CGH decentred by 20 µm relative to the interferometer adds a spurious coma term to the measured figure; the figuring machine removes it faithfully and spoils a surface that was actually within tolerance, and the next measurement shows coma of the opposite sign.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：自由曲面光學量測
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Freeform-optics metrology
guides.concept: 以一片口徑 50 mm、對最佳擬合球面偏離 200 µm、最大斜率 20 mrad 的自由曲面反射鏡為案例：先說明無對稱軸的表面為何讓六個剛體自由度與面形誤差糾纏，必須靠基準與定位標記配準；再比較 CGH 零位干涉、傾斜波非零位干涉、接觸與光學探針輪廓儀及次口徑拼接的物理限制，建立含 CGH 寫入誤差、基板、回溯誤差與熱漂移的不確定度預算，最後以兩種獨立方法交叉驗證並把量測圖回饋到確定性修形與實測重最佳化。
guides.conceptEn: Using a 50 mm freeform mirror with 200 µm departure from its best-fit sphere and 20 mrad maximum slope as the case, the course first shows why a surface without a symmetry axis entangles the six rigid-body degrees of freedom with form error and must be registered through datums and fiducials; it then compares the physical limits of CGH null interferometry, tilted-wave non-null interferometry, contact and optical probe profilometry and subaperture stitching, builds an uncertainty budget covering CGH writing error, substrate, retrace error and thermal drift, and closes by cross-validating two independent methods and feeding the map back into deterministic figuring and as-built re-optimisation.
procedure: 自由曲面是沒有旋轉對稱軸的光學面，通常以圓錐基面加上 XY 多項式或 Zernike 項描述，用於離軸反射系統、頭戴顯示與光束整形。量測的對象不是「面」本身，而是面相對於設計座標系的誤差：球面或旋轉對稱非球面可以靠對稱性消去部分剛體自由度，自由曲面卻讓平移、傾斜與繞軸轉動（clocking）六個自由度都和面形誤差混在一起。沒有基準面與定位標記，量到的誤差圖只是某個最佳擬合下的殘差，與設計師在系統中需要的誤差並不相同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

干涉儀只能解析條紋間距大於兩個像素的區域，自由曲面對參考波前的斜率差讓條紋在大部分區域過密，因此有兩條路：零位測試用電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生與設計表面完全匹配的波前，條紋只反映誤差；非零位測試如傾斜波干涉儀用一組傾斜的點光源，使每個局部區域至少有一個光源的條紋可解析，再用已校正的光線追跡模型扣除非共路的回溯誤差。零位測試精度高但 CGH 專用於一個設計；非零位測試通用但依賴儀器模型的完整校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

CGH 是在熔融石英基板上以電子束或雷射直寫的繞射圖樣，振幅型以鉻膜遮光，相位型以蝕刻深度產生 π 相位差，效率差四倍；設計時加入載波傾斜使主測量級次與其他級次在像面上分離，避免鬼像干涉。基板本身的面形與厚度不均勻會直接疊加在測量波前上，必須事先量測並扣除；CGH 上另外寫入對準區，用回射或貓眼圖樣讓 CGH 相對干涉儀的位置與傾斜能被獨立確認。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

輪廓儀以接觸探針或非接觸光學探頭沿表面掃描，不受條紋密度限制，是自由曲面量測的通用方法。接觸探針以紅寶石球接觸表面，量到的是球心軌跡，必須依局部斜率做探針半徑補償，探針力則造成赫茲接觸壓入；光學探頭（多波長干涉或共軛焦）無接觸，但對斜率與表面反射率敏感。兩者都要用高精度的運動平台或旋轉台與線性尺，量測時間長達數小時，熱漂移成為主要誤差源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「探針球與多波長光學探頭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

次口徑拼接把自由曲面分成多個小區域，每個區域傾斜到局部斜率在干涉儀可解析範圍內分別量測，再用重疊區解出各子孔徑的六個剛體參數與參考波前誤差後合成全口徑。拼接的強項是用一般球面干涉儀量任意面形，弱點是子孔徑之間的對準誤差會隨拼接鏈長度以隨機漫步方式累積，低階的整體形狀誤差最難被約束；通常搭配一次低解析度的全口徑量測或外部基準作為全域約束。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「次口徑拼接與重疊區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每種方法都要有一張不確定度預算表：干涉儀參考面、CGH 或儀器模型、對準與回溯、拼接、熱漂移與雜訊逐項列出，以均方根合成後與公差比較。追溯靠參考件：三平面法或隨機球法給出絕對參考面誤差，經國家計量機構（如 PTB）校正的球面與非球面標準件提供與長度單位的連結。熱是長時間量測的主因：工件、夾具與儀器的膨脹與折射率變化都在預算內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「不確定度預算表與參考件」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

自由曲面的工程價值在於量測圖能被正確放回設計座標並驅動下一步：加工端用它計算修形的停留時間圖，設計端用它做實測重最佳化，裝配端用它決定補償調整。這需要在工件上設計可量測的基準：三個定位球或基準平面與邊緣，在加工機、量測機與鏡座之間共用同一套參考。定位標記本身的量測不確定度透過斜率轉成面形不確定度，因此基準的佈局要盡量拉長基線、靠近有效口徑。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「定位標記與數位製造迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

自由曲面沒有簡單的通用標準件，所以驗收依賴兩種物理原理不同的方法互相比對：例如 CGH 干涉與探針輪廓儀，兩者的差異圖應在合成不確定度內且不含結構性圖樣。驗收報告依 ISO 10110-19 的自由曲面規格標示面形、斜率誤差、中頻與粗糙度，並註明所用的座標系、扣除的擬合項、取樣密度與不確定度；交接文件附上以設計座標表示的實測面形檔，供後續的實測重最佳化與系統對準使用。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A freeform is an optical surface without a rotational symmetry axis, usually described by a conic base plus XY polynomial or Zernike terms, and used in off-axis reflective systems, head-mounted displays and beam shaping. The measurand is not the surface itself but its error relative to the design coordinate frame: spheres and rotationally symmetric aspheres let symmetry eliminate some rigid-body degrees of freedom, whereas a freeform entangles all six, translation, tilt and clocking, with form error. Without datum surfaces and fiducials the measured map is only a residual under some best fit, not the error the designer needs in the system. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Freeform definition and datum frame”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An interferometer resolves only regions where fringe spacing exceeds two pixels, and a freeform's slope difference from the reference wavefront makes fringes too dense almost everywhere, leaving two routes: a null test uses a computer-generated hologram (CGH) that diffracts a wavefront exactly matching the design surface so that fringes show only error, while a non-null test such as the tilted-wave interferometer uses an array of tilted point sources so that every local region has at least one source with resolvable fringes, then removes the non-common-path retrace error with a calibrated ray-trace model of the instrument. Null tests are the most accurate but each CGH serves one design; non-null tests are general but depend on a fully calibrated instrument model. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CGH line spacing and retrace error”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A CGH is a diffractive pattern written by electron beam or laser on a fused-silica substrate; amplitude types block light with chrome, phase types etch a depth giving a π phase difference and are four times more efficient. A carrier tilt is added in the design so the measurement order separates from the other orders at the image plane and ghost interference is avoided. The substrate's own figure and thickness variation add directly to the measured wavefront and must be measured beforehand and subtracted; an alignment zone written on the CGH returns a retro or cat's-eye pattern so the CGH position and tilt relative to the interferometer can be confirmed independently. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A profilometer scans the surface with a contact stylus or a non-contact optical probe, is unconstrained by fringe density and is the general-purpose freeform method. A contact probe touches the surface with a ruby ball, measures the trajectory of the ball centre and therefore needs a radius compensation based on local slope, while the probe force causes Hertzian indentation; optical probes (multi-wavelength interferometric or confocal) are contact-free but sensitive to slope and surface reflectivity. Both rely on high-precision motion stages or rotary tables with linear scales, and because scans take hours, thermal drift becomes the dominant error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Probe ball and multi-wavelength optical probe”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Subaperture stitching divides a freeform into small regions, each tilted so the local slope falls within the interferometer's resolvable range and measured separately, then solves the six rigid-body parameters and reference-wavefront error of every subaperture from the overlaps to assemble the full aperture. Its strength is measuring arbitrary shapes with an ordinary spherical interferometer; its weakness is that alignment errors between subapertures accumulate along the stitching chain like a random walk, with the low-order global shape hardest to constrain, so a low-resolution full-aperture measurement or an external datum is usually added as a global constraint. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Every method needs an uncertainty-budget table: interferometer reference, CGH or instrument model, alignment and retrace, stitching, thermal drift and noise are listed term by term, combined in quadrature and compared with the tolerance. Traceability rests on reference artefacts: the three-flat or random-ball test gives the absolute reference-surface error, and spherical and aspheric standards calibrated by a national metrology institute such as PTB link the measurement to the unit of length. Temperature dominates long measurements, so expansion and index change of the part, fixture and instrument all belong in the budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The engineering value of freeform metrology lies in placing the measured map correctly into the design frame and letting it drive the next step: the fabricator computes the figuring dwell-time map from it, the designer re-optimises with as-built data, and the integrator decides compensating adjustments. This needs measurable datums designed into the part, three fiducial spheres or a datum plane plus edge, shared as one reference by the machine tool, the metrology instrument and the mount. The fiducials' own measurement uncertainty converts through slope into form uncertainty, so their layout should maximise the baseline and sit close to the clear aperture. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Freeforms have no simple universal standard artefact, so acceptance relies on comparing two methods of different physical principle, for example CGH interferometry and probe profilometry, whose difference map should lie within the combined uncertainty and contain no structured pattern. The acceptance report specifies figure, slope error, mid-frequency and roughness according to the freeform conventions of ISO 10110-19 and states the coordinate frame, the removed fitted terms, the sampling density and the uncertainty; the handoff package includes the as-measured surface file in design coordinates for later as-built re-optimisation and system alignment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 量測軟體若對自由曲面也自動扣除離焦與像散這類「對準項」，真正的設計誤差會被當成對準誤差移除，報告顯示合格的鏡子裝進系統後波前比預期差數十奈米。
重疊區若只有 10% 而非建議的 30% 以上，子孔徑之間的相對傾斜解算病態，合成圖出現沿拼接邊界的「屋頂」狀折痕，被誤認為真正的面形不連續。
pitfallsEn: If the metrology software automatically removes defocus and astigmatism as alignment terms on a freeform as it would on a sphere, genuine design error is discarded as alignment, and a mirror reported compliant degrades the system wavefront by tens of nanometres once installed.

With overlaps of only 10% instead of the recommended 30% or more, the solution for relative tilt between subapertures becomes ill-conditioned, the assembled map shows roof-like creases along the stitching boundaries, and these are mistaken for real form discontinuities.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：光學玻璃精密退火
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Precision annealing of optical glass
guides.concept: 以一塊厚 100 mm 的 N-BK7 光學玻璃毛胚為案例：從黏度與 Maxwell 鬆弛時間說明退火點與應變點的意義，推導冷卻速率如何透過假想溫度改變折射率、毛胚內溫差如何依 Adams–Williamson 關係凍結成殘餘應力，再談精密退火爐的均勻性要求、應力雙折射與折射率均勻性的量測，最後設計一份完整的退火程式並以熔次資料表完成與光學設計的交接。
guides.conceptEn: Using a 100 mm thick N-BK7 blank as the case, the course explains the annealing and strain points through viscosity and the Maxwell relaxation time, derives how cooling rate changes refractive index via the fictive temperature and how the temperature difference inside the blank freezes into residual stress by the Adams–Williamson relation, then covers the uniformity demands on a precision annealing furnace, the measurement of stress birefringence and index homogeneity, and finally designs a complete annealing schedule and hands the melt data sheet over to optical design.
procedure: 玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。應力以 Maxwell 模型鬆弛，時間常數 τ = η/G，所以在退火點附近幾十秒就能釋放應力，在應變點以下則需要數小時到數天，實際上被凍結。N-BK7 的轉變溫度約 557 °C，精密退火就是在這段溫度範圍內用受控的速率冷卻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。每把冷卻速率提高十倍，T_f 大約上升二十幾度，因此折射率與冷卻速率的對數成線性關係，玻璃廠以退火係數描述：n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀)。型錄折射率對應參考冷卻速率，任何後續的熱成形或模造若用不同速率冷卻，折射率就會偏離，必須重新退火或在設計中用實測值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「假想溫度與折射率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

精密退火爐是一個以多區加熱、厚重爐膛與輻射屏蔽把毛胚包起來的慢速溫控系統，目標不是加熱而是讓整個裝載區在冷卻過程中保持極小的空間溫差：橫向溫差會在凍結瞬間變成假想溫度差，直接轉成折射率的不均勻。熱電偶要靠近毛胚、定期以固定點或參考熱電偶校正，控制器以程式化的速率曲線運行數天到數週；毛胚放在耐火板與分離粉上，避免黏結與因接觸造成的局部熱流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「精密退火爐與溫度均勻性」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

以固定速率冷卻的玻璃板，中心比表面熱，溫差與速率成正比、與厚度平方成正比、與熱擴散率成反比。穿過轉變區時這個溫差被凍結：之後中心比表面多收縮，於是表面受壓、中心受拉，形成永久的殘餘應力；Adams 與 Williamson 在 1920 年給出永久應力與冷卻速率的正比關係，是退火程式設計的核心。厚毛胚因此需要極慢的冷卻，退火時間以週計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「毛胚厚度與熱擴散率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

殘餘應力使玻璃成為弱雙折射材料，光程差與應力和光程長度成正比，比例係數是光彈常數 K。量測用偏光儀：Sénarmont 補償法把光程差轉成檢偏鏡的旋轉角，光彈調制器法則以交流訊號達到 0.1 nm 等級；結果以每公分光程的奈米數（nm/cm）表示，是玻璃型錄的分級量。因為毛胚內應力分佈為中心拉、表面壓，量測要在穿透厚度方向與多個位置進行，並以平均與最大值分別記錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏光儀與光彈常數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

折射率以 V 形塊折射儀（精度約 1×10⁻⁵）或光譜測角儀的最小偏向角法（可達數個 10⁻⁶）在多條譜線量測，Abbe 數由 n_d、n_F、n_C 算出；均勻性則用干涉儀量穿透波前：把毛胚磨成平行板後量透射波前，扣除兩個表面的面形貢獻（以油浸或分別量測表面的方法）後，剩餘波前除以厚度就是折射率的空間變化。這些量的不確定度要與公差等級一起寫進熔次資料表，因為設計端會依此決定是否需要重算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「折射儀與均勻性干涉量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

完整的退火程式由四段組成：升溫到退火點附近並保溫足夠時間讓既有應力鬆弛與溫度均勻；以慢速率穿過退火點到應變點的轉變區，這一段決定折射率與永久應力；過了應變點後以較快速率冷卻，此時溫差只造成暫時的彈性應力，不再凍結，但仍須低於玻璃的破裂強度；最後接近室溫時再減速避免熱衝擊。速率切換點與各段速率都由前面的鬆弛時間、Adams–Williamson 應力與折射率公差共同決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「退火程式曲線與速率切換點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

退火完成的毛胚以熔次資料表交付：實測的 n_d、ν_d 與各譜線折射率、折射率與 Abbe 數的公差等級、應力雙折射（nm/cm）、均勻性等級、條紋與氣泡等級，以及退火速率與量測不確定度。光學設計端拿到實測值後進行「熔次重算」：把設計中的型錄折射率換成實測值，重新最佳化曲率、厚度或空氣間隔，再把修正後的加工圖交給光學工廠。沒有這一步，精密退火得到的折射率精度就白費了。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熔次資料表與設計重算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Glass has no melting point, only a transition range in which viscosity changes continuously with temperature: the annealing point is defined at a viscosity of 10¹² Pa·s (10¹³ dPa·s), the strain point at 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s, roughly 30 to 40 K lower. Stress relaxes by the Maxwell model with a time constant τ = η/G, so near the annealing point stress releases within tens of seconds, while below the strain point it would take hours to days and is effectively frozen. N-BK7 has a transformation temperature near 557 °C, and precision annealing means cooling through this range at a controlled rate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On passing through the transition range the structure freezes at some temperature called the fictive temperature T_f; faster cooling freezes the structure at a higher temperature with lower density and hence lower refractive index. Each tenfold increase in cooling rate raises T_f by roughly twenty-odd kelvin, so refractive index is linear in the logarithm of cooling rate, which glass makers express with an annealing coefficient: n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀). Catalogue indices correspond to a reference cooling rate, and any later hot forming or molding cooled at a different rate shifts the index, requiring re-annealing or the use of measured values in design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fictive temperature and refractive index”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A precision annealing furnace is a slow temperature-control system with multi-zone heating, a massive muffle and radiation shields enclosing the blanks; its purpose is not heating but keeping the spatial temperature difference across the load extremely small during cooling, because a lateral difference at the moment of freezing becomes a fictive-temperature difference and hence index inhomogeneity. Thermocouples sit close to the blanks and are calibrated regularly against fixed points or reference thermocouples, the controller runs a programmed rate curve over days to weeks, and blanks rest on refractory plates with parting powder to avoid sticking and local heat flow through contact. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Precision annealing furnace and temperature uniformity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A glass plate cooled at a constant rate is hotter at its centre than at its surface, with a difference proportional to rate and to thickness squared and inversely proportional to thermal diffusivity. On passing through the transition range this difference is frozen: the centre then contracts more than the surface, leaving the surface in compression and the centre in tension as permanent residual stress; Adams and Williamson in 1920 gave the proportionality between permanent stress and cooling rate that underlies every annealing schedule. Thick blanks therefore need very slow cooling, with annealing times measured in weeks. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Blank thickness and thermal diffusivity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Residual stress makes glass weakly birefringent, with an optical path difference proportional to stress and path length through the photoelastic constant K. It is measured with a polarimeter: the Sénarmont compensation method converts the path difference into an analyser rotation angle, and photoelastic-modulator methods reach the 0.1 nm level with an AC signal; the result is quoted in nanometres per centimetre of path (nm/cm), the grading quantity in glass catalogues. Because the stress is tensile at the centre and compressive at the surface, measurement is made through the thickness at several positions and reported as both mean and maximum. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polarimeter and photoelastic constant”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Refractive index is measured on several spectral lines with a V-block refractometer (about 1×10⁻⁵) or by the minimum-deviation method on a spectral goniometer (a few 10⁻⁶), and the Abbe number follows from n_d, n_F and n_C; homogeneity is measured interferometrically on the transmitted wavefront: the blank is worked into a parallel plate, the transmitted wavefront is measured, the contributions of the two surfaces are removed by oil immersion or by separate surface measurements, and the remaining wavefront divided by thickness gives the spatial index variation. The uncertainties of these quantities must appear in the melt data sheet together with the tolerance grades, because the design side decides from them whether a recompute is needed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Refractometer and homogeneity interferometry”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A complete schedule has four segments: heating to near the annealing point and holding long enough for existing stress to relax and the temperature to equalise; cooling slowly through the transition range from annealing to strain point, the segment that fixes index and permanent stress; cooling faster below the strain point, where the temperature difference causes only transient elastic stress that no longer freezes but must stay below the fracture strength of the glass; and slowing again near room temperature to avoid thermal shock. The switch points and each segment's rate follow jointly from the relaxation times, the Adams–Williamson stress and the index tolerance derived earlier. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Annealing schedule curve and rate switch points”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An annealed blank is delivered with a melt data sheet: measured n_d, ν_d and indices at each spectral line, the tolerance grades for index and Abbe number, stress birefringence in nm/cm, homogeneity grade, striae and bubble classes, plus the annealing rate and measurement uncertainties. The optical designer then performs a melt recompute, replacing catalogue indices in the design with measured values and re-optimising radii, thicknesses or air spaces before releasing corrected fabrication drawings to the optics shop. Without this step the index accuracy won by precision annealing is simply wasted. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Melt data sheet and design recompute”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把應變點以下的溫度當成仍可鬆弛的區間，程式在那裡放慢冷卻完全無效，而真正需要慢冷的退火點附近卻冷得太快，毛胚帶著殘餘應力出爐，拋光後面形隨材料去除而變化。
量測時以毛胚標稱厚度而非實際厚度換算 nm/cm，或量測點集中在應力為零的中性面附近，報告低估最大應力，鏡片在精磨減薄後因應力重新分佈而彎曲，面形失效。
pitfallsEn: Treating temperatures below the strain point as still relaxing wastes slow cooling there while the region near the annealing point that really needs it is cooled too fast; the blank leaves the furnace with residual stress and its figure changes as material is removed in polishing.

Converting to nm/cm with the nominal instead of the actual thickness, or measuring only near the stress-free neutral plane, understates the maximum stress; the lens then bends when fine grinding thins it and redistributes the stress, and its figure fails.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：離子束光學表面修形
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces
guides.concept: 從氬離子濺射的原子級去除出發，建立高斯去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與空間頻率上限的概念，再把離子源、柵極、真空與基板熱負載、干涉量測對位、誤差預算與驗收紀錄串成一條可重複的確定性修形流程。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from atomic-scale removal by argon-ion sputtering, build the Gaussian removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and spatial-frequency limit, then chain ion source, grids, vacuum, substrate thermal load, interferometer registration, error budget and acceptance record into a repeatable deterministic figuring process.
procedure: 離子束修形用能量約 0.5 到 1.5 keV 的氬離子轟擊光學表面，離子把動量傳給近表面原子，形成碰撞級聯，部分原子獲得足以脫離表面的能量而被濺射出去。每個入射離子平均濺射出的原子數稱為濺射產率 Y，對熔融石英在 1 keV 附近約為 1 個原子，去除深度只由離子通量、產率與材料原子密度決定。因為沒有機械接觸，不存在拋光壓力造成的邊緣效應與工具磨耗，整個過程在真空中進行，去除量以奈米為單位可預測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氬離子束與工件表面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

離子束在工件上的去除分佈稱為去除函數（beam removal function），通常近似高斯，半高全寬由柵極光學與工作距離決定，約 3 到 30 mm。修形時束流以固定功率在面上掃描，實際去除量等於去除函數與駐留時間圖的二維卷積，因此已知誤差圖後必須反卷積求出非負的駐留時間，常用 Richardson–Lucy 或帶非負約束的最小平方法。高斯函數在頻域也是高斯，空間週期短於束寬的誤差幾乎無法被修正，這決定了離子束修形只能處理低頻面形，中高頻必須由前段拋光控制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

修形機的核心是 Kaufman 型柵極離子源：放電室以燈絲或射頻把氬氣游離成電漿，屏蔽柵與加速柵之間的電位差把離子抽出並加速到設定能量，兩片柵極的孔徑對準與間距決定束流發散與去除函數寬度。束流離開後由熱燈絲或電漿橋中和器注入電子，避免絕緣的玻璃工件表面充電而使束流偏折。腔體工作壓力約 10⁻⁴ mbar，比離子平均自由徑對應的壓力低，使離子在抵達工件前幾乎不碰撞；真空品質、氣體流量與柵極溫度都影響束流穩定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「柵極離子源與中和器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

離子束修形把束流功率的大部分變成工件的熱：1 keV 離子停在表面下僅 2 到 3 nm，能量以熱的形式沉積，而玻璃的熱導率只有約 1.3 W/(m·K)，真空中又只能靠輻射與夾具傳導散熱，所以大型工件在長時間修形中會升溫數十度。材料對濺射的反應也不同：熔融石英為均質玻璃，修形後粗糙度幾乎不變；微晶玻璃含有奈米級結晶相與玻璃相，兩相濺射速率不同，深度去除後粗糙度可能從 0.3 nm 上升到 1 nm 等級，因此前段拋光必須先把誤差壓到數百奈米以內以限制去除深度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基板材料與熱負載」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

修形的輸入是干涉儀量到的面形誤差圖，它必須以基準記號或邊緣偵測對位到機台的掃描座標，位置誤差會乘上局部斜率變成去除誤差。去除函數必須在每次修形前以靜止凹坑實測，而不是沿用舊值，因為柵極老化、氣流與工作距離變化都會改變峰值速率與寬度。干涉儀本身的重複性、參考面誤差與空氣擾動設定了可達到的面形下限，所以量測需平均多幀並扣除參考面。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「干涉儀誤差圖與機台座標對位」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

一次修形後的殘差來自幾個互相獨立的來源：量測重複性、去除率漂移乘以去除深度、對位誤差乘以斜率、反卷積無法修正的中頻成分，以及工件邊緣束流溢出造成的邊緣效應。因為各項獨立，總殘差以均方根相加；去除率與對位項正比於本次去除深度，所以第二次迭代時它們自動縮小，最後收斂到由中頻與量測底限決定的平台。理解這個結構才能判斷再多做一次迭代是否值得。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「修形誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

離子束修形位於製程鏈的末端：研磨與傳統拋光先給出低粗糙度與受控的中頻，磁流變或小工具拋光把面形壓到數百奈米，最後才由離子束做奈米級收斂，之後清洗、鍍膜。掃描策略決定邊緣處理：為了讓邊緣也獲得正確去除，駐留時間圖必須延伸到工件外一到兩個束寬，這段溢出時間是純粹的成本。修形後工件溫度高於環境，低膨脹材料雖然變形小，但量測仍需等待熱平衡，否則面形圖內含熱梯度項。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收不是只看一個 PV 數字：規格通常以波長分數給出，必須換算成表面 RMS 並說明是否已扣除傾斜與離焦、使用的濾波頻寬與取樣密度。反射鏡的表面誤差在波前上加倍，Maréchal 判準給出 Strehl 0.8 所需的波前 RMS 約 λ/14，可反推表面容許值。交接資料包應包含最終面形圖與 Zernike 係數、各頻段 PSD、修形前後粗糙度、去除函數校正紀錄、駐留時間圖與總去除深度，以及鍍膜前清洗建議，讓下游能追溯每一項數據的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收報告與交接資料包」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Ion-beam figuring bombards the optical surface with argon ions of roughly 0.5 to 1.5 keV; each ion transfers momentum to near-surface atoms, starting a collision cascade in which some atoms gain enough energy to leave the surface. The mean number of atoms ejected per incident ion is the sputter yield Y, about 1 atom per ion for fused silica near 1 keV, so removal depth is set only by ion flux, yield and atomic density. With no mechanical contact there is no pressure-driven edge effect and no tool wear; the process runs in vacuum and removal is predictable in nanometres. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The removal distribution of the beam on the workpiece is the beam removal function, usually near Gaussian with a full width at half maximum set by grid optics and working distance, about 3 to 30 mm. During figuring the beam scans the surface at constant power, and actual removal equals the two-dimensional convolution of the removal function with the dwell-time map, so the error map must be deconvolved into a non-negative dwell map with Richardson–Lucy or non-negative least squares. A Gaussian is also Gaussian in the frequency domain, so errors with periods shorter than the beam width are barely correctable; ion-beam figuring therefore handles low-frequency figure only, and mid and high frequencies must be controlled by the preceding polish. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The heart of the machine is a Kaufman-type gridded ion source: a discharge chamber ionises argon with a filament or RF antenna, the potential between screen and accelerator grids extracts and accelerates ions to the set energy, and the alignment and gap of the two grids set beam divergence and removal-function width. A hot-filament or plasma-bridge neutralizer injects electrons into the beam so the insulating glass workpiece does not charge and deflect it. The chamber operates near 10⁻⁴ mbar, low enough that ions rarely collide before reaching the part; vacuum quality, gas flow and grid temperature all affect beam stability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gridded ion source and neutralizer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Most beam power ends up as heat in the workpiece: 1 keV ions stop only 2 to 3 nm below the surface and deposit their energy thermally, while glass conducts only about 1.3 W/(m·K) and in vacuum can shed heat only by radiation and conduction into the fixture, so a large part warms by tens of kelvin during a long run. Materials also respond differently: fused silica is homogeneous and keeps its roughness, whereas glass ceramic contains nanometre crystallites and a glassy phase that sputter at different rates, so deep removal can raise roughness from 0.3 nm toward 1 nm; the preceding polish must therefore bring the error within a few hundred nanometres to limit removal depth. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Substrate material and thermal load”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The input to figuring is the interferometric error map, which must be registered to the machine scan coordinates with fiducials or edge detection; a position error multiplied by the local slope becomes a removal error. The removal function must be re-measured with a stationary crater before every run rather than reused, because grid ageing, gas flow and working-distance changes alter both peak rate and width. Interferometer repeatability, reference-surface error and air turbulence set the attainable figure floor, so measurements are averaged over many frames with the reference subtracted. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Interferometer error map and machine registration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The residual after one run comes from several independent sources: measurement repeatability, rate drift times removal depth, registration error times slope, the mid-spatial-frequency content that deconvolution cannot correct, and the edge effect from beam overrun at the part boundary. Being independent, they add root-sum-square; the rate and registration terms scale with the removal depth of that run, so they shrink automatically in the second iteration, and the process converges to a floor set by mid-frequency content and the metrology limit. Understanding this structure tells you whether another iteration is worth running. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Figuring error budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Ion-beam figuring sits at the end of the chain: grinding and conventional polishing deliver low roughness and controlled mid-frequency, magnetorheological or small-tool polishing brings figure to a few hundred nanometres, and only then does the ion beam provide nanometre convergence, followed by cleaning and coating. The scan strategy governs edge handling: for correct removal at the rim the dwell map must extend one to two beam widths beyond the part, and that overrun time is pure cost. After the run the part is warmer than ambient; even a low-expansion material must settle thermally before measurement or the map contains a thermal-gradient term. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Process chain and thermal settling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance is more than one PV number: specifications are usually given as a wavelength fraction and must be converted to surface RMS with a statement of whether tilt and focus were removed, the filter bandwidth and the sampling density. A mirror's surface error doubles in the wavefront, and the Maréchal criterion requires about λ/14 RMS wavefront for a Strehl ratio of 0.8, from which the surface allowance follows. The handoff package should contain the final map with Zernike coefficients, band-limited PSDs, roughness before and after, the removal-function calibration record, the dwell map and total removal depth, plus a pre-coating cleaning recommendation, so downstream users can trace every figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance report and handoff package”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfallsEn: Applying a removal rate measured on fused silica to silicon carbide or glass ceramic lets the yield difference desynchronise actual removal from the dwell map; the figure fails to converge and leaves a residual shaped like the original error map.

Reusing last month's removal function after the grids have aged, with the peak rate 15% lower, leaves a residual shaped like the original map, only smaller; a mirrored error map doubles the error instead of removing it.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：磁流變光學拋光
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Magnetorheological optical finishing
guides.concept: 從羰基鐵粒子在磁場中成鏈、形成具降伏應力的流體帶談起，用 Preston 關係與 D 形去除點建立磁流變拋光的去除模型，再把拋光輪、流體黏度閉迴路、工件材料與次表面損傷、干涉量測與去除點校正、誤差預算，直到清洗與驗收交接，整合成一條可重複的非球面修形流程。
guides.conceptEn: Start with carbonyl-iron particles chaining in a magnetic field into a ribbon with a yield stress, model removal with the Preston relation and the D-shaped spot, then integrate the wheel, fluid-viscosity loop, workpiece materials and subsurface damage, interferometry and spot calibration, error budget, cleaning and acceptance into a repeatable aspheric figuring process.
procedure: 磁流變液是水基懸浮液，含有直徑約 4 µm 的羰基鐵粒子、拋光用的氧化鈰或奈米鑽石磨料以及穩定劑。無磁場時它是黏度約 0.5 Pa·s 的流體，可被泵送到旋轉輪面；進入電磁鐵上方約 0.2 到 0.4 T 的區域後，鐵粒子沿磁力線成鏈，流體在毫秒內變成具有降伏應力的賓漢塑性體，形成一條硬化的「流體帶」。工件以約 0.5 mm 的深度浸入帶中，磨料被磁場梯度推向帶的表面，材料去除由這個受控的剪切流決定，而不是由硬質拋光工具的壓力決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

材料去除率遵循 Preston 關係：單位時間去除深度正比於介面應力與相對速度的乘積，比例常數 k_p 由材料、磨料與化學環境決定。工件靜止在流體帶中時，去除集中在一個 D 形的去除點，長軸沿輪面運動方向約 10 mm、寬約 4 mm，深度分佈由帶內剪切應力與磨料分佈決定。去除點是整個修形的單位脈衝：工件沿螺旋或光柵軌跡移動，實際去除等於去除點函數與駐留時間的卷積，去除點一旦量準，修形便是確定性的。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「D 形去除點與 Preston 關係」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

機台把流體從調節槽泵到噴嘴，鋪在直徑約 150 mm 的旋轉輪面上，流過電磁鐵極靴上方的工作區後被刮刀回收，回到調節槽重新混合與控溫。因為水會蒸發、鐵粒子會氧化，調節迴路用流量與壓降推算黏度，並自動補水把黏度維持在設定值，這是去除率穩定的關鍵。工件由多軸數控平台握持，三軸機可修平面與淺曲面，修非球面與自由曲面需五軸讓表面法線始終對準流體帶。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「拋光輪、噴嘴與流體調節迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

不同材料的 Preston 常數差異很大：矽酸鹽玻璃配氧化鈰去除快，熔融石英較慢，藍寶石與碳化矽需要奈米鑽石磨料且去除率低一個數量級。磁流變拋光的法向載荷小、以剪切為主，因此不會產生新的次表面損傷，反而能去除前段研磨與拋光留下的微裂紋層，表面粗糙度可達 0.5 到 1 nm RMS。對軟質或水溶性晶體，流體的水基環境與化學作用必須另外評估，否則會出現腐蝕紋或霧化。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「工件材料與次表面損傷層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

修形迴路的輸入是干涉儀的面形圖：球面用參考球面直接量，非球面需電腦全像（CGH）零檢鏡或子孔徑拼接，自由曲面則用拼接或輪廓儀。量測圖必須對位到機台座標，機台用工件邊緣與基準記號定位，位置誤差乘上局部斜率成為去除誤差。每次修形前先在工件本身或同材料試片上打一個去除點並量測，取得當天的峰值去除率與點形，去除率的日漂移通常為百分之幾，這就是校正不能省略的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「干涉儀與去除點校正紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

一次修形後的殘差由獨立項的均方根組成：去除率漂移乘以去除深度、量測重複性、對位誤差乘以斜率，以及去除點沿軌跡變化留下的中頻紋理。因為去除點寬度只有幾毫米，光柵或螺旋軌跡的步距若接近點寬會留下週期性波紋，步距小於點寬的一半時波紋被去除點本身平滑掉。磁流變拋光通常每次迭代可把低頻面形縮小 5 到 10 倍，但中頻紋理決定了收斂平台，必要時由後續小步距的「平滑」趟次或離子束處理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「修形誤差預算與中頻紋理」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

磁流變拋光接在精磨或傳統拋光之後：前段提供可量測的面形與受控的粗糙度，磁流變負責去除損傷層與確定性修形，之後視規格再接離子束。因為去除靠剪切流，工件邊緣沒有壓力式工具的塌邊，但軌跡仍需讓去除點完整越過邊緣以維持均勻性。修形後工件表面殘留鐵粒子與乾涸流體，必須在數分鐘內用去離子水沖洗並以適當清潔程序處理，否則鐵鏽斑與水痕會在鍍膜前留下缺陷；鏡片的斜面與邊緣也需檢查是否有流體殘留。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「製程鏈、邊緣處理與清洗」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

透鏡表面誤差對穿透波前的影響是 (n − 1) 倍，反射面則是 2 倍，驗收前必須把表面 RMS 換算成系統要求的波前量，並註明是否扣除傾斜、離焦與使用的空間濾波。交接資料應包含最終面形圖與 Zernike 係數、分頻段 PSD、修形前後粗糙度、去除點校正紀錄、流體批號與黏度日誌、總去除深度與清洗紀錄，使鍍膜與組裝端能評估殘留風險。獨立儀器的複測是驗收的核心，而不是只核對機台自己的量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收報告與穿透波前換算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: An MR fluid is a water-based suspension of roughly 4 µm carbonyl-iron particles, cerium-oxide or nanodiamond polishing abrasive and stabilisers. Without a field it is a liquid of about 0.5 Pa·s that can be pumped onto a rotating wheel; above the electromagnet, in a field of about 0.2 to 0.4 T, the iron particles chain along field lines and within milliseconds the fluid becomes a Bingham plastic with a yield stress, forming a stiffened ribbon. The workpiece is immersed about 0.5 mm into the ribbon, the field gradient pushes abrasive toward the ribbon surface, and removal is governed by this controlled shear flow rather than by the pressure of a hard tool. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “MR ribbon and electromagnet”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Removal follows the Preston relation: depth removed per unit time is proportional to the product of interfacial stress and relative velocity, with a constant k_p set by material, abrasive and chemistry. With the part held still in the ribbon the removal concentrates in a D-shaped spot about 10 mm long along the wheel motion and 4 mm wide, its depth profile set by the shear stress and abrasive distribution in the ribbon. The spot is the unit impulse of the whole process: the part moves along a spiral or raster path, actual removal equals the convolution of the spot function with dwell time, and once the spot is measured the figuring is deterministic. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “D-shaped removal spot and the Preston relation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The machine pumps fluid from a conditioning tank to a nozzle, lays it on a rotating wheel of about 150 mm diameter, carries it through the working zone above the electromagnet pole pieces, scrapes it off and returns it to the tank for remixing and temperature control. Because water evaporates and iron oxidises, the loop infers viscosity from flow and pressure drop and adds water automatically to hold the setpoint, which is the key to a stable removal rate. A multi-axis CNC stage holds the part; three axes suffice for flats and shallow curves, while aspheres and freeforms need five axes to keep the surface normal aligned to the ribbon. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wheel, nozzle and fluid-conditioning loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Preston constants differ widely between materials: silicate glass with cerium oxide removes quickly, fused silica more slowly, and sapphire or silicon carbide need nanodiamond abrasive with rates an order of magnitude lower. Because MRF applies a small normal load and works by shear, it creates no new subsurface damage and instead strips the microcrack layer left by earlier grinding and polishing, reaching 0.5 to 1 nm RMS roughness. For soft or water-soluble crystals the aqueous chemistry of the fluid must be assessed separately or etch texture and haze appear. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Workpiece material and subsurface-damage layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The loop's input is an interferometric map: spheres are measured against a reference sphere, aspheres need a computer-generated-hologram null or sub-aperture stitching, and freeforms use stitching or profilometry. The map must be registered to machine coordinates using the part edge and fiducials, since position error times local slope becomes removal error. Before each run a spot is made and measured on the part itself or a witness of the same material to obtain that day's peak rate and spot shape; day-to-day drift of a few percent is why calibration cannot be skipped. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Interferometer and spot-calibration record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The post-run residual is the root-sum-square of independent terms: rate drift times removal depth, measurement repeatability, registration error times slope, and the mid-frequency texture left by spot variation along the path. Because the spot is only a few millimetres wide, a raster or spiral pitch close to the spot width leaves periodic ripple, while a pitch below half the spot width is smoothed by the spot itself. MRF typically shrinks low-frequency figure by 5 to 10 times per iteration, but mid-frequency texture sets the convergence floor, handled if needed by a fine-pitch smoothing pass or ion-beam finishing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Figuring error budget and mid-frequency texture”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

MRF follows fine grinding or conventional polishing: the earlier stages supply a measurable figure and controlled roughness, MRF removes the damage layer and performs deterministic figuring, and ion-beam finishing may follow depending on specification. Because removal is by shear flow there is no pressure-tool edge roll, but the path must still carry the spot fully across the edge for uniformity. After the run the surface holds iron particles and drying fluid; it must be rinsed with deionised water within minutes and cleaned by a suitable procedure, or rust spots and water marks become coating defects, and bevels and edges must be checked for trapped fluid. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Process chain, edge handling and cleaning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A lens surface error enters the transmitted wavefront (n − 1) times, a mirror surface 2 times, so before acceptance the surface RMS must be converted to the wavefront quantity the system requires, stating whether tilt and focus were removed and which spatial filter was used. The handoff package should contain the final map with Zernike coefficients, band-limited PSDs, roughness before and after, the spot-calibration record, fluid batch and viscosity log, total removal depth and cleaning record, so coating and assembly can judge residual risk. Re-measurement on an independent instrument is the core of acceptance, not a check of the machine's own data. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance report and transmitted-wavefront conversion”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfallsEn: Oxidised iron particles or a change in water content shift yield stress and viscosity, the spot depth drifts by more than 10% within a day, and a dwell map run with the old calibration leaves a residual shaped like the error map.

A misaligned CGH null produces false coma that is figured out as if it were real, so the finished surface carries a coma of opposite sign, discovered only when acceptance is run on a different instrument.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Optical interference coatings
guides.concept: 從單層膜的 Fresnel 振幅相加出發，用特徵矩陣與導納轉換推導四分之一波堆的反射率與阻帶寬度，再討論氧化物與氟化物材料、蒸鍍與濺鍍的微結構差異、石英晶體與光學監控、分光光度驗證與逆向工程、入射角與環境造成的光譜位移，直到均勻性夾具、環境測試與驗收交接。
guides.conceptEn: Beginning with Fresnel amplitudes adding in a single film, derive quarter-wave-stack reflectance and stop-band width with the characteristic matrix and admittance transformation, then cover oxide and fluoride materials, the microstructural difference between evaporated and sputtered films, quartz-crystal and optical monitoring, spectrophotometric verification and reverse engineering, spectral shifts with incidence angle and environment, and finally uniformity fixtures, environmental testing and acceptance handoff.
procedure: 一層厚度 d、折射率 n₁ 的透明薄膜有兩個界面，各自依 Fresnel 公式反射一部分振幅；兩束反射光的相位差由光程 2n₁d·cosθ 決定，彼此可以相消或相加。當光學厚度 n₁d 等於四分之一波長時，兩個界面的反射相位相反，若 n₁ 介於入射介質與基板之間反射率下降，若 n₁ 高於基板反射率反而上升；光學厚度為半波時薄膜「隱形」，反射率回到裸基板值。這個單層結果是所有干涉鍍膜的基本單元，也說明為何同一層膜在不同波長下行為完全不同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單層膜的兩個界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

多層膜用每層的 2×2 特徵矩陣連乘來計算，矩陣元素只含該層的折射率與相位厚度，整個膜系在入射側呈現一個等效導納 Y，反射率就是 [(n₀ − Y)/(n₀ + Y)]²。四分之一波層的矩陣特別簡單：它把後方的導納 Y 轉成 n²/Y，所以高低折射率交替的 (HL)ᴺ 堆每加一對就把導納乘上 (n_H/n_L)²，反射率隨對數迅速逼近 1。阻帶寬度只由折射率比決定，與層數無關；層數只決定阻帶內的反射率深度與帶邊陡度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四分之一波堆與導納」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

可見與近紅外鍍膜以氧化物為主：SiO₂（1.46）作低折射率層，Al₂O₃（1.63）、HfO₂（1.95）、Ta₂O₅（2.10）、Nb₂O₅（2.30）與 TiO₂（2.35）作高折射率層；紫外區要避開 TiO₂ 與 Ta₂O₅ 的吸收邊，改用 HfO₂ 或氟化物如 MgF₂（1.38）與 LaF₃；紅外區則用 ZnS、Ge、YbF₃。材料選擇同時受吸收係數、應力、硬度與與基板的附著力限制。蒸鍍膜常呈柱狀多孔結構，堆積密度 0.8 到 0.9，孔隙吸水後折射率上升、光譜紅移；離子輔助或濺鍍能把密度推近 1，光譜才能穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氧化物與氟化物膜材」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

電子束蒸鍍的原子到達能量只有約 0.1 eV，形成柱狀多孔膜，加上離子輔助（IAD）能把密度提高；磁控濺鍍與離子束濺鍍（IBS）的到達能量為數 eV 到數十 eV，膜層緻密、非晶且損耗最低，但 IBS 速率僅約 0.1 nm/s；原子層沉積以自限反應逐層生長，共形性最好但更慢。厚度監控有兩類：石英晶體微天平依 Sauerbrey 關係把質量變化轉成頻率變化，需要校正「工具因子」把晶體位置換算到基板位置；光學監控直接看監控片在控制波長的穿透或反射率，在四分之一波轉折點停止，具有自我補償誤差的特性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鍍膜完成後用分光光度計量穿透率與反射率光譜，絕對精度約 0.1% 到 0.3%，再與設計曲線比對；差異可用逆向工程把各層厚度與折射率當成未知數擬合，找出是哪一層、哪一種誤差造成偏移。損耗以 1 − R − T 分解成吸收與散射，吸收由光熱或光腔衰盪法量到 ppm 等級，散射由總積分散射儀取得。對窄帶濾光片，中心波長對光學厚度極度敏感，所以驗證必須同時說明量測的波長準確度與光束發散角。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「分光光度計與逆向工程」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

薄膜的相位厚度含 cosθ 因子，入射角增加時每層的有效光學厚度變小，整個光譜向短波移動；位移量由一個等效折射率決定，高折射率膜系位移較小。斜入射時 s 與 p 偏振的 Fresnel 係數不同，阻帶寬度與帶邊位置分裂，45° 的分光鏡必須分別對兩個偏振設計。公差預算把厚度、折射率、均勻性與入射角誤差各自換算成波長位移，以均方根相加，再與規格的帶邊容差比較，決定哪一項必須被製程或量測收緊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鍍膜腔內的沉積速率隨位置變化：點狀蒸發源向上方平面沉積的厚度隨離軸距離下降，因此基板放在旋轉的行星轉架上並加上修正遮罩，把全批的厚度差壓到 0.5% 以內；濺鍍系統則靠靶材與基板幾何及公轉達到相同目的。每一批放入與產品同材料的見證片，用於光譜、附著與環境測試。環境耐久依 ISO 9211 或軍規序列進行：濕熱、鹽霧、溫度循環、膠帶附著與橡皮擦磨耗，確認膜層不會起泡、龜裂或脫落。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鍍膜規格必須同時指定波段、入射角範圍、偏振、基板材料、穿透或反射的平均值與極值，以及環境等級與（若適用）雷射損傷門檻；缺少任一項，驗收就沒有依據。因為量測有不確定度，驗收必須設保護帶：量測值必須比規格好於量測不確定度的範圍才能判定合格。交接資料包含設計層結構摘要（不含製程配方）、見證片光譜、逆向工程結果、均勻性分佈、環境測試報告與批次編號，讓系統整合端能追溯每片元件的鍍膜狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A transparent film of thickness d and index n₁ has two interfaces, each reflecting part of the amplitude according to the Fresnel equations; the phase difference between the two reflected waves is set by the path 2n₁d·cosθ, so they can cancel or reinforce. When the optical thickness n₁d equals a quarter wavelength the two reflections are in antiphase: reflectance drops if n₁ lies between the incident medium and substrate, but rises if n₁ exceeds the substrate index; at half-wave thickness the film is absentee and reflectance returns to the bare-substrate value. This single-layer result is the basic unit of every interference coating and shows why one film behaves completely differently at different wavelengths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The two interfaces of a single film”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A multilayer is computed by multiplying the 2×2 characteristic matrix of each layer, whose elements contain only that layer's index and phase thickness; the whole stack presents an equivalent admittance Y on the incident side, and reflectance is [(n₀ − Y)/(n₀ + Y)]². A quarter-wave layer has an especially simple matrix: it transforms the admittance behind it, Y, into n²/Y, so each added pair of an alternating (HL)ᴺ stack multiplies the admittance by (n_H/n_L)² and reflectance approaches 1 rapidly with pair count. The stop-band width depends only on the index ratio, not on the layer count; the count sets only the reflectance depth inside the band and the edge steepness. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quarter-wave stack and admittance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Visible and near-infrared coatings rely mainly on oxides: SiO₂ (1.46) as the low-index layer and Al₂O₃ (1.63), HfO₂ (1.95), Ta₂O₅ (2.10), Nb₂O₅ (2.30) or TiO₂ (2.35) as high-index layers; in the ultraviolet the absorption edges of TiO₂ and Ta₂O₅ must be avoided in favour of HfO₂ or fluorides such as MgF₂ (1.38) and LaF₃, while the infrared uses ZnS, Ge and YbF₃. The choice is also bounded by absorption coefficient, stress, hardness and adhesion to the substrate. Evaporated films are often columnar and porous with packing density 0.8 to 0.9; water filling the pores raises the index and red-shifts the spectrum, and only ion assistance or sputtering pushes density toward 1 so the spectrum stays stable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Oxide and fluoride film materials”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Electron-beam evaporation delivers adatoms with only about 0.1 eV, producing columnar porous films, and ion-assisted deposition raises their density; magnetron and ion-beam sputtering arrive with several to tens of eV, giving dense amorphous films with the lowest loss, though IBS runs at only about 0.1 nm/s; atomic layer deposition grows self-limiting monolayers with the best conformality but is slower still. Thickness monitoring comes in two kinds: a quartz-crystal microbalance converts mass change into frequency change through the Sauerbrey relation and needs a calibrated tooling factor to map crystal position to substrate position, while optical monitoring watches the transmittance or reflectance of a witness at a control wavelength and stops at the quarter-wave turning point, which self-compensates thickness errors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve; the difference is fitted by reverse engineering, treating layer thicknesses and indices as unknowns, to find which layer and which error type caused the deviation. Loss is decomposed as 1 − R − T into absorption and scatter, absorption measured to ppm by photothermal or cavity ring-down methods and scatter by total-integrated-scatter instruments. For narrowband filters the centre wavelength is extremely sensitive to optical thickness, so verification must state the wavelength accuracy and beam divergence of the measurement. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The phase thickness of a film carries a cosθ factor, so as incidence angle grows every layer's effective optical thickness shrinks and the whole spectrum moves to shorter wavelengths; the shift is governed by an effective index, with high-index stacks shifting less. At oblique incidence the s and p Fresnel coefficients differ, so stop-band width and edge positions split, and a 45° beam splitter must be designed for each polarization separately. The tolerance budget converts thickness, index, uniformity and angle errors into wavelength shifts, adds them root-sum-square and compares the total with the specified edge tolerance to decide which term the process or metrology must tighten. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Deposition rate inside a chamber varies with position: a point-like evaporation source coats a plane above it with thickness falling off-axis, so substrates ride on a rotating planetary fixture with correction masks to hold the batch thickness spread within 0.5%, while sputtering systems reach the same goal through target-substrate geometry and planetary motion. Each batch carries witness samples of the same material as the product for spectral, adhesion and environmental tests. Durability follows ISO 9211 or military-specification sequences: humidity, salt fog, temperature cycling, tape adhesion and eraser abrasion, confirming that the film neither blisters, cracks nor delaminates. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A coating specification must state band, incidence-angle range, polarization, substrate material, average and extreme transmittance or reflectance, environmental class and, where relevant, laser-damage threshold; missing any item leaves acceptance without a basis. Because measurements carry uncertainty, acceptance needs a guard band: the measured value must beat the specification by the measurement uncertainty before a pass is declared. The handoff package holds a design summary of the layer structure (not the process recipe), witness spectra, reverse-engineering results, uniformity map, environmental test report and batch numbers so the system integrator can trace each element's coating state. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把高折射率單層誤當成增透膜鍍在透鏡上，反射率反而由 4% 升到 30%，整組鏡頭的穿透率與鬼影同時惡化。

pitfallsEn: Depositing a high-index single layer as if it were an antireflection film raises reflectance from 4% to 30%, degrading lens transmission and ghost images together.

Measuring a narrowband filter with a 3° divergent beam broadens the passband and blue-shifts it through the effective incidence angle, rejecting good parts; measuring transmission only and attributing the missing light to scatter sends the investigation after roughness when the real cause is absorption.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：增透膜設計與沉積
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Antireflection coating design and deposition
guides.concept: 從 Fresnel 反射與多片鏡頭的穿透率損失出發，用導納匹配條件推導 MgF₂ 單層、四分之一波雙層 V 膜與四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜的殘餘反射率，再討論低折射率膜材與熱基板蒸鍍、透鏡上的厚度分佈、低反射率量測的背面陷阱、入射角與偏振的影響，最後把殘餘反射換算成鏡頭鬼影與穿透率預算並完成驗收交接。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from Fresnel reflection and the transmission loss of multi-element lenses, derive the residual reflectance of a MgF₂ single layer, a quarter-quarter V-coat and a quarter-half-quarter broadband design from the admittance-matching condition, then cover low-index materials and hot-substrate evaporation, thickness distribution on lenses, the back-surface trap in low-reflectance metrology, incidence-angle and polarization effects, and finally convert residual reflectance into lens ghost and transmission budgets for acceptance handoff.
procedure: 每個空氣與玻璃的界面在正向入射時依 Fresnel 公式反射 [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² 的能量，BK7 約 4.3%。一支十片透鏡的鏡頭有二十個這樣的界面，未鍍膜時穿透率只剩四成，而且任意兩個界面反射的光會再度抵達像面形成鬼影，其強度正比於兩個反射率的乘積。增透膜的任務就是把每個界面的反射率壓到千分之幾，使穿透率回到九成以上，並把鬼影強度降低兩個數量級；因此增透膜的規格必須從系統的穿透率與雜散光預算倒推，而不是單獨追求某一波長的零反射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多片鏡頭的二十個空氣界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

增透的條件是讓膜系在入射側的等效導納等於入射介質的折射率。四分之一波單層把基板導納 n_s 轉成 n₁²/n_s，要完全匹配空氣需要 n₁ = √n_s，對 BK7 是 1.23，沒有這麼低的緻密材料，最接近的 MgF₂（1.38）只能把反射率降到 1.3%。雙層四分之一波設計用內層的高折射率把基板導納先抬高、再由外層 MgF₂ 拉回 1，條件是 n₂/n₁ = √n_s；這種設計在單一波長達到近零反射而兩側迅速上升，光譜呈 V 形，因此稱為 V 膜，適合雷射線寬的應用。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「MgF₂ 單層與四分之一波雙層 V 膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

寬帶增透的經典三層結構由基板側起為四分之一波 Al₂O₃、半波 ZrO₂ 與四分之一波 MgF₂：半波層在設計波長是「隱形」的，不改變中心反射率，但在偏離中心的波長上它改變導納軌跡的曲率，把兩側的反射率壓平，使可見光全波段平均降到 0.2% 等級。再往上走是四到八層的 TiO₂/SiO₂ 或 Nb₂O₅/SiO₂ 最佳化設計，可把 400 到 700 nm 的平均反射率壓到 0.2% 以下並延伸到近紅外，代價是總厚度、應力與對厚度誤差的敏感度上升。層數的選擇是光譜寬度、角度容忍度、製程能力與成本之間的平衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

增透膜的最外層必須是低折射率材料，可見光區幾乎只有 MgF₂ 與 SiO₂ 可選。MgF₂ 以熱蒸鍍或電子束蒸鍍沉積，基板必須加熱到 250 °C 以上才能得到緻密、附著良好且耐擦拭的膜，冷基板上的 MgF₂ 疏鬆、吸濕且一擦就花。玻璃透鏡可以承受加熱，但塑膠透鏡只能在 80 °C 以下處理，必須改用離子輔助蒸鍍或濺鍍 SiO₂ 並加上附著層。加熱沉積後冷卻時，膜與基板的熱膨脹差異在膜內留下張應力，厚膜系會因此龜裂，這是寬帶多層增透膜總厚度受限的原因之一。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱基板蒸鍍與低折射率膜材」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

量 0.2% 的反射率比量 99% 的反射率困難得多，因為任何雜散光與基板背面的反射都會淹沒訊號。平行平板試片若只有正面鍍膜，背面的 4.3% 反射會穿過正面進入偵測器，量到的總反射率幾乎全是背面貢獻；所以量測前必須把背面磨粗並塗黑，或使用楔形試片把背面反射偏離光路，或以穿透率反推。絕對反射率需要 V-W 型附件，用同一面鏡子在兩種幾何下的比值消去鏡面反射率；光度刻度則以 NIST 可追溯的反射率標準校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「V-W 反射率附件與背面處理」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

增透膜在斜入射時有兩個效應：各層有效光學厚度隨 cosθ 縮短使最低點向短波移動，以及 s 與 p 偏振的導納分離使兩者的殘餘反射率不再相同，s 偏振通常惡化得更快。V 膜因為頻寬窄，對角度與厚度誤差都比寬帶膜敏感；寬帶膜在 30° 內仍能維持接近正向的平均反射率。公差分析要把製程厚度散佈、折射率散佈與使用角度範圍一起放進蒙地卡羅，算出平均反射率的分佈，而不是只看設計點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「入射角與厚度誤差的敏感度表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

蒸鍍的膜厚與表面相對於蒸氣流的傾角有關，近似隨 cosφ 下降，陡峭透鏡的邊緣會比中心薄；增透膜的最低點因此在邊緣向短波移動，殘餘反射率沿口徑變化。夾具設計用傾斜的鏡片座、遮罩或把鏡片放在行星轉架的特定半徑來補償，或把設計中心波長略向長波偏移讓邊緣落回波段內。整合到鏡頭時還要處理膠合面（膠的折射率接近玻璃，反射率只有萬分之幾，不需鍍膜）、邊緣塗黑以吸收內反射，以及雷射系統中增透膜的損傷門檻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「透鏡夾具與邊緣厚度衰減」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

增透膜的規格應寫成「在指定波段與角度範圍內的平均與最大反射率」，並註明單面或雙面、基板折射率、偏振，以及耐久等級：依 ISO 9211 或軍規的磨耗、附著、濕熱與鹽霧序列。驗收時用塗黑背面的見證片量反射率，並把每面的實測值代回系統模型計算鏡頭穿透率與主要鬼影，與系統預算比較。交接資料包括各面的膜型（V 膜或寬帶）、設計波長、見證片光譜、耐久測試結果與批號，使鏡頭裝配與雷射系統端能追溯每個面的狀態與清潔方式限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「增透膜規格表與鏡頭穿透率預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: At normal incidence each air-glass interface reflects a fraction [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² of the energy by the Fresnel equations, about 4.3% for BK7. A ten-element lens has twenty such interfaces, so uncoated it transmits only about forty percent, and light reflected by any two interfaces reaches the image again as a ghost whose intensity scales with the product of the two reflectances. The job of an antireflection film is to push each interface to a few tenths of a percent, restoring transmission above ninety percent and cutting ghost intensity by two orders of magnitude; the coating specification therefore follows from the system's transmission and stray-light budget rather than from zero reflectance at one wavelength. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Twenty air-glass interfaces of a multi-element lens”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The antireflection condition is that the stack's equivalent admittance on the incident side equals the index of the incident medium. A quarter-wave single layer transforms the substrate admittance n_s into n₁²/n_s, so matching air requires n₁ = √n_s, about 1.23 for BK7; no dense material is that low, and the closest, MgF₂ at 1.38, only brings reflectance down to 1.3%. A two-layer quarter-quarter design uses a higher-index inner layer to raise the substrate admittance first and the outer MgF₂ layer to bring it back to 1, with the condition n₂/n₁ = √n_s; it reaches near-zero reflectance at one wavelength and rises quickly on both sides, giving the V-shaped spectrum that names the V-coat and suits laser-line applications. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “MgF₂ single layer and quarter-quarter V-coat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The classic three-layer broadband structure, from the substrate side, is a quarter-wave Al₂O₃, a half-wave ZrO₂ and a quarter-wave MgF₂: the half-wave layer is absentee at the design wavelength and leaves the central reflectance unchanged, but away from centre it alters the curvature of the admittance path and flattens the reflectance on both sides, bringing the visible-band average to the 0.2% level. Beyond that, four- to eight-layer optimised TiO₂/SiO₂ or Nb₂O₅/SiO₂ designs push the 400 to 700 nm average below 0.2% and extend into the near infrared, at the cost of total thickness, stress and sensitivity to thickness error. Choosing the layer count balances spectral width, angular tolerance, process capability and cost. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quarter-half-quarter broadband design”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The outermost antireflection layer must be a low-index material, and in the visible there are essentially only MgF₂ and SiO₂. MgF₂ is deposited by thermal or electron-beam evaporation with the substrate heated above 250 °C to obtain a dense, well-adhered, wipe-resistant film; on a cold substrate MgF₂ is porous, hygroscopic and scratches at the first wipe. Glass lenses tolerate heating, but polymer lenses must stay below 80 °C, forcing ion-assisted evaporation or sputtered SiO₂ with an adhesion layer. On cooling after hot deposition the thermal-expansion mismatch between film and substrate leaves tensile stress in the film, which cracks thick stacks and is one reason the total thickness of broadband multilayers is limited. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hot-substrate evaporation and low-index materials”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Measuring 0.2% reflectance is far harder than measuring 99%, because any stray light and the substrate's back-surface reflection swamp the signal. A plane-parallel witness coated only on the front lets the 4.3% back reflection pass through the front into the detector, so the measured total is almost entirely the back surface; the back must therefore be ground and blackened, a wedged witness used to steer the back reflection out of the path, or the front reflectance inferred from transmission. Absolute reflectance needs a V-W accessory, where the ratio of two geometries with the same mirror cancels the mirror's reflectance, and the photometric scale is calibrated with NIST-traceable reflectance standards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “V-W reflectance accessory and back-surface handling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

At oblique incidence an antireflection film shows two effects: each layer's effective optical thickness shrinks with cosθ, moving the minimum to shorter wavelengths, and the admittances for s and p polarization separate so their residual reflectances differ, with s usually degrading faster. A V-coat, being narrow, is more sensitive to both angle and thickness error than a broadband design, which keeps near-normal average reflectance out to about 30°. Tolerance analysis must put the process thickness spread, index spread and the range of use angles together into a Monte-Carlo run and report the distribution of average reflectance, not just the design point. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensitivity table for angle and thickness error”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Evaporated thickness depends on the surface tilt relative to the vapour stream, falling roughly as cosφ, so the rim of a steep lens receives less than the centre; the antireflection minimum therefore shifts to shorter wavelengths at the rim and the residual varies across the aperture. Fixture design compensates with tilted lens seats, masks or placement at a chosen planetary radius, or the design centre is biased slightly to longer wavelengths so the rim falls back into band. Integration into the lens also handles cemented interfaces, where the cement index is close to glass and reflectance is only a few parts in ten thousand with no coating needed, edge blackening to absorb internal reflections, and, in laser systems, the damage threshold of the antireflection film. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lens fixture and edge thickness fall-off”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An antireflection specification should read as average and maximum reflectance within a stated band and angle range, with single- or double-sided, substrate index, polarization and durability class per ISO 9211 or military abrasion, adhesion, humidity and salt-fog sequences. Acceptance measures witnesses with blackened backs and feeds each surface's measured value back into the system model to compute lens transmission and the main ghosts against the system budget. The handoff lists each surface's film type (V-coat or broadband), design wavelength, witness spectrum, durability results and batch number so lens assembly and laser-system users can trace every surface's state and cleaning limits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Antireflection specification sheet and lens transmission budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 只在 550 nm 要求零反射而忽略 450 nm 與 650 nm 的殘餘反射，鏡頭在白光下出現帶紫紅色的鬼影與偏色的穿透率，影像對比在藍與紅端下降。
未處理背面就量反射率，4.4% 的讀數讓合格的增透膜被判為失敗而整批重鍍；或用穿透率推算，0.1% 的不確定度把 0.18% 與 0.28% 混為一談，無法分辨製程漂移。
pitfallsEn: Demanding zero reflectance at 550 nm while ignoring the residual at 450 and 650 nm produces purple-tinted ghosts and a colour-biased transmission under white light, lowering contrast at the blue and red ends.

Measuring without treating the back yields 4.4% and condemns a good antireflection batch to recoating; inferring from transmission with 0.1% uncertainty cannot tell 0.18% from 0.28% and hides process drift.

guides.scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
