guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：高反射雷射鏡片
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: High-reflectivity laser mirrors
guides.concept: 雷射鏡片與一般高反射膜的差別在於損耗以 ppm 計、功率以損傷門檻計：本課從 1 − R = T + A + S 的損耗帳出發，分析四分之一波堆內的駐波場與損傷起點、超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷、離子束濺鍍與退火對吸收的要求，再用光腔衰盪、光熱吸收與 ISO 21254 損傷測試驗證，最後處理高功率熱效應、安裝污染與規格交接。
guides.conceptEn: A laser mirror differs from an ordinary high reflector in that loss is counted in ppm and power in damage threshold: starting from the loss ledger 1 − R = T + A + S, the course analyses the standing-wave field and damage origin inside a quarter-wave stack, superpolished substrates and nodular defects, ion-beam sputtering and annealing requirements for absorption, then verifies with cavity ring-down, photothermal absorption and ISO 21254 damage testing, and finishes with high-power thermal effects, mounting contamination and specification handoff.
procedure: 雷射鏡的反射率不是「越接近 1 越好」的單一數字，而是 1 − R = T + A + S 三項的總和：穿透 T 由膜堆的導納決定，可以靠加層數無限壓低；吸收 A 由材料的消光係數與膜內場分佈決定；散射 S 由基板與膜層的粗糙度與缺陷決定。離子束濺鍍的 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ 鏡可以把 A 與 S 各壓到 1 到 5 ppm，所以 T 低於幾個 ppm 之後再加層數已無意義，規格應改寫成「T ≤ 10 ppm、A ≤ 2 ppm、S ≤ 3 ppm」而不是「R ≥ 99.999%」。腔內功率數十 kW 的系統裡，幾個 ppm 的吸收就是數十 mW 的熱，這是損耗帳必須分項的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高反射堆前方的入射波與反射波形成駐波，進入膜堆後逐對衰減。以高折射率層結尾的四分之一波堆在空氣界面是波節，場強最大值落在第一個 H/L 界面，之後每深一對就乘上 (n_L/n_H)²，所以吸收與損傷幾乎都由最上面幾對決定。奈秒脈衝的損傷由缺陷吸收引發熱爆裂，飛秒脈衝則由多光子與雪崩游離主導，門檻隨材料能隙上升：SiO₂ 約 9 eV、HfO₂ 約 5.6 eV、Ta₂O₅ 約 4 eV、TiO₂ 約 3.3 eV，因此高損傷門檻鏡用 HfO₂/SiO₂，最低吸收鏡用 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「膜堆內的駐波場與第一個 H/L 界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鏡片的散射下限由基板粗糙度決定，膜層會複製基板的形貌。雷射鏡基板通常是熔融石英或低膨脹玻璃，經超拋光到 0.1 到 0.2 nm RMS，表面品質達 10-5 等級，並在潔淨室中清洗後立刻進入鍍膜腔。基板上任何殘留微粒在厚膜堆中會長成倒錐形的節瘤缺陷，節瘤直徑隨種子直徑與膜厚的乘積開平方增長，而節瘤邊界的場強集中使局部損傷門檻遠低於無缺陷區，所以損傷統計往往是由缺陷密度而非材料本質決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雷射鏡幾乎都以離子束濺鍍沉積：氬離子束轟擊 Ta 或 Ta₂O₅ 靶，濺出的原子帶著數 eV 能量到達基板，形成緻密、非晶、低散射的膜，腔內通入氧氣維持氧化物的化學計量，否則缺氧的 TaOₓ 會帶來 ppm 以上的吸收。沉積速率只有約 0.1 nm/s，一片 41 層、6 µm 的鏡需十幾小時，過程中靶材老化與氧分壓漂移都會改變折射率。鍍後在數百度退火可以降低吸收與機械損耗並釋放部分壓應力，是重力波探測器鏡片與高精度腔鏡的標準工序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子束濺鍍腔、氧分壓與退火爐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

分光光度計的絕對精度約 0.1%，等於 1000 ppm，對雷射鏡毫無用處。損耗必須用光腔衰盪量測：把兩片鏡組成光腔，注入雷射後突然關斷，腔內光強以指數衰減，時間常數由腔長與鏡片總損耗決定，測時間比測光強準得多。吸收另以光熱共路干涉或光熱偏折量測，把泵浦雷射造成的微小熱膨脹與折射率變化轉成訊號，校正後可達 0.1 ppm；散射以總積分散射儀收集半球內的散射光。三者分別量測再相加，才是完整的損耗帳。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光腔衰盪與光熱吸收量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

損傷門檻依 ISO 21254 以 1-on-1（每點一發）或 S-on-1（每點多發）測試，在多個能量密度各打數十點，統計損傷機率對能量密度的曲線，把機率外推到零得到門檻，並記錄波長、脈寬、光斑大小、重複率與損傷判定方法。門檻隨脈寬在奈秒熱擴散區近似以平方根縮放，隨波長近似線性，光斑越大掃到缺陷的機率越高而門檻越低；這些縮放只是估計，跨越物理機制（例如進入飛秒區）時完全失效。工程上以高斯光束的峰值能量密度與門檻比較，並留二到五倍的安全係數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ISO 21254 損傷測試與脈寬縮放表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

連續波高功率下，鏡片吸收的功率在光斑中心形成溫度峰，熱膨脹把表面頂成一個凸起，反射波前因此帶有離焦與球差，腔的穩定區隨功率漂移；基板熱導率越高、光斑越大，溫升越小。安裝時的夾持力會在面形上壓出像散，所以用三點運動學或撓性座並控制扭矩。污染是壽命殺手：鏡面吸附的碳氫化合物在紫外或高功率下碳化，形成吸收中心並降低門檻，真空或密閉腔內必須控制除氣材料並維持潔淨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雷射鏡規格表必須分項列出：工作波長與入射角、偏振、T、A、S 各自的上限與量測方法、損傷門檻及其測試條件、面形與表面品質、超快應用的群延遲色散、以及清潔方式限制。驗收以衰盪與光熱量測為準，並設保護帶。系統端把每片鏡的損耗代入腔的往返損耗，計算精細度與腔內功率增益，確認與設計一致。交接資料含鍍膜批號、見證片衰盪紀錄、損傷證書、退火紀錄與基板來源，使未來任何一片鏡的異常都能回溯到製程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A laser mirror's reflectance is not a single number to push toward 1 but the sum 1 − R = T + A + S: transmission T is set by the stack admittance and can be driven down without limit by adding layers; absorption A by the materials' extinction coefficients and the field distribution inside the stack; scatter S by substrate and film roughness and defects. Ion-beam-sputtered Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ mirrors reach A and S of 1 to 5 ppm each, so once T is below a few ppm further layers are pointless, and the specification should read T ≤ 10 ppm, A ≤ 2 ppm, S ≤ 3 ppm rather than R ≥ 99.999%. With tens of kilowatts circulating in a cavity, a few ppm of absorption is tens of milliwatts of heat, which is why the ledger must be itemised. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The incident and reflected waves in front of a high reflector form a standing wave that decays pair by pair inside the stack. A quarter-wave stack ending in a high-index layer has a node at the air interface, the field maximum sits at the first H/L interface, and each deeper pair multiplies the intensity by (n_L/n_H)², so absorption and damage are governed almost entirely by the top few pairs. Nanosecond damage is initiated by defect absorption and thermal explosion, while femtosecond damage is dominated by multiphoton and avalanche ionisation whose threshold rises with band gap: about 9 eV for SiO₂, 5.6 eV for HfO₂, 4 eV for Ta₂O₅ and 3.3 eV for TiO₂, which is why high-threshold mirrors use HfO₂/SiO₂ and lowest-absorption mirrors Ta₂O₅/SiO₂. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Standing-wave field and the first H/L interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A mirror's scatter floor is set by substrate roughness, which the film replicates. Laser-mirror substrates are usually fused silica or low-expansion glass superpolished to 0.1 to 0.2 nm RMS with 10-5 surface quality, cleaned in a clean room and loaded into the chamber immediately. Any residual particle on the substrate grows through a thick stack into an inverted-cone nodular defect whose diameter scales as the square root of seed diameter times film thickness, and field concentration at the nodule boundary makes the local damage threshold far lower than defect-free film, so damage statistics are often governed by defect density rather than intrinsic material limits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Superpolished substrate and nodular defects”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Laser mirrors are almost always deposited by ion-beam sputtering: an argon-ion beam strikes a Ta or Ta₂O₅ target, the sputtered atoms arrive with several eV and form dense, amorphous, low-scatter films, and oxygen is admitted to keep the oxide stoichiometric, since oxygen-deficient TaOₓ brings absorption above ppm. The rate is only about 0.1 nm/s, so a 41-layer, 6 µm mirror takes well over ten hours, during which target ageing and oxygen-pressure drift alter the index. Post-deposition annealing at several hundred degrees lowers absorption and mechanical loss and relaxes part of the compressive stress, a standard step for gravitational-wave-detector mirrors and high-precision cavity mirrors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “IBS chamber, oxygen partial pressure and annealing furnace”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A spectrophotometer's absolute accuracy of about 0.1% equals 1000 ppm and is useless for laser mirrors. Loss must be measured by cavity ring-down: two mirrors form a cavity, the laser is switched off abruptly, the stored light decays exponentially with a time constant set by cavity length and total mirror loss, and time is measured far more accurately than intensity. Absorption is measured separately by photothermal common-path interferometry or deflection, converting the tiny thermal expansion and index change produced by a pump laser into a signal with 0.1 ppm resolution after calibration; scatter is collected over a hemisphere by a total-integrated-scatter instrument. Only the three measured separately and summed form the complete ledger. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cavity ring-down and photothermal absorption measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Thresholds are tested per ISO 21254 in 1-on-1 (one shot per site) or S-on-1 (many shots per site) mode: tens of sites are irradiated at each of several fluences, damage probability is plotted against fluence and extrapolated to zero probability, and wavelength, pulse width, spot size, repetition rate and the damage criterion are recorded. In the nanosecond thermal-diffusion regime the threshold scales roughly with the square root of pulse width and roughly linearly with wavelength, and larger spots find more defects and give lower thresholds; these scalings are estimates only and fail completely when the physics changes, as in the femtosecond regime. Engineering compares the Gaussian beam's peak fluence with the threshold and keeps a safety factor of two to five. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ISO 21254 damage test and pulse-width scaling table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Under high continuous-wave power the absorbed power forms a temperature peak at the beam centre, thermal expansion raises a bump on the surface, the reflected wavefront acquires defocus and spherical aberration, and the cavity stability region drifts with power; higher substrate conductivity and larger spots reduce the rise. Clamping forces during mounting press astigmatism into the figure, so three-point kinematic or flexure mounts with controlled torque are used. Contamination is the lifetime killer: adsorbed hydrocarbons carbonise under ultraviolet or high power, forming absorption centres and lowering the threshold, so outgassing materials in sealed or vacuum cavities must be controlled and cleanliness maintained. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A laser-mirror specification must itemise working wavelength and incidence angle, polarization, separate ceilings and measurement methods for T, A and S, the damage threshold with its test conditions, figure and surface quality, group-delay dispersion for ultrafast use, and cleaning limits. Acceptance relies on ring-down and photothermal measurements with a guard band. The system side enters each mirror's loss into the cavity round-trip loss to compute finesse and intracavity power build-up and checks them against the design. The handoff holds the coating run number, witness ring-down records, damage certificate, annealing record and substrate origin, so any later anomaly in any mirror can be traced to its process. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 規格只寫 R ≥ 99.99% 並以分光光度計驗收，實際鏡片吸收 50 ppm，在 20 kW 腔內功率下吸收 1 W，熱透鏡使模態失穩，鏡片在數小時後損傷。
衰盪腔內有高階橫模同時振盪，衰減曲線成為多指數，擬合得到的 τ 偏短，鏡片損耗被高估三倍而誤判不合格；或以分光光度計的 99.95% 讀值當作合格證據，實際損耗根本無法分辨。
pitfallsEn: A specification of only R ≥ 99.99% verified by spectrophotometer passes a mirror absorbing 50 ppm; at 20 kW circulating power it absorbs 1 W, thermal lensing destabilises the mode and the mirror fails after hours.

Higher-order transverse modes oscillating in the ring-down cavity make the decay multi-exponential, the fitted τ is short and the mirror loss is overestimated threefold, rejecting a good part; a spectrophotometer reading of 99.95% taken as evidence proves nothing about ppm loss.

guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Polarization-optics fabrication
guides.concept: 本課以消光比與延遲量兩個核心指標貫穿偏振元件的製作：先用 Malus 定律與雙折射建立規格的物理意義，再分別處理石英波片的定向、研磨至延遲量與零級複合結構、方解石 Glan 稜鏡的全反射幾何、奈米線柵與 MacNeille 薄膜偏振分光器、Fresnel 菱體的消色差延遲，接著用 Sénarmont 與消光比量測建立誤差預算，最後處理應力雙折射安裝與規格交接。
guides.conceptEn: Two figures of merit, extinction ratio and retardance, run through this course on fabricating polarization optics: Malus's law and birefringence give the specifications physical meaning, then quartz-waveplate orientation, polishing to retardance and compound zero-order construction, the total-internal-reflection geometry of calcite Glan prisms, nanowire-grid and MacNeille thin-film beam splitters and the achromatic retardance of the Fresnel rhomb are treated in turn, followed by Sénarmont and extinction-ratio metrology for the error budget, stress-birefringence-free mounting and specification handoff.
procedure: 線偏振光通過透射軸夾角 θ 的理想偏振片後強度為 I = I₀cos²θ，這是 Malus 定律；真實偏振片以消光比 ER = T_max/T_min 描述，它由材料的二向吸收、晶體的全反射幾何或薄膜的 Brewster 條件決定。元件類別與消光比的典型範圍：拉伸聚合物片與含銀粒子玻璃 10³ 到 10⁴，鋁奈米線柵 10³ 到 10⁴ 且寬頻，薄膜分光立方體 10² 到 10³，方解石 Glan 稜鏡 10⁵ 到 10⁶。消光比規格必須連同波長、入射角與光束發散角一起給，因為這三者都會把漏光放大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交叉偏振片與消光比」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

單軸晶體對平行與垂直光軸的偏振有不同折射率，厚度 d 的平板使兩個分量產生相位差 Γ = Δn·d/λ（以波數計），這就是延遲量。石英在 633 nm 的 Δn 約 0.0091，真正的零級四分之一波片只有十幾微米厚，無法獨立研磨，所以有兩種做法：多級波片把延遲量做成 m + 1/4 波（厚度數百微米），或把兩片多級片光軸交叉疊合，使厚度差等於零級厚度，稱為複合零級波片。多級波片的延遲量對波長與溫度的敏感度隨級數線性放大，這是工程選擇的核心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「石英波片的雙折射與延遲量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

石英波片的晶片必須切成光軸平行於表面，定向用 X 光繞射或錐光干涉圖確認到 0.1° 以內，再研磨拋光到厚度；因為延遲量對厚度的要求是 0.2 µm 等級，最後一道工序不是量厚度而是邊拋邊量延遲量，直到進入公差。複合零級波片的兩片以光學膠合或空氣間隙組合，膠合會引入應力與雷射功率限制。方解石 Glan–Taylor 稜鏡由兩塊光軸平行於入射面的方解石以空氣間隙組成，切角使尋常光在間隙全反射、非常光穿透；接受角由兩個臨界角夾出，只有幾度，材料的解理與軟度使加工與清潔都比玻璃困難。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「晶體定向、研磨至延遲量與方解石稜鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鋁奈米線柵以奈米壓印或干涉微影在玻璃上做出週期 100 到 150 nm、占空比約一半的鋁線，當週期遠小於波長時，電場平行線條的偏振被反射、垂直的被透射，寬頻且耐高溫，但週期必須小於波長除以基板折射率才不會產生繞射級。MacNeille 偏振分光立方體靠多層膜內每個界面都在 Brewster 角工作：p 偏振幾乎不反射而 s 偏振被四分之一波堆高反射，條件 n_g² = 2n_H²n_L²/(n_H² + n_L²) 把膜材與立方體玻璃綁在一起。Fresnel 菱體用兩次全反射各產生約 45° 的相位差，延遲量只依賴折射率，幾乎不隨波長變化，是消色差的四分之一波延遲器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鋁奈米線柵、MacNeille 膜堆與 Fresnel 菱體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

延遲量以 Sénarmont 法量測：待測片放在 45° 的線偏振光中，其後接一片精確的四分之一波片把橢圓偏振轉回線偏振，旋轉檢偏器到消光，檢偏器轉角的兩倍就是延遲量，量測精度由旋轉台的角度讀數與消光點的判定決定；更高精度與速度用光彈調制器或旋轉補償器的偏振儀。快軸方向以同樣的消光法標定，並刻在元件邊緣。消光比量測的瓶頸不是光學而是動態範圍：10⁶:1 需要偵測器在六個數量級內線性，實務上以鎖相放大、已校正的中性密度濾片分段量測，並把雜散光底限單獨量出扣除。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Sénarmont 補償器與六個數量級的偵測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

波片的延遲量誤差來自五個獨立來源：製造厚度誤差、工作波長偏離設計、溫度、入射角與安裝應力。入射角的影響與傾斜方向有關：繞慢軸傾斜使延遲量減少，繞快軸傾斜使延遲量增加，量級約為 sin²θ/(2n²) 的相對變化，且隨級數放大。把每一項換算成波數後以均方根相加，與規格比較，就能判斷該用零級、複合零級還是消色差設計，以及公差該往哪一項收緊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「延遲量誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

任何偏振元件在安裝時受到的機械應力都會透過光彈效應產生附加雙折射，使偏振片的消光比下降、波片的延遲量偏移，而且分佈不均勻。玻璃與熔融石英的應力光學係數約 3 到 4×10⁻¹² /Pa，看似很小，但光程只要幾毫米、應力只要 1 MPa 就能造成數十奈米的延遲。因此元件用三點或撓性無應力座固定，避免彈簧壓片與過緊的螺紋環；膠合界面要選低收縮的光學膠並控制固化，雷射功率高時改用空氣間隙或光學接觸。增透膜必須針對晶體的兩個折射率設計，並把快軸刻記與安裝基準對齊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「無應力安裝座與膠合界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

偏振元件的規格表應列出：延遲量與公差（指定波長與溫度）、快軸標記精度、消光比（指定波長、入射角、光束發散）、穿透波前、表面品質、增透膜殘餘反射、損傷門檻、工作溫度範圍與安裝方式限制。系統端把這些數值換算成系統指標，例如 Faraday 隔離器的隔離度由偏振片消光比與 45° 旋轉角誤差共同決定，兩項漏光相加後取分貝。交接資料包含晶體批次與定向紀錄、延遲量與軸向量測報告、消光比曲線與量測條件，讓系統整合者能重現驗收結果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏振元件規格表與隔離度預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Linearly polarized light passing an ideal polarizer whose transmission axis is at angle θ emerges with I = I₀cos²θ, Malus's law; a real polarizer is described by its extinction ratio ER = T_max/T_min, set by dichroic absorption in the material, total-internal-reflection geometry in a crystal or the Brewster condition in a thin-film stack. Typical classes and ranges: stretched polymer sheet and silver-particle glass 10³ to 10⁴, aluminium nanowire grids 10³ to 10⁴ and broadband, thin-film cube splitters 10² to 10³, calcite Glan prisms 10⁵ to 10⁶. An extinction specification must always carry wavelength, incidence angle and beam divergence, because all three enlarge the leakage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Crossed polarizers and extinction ratio”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A uniaxial crystal has different indices for polarizations parallel and perpendicular to its optic axis, so a plate of thickness d gives the two components a phase difference Γ = Δn·d/λ in waves, the retardance. Quartz has Δn of about 0.0091 at 633 nm, so a true zero-order quarter-wave plate is only tens of micrometres thick and cannot be polished free-standing; either a multi-order plate carries m + 1/4 waves at several hundred micrometres, or two multi-order plates are stacked with crossed axes so their thickness difference equals the zero-order thickness, the compound zero-order plate. A multi-order plate's sensitivity of retardance to wavelength and temperature scales with its order, which is the core of the engineering choice. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Birefringence and retardance of a quartz waveplate”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A quartz waveplate blank is cut with the optic axis parallel to the surface, the orientation verified to within 0.1° by X-ray diffraction or conoscopic interference, then lapped and polished to thickness; because the retardance demands thickness at the 0.2 µm level, the final step measures retardance while polishing rather than thickness, stopping inside tolerance. The two halves of a compound zero-order plate are optically cemented or air-spaced, cementing bringing stress and a laser-power limit. A calcite Glan–Taylor prism is two calcite pieces with optic axes parallel to the entrance face separated by an air gap, cut so the ordinary ray is totally reflected at the gap while the extraordinary ray passes; the acceptance angle lies between two critical angles and is only a few degrees, and calcite's cleavage and softness make machining and cleaning harder than glass. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Crystal orientation, polishing to retardance and calcite prisms”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An aluminium nanowire grid is made by nanoimprint or interference lithography as 100 to 150 nm pitch lines of about half duty cycle on glass; for pitch far below the wavelength the polarization parallel to the wires is reflected and the perpendicular one transmitted, broadband and heat-tolerant, but the pitch must stay below the wavelength divided by the substrate index to avoid diffracted orders. A MacNeille polarizing cube works with every interface of its multilayer at Brewster's angle: p polarization is barely reflected while s is strongly reflected by the quarter-wave stack, and the condition n_g² = 2n_H²n_L²/(n_H² + n_L²) ties the film materials to the cube glass. A Fresnel rhomb produces about 45° of phase difference at each of two total internal reflections; the retardance depends only on refractive index and hardly on wavelength, giving an achromatic quarter-wave retarder. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aluminium nanowire grid, MacNeille stack and Fresnel rhomb”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Retardance is measured by the Sénarmont method: the sample sits in linearly polarized light at 45°, an accurate quarter-wave plate behind it converts the elliptical output back to linear, the analyser is rotated to extinction, and twice the analyser angle is the retardance, with accuracy set by the stage's angular readout and the extinction judgement; higher accuracy and speed come from photoelastic-modulator or rotating-compensator polarimeters. The fast-axis direction is marked by the same extinction method and engraved on the edge. The bottleneck in extinction measurement is not optics but dynamic range: 10⁶:1 needs a detector linear over six decades, so in practice lock-in detection and calibrated neutral-density filters are used in stages, with the stray-light floor measured separately and subtracted. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sénarmont compensator and six-decade detection”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Retardance error in a waveplate comes from five independent sources: manufacturing thickness error, working wavelength away from design, temperature, incidence angle and mounting stress. The angular effect depends on tilt direction: tilting about the slow axis reduces retardance, tilting about the fast axis increases it, with a relative change of order sin²θ/(2n²), amplified by the order. Converting each term to waves and adding root-sum-square against the specification shows whether a zero-order, compound zero-order or achromatic design is needed and which tolerance to tighten. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Retardance error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Any mechanical stress applied to a polarization element during mounting adds birefringence through the photoelastic effect, lowering a polarizer's extinction and shifting a waveplate's retardance, non-uniformly across the aperture. The stress-optic coefficient of glass and fused silica is only about 3 to 4×10⁻¹² /Pa, yet a path of a few millimetres under 1 MPa produces tens of nanometres of retardance. Elements are therefore held in three-point or flexure stress-free mounts rather than spring retainers or over-tightened threaded rings; cemented interfaces use low-shrinkage optical cement with controlled curing, and air spacing or optical contact replaces cement at high laser power. Antireflection films must be designed for the crystal's two indices, and the fast-axis mark aligned to the mounting datum. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Stress-free mount and cemented interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A polarization-component specification should list retardance and tolerance (at stated wavelength and temperature), fast-axis marking accuracy, extinction ratio (at stated wavelength, incidence angle and beam divergence), transmitted wavefront, surface quality, antireflection residual, damage threshold, operating temperature range and mounting limits. The system side converts these into system metrics; for instance a Faraday isolator's isolation is set jointly by polarizer extinction and the error in the 45° rotation angle, the two leakages adding before conversion to decibels. The handoff carries the crystal batch and orientation record, retardance and axis measurement reports and the extinction curve with its conditions, so the integrator can reproduce the acceptance result. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polarization-component specification sheet and isolation budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 用 2° 發散的 LED 光束量 Glan 稜鏡，部分光線超出全反射的接受角而直接漏過，消光比只讀到 10³:1，合格的稜鏡被判為不良；或偵測器在低功率端非線性，漏光被低估十倍。
用品質 λ/50 的四分之一波片當 Sénarmont 補償片，所有待測片的延遲量都帶著同一個系統偏差，整批交貨後在客戶端被判超差；消光比量測未擋雜散光，10⁶:1 的稜鏡只能量到 10⁴:1。
pitfallsEn: Measuring a Glan prism with a 2° divergent LED beam lets rays beyond the total-internal-reflection acceptance angle leak straight through, reading only 10³:1 and rejecting a good prism; a detector non-linear at low power underestimates leakage tenfold.

Using a λ/50 quarter-wave plate as the Sénarmont compensator stamps the same systematic bias on every measured plate and the whole delivery is rejected by the customer; extinction measured without stray-light control reads a 10⁶:1 prism as only 10⁴:1.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：繞射光學元件製作
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Diffractive optical-element fabrication
guides.concept: 本課從 2π 相位摺疊與 M 階量化的 sinc² 效率出發，說明設計波長失諧與深度誤差如何把能量漏到零級與高階，再走過二元微影的光罩數與最小線寬、反應離子蝕刻與灰階直寫、奈米壓印複製，用輪廓儀與零級洩漏量測建立效率誤差預算，最後以混合折射繞射消色差透鏡的整合與規格交接收尾。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from 2π phase wrapping and the sinc² efficiency of M-level quantisation, the course shows how design-wavelength detuning and depth error leak energy into the zero and higher orders, walks through mask count and minimum feature in binary lithography, reactive-ion etching, grayscale direct writing and nanoimprint replication, builds an efficiency error budget from profilometry and zero-order leakage measurement, and closes with hybrid refractive-diffractive achromat integration and specification handoff.
procedure: 繞射光學元件把一個連續的相位函數以 2π 為模數摺疊成薄的表面浮雕，每個週期內相位從 0 線性升到 2π，理想的閃耀（kinoform）輪廓在設計波長把全部能量送進第一繞射級。微影製作無法做出連續斜面，而是以 M 個等高階梯逼近，純量理論給出第一級效率 η = sinc²(1/M)，剩餘能量分散到其他級次。浮雕的總深度由材料折射率決定，d = λ₀/(n − 1)，階數越多越接近連續輪廓，但每多一個光罩就多一次對準與蝕刻，製程誤差也隨之累積。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

浮雕深度只在設計波長給出 2π 相位；波長改變或深度有誤差時，相位深度變成 2π(1 + ε)，第一級效率降為 sinc²(ε)，而零級與第二級各獲得約 ε² 量級的能量。這就是繞射元件強烈色散與對深度敏感的根源：在雷射系統裡，零級洩漏表現為未被整形的中央亮點，對光束整形器與分束器而言比效率損失更致命。寬頻應用需要混合折射繞射設計或多階（harmonic）繞射元件，把深度做成多個 2π 的整數倍以在數個波長同時閃耀。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「設計波長失諧與零級洩漏」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

二元光學以 N 道二元光罩製作 2ᴺ 階：第一道蝕刻 d/2、第二道 d/4、第三道 d/8，每道都要與前一道的圖形套準。繞射透鏡的環帶向外越來越密，最外環帶的週期等於波長除以數值孔徑，而最細線寬是週期除以階數，這決定了需要接觸式曝光、步進機還是電子束直寫。套準誤差對效率的傷害與最細線寬成反比，週期小、階數多的元件往往因為套準而不是階數限制了效率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三道光罩與最外環帶的最小線寬」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

浮雕以反應離子蝕刻或感應耦合電漿蝕刻轉移到熔融石英，深度由蝕刻速率與時間決定，速率隨腔體狀態漂移數個百分點，因此需要干涉式終點偵測或以見證片逐批校正，側壁角與微負載效應（密集區蝕刻較慢）則讓環帶內外的深度不一致。灰階直寫以雷射或電子束在光阻中寫入連續劑量，顯影後得到近似連續的輪廓再蝕刻轉移，省去套準但依賴光阻對比與蝕刻選擇比的線性。量產靠奈米壓印或 UV 澆鑄複製：以母模壓印聚合物，聚合物固化收縮會同時改變深度與橫向尺寸，後者直接改變繞射透鏡的焦距。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反應離子蝕刻、灰階直寫與壓印模具」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

繞射元件的量測分兩層：幾何層以白光干涉輪廓儀或觸針式輪廓儀量階高與總深度（精度數奈米）、以 SEM 量線寬與側壁、以 AFM 量階面粗糙度；功能層以設計波長的雷射照射，用功率計量各繞射級的功率得到效率與零級洩漏，對光束整形器則用相機記錄輸出強度分佈並計算均勻度。零級洩漏對深度的二次敏感度使它成為比輪廓儀更靈敏的深度檢驗：輪廓儀的 2 nm 不確定度對 1385 nm 深度是 0.14%，而零級量到 0.01% 就能分辨 1% 的深度偏差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「白光干涉輪廓儀與零級功率計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

繞射元件的效率損失是相乘而不是相加：量化損失 sinc²(1/M)、深度誤差 sinc²(ε)、套準造成的相位錯誤區、階面粗糙度與側壁圓角的散射、以及未鍍增透膜的 Fresnel 反射，各自是一個小於 1 的因子。預算表把每項的設計值與製程能力並列，判斷哪一項最值得投資：例如從 8 階升到 16 階只多 3.7%，但若套準能力不足，多出的兩道光罩反而讓效率下降。純量模型在週期小於約十倍波長時開始高估效率，接近波長尺度的元件必須以嚴格耦合波分析重算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「效率誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

繞射面的等效 Abbe 數是 −3.45，色散與玻璃相反而且強得多，所以在折射透鏡上加一個弱的繞射面就能消色差，而不需要第二種玻璃；繞射部分只佔總光焦度的幾個百分點，環帶週期很大，可用鑽石車削或壓印製作。整合時要決定浮雕面朝向（朝內以免刮傷與污染）、增透膜在階梯上的陰影效應、以及繞射面效率損失變成的雜散光：第零級與第二級的光聚焦在不同位置，形成背景光暈，相機鏡頭對此比雷射系統更敏感。繞射面的清潔只能吹氣與溶劑沖洗，不能擦拭。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「混合折射繞射消色差透鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

繞射元件的規格必須寫明：設計波長與可用波段、目標級次效率的下限、零級洩漏的上限、分束器各級次的均勻度定義（最大減最小除以最大加最小）、光束整形器的輸入光束尺寸與 M² 容許範圍、材料與損傷門檻、基板厚度與平面度。驗收以設計波長的級次功率報告為準，並以量測不確定度設保護帶。交接資料包含光罩組編號、蝕刻批次與見證片階高、輪廓儀與零級量測結果，以及清潔與安裝方向的限制，讓系統端能在失效時區分設計、製程與使用問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「繞射元件規格表與級次功率報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A diffractive optical element folds a continuous phase function modulo 2π into a thin surface relief, the phase rising linearly from 0 to 2π within each period, and an ideal blazed (kinoform) profile sends all the energy into the first diffraction order at the design wavelength. Lithography cannot make a continuous slope, so it approximates it with M equal-height steps; scalar theory gives a first-order efficiency η = sinc²(1/M), with the remainder spread over other orders. The total relief depth is set by the material index, d = λ₀/(n − 1); more levels approach the continuous profile, but every extra mask adds an alignment and an etch, and process errors accumulate accordingly. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The relief depth gives 2π of phase only at the design wavelength; when the wavelength changes or the depth is in error, the phase depth becomes 2π(1 + ε), first-order efficiency falls to sinc²(ε), and the zero and second orders each receive energy of order ε². This is the root of a diffractive element's strong dispersion and depth sensitivity: in a laser system zero-order leakage appears as an unshaped central hot spot, more damaging to beam shapers and splitters than the efficiency loss itself. Broadband use calls for hybrid refractive-diffractive designs or harmonic diffractive elements whose depth is several integer multiples of 2π so that several wavelengths blaze simultaneously. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Design-wavelength detuning and zero-order leakage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Binary optics builds 2ᴺ levels with N binary masks: the first etches d/2, the second d/4, the third d/8, and each must be overlaid on the previous pattern. The zones of a diffractive lens grow denser outward; the outermost period equals the wavelength divided by the numerical aperture, and the finest feature is that period divided by the level count, which decides between contact exposure, a stepper or electron-beam writing. Overlay error damages efficiency in inverse proportion to the finest feature, so small-period, many-level elements are often limited by overlay rather than by level count. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three masks and the minimum feature of the outermost zone”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The relief is transferred into fused silica by reactive-ion or inductively coupled plasma etching, the depth set by etch rate and time; the rate drifts by several percent with chamber condition, so interferometric endpoint detection or per-batch witness calibration is needed, while sidewall angle and microloading (dense regions etch more slowly) make depth differ between inner and outer zones. Grayscale direct writing exposes a continuous dose into resist with a laser or electron beam, giving a near-continuous profile after development that is then etch-transferred, avoiding overlay but relying on the linearity of resist contrast and etch selectivity. Volume production uses nanoimprint or UV casting: a master mould is pressed into polymer, and curing shrinkage changes both depth and lateral dimensions, the latter shifting a diffractive lens's focal length directly. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reactive-ion etching, grayscale writing and imprint mould”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Measurement of a diffractive element has two layers: the geometric layer uses white-light or stylus profilometry for step height and total depth (a few nanometres), SEM for line width and sidewalls and AFM for step-surface roughness; the functional layer illuminates at the design wavelength and measures each order's power with a power meter for efficiency and zero-order leakage, while beam shapers are recorded with a camera to compute uniformity. The quadratic sensitivity of zero-order leakage to depth makes it a more sensitive depth check than the profiler: 2 nm of profiler uncertainty is 0.14% of a 1385 nm depth, whereas a zero-order measurement at 0.01% resolves a 1% depth deviation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “White-light profiler and zero-order power meter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Efficiency losses in a diffractive element multiply rather than add: quantisation sinc²(1/M), depth error sinc²(ε), phase-error regions from overlay, scatter from step roughness and sidewall rounding, and Fresnel reflection where no antireflection film is applied, each a factor below 1. The budget table places each term's design value beside the process capability to judge which investment pays: going from 8 to 16 levels adds only 3.7%, and with insufficient overlay capability the two extra masks lower efficiency instead. The scalar model starts to overestimate efficiency when the period falls below roughly ten wavelengths, and wavelength-scale elements must be recomputed with rigorous coupled-wave analysis. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Efficiency error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A diffractive surface has an equivalent Abbe number of −3.45, dispersing opposite to glass and far more strongly, so adding a weak diffractive surface to a refractive lens corrects chromatic aberration without a second glass; the diffractive part carries only a few percent of the total power, its zone periods are large, and it can be diamond-turned or imprinted. Integration decides the relief orientation (inward, away from scratches and contamination), the shadowing of antireflection films on the steps, and the stray light produced by the diffractive efficiency loss: the zero and second orders focus elsewhere and form a background halo to which camera lenses are far more sensitive than laser systems. A diffractive surface may be cleaned only by blowing and solvent rinsing, never by wiping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hybrid refractive-diffractive achromat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A diffractive-element specification must state design wavelength and usable band, the lower limit on target-order efficiency, the upper limit on zero-order leakage, the uniformity definition for splitters (maximum minus minimum over maximum plus minimum), the input-beam size and M² range for beam shapers, material and damage threshold, substrate thickness and flatness. Acceptance rests on the order-power report at the design wavelength with a guard band set by measurement uncertainty. The handoff includes the mask-set number, etch batch and witness step heights, profiler and zero-order results and the cleaning and orientation limits, so the system side can separate design, process and usage problems at failure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DOE specification sheet and order-power report”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把為 PMMA（n = 1.49）設計的 1292 nm 深度直接用在熔融石英上，相位深度只有 2π×0.457/0.49，不足約 7%（ε ≈ −0.067），看似小，卻把約 0.5% 的能量送進零級並在雷射系統中形成中央亮點。
只做輪廓儀驗收，階面上 3 nm RMS 的蝕刻粗糙度與側壁圓角沒有被量到，實際效率比純量預測低 4%，客戶端的功率預算不足；或功率計未加光闌，鄰近級次混入使效率被高估。
pitfallsEn: Using the 1292 nm depth designed for PMMA (n = 1.49) directly on fused silica gives a phase depth of only 2π×0.457/0.49, about 7% short (ε ≈ −0.067), which looks small yet sends about 0.5% of the energy into the zero order as a central hot spot in a laser system.

Relying on profilometry alone misses 3 nm RMS etch roughness on the step surfaces and rounded sidewalls, so real efficiency is 4% below the scalar prediction and the customer's power budget falls short; a power meter without an aperture admits neighbouring orders and overstates efficiency.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：超穎透鏡製程研究
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Metalens fabrication research
guides.concept: 以 532 nm、NA 0.8 的 TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎透鏡為主線，從廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣出發，解釋奈米柱如何在 600 nm 高度內覆蓋 2π 相位，再比較電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機的解析度與產能，最後把蝕刻側壁、關鍵尺寸均勻性、色差與拼接誤差整合成可量測的聚焦效率與 Strehl 預算。
guides.conceptEn: Using a 532 nm, NA 0.8 TiO₂ nanopillar metalens as the running case, the course starts from the generalized Snell law and phase sampling, shows how pillars cover 2π of phase within 600 nm of height, compares electron-beam direct write with DUV steppers for resolution and throughput, then folds etch sidewalls, critical-dimension uniformity, chromatic focal shift and field stitching into a measurable focusing-efficiency and Strehl budget.
procedure: 超穎透鏡不靠厚度累積光程，而是在一層次波長的奈米結構上逐點指定穿透相位。要把平面波聚到焦距 f，相位剖面必須是 φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f)，其徑向梯度 dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ 就是廣義 Snell 定律中的面內波向量，透鏡邊緣的 sinθ 即數值孔徑 NA。相位以週期 p 的格點離散取樣，格點既要細到能解析邊緣最陡的相位斜率，又要小於基板內波長以免格點本身繞射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每根 TiO₂ 奈米柱是一段截斷的介電波導，直徑決定基模有效折射率 n_eff，穿透相位約為 (2π/λ)·n_eff·h。直徑從約 80 nm 增到 200 nm 時，532 nm 波長下 n_eff 約從 1.1 升到 2.1，因此固定高度 h 的柱子只靠直徑就能掃過 2π。另一條路是幾何相位：把柱子做成半波片並旋轉角度 θ，對圓偏振光給出 φ = 2θ，覆蓋範圍天生是完整的 2π，但效率由偏振轉換率決定且會把未轉換光留在零階。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

研究階段的超穎透鏡多以 100 keV 電子束直寫定義圖形，光點約 2 nm、特徵尺寸可到 10 nm，寫場約 1 mm，場間拼接與套刻誤差在 20 nm 以內；但寫入時間與曝光面積和劑量成正比、與束流成反比，公分級透鏡需要數百小時。量產改用 248 或 193 nm DUV 步進機，一次曝光一整個 26 × 33 mm 場，解析度由 k₁·λ/NA 決定，大口徑透鏡則由多個場拼接而成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

可見光超穎透鏡需要高折射率、低吸收的材料：TiO₂（n ≈ 2.4、k < 10⁻⁴）與 GaN 適用可見光，非晶矽在 532 nm 吸收過大但在 940 nm 近紅外幾乎無損。TiO₂ 常以原子層沉積填入電子束阻劑的孔洞，再回蝕頂層並去除阻劑，形成垂直側壁的柱子；非晶矽或 GaN 則以硬遮罩加電感耦合電漿乾蝕刻成形。側壁角度、底部殘留與柱頂圓角都會改變 n_eff，等效於直徑誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ALD 填充與高深寬比乾蝕刻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

聚焦效率定義為焦點附近（常取 3 倍 FWHM 半徑的圓）內的功率除以入射功率，必須與穿透率分開報告，因為未聚焦的零階光也會穿透。焦斑用一支 NA 高於待測透鏡的顯微物鏡放大成像到相機，以像素尺寸與放大率換算 FWHM；Strehl 比由實測峰值強度對理想 Airy 峰值的比值求得，或由 PSF 反推波前 RMS。入射光需以已知偏振與準直度照明，否則量到的是光源而非透鏡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「焦平面顯微成像與針孔功率計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

單層超穎透鏡本質上是繞射元件，焦距與波長近似成反比，f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ，與折射透鏡的色差方向相反且大得多。高 NA 時景深 λ/NA² 只有一個微米以下，所以可用頻寬極窄。要消色差必須讓每個超穎原子同時提供正確的相位與群延遲，而群延遲範圍受奈米柱高度限制在數十飛秒，因此消色差設計只在口徑數十微米的透鏡上成立，大口徑則改用多層或繞射折射混合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波長掃描光源與 z 軸焦點位移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

量產超穎透鏡在 200 或 300 mm 晶圓上一次做出數千顆，整合工作包括背面增透鍍膜、保護層、切割與和影像感測器或 VCSEL 的對位。DUV 步進機的場拼接線會穿過大口徑透鏡，拼接位移等於在該線兩側加一個相位台階，其大小由局部相位梯度決定；模組對位則由透鏡傾斜造成的慧差與去中心造成的影像偏移決定公差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「DUV 場拼接線與背面增透層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

超穎透鏡的品質最終由每根柱子的直徑誤差決定，因為相位庫把直徑映射成相位，直徑的隨機誤差直接變成波前的隨機誤差。交接文件必須把設計相位圖、量測的 CD 分佈、側壁角、穿透相位驗證、效率對波長曲線、PSF/MTF 與環境測試連成一條可追溯的鏈，讓製程端知道哪個參數的漂移會先讓 Strehl 低於 0.8。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CD 均勻性地圖與驗收數據包」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A metalens does not accumulate optical path through thickness; it assigns a transmission phase point by point on a single subwavelength-structured layer. To focus a plane wave at distance f the phase must follow φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f), whose radial gradient dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ is the in-plane wavevector of the generalized Snell law, and sinθ at the rim equals the numerical aperture. The phase is sampled on a lattice of pitch p that must resolve the steepest slope at the rim yet stay below the wavelength inside the substrate so that the lattice itself does not diffract. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each TiO₂ nanopillar is a truncated dielectric waveguide whose diameter sets the fundamental-mode effective index n_eff, giving a transmission phase of about (2π/λ)·n_eff·h. As the diameter grows from roughly 80 nm to 200 nm at 532 nm, n_eff rises from about 1.1 to 2.1, so pillars of fixed height sweep 2π by diameter alone. The alternative is geometric phase: pillars shaped as half-wave plates and rotated by θ impart φ = 2θ to circularly polarized light, covering a full 2π by construction, but efficiency is set by the polarization-conversion ratio and unconverted light stays in the zeroth order. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Research metalenses are usually patterned by 100 keV electron-beam direct write with a spot near 2 nm, features down to 10 nm, write fields of about 1 mm and stitching and overlay errors under 20 nm; but write time scales with exposed area times dose divided by beam current, so a centimetre-class lens would take hundreds of hours. Production moves to 248 or 193 nm DUV steppers that expose a whole 26 × 33 mm field at once with resolution set by k₁·λ/NA, and large apertures are built by stitching several fields. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron-beam direct write and DUV stepper”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Visible metalenses need high-index, low-loss materials: TiO₂ (n ≈ 2.4, k < 10⁻⁴) and GaN serve the visible, whereas amorphous silicon absorbs too strongly at 532 nm but is nearly lossless at 940 nm in the near infrared. TiO₂ is usually grown by atomic-layer deposition into holes of an electron-beam resist, then etched back and freed from resist to leave vertical pillars; amorphous silicon or GaN is shaped by inductively coupled plasma etching through a hard mask. Sidewall angle, footing and top rounding all change n_eff and act like diameter errors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ALD fill and high-aspect-ratio dry etch”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Focusing efficiency is the power inside a circle of about three FWHM radii around the focus divided by the incident power, and must be reported separately from transmittance because undiffracted zeroth-order light is also transmitted. The spot is relayed to a camera by a microscope objective whose NA exceeds that of the lens under test, and FWHM is converted through pixel size and magnification; the Strehl ratio comes from the measured peak against the ideal Airy peak or from the wavefront RMS inferred from the PSF. Illumination must have known polarization and collimation, otherwise the source rather than the lens is being measured. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Focal-plane microscope and pinhole power meter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A single-layer metalens is intrinsically diffractive: focal length scales roughly inversely with wavelength, f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ, opposite in sign and far larger than refractive chromatic aberration. At high NA the depth of focus λ/NA² is below one micrometre, so the usable bandwidth is very narrow. Achromatization requires each meta-atom to supply the correct phase and group delay together, and the group-delay range available from sub-micrometre pillars is a few tens of femtoseconds, so achromatic designs hold only for apertures of tens of micrometres while larger lenses use multilayer or hybrid refractive-diffractive schemes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tunable source and axial focal shift”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Production metalenses are made by the thousand on 200 or 300 mm wafers, and integration covers backside antireflection coating, protective layers, dicing and alignment to an image sensor or VCSEL. Stepper field boundaries cross a large-aperture lens, and a stitching displacement equals a phase step across that line whose size is set by the local phase gradient; module alignment tolerances come from the coma induced by lens tilt and the image shift induced by decentre. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DUV field-stitch line and backside AR layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The quality of a metalens is ultimately fixed by the diameter error of every pillar, because the library maps diameter to phase and random diameter error becomes random wavefront error directly. The handoff package must chain the design phase map, measured CD distribution, sidewall angle, transmitted-phase verification, efficiency-versus-wavelength curve, PSF/MTF and environmental tests into one traceable record so the process side knows which parameter drift pushes Strehl below 0.8 first. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CD-uniformity map and acceptance data package”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 為了追求高 NA 而讓邊緣每週期取樣數掉到 2 以下時，外圈能量進入其他繞射級，表現為焦點周圍的環狀背景與聚焦效率隨 NA 急遽下降，而中心區量測仍看似正常。
用 NA 0.5 的物鏡觀察 NA 0.8 的焦斑會把 PSF 擴寬一倍以上，FWHM 與 Strehl 都被低估；若同時把零階穿透光算進焦點功率，效率又被高估，兩個錯誤互相掩蓋。
pitfallsEn: Pushing NA until the rim falls below two samples per period sends outer-zone energy into other diffraction orders, seen as a ring-shaped background around the focus and a sharp drop in focusing efficiency with NA, while the central zone still measures normally.

Viewing an NA 0.8 focus with an NA 0.5 objective more than doubles the apparent PSF, underestimating FWHM and Strehl; counting zeroth-order transmission as focal power then overstates efficiency, and the two errors mask each other.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：全像光學元件製作
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Holographic optical-element fabrication
guides.concept: 以 1200 線/mm、16 µm 厚光聚合物的穿透式體相位光柵與同厚度的反射式全像為兩條主線，從厚光柵 Q 參數與 Kogelnik 的 sin² 與 tanh² 效率式出發，推導角度與波長選擇性，再處理記錄材料收縮、干涉條紋穩定性、搖擺曲線擬合與抬頭顯示器或波導耦合器的幾何，形成可交接的全像光學元件工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Two running cases, a 1200 line/mm transmission volume phase grating and a reflection hologram in a 16 µm photopolymer, carry the course from the thick-grating Q parameter and Kogelnik's sin² and tanh² efficiency laws to angular and spectral selectivity, then through recording-material shrinkage, fringe stability, rocking-curve fitting and the geometry of head-up-display combiners and waveguide couplers, ending in a handoff-ready holographic optical-element record.
procedure: 全像光學元件把兩束同調光的干涉條紋寫成記錄層內的折射率調制 n(x) = n₀ + n₁cos(2πx/Λ)，而不是表面刻槽。當層厚 d 遠大於條紋週期 Λ 時，入射光與繞射光在層內持續交換能量，只有滿足布拉格條件的方向能建設性疊加，這就是 Kogelnik 的雙波耦合模型；它預測穿透式光柵在布拉格入射時效率為 η = sin²(ν)，反射式為 η = tanh²(ν)，耦合強度 ν = π·n₁·d/(λ·cosθ_B) 由折射率調制幅度與厚度的乘積決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「記錄層內的折射率條紋」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

體全像的選擇性來自厚度：偏離布拉格角 Δθ 後，入射與繞射波在層厚方向累積相位失配，Kogelnik 的失諧參數 ξ 隨 Δθ·d/Λ 增長，效率依 sin²√(ν² + ξ²)/(1 + ξ²/ν²) 下降。穿透式元件的角度頻寬約為 Λ/d，波長頻寬再除以 tanθ_B，因此低線數穿透光柵對波長寬容但對角度敏感；反射式元件的條紋平行於表面、週期只有 λ/(2n₀)，波長頻寬 Δλ/λ ≈ Λ/d 窄到數奈米，成為波長濾波器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「布拉格角與搖擺曲線寬度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

可用的記錄材料各有折射率調制上限與後處理需求：自顯影光聚合物（如 Bayfol HX 類型）在曝光時單體向亮紋擴散並聚合，n₁ 可達 0.02 到 0.03 以上，不需濕式處理，但聚合伴隨厚度收縮；重鉻酸鹽明膠（DCG）n₁ 可超過 0.08，效率最高，卻需顯影脫水並密封防潮；鹵化銀適合高解析但有散射；光阻只能做表面浮雕，之後以離子束蝕刻轉成玻璃光柵。收縮會壓縮垂直於表面的條紋週期並使斜條紋傾斜，直接移動布拉格波長與角度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光聚合物、DCG 與光阻記錄層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

記錄時把單縱模雷射分成物光與參考光，兩束以夾角 2θ 在記錄層交會，條紋週期由波長與夾角決定；條紋在曝光期間若移動超過週期的十分之一，折射率調制就被洗掉。因此光路需放在隔振平台上、縮短兩臂光程差到遠小於同調長度，並以空間濾波器清理波前；兩束強度比決定干涉對比 V = 2√(I₁I₂)/(I₁ + I₂)，對比不足時 n₁ 按 V 比例下降。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「分束干涉記錄光路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收體全像元件要同時量絕對繞射效率、搖擺曲線與穿透光譜，並把它們反推成 n₁ 與 d 兩個物理量。絕對效率定義為一階繞射功率除以入射功率，須與扣除表面 Fresnel 反射後的相對效率分開報告；搖擺曲線主瓣寬度對應層厚，峰值對應耦合強度，旁瓣高度反映層內折射率調制沿厚度的不均勻（Kogelnik 假設均勻）。反射式元件則以光譜缺口的中心、深度與寬度取代搖擺曲線。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「旋轉台搖擺曲線與光譜儀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

元件在系統中以與記錄不同的光源重建：LED 的 20 nm 頻寬、雷射二極體的溫漂、機構安裝的角度誤差與溫度造成的條紋週期變化，都會偏離布拉格條件。誤差預算要把每項換算成效率損失：對反射式濾波型元件，光源頻寬遠寬於布拉格頻寬時有效效率約按頻寬比下降；對穿透式元件，安裝角誤差透過失諧參數 ξ 降低效率。各項以均方根合成後，才能決定記錄時是否要故意加寬頻寬（犧牲峰值）或加嚴安裝公差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「重建光源光譜與角度誤差預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

全像光學元件最常見的系統角色是抬頭顯示器的透明合成器與擴增實境波導的進出光耦合器。合成器是反射式元件，對窄頻投影光高效反射、對寬頻環境光近乎透明；波導耦合器是斜條紋的穿透或反射元件，把近乎正向入射的影像光折到玻璃內的全反射角。耦合光柵週期由 Λ = λ/(n₀sinθ_g − sinθ_air) 決定，可用視場則受限於全反射角上下限所能容納的 k 向量範圍，因此波導的視場與玻璃折射率直接掛鉤。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波導耦合光柵與 HUD 合成器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

成品驗證把單點量測擴展到整個孔徑與整個壽命：在孔徑上以網格量效率、布拉格波長與霧度，繪成均勻度圖；以溫濕循環與光照老化追蹤布拉格波長漂移與效率衰減；並記錄見穿透率、霧度與散射的光學品質。交接文件要把記錄幾何（波長、兩束角度、光束比、曝光量）、材料批號、量得的 n₁ 與 d、均勻度圖、環境測試結果與系統公差連成一條可追溯鏈，讓下一批生產與系統端能判斷哪個參數漂移會先讓效率或視場超出規格。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「效率均勻度圖與環境測試報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A holographic optical element stores the interference fringes of two coherent beams as an index modulation n(x) = n₀ + n₁cos(2πx/Λ) inside the recording layer rather than as surface grooves. When the thickness d is much larger than the fringe period Λ, the incident and diffracted waves exchange energy continuously through the layer and only the Bragg-matched direction adds constructively; this is Kogelnik's two-wave coupled model, which predicts η = sin²(ν) for transmission gratings at Bragg incidence and η = tanh²(ν) for reflection gratings, with coupling strength ν = π·n₁·d/(λ·cosθ_B) set by the product of index-modulation amplitude and thickness. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Index fringes inside the recording layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Selectivity of a volume hologram comes from thickness: once incidence departs from the Bragg angle by Δθ, the incident and diffracted waves accumulate phase mismatch through the layer, Kogelnik's detuning parameter ξ grows with Δθ·d/Λ, and efficiency falls as sin²√(ν² + ξ²)/(1 + ξ²/ν²). A transmission element has an angular bandwidth of about Λ/d and a spectral bandwidth of that divided by tanθ_B, so a low-line-density transmission grating tolerates wavelength but not angle; a reflection element has fringes parallel to the surface with period only λ/(2n₀), and its spectral bandwidth Δλ/λ ≈ Λ/d narrows to a few nanometres, making it a wavelength filter. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bragg angle and rocking-curve width”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Available recording media differ in attainable index modulation and post-processing: self-developing photopolymers (the Bayfol HX type) let monomer diffuse into bright fringes and polymerize during exposure, reach n₁ of 0.02 to above 0.03 and need no wet processing, but polymerization shrinks the layer; dichromated gelatin (DCG) exceeds n₁ of 0.08 and gives the highest efficiency yet needs development, dehydration and sealing against humidity; silver halide resolves finely but scatters; photoresist only records surface relief, later transferred into glass by ion-beam etching. Shrinkage compresses the fringe period normal to the surface and tilts slanted fringes, moving the Bragg wavelength and angle directly. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photopolymer, DCG and photoresist layers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The recording bench splits a single-longitudinal-mode laser into object and reference beams that meet in the layer at a full angle 2θ, the fringe period following from wavelength and angle; if the fringes move by more than a tenth of a period during exposure the index modulation is washed out. The bench therefore sits on a vibration-isolated table, the two arms are matched to far less than the coherence length, and spatial filters clean the wavefronts; the beam-intensity ratio sets the fringe visibility V = 2√(I₁I₂)/(I₁ + I₂), and n₁ falls in proportion to V when contrast is poor. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Two-beam interference recording bench”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of a volume element measures absolute diffraction efficiency, the rocking curve and the transmission spectrum together, then inverts them into the two physical quantities n₁ and d. Absolute efficiency is first-order diffracted power over incident power and must be reported separately from relative efficiency corrected for surface Fresnel reflection; the rocking-curve main-lobe width maps to thickness, its peak to coupling strength, and sidelobe heights expose non-uniform modulation through the depth, which Kogelnik assumes uniform. For reflection elements the centre, depth and width of the spectral notch replace the rocking curve. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rotation-stage rocking curve and spectrometer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

In the system the element is replayed with a source unlike the recording laser: a 20 nm wide LED, a temperature-drifting diode laser, mounting-angle errors and temperature-driven fringe-period changes all move it off Bragg. The budget converts each item into an efficiency loss: for a reflection filter element whose source is far wider than its Bragg band, effective efficiency drops roughly with the bandwidth ratio; for a transmission element a mounting-angle error lowers efficiency through the detuning parameter ξ. Only after root-sum-squaring the items can one decide whether to broaden the recorded bandwidth deliberately at the cost of peak efficiency or to tighten mounting tolerances. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Replay-source spectrum and angle error budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The commonest system roles of a holographic element are the transparent combiner of a head-up display and the in- and out-couplers of an augmented-reality waveguide. A combiner is a reflection element that reflects the narrowband projector light efficiently while staying nearly transparent to broadband scene light; a waveguide coupler is a slanted-fringe transmission or reflection element that bends near-normal image light to total-internal-reflection angles inside the glass. The coupler period follows Λ = λ/(n₀sinθ_g − sinθ_air), and the usable field of view is limited by the range of k-vectors that fits between the lower and upper total-internal-reflection angles, tying waveguide field of view directly to glass index. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Waveguide coupler grating and HUD combiner”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Final validation extends single-point measurements over the whole aperture and the whole life: efficiency, Bragg wavelength and haze are measured on a grid and drawn as uniformity maps; temperature-humidity cycling and light ageing track Bragg-wavelength drift and efficiency decay; see-through transmittance, haze and scatter are logged as optical quality. The handoff record chains recording geometry (wavelength, beam angles, beam ratio, dose), material lot, fitted n₁ and d, uniformity maps, environmental results and system tolerances into one traceable line, so the next production batch and the system team can judge which parameter drift first pushes efficiency or field of view out of specification. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Efficiency-uniformity map and environmental report”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把薄光柵（Raman–Nath）思維用在 16 µm 厚的層上，會期待多個繞射級同時出現並用純量光柵式預估效率；實際只有布拉格方向有效率，角度一偏效率驟降，整個元件在非設計角度幾乎透明。
用多縱模雷射二極體量搖擺曲線時，各縱模的布拉格角略有不同，曲線被展寬並降低峰值，擬合出的層厚偏薄、n₁ 偏低，使合格品被誤判為曝光不足。
pitfallsEn: Applying thin-grating (Raman–Nath) thinking to a 16 µm layer leads one to expect several orders at once and to predict efficiency with scalar grating formulas; in reality only the Bragg direction is efficient, efficiency collapses with small angle errors and the element is nearly transparent off-design.

Measuring the rocking curve with a multi-longitudinal-mode diode laser lets each mode satisfy Bragg at a slightly different angle; the curve broadens and its peak drops, the fit returns a thinner d and lower n₁, and a good element is wrongly judged underexposed.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：液晶空間光調制器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators
guides.concept: 以 8 µm 像素、1920×1200 的反射式 LCOS 相位調制器為對象，從向列型液晶的雙折射推導 2π 相位行程與單元間隙的關係，計算像素化閃耀光柵的繞射效率與最大偏折角，再把液晶響應時間、相位閃爍、溫度漂移與背板平整度整合成查找表校正與波前修正流程，最後以傅立葉光學系統的驗收指標完成交接。
guides.conceptEn: Taking an 8 µm pixel, 1920×1200 reflective LCOS phase modulator as the object, the course derives the 2π phase stroke against cell gap from nematic birefringence, computes diffraction efficiency and maximum steering angle of pixelated blazed gratings, then folds liquid-crystal response time, phase flicker, temperature drift and backplane flatness into a lookup-table calibration and wavefront-correction flow, closing with acceptance metrics of a Fourier-optics system.
procedure: 相位型液晶調制器使用平行配向的向列型液晶：無電場時液晶指向矢平行基板，沿此方向偏振的光感受非常光折射率 n_e；加電壓後指向矢朝電場方向傾斜，有效折射率往尋常光折射率 n_o 下降，穿越厚度 d 的光程隨之改變而偏振態不變，這就是純相位調制。反射式 LCOS 讓光來回穿過液晶層兩次，所以同樣的單元間隙給出兩倍的相位行程；靠近配向層的分子無法完全傾斜，實際可用的折射率差只有材料 Δn 的七到八成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「平行配向向列液晶層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

液晶調制器的相位圖是以像素週期 p 取樣的階梯函數，任何圖樣都同時受三個因素限制：相鄰像素的最小週期 2p 決定最大偏折角；一個鋸齒週期內的像素數 N 決定階梯近似閃耀面的效率 sinc²(1/N)；像素間隙與電極邊緣的邊緣電場使相位在像素邊界被平滑，短週期圖樣的實際效率低於純量預測。填充因子以外的面積反射未調制光，成為無法消除的零階。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「像素格點與閃耀光柵圖樣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

LCOS 元件由 CMOS 矽背板、頂層金屬像素電極兼反射鏡、配向層、液晶層、ITO 共同電極與蓋玻璃疊成；像素電極之上可再鍍介電多層膜把反射率從鋁的約 90% 提高到 98% 以承受高功率。背板經封裝與蓋玻璃貼合後會產生數個波長的彎曲，單元間隙也會沿孔徑漸變，兩者都疊加在輸出波前上；高精度應用因此把背板面形當成一個固定像差，以干涉儀量測後用相位圖抵消。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CMOS 背板、像素電極與蓋玻璃」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

液晶加電時由電場驅動而快速傾斜，去電後只靠彈性回復，所以關閉時間最慢並與間隙平方成正比、與旋轉黏度成正比；這使得為長波長加厚間隙的元件響應明顯變慢。液晶必須以交流驅動避免離子累積，數位背板以脈寬調變合成有效電壓，位元平面切換造成相位隨時間抖動（閃爍）；類比背板直接保持電壓，閃爍小但需要更複雜的驅動與直流平衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「液晶鬆弛動力學與驅動波形」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驅動電壓與相位之間是非線性的，且隨波長、溫度與元件個體而異，所以每片調制器在每個工作波長都要建立灰階對相位的查找表。常用的繞射法把一半像素固定在灰階 g₀、另一半掃描灰階 g，構成二元光柵，一階強度隨相位差以 sin²(Δφ/2) 變化，由強度曲線反演相位；干涉法則把調制器分成兩區，一區當參考，用相機量條紋位移。目標是讓灰階 0 到 2π 的對應成線性，使相位量化均勻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「灰階對相位查找表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

影響輸出波前的誤差來源有五類：查找表殘差、相位閃爍、背板修正殘差、單元間隙漸變與溫度漂移。液晶的雙折射隨溫度上升而下降，相位行程跟著縮，而吸收的雷射功率又會加熱液晶層，所以高功率下相位對灰階的對應會隨時間漂移。各項以均方根相加換算成 Strehl 比，才能決定需要水冷、溫控或定期重校。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「溫度、功率與相位誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整合時把調制器放在傅立葉透鏡的前焦面，目標圖樣就出現在後焦面；入射光須以線偏振對準液晶指向矢，入射角保持在 10° 以內以免相位行程按 cosθ 縮減並混入振幅調制。零階光總是聚在後焦面中心，可用空間擋板遮蔽或在相位圖上加線性相位斜坡把工作圖樣移開。可定址的視場由最大偏折角與焦距決定，光斑大小由孔徑決定，兩者的比值就是可解析點數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏振器、傅立葉透鏡與零階擋板」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

交接時要把調制器當成一個帶有校正檔案的光學元件：每個工作波長的查找表、背板修正相位圖、量測的相位行程、響應時間、閃爍、效率對光柵週期曲線與熱漂移斜率，都必須附上量測條件與日期。驗收指標以理論效率扣除反射率與填充因子後的比值表示，才能分辨是元件退化還是系統對準問題；壽命項則追蹤液晶在紫外與高功率下的雙折射衰減。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收報告與校正檔案包」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A phase-only liquid-crystal modulator uses a parallel-aligned nematic: with no field the director lies parallel to the substrates and light polarized along it sees the extraordinary index n_e; with voltage the director tilts toward the field, the effective index falls toward the ordinary index n_o, and the optical path through thickness d changes while the polarization state stays fixed, which is pure phase modulation. A reflective LCOS passes light through the layer twice, so the same cell gap gives double the phase stroke; molecules near the alignment layers cannot tilt fully, so the usable index change is only 70 to 80% of the material Δn. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The phase map of a liquid-crystal modulator is a staircase sampled at the pixel pitch p, and every pattern is limited by three factors at once: the minimum period of 2p sets the maximum steering angle; the number of pixels N per sawtooth period sets the staircase efficiency sinc²(1/N) relative to an ideal blaze; and inter-pixel gaps plus fringing fields at electrode edges smooth the phase across pixel boundaries, so short-period patterns fall below the scalar prediction. The area outside the fill factor reflects unmodulated light that becomes an irreducible zeroth order. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pixel lattice and blazed-grating pattern”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An LCOS device stacks a CMOS silicon backplane, top-metal pixel electrodes that double as mirrors, alignment layers, the liquid-crystal layer, an ITO common electrode and a cover glass; a dielectric multilayer over the electrodes raises reflectance from about 90% for aluminium to 98% for high-power use. After packaging and cover-glass bonding the backplane bows by several wavelengths and the cell gap ramps across the aperture, and both add to the output wavefront; precision applications therefore treat the backplane figure as a fixed aberration, measure it interferometrically and cancel it with a phase map. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CMOS backplane, pixel electrodes and cover glass”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Under voltage the liquid crystal tilts quickly because the field drives it, but after the voltage is removed it relaxes by elasticity alone, so the off time is the slowest and scales with the square of the gap and with rotational viscosity; cells thickened for long wavelengths respond markedly slower. The liquid crystal must be driven with alternating polarity to avoid ion accumulation; digital backplanes synthesize the effective voltage by pulse-width modulation and bit-plane switching makes the phase jitter in time (flicker), whereas analog backplanes hold the voltage directly with little flicker at the cost of more complex drive and DC balancing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “LC relaxation dynamics and drive waveform”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Drive voltage and phase are related nonlinearly and the relation changes with wavelength, temperature and device, so every modulator needs a grey-level-to-phase lookup table at each working wavelength. The common diffraction method fixes half of the pixels at grey level g₀ and sweeps the other half through g to form a binary grating whose first-order intensity varies as sin²(Δφ/2) with the phase difference, from which the phase is inverted; the interferometric method splits the modulator into two zones, uses one as reference and reads fringe shifts with a camera. The goal is a linear map from grey level to 0–2π so that phase quantization is uniform. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Grey-level-to-phase lookup table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Five classes of error affect the output wavefront: lookup-table residual, phase flicker, backplane-correction residual, cell-gap ramp and temperature drift. Liquid-crystal birefringence falls as temperature rises so the phase stroke shrinks, and absorbed laser power heats the layer, so at high power the phase-to-grey mapping drifts over time. The items are root-sum-squared and converted into a Strehl ratio before deciding whether water cooling, temperature control or periodic recalibration is required. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Temperature, power and phase-error budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

For integration the modulator sits in the front focal plane of a Fourier lens so that the target pattern forms in the back focal plane; the input must be linearly polarized along the director, with incidence kept within 10° so that the stroke is not reduced by cosθ and no amplitude modulation is mixed in. The zeroth order always focuses at the centre of the back focal plane and is either blocked by a spatial stop or pushed aside by adding a linear phase ramp to the pattern. The addressable field follows from maximum steering angle and focal length, the spot size from the aperture, and their ratio is the number of resolvable points. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polarizer, Fourier lens and zero-order stop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

At handoff the modulator is treated as an optical element shipped with calibration files: the lookup table for each working wavelength, the backplane correction map, measured stroke, response time, flicker, the efficiency-versus-period curve and the thermal-drift slope, each with measurement conditions and date. Acceptance is expressed as the ratio of measured efficiency to the theoretical value after reflectance and fill factor are removed, so that device degradation can be told from system misalignment; the lifetime item tracks birefringence decay of the liquid crystal under ultraviolet and high power. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance report and calibration file package”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把為可見光選的 2 µm 間隙元件用在 1064 nm，相位只到 1.2π，閃耀光柵的相位包裹處出現 0.8π 的缺口，光被散回零階，繞射效率不到三成。
沿用出廠 633 nm 查找表在 532 nm 工作，相位被放大 19%，鋸齒頂端過衝 0.38π，閃耀效率降到七成以下，殘餘光進入零階與負一階。
pitfallsEn: Using a 2 µm gap chosen for the visible at 1064 nm yields only about 1.2π of phase; every wrap of a blazed grating leaves a 0.8π gap, light is thrown back into the zeroth order and diffraction efficiency falls below 30%.

Reusing the factory 633 nm table at 532 nm scales phase by 19%, the sawtooth overshoots by 0.38π at each wrap, blaze efficiency drops below 70% and the remainder leaks into the zeroth and minus-first orders.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：數位微鏡光學引擎
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Digital-micromirror optical engines
guides.concept: 以 0.65 吋 1080p、7.56 µm 間距、±12° 傾角的數位微鏡元件為核心，推導照明 f 數與傾角的關係、微鏡陣列的繞射級位置與光展量上限，說明積分柱、TIR 稜鏡與投影鏡頭的設計規則，再以亮度鏈、對比、均勻度與圖樣時序的量測完成光學引擎的誤差預算與交接。
guides.conceptEn: Built around a 0.65-inch 1080p digital micromirror device with 7.56 µm pitch and ±12° tilt, the course derives the illumination f-number from tilt angle, the diffraction-order positions and étendue ceiling of the mirror array, states the design rules of integrator rods, TIR prisms and projection lenses, and closes the engine's error budget and handoff through measurements of the luminous-flux chain, contrast, uniformity and pattern timing.
procedure: 數位微鏡元件的每個鋁鏡面繞對角線軸在 +12° 與 −12° 兩個穩態之間切換。照明光以傾角兩倍（24°）的角度射入，開態鏡面把光反射到元件法線方向進入投影鏡頭，關態鏡面則把光反射到法線另一側 48° 處被光吸收器接走，未上電的平態鏡面反射到 24°。要讓三個反射錐彼此不重疊，照明與投影的錐半角都不能超過傾角，這直接決定了引擎的最小 f 數，也決定亮度上限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「±12° 微鏡傾角與照明入射角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

微鏡陣列本身是一個二維閃耀光柵：週期 7.56 µm 的鏡面格點讓反射光只能存在於離散的繞射級，而傾斜的鏡面像閃耀面一樣決定能量落在哪幾個級。寬頻 LED 照明時各波長的級互相填補，投影錐內看起來連續；用雷射照明時各級變成分立亮點，對比與均勻性都受影響。光展量 G = A·π·sin²θ 由鏡面面積與可接受的錐角決定，光源的光展量一旦超過它，多出的光無論如何都進不了引擎。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「7.56 µm 鏡面格點的繞射級」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每個像素由鋁鏡面、下方的軛與扭轉鉸鏈、定址電極以及 CMOS 記憶單元組成：記憶單元先寫入下一個狀態，重置脈衝釋放鏡面後靜電力把它拉到對應的著陸點，鉸鏈的扭轉在數微秒內完成並在著陸點以機械止擋與彈簧尖端定住。鏡面之間留有次微米間隙與中央通孔，決定填充因子；密封窗口鍍增透膜並承受全部光功率。鉸鏈的疲勞壽命以兆次切換計，而鏡面黏附是主要的可靠度風險。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鋁鏡面、扭轉鉸鏈與 CMOS SRAM 單元」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

照明光路要把光源的空間與角度分佈轉成在 DMD 上均勻、錐角剛好 f/2.4、長寬比 16:9 的照明。積分柱靠多次全反射把輸入端的不均勻打散，出口面以中繼鏡組放大成像到 DMD；光展量守恆使放大倍率同時縮小角度，所以柱內光錐遠比 DMD 上陡。TIR 稜鏡把 24° 入射的照明光以全反射折向 DMD，而法線方向的開態光穿過同一個空氣間隙進入投影鏡頭，讓照明與投影在極短的後焦距內共用空間。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「積分柱、中繼鏡組與 TIR 稜鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

引擎驗收以三組量測為主：以 9 點照度乘以投影面積得到流明並與光源流明乘上各級效率的亮度鏈比較；以全白／全黑影像量順序對比、以 4×4 棋盤量 ANSI 對比，後者更能反映鏡頭的眩光；以高速光電二極體記錄單一像素在二元與灰階圖樣下的時間波形，檢查圖樣率、位元時槽與消隱。亮度鏈的每一項都要獨立量過，才能知道損失集中在哪一級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「積分球、9 點照度計與高速光電二極體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

引擎的誤差預算把亮度、對比、均勻度與灰階準確度的損失各自歸到可量化的來源：DMD 吸收的光功率與驅動電功率決定陣列溫度，溫度過高會縮短鉸鏈壽命並改變切換時間；灰階由二進位時槽疊加而成，鏡面穩定時間與最低位元時槽同量級時，低灰階會非線性並出現輪廓；雷射照明的離散繞射級與相干散斑則讓均勻度隨波長與角度起伏。各項以均方根合成，再決定是否加散熱、降圖樣率或改用寬頻光源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「DMD 陣列溫度與熱阻模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

把引擎整合進 3D 列印、無光罩微影或結構光量測時，投影鏡頭的倍率決定像面的像素尺寸，而像方數值孔徑等於物方數值孔徑除以倍率，繞射光斑與景深都由它決定。DMD 側的 f/2.4 對應物方 NA 0.208；倍率越大像面像素越大、NA 越小、景深越深，解析度則由像素與繞射光斑中較大者決定。設計時要讓繞射光斑小於像素，又讓景深涵蓋平台的平面度與樹脂液面的起伏。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「投影鏡頭倍率與成像面像素」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

交接文件把引擎的光學規格與下游製程的敏感度連起來。對投影顯示，9 點均勻度與色彩不均勻以 ANSI 方法報告；對光固化列印，像面照度均勻度直接透過 Jacobs 固化深度關係 C_d = D_p·ln(E/E_c) 轉成層厚誤差，因此均勻度規格必須從列印公差反推。報告需附亮度鏈表、對比、均勻度地圖、畸變圖、灰階曲線、熱與壽命數據，以及控制器韌體與時槽補償表的版本。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「均勻度地圖、固化深度與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Each aluminium mirror of a digital micromirror device switches about a diagonal axis between two stable states at +12° and −12°. Illumination arrives at twice the tilt (24°); on-state mirrors send light along the device normal into the projection lens, off-state mirrors send it to 48° on the other side of the normal into a light absorber, and unpowered flat-state mirrors reflect at 24°. For the three reflected cones not to overlap, the half-angles of the illumination and projection cones must not exceed the tilt angle, which fixes the engine's minimum f-number and hence its brightness ceiling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “±12° mirror tilt and illumination incidence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The mirror array is itself a two-dimensional blazed grating: the 7.56 µm lattice allows reflected light only in discrete diffraction orders, while the tilted facets act as the blaze that decides which orders carry the energy. Under broadband LED illumination the orders of different wavelengths fill each other in and the projection cone looks continuous; under laser illumination the orders become separate bright spots that affect contrast and uniformity. The étendue G = A·π·sin²θ is fixed by mirror area and acceptance cone, and any source étendue beyond it cannot enter the engine by any means. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Diffraction orders of the 7.56 µm mirror lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each pixel consists of an aluminium mirror, a yoke and torsion hinge beneath it, address electrodes and a CMOS memory cell: the memory cell is written with the next state first, a reset pulse releases the mirror and electrostatic force pulls it to the matching landing point, where the hinge twist completes in a few microseconds and spring tips hold it against a mechanical stop. Sub-micrometre gaps between mirrors and the central via set the fill factor; a sealed window with antireflection coating carries the full optical power. Hinge fatigue life is counted in trillions of cycles, and mirror stiction is the main reliability risk. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aluminium mirror, torsion hinge and CMOS SRAM cell”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The illumination train must turn the source's spatial and angular distribution into uniform illumination on the DMD with exactly an f/2.4 cone and a 16:9 shape. The integrator rod scrambles the input non-uniformity by multiple total internal reflections, and relay optics image its exit face onto the DMD with magnification; étendue conservation makes that magnification shrink the angles, so the cone inside the rod is far steeper than at the DMD. The TIR prism folds the 24° illumination onto the DMD by total internal reflection while the on-state light along the normal passes through the same air gap into the projection lens, letting illumination and projection share space within a very short back focal distance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Integrator rod, relay optics and TIR prism”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Engine acceptance rests on three measurement groups: luminous flux from 9-point illuminance times projected area, compared with the flux chain of source lumens multiplied by each stage efficiency; sequential contrast from all-white/all-black images and ANSI contrast from a 4×4 checkerboard, the latter exposing lens veiling glare; and the time waveform of a single pixel under binary and grey-scale patterns recorded with a fast photodiode to check pattern rate, bit slots and blanking. Every stage of the flux chain must be measured on its own to locate where the loss concentrates. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Integrating sphere, 9-point lux meter and fast photodiode”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The engine error budget assigns losses in brightness, contrast, uniformity and grey-scale accuracy to quantifiable sources: optical power absorbed by the DMD plus drive electrical power sets the array temperature, and excess temperature shortens hinge life and alters switching time; grey levels are built from binary time slots, so when mirror settling is comparable to the least-significant-bit slot the low greys turn nonlinear and show contouring; under laser illumination the discrete diffraction orders and coherent speckle make uniformity vary with wavelength and angle. The items are root-sum-squared before deciding on more cooling, a lower pattern rate or a broadband source. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DMD array temperature and thermal-resistance model”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When the engine is integrated into 3D printing, maskless lithography or structured-light measurement, the projection magnification sets the pixel size at the image plane, and the image-side numerical aperture equals the object-side value divided by magnification, which in turn fixes the diffraction spot and depth of field. The f/2.4 at the DMD corresponds to an object-side NA of 0.208; larger magnification gives larger image pixels, smaller NA and deeper focus, with resolution set by the larger of pixel and diffraction spot. The design must keep the spot smaller than the pixel while the depth of field covers the platform flatness and resin-surface variation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Projection magnification and image-plane pixel”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The handoff document ties the engine's optical specifications to the sensitivity of the downstream process. For projection displays, 9-point uniformity and colour non-uniformity are reported by the ANSI method; for photopolymer printing, image-plane irradiance uniformity converts directly into layer-thickness error through the Jacobs cure-depth relation C_d = D_p·ln(E/E_c), so the uniformity specification must be derived backward from the print tolerance. The report carries the flux-chain table, contrast, uniformity map, distortion map, grey-scale curve, thermal and lifetime data, and the versions of controller firmware and slot-compensation tables. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Uniformity map, cure depth and acceptance report”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfallsEn: Enlarging the illumination cone to f/1.8 (16° half-angle) for brightness lets the on-state and flat-state cones overlap between 12° and 16°; black-level leakage cuts contrast from 2000:1 to 300:1 while brightness gains only about 70%.
Opening the projection lens to f/2.0 for a higher flux reading admits flat- and off-state leakage; lumens read 15% high while contrast halves, and the acceptance data contradict each other.
