guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：相位式計算全像
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Phase-only computer-generated holography
guides.concept: 以 1920×1080、8 µm 像素的相位型 SLM 與 300 mm 傅立葉透鏡為基準系統，說明重建面取樣與視窗大小的關係、Gerchberg–Saxton 演算法的收斂與計算成本、相位量化與像素包絡的效率損失，再以相機閉環校正、散斑與零階的誤差預算，以及近眼全像顯示的視角與眼盒限制，完成相位全像的設計到驗收流程。
guides.conceptEn: Using a 1920×1080, 8 µm phase-only SLM with a 300 mm Fourier lens as the reference system, the course explains replay-plane sampling and window size, the convergence and compute cost of the Gerchberg–Saxton algorithm, efficiency losses from phase quantization and the pixel envelope, then camera-in-the-loop calibration, a speckle and zeroth-order error budget and the field-of-view and eyebox limits of near-eye holographic displays, completing the design-to-acceptance flow of phase-only holograms.
procedure: 相位型計算全像把目標影像的資訊編碼成 SLM 上每個像素的相位，放在透鏡前焦面後，後焦面的光場是 SLM 場的傅立葉轉換。離散取樣決定兩個尺度：SLM 的像素週期 p 決定重建視窗的總寬度 λf/p，SLM 的總寬度 Np 決定重建面的最小解析單元 λf/(Np)，兩者相除就是每軸 N 個可定址點。零階總在視窗中心，所以實際影像通常安排在偏離中心的區域，且視窗之外會出現週期重複的高階影像。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SLM 平面與傅立葉重建面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Gerchberg–Saxton 在兩個平面之間交替投影：在 SLM 面把振幅強制為均勻（只保留相位），在重建面把振幅強制為目標、保留計算得到的相位，每次迭代用一對 FFT 往返。因為每一步都是在集合上的投影，重建面的誤差單調不增，通常在 20 到 50 次迭代後進入停滯；連續影像的結果帶有隨機相位造成的散斑，點陣目標則可用加權 GS 把各點強度誤差回饋成權重，使均勻度逼近 99%。它對初始相位敏感，不同隨機種子得到不同的局部解。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「GS 迭代迴圈與誤差曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

連續相位在元件上只能以有限階數表示：SLM 以 8 位元查找表給 256 級，靜態繞射元件則常只有 2 到 16 級。量化把部分能量推到共軛影像與其他繞射級，對類閃耀的相位結構效率約為 sinc²(1/M)。另一個與演算法無關的損失來自像素的有限孔徑：每個像素是寬度 a 的小孔，整個重建視窗被 sinc² 包絡調制，視窗邊緣的亮度明顯低於中心，必須在目標影像上預先以包絡的倒數補償。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相位階數與像素孔徑包絡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

同一張設計相位圖可以動態載入 SLM，或固化成靜態的多階繞射元件。靜態元件以多次微影與蝕刻在熔融石英上做出 2ᵏ 階的台階，每階的蝕刻深度由波長與折射率差決定，深度誤差直接變成相位誤差並把能量洩漏到零階；它只對設計波長正確，但無像素間隙、無閃爍且能承受高功率。動態載入時相位圖要先經查找表轉成灰階，再疊加元件的波前修正圖與線性相位斜坡；任何波長改變都需要重算或重新縮放相位。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多階蝕刻相位元件與 SLM 查找表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

模擬中的理想傅立葉轉換與真實光路之間有差異：SLM 相位非線性與邊緣電場、透鏡像差、光源的高斯強度分佈與對準誤差都會讓重建影像偏離設計。相機閉環把實際拍到的影像當成最佳化的回饋，透過可微分的傳播模型或學到的系統模型計算梯度並更新相位，使全像自動補償這些硬體缺陷。品質以峰值訊噪比、繞射效率與散斑對比三個指標共同描述，單一指標會互相掩蓋。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「重建面相機與閉環最佳化」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

相位全像的三個系統性誤差各有來源：連續影像的隨機相位解在相鄰像元之間干涉，產生對比接近 1 的散斑，時間多工 K 張獨立全像可把對比降到 1/√K，但受 SLM 幀率限制；零階來自未調制光與查找表誤差，固定落在視窗中心；波長漂移則按比例縮放整個重建面，使邊緣的點偏離設計位置。預算表把三者換算成同一組影像指標後，才能判斷是改演算法、改硬體還是改光源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「散斑對比、零階與波長漂移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

全像顯示不經傅立葉透鏡而直接以菲涅耳或角譜傳播到不同距離的平面，可同時在多個深度成像並提供真實的聚焦線索；每個深度平面在最佳化中以各自的傳播核計算，彩色則以三個波長分時逐一計算。但 SLM 的像素週期限制最大繞射角，因而限制眼盒寬度；SLM 的實際尺寸限制視角。兩者互相拉扯：小像素擴大繞射角卻縮小面板，所以近眼全像顯示的規格由像素週期與面板尺寸共同鎖定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「角譜傳播與近眼眼盒」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

交接的對象不只是相位圖，而是一個可重現的資料包：相位圖與其版本、波長、像素週期、焦距、查找表識別碼、波前修正圖、包絡補償係數，以及在指定硬體上量得的效率、PSNR、均勻度、零階與散斑對比。驗收以理論上限的比例訂門檻，使不同系統可以比較；回歸測試在固定時間間隔重跑同一組全像，追蹤硬體漂移。光鑷等應用還要把每個陷阱的功率預算一併列出。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「全像資料包與回歸測試」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A phase-only computer-generated hologram encodes the target image into the phase of every SLM pixel; with the SLM in the front focal plane of a lens, the field in the back focal plane is the Fourier transform of the SLM field. Discrete sampling fixes two scales: the pixel pitch p sets the total replay-window width λf/p, and the full SLM width Np sets the smallest replay resolution cell λf/(Np), so their ratio gives N addressable points per axis. The zeroth order always sits at the window centre, so the useful image is usually placed off-centre, and periodic higher-order copies appear beyond the window. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SLM plane and Fourier replay plane”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Gerchberg–Saxton alternates projections between two planes: on the SLM plane the amplitude is forced to be uniform (keeping only phase), on the replay plane the amplitude is forced to the target while the computed phase is kept, and each iteration makes one round trip with a pair of FFTs. Because every step is a projection onto a set, the replay error is non-increasing and usually stagnates after 20 to 50 iterations; continuous images carry speckle from the random phase, while spot-array targets can use weighted GS, feeding each spot's intensity error back as a weight so uniformity approaches 99%. It is sensitive to the initial phase, and different random seeds land in different local solutions. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “GS iteration loop and error curve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A continuous phase can only be represented with a finite number of levels on hardware: an SLM gives 256 levels through an 8-bit lookup table, whereas static diffractive elements often have only 2 to 16. Quantization pushes part of the energy into the conjugate image and other orders, with efficiency about sinc²(1/M) for blaze-like phase structures. A second loss independent of the algorithm comes from the finite pixel aperture: each pixel is a small aperture of width a, so the whole replay window is modulated by a sinc² envelope and the window edge is noticeably dimmer than the centre, which must be pre-compensated by dividing the target by the envelope. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Phase levels and pixel-aperture envelope”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The same design phase map can be loaded dynamically onto an SLM or frozen into a static multilevel diffractive element. A static element is made by repeated lithography and etching of fused silica into 2ᵏ-level steps whose etch depth per level follows from wavelength and index contrast; depth error becomes phase error directly and leaks energy into the zeroth order. It is correct only at the design wavelength but has no pixel gaps, no flicker and tolerates high power. For dynamic loading the phase map is first converted to grey levels through the lookup table, then the device's wavefront-correction map and a linear phase ramp are added; any wavelength change requires recomputation or rescaling of the phase. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multilevel etched phase element and SLM lookup table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The ideal Fourier transform in simulation differs from the real optical train: SLM phase nonlinearity and fringing fields, lens aberrations, the Gaussian intensity profile of the source and alignment errors all pull the replayed image away from the design. Camera-in-the-loop uses the captured image as feedback, computes gradients through a differentiable propagation model or a learned system model and updates the phase, so the hologram compensates these hardware imperfections automatically. Quality is described jointly by peak signal-to-noise ratio, diffraction efficiency and speckle contrast, because any single metric can hide the others. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Replay-plane camera and closed-loop optimization”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Three systematic errors of phase holograms have distinct origins: the random-phase solution for a continuous image interferes between neighbouring replay cells and produces speckle with contrast near 1, which time-multiplexing K independent holograms reduces to 1/√K within the limit of SLM frame rate; the zeroth order comes from unmodulated light and lookup-table error and stays fixed at the window centre; wavelength drift scales the whole replay plane proportionally so that edge points leave their design positions. Only after the budget converts all three into the same image metrics can one decide whether to change the algorithm, the hardware or the source. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Speckle contrast, zeroth order and wavelength drift”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A holographic display skips the Fourier lens and propagates directly by Fresnel or angular-spectrum methods to planes at different distances, forming images at several depths at once with true focus cues; each depth plane is computed with its own propagation kernel in the optimization, and colour is handled with three wavelengths in time sequence. The SLM pixel pitch, however, limits the maximum diffraction angle and therefore the eyebox width, while the physical SLM size limits the field of view. The two pull against each other: smaller pixels widen the diffraction angle but shrink the panel, so near-eye holographic display specifications are locked jointly by pitch and panel size. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Angular-spectrum propagation and near-eye eyebox”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

What is handed over is not only a phase map but a reproducible data package: the map with its version, wavelength, pixel pitch, focal length, lookup-table identifier, wavefront-correction map, envelope-compensation coefficients, and the efficiency, PSNR, uniformity, zeroth order and speckle contrast measured on the specified hardware. Acceptance thresholds are set as fractions of theoretical limits so that different systems can be compared, and regression tests rerun the same hologram set at fixed intervals to track hardware drift. Applications such as optical tweezers also list the per-trap power budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hologram data package and regression tests”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

相機曝光飽和時梯度失真，閉環把亮區壓暗以「降低誤差」，整體效率掉到五成而 PSNR 看似提升；驗收時影像偏暗才發現迴圈在錯誤的量測上收斂。
pitfallsEn: Placing the target image at the window centre stacks the zeroth-order spot on top of it, tens of times brighter than the image; the camera saturates and the algorithm is blamed, until the image is moved into a quadrant.

With the camera saturated the gradients are distorted; the loop dims bright regions to reduce error, overall efficiency falls to half while PSNR seems to improve, and only the dim image at acceptance reveals that the loop converged on a wrong measurement.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：多視角全像顯示校正
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Multiview holographic-display calibration
guides.concept: 從光場顯示的角取樣與全像的空間頻寬積出發，理解斜向柱狀透鏡、繞射式背光與眼動追蹤顯示為何必須逐台校正，再把摩爾相移映射、串擾與亮度漣波、熱漂移、延遲與深度驗收整合成可交接的多視角顯示校正工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the angular sampling of light-field displays and the space–bandwidth product of holography to see why slanted-lenticular, diffractive-backlight and eye-tracked displays must each be calibrated unit by unit, then integrate moiré phase-shift mapping, crosstalk and luminance ripple, thermal drift, latency and depth acceptance into a transferable multiview calibration record.
procedure: 多視角顯示把面板像素分配給不同的出射方向：每個透鏡或光學單元下方的子像素各自對應一個視點，觀察者兩眼落在不同視點便看到雙眼視差，頭部移動時則看到運動視差。面板總像素數固定，所以視點數 N 與每個視點的空間解析度直接互換；視角錐被切成 N 份，角取樣間隔 Δθ 決定能重現多深的立體內容。距螢幕平面 z 的點在相鄰視點間位移 z·Δθ，一旦超過透鏡節距影像便開始模糊，因此深度預算是角取樣的直接後果，而不是渲染軟體的設定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「視角錐與角取樣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

真正的全像顯示以空間光調制器重建波前，最大繞射角由像素節距決定：sinθ = λ/(2p)。視窗寬度 W 與視角 2θ 的乘積受空間頻寬積 N = W·2sinθ/λ 限制，而這個數正好等於該方向的像素數，因此像素數固定時螢幕越大視角越小，反之亦然。這個守恆與光展量（étendue）同源，透鏡或擴束器只能在 W 與 θ 之間交換，不能同時增加兩者。多視角全像必須逐視角校正，因為每個觀看方向只用到總頻寬中的一個子孔徑，各子孔徑的像差與相位誤差並不相同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SLM 像素節距與繞射錐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光場顯示最常見的光學層是斜向柱狀透鏡：透鏡以小角度斜跨 RGB 子像素，把視點數造成的解析度損失分攤到水平與垂直兩個方向，並打散黑色矩陣造成的摩爾紋。每個子像素屬於哪個視點由三個參數決定：以子像素為單位的透鏡節距、斜率與中心相位偏移；這些不是設計值，而是貼合後的實際值，因為模造公差、膠層厚度與溫度都會改變它們。透鏡通常以 UV 複製成型在玻璃上再光學貼合到面板，基材的熱膨脹係數必須與面板玻璃匹配。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「斜向柱狀透鏡與面板貼合」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

另一類被稱為全像的多視角顯示把方向性放在背光裡：光在導光板內以全反射傳播，板面上的奈米光柵把一部分光耦出到特定角度，每個光柵單元對應一個視點方向，前方的液晶面板只負責強度調制。耦出角由光柵方程式 sinθ_out = n·sinθ_g − λ/Λ 決定，同時依賴波長 λ 與導光角 θ_g；因此紅綠藍需要不同週期的光柵，而導光角的發散與光源頻寬都會直接變成視點方向的模糊。這類元件以奈米壓印或全像曝光製作，週期誤差 ΔΛ/Λ 會讓所有視點一起偏轉。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「導光板繞射耦出光柵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

視點映射校正的核心是讓顯示器自己顯示能放大參數誤差的圖樣：渲染只點亮單一視點的條紋，若假設節距與實際不同，固定位置的相機就會看到低頻摩爾條紋，條紋數放大了節距誤差，條紋傾角放大了斜率誤差，條紋相位給出中心偏移。數條紋只能把相對節距誤差壓到 10⁻³ 等級；要達到 10⁻⁵，必須逐步平移假設的中心相位做相移，在每個影像區塊擬合條紋相位。全像顯示則以相機在多個觀看位置做閉迴路相位校正，每個位置各有一組 Zernike 修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「摩爾條紋與相移圖樣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每個視點在角度上不是理想的方塊，而是有寬度的分布：透鏡像差、散焦、子像素開口與面板散射都會讓它變寬。視點窄時鄰點漏光少，但兩視點之間的方向亮度下陷，觀察者移動時看到明暗閃動（柵欄效應）；視點寬時亮度平順，但串擾讓深度邊緣出現疊影。串擾與漣波是同一個角分布的兩面，必須一起量、一起做預算，再把貼合錯位、熱漂移與量測不確定度依均方根加總。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「視點串擾與角亮度漣波」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

眼動追蹤型立體顯示（例如以高速視覺感測器追蹤雙眼的空間實境顯示器）不再固定 N 個視點，而是即時把左右兩個視點導向兩眼，並依眼睛位置重新渲染透視。這把面板解析度集中給兩眼，但引入新的系統變數：追蹤相機曝光、影像處理、渲染、面板掃描與液晶反應構成延遲鏈，觀察者移動時畫面落後，產生透視游移，甚至讓左右眼視區交界掃過眼睛。整合時要把延遲換算成位置誤差，再以運動預測補償。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「眼動追蹤與渲染延遲」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收要證明觀察者看到的三維幾何正確，而不只是每個參數都在範圍內。做法是渲染已知深度的靶點，用兩台模擬雙眼的相機或沿軌道移動的單一相機量它在螢幕平面上的視差，反推重建深度；同時記錄串擾矩陣、角亮度漣波、各視點的色度與亮度，以及溫度與觀看位置的影響。交接文件要包含映射參數、量測時的溫度、相機與鏡頭的校正檔和允許重新校正的條件，因為顯示器出貨後會在完全不同的溫度與照明下使用。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「深度靶與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A multiview display distributes panel pixels over emission directions: the subpixels beneath each lens or optical cell each feed one view, so two eyes landing in different views see binocular parallax and head motion reveals motion parallax. The panel pixel count is fixed, so the view count N trades directly against per-view spatial resolution; the view cone is cut into N slices and the angular pitch Δθ decides how deep the reproducible 3D content can be. A point at distance z from the screen plane shifts by z·Δθ between adjacent views, and once that exceeds the lens pitch the image blurs, so the depth budget is a direct consequence of angular sampling, not a rendering setting. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “View cone and angular sampling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A true holographic display reconstructs a wavefront with a spatial light modulator whose maximum diffraction angle is set by the pixel pitch: sinθ = λ/(2p). The product of window width W and viewing angle 2θ is bounded by the space–bandwidth product N = W·2sinθ/λ, which equals the pixel count along that axis, so for a fixed pixel count a larger screen means a narrower viewing angle and vice versa. This conservation has the same root as optical étendue: lenses or beam expanders only trade W against θ and never raise both. Multiview holograms must be calibrated view by view because each viewing direction uses only a sub-aperture of the total bandwidth, and the aberration and phase error of each sub-aperture differ. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SLM pixel pitch and diffraction cone”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The most common optical layer in light-field displays is the slanted lenticular: lenses tilted by a small angle across the RGB subpixels spread the resolution loss from view count over both horizontal and vertical directions and break up moiré from the black matrix. Which view a subpixel feeds is set by three parameters: lens pitch in subpixels, slant and centre-phase offset; these are not design values but as-bonded values, because moulding tolerance, adhesive thickness and temperature all change them. Lenses are usually UV-replicated on glass and optically bonded to the panel, and the substrate's thermal expansion must match the panel glass. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Slanted lenticular and panel bond”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Another class of multiview display marketed as holographic puts the directionality in the backlight: light travels inside a light-guide plate by total internal reflection, and nanoscale gratings on the plate couple part of it out at specific angles, each grating element serving one view direction while the LCD in front only modulates intensity. The outcoupling angle follows the grating equation sinθ_out = n·sinθ_g − λ/Λ and depends on both wavelength λ and guided angle θ_g, so red, green and blue need different grating periods, and any spread in guided angle or source bandwidth becomes blur in view direction. Such elements are made by nanoimprint or holographic exposure, and a period error ΔΛ/Λ deflects all views together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Light-guide grating outcoupler”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The core of view-mapping calibration is to make the display show patterns that magnify its own parameter errors: render stripes that light a single view, and if the assumed pitch differs from the real one a fixed camera sees low-frequency moiré fringes whose count magnifies the pitch error, whose tilt magnifies the slant error and whose phase gives the centre offset. Counting fringes only reaches a relative pitch error of about 10⁻³; reaching 10⁻⁵ needs phase shifting, stepping the assumed centre phase and fitting the fringe phase in every image block. Holographic displays are instead calibrated in closed loop with a camera at several viewing positions, each with its own set of Zernike corrections. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Moiré fringes and phase-shift patterns”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each view is not an ideal box in angle but a distribution with width: lens aberration, defocus, subpixel aperture and panel scatter all widen it. Narrow views leak little into neighbours but leave luminance dips between views, so a moving observer sees brightness flicker (the picket-fence effect); wide views give smooth luminance but crosstalk ghosts depth edges. Crosstalk and ripple are two faces of the same angular distribution and must be measured and budgeted together, with bonding misregistration, thermal drift and measurement uncertainty added root-sum-square. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “View crosstalk and luminance ripple”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Eye-tracked stereo displays, such as spatial-reality displays that follow both eyes with a high-speed vision sensor, no longer fix N views but steer a left and a right view to the eyes in real time and re-render perspective for the tracked positions. This concentrates panel resolution on two eyes but adds new system variables: tracking-camera exposure, image processing, rendering, panel scan-out and liquid-crystal response form a latency chain, so a moving viewer sees the picture lag, producing perspective swim or even sweeping the left-right zone boundary across an eye. Integration must convert latency into position error and compensate with motion prediction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Eye tracking and render latency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance must prove that the observer sees correct 3D geometry, not merely that each parameter is in range. The method is to render targets at known depths, measure their parallax on the screen plane with two cameras emulating the eyes or one camera moving along a rail, and invert that into reconstructed depth; at the same time record the crosstalk matrix, angular luminance ripple, per-view chromaticity and luminance, and the effects of temperature and viewing position. The handoff file must contain the mapping parameters, the temperature during measurement, the camera and lens calibration files and the conditions under which recalibration is allowed, because shipped displays operate at entirely different temperatures and lighting. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Depth target and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 內容團隊把物件放到螢幕前 100 mm 製造跳出效果，模糊達 1.55 mm（近 4 個節距），邊緣出現多重疊影；使用者抱怨失焦，工程團隊卻去重新貼合面板與透鏡，把時間浪費在不是根因的地方。

pitfallsEn: A content team places objects 100 mm in front of the screen for a pop-out effect, the blur reaches 1.55 mm (nearly four pitches) and edges show multiple ghost copies; users complain of defocus and engineering wastes time re-bonding the lens to the panel, which is not the root cause.

A calibration camera with 2% barrel distortion that was never corrected makes the fitted pitch differ between centre and edge, so the software writes lens distortion into the display parameters; from another viewpoint the edge misplacement grows, and every unit carries the fingerprint of the same lens.

guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Laser-speckle reduction
guides.concept: 從雷射照在粗糙屏幕上的隨機相量和出發，理解散斑對比 C = σ/⟨I⟩ 為何只能靠疊加獨立圖樣以 1/√N 降低，再把角度、偏振與波長多樣性、移動擴散片、多模光纖、等效人眼相機、投影鏡頭光展量與壽命驗收整合成可交接的散斑抑制工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the random phasor sum of laser light on a rough screen to see why speckle contrast C = σ/⟨I⟩ falls only as 1/√N by stacking independent patterns, then integrate angle, polarization and wavelength diversity, moving diffusers, multimode fibers, eye-equivalent cameras, projection-lens étendue and lifetime acceptance into a transferable speckle-reduction record.
procedure: 同調光照到粗糙度大於波長的屏幕時，觀察者每個解析單元內都有大量隨機相位的散射子波，它們在視網膜或感測器上做複數相加，形成隨機相量和。當相位完全隨機且散射子很多時，強度服從負指數分布，散斑對比 C = σ_I/⟨I⟩ = 1，稱為完全發展的散斑；去偏振屏幕把光分成兩個獨立偏振的散斑圖，C 降到 1/√2。人眼看到的是主觀散斑，顆粒大小由觀察者瞳孔而非屏幕決定，所以同一畫面在明亮環境下瞳孔縮小時，散斑更粗、更明顯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

降低散斑的唯一途徑，是在觀察者的一個解析單元與一個積分時間內疊加 N 個彼此不相關、強度相近的散斑圖；強度相加使 C = 1/√N。獨立圖樣來自三種多樣性：照明角度（投影光瞳相對觀察者瞳孔的立體角比）、偏振（最多 2 個圖樣）與波長（光源頻寬相對屏幕路徑差所需的去相關波長）。三者相乘得總縮減因子 R = R_角·R_偏·R_λ，每一項都有物理上限，所以設計要先把目標 C 換算成所需的 N，再分配給各項。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「角度、偏振與波長多樣性」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

角度多樣性要在時間上實現，最常見的元件是放在中間像面或光瞳附近的移動擴散片：擴散片每移動一個相關長度，屏幕上的散斑就換成一個新的獨立圖樣。旋轉擴散片速度高，但體積大且有軸承壽命問題；以電活性聚合物膜驅動的小型擴散片用 x、y 兩組電極以 90° 相位差產生圓周運動，避免線性往返在折返點停頓並重走相同路徑。關鍵在於：時間上的圖樣再多，有效 N 仍受投影光瞳能容納的角度數 N_角 封頂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「移動擴散片與相關長度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

另一條路是讓光源本身攜帶多樣性：多發射體雷射二極體陣列天生有波長分散，調變驅動電流也能展寬譜線；多模光纖則把光分到數以萬計的模態，各模態的群速度不同。但模態彼此仍是同調的，只有當模態間的最大光程差大於光源同調長度時，光纖出口才會變成多個互不相干的散斑圖，所以單頻雷射進多模光纖依舊滿是散斑。階躍折射率光纖的模態色散遠大於漸變折射率光纖，在去散斑用途上反而是優點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多模光纖與光源頻寬」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

散斑對比不是屏幕或光源的固有數字，而是對特定偵測器定義的量：偵測器孔徑決定顆粒大小與能收集多少角度多樣性，像素大小決定空間積分，曝光時間決定時間平均。要評估人眼感受，量測相機必須模擬眼睛：放在觀看位置、入瞳直徑等於瞳孔、對焦於屏面、每個顆粒至少兩個像素取樣、曝光接近眼睛的積分時間。任何一項不匹配都會讓 C 被系統性高估或低估，而且不同實驗室的數字無法比較。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「等效人眼散斑相機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

相機量得的對比是多個獨立變動來源的平方和：真正的散斑、散粒雜訊、像素響應不均（PRNU）與照明的低頻不均。要得到真正的散斑對比必須逐項估算並扣除；低頻不均可用高通濾波或局部平均正規化去除，但濾波尺度必須遠大於散斑顆粒，否則連散斑一起濾掉。另一個常被忽略的是部分相關：相鄰時間的圖樣若沒有完全去相關，有效 N 小於名目值，C 對曝光時間的曲線會比 1/√N 平緩並提早飽和。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「對比雜訊預算與飽和曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

散斑抑制最後要放進真實的投影機：照明的發散角受 DMD 或 LCOS 接受角與投影鏡頭 F 數限制，擴散片產生的角度若超出投影鏡頭的光展量就會被裁掉，變成光損而不是散斑改善。因此 R_角 的上限其實是投影鏡頭出瞳對屏幕的張角與觀察者瞳孔張角之比，與擴散片多強無關。要再往下降，只能在屏幕端加入多樣性（振動屏幕）、擴大波長分布，或在 RGB 純雷射與雷射螢光粉架構間取捨：螢光粉轉換出的光是寬頻非同調光，本身幾乎沒有散斑。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「投影鏡頭光瞳與振動屏幕」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

散斑驗收要涵蓋人眼與機器兩種觀察者：等效人眼相機（3 mm 入瞳、約 50 ms 曝光）評估觀感，短曝光工業相機（例如 1 ms）評估量測用途，兩者時間平均的圖樣數相差數十倍。驗收矩陣包含紅綠藍三色、屏幕多個位置與多個觀看角度，並記錄光源頻寬、擴散片軌跡與屏幕型號。移動件是散斑抑制系統的壽命瓶頸，交接資料要包含疲勞週期、噪音與失效時的退化特徵，因為擴散片一旦停止，散斑會立刻回到接近完全發展的水準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收矩陣與壽命紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: When coherent light strikes a screen rougher than a wavelength, every resolution cell of the observer contains many scattered wavelets of random phase that add as complex amplitudes on the retina or sensor, forming a random phasor sum. With fully random phases and many scatterers the intensity follows a negative-exponential distribution and the speckle contrast C = σ_I/⟨I⟩ = 1, called fully developed speckle; a depolarizing screen splits the light into two independent polarization patterns and C falls to 1/√2. The eye sees subjective speckle whose grain size is set by the observer's pupil rather than the screen, so the same picture shows coarser, more visible speckle in bright surroundings where the pupil contracts. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Screen roughness and observer pupil”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The only way to lower speckle is to stack, within one observer resolution cell and one integration time, N mutually uncorrelated speckle patterns of similar intensity; intensity addition gives C = 1/√N. Independent patterns come from three diversities: illumination angle (the solid-angle ratio of projection pupil to observer pupil), polarization (at most two patterns) and wavelength (source bandwidth relative to the decorrelation wavelength set by the screen's path-length spread). They multiply into a total reduction factor R = R_angle·R_pol·R_λ, each with a physical ceiling, so design first converts the target C into the required N and then allocates it among the three. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Angle, polarization and wavelength diversity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Angle diversity has to be delivered in time, most often by a moving diffuser near an intermediate image or pupil: each time the diffuser moves one correlation length the screen speckle becomes a new independent pattern. Rotating diffusers are fast but bulky and limited by bearing life; compact diffusers on electroactive-polymer membranes drive x and y electrodes 90° apart in phase to produce circular motion, avoiding the stall at the turning points of a linear stroke and the retracing of the same path. The key point is that however many patterns appear in time, the effective N is capped by the number of angles N_angle the projection pupil can hold. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Moving diffuser and correlation length”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Another route is to make the source carry diversity itself: multi-emitter laser-diode arrays have an inherent wavelength spread and modulated drive current can broaden the line, while a multimode fiber divides the light among tens of thousands of modes with different group velocities. The modes are still mutually coherent, though, and the fiber output becomes many mutually incoherent speckle patterns only when the maximum intermodal path difference exceeds the source coherence length, so a single-frequency laser in a multimode fiber still emerges full of speckle. Step-index fiber has far more modal dispersion than graded-index fiber, which here is an advantage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multimode fiber and source bandwidth”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Speckle contrast is not an intrinsic number of a screen or source but a quantity defined for a particular detector: the detector aperture sets grain size and how much angle diversity is collected, pixel size sets spatial integration and exposure time sets temporal averaging. To judge what the eye sees, the measuring camera must emulate the eye: placed at the viewing position, with an entrance pupil equal to the eye pupil, focused on the screen, sampling each grain with at least two pixels and exposing for about the eye's integration time. Any mismatch biases C systematically up or down and makes numbers from different laboratories incomparable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Eye-equivalent speckle camera”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The contrast a camera reads is a sum of squares of independent variations: true speckle, shot noise, pixel response non-uniformity (PRNU) and low-frequency illumination non-uniformity. Recovering the true speckle contrast means estimating and subtracting each term; low-frequency non-uniformity is removed by high-pass filtering or local-mean normalisation, with a filter scale far larger than the grain, otherwise speckle is filtered away too. Another often-ignored factor is partial correlation: if successive patterns are not fully decorrelated, the effective N is below nominal and the C-versus-exposure curve is shallower than 1/√N and saturates early. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Contrast noise budget and saturation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Speckle reduction must finally fit inside a real projector: illumination divergence is limited by the DMD or LCOS acceptance angle and the projection-lens F-number, and any diffuser angle beyond the lens étendue is clipped, turning into light loss rather than speckle improvement. The ceiling on R_angle is therefore the ratio of the angle the projection exit pupil subtends at the screen to that of the observer pupil, regardless of diffuser strength. Going lower requires diversity at the screen (a vibrating screen), a wider wavelength spread, or a trade between RGB pure-laser and laser-phosphor architectures, since phosphor-converted light is broadband and incoherent and carries almost no speckle. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Projection pupil and vibrating screen”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Speckle acceptance must cover two kinds of observer: an eye-equivalent camera (3 mm entrance pupil, about 50 ms exposure) for perceived quality and a short-exposure industrial camera (for example 1 ms) for measurement use, whose time-averaged pattern counts differ by tens of times. The acceptance matrix covers red, green and blue, several screen positions and several viewing angles, and records source bandwidth, diffuser trajectory and screen model. Moving parts are the lifetime bottleneck of a speckle-reduction system, so the handoff must include fatigue cycles, acoustic noise and degradation signatures, because the moment a diffuser stops the speckle returns to nearly fully developed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance matrix and lifetime record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 在暗室評估時觀察者瞳孔約 6 mm，散斑細到難以察覺而判定合格；產品裝進明亮大廳後瞳孔縮到 2 到 3 mm，顆粒變粗一倍以上，畫面出現閃爍砂粒感，客訴才出現。
供應商報告寫散斑對比 2%，但量測用 F/2 鏡頭與 10 ms 曝光；以等效人眼設定重量得 6%。採購依報告數字比價，選中了實際最差的方案。
pitfallsEn: Evaluated in a dark room with observer pupils near 6 mm, the speckle is too fine to notice and the design passes; installed in a bright lobby the pupils shrink to 2 to 3 mm, the grain more than doubles, the picture takes on a sparkling sandy texture and only then do complaints arrive.

A supplier report quotes 2% speckle contrast measured with an F/2 lens and 10 ms exposure; re-measured with eye-equivalent settings it reads 6%, and purchasing, comparing reported numbers, selects the option that is actually worst.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：數位全像顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Digital holographic microscopy
guides.concept: 從物光與參考光在感測器上形成的離軸干涉條紋出發，理解載波頻率如何讓單張全像圖分離出複數波前，再把相位展開、光源同調、物鏡曲率補償、折射率與波長校正、雜訊預算和數值重聚焦整合成可驗收的定量相位顯微工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the off-axis interference fringes that object and reference beams form on the sensor, see how the carrier frequency lets a single hologram yield the complex wavefront, then integrate phase unwrapping, source coherence, objective-curvature compensation, refractive-index and wavelength calibration, noise budgets and numerical refocusing into an acceptable quantitative-phase microscope.
procedure: 數位全像顯微鏡用相機記錄物光 O 與參考光 R 的干涉強度 I = |O|² + |R|² + OR* + O*R。若參考光以角度 θ 斜射，交叉項帶有空間載波 sinθ/λ，在頻譜中把 +1 階（含完整複數物光）、−1 階與零階分開；數值濾波取出 +1 階後就能同時得到振幅與相位。載波必須夠高才能分離三項，卻又不能高到讓條紋週期小於兩個像素而違反取樣定理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離軸干涉條紋與感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

重建得到的相位 φ = arg(O) 只在 (−π, π] 內有定義，實際光程差超過一個波長時相位會跳回，形成 2π 包裹。透射量測的相位 Δφ = 2π·(n_s − n_m)·h/λ 與樣品厚度 h 及折射率差成正比；反射量測因光來回兩次，Δφ = 4π·h/λ。展開演算法沿路徑補回 2π 跳變，但只在相鄰像素相位差小於 π 時可靠，陡峭台階需要雙波長合成波長來擴大不含糊範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「包裹相位圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

干涉條紋的對比取決於兩臂光程差與光源同調長度的關係，以及兩光束的強度比。長同調雷射讓裝調容易，但光學元件的寄生反射也會互相干涉，形成固定的同調雜訊；短同調光源能壓制這些雜訊，代價是兩臂光程必須匹配到同調長度的一小部分，並且樣品厚度變化也會讓對比下降。參考臂通常用可調延遲線與衰減器，把強度比與光程都調到設計點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射光源與參考臂」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

顯微物鏡把物光放大並投射到感測器，但也在物光上疊加一個球面相位，與平面參考光相減後留下二次項曲率，必須以參考臂放置相同物鏡做物理補償，或在重建時乘上數位相位遮罩做數值補償。感測器的像素尺寸、位元深度與滿井電荷決定條紋取樣與相位雜訊；同調照明下的橫向解析極限為 λ/NA，放大率需讓這個尺度在感測器上占數個像素。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「顯微物鏡與曲率補償」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

相位轉換成高度需要準確的波長與折射率差。反射式只依賴波長與入射角，可以用認證台階標準片直接驗證；透射式的厚度與折射率差耦合在同一個光程差裡，必須用兩種已知折射率的介質分別量測來解耦，或用已知厚度的樣品反推折射率。橫向比例尺則以載物台測微尺或光柵標板校正，和高度軸分開追溯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「台階標準片與折射率解耦」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

相位雜訊來自光子散粒雜訊、感測器讀出雜訊、同調雜訊（寄生干涉與散斑）、以及兩臂之間的機械振動與空氣擾動。散粒雜訊決定單張全像圖的極限，與條紋對比和每像素光電子數有關；振動與熱漂移主要造成整場的活塞項與傾斜項，可用視場內的參考平坦區自我參考去除；殘留的空間雜訊則來自同調雜訊與曲率擬合殘差，需分項列入預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「時間與空間相位雜訊圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

重建流程依序為：傅立葉轉換、+1 階濾波與移到中心、乘上曲率補償遮罩、以角譜法或菲涅耳法傳播到像面、取振幅與相位、展開並去除活塞與傾斜。角譜法對波前每個平面波分量乘上傳播因子 exp(i·2π·d·√(1/λ² − f²))，可精確處理短距離傳播；因為複數波前已被記錄，重聚焦只需改變 d，不必移動樣品，等於把景深延伸到遠超物鏡本身。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「角譜重建與數值重聚焦」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收不是只看單一指標，而是把橫向解析度、高度準確度、時間與空間雜訊、視場、重聚焦範圍與重建參數一起記錄。高度準確度用認證台階片與相符性指標 E_n 判定；解析度用標板的最小可分辨線對；雜訊用平坦鏡面連拍；重建參數檔（波長、像素尺寸、傳播距離、濾波視窗、補償遮罩）必須版本化存檔，否則同一張全像圖日後無法重現相同結果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收報告與重建參數檔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A digital holographic microscope records on a camera the interference intensity of object wave O and reference wave R, I = |O|² + |R|² + OR* + O*R. When the reference arrives at an angle θ, the cross terms carry a spatial carrier sinθ/λ that separates the +1 order, which contains the full complex object wave, from the −1 order and the zero order in the spectrum; filtering out the +1 order numerically gives amplitude and phase at once. The carrier must be high enough to separate the three terms yet low enough that the fringe period stays above two pixels, otherwise sampling fails. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Off-axis fringes and the sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The reconstructed phase φ = arg(O) is defined only within (−π, π]; when the real optical path exceeds one wavelength the phase jumps back, producing 2π wraps. In transmission Δφ = 2π·(n_s − n_m)·h/λ scales with sample thickness h and the index difference; in reflection the light travels twice, so Δφ = 4π·h/λ. Unwrapping algorithms restore the 2π jumps along a path, but only reliably when neighbouring pixels differ by less than π, so steep steps need a two-wavelength synthetic wavelength to extend the unambiguous range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wrapped phase map”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Fringe contrast depends on the arm path difference relative to the source coherence length and on the intensity ratio of the two beams. A long-coherence laser makes alignment easy but lets parasitic reflections from every optic interfere as fixed coherent noise; a short-coherence source suppresses that noise at the price of matching the two arm paths to a fraction of the coherence length, and thick samples also reduce contrast. The reference arm therefore carries an adjustable delay line and an attenuator to set both the path and the intensity ratio at the design point. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser source and reference arm”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The objective magnifies the object wave onto the sensor but also imposes a spherical phase on it; subtracting the plane reference leaves a quadratic curvature that must be compensated physically with an identical objective in the reference arm or numerically with a digital phase mask at reconstruction. Pixel pitch, bit depth and full-well capacity of the sensor set fringe sampling and phase noise; under coherent illumination the lateral resolution limit is λ/NA, and the magnification must map that scale onto several pixels. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Microscope objective and curvature compensation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Converting phase to height needs an accurate wavelength and index difference. Reflection measurements depend only on wavelength and incidence angle and can be checked directly with a certified step standard; in transmission, thickness and index difference are coupled in one optical path difference, so they are decoupled by measuring in two media of known index or by inferring index from a sample of known thickness. The lateral scale is calibrated separately with a stage micrometer or grating target. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Step standard and index decoupling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Phase noise comes from photon shot noise, sensor read noise, coherent noise from parasitic interference and speckle, and mechanical vibration and air turbulence between the arms. Shot noise sets the single-hologram limit and depends on fringe contrast and photoelectrons per pixel; vibration and thermal drift mainly add piston and tilt across the field, which self-referencing to a flat region removes; the remaining spatial noise comes from coherent noise and curvature-fit residuals and must be budgeted item by item. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Temporal and spatial phase-noise maps”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The pipeline runs: Fourier transform, +1-order filtering and recentring, multiplication by the curvature mask, propagation to the image plane by the angular-spectrum or Fresnel method, extraction of amplitude and phase, then unwrapping and removal of piston and tilt. The angular-spectrum method multiplies each plane-wave component by exp(i·2π·d·√(1/λ² − f²)) and handles short propagation distances exactly; because the complex wavefront is recorded, refocusing only changes d without moving the sample, extending the usable depth far beyond the objective's own depth of field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Angular-spectrum reconstruction and numerical refocusing”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance is not a single number but a record of lateral resolution, height accuracy, temporal and spatial noise, field of view, refocusing range and reconstruction parameters together. Height accuracy is judged with a certified step and the E_n compatibility index; resolution with the smallest resolved line pair of a target; noise with repeated flat-mirror captures; and the reconstruction parameter file (wavelength, pixel size, propagation distance, filter window, compensation mask) must be versioned, otherwise the same hologram cannot be reproduced later. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance record and reconstruction parameter file”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 參考光角度太小時 +1 階與零階重疊，重建相位出現低頻假象與對比損失；角度太大時條紋欠取樣而混疊，相位圖出現與樣品無關的摩爾紋。
把文獻的平均細胞折射率套用到所有樣品，厚度誤差可達 5% 到 10%，且不同細胞類型之間的差異會被誤讀為厚度差異。
pitfallsEn: Too small a reference angle overlaps the +1 and zero orders, producing low-frequency artefacts and contrast loss in the reconstructed phase; too large an angle undersamples the fringes and aliasing imprints moiré patterns unrelated to the sample.
Applying a literature-average cell index to every sample produces thickness errors of 5% to 10%, and differences between cell types are misread as thickness differences.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：光學同調斷層掃描
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Optical coherence tomography
guides.concept: 從寬頻光源的同調長度推出 OCT 的軸向解析度，理解頻域偵測如何把深度編碼成光譜干涉頻率、為何光譜儀的像素間距決定深度範圍與靈敏度衰減，再把光源頻寬、光譜儀色散、散粒雜訊極限、兩臂色散匹配與掃描光學整合成可驗收的斷層影像系統。
guides.conceptEn: Derive the axial resolution of OCT from the coherence length of a broadband source, see how Fourier-domain detection encodes depth as spectral interference frequency and why spectrometer pixel spacing sets depth range and sensitivity roll-off, then integrate source bandwidth, spectrometer dispersion, the shot-noise limit, arm dispersion matching and scanning optics into an acceptable tomographic imaging system.
procedure: OCT 是邁克森干涉儀的延伸：樣品臂的背向散射光只在與參考臂光程差小於光源同調長度時才產生干涉，因此干涉包絡的寬度就是深度方向的解析度，與物鏡數值孔徑無關。軸向解析度由中心波長與頻寬決定，橫向解析度則由聚焦光斑決定，兩者可以獨立設計；這正是 OCT 能用低數值孔徑光學取得微米級深度解析的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「寬頻光源與同調包絡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

頻域 OCT 不移動參考鏡，而是記錄整個光譜的干涉圖 I(k) ∝ S(k)[1 + Σ2√(R_r·R_n)·cos(2k·z_n) + …]；每個深度 z_n 對應光譜中一個頻率 2z_n，對 k 做傅立葉轉換即得到整條深度剖面。因為所有深度同時偵測，靈敏度比時域 OCT 高出 N/2 倍；但光譜儀有限的解析度讓高頻干涉條紋被平滑，深度越大、訊號越弱，這就是靈敏度衰減。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光譜干涉圖與傅立葉轉換」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

超輻射二極體提供數十奈米的頻寬與毫瓦級功率，掃頻雷射則以時間掃描波長；兩者都要求光譜平滑、無漣波，因為光譜上的任何週期結構會在深度剖面上變成假峰。頻寬加大能縮小 δz，但固定像素數的光譜儀必須覆蓋更寬的波段，每像素的 δλ 隨之變大、深度範圍縮小，所以頻寬選擇是解析度與深度範圍的直接取捨；眼睛的安全曝光上限又限制了可用功率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超輻射二極體與光譜形狀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光譜域 OCT 的光譜儀由準直鏡、繞射光柵、聚焦鏡與線型相機組成；光柵方程式 sinα + sinβ = mλ/d 給出偏向角，線色散 dλ/dx = d·cosβ/(m·f) 決定每個像素覆蓋的波長。相機像素在波長上等距，但傅立葉轉換需要在波數 k = 2π/λ 上等距，所以在轉換前必須重新取樣；省略這一步，點擴散函數會隨深度迅速變寬。光譜儀的聚焦品質決定 w 值，也就是衰減速率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光柵光譜儀與線型相機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

靈敏度定義為能以信噪比 1 偵測的最小樣品反射率，常以 dB 表示。當參考光足夠強使散粒雜訊主導時，靈敏度極限只取決於樣品臂回到偵測器的光子數：功率乘上曝光時間、除以光子能量、再乘上偵測效率。實際系統因耦合器分光、光譜儀效率與相機量子效率而低於極限數 dB，差距就是損耗預算；更高的 A 掃描速率縮短曝光時間，靈敏度按比例下降。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「散粒雜訊極限與靈敏度量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

參考臂與樣品臂若通過不同長度的玻璃、光纖或水，群速度色散會在干涉光譜上加入二次相位，使同調包絡像被啁啾的脈衝一樣展寬，軸向解析度變差且峰值下降。補償方法是在參考臂放入等效材料與長度的玻璃或水槽，或在重建時用數值方式乘上反向的二次相位並以峰值銳度最佳化係數。解析度預算需把光源頻寬實測值、殘留色散與光譜儀 k 標定誤差逐項列入。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「色散補償玻璃與點擴散函數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

樣品臂以一對振鏡在物鏡（眼底成像時是眼睛本身）的瞳孔共軛面上偏轉光束，掃描透鏡與中繼光學把偏轉角轉成視網膜上的位置。光斑大小由入瞳光束直徑與焦距決定，必須刻意保持低數值孔徑，讓焦深覆蓋整個感興趣的深度；橫向取樣間距需小於光斑的一半，否則細節混疊。A 掃描速率、每幅 B 掃描的 A 掃描數與體積大小共同決定擷取時間，而受測者的眼動限制了可接受的時間。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「振鏡掃描與眼底成像光學」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收必須證明深度軸可追溯：用已知厚度與群折射率的玻璃片量其在影像中的像素數，與理論光學厚度比較，確認每像素深度與線性度；用鏡面與中性濾鏡量靈敏度與衰減曲線；用散射假體確認在深度上的點擴散函數與對比。交接文件要記錄光源光譜、k 標定多項式、色散補償係數、掃描比例與所有驗收數據，讓日後任何重建都能重現。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「深度比例尺假體與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: OCT extends the Michelson interferometer: backscattered light from the sample arm interferes only when its path differs from the reference arm by less than the source coherence length, so the width of the interference envelope is the depth resolution, independent of objective numerical aperture. Axial resolution is set by centre wavelength and bandwidth, lateral resolution by the focused spot, and the two can be designed independently; this is why OCT achieves micrometre depth resolution with low-NA optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Broadband source and coherence envelope”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Fourier-domain OCT keeps the reference mirror fixed and records the interferogram across the spectrum, I(k) ∝ S(k)[1 + Σ2√(R_r·R_n)·cos(2k·z_n) + …]; each depth z_n maps to a spectral frequency 2z_n, and a Fourier transform over k returns the whole depth profile. Because all depths are detected simultaneously the sensitivity exceeds time-domain OCT by N/2; but the finite spectral resolution of the spectrometer smooths the high-frequency fringes, so signal falls with depth, which is the sensitivity roll-off. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Spectral interferogram and Fourier transform”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Superluminescent diodes deliver tens of nanometres of bandwidth at milliwatt power, while swept lasers scan wavelength in time; both need smooth, ripple-free spectra because any periodic spectral structure becomes a false peak in the depth profile. Wider bandwidth shrinks δz, but a spectrometer with a fixed pixel count must cover a wider band, so δλ per pixel grows and depth range shrinks; bandwidth choice is a direct trade between resolution and depth range, and ocular exposure limits cap the usable power. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Superluminescent diode and spectral shape”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The spectrometer of spectral-domain OCT consists of a collimator, a diffraction grating, a focusing lens and a line camera; the grating equation sinα + sinβ = mλ/d gives the diffraction angle and the linear dispersion dλ/dx = d·cosβ/(m·f) sets the wavelength per pixel. Camera pixels are equally spaced in wavelength but the Fourier transform needs equal spacing in wavenumber k = 2π/λ, so the data must be resampled before transforming; skipping this step broadens the point-spread function rapidly with depth. The focusing quality of the spectrometer sets w and therefore the roll-off rate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Grating spectrometer and line camera”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Sensitivity is the smallest sample reflectivity detectable at unit signal-to-noise ratio, usually quoted in dB. When the reference beam is strong enough for shot noise to dominate, the limit depends only on the number of sample-arm photons reaching the detector: power times exposure time divided by photon energy, times detection efficiency. Real systems fall a few dB short because of coupler splitting, spectrometer efficiency and camera quantum efficiency, and that gap is the loss budget; higher A-scan rates shorten the exposure and lower sensitivity proportionally. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Shot-noise limit and sensitivity measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

If reference and sample arms traverse different lengths of glass, fibre or water, group-velocity dispersion adds a quadratic phase across the interference spectrum, broadening the coherence envelope like a chirped pulse and lowering the peak. Compensation places glass or a water cell of equivalent material and length in the reference arm, or numerically multiplies by the inverse quadratic phase with coefficients optimized for peak sharpness. The resolution budget must list the measured source bandwidth, residual dispersion and the spectrometer k-calibration error item by item. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Dispersion-compensation glass and PSF”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The sample arm deflects the beam with a galvanometer pair at a pupil-conjugate plane of the objective, which for retinal imaging is the eye itself, and the scan lens and relay optics convert angle into position on the retina. Spot size follows from the entrance-beam diameter and focal length, and the numerical aperture is deliberately kept low so that the depth of focus spans the whole depth of interest; lateral sampling must be finer than half the spot or detail aliases. A-scan rate, A-scans per B-scan and volume size set acquisition time, which subject eye motion bounds. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Galvo scanner and retinal imaging optics”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance must prove that the depth axis is traceable: measure the pixel count of a glass plate of known thickness and group index, compare with its theoretical optical thickness to confirm depth per pixel and linearity; measure sensitivity and the roll-off curve with a mirror and neutral-density filters; and confirm point-spread function and contrast versus depth with a scattering phantom. The handoff record stores the source spectrum, the k-calibration polynomial, dispersion coefficients, scan scales and all acceptance data so that any later reconstruction can be reproduced. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Depth-scale phantom and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 用頻寬標示值而非實測頻寬估算解析度，再加上光譜被濾波或耦合器裁切，實際 δz 可能比預期差 30% 以上，薄層結構無法分辨。
參考光太強使相機飽和或進入過量雜訊區，或太弱使讀出雜訊主導，兩者都讓靈敏度偏離散粒雜訊極限 5 到 10 dB，深層弱散射組織消失在雜訊底之下。
pitfallsEn: Estimating resolution from the nominal rather than the measured bandwidth, with the spectrum further clipped by filters or couplers, can make the real δz more than 30% worse than expected, so thin layers are not resolved.

A reference beam strong enough to saturate the camera or enter the excess-noise regime, or weak enough for read noise to dominate, pushes sensitivity 5 to 10 dB away from the shot-noise limit, and weakly scattering deep tissue disappears below the noise floor.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：共軛焦顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Confocal microscopy
guides.concept: 從點照明與點偵測的共軛關係推導針孔為何能排除離焦光，用艾里單位把針孔直徑、橫向解析度與光學切片厚度連起來，再把螢光光子預算、振鏡掃描時序、偵測器死時間、折射率失配與奈奎斯特取樣整合成一台可驗收的雷射掃描共軛焦顯微鏡。
guides.conceptEn: Derive from the conjugate relation of point illumination and point detection why a pinhole rejects out-of-focus light, use Airy units to tie pinhole diameter to lateral resolution and optical-section thickness, then integrate the fluorescence photon budget, galvanometer timing, detector dead time, refractive-index mismatch and Nyquist sampling into an acceptable laser-scanning confocal microscope.
procedure: 共軛焦顯微鏡把雷射聚成一個繞射極限光點照明樣品，並在偵測路徑上與焦點共軛的位置放一個針孔；焦平面上的螢光成像在針孔中心通過，離焦平面的螢光在針孔處散成大斑而大部分被擋掉。系統點擴散函數是照明與偵測點擴散函數的乘積，因此橫向解析度略優於寬場，而沿光軸的訊號隨離焦距離快速衰減，形成光學切片。針孔直徑以艾里單位（AU）表示，1 AU 等於艾里斑第一暗環的直徑。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

螢光分子吸收激發光子後在奈秒內放出較長波長的光子，激發與發射的波長差（Stokes 位移）讓二向色鏡與發射濾鏡能把激發光擋掉。每個分子的發射速率受吸收截面、激發強度與激發態壽命限制，接近飽和強度時再加雷射功率只會加速光漂白。共軛焦的像素停留時間只有微秒，收集立體角、光學穿透率與偵測器量子效率又把到達偵測器的光子再砍一個數量級，因此每像素常只有數十個光子，散粒雜訊主導影像品質。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光激發與光子計數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

一對振鏡在物鏡後焦面的共軛位置偏轉光束，掃描透鏡與管鏡把角度轉成樣品面上的位置；振鏡在每條掃描線末端需要減速與回程，所以有效停留時間小於幀時間除以像素數。共振掃描器以固定頻率正弦掃描，速度快但每像素的停留時間只有數十奈秒，光子數大幅減少。物鏡的焦距（管鏡焦距除以放大率）與掃描半角決定最大視場，像素尺寸則由視場除以像素數決定，要達到奈奎斯特條件必須小於橫向半高寬的一半。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「振鏡掃描器與掃描透鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

針孔是可變直徑的機械光闌，必須精確對準到偵測光路的共軛焦點，橫向偏差超過十分之一艾里單位就會損失訊號並使切片不對稱。偵測器從多鹼光電倍增管進展到 GaAsP 光陰極與混合式偵測器，量子效率從約 20% 提升到 40% 以上；光子計數模式消除增益雜訊，但每個脈衝後有死時間，計數率高時會漏計，需要修正或降低功率。光譜偵測以稜鏡或光柵把發射光分散到多陽極偵測器上，容許多染料的線性拆分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「GaAsP 偵測器與針孔機構」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

校正分三個層次：橫向比例尺用已知週期的格線標板；三維點擴散函數用次解析度螢光珠，量半高寬並與理論比較以判斷物鏡、針孔與對準狀態；多通道配準用多色螢光珠量各波長之間的橫向與軸向偏移。物鏡的軸向色差在 488 與 640 nm 之間常有一到數百奈米，若不校正，雙色共定位會出現假陽性或假陰性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光珠 PSF 與格線標板」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

油鏡設計用於折射率 1.518 的介質，當焦點進入折射率 1.33 的水性樣品時，光線在蓋玻片界面折射，焦點移動量小於載物台位移，影像在 z 方向被拉長；同時邊緣光線與近軸光線的焦點分離，產生隨深度增加的球差，軸向點擴散函數變寬、峰值下降。軸向量測的誤差預算因此包含比例因子（系統誤差）、球差造成的半高寬展寬、z 步進的量化與載物台重複性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「折射率失配與軸向比例」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整合階段要把雷射合併與 AOTF 功率控制、掃描時序、針孔、偵測器與 z 驅動統一在一個擷取流程裡，並依奈奎斯特條件決定 x、y、z 取樣。共軛焦在擷取每一層時，整個雙錐照明體積都被曝光，所以厚樣品的每個體素會被照射到次數等於層數，劑量管理必須把層數、通道數與幀平均一起算進去；時序影像還要在訊號雜訊比與漂白之間決定幀間隔。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Z 疊層時序與雷射劑量表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收以測試矩陣進行：每個物鏡的三維點擴散函數、視場照度均勻性、通道配準、每條雷射線在樣品面的功率與穩定度、偵測器線性與死時間、載物台與 z 驅動重複性。每項設定允收門檻並附量測方法，結果與校正檔、韌體與軟體版本一起歸檔；交接文件還需記載針孔對準基準、AOTF 功率對照表與已知限制（例如深層水性樣品需水鏡），使後續使用者能判斷系統狀態是否仍在驗收範圍內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收矩陣與校正檔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A confocal microscope focuses the laser to a diffraction-limited spot and places a pinhole in the detection path at a position conjugate to that focus; fluorescence from the focal plane passes through the pinhole centre, while light from out-of-focus planes spreads into a large patch at the pinhole and is mostly blocked. The system point-spread function is the product of the illumination and detection functions, so lateral resolution is slightly better than widefield and the axial signal decays quickly with defocus, producing an optical section. Pinhole diameter is quoted in Airy units, 1 AU being the diameter of the first dark ring of the Airy disc. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A fluorophore absorbs an excitation photon and within nanoseconds emits a longer-wavelength photon; the excitation-emission wavelength gap (Stokes shift) lets a dichroic and an emission filter block the excitation light. Each molecule's emission rate is limited by absorption cross-section, excitation intensity and excited-state lifetime, and near the saturation intensity more laser power only accelerates photobleaching. Confocal pixel dwell times are microseconds, and collection solid angle, optical transmission and detector quantum efficiency cut the photons reaching the detector by another order of magnitude, so a pixel often holds only tens of photons and shot noise governs image quality. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fluorescence excitation and photon count”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A galvanometer pair deflects the beam at a plane conjugate to the objective back focal plane, and the scan lens and tube lens convert angle into position on the sample; the mirrors must decelerate and fly back at each line end, so the effective dwell is less than frame time divided by pixel count. A resonant scanner oscillates sinusoidally at a fixed frequency, fast but with only tens of nanoseconds per pixel and far fewer photons. The objective focal length (tube-lens focal length over magnification) and scan half-angle set the maximum field, pixel size is field over pixel count, and Nyquist sampling requires it to be below half the lateral FWHM. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Galvanometer scanners and scan lens”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The pinhole is a variable mechanical aperture that must sit precisely at the conjugate focus of the detection path; a lateral offset above a tenth of an Airy unit loses signal and skews the section. Detectors progressed from multialkali photomultipliers to GaAsP photocathodes and hybrid detectors, raising quantum efficiency from about 20% to above 40%; photon-counting mode removes gain noise but each pulse is followed by a dead time, so high count rates undercount and need correction or lower power. Spectral detection disperses the emission with a prism or grating onto a multi-anode detector, allowing linear unmixing of several dyes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “GaAsP detector and pinhole mechanism”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Calibration has three layers: lateral scale with a grid target of known pitch; the three-dimensional point-spread function with sub-resolution fluorescent beads, measuring FWHM against theory to judge objective, pinhole and alignment; and multichannel registration with multicolour beads to measure lateral and axial offsets between wavelengths. Axial chromatic aberration of an objective between 488 and 640 nm is often one to several hundred nanometres, and without correction two-colour colocalization yields false positives or negatives. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fluorescent-bead PSF and grid target”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An oil objective is designed for a medium of index 1.518; when the focus enters an aqueous sample of index 1.33, rays refract at the coverslip interface, the focus moves less than the stage, and the image is stretched along z; at the same time marginal and paraxial rays focus apart, producing spherical aberration that grows with depth, broadening the axial point-spread function and lowering its peak. The axial error budget therefore holds a scale factor (systematic), aberration-induced broadening, z-step quantization and stage repeatability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Refractive-index mismatch and axial scaling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Integration unifies laser combining with AOTF power control, scan timing, pinhole, detectors and the z-drive in one acquisition pipeline, with x, y and z sampling fixed by Nyquist. Because the whole double-cone illumination volume is exposed while each slice is acquired, every voxel of a thick sample is irradiated as many times as there are slices, so dose management must count slices, channels and frame averaging together; a time series must also balance signal-to-noise against bleaching when choosing the frame interval. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Z-stack timing and laser-dose table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance follows a test matrix: three-dimensional point-spread function per objective, field illumination uniformity, channel registration, power and stability of each laser line at the sample plane, detector linearity and dead time, and stage and z-drive repeatability. Each item carries an acceptance threshold and a measurement method, and results are archived with calibration files and firmware and software versions; the handoff record also lists the pinhole alignment reference, the AOTF power lookup table and known limits such as the need for a water objective in deep aqueous samples, so later users can judge whether the system still sits inside its accepted range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance matrix and calibration files”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfallsEn: Opening the pinhole beyond 3 AU for brightness lets a large out-of-focus background reach the detector, section thickness grows to several micrometres, and images of thick samples degrade toward a widefield-like blur.

Measuring the point-spread function with oversized 500 nm beads inflates the FWHM with the bead size, leading to a false diagnosis of objective degradation and an unnecessary repair; or claiming colocalization of two proteins without chromatic registration.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：雙光子顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Two-photon microscopy
guides.concept: 從雙光子吸收率與強度平方成正比出發，理解為何飛秒脈衝、高數值孔徑與非去掃描偵測能在散射組織深處取得固有光學切片，再把脈衝展寬、散射長度、功率與熱負載、點擴散函數校正和共振掃描時序整合成可驗收的雙光子成像系統。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the quadratic intensity dependence of two-photon absorption to see why femtosecond pulses, high numerical aperture and non-descanned detection give intrinsic optical sections deep in scattering tissue, then integrate pulse broadening, scattering length, power and heat load, point-spread calibration and resonant-scan timing into an acceptable two-photon imaging system.
procedure: 雙光子激發要求兩個近紅外光子在飛秒內同時被同一分子吸收，速率正比於強度平方 I²，所以只有焦點附近強度最高的微小體積才有效發光；離焦平面的總激發量隨離焦距離以 1/z² 衰減，不需要針孔就能切片。要把平均功率不高的光做到足夠的瞬時強度，必須用鎖模雷射把能量壓縮成約 100 fs 的脈衝，並以約 80 MHz 重複；在固定平均功率下，脈衝越短、重複率越低，每個脈衝的激發機率越高。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「焦點處的 I² 激發體積」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

激發只靠到達焦點的彈道光子，而彈道功率隨深度按 exp(−z/l_s) 衰減，雙光子訊號因此按 exp(−2z/l_s) 下降；要維持訊號必須讓表面功率隨深度指數上升。近紅外波長越長散射越弱，920 nm 在腦皮質的散射長度約 200 µm，1300 nm 約 350 µm，所以長波長能以更少功率到達同樣深度，代價是水的吸收上升與可用的螢光蛋白較少。當表面附近的離焦雙光子背景與焦點訊號相當時，就到達成像深度極限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「散射組織中的彈道光子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鈦藍寶石雷射可在 680 到 1080 nm 調諧，摻鐿光纖雷射提供 920 或 1030 nm 的固定波長與較高功率。脈衝通過聲光調制器、掃描透鏡、管鏡與物鏡時，群延遲色散使不同波長成分延遲不同，脈衝在樣品處被展寬數倍，雙光子訊號按 1/τ 下降。預補償以稜鏡對、光柵對或啁啾鏡在雷射出口加入負色散，使脈衝到達焦點時最短；二氧化碲調制器的色散特別大，是常被忽略的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「預啁啾稜鏡對與自相關儀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雙光子用低放大率、高數值孔徑、長工作距離的水浸物鏡，其後孔徑可達 15 到 20 mm，雷射光束必須擴束到填滿後孔徑才能得到設計的數值孔徑與最小激發體積。螢光從深處出射時幾乎全部被散射，離開表面時分布在遠大於焦點的區域；非去掃描偵測把 GaAsP 光電倍增管放在物鏡後方最近處，以大面積直接收集，而不是把光送回掃描器與針孔。偵測路徑只需阻擋激發光，不需成像品質。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「大瞳孔物鏡與非去掃描偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

因為訊號與功率平方成正比，功率的校正誤差會被放大兩倍；Pockels 盒的穿透率對電壓是正弦曲線，必須以樣品面的功率計建立對照表並定期重量。脈衝寬度要在樣品面以自相關儀量，雙曲正割脈衝的自相關半高寬是脈衝寬度的 1.54 倍。點擴散函數以 0.2 µm 珠子在表面與深處各量一次，判斷光束填充、色散與球差狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「樣品面功率計與功率平方曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雙光子影像每像素的光子數常只有個位數到數十個，散粒雜訊主導；光電倍增管的增益起伏再引入過量雜訊因子 F，GaAsP 管約 1.2 到 1.4，使有效信噪比下降。改善途徑是提高每脈衝激發效率、增加停留時間或幀平均，而非單純加功率。熱負載來自水對近紅外的吸收與組織散射後的沉積，與平均功率成正比；1300 nm 的水吸收比 920 nm 高約 20 倍，同樣功率下發熱更明顯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子計數直方圖與熱負載估計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整合階段把雷射、預補償、Pockels 盒、掃描器、物鏡 z 驅動與偵測器納入同一時序。共振掃描器以固定 8 kHz 正弦擺動，雙向取線可達每秒 16,000 條線，但像素停留時間縮到數十奈秒，每像素只落下幾個雷射脈衝，訊號極度受限；振鏡掃描則慢但停留時間長。Pockels 盒在回程與視場外閘控雷射以減少劑量；正弦速度不均需以像素時脈補償，否則視場邊緣被拉伸。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共振掃描器與像素時脈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收要同時在表面與深處證明性能：表面用螢光珠量點擴散函數，深處用含脂肪乳劑的瓊脂假體在 300 µm 處再量一次，判斷散射與球差的退化；用螢光素溶液確認功率平方律與脈衝最短點；用功率計與自相關儀記錄每條波長的樣品面功率與脈衝寬度。交接文件包含 Pockels 對照表、預補償設定對物鏡與波長的表格、各偵測器的 F 值與允收結果，並註明熱安全的平均功率上限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「散射假體驗收與交接文件」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Two-photon excitation needs two near-infrared photons absorbed by the same molecule within femtoseconds, at a rate proportional to the squared intensity I², so only the tiny volume of highest intensity around the focus emits efficiently; the total excitation in out-of-focus planes falls as 1/z² with defocus, giving sectioning without a pinhole. To reach sufficient instantaneous intensity from modest average power, a mode-locked laser compresses the energy into pulses of about 100 fs repeated at about 80 MHz; at fixed average power, shorter pulses and lower repetition rate raise the excitation probability per pulse. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “I² excitation volume at the focus”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Excitation relies only on ballistic photons reaching the focus, and ballistic power decays with depth as exp(−z/l_s), so the two-photon signal falls as exp(−2z/l_s); keeping signal constant requires surface power to rise exponentially with depth. Longer near-infrared wavelengths scatter less: in cortex the scattering length is about 200 µm at 920 nm and about 350 µm at 1300 nm, so the longer wavelength reaches the same depth with less power, at the cost of higher water absorption and fewer suitable fluorescent proteins. The depth limit is reached when out-of-focus two-photon background near the surface equals the focal signal. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ballistic photons in scattering tissue”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Ti:sapphire lasers tune from 680 to 1080 nm, while ytterbium fibre lasers give fixed 920 or 1030 nm output at higher power. As pulses pass the acousto-optic modulator, scan lens, tube lens and objective, group-delay dispersion delays spectral components differently, so the pulse at the sample stretches several times and two-photon signal falls as 1/τ. Precompensation adds negative dispersion with a prism pair, grating pair or chirped mirrors at the laser output so that the pulse is shortest at the focus; tellurium-dioxide modulators have especially large dispersion and are an often overlooked source. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Prechirp prism pair and autocorrelator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Two-photon systems use low-magnification, high-NA, long-working-distance water-immersion objectives whose back apertures reach 15 to 20 mm, and the laser beam must be expanded to fill that aperture to obtain the design NA and the smallest excitation volume. Fluorescence leaving deep tissue is almost entirely scattered and emerges over an area far larger than the focus; non-descanned detection places GaAsP photomultipliers as close as possible behind the objective to collect over a large area instead of returning light through the scanner and a pinhole. The detection path only has to block the excitation and needs no imaging quality. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Large-pupil objective and non-descanned detector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Because signal scales with the square of power, any power calibration error is doubled; the transmission of a Pockels cell is sinusoidal in voltage, so a lookup table must be built with a power meter at the sample plane and re-measured periodically. Pulse width is measured at the sample plane with an autocorrelator, where the autocorrelation FWHM of a hyperbolic-secant pulse is 1.54 times the pulse width. The point-spread function is measured with 0.2 µm beads at the surface and at depth to judge beam filling, dispersion and spherical aberration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sample-plane power meter and P² curve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A two-photon image often holds only single digits to tens of photons per pixel, so shot noise dominates; gain fluctuations of the photomultiplier add an excess-noise factor F of about 1.2 to 1.4 for GaAsP tubes, lowering the effective signal-to-noise ratio. Improvement comes from higher per-pulse excitation efficiency, longer dwell or frame averaging rather than simply more power. Heat load comes from water absorption of near-infrared light and deposition of scattered light, proportional to average power; water absorbs about 20 times more at 1300 nm than at 920 nm, so the same power heats more. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon-count histogram and heat-load estimate”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Integration brings the laser, precompensation, Pockels cell, scanners, objective z-drive and detectors into one timing scheme. A resonant scanner oscillates sinusoidally at a fixed 8 kHz and bidirectional acquisition yields 16,000 lines per second, but pixel dwell shrinks to tens of nanoseconds so only a few laser pulses land per pixel and signal is severely limited; galvanometer scanning is slower but dwells longer. The Pockels cell gates the laser during fly-back and outside the field to cut dose, and the nonuniform sinusoidal velocity must be corrected with the pixel clock or the field edges stretch. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Resonant scanner and pixel clock”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance must prove performance at the surface and at depth: beads at the surface for the point-spread function, a lipid-emulsion agarose phantom at 300 µm for a second measurement that reveals scattering and spherical-aberration degradation; fluorescein solution to confirm the power square law and the shortest-pulse setting; and a power meter plus autocorrelator to log sample-plane power and pulse width at each wavelength. The handoff record holds the Pockels lookup table, the precompensation setting per objective and wavelength, each detector's F value and the acceptance results, and states the thermally safe average-power ceiling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Scattering-phantom acceptance and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfallsEn: Driving power until each pulse yields nearly one photon pair saturates the excitation, the slope drops from 2 to below 1, the point-spread function broadens, sectioning thickens, and higher-order absorption at the focus causes irreversible damage.

Converting laser-output power to sample power while ignoring an objective transmission of only about 70% at 920 nm underestimates the real power by 30%, puts the expected signal off by more than 50% and makes results incomparable across systems.
