guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：光片顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Light-sheet microscopy
guides.concept: 從照明與偵測互相垂直的光路出發，理解光片顯微鏡為何能以極低光劑量做活體與透明化組織的 3D 成像，再把光束腰與瑞利長度、掃描光片與滾動快門同步、偵測取樣、光片共面校正、散射與折射率失配預算、多視角融合與資料管線整合成可交接的光片系統工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from mutually perpendicular illumination and detection paths to see why light-sheet microscopes image live and cleared samples in 3D at very low light dose, then integrate beam waist and Rayleigh range, scanned sheets synchronized to rolling shutters, detection sampling, sheet coplanarity calibration, scattering and index-mismatch budgets, multiview fusion and data pipelines into a transferable light-sheet system record.
procedure: 光片顯微鏡把照明與偵測拆成兩條互相垂直的光路：照明物鏡從側面送入一片薄光，只激發偵測物鏡焦平面附近的螢光，偵測物鏡則以寬場方式一次拍下整個平面。和寬場或共軛焦顯微鏡不同，拍這一層時焦平面外的分子根本沒有被照到，所以光學切片來自照明而不是針孔，整個體積的光劑量與光漂白大幅降低。代價是樣品必須能從側面進光，並放在充滿浸潤液的樣品槽中，與兩支物鏡的工作距離和幾何互相牽制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「正交照明與偵測物鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

以高斯光束形成的光片最薄處是光束腰 w0，離開腰後依 w(z) = w0·√(1 + (z/z_R)²) 變厚，瑞利長度 z_R = πn·w0²/λ。習慣上把可用視野定為 2z_R，此時邊緣厚度是中心的 √2 倍；由於 z_R 與 w0² 成正比，光片薄一半，可用視野就縮成四分之一。貝索光束與晶格光片以錐狀角譜延長無繞射長度，但貝索光束的旁瓣攜帶大量能量，在焦平面外造成背景與漂白；晶格光片以干涉圖樣壓抑旁瓣，在厚度、視野與旁瓣之間取得不同平衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高斯光束腰與瑞利長度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光片可以用柱狀透鏡一次形成靜態平面，也可以用振鏡把細光束在焦平面內快速掃過（數位掃描光片），後者強度均勻、可逐行調變，還能做擺動掃描改變入射角，把吸收物造成的條紋陰影平均掉。要突破厚度與視野的取捨，可用電調焦透鏡沿傳播方向移動光束腰，並與 sCMOS 相機的滾動快門同步，讓每一列像素只在光束腰經過時曝光，整個視野都用最薄的那段光片成像。代價是同步時序變成關鍵規格，振鏡、透鏡與相機的觸發抖動直接變成厚度誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「振鏡、電調透鏡與滾動快門」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

偵測端本身是一台寬場顯微鏡：物鏡 NA 決定橫向解析度與景深，相機像素換算到樣品端的大小決定是否滿足奈奎斯特取樣。光片系統的軸向點擴散函數是照明光片剖面與偵測軸向 PSF 的乘積，兩者都影響軸向解析度：低 NA 偵測的大視野系統由光片厚度主導，高 NA 偵測時由偵測景深主導，光片則負責壓抑焦外背景。偵測物鏡必須浸在樣品槽介質中，工作距離、物鏡外殼角度與照明物鏡的幾何干涉限制了可用的 NA 組合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偵測物鏡與 sCMOS 取樣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光片必須與偵測物鏡的焦平面完全共面：光片中心偏離焦平面會讓訊號下降、背景上升；光片相對焦平面有傾角時，視野一側在焦內、另一側在焦外。校正通常用螢光珠或均勻螢光樣品，依序調整光片高度（照明側振鏡偏移）、傾角（與物鏡後焦面共軛的振鏡或鏡座）與光束腰位置（照明物鏡或電調透鏡），每一項都以影像銳利度或珠的軸向 PSF 為指標。雙側照明時兩片光必須分別對位，並確認兩者在中央重合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光片傾角與焦平面共面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光片從側面穿過樣品，深處的光要先經過前方組織：散射把彈道光子轉成背景並讓光片變厚，吸收物（色素、卵黃）在其後方投下條紋陰影。樣品折射率與浸潤介質不同時，偵測物鏡看到的焦平面隨深度漂移，光片與焦平面逐漸分離。對策包括雙側照明（每側只負責一半寬度）、擺動掃描、多角度取像，以及組織透明化搭配折射率相符的介質；活體大樣品則需要隨深度動態補償焦距。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「散射、陰影與折射率失配」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

單一視角的光片影像軸向解析度比橫向差數倍，深處又受散射與陰影影響。多視角取像把樣品旋轉或用多支物鏡從不同方向拍同一體積，以嵌入的螢光珠或影像特徵配準，再以加權平均或多視角反摺積融合，得到接近等向的解析度與完整覆蓋。整合時資料量往往才是真正的瓶頸：sCMOS 相機持續以數百 MB/s 輸出，需要串流寫入磁碟陣列、即時壓縮與自動化的配準融合流程，否則長時間縮時實驗無法收尾。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多視角融合與資料管線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光片顯微鏡的驗收把前面每個模型變成量測：視野多處螢光珠的橫向與軸向 FWHM 驗證偵測解析度與光片均勻性；光片側影驗證 w0、z_R 與腰的位置；共面性掃描驗證傾角；觸發時序驗證同步；重複取像驗證漂白率與熱漂移；連續寫入測試驗證資料管線。交接紀錄必須包含每一組物鏡、介質與光片設定下的校正值，因為換介質、換樣品槽或換波長都會讓舊值失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光珠驗收與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A light-sheet microscope splits illumination and detection into two perpendicular paths: an illumination objective sends a thin sheet of light in from the side, exciting fluorescence only near the focal plane of the detection objective, which records the whole plane at once in widefield fashion. Unlike widefield or confocal microscopes, molecules outside the focal plane are simply not illuminated while that plane is recorded, so optical sectioning comes from the illumination rather than a pinhole and the light dose and photobleaching of the whole volume fall sharply. The price is that the sample must admit light from the side and sit in a chamber filled with immersion medium, its geometry constrained by the working distances of two objectives. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Orthogonal illumination and detection”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A sheet formed by a Gaussian beam is thinnest at the waist w0 and thickens away from it as w(z) = w0·√(1 + (z/z_R)²), with Rayleigh range z_R = πn·w0²/λ. The usable field is conventionally taken as 2z_R, where the edge thickness is √2 times the centre; because z_R scales with w0², halving the sheet thickness quarters the usable field. Bessel beams and lattice sheets extend the non-diffracting length with a conical angular spectrum, but Bessel side lobes carry much of the energy and cause out-of-focus background and bleaching, while lattice sheets suppress side lobes through interference, striking a different balance among thickness, field and side lobes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gaussian waist and Rayleigh range”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A sheet can be formed statically by a cylindrical lens or by a galvanometer sweeping a thin beam rapidly across the focal plane (a digitally scanned light sheet); the latter is uniform, modulable line by line and can pivot to change the incidence angle, averaging away stripe shadows behind absorbers. To break the thickness-versus-field trade-off, an electrically tunable lens moves the waist along the propagation direction in sync with an sCMOS rolling shutter so each pixel row is exposed only while the waist passes, imaging the whole field with the thinnest part of the sheet. The price is that synchronization timing becomes a key specification, and trigger jitter among galvo, lens and camera turns directly into thickness error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Galvo, tunable lens and rolling shutter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The detection side is itself a widefield microscope: objective NA sets lateral resolution and depth of field, and camera pixel size referred to the sample decides whether Nyquist sampling is met. The axial point-spread function of a light-sheet system is the product of the sheet profile and the detection axial PSF, so both affect axial resolution: large-field systems with low-NA detection are dominated by sheet thickness, while high-NA detection is dominated by detection depth of field and the sheet mainly suppresses out-of-focus background. The detection objective must dip into the chamber medium, and working distance, nosepiece angle and geometric interference with the illumination objective limit the usable NA combinations. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Detection objective and sCMOS sampling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The sheet must be exactly coplanar with the detection focal plane: a sheet centre offset from focus lowers signal and raises background, and a sheet tilted relative to focus leaves one side of the field sharp and the other blurred. Calibration usually uses beads or a uniform fluorescent sample, adjusting in turn sheet height (an illumination galvo offset), tilt (a galvo or mount conjugate to the objective back focal plane) and waist position (the illumination objective or tunable lens), each judged by image sharpness or bead axial PSF. With dual-sided illumination both sheets are aligned separately and confirmed to coincide at the centre. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sheet tilt and focal-plane coplanarity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The sheet crosses the sample from the side, so light reaching deep regions must first pass through the tissue in front: scattering converts ballistic photons into background and thickens the sheet, and absorbers such as pigment or yolk cast stripe shadows behind them. When sample and immersion medium differ in refractive index, the focal plane seen by the detection objective drifts with depth and the sheet and focal plane separate. Remedies include dual-sided illumination with each side covering half the width, pivot scanning, multi-angle acquisition and tissue clearing with index-matched media, while large live samples need depth-dependent focus compensation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Scattering, shadows and index mismatch”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A single-view light-sheet image has axial resolution several times worse than lateral, and deep regions suffer scattering and shadows. Multiview acquisition rotates the sample or uses several objectives to record the same volume from different directions, registers the views with embedded beads or image features, then fuses them by weighted averaging or multiview deconvolution for near-isotropic resolution and complete coverage. In integration the data volume is often the real bottleneck: sCMOS cameras stream hundreds of MB/s continuously, demanding streaming to disk arrays, on-the-fly compression and automated registration and fusion, without which long time-lapse experiments cannot be completed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multiview fusion and data pipeline”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Light-sheet acceptance turns each earlier model into a measurement: lateral and axial bead FWHM at many field positions verify detection resolution and sheet uniformity; the sheet profile verifies w0, z_R and waist position; a coplanarity scan verifies tilt; trigger timing verifies synchronization; repeated acquisition verifies bleach rate and thermal drift; a sustained write test verifies the data pipeline. The handoff record must hold calibration values for every combination of objective, medium and sheet setting, because a change of medium, chamber or wavelength invalidates the old values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bead acceptance and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 為了提高訊號把照明功率調高 10 倍並加長曝光，影像更乾淨，但胚胎數小時後發育明顯變慢、細胞分裂停滯；團隊只看影像品質沒有監測生理指標，把光毒性造成的異常當成生物學發現。
樣品槽換新後窗片厚度不同，照明光進入介質時的折射使光片高度偏移 3 µm，所有影像都偏暗偏糊；操作者以提高雷射功率補償，漂白因此加速，而真正需要的只是重新對位。
pitfallsEn: To raise signal the illumination power is increased tenfold with longer exposures, the images look cleaner, but after a few hours embryo development slows markedly and cell division stalls; the team watched only image quality, not physiology, and reported a phototoxic artefact as a biological finding.

A new sample chamber has a different window thickness, refraction where the illumination enters the medium shifts the sheet height by 3 µm and every image is dim and soft; the operator compensates with more laser power, accelerating bleaching, when all that was needed was realignment.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：超解析螢光顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Super-resolution fluorescence microscopy
guides.concept: 從 Abbe 繞射極限出發，理解結構照明、STED 與單分子定位如何利用頻率混合與螢光開關繞過它，再把損耗飽和、染料佔空比與標記密度、TIRF 背景與相機雜訊、漂移與焦距鎖定、解析度預算與 FRC、技術選擇與標準樣品驗收整合成可交接的超解析系統工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the Abbe diffraction limit to see how structured illumination, STED and single-molecule localization bypass it with frequency mixing and fluorescence switching, then integrate depletion saturation, dye duty cycle and labeling density, TIRF background and camera noise, drift and focus lock, resolution budgets and FRC, technique choice and reference-sample acceptance into a transferable super-resolution system record.
procedure: 傳統螢光顯微鏡的光學轉移函數在空間頻率 2NA/λ 截止，比 λ/(2NA) 更細的結構傳不到相機。超解析方法不是打破繞射，而是繞過它：結構照明（SIM）以已知條紋與樣品頻率混合，把截止外的資訊以摩爾紋搬進通帶，解析度約提升 2 倍；STED 以損耗光強迫焦點周圍的分子回到暗態，只留下中心的奈米發光區；單分子定位（PALM/STORM）讓分子在時間上輪流亮起，每次只有稀疏的分子發光，再以擬合求中心，精度約 s/√N。三者分別以線性光學、確定性切換與隨機切換換取解析度，速度、光劑量與標記要求各不相同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「繞射極限與螢光開關」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

STED 在激發光點上疊加一束中心為零的甜甜圈形損耗光，波長位於螢光光譜紅端，以受激發射把激發態分子在發出螢光前帶回基態。損耗效果隨強度飽和：局部強度遠大於飽和強度 I_sat 時幾乎所有分子都被關掉，只剩甜甜圈零點附近的分子能發光，有效光點依 d ≈ λ/(2NA·√(1 + I/I_sat)) 縮小，原理上沒有下限。實務限制來自三處：零點品質（中心殘餘強度會壓低訊號）、損耗光造成的漂白與熱，以及激發與損耗光束在三維中的重合精度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「甜甜圈損耗光與飽和強度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

單分子定位需要絕大多數分子處於暗態：光活化螢光蛋白（PALM）由紫光逐次打開，有機染料（dSTORM）則在含硫醇與除氧系統的緩衝液中進入長壽命暗態，再隨機回到亮態。每個分子亮著的時間比例稱為佔空比，它決定單位面積可容許的最大標記密度；奈奎斯特準則卻要求標記間距不大於目標解析度的一半，兩者互相拉扯。標記本身也有大小：一抗加二抗把螢光團放在離目標蛋白十幾奈米外，造成連結誤差，奈米抗體或自標記標籤等小型標記可大幅縮小它。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光開關染料與標記密度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

定位精度不只由光子數決定，背景與像素化同樣重要。全內反射（TIRF）照明以超過臨界角的入射在玻片表面形成漸逝波，只激發玻片上方約百奈米內的分子，大幅降低背景；斜照（HILO）則以略小於臨界角的傾斜光片照到細胞較深處。偵測器方面，EMCCD 以電子倍增壓過讀出雜訊，但倍增的隨機性帶來 √2 的過量雜訊因子，等效於光子數減半；sCMOS 讀出雜訊僅約 1 到 2 個電子，但每個像素的偏移與增益不同，必須逐像素校正。像素換算到樣品端約等於 PSF 標準差時精度最佳。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TIRF 物鏡與單光子相機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

單分子定位要拍數千到數萬幀、耗時數分鐘，而載物台、物鏡與樣品座構成的結構迴路會隨溫度漂移數十奈米，遠大於定位精度。橫向漂移有兩種校正方式：在樣品中放入不會漂白的金奈米粒子或多色螢光珠作為基準點逐幀追蹤，或把定位資料切成時間段做影像互相關。軸向則以紅外光在玻片界面的反射建立主動焦距鎖定，否則失焦不只讓 PSF 變胖，3D 定位的高度也會整體偏移。STED 與 SIM 單張影像較快，但多色或長時間取像同樣需要漂移紀錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基準金粒子與焦距鎖定」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

定位影像的實際解析度是多個獨立誤差的平方和：定位精度、漂移校正殘差、標記連結誤差與雙色配準誤差，並受標記密度的奈奎斯特極限約束，單看定位精度會嚴重高估解析度。傅立葉環相關（FRC）把資料分成兩半各自重建，比較兩者在各空間頻率的相關性，以 1/7 閾值給出可與預算比較的解析度；若 FRC 遠差於預算，表示有未列入的誤差來源，例如同一分子重複計數或漂移殘差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「解析度預算與 FRC 曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

三種超解析方法在系統層級的取捨不同：SIM 用低強度寬場照明、只需數張原始影像，最適合活細胞動態，但解析度只到約兩倍；STED 是點掃描，可直接看到結果，但視野越大越慢，損耗光強度高；單分子定位解析度最高，卻需要數萬幀、特殊緩衝液與通常固定的樣品。整合時要把生物問題的時間尺度、結構尺寸與樣品可承受的光劑量放在同一張表上比較，再決定照明、偵測、焦距鎖定與重建軟體的組合；在同一平台整合多種模式時，共用的物鏡與偵測器必須同時滿足各模式。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「技術選擇與時間解析度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

超解析系統的驗收要用已知幾何的標準樣品，把預算的每一項變成可量的數字：DNA 摺紙奈米尺以設計好的固定間距（例如 40 nm 或 20 nm）驗證解析度與尺度；核孔複合體的八重對稱環提供細胞內的天然標準，同時檢驗標記效率；多色螢光珠驗證雙色配準；長時間珠樣品驗證漂移校正；SIM 以重建影像的傅立葉譜與調制深度驗證條紋參數。交接紀錄要包含各雷射的功率密度、緩衝液配方批次與效期、相機逐像素校正檔、配準矩陣與 FRC 結果，因為任何一項改變都會讓同一個數字代表不同的品質。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「DNA 摺紙奈米尺與核孔標準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The optical transfer function of a conventional fluorescence microscope cuts off at spatial frequency 2NA/λ, so structure finer than λ/(2NA) never reaches the camera. Super-resolution methods do not break diffraction but go around it: structured illumination (SIM) mixes a known fringe pattern with sample frequencies, moving information beyond the cutoff into the passband as moiré and gaining about a factor of 2; STED uses a depletion beam to force molecules around the focus back to a dark state, leaving a nanoscale emitting centre; single-molecule localization (PALM/STORM) lets molecules light up in turn so only sparse emitters glow at once, then fits their centres with precision near s/√N. The three trade linear optics, deterministic switching and stochastic switching for resolution, at different costs in speed, dose and labeling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Diffraction limit and fluorescence switching”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

STED overlays the excitation spot with a doughnut-shaped depletion beam whose centre is zero, at a wavelength on the red edge of the emission spectrum, returning excited molecules to the ground state by stimulated emission before they fluoresce. Depletion saturates with intensity: where local intensity far exceeds the saturation intensity I_sat nearly every molecule is switched off and only those near the doughnut zero can emit, so the effective spot shrinks as d ≈ λ/(2NA·√(1 + I/I_sat)) with no lower bound in principle. Practical limits come from three places: the quality of the zero, since residual intensity there suppresses signal; bleaching and heating by the depletion light; and the three-dimensional overlap accuracy of the excitation and depletion beams. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Doughnut depletion beam and saturation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Single-molecule localization needs nearly all molecules dark: photoactivatable fluorescent proteins (PALM) are switched on a few at a time by violet light, while organic dyes (dSTORM) enter long-lived dark states in buffers with thiols and oxygen scavenging and return stochastically. The fraction of time a molecule spends on is its duty cycle, which sets the maximum labeling density per area; the Nyquist criterion, however, demands label spacing no larger than half the target resolution, so the two pull against each other. Labels also have size: primary plus secondary antibodies place the fluorophore over ten nanometres from the target protein, a linkage error that small labels such as nanobodies or self-labeling tags shrink greatly. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photoswitchable dyes and labeling density”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Localization precision depends not only on photon count but equally on background and pixelation. Total internal reflection (TIRF) illumination beyond the critical angle creates an evanescent wave at the coverslip that excites only molecules within about a hundred nanometres, sharply reducing background, while highly inclined illumination (HILO) uses a tilted sheet just below the critical angle to reach deeper into the cell. Among detectors, an EMCCD beats read noise by electron multiplication but its randomness adds an excess-noise factor of √2, equivalent to halving the photon count; an sCMOS has only 1 to 2 electrons of read noise but every pixel has its own offset and gain and must be calibrated individually. Precision is best when the pixel referred to the sample is about the PSF standard deviation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TIRF objective and low-noise camera”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Single-molecule localization records thousands to tens of thousands of frames over minutes, while the structural loop of stage, objective and sample holder drifts tens of nanometres with temperature, far beyond the localization precision. Lateral drift is corrected in two ways: non-bleaching gold nanoparticles or multicolour beads in the sample serve as fiducials tracked frame by frame, or the localizations are cut into time segments and cross-correlated. Axially, an infrared beam reflected from the coverslip interface provides an active focus lock; without it defocus not only fattens the PSF but shifts 3D heights wholesale. STED and SIM frames are faster, but multicolour or long acquisitions still need a drift record. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fiducial gold particles and focus lock”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The real resolution of a localization image is the root-sum-square of independent errors, namely localization precision, drift-correction residual, label linkage error and two-colour registration error, and it is further bounded by the Nyquist limit of labeling density, so localization precision alone grossly overstates resolution. Fourier ring correlation (FRC) splits the data into two halves, reconstructs each and compares their correlation at every spatial frequency, giving at the 1/7 threshold a resolution comparable with the budget; an FRC far worse than the budget reveals an unlisted error such as repeated counting of one molecule or drift residual. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Resolution budget and FRC curve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The three methods trade differently at system level: SIM uses low-intensity widefield illumination and only a handful of raw frames, best for live-cell dynamics but limited to about twofold; STED scans a point and shows results directly, but slows with field size and uses intense depletion light; single-molecule localization gives the highest resolution but needs tens of thousands of frames, special buffers and usually fixed samples. Integration puts the biological time scale, structure size and tolerable light dose in one table, then chooses the combination of illumination, detection, focus lock and reconstruction software; when one platform hosts several modes, the shared objective and detectors must satisfy all of them. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Technique choice and temporal resolution”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Super-resolution acceptance uses reference samples of known geometry to turn every budget item into a measurable number: DNA-origami nanorulers with designed spacings such as 40 nm or 20 nm verify resolution and scale; the eightfold-symmetric ring of the nuclear pore complex offers a natural in-cell standard that also tests labeling efficiency; multicolour beads verify two-colour registration; long bead acquisitions verify drift correction; and SIM fringe parameters are verified from the Fourier spectrum and modulation depth of reconstructions. The handoff must hold each laser's power density, buffer recipe batch and shelf life, per-pixel camera calibration, registration matrices and FRC results, because a change in any of them makes the same number mean a different quality. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DNA-origami rulers and nuclear-pore standards”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把 SIM 重建影像上的細紋當成超解析結構，實際上是條紋頻率或相位估計錯誤造成的蜂巢狀或條紋狀重建假影；研究者把假影解讀為新的蛋白排列，直到論文被質疑才發現。
選用的基準螢光珠在長時間照射下逐漸漂白，後段幀的基準定位精度變差，校正把雜訊注入整個資料集，影像後半段變模糊；若不檢查基準點光子數隨時間的變化，會誤判為樣品品質問題。
pitfallsEn: Fine lines in a SIM reconstruction are taken as super-resolved structure when they are honeycomb or stripe artefacts from wrongly estimated fringe frequency or phase; researchers interpret the artefact as a new protein arrangement and discover the error only when the paper is challenged.

The fiducial beads chosen slowly bleach under long illumination, their localization precision degrades in late frames, the correction injects noise into the whole dataset and the second half of the image blurs; without checking fiducial photon counts over time this is misdiagnosed as poor sample quality.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：拉曼顯微光譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Raman microspectrometers
guides.concept: 從分子振動造成的非彈性散射出發，理解拉曼顯微光譜儀如何從比入射雷射弱十個數量級的散射光中取出化學與應力資訊，再把共軛焦取樣、邊緣濾光片、光柵色散、矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 校正、螢光背景與雷射加熱整合成可交接的量測紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Start from inelastic scattering by molecular vibrations to see how a Raman microspectrometer extracts chemical and stress information from light ten orders of magnitude weaker than the laser, then integrate confocal sampling, edge filters, grating dispersion, silicon 520.7 cm⁻¹ calibration, fluorescence background and laser heating into a transferable measurement record.
procedure: 雷射電場使分子電子雲極化，誘導偶極主要以入射頻率振盪而產生瑞利散射；若極化率隨某個振動座標改變，誘導偶極還會出現 ν₀ ± ν_vib 的邊帶，這就是拉曼散射。失去一個振動量子的是斯托克斯線，取得一個量子的是反斯托克斯線，後者強度受振動激發態的波茲曼佈居限制。拉曼位移 Δν̃ = 1/λ₀ − 1/λs 只與振動能階有關、與雷射波長無關，所以頻譜以 cm⁻¹ 為座標；散射功率約與 (ν̃₀ − Δν̃)⁴ 成正比，短波長激發的訊號較強，但也較容易激發螢光。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射線與斯托克斯散射光」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

拉曼顯微光譜儀以高數值孔徑物鏡把雷射聚成繞射極限光點，同一支物鏡以背向散射幾何收集拉曼光，再經過與焦點共軛的針孔或狹縫，只讓焦平面附近的散射光進入光譜儀。橫向取樣直徑約 1.22λ/NA，軸向取樣深度由針孔大小決定，通常是橫向的兩到三倍；針孔越小深度越淺但通量越低。拉曼微分截面只有 10⁻²⁹ cm²/sr 等級，計數率正比於雷射光子數、分子數密度、取樣長度、收集立體角與光路透射率，任何一項打折都直接轉成更長的積分時間。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「物鏡焦點與共軛焦針孔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

拉曼雷射需要窄線寬與穩定波長：線寬直接疊加到每一條拉曼峰上，波長漂移則直接變成位移誤差。半導體雷射的放大自發放射背景與氣體雷射的電漿線必須用窄帶淨化濾光片去除，否則會在頻譜上出現假峰。收集端的瑞利光與鏡面反射比拉曼光強六到十個數量級，需要光學密度 OD 6 以上的干涉式長波通邊緣濾光片或體布拉格光柵陷波濾光片；濾光片的過渡帶寬決定能量測的最低波數，入射角偏離設計值則讓截止邊往短波長移動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射淨化濾光片與邊緣濾光片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

通過共軛焦針孔的拉曼光進入 Czerny–Turner 光譜儀：入口狹縫經準直鏡成為平行光，光柵依 mλ = d(sin α + sin β) 把不同波長分到不同角度，再由聚焦鏡成像到背照式 CCD。倒線色散 dλ/dx = cos β/(m·G·f) 決定每個像素對應的波數，狹縫影像寬度決定儀器線寬，CCD 長度決定單次曝光涵蓋的範圍；高刻線密度與長焦距提升解析度，卻縮小範圍並使寬頻譜需要拼接。CCD 以熱電或液態氮致冷到 −60 °C 以下壓低暗電流，並沿狹縫方向合併像素以降低讀出雜訊的比重。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光柵光譜儀與 CCD 陣列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

波數軸校正分兩步：先用氖、氬或汞燈已知的原子線把像素對應到絕對波長，修正光柵角與色散非線性；再用矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 或其他已知拉曼峰定出雷射的實際波長，也就是零位移點，因為雷射波長漂移會讓整條位移軸平移。以矽峰位做應力計量時，單軸應力約每 cm⁻¹ 對應 500 MPa，所以 0.1 cm⁻¹ 的校正誤差就是 50 MPa 的應力誤差；峰位必須以洛倫茲或 Voigt 函數擬合取得次像素精度，燈線與雷射波長也必須一致地使用空氣或真空值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 與氖燈校正線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

拉曼截面比螢光小很多個數量級，樣品或雜質只要有微量螢光，寬廣的背景就會淹沒拉曼峰。背景可以用多項式扣掉平均值，但其散粒雜訊 √B 會留在頻譜裡，所以真正的訊噪比是 S/√(S + B + D + σ_read²)。對策包括改用 785 或 1064 nm 激發避開電子吸收、以雷射預先光漂白、時間閘控或移頻激發差分；換長波長會因 ν⁴ 與 CCD 量子效率下降而損失訊號，必須以訊噪比而非訊號大小決策。不同設定的相對強度還需用 NIST SRM 2241（785 nm 用）等螢光標準玻璃做儀器響應校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光背景與 CCD 雜訊底」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高 NA 物鏡把數 mW 集中在不到 1 µm 的光點，峰值功率密度達 MW/cm² 等級，被吸收的功率造成局部升溫；溫升與熱導率和光點半徑成反比，所以矽只升高數十 K，深色聚合物、碳材或生物組織卻可能燒毀或相變。升溫會讓峰位紅移、線寬變寬，若與應力或成分訊號混在一起就無法分離。拉曼成像把電動平台、自動對焦、曝光與讀出同步，整幅影像所需時間、焦面平整度與宇宙射線尖峰的處理都必須事先預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射功率密度與成像平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

拉曼顯微光譜儀的驗收把前面的模型轉成固定測試：氖燈線形驗證儀器線寬與色散，矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 驗證峰位、重複性與每 mW 計數率，Z 掃描驗證共軛焦深度，SRM 強度標準驗證相對響應，功率計在樣品面量實際功率，低波數與反斯托克斯量測驗證濾光片截止邊。交接紀錄須包含每個雷射與光柵組合的校正係數、物鏡與針孔設定、量得的線寬與計數率、環境溫度與樣品安全功率上限，因為任何一項改變都會讓跨日或跨機台的比較失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「矽、氖燈與強度標準驗收表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The laser field polarises the molecular electron cloud and the induced dipole oscillates mainly at the incident frequency, producing Rayleigh scattering; if the polarisability changes along a vibrational coordinate, the dipole also acquires sidebands at ν₀ ± ν_vib, which is Raman scattering. Losing one vibrational quantum gives the Stokes line and gaining one gives the anti-Stokes line, whose strength is limited by the Boltzmann population of the excited level. The Raman shift Δν̃ = 1/λ₀ − 1/λs depends only on the vibrational levels and not on the laser wavelength, so spectra are plotted in cm⁻¹; scattered power scales roughly as (ν̃₀ − Δν̃)⁴, so shorter-wavelength excitation gives stronger signals but also excites fluorescence more easily. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser line and Stokes-scattered light”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A Raman microspectrometer focuses the laser to a diffraction-limited spot with a high-numerical-aperture objective, collects the Raman light through the same objective in backscattering geometry, and passes it through a pinhole or slit conjugate to the focus so only light from near the focal plane enters the spectrometer. The lateral sampling diameter is about 1.22λ/NA while the axial sampling depth is set by the pinhole and is typically two to three times larger; a smaller pinhole gives a shallower depth but less throughput. Raman differential cross-sections are only of order 10⁻²⁹ cm²/sr, and the count rate is proportional to laser photon flux, molecular number density, sampled length, collection solid angle and optical transmission, so any loss turns directly into longer integration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Objective focus and confocal pinhole”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A Raman laser needs a narrow linewidth and a stable wavelength: the linewidth convolves into every Raman band and wavelength drift becomes shift error directly. Amplified spontaneous emission from diode lasers and plasma lines from gas lasers must be removed with a narrow clean-up filter or they appear as false peaks. On the collection side Rayleigh light and specular reflection are six to ten orders of magnitude stronger than the Raman light, so an interference long-pass edge filter or a volume-Bragg-grating notch filter with optical density OD 6 or more is required; the filter transition width sets the lowest measurable wavenumber, and tilting away from the design angle moves the edge toward shorter wavelength. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser clean-up and edge filters”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Raman light leaving the confocal pinhole enters a Czerny–Turner spectrograph: the entrance slit is collimated, the grating sends each wavelength to a different angle through mλ = d(sin α + sin β), and a focusing mirror images the spectrum onto a back-illuminated CCD. The reciprocal linear dispersion dλ/dx = cos β/(m·G·f) sets the wavenumber per pixel, the slit image width sets the instrument linewidth and the CCD length sets the range covered per exposure; denser gratings and longer focal lengths improve resolution but shrink the range so broad spectra must be stitched. The CCD is cooled thermoelectrically or with liquid nitrogen below −60 °C to suppress dark current, and pixels are binned along the slit to reduce the weight of read noise. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Grating spectrograph and CCD array”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Wavenumber calibration has two steps: atomic lines of known wavelength from neon, argon or mercury lamps map pixels to absolute wavelength and correct the grating angle and dispersion nonlinearity, then the silicon 520.7 cm⁻¹ band or another known Raman band fixes the actual laser wavelength, the zero-shift point, because laser drift translates the whole shift axis. For stress metrology from the silicon band, roughly 500 MPa of uniaxial stress corresponds to 1 cm⁻¹, so a 0.1 cm⁻¹ calibration error is a 50 MPa stress error; peak positions must be fitted with Lorentzian or Voigt functions to sub-pixel precision, and lamp and laser wavelengths must consistently be air or vacuum values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Si 520.7 cm⁻¹ and neon calibration lines”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Raman cross-sections are many orders of magnitude smaller than fluorescence, so a trace of fluorescence from the sample or an impurity buries the Raman bands under a broad background. A polynomial can subtract the mean background but its shot noise √B remains, so the true signal-to-noise ratio is S/√(S + B + D + σ_read²). Remedies include 785 or 1064 nm excitation to avoid electronic absorption, photobleaching with the laser beforehand, time gating or shifted-excitation difference methods; longer wavelengths lose signal through ν⁴ and falling CCD quantum efficiency, so the decision must rest on signal-to-noise rather than signal size. Relative intensities across settings also need instrument-response correction with fluorescent standard glasses such as NIST SRM 2241 for 785 nm. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fluorescence background and CCD noise floor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A high-NA objective concentrates a few milliwatts into a spot under 1 µm, giving peak irradiance of order MW/cm², and absorbed power heats the sample locally; the temperature rise scales inversely with thermal conductivity and spot radius, so silicon warms by only tens of kelvin while dark polymers, carbon materials or biological tissue may burn or change phase. Heating red-shifts and broadens bands and cannot be separated once it mixes with stress or composition signals. Raman imaging synchronises a motorised stage, autofocus, exposure and readout, so total map time, focal-plane flatness and cosmic-ray spike handling must all be budgeted in advance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser irradiance and mapping stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of a Raman microspectrometer turns the earlier models into fixed tests: neon line shapes verify instrument linewidth and dispersion, the silicon 520.7 cm⁻¹ band verifies position, repeatability and counts per milliwatt, a Z scan verifies confocal depth, an SRM intensity standard verifies relative response, a power meter measures the real power at the sample, and low-wavenumber and anti-Stokes measurements verify the filter edges. The handoff record must hold calibration coefficients for every laser–grating combination, objective and pinhole settings, measured linewidths and count rates, ambient temperature and the safe power limit for each sample class, because a change in any of them invalidates day-to-day or instrument-to-instrument comparison. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Si, neon and intensity-standard acceptance table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 換了雷射或雷射波長漂移後仍沿用舊的 λ₀ 換算，整條位移軸平移，0.2 nm 的差異在 532 nm 就是約 7 cm⁻¹，比對資料庫時錯認物相；以反斯托克斯比值測溫卻沒有修正偵測器在兩側的響應差異，推得的溫度可錯 20 K 以上。
只在早上校正一次，實驗室溫度漂移 2 K 讓光譜儀與雷射波長改變，下午量到的矽峰偏移 0.3 cm⁻¹，被報告成 150 MPa 的應力差異；不同機台各自校正卻採用不同的矽參考值（520.0 對 520.7 cm⁻¹），跨廠資料出現系統性不一致。
pitfallsEn: Keeping the old λ₀ after a laser change or wavelength drift shifts the whole shift axis, and a 0.2 nm difference at 532 nm is about 7 cm⁻¹, enough to misidentify phases against a library; using the anti-Stokes ratio as a thermometer without correcting the detector response on the two sides can put the inferred temperature off by more than 20 K.

Calibrating only once in the morning while the laboratory drifts 2 K changes the spectrometer and laser wavelength, so afternoon silicon peaks shift 0.3 cm⁻¹ and are reported as a 150 MPa stress difference; instruments calibrated separately against different silicon reference values (520.0 versus 520.7 cm⁻¹) produce systematically inconsistent data between sites.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers
guides.concept: 從干涉圖與傅立葉轉換的關係出發，理解動鏡行程如何決定解析度、氦氖雷射條紋如何定義波數軸與取樣，再把分光鏡、光源、偵測器、光闌與吹掃整合成可驗收的紅外光譜儀；聚苯乙烯標準片與 100% 線測試是全課的量測主軸。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair, this course shows how mirror travel sets resolution, how HeNe laser fringes define the wavenumber axis and sampling, and how beamsplitter, source, detector, aperture stop and purge combine into an acceptable infrared spectrometer; the polystyrene standard and the 100% line test are the measurement backbone throughout.
procedure: FTIR 不用光柵分光，而是讓紅外光進入麥克森干涉儀：分光鏡把光分成兩路，一路到固定鏡、一路到以等速移動的動鏡，兩路重合後的強度隨光程差 x 變化，形成干涉圖 I(x) = ∫B(ν̃)cos(2πν̃x)dν̃。每個波數 ν̃ 的光在動鏡掃描時都以自己的頻率 f = 2v·ν̃ 被調變（v 為動鏡速度、2v 為光程差速度），所有波數同時被偵測器記錄，再用傅立葉轉換把干涉圖還原成光譜 B(ν̃)。這就是費爾蓋特多工優勢的來源：整個掃描時間內每個波數都在累積訊號，而不是像色散式儀器逐一通過狹縫。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光譜解析度由最大光程差 Δ_max 決定：Δν̃ ≈ 1/Δ_max，動鏡只需移動 Δ_max/2，因為光程差是鏡位移的兩倍。干涉圖在 Δ_max 處被截斷相當於乘上矩形窗，光譜中每條譜線因此帶有 sinc 形的儀器線形與 −22% 的旁瓣；改用三角形等切趾函數可壓低旁瓣，代價是線寬變寬。雅基諾優勢來自干涉儀不需要狹縫：允許的立體角 Ω = 2π/R（R 為解析能力 ν̃_max/Δν̃），遠大於同解析度的光柵儀器，因此可用較大的光闌通過更多能量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「動鏡行程與雅基諾光闌」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

中紅外光源通常是加熱到約 1300 K 的碳化矽棒（globar），依普朗克定律其峰值在 2.2 µm 附近，10 µm 處只在長波尾端。分光鏡是鍍 Ge 的 KBr 基板，覆蓋約 7800–350 cm⁻¹，但 KBr 會潮解，必須保持乾燥；遠紅外改用 Mylar 或固態分光鏡，近紅外改用 CaF₂ 或石英。偵測器有兩類：室溫的 DTGS 熱電型偵測器響應平坦但靈敏度低且隨調變頻率滾降；液態氮冷卻的 MCT 光導偵測器靈敏度高一到兩個數量級，但截止在約 600–750 cm⁻¹，且在強光下非線性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「KBr/Ge 分光鏡與 DTGS/MCT 偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

動鏡裝在空氣軸承、撓性或音圈驅動的滑軌上，以伺服控制等速掃描；但真正決定波數軸的不是機械，而是與紅外光共用光路的氦氖參考雷射。氦氖光的干涉條紋每 632.8 nm 光程差重複一次，電子電路在條紋的零交越點觸發 ADC 取樣，因此干涉圖的取樣位置由雷射波長精確定義，這就是康尼斯優勢。取樣間隔決定可達的最高波數（奈奎斯特），每個零交越或每隔幾個零交越取樣是依光譜範圍選擇的設定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氦氖雷射條紋與零交越取樣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

氦氖雷射給出極好的波數線性，但離軸光線的光程差是 x·cosα，整個光闌錐角內的平均使所有譜線按同一比例向低波數偏移；這是系統性的刻度因子，而非隨機誤差。因此 FTIR 軟體把「有效雷射波數」當作校正參數，用 NIST SRM 1921b 聚苯乙烯片的認證峰位（例如 1601 與 1028 cm⁻¹ 附近的譜帶）去擬合，把刻度拉回正確值；換光闌、換分光鏡或重新對準後都必須重做。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「聚苯乙烯標準片 SRM 1921b」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

FTIR 的雜訊以 100% 線評估：連續取兩次背景光譜相除，理想上應為平坦的 100% T，其峰對峰或均方根偏差就是光度雜訊。偵測器雜訊主導時，訊雜比隨掃描次數的平方根成長；而在固定光闌下，解析度加倍（Δν̃ 減半）使每個光譜元素的能量減半，需要四倍掃描數才能維持同樣的訊雜比；若光闌也依雅基諾條件縮小，代價再乘上四倍。這就是 FTIR 的交換規則，也是規劃量測時間的依據。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「100% 線與訊雜比交換規則」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

大氣水氣在 1300–1900 與 3500–3900 cm⁻¹ 有密集的轉動—振動譜線，CO₂ 在 2350 cm⁻¹ 有強雙峰、667 cm⁻¹ 有彎曲振動；它們在樣品與背景之間若有任何變化，就會以正負尖刺的形式疊在樣品光譜上。工程解法是把干涉儀與偵測器腔密封並放乾燥劑，樣品室以乾燥空氣或氮氣吹掃，並在換樣品後等待吹掃恢復；ATR 附件把路徑縮到一次漸逝波深度，是另一種同時降低氣體干擾與樣品製備負擔的介面。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「乾燥吹掃與樣品室」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

一台 FTIR 的交接不是看規格書，而是以同一套可重複的測試把波數準確度、解析度、光度雜訊、能量通量與穩定性鎖成基準：聚苯乙烯峰位在容差內、2870 與 2851 cm⁻¹ 之間的穿透率差大於規定值、100% 線雜訊低於門檻、單光束能量不低於出廠基準的某個百分比、氦氖與光源強度在診斷頁面正常。這些數據連同光闌、速度、取樣倍率、切趾等設定一起寫入驗收報告，日後任何維修或漂移都與它比對。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「性能驗證報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Instead of dispersing light with a grating, an FTIR sends the infrared beam into a Michelson interferometer: the beamsplitter divides it toward a fixed mirror and a mirror moving at constant velocity, and the recombined intensity varies with optical path difference x as the interferogram I(x) = ∫B(ν̃)cos(2πν̃x)dν̃. Each wavenumber ν̃ is modulated at its own audio frequency f = 2v·ν̃ (v the mirror velocity, 2v the path-difference velocity), all wavenumbers reach the detector simultaneously, and a Fourier transform recovers the spectrum B(ν̃). This is the Fellgett multiplex advantage: every spectral element accumulates signal for the whole scan rather than taking turns through a slit. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Michelson interferometer and interferogram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Spectral resolution is fixed by the maximum optical path difference Δ_max through Δν̃ ≈ 1/Δ_max, and the mirror itself travels only Δ_max/2 because path difference is twice the mirror displacement. Truncating the interferogram at Δ_max multiplies it by a boxcar window, so every spectral line carries a sinc instrument line shape with −22% side lobes; a triangular or similar apodization suppresses the side lobes at the cost of a wider line. The Jacquinot advantage arises because an interferometer needs no slit: the admissible solid angle is Ω = 2π/R with R = ν̃_max/Δν̃ the resolving power, far larger than a grating instrument of equal resolution, so a larger stop passes more energy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mirror travel and the Jacquinot stop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The mid-infrared source is usually a silicon-carbide rod (globar) heated to about 1300 K; by Planck's law its emission peaks near 2.2 µm, so 10 µm lies on the long-wavelength tail. The beamsplitter is a germanium-coated KBr substrate covering roughly 7800–350 cm⁻¹, but KBr is hygroscopic and must be kept dry; far-infrared work uses Mylar or solid-state beamsplitters and near-infrared uses CaF₂ or quartz. Two detector classes exist: the room-temperature pyroelectric DTGS has a flat response but low sensitivity that rolls off with modulation frequency, while liquid-nitrogen-cooled photoconductive MCT is one to two orders more sensitive but cuts off near 600–750 cm⁻¹ and becomes nonlinear under strong illumination. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “KBr/Ge beamsplitter and DTGS/MCT detectors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The moving mirror rides on an air bearing, flexure or voice-coil slide under servo control at constant velocity, but the wavenumber axis is defined not by the mechanics but by a HeNe reference laser sharing the optical path. Its fringes repeat every 632.8 nm of path difference and the electronics trigger ADC samples at the fringe zero crossings, so the sample positions are fixed by the laser wavelength; this is the Connes advantage. The sampling interval sets the highest reachable wavenumber (Nyquist), and sampling at every zero crossing or every few crossings is chosen according to the spectral range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “HeNe fringes and zero-crossing sampling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The HeNe laser gives excellent wavenumber linearity, but an off-axis ray sees a path difference x·cosα, and averaging over the aperture cone shifts every line toward lower wavenumber by the same fraction; this is a systematic scale factor, not random error. FTIR software therefore treats an effective laser wavenumber as a calibration parameter fitted to the certified peak positions of the NIST SRM 1921b polystyrene film (for example the bands near 1601 and 1028 cm⁻¹) to pull the scale back; it must be redone after any change of aperture, beamsplitter or realignment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polystyrene standard SRM 1921b”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

FTIR noise is judged with the 100% line: two consecutive background spectra are ratioed and should ideally be a flat 100% T, and their peak-to-peak or RMS deviation is the photometric noise. When detector noise dominates, signal-to-noise grows with the square root of the number of scans; at a fixed aperture, doubling resolution (halving Δν̃) halves the energy per spectral element and needs four times as many scans for the same SNR, and if the stop is also reduced to satisfy the Jacquinot condition the penalty multiplies by another four. These are the FTIR trading rules and the basis for planning measurement time. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The 100% line and SNR trading rules”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Atmospheric water vapour has dense rotation–vibration lines in the 1300–1900 and 3500–3900 cm⁻¹ regions, and CO₂ has a strong doublet at 2350 cm⁻¹ and a bending mode at 667 cm⁻¹; any change between sample and background measurements appears as positive or negative spikes on the sample spectrum. The engineering answer is to seal the interferometer and detector compartments with desiccant, purge the sample compartment with dry air or nitrogen, and wait for purge recovery after each sample exchange; an ATR accessory shortens the path to a single evanescent depth and is another interface that reduces both gas interference and sample preparation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Dry purge and the sample compartment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Handing over an FTIR is not a matter of reading the datasheet but of locking wavenumber accuracy, resolution, photometric noise, energy throughput and stability into a baseline with one repeatable test set: polystyrene peaks within tolerance, the transmittance difference between 2870 and 2851 cm⁻¹ above the specified value, 100% line noise below threshold, single-beam energy not below a stated fraction of the factory baseline, and HeNe and source levels normal on the diagnostic page. These results, together with aperture, velocity, sampling ratio and apodization settings, go into the qualification record against which every later repair or drift is compared. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Performance-qualification record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若動鏡速度設定高於 DTGS 偵測器的響應頻寬，高波數端訊號會被偵測器的低通特性壓低，單光束光譜在 4000 cm⁻¹ 附近塌陷，使用者誤以為是光源老化。
使用者在大光闌下校正、再換到小光闌量測，刻度因子不再適用，譜峰系統性偏移約 1 cm⁻¹，藥典式的聚苯乙烯檢查失敗卻被歸咎於樣品。
pitfallsEn: If the mirror velocity is set above the DTGS detector's response bandwidth, the detector's low-pass behaviour suppresses the high-wavenumber end, the single-beam spectrum collapses near 4000 cm⁻¹, and users wrongly blame an aging source.

Calibrating at a large aperture and then measuring at a small one leaves an unsuitable scale factor, peaks shift systematically by about 1 cm⁻¹, and a pharmacopoeia-style polystyrene check fails while the sample gets the blame.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：橢圓偏光儀建置
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Ellipsometer construction
guides.concept: 以反射偏振比 ρ = tanΨ·e^{iΔ} 為核心，說明橢圓偏光儀為何能把薄膜厚度量到次埃，再逐步建置光源、偏光鏡、補償器、測角儀與旋轉檢偏鏡，並用 SiO₂/Si 參考片把校正、參數相關性、視窗雙折射與量規重複性整合成可交接的儀器。
guides.conceptEn: Built around the reflection polarization ratio ρ = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, this course explains why an ellipsometer resolves film thickness to sub-ångström level, then assembles source, polarizer, compensator, goniometer and rotating analyzer step by step, using SiO₂/Si reference wafers to tie calibration, parameter correlation, window birefringence and gauge repeatability into a hand-over-ready instrument.
procedure: 橢圓偏光儀不量反射率的絕對值，而是量 p 偏振與 s 偏振反射係數的複數比 ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}：Ψ 描述振幅比、Δ 描述相位差。因為是比值，光源強度漂移、偵測器增益變化與視窗穿透率都在第一階消去，這是它能把薄膜厚度解析到 0.01 nm 等級的根本原因。入射角選在基板布魯斯特角附近時 r_p 最小而 ρ 對薄膜最敏感；對矽（633 nm 時 n ≈ 3.88）布魯斯特角約 75.5°，所以商用儀器多在 65–75° 工作。系統邊界是：一束已知偏振的準直光、一個角度已知的反射面、一個能解出偏振態的分析臂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

單層薄膜的反射係數由兩個界面的菲涅耳係數與膜內相位厚度 β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ) 組成：r = (r₀₁ + r₁₂e^{−2iβ})/(1 + r₀₁r₁₂e^{−2iβ})，p 與 s 各算一次再取比值得到 ρ(d, n₁, n₂, φ, λ)。量測得到 Ψ、Δ 之後，厚度與折射率是以模型擬合反解，而不是直接讀出。對很薄的膜，Δ 對厚度的靈敏度極高而 Ψ 幾乎不動；膜厚增加到數十奈米後 Ψ 開始承擔厚度資訊；當 β 累積到 π 時 Ψ、Δ 回到起點，產生厚度週期性的多解。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SiO₂/Si 薄膜的菲涅耳—艾里模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光譜型橢偏儀的光源常用 75 W 氙燈或氘燈加鹵素燈，覆蓋 190–1700 nm；單波長儀器用氦氖雷射或 LED。偏光鏡與檢偏鏡用方解石格蘭—泰勒稜鏡，消光比可達 10⁻⁵–10⁻⁶，深紫外改用 MgF₂ 羅瓊稜鏡。補償器是一片提供約四分之一波相位延遲的雙折射波片，讓儀器在 Δ 接近 0° 或 180° 時仍有相位靈敏度；旋轉補償器型（RCE）用它作為調制元件，並藉由 Δ 的正負號辨識消除 RAE 的符號模糊。偵測端以光柵光譜儀配 Si CCD 與 InGaAs 陣列同時讀出數百個波長。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「格蘭—泰勒偏光鏡與 MgF₂ 補償器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光源臂與偵測臂裝在同軸的雙臂測角儀上，轉軸必須通過樣品表面：若樣品高度偏離轉軸，改變入射角時光點會在樣品上移動且反射光偏離偵測器。入射角由編碼器讀出並以直通位置（φ = 90°）歸零；樣品傾斜由四象限偵測器或自準直系統在量測前調平。因為 Δ 對入射角極度敏感，角度與傾斜的機械精度直接轉成薄膜參數的系統誤差，所以測角儀的軸承、編碼器與樣品台的 z 軸都屬於光學量測鏈的一部分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙臂測角儀與樣品台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

旋轉檢偏鏡型（RAE）儀器讓檢偏鏡以固定轉速旋轉，偵測器訊號為 I(A) = I₀[1 + α·cos2A + β·sin2A]，以鎖相或數位傅立葉分析取出正規化係數 α、β。在偏光鏡方位 P 已知時，tanΨ = |tanP|·√((1 + α)/(1 − α))、cosΔ = β/√(1 − α²)。這組公式假設 P 與 A 的零點完全對準，因此建置時要做回歸校正：在多個 P 值下量 α、β，擬合殘差函數找出偏光鏡與檢偏鏡的方位偏置及偵測器衰減係數，再把它們寫進軟體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「旋轉檢偏鏡傅立葉係數 α、β」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

橢偏結果的不確定度不只來自 Ψ、Δ 的雜訊，更多來自模型：厚度 d 與折射率 n 在很薄的膜中高度相關，因為 Δ 的一階變化只取決於 (n² − 1)·d/n² 這類組合，單一波長無法把兩者分開；表面粗糙層、界面層與基板光學常數的選擇也會把誤差推到厚度上。擬合以均方誤差 MSE 衡量，並用參數的 90% 信賴區間與相關矩陣判斷結果是否可信；光譜與多角度資料增加獨立觀測量，是打破相關性的主要手段。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「MSE 擬合與 n–d 相關性」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

把橢偏儀裝到鍍膜或蝕刻腔上做原位量測時，光必須穿過真空視窗，而視窗中的殘餘應力雙折射會對 Δ 加上偏置；應力自由熔融石英視窗與回歸式視窗校正（在腔內放已知樣品、擬合視窗延遲）是標準做法。晶圓廠的量測機台則把樣品對準自動化：四象限偵測器讀取反射光位置、Z 軸自動對焦、R-θ 平台做晶圓圖掃描，並把每一點的對準殘差記錄下來作為資料品質指標。溫度也是整合變數，基板光學常數隨溫度變化會被誤判成厚度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「應力自由視窗與原位量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

橢偏儀的交接以量規重複性與再現性（GR&R）為核心：同一片參考片連續量測得到重複性，隔日、換人、重新裝載得到再現性，兩者合成的總變異與製程容差相比得到精度／容差比。多台機台則以同一組參考片做機台比對，要求平均值差異落在容差的一小部分內。驗收報告要列出參考片編號、量測配方（角度、波長範圍、模型）、各項標準差、相關矩陣與校正日期，使後續任何結果都能回溯到這份基準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「參考片與量規 R&R 報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: An ellipsometer does not measure absolute reflectance but the complex ratio of the p- and s-polarized reflection coefficients, ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, where Ψ describes the amplitude ratio and Δ the phase difference. Because it is a ratio, source drift, detector gain changes and window transmission cancel to first order, which is the root reason the technique resolves film thickness at the 0.01 nm level. Choosing the angle of incidence near the substrate's Brewster angle minimises r_p and maximises the sensitivity of ρ to a film; for silicon (n ≈ 3.88 at 633 nm) the Brewster angle is about 75.5°, so commercial instruments work at 65–75°. The system boundary is a collimated beam of known polarization, a reflecting surface at a known angle, and an analysis arm able to solve for the polarization state. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A single film's reflection coefficient combines the Fresnel coefficients of its two interfaces with the film phase thickness β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ): r = (r₀₁ + r₁₂e^{−2iβ})/(1 + r₀₁r₁₂e^{−2iβ}), evaluated for p and s and then ratioed to give ρ(d, n₁, n₂, φ, λ). Thickness and index are recovered by fitting this model to the measured Ψ and Δ, not read directly. For very thin films Δ is extremely sensitive to thickness while Ψ hardly moves; beyond a few tens of nanometres Ψ takes over the thickness information; and once β accumulates to π, Ψ and Δ return to their starting values, producing periodic thickness ambiguity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fresnel–Airy model of SiO₂/Si films”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A spectroscopic ellipsometer typically uses a 75 W xenon lamp or deuterium plus halogen lamps covering 190–1700 nm, while single-wavelength instruments use a HeNe laser or LED. Polarizer and analyzer are calcite Glan–Taylor prisms with extinction ratios of 10⁻⁵–10⁻⁶, replaced by MgF₂ Rochon prisms in the deep ultraviolet. The compensator is a birefringent plate providing roughly quarter-wave retardance so that the instrument keeps phase sensitivity when Δ approaches 0° or 180°; a rotating-compensator ellipsometer (RCE) uses it as the modulating element and resolves the sign of Δ that an RAE cannot. The detection end uses a grating spectrograph with Si CCD and InGaAs arrays to read hundreds of wavelengths at once. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Glan–Taylor polarizers and the MgF₂ compensator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Source and detector arms sit on a coaxial two-arm goniometer whose rotation axis must pass through the sample surface: if the sample height departs from the axis, the spot walks across the sample when the angle changes and the reflected beam leaves the detector. The angle of incidence is read from an encoder and zeroed at the straight-through position (φ = 90°); sample tilt is levelled before measurement with a quadrant detector or autocollimation. Because Δ is extremely sensitive to the angle of incidence, mechanical accuracy of angle and tilt converts directly into systematic film-parameter error, so the goniometer bearings, encoder and the z axis of the sample stage are part of the optical measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Two-arm goniometer and sample stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A rotating-analyzer ellipsometer (RAE) spins the analyzer at constant speed, and the detector signal is I(A) = I₀[1 + α·cos2A + β·sin2A], with the normalised coefficients α and β extracted by lock-in or digital Fourier analysis. With the polarizer azimuth P known, tanΨ = |tanP|·√((1 + α)/(1 − α)) and cosΔ = β/√(1 − α²). These formulas assume that the zero positions of P and A are exactly aligned, so construction includes a regression calibration: α and β are measured at several P values, a residual function is fitted to extract the polarizer and analyzer azimuth offsets and the detector attenuation factor, and these are written into the software. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rotating-analyzer Fourier coefficients α and β”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The uncertainty of an ellipsometric result comes less from noise in Ψ and Δ than from the model: thickness d and index n are strongly correlated for very thin films because the first-order change of Δ depends only on a combination such as (n² − 1)·d/n², which a single wavelength cannot separate; choices of surface-roughness layer, interface layer and substrate optical constants likewise push error into the thickness. Fits are judged by the mean-squared error (MSE), and 90% confidence limits and the correlation matrix of the parameters decide whether a result is trustworthy; spectroscopic and multi-angle data add independent observables and are the main way to break the correlation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “MSE fitting and n–d correlation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When an ellipsometer is mounted on a deposition or etch chamber for in-situ measurement, the beam must pass vacuum viewports whose residual stress birefringence adds an offset to Δ; strain-free fused-silica windows plus a regression window calibration (a known sample inside the chamber, fitting the window retardance) are standard practice. Fab metrology tools automate sample alignment: a quadrant detector reads the reflected-beam position, the z axis autofocuses, an R-θ stage scans the wafer map, and the alignment residual at each point is logged as a data-quality indicator. Temperature is also an integration variable, because substrate optical constants changing with temperature can be misread as thickness. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Strain-free viewports and in-situ measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Hand-over of an ellipsometer centres on gauge repeatability and reproducibility (GR&R): consecutive measurements of one reference wafer give repeatability, measurements on other days, by other operators and after reloading give reproducibility, and the combined variation compared with the process tolerance gives the precision-to-tolerance ratio. Several tools are matched with the same reference set, requiring mean differences within a small fraction of the tolerance. The acceptance record lists reference-wafer identifiers, the measurement recipe (angle, wavelength range, model), each standard deviation, the correlation matrix and calibration dates, so that every later result traces back to this baseline. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reference wafers and gauge R&R record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把橢偏儀當反射率計使用、拿單一角度的強度訊號推薄膜厚度，光源 1% 的漂移就會變成奈米級厚度誤差；真正的橢偏量測必須建立在 Ψ、Δ 這兩個比值型觀測量之上。

pitfallsEn: Using the ellipsometer as a reflectometer and inferring thickness from single-angle intensity turns a 1% source drift into nanometre-scale thickness error; a genuine ellipsometric measurement must rest on the ratio-type observables Ψ and Δ.

An uncalibrated 0.3° assembly offset between the analyzer motor encoder and the optical axis rotates the phase of α and β, biasing Ψ by 0.15° and Δ by 0.6°, so every film's refractive index fits systematically high.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：積分球輻射量測
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Integrating-sphere radiometry
guides.concept: 從朗伯漫反射壁面如何把任意方向的光通量變成均勻輻射亮度出發，推導球倍增因子 M = ρ/(1 − ρ(1 − f))，再逐步建立塗層、開口、擋板、偵測器、標準燈替代法與自吸收修正，最後以不確定度預算與國家實驗室比對完成總光通量量測系統的驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from how a Lambertian diffuse wall turns flux from any direction into uniform radiance, this course derives the sphere multiplier M = ρ/(1 − ρ(1 − f)), then builds up coating, ports, baffles, detector, standard-lamp substitution and self-absorption correction, and closes with an uncertainty budget and a national-laboratory comparison to accept a total-luminous-flux measurement system.
procedure: 積分球的內壁是高反射率的朗伯漫反射面：任一點被照亮後向所有方向以餘弦分佈再輻射，而球面幾何的特性是球內任意一點發出的光在其他所有壁面上造成相同的輻照度，與方向無關。於是輸入光通量 Φ 經過無窮多次反射後，壁面輻照度成為等比級數的和，比值由壁面反射率 ρ 與開口比 f（所有開口面積佔球面積的比例）決定。偵測器看到的是這個經過空間積分、與光源方向和分佈無關的均勻輻射亮度，這就是「積分」的意義。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「朗伯漫反射壁面與球倍增因子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

穩態下壁面輻照度 E = Φ·M/A_s，其中 A_s = 4πR² 是球內表面積；朗伯面的輻射亮度 L = E/π（單位 W·m⁻²·sr⁻¹）。與壁面齊平的偵測器開口接收的通量就是 E 乘以它的面積，因此偵測器訊號正比於輸入總通量，比例常數包含 M、A_s、偵測器面積與響應度。量測總光通量時光源放在球心（4π 配置），量測定向光源時光源在開口外照入（2π 配置），量測反射率或穿透率時樣品裝在樣品埠；三種配置的 M 與 f 都不同，校正必須在同一配置下進行。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「壁面輻照度與偵測器通量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

可見與近紅外積分球多用燒結 PTFE（厚度約 10 mm 才能達到 0.99 的反射率，因為材料半透明）或硫酸鋇漆（約 0.97–0.98，較便宜但易受污染與紫外老化）；中紅外改用鍍金粗化表面，在 0.8–20 µm 保持 0.95–0.98。開口比 f 必須壓到幾個百分點以內，而且入口與偵測器之間要加同材質的擋板，阻止第一次反射光直接進入偵測器；擋板本身也算進有效開口比。樣品埠、燈座與導線都會吸收光，使實際的 f 比純幾何計算大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「燒結 PTFE 塗層與開口比」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

偵測端有兩條路：光度計頭是矽光二極體加 V(λ) 濾光片組合，直接讀出光度量，但濾光片與 V(λ) 的失配（以 f1' 指標描述，好的光度計約 1.5–3%）在光源光譜與校正燈不同時產生誤差；光譜輻射計透過光纖接到球壁，量出相對光譜後以數值積分得到總光譜輻射通量與光通量，失配問題轉為波長校正與雜散光問題。兩者都要求偵測器在 4 個數量級的通量範圍內線性，並把溫度係數控制在 0.1%/K 以內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「V(λ) 光度計頭與光譜輻射計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

因為 M 對 ρ 極敏感，絕對量測不可行，積分球永遠用替代法：先把可追溯至 NIST 等國家實驗室的總光通量標準燈放在球心讀訊號 S_ref，再換上待測燈讀 S_DUT，比值乘以標準燈的認證值就是待測光通量。但待測燈的燈體、燈座與反射罩會吸收球內的光，改變 M；於是球壁上裝一支輔助燈，分別在標準燈與待測燈在位（均不點亮）時點亮輔助燈讀訊號，兩者比值就是自吸收修正因子。標準燈的電流、預熱時間與極性必須按證書操作，否則認證值失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「總光通量標準燈與輔助燈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

總光通量的不確定度由標準燈認證值、光譜失配、自吸收、空間響應不均勻（燈的配光與標準燈不同時，球壁各區響應差異會引入誤差）、偵測器線性與漂移、以及重複性等項組成；各項以相對標準不確定度表示，彼此獨立時用均方根合成，再乘涵蓋因子 k = 2 得到擴充不確定度。預算表的價值在於指出哪一項主導：對白光 LED 常是標準燈與光譜失配，對指向性強的燈具則是空間不均勻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「不確定度預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整合時要決定燈的安裝方式（球心 4π 或開口 2π）、擋板的位置與尺寸（遮住燈到偵測器的直視線但不遮太多壁面）、導線與燈座的顏色與尺寸（白色且最小化），並確保偵測器視野只看到被擋板遮蔽後的壁面。LED 光源的光通量隨接面溫度下降，球內空氣溫度又因燈的功耗上升，所以要等熱平衡並記錄溫度，或以溫控座固定 LED 溫度；大型燈具則須注意球的尺寸應遠大於燈具，否則空間不均勻項失控。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「球心燈座、擋板與溫度控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

量測系統交接的最後一步是證明它與國家計量體系一致：把一支傳遞標準燈送到 NIST、PTB 或 NMIJ 等實驗室校正，再回到本實驗室以替代法量測，用 En 值比較兩者。En = (x_lab − x_ref)/√(U_lab² + U_ref²)，絕對值 ≤ 1 表示在各自宣告的擴充不確定度內一致。交接文件需包含配置圖、標準燈清單與證書、自吸收與光譜失配修正程序、不確定度預算、管制圖與塗層反射率的定期檢查紀錄，因為塗層老化會使替代法以外的任何快速檢查失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「國家實驗室比對與 En 值」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The inner wall of an integrating sphere is a highly reflective Lambertian diffuser: any illuminated point re-radiates in all directions with a cosine distribution, and the geometry of a sphere makes light leaving any point produce the same irradiance on every other part of the wall regardless of direction. The input flux Φ therefore builds up through an infinite series of reflections, and the wall irradiance becomes a geometric sum whose ratio depends on wall reflectance ρ and port fraction f (the fraction of sphere area occupied by all openings). The detector sees this spatially integrated radiance, independent of the source's direction and distribution, which is what integrating means. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lambertian wall and the sphere multiplier”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

In steady state the wall irradiance is E = Φ·M/A_s with A_s = 4πR² the interior area, and for a Lambertian wall the radiance is L = E/π (in W·m⁻²·sr⁻¹). A detector aperture flush with the wall collects E times its area, so the detector signal is proportional to the total input flux with a constant that contains M, A_s, detector area and responsivity. For total flux the source sits at the sphere centre (4π configuration), a directional source shines in through a port (2π configuration), and reflectance or transmittance samples mount on a sample port; each configuration has its own M and f, so calibration must be done in the same configuration as the measurement. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wall irradiance and detector flux”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Visible and near-infrared spheres use sintered PTFE (about 10 mm thick to reach 0.99 reflectance because the material is translucent) or barium-sulfate paint (about 0.97–0.98, cheaper but prone to contamination and ultraviolet aging); mid-infrared spheres use roughened gold surfaces holding 0.95–0.98 from 0.8 to 20 µm. The port fraction f must be kept to a few percent, and a baffle of the same material between entrance and detector blocks first-bounce light from reaching the detector; the baffle itself counts toward the effective port fraction. Sample ports, lamp holders and leads absorb light too, making the real f larger than the pure geometric value. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sintered-PTFE coating and port fraction”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The detection end has two routes: a photometer head combining a silicon photodiode with a V(λ) filter reads photometric quantities directly, but the mismatch between filter and V(λ) (described by the f1' index, about 1.5–3% for a good head) causes error whenever the source spectrum differs from the calibration lamp; a spectroradiometer coupled to the wall by a fibre measures the relative spectrum and numerically integrates it into total spectral radiant flux and luminous flux, converting the mismatch problem into wavelength-calibration and stray-light problems. Both require detector linearity over four decades of flux and a temperature coefficient below 0.1%/K. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “V(λ) photometer head and spectroradiometer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Because M is so sensitive to ρ, absolute measurement is impractical and spheres always use substitution: a total-luminous-flux standard lamp traceable to a national laboratory such as NIST is placed at the centre and read as S_ref, then the device under test is read as S_DUT, and the ratio times the certified value gives the test flux. But the test lamp's envelope, holder and reflector absorb light inside the sphere and change M, so an auxiliary lamp mounted on the wall is lit with the standard lamp and then with the test lamp in place (both unlit), and the ratio of those readings is the self-absorption correction factor. The standard lamp's current, warm-up time and polarity must follow its certificate or the certified value no longer applies. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Total-flux standard lamp and auxiliary lamp”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The uncertainty of total luminous flux combines the standard lamp's certified value, spectral mismatch, self-absorption, spatial non-uniformity (when the test source's intensity distribution differs from the standard lamp, response differences across the wall introduce error), detector linearity and drift, and repeatability; each is expressed as a relative standard uncertainty, independent terms are combined root-sum-square, and a coverage factor k = 2 gives the expanded uncertainty. The value of the table is to show which term dominates: for white LEDs usually the standard lamp and spectral mismatch, for highly directional luminaires the spatial non-uniformity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Uncertainty budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Integration decides how the lamp is mounted (4π at the centre or 2π at a port), where and how large the baffle is (blocking the direct line from lamp to detector without hiding too much wall), the colour and size of leads and holders (white and minimal), and ensures that the detector's field of view sees only baffled wall. LED flux falls with junction temperature while the air inside the sphere warms from the lamp's dissipation, so the system must reach thermal equilibrium with temperature logged, or hold the LED on a temperature-controlled mount; for large luminaires the sphere must be much larger than the luminaire or the spatial non-uniformity term runs out of control. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Centre mount, baffle and temperature control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The last step of handing over the measurement system is to prove consistency with the national measurement system: a transfer standard lamp is calibrated at NIST, PTB, NMIJ or a similar laboratory, measured again at home by substitution, and the two results compared through the En value. En = (x_lab − x_ref)/√(U_lab² + U_ref²), and |En| ≤ 1 means agreement within the stated expanded uncertainties. The handoff file must include the configuration drawing, the list of standard lamps with certificates, the self-absorption and spectral-mismatch procedures, the uncertainty budget, control charts and the periodic coating-reflectance check, because coating aging invalidates any quick check other than substitution. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “National-laboratory comparison and En value”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把球壁當成普通白漆面、容許 10% 的開口比，倍增因子降到個位數且首次反射光直接進入偵測器，量測值隨光源擺放角度變動 5% 以上，積分球失去積分功能。
標準燈以交流電源點亮且電流偏高 1%，燈絲溫度上升使光通量多出約 3.5%，所有以它校正的量測值全部偏高；證書上的直流電流條件被當成建議而非規定。
pitfallsEn: Treating the wall as ordinary white paint and allowing a 10% port fraction drops the multiplier to single digits and lets first-bounce light reach the detector directly; readings then vary by more than 5% with source orientation and the sphere no longer integrates.

Running the standard lamp on AC with the current 1% high raises the filament temperature and adds about 3.5% to its flux, biasing every measurement calibrated against it; the DC current condition on the certificate was treated as advice rather than a requirement.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：光學頻率梳穩定系統
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems
guides.concept: 以摻鉺光纖鎖模雷射為對象，從梳齒方程式與載波包絡偏移出發，建置超連續光譜、f-2f 干涉儀與 f_ceo／f_rep 兩個鎖相迴路，說明射頻與光學參考的槓桿效應、梳齒序數判定、週期滑脫與艾倫偏差評估，最後把熱漂移與致動器範圍整合成可全天候運行並可交接的頻率梳。
guides.conceptEn: Taking an erbium-fibre mode-locked laser as the object, this course starts from the comb equation and the carrier-envelope offset, builds the supercontinuum, the f-2f interferometer and the two phase-locked loops for f_ceo and f_rep, explains the lever effect of RF versus optical references, mode-number determination, cycle slips and Allan-deviation evaluation, and finally integrates thermal drift and actuator ranges into a comb that runs around the clock and can be handed over.
procedure: 鎖模雷射每隔 T_rep = 1/f_rep 發出一個脈衝，時域上的週期脈衝串在頻域上就是一排間距 f_rep 的譜線。但脈衝內的載波相對於包絡每一個脈衝會滑動一個相位 Δφ_ce，因為腔內群速度與相速度不同；這個逐脈衝相位滑移在頻域上把整排梳齒平移了 f_ceo = f_rep·Δφ_ce/(2π)，於是第 n 根梳齒的頻率為 f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo。只要兩個射頻量 f_rep 與 f_ceo 被鎖定，數十萬根光學頻率的梳齒就全部被鎖定，這就是頻率梳把光頻與射頻連接起來的原理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「梳齒方程式與載波包絡相位」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

f_ceo 無法直接從光譜讀出，必須用自參考法：先用高非線性光纖把光譜展寬到一個倍頻程，再把低頻端的梳齒 f_n 以 PPLN 晶體倍頻得到 2f_n = 2n·f_rep + 2f_ceo，與高頻端的梳齒 f_2n = 2n·f_rep + f_ceo 在同一個光二極體上拍頻，差頻正好是 f_ceo。這個拍頻訊號的訊雜比決定鎖相能否持續：業界經驗是 100 kHz 解析頻寬下至少 30 dB。f_ceo 的自由運轉線寬在摻鉺光纖梳約為數十到數百 kHz，由泵浦強度雜訊與腔內非線性相位轉換而來。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「f-2f 干涉儀與 f_ceo 拍頻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

摻鉺光纖振盪器（非線性偏振旋轉或 SESAM 鎖模）產生 250 MHz、數十 fs 的脈衝，經 EDFA 放大到數百 mW 後送入色散設計過的高非線性光纖產生超連續，再以 PPLN 倍頻。穩頻需要三類致動器：貼在光纖或腔鏡上的壓電致動器改變腔長以控制 f_rep（範圍數 kHz、頻寬數十 kHz）；腔內電光調制器提供 MHz 等級頻寬但只有 Hz 等級範圍；泵浦二極體電流透過腔內功率改變非線性相位來控制 f_ceo，頻寬受鉺增益動態限制在約 100 kHz；溫度或步進馬達平台則補償長期漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「摻鉺振盪器、EDFA、HNLF 與 PPLN」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

兩個迴路各自把一個拍頻與合成器輸出的相位差送入 PID 控制器：f_ceo 迴路驅動泵浦電流，f_rep 迴路驅動壓電與 EOM。參考源有兩種選擇：射頻參考（氫邁射或銫鐘）把 f_rep 直接鎖到 10 MHz 的倍頻鏈上，但 f_rep 的相位雜訊會被乘上 n² 的功率比例傳到光頻；光學參考則把某一根梳齒與腔穩頻的連續波雷射拍頻鎖定，光頻的穩定度由參考雷射決定，再把 f_rep 當作輸出而非輸入。現代光鐘系統幾乎都用後者，射頻參考只用來計數與提供長期準確度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「f_rep／f_ceo 鎖相迴路與參考源」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

量測一支連續波雷射的絕對頻率時，f_cw = n·f_rep ± f_ceo ± f_beat，四種符號組合與序數 n 都要被判定。序數靠波長計：只要波長計的準確度優於 f_rep/2，就能唯一指定 n；符號靠擾動：把 f_rep 略微提高，若拍頻隨之下降則 f_cw 在梳齒之上，再把 f_ceo 鎖定點改變看拍頻方向就能定第二個符號。計數時用無死區的計數器，並以兩台計數器（不同閘門時間或相位記錄模式）平行計數偵測週期滑脫。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「梳齒序數 n 與符號判定」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

頻率梳作為「齒輪」本身引入的誤差要用兩台獨立梳鎖到同一光學參考、再比較它們在另一波長的梳齒來評估；得到的艾倫偏差隨平均時間以 1/τ 下降（相位鎖定的白相位雜訊特性），而不是 1/√τ。誤差預算包含：迴路外路徑（光纖、放大器）的相位漂移、f_ceo 拍頻訊雜比不足造成的週期滑脫、參考源的傳遞、偏振與功率相關的拍頻偏移，以及計數器的閘門同步。只有把這些逐項量化，梳才能支撐 10⁻¹⁸ 等級的光鐘比對。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙梳比對與艾倫偏差」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

全天候運轉的關鍵是把雜訊按頻段分配給正確的致動器，並讓環境漂移不耗盡任何一個致動器的範圍：EOM 處理 10 kHz 以上、壓電處理 1 Hz–10 kHz、步進平台或溫控處理更慢的漂移，各迴路之間以積分器「卸載」（offloading）把慢速累積交給大範圍致動器。光纖的熱光係數使腔長隨溫度變化，必須用隔熱與溫控外殼壓低；梳光送到他處使用時，傳輸光纖的相位雜訊以往返干涉法主動消除。偏振、泵浦功率與 EDFA 增益都要有監控點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱漂移、致動器範圍與光纖雜訊消除」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

頻率梳的驗收不是「有拍頻就好」，而是用可量化的指標：殘餘相位雜訊積分值（決定多少功率在相干載波中）、f_ceo 與 f_rep 拍頻訊雜比、迴路外艾倫偏差、週期滑脫率、連續鎖定時數與自動重鎖能力。交接文件應包含每個致動器的轉移函數、伺服參數、鎖定點、所有拍頻的頻率與符號約定、波長計校正值、以及環境監測的正常範圍，讓接手者能在不重新摸索的情況下判斷系統是否仍處於驗收狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鎖定品質報告與全天候驗證」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A mode-locked laser emits one pulse every T_rep = 1/f_rep, and a periodic pulse train in time is a row of lines spaced f_rep in frequency. Inside each pulse, however, the carrier slips by a phase Δφ_ce relative to the envelope from pulse to pulse because group and phase velocities in the cavity differ; in the frequency domain this per-pulse slip shifts the whole row by f_ceo = f_rep·Δφ_ce/(2π), so the n-th tooth sits at f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo. Locking the two radio frequencies f_rep and f_ceo locks all several hundred thousand optical teeth at once, which is how a comb links optical and radio frequencies. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Comb equation and carrier-envelope phase”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

f_ceo cannot be read from the spectrum directly and needs self-referencing: a highly nonlinear fibre broadens the spectrum to an octave, the low-frequency tooth f_n is frequency-doubled in a PPLN crystal to 2f_n = 2n·f_rep + 2f_ceo, and this beats on one photodiode with the high-frequency tooth f_2n = 2n·f_rep + f_ceo, the difference being exactly f_ceo. The signal-to-noise ratio of this beat decides whether a phase lock can hold: industry practice asks for at least 30 dB in a 100 kHz resolution bandwidth. The free-running f_ceo linewidth of an erbium comb is tens to hundreds of kilohertz, produced by pump intensity noise converted through the intracavity nonlinear phase. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “f-2f interferometer and the f_ceo beat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An erbium fibre oscillator (nonlinear polarization rotation or SESAM mode locking) produces 250 MHz pulses of tens of femtoseconds, an EDFA amplifies them to a few hundred milliwatts, a dispersion-engineered highly nonlinear fibre generates the supercontinuum and a PPLN doubles it. Stabilization needs three classes of actuator: a piezo on the fibre or a cavity mirror changes cavity length to control f_rep (range of a few kHz, bandwidth of tens of kHz); an intracavity electro-optic modulator offers megahertz bandwidth but only hertz-level range; the pump-diode current controls f_ceo through the intracavity-power-dependent nonlinear phase with a bandwidth limited by erbium gain dynamics to about 100 kHz; temperature or a stepper stage absorbs long-term drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Er oscillator, EDFA, HNLF and PPLN”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each loop feeds the phase difference between a beat and a synthesizer output into a PID controller: the f_ceo loop drives the pump current, the f_rep loop drives piezo and EOM. Two kinds of reference exist: an RF reference (hydrogen maser or caesium clock) locks f_rep to a multiplied 10 MHz chain, but the f_rep phase noise is transferred to the optical teeth multiplied by n² in power; an optical reference locks the beat between one tooth and a cavity-stabilised cw laser, the optical stability is set by that laser and f_rep becomes an output rather than an input. Modern optical-clock systems almost always use the latter, keeping the RF reference for counting and long-term accuracy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “f_rep/f_ceo phase-locked loops and references”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

To measure a cw laser's absolute frequency, f_cw = n·f_rep ± f_ceo ± f_beat, and both the mode number n and the four sign combinations must be determined. The mode number comes from a wavemeter: an accuracy better than f_rep/2 assigns n uniquely; the signs come from perturbation: raise f_rep slightly and if the beat falls the laser lies above the tooth, then change the f_ceo lock point and watch the beat direction to fix the second sign. Counting uses dead-time-free counters, and two counters run in parallel (different gate times or phase-recording mode) to detect cycle slips. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mode number n and sign determination”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The error a comb itself introduces as a gear is evaluated by locking two independent combs to the same optical reference and comparing their teeth at another wavelength; the resulting Allan deviation falls as 1/τ with averaging time (the white-phase-noise signature of a phase lock), not as 1/√τ. The budget includes phase drift of out-of-loop paths (fibres, amplifiers), cycle slips from insufficient f_ceo beat SNR, transfer of the reference, polarization- and power-dependent beat offsets, and counter gate synchronisation. Only when each is quantified can a comb support optical-clock comparisons at the 10⁻¹⁸ level. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Comb-versus-comb comparison and Allan deviation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Round-the-clock operation hinges on assigning noise bands to the right actuators and keeping environmental drift from exhausting any actuator's range: the EOM handles above 10 kHz, the piezo 1 Hz to 10 kHz, and a stepper stage or temperature control the slower drift, with integrators offloading slow accumulation from fast actuators to the large-range ones. The thermo-optic coefficient of fibre makes cavity length track temperature, which insulation and a temperature-controlled housing must suppress; when comb light is delivered elsewhere, the phase noise of the transport fibre is cancelled actively with a round-trip interferometer. Polarization, pump power and EDFA gain all need monitoring points. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thermal drift, actuator range and fibre-noise cancellation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Accepting a comb is not a matter of seeing a beat but of quantified indicators: the integrated residual phase noise (which sets how much power sits in the coherent carrier), the SNR of the f_ceo and f_rep beats, out-of-loop Allan deviation, cycle-slip rate, continuous lock time and automatic relock capability. The handoff file should contain each actuator's transfer function, servo parameters, lock points, the frequency and sign convention of every beat, the wavemeter calibration value and the normal range of every environmental monitor, so the next engineer can judge whether the system is still in its accepted state without rediscovering it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lock-quality record and round-the-clock validation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 雷射進入多脈衝或 Q 切換鎖模狀態，f_rep 頻譜出現邊帶與次諧波，梳齒不再是單一等間距序列，後續的 f_ceo 拍頻消失，整套穩頻系統無從啟動。
波長計未校正、偏了 200 MHz，序數 n 被指定錯一根，絕對頻率報告值偏差整整 250 MHz，卻因為拍頻計數穩定而無人察覺。
pitfallsEn: If the laser slips into multi-pulse or Q-switched mode locking, the f_rep spectrum shows sidebands and sub-harmonics, the teeth are no longer one equally spaced series, the f_ceo beat vanishes and the stabilization chain cannot start.

An uncalibrated wavemeter off by 200 MHz assigns the mode number one tooth wrong, the reported absolute frequency is off by a full 250 MHz, and nobody notices because the beat counts are perfectly stable.
