guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：渦輪分子泵與真空計
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges
guides.concept: 以一台 DN100、約 260 L/s 的混合軸承渦輪分子泵與它的泵站為對象：從分子流下葉片把動量傳給氣體分子出發，理解壓縮比為何隨分子量呈指數變化、前級壓力如何決定極限壓力；再把轉子材料與動平衡、電容薄膜計、Pirani、Penning 與 Bayard–Alpert 真空計的物理與校正鏈、抽速量測與互鎖整合成可驗收的真空泵站。
guides.conceptEn: Built around a DN100, roughly 260 L/s hybrid-bearing turbomolecular pump and its pumping station: start from blades handing momentum to gas molecules in molecular flow to see why the compression ratio grows exponentially with molecular mass and how foreline pressure sets the ultimate pressure, then integrate rotor materials and balancing, the physics and calibration chain of capacitance-diaphragm, Pirani, Penning and Bayard–Alpert gauges, pumping-speed measurement and interlocks into a pumping station that can be accepted.
procedure: 在分子流中，撞上葉片表面的分子會以漫反射重新發射，並疊加上葉片表面的速度；當葉尖速度與分子熱速度 c̄ = √(8kT/πm) 同量級時，傾斜的葉片讓從入口側來的分子較容易被送到出口側、反向的分子較難穿透，單級形成一個方向性的傳輸機率差，數十級轉子與定子交替串聯後得到很高的壓縮比。因為 c̄ 隨 1/√M 增加，氫分子比氮快 3.7 倍，同一組葉片對氫的「追得上」程度差很多，壓縮比隨 √M 呈指數變化。入口的最大抽速則受限於入口截面與捕獲機率，與葉片轉得多快關係不大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。混合泵在渦輪級之後加上 Holweck 螺旋槽拖曳段，把容許的前級壓力拉高到數 mbar，因此能用隔膜泵或小型渦卷泵做前級。零流量壓縮比 K₀ 決定每種氣體從前級回流到入口的分壓，入口極限壓力是各氣體 p_fore,i/K₀,i 的總和再加上出氣量除以抽速；重氣體的 K₀ 高達 10¹¹，前級成分只對氫與氦重要。高氣體流量時轉子被氣體摩擦加熱，馬達功率與轉子溫度上限（鋁合金潛變）決定了泵的最大流量與最大前級壓力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前級管路與 Holweck 段」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

轉子由單塊高強度鋁合金整體切削，葉尖速度 300–500 m/s 使離心應力逼近材料極限，所以轉子溫度上限（約 90–120 °C）是為了控制鋁合金的潛變而設。轉子必須做到極高等級的動平衡，否則不平衡力隨 ω² 放大成振動與軸承負載。軸承有兩種：混合軸承在前級側用陶瓷球加鋼製滾道、終身潤滑油脂，在高真空側用永磁軸承；五軸主動磁浮則完全沒有潤滑劑與微粒、振動更低，但需要備用的機械落地軸承承受斷電或撞機。葉片的製造公差、表面處理與入口防護網都屬於轉子工程的一部分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鋁合金轉子與軸承」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

沒有任何一種真空計能從 1000 mbar 量到 10⁻¹² mbar，所以泵站要用三種物理機制接力：電容薄膜計直接量氣體對薄膜的力，與氣體種類無關，每個感測頭涵蓋約四個數量級，精度可達 0.2%；Pirani 計量加熱絲的熱損失，在 10⁻⁴ 到 10 mbar 之間熱損失與壓力有關，但隨氣體的熱傳導係數不同而讀值不同，接近大氣時熱傳導不再隨壓力變化而飽和；游離計分成冷陰極的 Penning／反磁控管（放電電流約隨 p^n 變化，n 約 1.1–1.4，耐用但點火有延遲）與熱陰極的 Bayard–Alpert（10⁻² 到 10⁻¹¹ mbar，引出式到 10⁻¹²）。組合計把 Pirani 與游離計做在一起自動切換。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

真空量值的溯源鏈從國家計量機構的初級標準開始：靜態膨脹法涵蓋約 10⁻⁴ 到 1000 mbar，孔口流動（動態膨脹）法涵蓋約 10⁻⁸ 到 10⁻² mbar；轉移標準是旋轉轉子真空計（量鋼球在氣體中的減速率，約 10⁻⁶ 到 1 mbar，不確定度約 1%）與電容薄膜計；工作真空計則在校正腔內以比較法校正。主要不確定度來源包括參考計本身、氣體種類、熱蒸騰（真空計與腔體溫度不同時，分子流下 p₁/p₂ = √(T₁/T₂)）、真空計安裝位置的傳導率效應，以及熱陰極計靈敏度在兩次校正之間 10–20% 的漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正腔與旋轉轉子參考計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

廠商的抽速是在標準測試罩中量的：氣體經校正流量計注入、真空計裝在規定位置，S = Q/(p − p₀)。腔體得到的有效抽速一定比銘牌低，因為要串聯管路與閥門的傳導率。泵還有流量上限：高流量時黏滯摩擦加熱轉子，馬達電流與轉子溫度達到上限後泵會降速，所以製程氣體負載必須查泵的 S(p) 曲線與最大流量規格。氣體負載由製程進氣、出氣與漏氣構成，三者相加後除以有效抽速才是工作壓力，而真空計的擺放若直視泵口會因分子束流效應讀得偏低。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「流量計與測試罩」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

泵站的整合是一連串有條件的動作：先啟動前級泵，前級壓力低於渦輪泵允許的啟動壓力後才升速；升速需數分鐘，控制器監看轉速、電流與溫度；真空計在 10⁻³ mbar 附近由 Pirani 切換到游離計；渦輪泵轉速超過 90% 且腔體已經由旁路粗抽到 10⁻² mbar 以下，閘閥才允許開啟。停電時通氣閥在延遲後以乾燥氮氣通氣，讓轉子受控減速並阻止前級的油氣或微粒回流；通氣速率要受限，避免黏滯氣流對葉片造成衝擊。冷卻（風冷或水冷）、入口法蘭的烘烤溫度上限（約 120 °C）、外部磁場（渦電流加熱轉子）與振動去耦都要在整合時一併設定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

泵站驗收包含：入口封盲板後 24 小時的基礎壓力、接上腔體後的極限壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、額定負載下的前級壓力、噪音、各真空計在重疊區的交叉核對表，以及互鎖與停電測試紀錄。維護週期依軸承型式而定：油脂潤滑的混合軸承依運轉時數定期更換，磁浮泵沒有軸承保養但要監看落地軸承次數；前級渦卷泵的尖端密封與隔膜泵的膜片有各自的壽命；BA 計燈絲與 Penning 計的放電污染也要排程處理。交接文件必須記錄泵的序號、累計時數、軸承保養日期、各真空計的校正日期與靈敏度常數、互鎖邏輯版本與備品清單。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: In molecular flow a molecule striking a blade is re-emitted diffusely with the blade's surface velocity added; when the blade-tip speed is comparable to the molecular thermal speed c̄ = √(8kT/πm), the inclined blades let molecules arriving from the inlet side pass to the outlet side more readily than the reverse, each stage producing a directional difference in transmission probability, and tens of alternating rotor and stator stages in series multiply into a very high compression ratio. Because c̄ grows as 1/√M, hydrogen moves 3.7 times faster than nitrogen, the blades keep up with it far less well, and the compression ratio therefore varies exponentially with √M. The maximum inlet pumping speed is bounded by the inlet cross-section and the capture probability and depends little on how fast the blades turn. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rotor blades and gas molecules”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Turbo stages work only in molecular flow; above roughly 10⁻² mbar at the inlet, intermolecular collisions between the blades destroy the compression, so a turbopump always needs a backing pump. Hybrid pumps add Holweck spiral-groove drag stages behind the turbo stages, raising the permitted foreline pressure to several millibar so that a diaphragm pump or a small scroll pump can serve as backing. The zero-flow compression ratio K₀ sets the partial pressure of each gas that leaks back from foreline to inlet, and the inlet ultimate pressure is the sum of p_fore,i/K₀,i over the gases plus outgassing divided by pumping speed; for heavy gases K₀ reaches 10¹¹, so the foreline composition matters only for hydrogen and helium. At high throughput gas friction heats the rotor, and the motor power together with the rotor temperature limit (creep of the aluminium alloy) fixes the pump's maximum throughput and maximum foreline pressure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Foreline and Holweck stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The rotor is machined from a single block of high-strength aluminium alloy, and tip speeds of 300–500 m/s push the centrifugal stress toward the material limit, which is why the rotor temperature ceiling of about 90–120 °C exists: it bounds the creep of the alloy. The rotor must be balanced to an extremely fine grade, because any residual unbalance is amplified by ω² into vibration and bearing load. Two bearing systems are used: hybrid bearings with ceramic balls on steel races and lifetime grease on the foreline side plus a permanent-magnet bearing on the high-vacuum side, or five-axis active magnetic levitation with no lubricant and no particles and lower vibration, which needs backup touchdown bearings for power loss or a crash. Blade machining tolerances, surface treatment and the inlet protection screen are all part of rotor engineering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

No single gauge spans 1000 mbar to 10⁻¹² mbar, so a pumping station relays between three physical mechanisms: the capacitance-diaphragm gauge measures the gas force on a membrane directly, independent of gas species, each head covering about four decades with accuracy down to 0.2%; the Pirani gauge measures the heat loss of a heated wire, which depends on pressure between 10⁻⁴ and 10 mbar but reads differently for gases of different thermal conductivity and saturates toward atmosphere where conduction stops depending on pressure; ionisation gauges split into cold-cathode Penning or inverted-magnetron types (discharge current roughly ∝ p^n with n about 1.1–1.4, robust but slow to strike) and the hot-cathode Bayard–Alpert gauge (10⁻² to 10⁻¹¹ mbar, 10⁻¹² for the extractor type). Combination gauges package a Pirani with an ionisation element and switch automatically. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The traceability chain for vacuum starts at the primary standards of national metrology institutes: static expansion covers about 10⁻⁴ to 1000 mbar and orifice-flow (dynamic expansion) about 10⁻⁸ to 10⁻² mbar; transfer standards are the spinning-rotor gauge (measuring the deceleration of a levitated steel ball in gas, about 10⁻⁶ to 1 mbar with roughly 1% uncertainty) and the capacitance-diaphragm gauge; working gauges are then calibrated by comparison in a calibration chamber. The main uncertainty sources are the reference gauge itself, gas species, thermal transpiration (with gauge and chamber at different temperatures, p₁/p₂ = √(T₁/T₂) in molecular flow), conductance effects at the gauge's mounting position, and the 10–20% drift of hot-cathode sensitivity between calibrations. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibration chamber and spinning-rotor reference”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A vendor's pumping speed is measured in a standard test dome: gas is admitted through a calibrated flow meter, the gauge sits at a prescribed position, and S = Q/(p − p₀). The effective speed at the chamber is always below nameplate because line and valve conductances are in series. The pump also has a throughput limit: at high flow viscous friction heats the rotor, and once motor current and rotor temperature reach their limits the pump slows, so process gas loads must be checked against the pump's S(p) curve and its maximum-throughput rating. The gas load is the sum of process gas, outgassing and leaks, and that sum divided by the effective speed is the working pressure; a gauge that looks straight into the pump inlet reads low because of molecular beaming. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Flow meter and test dome”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Integrating a pumping station is a chain of conditional actions: start the backing pump first and run the turbopump up only once the foreline is below its permitted start pressure; run-up takes minutes while the controller watches speed, current and temperature; gauges switch from Pirani to ionisation near 10⁻³ mbar; the gate valve may open only when the turbopump exceeds 90% speed and the chamber has been rough-pumped through a bypass below 10⁻² mbar. On a power failure the vent valve admits dry nitrogen after a delay so the rotor decelerates under control and no oil vapour or particles backstream from the foreline; the venting rate is throttled so that viscous inflow does not shock the blades. Cooling (air or water), the inlet-flange bake limit (about 120 °C), external magnetic fields (eddy-current heating of the rotor) and vibration decoupling are all settled during integration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Controller, vent valve and interlocks”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Pump-station acceptance covers the base pressure after 24 hours with the inlet blanked, the ultimate pressure once connected to the chamber, run-up time, vibration spectrum, foreline pressure at rated load, noise, the cross-check table of every gauge in its overlaps, and the interlock and power-failure test records. Maintenance intervals depend on the bearing type: grease-lubricated hybrid bearings are replaced on running hours, magnetically levitated pumps need no bearing service but their touchdown count is monitored; scroll-pump tip seals and diaphragm-pump membranes have their own lives; BA filaments and Penning discharge contamination are scheduled as well. The handoff record must list pump serial numbers, accumulated hours, bearing service dates, every gauge's calibration date and sensitivity constant, the interlock logic version and the spares list. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pump-station acceptance report and run log”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 極限壓力被氫回流卡住：前級中氫分壓 10⁻⁴ mbar，若泵對氫的 K₀ 只有 10³，入口氫分壓就是 10⁻⁷ mbar，永遠進不了超高真空；症狀是入口殘氣譜的氫峰隨前級壓力同步起伏，換更大的渦輪泵也沒用，要改的是對氫的壓縮比或前級泵。

pitfallsEn: The ultimate pressure is pinned by hydrogen backflow: with a hydrogen partial pressure of 10⁻⁴ mbar in the foreline and a pump whose K₀ for hydrogen is only 10³, the inlet hydrogen partial pressure is 10⁻⁷ mbar and ultrahigh vacuum is never reached; the symptom is an inlet hydrogen peak that rises and falls in step with the foreline pressure, a bigger turbopump does not help, and what must change is the hydrogen compression or the backing pump.

After a controller swap the sensitivity constant reverts to the factory value and the aged BA gauge reads thirty percent low: the team believes the chamber is at 7×10⁻¹¹ mbar when it is really at 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, and the acceptance report and every later pressure log are systematically wrong until a comparison with a reference gauge exposes it.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：無振動精密實驗平台
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Vibration-isolated precision platforms
guides.concept: 以一張 1000 kg 蜂巢光學桌與四支 1.5 Hz 氣墊隔振腳為主線，說明樓板 VC 等級如何經傳遞率變成桌面奈米級運動，再把桌面模態、主動隔振的傾斜極限、熱與聲學漂移和管線振動短路整合成可量測、可交接的平台驗收紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Follow a 1000 kg honeycomb optical table on four 1.5 Hz pneumatic legs to see how a floor VC class becomes nanometre tabletop motion through transmissibility, then integrate table modes, the tilt limit of active isolation, thermal and acoustic drift and vibration short circuits through hoses into a measurable, transferable platform acceptance record.
procedure: 無振動平台的核心是一個質量—彈簧—阻尼系統：桌面質量 m 坐在剛度 k 的支撐上，自然頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(k/m)。地面運動以傳遞率 T(f) 傳到桌面：f 遠低於 f₀ 時桌面跟著地面走（T ≈ 1），f = f₀ 時共振放大，只有在 f > √2·f₀ 之後才開始隔振，無阻尼時隨 (f/f₀)⁻² 下降。阻尼壓低共振峰，卻在高頻把衰減斜率從 40 dB/decade 拉回到約 20 dB/decade，因此精密平台必須在共振放大與高頻隔振之間取捨。要把 f₀ 壓到 1 到 2 Hz，靜變形 δ = g/(2πf₀)² 必須達到十公分等級，這是鋼彈簧做不到、改用空氣彈簧的根本原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單自由度隔振器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

平台設計從場址的輸入開始。通用振動準則（VC 曲線）以三分之一倍頻帶的 rms 速度規範樓板：VC-A 50 µm/s、VC-B 25、VC-C 12.5、VC-D 6.25、VC-E 3.12 µm/s，每級減半，在約 1 到 80 Hz 範圍內為定值。以速度定義代表在固定速度下位移 x = v/(2πf) 隨頻率下降，所以低頻的位移最大，也最難隔離。振動之外，空調氣流、聲壓與局部熱源會直接作用在桌面上的元件，不經過隔振器，必須另外列入預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

氣墊隔振腳以橡膠膜片封住加壓氣室，活塞面積 A 承載重量 W = p_g·A，剛度來自氣體壓縮 k = n·p_abs·A²/V，因此自然頻率只取決於壓力比與等效高度 V/A，而與負載大小無關。兩個氣室之間以層流阻尼孔相連，氣體來回流動消耗能量提供阻尼；水平方向則以內部擺桿或膜片側向柔性形成約 1.5 Hz 的擺。機械式水平閥偵測桌面高度，自動補氣或排氣，使不同負載下高度回到原位，但閥的死區與反應時間會影響沉降與漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氣墊隔振腳與水平閥」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

隔振腳決定桌面整體跟地面的關係，桌面本身的彎曲與扭轉模態則決定桌上兩個元件之間的相對運動。蜂巢桌面以上下鋼板夾著薄鋼蜂巢芯，像工字梁一樣把材料放在離中性面最遠處，以低質量換取高彎曲剛度；但金屬結構的內阻尼很小，模態品質因數 Q 可達 100，任何落在共振頻率的力都會被放大。因此桌面內部要加寬頻阻尼器或調諧質量阻尼器，並以動態柔度曲線（位移／力對頻率）描述，而不只看靜態剛度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鋼製蜂巢桌面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗證平台需要兩種量測：以地面與桌面的感測器對量傳遞率，以敲擊或激振量動態柔度。低頻量測的難點在感測器雜訊：固定位移下加速度 a = (2πf)²x 隨頻率平方下降，1 Hz 時奈米級位移只對應奈克（ng）級加速度，低於一般壓電加速度計的雜訊底線，必須改用地震級加速度計或速度型地震儀。頻率響應以互功率譜估計 H₁ = S_xy/S_xx，並檢查相干函數；相干性低的頻段代表輸出被其他來源主導，結果不可信。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「地震儀、加速度計與頻譜分析儀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

平台上的實驗在意的是兩個元件之間的相對位移，而非桌面對地的絕對運動。隔振後，樓板傳入的剛體運動大多是共模，經桌面彎曲轉成的差模極小；真正主導長時間穩定度的是溫度：鋼的熱膨脹係數約 12 ppm/K，空氣折射率隨溫度變化約 −9.3×10⁻⁷/K，氣流與空調週期會讓光程在分鐘尺度漂移。聲壓則透過鏡架與立柱的機械共振直接激振元件，因此預算表要把熱、折射、聲學與殘餘振動分項列出後以 RSS 合成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相對運動誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

被動隔振在 f₀ 附近放大、低於 f₀ 完全無效；主動隔振以慣性感測器量桌面絕對運動，經控制器驅動音圈或壓電致動器把運動抵消，可在 0.5 到 10 Hz 提供 20 到 30 dB 的額外衰減並大幅壓低共振峰，常用於電子顯微鏡、AFM 與微影設備。主動系統的極限來自感測器：水平慣性感測器無法區分水平加速度與地面傾斜造成的重力分量 g·θ，低頻時傾斜雜訊會被當成運動注入桌面。此外，酬載的重心高度、本身的結構共振與桌面耦合，會限制控制頻寬並可能造成不穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動隔振控制迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

實驗室中的平台很少只靠隔振腳支撐：真空管、冷卻水管、電纜與光纖都把桌面和地面或振動源直接相連，形成繞過隔振器的振動短路。這些路徑的剛度與隔振器並聯，提高等效 f₀，更嚴重的是把泵或冷卻機的振動直接送上桌面。安裝時要讓管線以柔性迴圈先錨定在地面或獨立支架上，再接到桌面；驗收則在實際運轉狀態（泵、冷卻機、空調全開）量測桌面頻譜、傳遞率、柔度、沉降時間與溫度漂移，並把基準資料交接給使用者以便日後比對。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「管線、纜線與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A vibration-isolated platform is at heart a mass–spring–damper: the tabletop mass m sits on supports of stiffness k with natural frequency f0 = (1/2π)√(k/m). Ground motion reaches the top through the transmissibility T(f): well below f0 the top follows the ground (T ≈ 1), at f0 it is amplified, and isolation starts only above √2·f0, falling as (f/f0)⁻² when undamped. Damping lowers the resonant peak but at high frequency pulls the roll-off from 40 dB/decade back toward 20 dB/decade, so a precision platform trades resonant amplification against high-frequency isolation. Pushing f0 to 1 to 2 Hz demands a static deflection δ = g/(2πf0)² of order ten centimetres, which steel springs cannot provide and is the basic reason for air springs. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Platform design starts from the site input. The generic vibration criteria (VC curves) specify floor motion as one-third-octave rms velocity: VC-A 50 µm/s, VC-B 25, VC-C 12.5, VC-D 6.25 and VC-E 3.12 µm/s, halving at each step and flat over roughly 1 to 80 Hz. A velocity criterion means displacement x = v/(2πf) falls with frequency at constant velocity, so low frequencies carry the largest displacement and are the hardest to isolate. Beyond vibration, HVAC airflow, sound pressure and local heat sources act directly on components on the tabletop without passing through the isolators and must be budgeted separately. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A pneumatic leg seals a pressurized chamber with a rubber diaphragm; the piston area A carries the weight W = p_g·A, and stiffness comes from gas compression, k = n·p_abs·A²/V, so the natural frequency depends only on the pressure ratio and the effective height V/A, not on the load. Two chambers joined by a laminar damping orifice dissipate energy as gas flows back and forth, and horizontally an internal pendulum or the diaphragm's lateral compliance forms a pendulum near 1.5 Hz. A mechanical leveling valve senses table height and adds or vents air so the height returns under changing loads, but its dead band and response time affect settling and drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pneumatic isolator leg and leveling valve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The legs set how the whole top follows the ground, but the top's own bending and torsion modes set the relative motion between two components on it. A honeycomb top sandwiches a thin steel honeycomb core between steel skins, placing material far from the neutral plane like an I-beam to buy bending stiffness with little mass; yet metal structures have little internal damping, so modal quality factors reach 100 and any force at a resonance is amplified. Tops therefore include broadband or tuned-mass dampers and are characterized by a dynamic compliance curve, displacement per unit force versus frequency, rather than static stiffness alone. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Steel honeycomb tabletop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Validating a platform takes two measurements: transmissibility from paired floor and tabletop sensors, and dynamic compliance from impact or shaker excitation. The difficulty at low frequency is sensor noise: at fixed displacement the acceleration a = (2πf)²x falls with frequency squared, so nanometre motion at 1 Hz means only nano-g acceleration, below the noise floor of ordinary piezoelectric accelerometers, and seismic-grade accelerometers or velocity seismometers are needed. The frequency response is estimated from cross-spectra as H1 = S_xy/S_xx and checked with the coherence function; bands of low coherence mean the output is dominated by other sources and the result is not trustworthy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Seismometers, accelerometers and spectrum analyser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Experiments on a platform care about relative displacement between two components, not the top's absolute motion relative to the ground. After isolation, most rigid-body motion from the floor is common-mode and the differential part converted by table bending is tiny; what dominates long-term stability is temperature, since steel expands about 12 ppm/K and the refractive index of air changes about −9.3×10⁻⁷/K, so airflow and HVAC cycles drift optical paths over minutes. Sound pressure drives components directly through mount and post resonances, so the budget lists thermal, refractive, acoustic and residual-vibration terms separately and combines them by RSS. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Relative-motion error budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Passive isolation amplifies near f0 and does nothing below it; active isolation measures the top's absolute motion with inertial sensors and drives voice-coil or piezo actuators to cancel it, adding 20 to 30 dB of attenuation from 0.5 to 10 Hz and suppressing the resonant peak, which is why it is common under electron microscopes, AFMs and lithography tools. Its limit is the sensor: a horizontal inertial sensor cannot distinguish horizontal acceleration from the gravity component g·θ due to ground tilt, so at low frequency tilt noise is read as motion and injected into the top. In addition, payload center-of-gravity height, the payload's own structural resonances and their coupling to the top limit control bandwidth and can cause instability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active isolation control loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

In a real laboratory a platform rarely rests on its legs alone: vacuum hoses, cooling-water lines, cables and fibres tie the top directly to the floor or to vibration sources, forming short circuits that bypass the isolators. Their stiffness acts in parallel with the isolators and raises the effective f0, and worse, they carry pump or chiller vibration straight onto the top. Installation should route lines in compliant loops anchored first to the floor or an independent stand before reaching the top; acceptance then measures the tabletop spectrum, transmissibility, compliance, settling time and thermal drift under real operating conditions with pumps, chillers and HVAC running, and hands the baseline data to users for later comparison. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hoses, cables and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。
用雜訊太高的加速度計量傳遞率，桌面訊號其實是感測器雜訊，算出的傳遞率在 20 Hz 以上變成一條平坦的假底線，讓人誤以為隔振器只有 −20 dB，進而更換本來合格的系統。
pitfallsEn: Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway.

Measuring transmissibility with an accelerometer whose noise is too high makes the tabletop signal pure sensor noise, so the computed transmissibility flattens into a false floor above 20 Hz, suggesting the isolators give only −20 dB and prompting replacement of a system that was actually compliant.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：同步輻射儲存環
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Synchrotron storage rings
guides.concept: 以一座 3 GeV、528 m 的教學用多彎消色散儲存環為主線，從同步輻射造成的每圈 430 keV 能量損失出發，說明發射度為何隨彎轉角三次方下降，再把小孔徑磁鐵、射頻補能、束流尺寸量測、Touschek 壽命、插件磁鐵擾動與頂注驗收整合成可交接的光源工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Follow a 3 GeV, 528 m teaching multi-bend-achromat storage ring from the 430 keV per-turn energy loss caused by synchrotron radiation, see why emittance falls with the cube of the bending angle, then integrate small-bore magnets, RF energy replacement, beam-size measurement, Touschek lifetime, insertion-device perturbations and top-up acceptance into a transferable light-source engineering record.
procedure: 儲存環讓數 GeV 的電子在磁場中持續偏轉，相對論電子偏轉時沿切線方向放出張角約 1/γ 的同步輻射光錐，每一圈損失的能量 U₀ 必須由射頻腔補回。U₀ 與 E⁴/ρ 成正比，這是電子而非質子適合當光源的原因；輻射頻譜以臨界能量 εc 描述，一半功率在 εc 以上、一半在以下。輻射同時是阻尼機制：能量沿動量方向損失、射頻只在縱向補回，使振盪逐漸衰減，並與量子激發的隨機擾動達成平衡，決定環的平衡發射度與能量散佈。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「彎轉磁鐵與輻射光錐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

水平發射度 ε 是電子束位置與角度分佈的相空間面積，決定光源亮度與同調度。量子激發發生在色散不為零的彎轉磁鐵內，因此每片磁鐵的彎轉角 θ 越小、色散函數越小，發射度越低；理論最小值（TME）與 γ²θ³ 成正比。第三代光源每個晶胞只用兩片彎轉磁鐵（DBA），第四代改用五到七片（MBA），在同一周長中把磁鐵數提高到約 3 倍，發射度因 θ³ 降低一個數量級以上，代價是更強的四極與六極磁鐵、更小的動態孔徑與更困難的注入。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多彎消色散晶胞」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

MBA 晶格要求 50 T/m 以上的四極梯度與很強的六極，鐵芯磁極尖端磁場 B_tip = G·r 必須低於鐵的飽和（設計上約 1 T 以下較安全），因此只能縮小孔徑；孔徑縮小又讓所需安匝數按 r² 下降，磁鐵更小、更省電，但真空管只剩約 20 mm 內徑。磁鐵以數十微米精度預先對準在共同的磁鐵座上，再整座安裝；四極磁鐵偏離束流中心 Δx 時會給電子一個偏轉 θ = K₁L·Δx，經閉合軌道放大後，整圈軌道都會偏移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「小孔徑四極磁鐵與磁鐵座」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

射頻腔以迴轉頻率整數倍（諧波數 h）的電場加速電子，同步電子每次通過剛好拿回 U₀，相位滿足 eV·sin φs = U₀。早到與晚到的電子拿到不同能量，在色散造成的路徑差下繞同步點做縱向同步振盪，形成束團；腔壓相對 U₀ 的過電壓比 q 決定 RF 桶的高度，也就是可容許的能量偏差。射頻功率除了供給束流損失，還要支付腔壁的歐姆損耗，並隨插件磁鐵間隙改變而變動，因此低階射頻控制（LLRF）必須穩住振幅與相位。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「射頻腔與高功率放大器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

發射度無法直接量，只能從某處的束流尺寸反推：σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²)，其中 β 與色散 η 來自晶格量測，σδ 來自能量散佈量測。MBA 環的垂直尺寸只有數微米，可見光成像受繞射限制而失效，必須用 X 光針孔相機、繞射式成像或同步光干涉儀。量到的是束流尺寸與儀器點擴散函數（PSF）的捲積，因此 PSF 的校正誤差會直接放大成發射度誤差，尤其當束流尺寸與 PSF 相當時。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「X 光針孔相機與光源點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

儲存電流以多種機制慢慢流失。Touschek 散射是同一束團內兩顆電子碰撞，把橫向動量轉成縱向，使能量偏差超過動量接受度而損失；束團越密（發射度越小、束團越短）損失越快，因此低發射度環的壽命往往由 Touschek 主導。殘氣散射與真空壓力成正比，新安裝的真空腔要經過數百安培小時的束流清洗，讓光子誘發脫附下降。第三諧波腔把束團拉長數倍以降低電子密度，是 MBA 環延長壽命的標準手段。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「壽命監測與諧波腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

儲存環的主要光源是直線段中的插件磁鐵：波盪器以週期 λu 的交錯磁場讓電子小幅蛇行，輻射在特定波長干涉增強，光子能量以間隙調整 K 值；扭擺器則以強場產生寬頻、高功率的輻射。每支插件磁鐵都是環的一部分：它增加每圈能量損失與射頻負擔，產生垂直聚焦而改變工作點，磁場積分誤差在間隙變動時擾動軌道，因此每支插件磁鐵都要附帶以間隙為索引的修正子與四極前饋表。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波盪器間隙與前饋表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

現代光源以頂注運轉讓儲存電流幾乎恆定：增能環每隔幾分鐘把少量電荷注入環中，補回壽命損失，光束線的熱負載因此穩定，光學元件不必隨電流漂移重新對準。MBA 環的動態孔徑小，傳統以四支踢波磁鐵造凸軌的離軸注入很難不擾動儲存束流，因此發展出多極注入踢波器或軸上交換注入。由於注入時光束線光閘保持開啟，注入效率必須夠高，損失電荷要控制在輻射安全允許範圍內，這是頂注能否放行的核心驗收項目。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「頂注注入與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A storage ring keeps electrons of several GeV bending in magnetic fields, and relativistic electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially in a cone of opening about 1/γ; the energy U0 lost each turn must be restored by RF cavities. U0 scales as E⁴/ρ, which is why electrons rather than protons make light sources, and the spectrum is described by the critical energy εc, with half the power above it and half below. Radiation is also a damping mechanism: energy is lost along the momentum direction but replaced by RF only longitudinally, so oscillations decay until balanced by the random kicks of quantum excitation, which sets the ring's equilibrium emittance and energy spread. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bending magnet and radiation cone”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The horizontal emittance ε is the phase-space area of the electron beam's position and angle distribution and sets source brightness and coherence. Quantum excitation occurs in dipoles where dispersion is non-zero, so a smaller bending angle θ per magnet and smaller dispersion give lower emittance; the theoretical minimum (TME) scales as γ²θ³. Third-generation rings use two dipoles per cell (DBA), while fourth-generation rings use five to seven (MBA), roughly tripling the dipole count in the same circumference and cutting emittance by more than an order of magnitude through θ³, at the price of stronger quadrupoles and sextupoles, a smaller dynamic aperture and harder injection. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multi-bend achromat cell”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

MBA lattices need quadrupole gradients above 50 T/m and very strong sextupoles, and the iron pole-tip field B_tip = G·r must stay below saturation, safely under about 1 T, so the bore must shrink; a smaller bore also cuts the required ampere-turns as r², making magnets smaller and cheaper to power, but leaves only about 20 mm inner diameter for the vacuum chamber. Magnets are pre-aligned to tens of micrometres on common girders that are installed as units; a quadrupole offset Δx from the beam axis gives the electrons a kick θ = K1L·Δx that the closed orbit amplifies around the whole ring. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Small-bore quadrupoles and girders”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

RF cavities accelerate electrons with a field at an integer multiple h of the revolution frequency, and the synchronous electron regains exactly U0 each pass at a phase satisfying eV·sin φs = U0. Early and late electrons gain different energies and, through the path-length difference caused by dispersion, perform longitudinal synchrotron oscillations about the synchronous point, forming bunches; the overvoltage ratio q of cavity voltage to U0 sets the height of the RF bucket, the tolerable energy deviation. RF power must cover the beam loss plus cavity wall losses and changes as insertion-device gaps move, so the low-level RF control must hold amplitude and phase steady. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF cavities and high-power amplifiers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Emittance cannot be measured directly; it is inferred from a beam size somewhere through σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²), with β and dispersion η from lattice measurements and σδ from energy-spread measurement. Vertical sizes in an MBA ring are only a few micrometres, beyond diffraction-limited visible-light imaging, so X-ray pinhole cameras, diffractive imaging or synchrotron-light interferometers are used. The measured value is the beam size convolved with the instrument point-spread function (PSF), so PSF calibration error is amplified directly into emittance error, especially when beam size and PSF are comparable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “X-ray pinhole camera and source point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Stored current leaks away by several mechanisms. Touschek scattering is a collision between two electrons in the same bunch that converts transverse momentum into longitudinal, pushing the energy deviation beyond the momentum acceptance; the denser the bunch, with smaller emittance and shorter length, the faster the loss, so low-emittance rings are usually Touschek-dominated. Residual-gas scattering scales with vacuum pressure, and new chambers need hundreds of ampere-hours of beam conditioning to reduce photon-stimulated desorption. A third-harmonic cavity lengthens the bunch several times to lower electron density and is the standard way to extend lifetime in MBA rings. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lifetime monitor and harmonic cavity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A storage ring's main sources are insertion devices in the straights: an undulator's alternating field of period λu makes electrons snake gently so radiation interferes constructively at specific wavelengths, with photon energy tuned by gap through K; a wiggler uses strong fields for broadband, high-power radiation. Each device becomes part of the ring: it adds energy loss per turn and RF load, produces vertical focusing that shifts the tune, and its field-integral errors disturb the orbit as the gap moves, so every insertion device carries gap-indexed corrector and quadrupole feedforward tables. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Undulator gap and feedforward tables”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Modern light sources run in top-up mode to keep stored current nearly constant: every few minutes the booster injects a little charge to replace lifetime losses, so beamline heat loads stay steady and optics need no realignment as current drifts. MBA rings have small dynamic apertures, so classic off-axis injection with a four-kicker bump is hard to do without disturbing the stored beam, leading to multipole injection kickers or on-axis swap-out. Because beamline shutters stay open during injection, efficiency must be high and lost charge must stay within radiation-safety limits, which is the core acceptance item for allowing top-up. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Top-up injection and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 只用彎轉磁鐵估 U₀ 而漏算插件磁鐵，射頻電壓與功率留得太緊；所有插件磁鐵關閉間隙後同步相位上移、能量接受度下降，Touschek 壽命突然縮短，甚至在注入時掉束。
針孔相機的閃爍屏或像素尺度沒有重新校正，PSF 被低估，系統回報的垂直發射度只有真實值的一半，操作人員據此判斷耦合已最小化，實際光束線的光點與同調度卻達不到預期。
pitfallsEn: Estimating U0 from the dipoles alone and forgetting insertion devices leaves too little RF voltage and power; when all insertion devices close their gaps the synchronous phase rises, energy acceptance shrinks, and Touschek lifetime suddenly drops or beam is lost at injection.

If the pinhole camera's scintillator or pixel scale is not recalibrated, the PSF is underestimated and the reported vertical emittance comes out half the true value; operators conclude coupling is minimized while beamline spot size and coherence fall short of expectations.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：自由電子雷射加速器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Free-electron-laser accelerators
guides.concept: 以一座教學用 5.8 GeV、C 波段精簡型硬 X 光 FEL 為主線，從共振條件如何決定加速器長度出發，說明電子槍、射頻曲率線性化與磁束壓縮器如何產生 3 kA 的高品質束團，再把飛秒級縱向診斷、射頻抖動預算、波盪器軌道直線度與增益曲線驗收整合成可交接的 FEL 加速器工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Follow a 5.8 GeV, C-band compact hard X-ray FEL used for teaching, starting from how the resonance condition sets linac length, see how the gun, RF-curvature linearization and chicanes produce a high-quality 3 kA bunch, then integrate femtosecond longitudinal diagnostics, the RF jitter budget, undulator trajectory straightness and gain-curve acceptance into a transferable FEL-accelerator engineering record.
procedure: 自由電子雷射的波長不是由增益介質決定，而是由電子能量與波盪器共同決定：λ = λu(1 + K²/2)/(2γ²)。要得到 0.1 nm 硬 X 光，γ 必須上萬，所需的直線加速器長度、隧道與建築成本因此由 λu 與 K 的選擇決定。縮短波盪器週期（真空內波盪器、小間隙）並提高加速梯度（C 波段 5.7 GHz 常溫結構），能把同樣波長所需的能量與長度降低數倍，這是 SACLA、SwissFEL 等精簡型設施的設計邏輯；代價是更小的間隙，以及更嚴格的尾場與束流品質要求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波盪器週期與電子能量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SASE 增益要求電子束同時滿足三個條件：橫向上，幾何發射度 ε_n/γ 最好小於 λ/4π，使電子束與輻射模式重疊；縱向上，切片能量散佈要小於 Pierce 參數 ρ，否則電子的共振波長被抹開；峰值電流要達到數 kA，ρ 才夠大、增益長度才夠短。三者互相牽制：壓縮提高電流，同時放大能量散佈，並可能因相干同步輻射劣化發射度；能量散佈過小又會引發微束團不穩定，因此加速器設計是在這些規格之間取得平衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流品質規格表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

FEL 的電子束品質在電子槍就大致決定，後段加速只能保持而無法改善。驅動雷射以紫外脈衝照射銅或 Cs₂Te 光陰極，量子效率（QE）決定所需雷射能量；電子離開陰極時帶有平均橫向能量（MTE），形成與雷射光斑大小成正比的熱發射度。陰極表面約 100 MV/m 的射頻電場要快速把電子加速到相對論速度，以壓住空間電荷力；陰極面上的電荷面密度不能超過鏡像電荷極限 ε₀E，電子槍後的螺線管再做發射度補償，把各切片的橫向相空間重新對齊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光陰極與驅動雷射」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

束團壓縮先讓電子在離峰相位通過加速結構，建立頭低尾高的能量啁啾，再經四片偏轉磁鐵組成的磁束壓縮器，讓高能量電子走較短路徑追上前方。射頻電場是餘弦形，啁啾本身帶有二次曲率，壓縮後會把電流分佈扭成尖峰加長尾；在注入器後加一段頻率為主結構 4 倍的 X 波段結構，以減速相位運轉抵消曲率，使壓縮線性化。高梯度 C 波段結構孔徑小、短程尾場強，會在束團內產生額外能量變化，必須納入啁啾設計；壓縮器中的相干同步輻射則是發射度劣化的主要來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「X 波段線性化腔與磁束壓縮器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

束團長度只有數十 fs，電子學無法直接量測。橫向偏轉腔以零交叉相位的橫向射頻場，讓束團頭尾得到方向相反的偏轉，把時間軸轉成螢光屏上的垂直位置；再配合水平偏轉的能譜儀，一張影像就能同時看到電流、切片能量散佈與能量啁啾。時間解析度受偏轉強度與電子束本身在屏上的垂直尺寸限制，偏轉腔也會增加切片能量散佈，因此量測設定本身要列入誤差分析。放在波盪器之後時，還能比較有無雷射作用時的切片能量損失，重建 X 光脈衝的時間形狀。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「橫向偏轉腔與螢光屏」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

加速器每一段的射頻相位與振幅抖動，都會透過壓縮器轉換成束流參數的逐發變動：相位抖動改變啁啾，使壓縮因子與峰值電流抖動，進而改變增益長度與脈衝能量；振幅抖動造成能量偏差，經 R₅₆ 轉成到達時間偏移，並在最終能量上轉成光子波長抖動。壓縮因子在高壓縮時對啁啾非常敏感，因此第一級壓縮器之前的射頻穩定度要求最嚴，常需 0.02° 與 10⁻⁴ 等級，由低階射頻控制與光纖時序分配系統共同達成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「射頻相位與振幅抖動預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

波盪器由數十段 4 到 5 m 的模組組成，段間以四極聚焦、相位器與 BPM 銜接。電子軌道只要有微小角度偏差，路徑就比直線長，與光的相對相位滑移，使微束團與輻射失去同步；因此整條波盪器線要以束流基準對準，把軌道直線度做到每數公尺數微米。SASE 從雜訊起始，頻譜呈尖刺狀；硬 X 光自種子在中段插入鑽石晶體，以前半段 SASE 光經布拉格反射後的尾波作為窄頻種子，後半段只放大種子，使頻寬與穩定度大幅改善。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波盪器線與自種子晶體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

試運轉的核心證據是增益曲線：逐段打開波盪器間隙，或以軌道踢出使後段失效，量 X 光脈衝能量對有效波盪器長度的關係；指數增長段的斜率給出實際增益長度，轉平的位置給出飽和點。實測增益長度與由量測束流參數預測的三維值比較，可以判斷是發射度、能量散佈還是軌道誤差在吃掉增益。交接時要把操作點（電荷、壓縮設定、雷射加熱器能量、波盪器錐度）連同增益曲線、脈衝能量統計、波長穩定度與射頻抖動預算一起留下。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「增益曲線量測與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A free-electron laser's wavelength is set not by a gain medium but jointly by electron energy and the undulator: λ = λu(1 + K²/2)/(2γ²). Reaching 0.1 nm hard X-rays requires γ above ten thousand, so the linac length, tunnel and building cost follow from the choice of λu and K. Shortening the undulator period with small-gap in-vacuum devices and raising the accelerating gradient with C-band 5.7 GHz normal-conducting structures cuts the energy and length needed for the same wavelength several-fold, which is the design logic of compact facilities such as SACLA and SwissFEL; the price is smaller gaps and tighter wakefield and beam-quality requirements. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Undulator period and electron energy”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

SASE gain requires the electron beam to satisfy three conditions at once: transversely, the geometric emittance ε_n/γ should be below λ/4π so the beam overlaps the radiation mode; longitudinally, the slice energy spread must be below the Pierce parameter ρ or the resonant wavelength is smeared; and the peak current must reach several kiloamperes so that ρ is large and the gain length short. The three pull against each other: compression raises current but magnifies energy spread and can degrade emittance through coherent synchrotron radiation, while too small an energy spread triggers the microbunching instability, so the accelerator design is a balance among these specifications. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-quality specification sheet”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An FEL's beam quality is largely fixed at the gun; downstream acceleration can preserve but not improve it. A drive laser illuminates a copper or Cs2Te photocathode with ultraviolet pulses, and the quantum efficiency (QE) sets the laser energy needed; electrons leave the cathode with a mean transverse energy (MTE) that produces a thermal emittance proportional to the laser spot size. An RF field of about 100 MV/m at the cathode must quickly accelerate electrons to relativistic speed to suppress space-charge forces; the surface charge density cannot exceed the image-charge limit ε0E, and a solenoid after the gun performs emittance compensation to realign the transverse phase space of the slices. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photocathode and drive laser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Bunch compression first sends electrons off-crest through accelerating structures to build an energy chirp with the head lower and the tail higher, then through a four-dipole chicane where higher-energy electrons take a shorter path and catch up. Because the RF field is a cosine, the chirp carries a quadratic curvature that after compression twists the current profile into a spike with a long tail; an X-band section at four times the injector frequency, run at a decelerating phase after the injector, cancels the curvature and linearizes compression. High-gradient C-band structures have small irises and strong short-range wakefields that add energy variation within the bunch and must enter the chirp design, while coherent synchrotron radiation in the chicanes is the main source of emittance degradation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “X-band linearizer and magnetic chicane”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Bunches only tens of femtoseconds long cannot be measured directly with electronics. A transverse deflecting cavity applies a transverse RF field at zero crossing so head and tail are kicked in opposite directions, mapping time onto vertical position on a screen; combined with a horizontally bending spectrometer, one image shows current, slice energy spread and energy chirp together. Time resolution is limited by the kick strength and by the beam's own vertical size at the screen, and the deflector also adds slice energy spread, so the measurement setup belongs in the error analysis. Placed after the undulator, it compares slice energy loss with and without lasing to reconstruct the X-ray pulse's temporal shape. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Transverse deflecting cavity and screen”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Phase and amplitude jitter in every RF section becomes shot-to-shot variation of beam parameters through the compressors: phase jitter alters the chirp, so compression factor and peak current fluctuate, changing gain length and pulse energy; amplitude jitter produces energy deviation that R56 converts into arrival-time offset and, at the final energy, into photon-wavelength jitter. Because the compression factor is very sensitive to chirp at strong compression, RF stability before the first compressor is the most demanding, often at the 0.02° and 10⁻⁴ level, achieved jointly by low-level RF control and an optical-fibre timing distribution system. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF phase and amplitude jitter budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The undulator consists of tens of 4 to 5 m modules joined by quadrupoles, phase shifters and BPMs. Any small angular deviation lengthens the electron path relative to a straight line and slips its phase relative to the light, desynchronizing microbunches and radiation, so the whole line needs beam-based alignment to a straightness of a few micrometres over several metres. SASE starts from noise and has a spiky spectrum; hard X-ray self-seeding inserts a diamond crystal mid-line where the Bragg-reflected wake of the first half's SASE light serves as a narrow-band seed, and the second half amplifies only the seed, greatly improving bandwidth and stability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Undulator line and self-seeding crystal”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The core commissioning evidence is the gain curve: open undulator gaps segment by segment, or kick the orbit to disable downstream sections, and measure X-ray pulse energy versus active undulator length; the slope of the exponential region gives the real gain length and the turnover gives the saturation point. Comparing the measured gain length with the three-dimensional prediction from measured beam parameters shows whether emittance, energy spread or orbit error is eating the gain. Handoff records the working point (charge, compression settings, laser-heater energy, undulator taper) together with the gain curve, pulse-energy statistics, wavelength stability and the RF jitter budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gain-curve measurement and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 能譜分析磁鐵未經校正，實際電子能量比標示低 0.3%，光子能量隨之低 0.6%；使用者在吸收邊附近的實驗全部偏移，波盪器間隙表卻被誤認為有誤而遭錯誤修改。
只在單一零交叉量測，束團原有的 y–z 傾斜被誤當成束長，回報的電流偏高或偏低 30%；據此調整壓縮器後，實際峰值電流偏離設計，增益長度變長，飽和點移出波盪器末端。
pitfallsEn: An uncalibrated spectrometer dipole leaves the true electron energy 0.3% below the displayed value, so photon energy is 0.6% low; every user experiment near an absorption edge is shifted, and the undulator gap table is wrongly blamed and wrongly edited.

Measuring at only one zero crossing mistakes an intrinsic y–z tilt for bunch length, reporting current 30% high or low; tuning the compressors on that basis leaves the real peak current off design, lengthens the gain length and moves saturation past the end of the undulator.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：粒子加速器射頻腔
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Particle-accelerator radio-frequency cavities
guides.concept: 以 500 MHz 級常溫銅射頻腔為主軸，從 TM010 模態與渡越時間因子推到銅壁損耗、分路阻抗與冷卻，再把輸入耦合器 β、網路分析儀與珠拉量測、熱失諧調諧、束流負載補償及速調管與低階射頻迴路整合成可交接的加速腔工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Built around a 500 MHz-class normal-conducting copper cavity, the course goes from the TM010 mode and transit-time factor to copper wall loss, shunt impedance and cooling, then integrates the input-coupler β, network-analyser and bead-pull measurements, thermal-detuning tuning, beam-loading compensation and the klystron plus LLRF loop into a transferable cavity engineering record.
procedure: 射頻腔是把微波能量儲存在金屬空腔中的共振器，加速用的是 TM010 模態：電場沿束流軸向、在中心最大並沿半徑以貝索函數 J0 遞減，磁場沿方位角繞行並在側壁感應出表面電流。因為電場週期性反向，只有在電場指向前進方向的那半個週期穿過腔體的束團才會被加速，所以束團間距必須是射頻週期的整數倍。理想柱形腔的 TM010 頻率只由半徑決定，與長度無關；實際腔體加上鼻錐與束管後，頻率與場分布要用數值模擬修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TM010 腔體與軸向電場」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

粒子穿越間隙需要有限時間，這段時間內電場仍在正弦振盪，所以粒子實際獲得的電壓小於峰值間隙電壓，比例稱為渡越時間因子 T。間隙越長，粒子看到的場相位跨度越大，T 越小；但間隙太短又會提高表面電場並降低分路阻抗，鼻錐形狀就是在兩者間取捨。粒子相對射頻波峰的到達相位 φ 決定能量增益與縱向聚焦：直線加速器常在波峰附近運轉，儲存環則刻意偏離波峰以取得相位穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「加速間隙與同步相位」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

射頻電流只在腔壁表層的趨膚深度內流動，常溫無氧銅的表面電阻決定了每次振盪損失的能量，也就決定了無載品質因數 Q0。R/Q 只由腔形決定，代表單位儲能能產生多少加速電壓；分路阻抗 R_sh = (R/Q)·Q0 則把腔形與材料損耗合在一起，決定維持某個電壓需要灌入多少瓦的銅損。這些熱量必須由嵌在腔壁的冷卻水道帶走，所以常溫腔設計同時是射頻問題也是熱工問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「無氧銅腔壁與冷卻水道」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

功率由波導或同軸線經耦合環或耦合孔送入腔體，耦合強度以 β = Q0/Q_ext 表示：β = 1 時無束流的腔體對源完全匹配，β > 1 為過耦合。真空與大氣之間由氧化鋁陶瓷窗隔開，窗面常鍍數奈米氮化鈦以降低二次電子發射係數。耦合器與窗是多重電子倍增最容易發生的地方：電子在 RF 場中來回撞擊表面，若二次電子產額大於 1 且飛行時間與射頻週期同步，電流就會雪崩式增加並加熱或擊穿窗片，因此新腔需要逐步升功率的老練。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輸入耦合器與陶瓷窗」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

冷測是在低功率下用網路分析儀把腔體當成被動共振器量測：S21 的 3 dB 頻寬給出有載 Q_L，S11 在共振點的大小與相位給出 β，兩者合起來反推 Q0 與 Q_ext。場分布以珠拉法量測：把小金屬或介電珠沿軸拉過腔體，依 Slater 微擾理論，珠子所在處的電場平方正比於共振頻率位移，由此重建 Ez(z) 並計算 R/Q 與多腔結構的場平坦度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「網路分析儀與珠拉台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

腔體頻率對尺寸非常敏感，加工誤差、硬焊收縮、抽真空的壁面變形與運轉時的熱膨脹都會讓頻率偏離。運轉中的頻率必須維持在有載頻寬的一小部分內，否則振幅與相位會隨失諧而改變。實務上用柱塞或壁面變形式調諧器補償，調諧範圍必須涵蓋製造殘差、熱漂移與束流負載所需的刻意失諧，並保留餘量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「柱塞調諧器與頻率預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高電流束流穿過腔體時會感應出自身的場，等效上是一個與腔電壓不同相的電流源，稱為束流負載。為了讓發電機只看到純電阻負載、沒有反射，需同時把耦合係數提高到 β_opt = 1 + P_b/P_c，並把腔體刻意失諧以抵消束流電流的虛部。電流越大失諧越大，當失諧接近儲存環迴轉頻率時，加速模的阻抗會落在相鄰迴轉諧波上，引發縱向耦合束團不穩定；KEKB 的 ARES 腔以額外的大儲能腔降低有效 R/Q 來解決此問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流電流與腔體失諧」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

射頻功率由速調管或模組化固態放大器提供，經波導、環形器與耦合器送入腔體；速調管單管可達百萬瓦但有高壓電源與陰極壽命問題，固態放大器以數百個電晶體模組合成，單模組失效只降低少量功率。低階射頻系統以數位 IQ 解調取樣腔體探針訊號，透過比例積分回授與前饋把振幅與相位鎖在設定值，並控制調諧器。驗收要同時證明場穩定度、跳機率、聯鎖反應與老練紀錄，而不只是達到額定電壓。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「速調管、固態放大器與 LLRF」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: An RF cavity is a resonator that stores microwave energy in a metal enclosure, and acceleration uses the TM010 mode: the electric field points along the beam axis, peaks at the centre and falls radially as the Bessel function J0, while the magnetic field circles azimuthally and drives surface currents in the side wall. Because the field reverses every half period, only bunches crossing the gap while the field points forward are accelerated, so bunch spacing must be an integer number of RF periods. In an ideal pillbox the TM010 frequency depends only on radius, not length; nose cones and beam pipes in a real cell shift frequency and field shape and must be corrected by numerical simulation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TM010 cell and on-axis electric field”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A particle needs a finite time to cross the gap while the field keeps oscillating sinusoidally, so the voltage it actually gains is lower than the peak gap voltage by the transit-time factor T. A longer gap spans more RF phase and lowers T, while a very short gap raises the surface field and reduces shunt impedance, and nose-cone shaping is the compromise between the two. The arrival phase φ relative to the RF crest sets both energy gain and longitudinal focusing: linacs often run near crest, whereas storage rings deliberately run off crest to obtain phase stability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Accelerating gap and synchronous phase”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

RF currents flow only within the skin depth of the wall, and the surface resistance of room-temperature oxygen-free copper sets the energy lost per cycle and therefore the unloaded quality factor Q0. R/Q depends only on geometry and expresses how much accelerating voltage a given stored energy produces, while the shunt impedance R_sh = (R/Q)·Q0 combines geometry with material loss and sets how many watts of copper loss are needed to hold a voltage. That heat must be carried away by water channels in the wall, so a normal-conducting cavity is a thermal design as much as an RF design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Oxygen-free copper wall and cooling channels”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Power enters through a waveguide or coaxial line via a coupling loop or iris, and the coupling strength is β = Q0/Q_ext: at β = 1 an unloaded cavity is perfectly matched to the source, and β > 1 is over-coupled. An alumina ceramic window separates vacuum from air, often coated with a few nanometres of titanium nitride to lower secondary-electron yield. Couplers and windows are where multipacting is most likely: electrons strike surfaces repeatedly in the RF field, and when the secondary yield exceeds one and the flight time is synchronous with the RF period, current avalanches and can heat or puncture the window, which is why a new cavity is conditioned by raising power in steps. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Input coupler and ceramic window”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Cold test measures the cavity as a passive resonator at low power with a network analyser: the 3 dB bandwidth of S21 gives the loaded Q_L, and the magnitude and phase of S11 at resonance give β, together yielding Q0 and Q_ext. The field profile is mapped by the bead-pull method: a small metal or dielectric bead is drawn along the axis and, by Slater perturbation theory, the square of the electric field at the bead is proportional to the resonant-frequency shift, from which Ez(z), R/Q and the field flatness of multi-cell structures are reconstructed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Network analyser and bead-pull bench”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Cavity frequency is very sensitive to dimensions: machining errors, brazing shrinkage, wall deflection under vacuum and thermal expansion in operation all pull it away. In operation the frequency must stay within a small fraction of the loaded bandwidth, or amplitude and phase change with detuning. In practice a plunger or wall-deformation tuner compensates, and its range must cover fabrication residuals, thermal drift and the deliberate detuning required for beam loading, with margin. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Plunger tuner and frequency budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A high-current beam passing through the cavity induces its own field, equivalent to a current source out of phase with the cavity voltage, which is called beam loading. To present the generator with a purely resistive load and no reflection, the coupling is raised to β_opt = 1 + P_b/P_c and the cavity is deliberately detuned to cancel the reactive part of the beam current. The detuning grows with current, and when it approaches the ring revolution frequency the accelerating-mode impedance lands on neighbouring revolution harmonics and drives longitudinal coupled-bunch instability; the ARES cavity at KEKB attached a large storage cavity to lower the effective R/Q and solve this. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam current and cavity detuning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

RF power comes from a klystron or a modular solid-state amplifier and flows through waveguide, circulator and coupler into the cavity; a single klystron reaches megawatts but brings a high-voltage modulator and cathode lifetime issues, while a solid-state amplifier combines hundreds of transistor modules so one module failure costs only a little power. The low-level RF system samples the cavity probe with digital IQ demodulation, locks amplitude and phase to setpoints with proportional-integral feedback and feed-forward, and drives the tuner. Acceptance must demonstrate field stability, trip rate, interlock response and conditioning history together, not merely rated voltage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Klystron, solid-state amplifier and LLRF”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若設計時只用柱形腔公式而忽略束管與鼻錐的電容負載，製成的腔體頻率可能偏離數 MHz，超出調諧器數百 kHz 的範圍，只能重新加工或報廢。
未補償量測期間的室溫漂移，數 kHz 的頻率漂移會被誤讀為珠子造成的位移，得到虛假的場不平坦，進而錯誤地修調各腔；若把過耦合誤判為欠耦合，算出的 Q0 會偏差數十個百分比，進而錯估銅損與冷卻需求。
pitfallsEn: Designing from the pillbox formula alone while ignoring the capacitive loading of beam pipes and nose cones can leave the finished cavity several MHz off frequency, far outside a tuner range of a few hundred kHz, forcing re-machining or scrapping.

Uncompensated room-temperature drift during the measurement makes a few kHz of frequency drift look like bead-induced shift, producing a false field tilt and wrong cell tuning; mistaking over-coupling for under-coupling skews the derived Q0 by tens of percent and with it the predicted copper loss and cooling demand.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：超導加速腔製作
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication
guides.concept: 以 TESLA 型 1.3 GHz 九腔鈮製超導加速腔為對象，從 BCS 表面電阻與 Q₀ = G/Rs 出發，走過高 RRR 鈮板、深拉與電子束焊、電解拋光與烘烤、2 K 垂直測試與頻率調諧，最後整合成低溫模組並交付驗收紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using the TESLA-type 1.3 GHz nine-cell niobium cavity, start from BCS surface resistance and Q₀ = G/Rs, then follow high-RRR niobium sheet, deep drawing and electron-beam welding, electropolishing and baking, 2 K vertical testing and frequency tuning, and end with cryomodule integration and an acceptance record.
procedure: TESLA 型加速腔由九個橢圓形腔室以 π 模式串接，長度約 1.038 m，在 1.3 GHz 下建立沿軸的加速電場 E_acc。腔壁為鈮，臨界溫度 9.25 K，浸在 2 K 的超流氦中；壁面電流只在約 40 nm 的穿透深度內流動，表面電阻為奈歐姆等級，使品質因數 Q₀ 達 10¹⁰ 量級。系統邊界包括射頻功率耦合器、高階模耦合器、氦槽與調諧器；進入腔壁的功率全部變成 2 K 熱負載，而 2 K 製冷每瓦要花數百瓦電力，所以 Q₀ 是整個設計的經濟核心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

射頻場下超導體仍有耗散，因為未配對的準粒子在交變電場中被加速而碰撞。BCS 理論給出表面電阻 R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T)，其中 Δ 是能隙，鈮的 Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K；溫度越低、頻率越低，R_BCS 越小。實際表面電阻 R_s = R_BCS + R_res，殘餘電阻 R_res 來自捕獲磁通、氫化物析出與表面汙染，與溫度無關。品質因數 Q₀ = G/R_s，G 是只由腔形決定的幾何因子，TESLA 腔形 G ≈ 270 Ω。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

腔體用的鈮以殘餘電阻比 RRR ≥ 300 規格採購，RRR 是 300 K 與 4.2 K 正常態電阻的比值，反映間隙雜質（O、N、C、H）與金屬雜質（Ta、W）含量。高 RRR 的意義不在超導本身，而在 4.2 K 以下的熱導率，4.2 K 時 κ ≈ RRR/4 W/(m·K)。射頻表面上若有正常導電的缺陷或夾雜，局部發熱必須經由約 2.8 mm 厚的壁傳到氦槽；熱導率不足時缺陷周圍溫度超過 T_c，正常區域雪崩擴張，即熱崩潰（quench）。板材出廠要做渦電流或 SQUID 掃描找出夾雜，並以拉伸試驗確認深拉所需的延展性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

半腔由 2.8 mm 鈮板深拉成形，車削邊緣後在真空中以電子束焊接：先在虹膜（iris）焊成啞鈴，啞鈴再於赤道焊接成九腔；赤道焊道位於磁場最強處，焊道底面必須平滑無飛濺。焊接後表面有約 100 到 150 µm 的損傷層，用電解拋光（EP，HF–H₂SO₄ 電解液）或緩衝化學拋光（BCP）移除。接著 800 °C 真空退火數小時除氫，避免降溫時析出氫化鈮；最後再做輕度 EP、超純水高壓沖洗（HPR）、ISO 4 無塵室組裝與 120 °C 烘烤 48 小時，後者可明顯抑制高場 Q 下降。本課只說明公開的工藝邏輯，不含配方細節。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整支腔在垂直低溫槽內浸入 2 K 超流氦，以可調天線耦合射頻，鎖相迴路追蹤腔頻率。先在低場量射頻關斷後的指數衰減時間 τ，得到負載品質因數 Q_L = ω·τ；由前向與反射功率算出耦合係數 β，Q₀ = Q_L(1 + β)。接著逐步升場，每一點以穩態功率平衡求 P_diss 與儲能 U，得 Q₀(E_acc) 曲線，同時記錄輻射劑量率（場發射）與崩潰梯度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

九個腔室必須諧振在同一頻率，否則 π 模式的場在各腔室不等，局部峰值場提早到達崩潰極限。製作後以珠拉法（bead-pull）量軸上場分佈：小珠沿軸移動造成的頻率擾動正比於局部 E²（Slater 擾動定理），得到每腔室的相對振幅，場平坦度定義為 1 − (E_max − E_min)/E_avg，驗收通常要求 ≥ 95%。再以調諧機塑性拉伸或壓縮個別腔室校正頻率，並把整體頻率對準目標。運轉中腔壁受輻射壓力（勞倫茲力）而內凹，頻率隨 E_acc² 下降；加上氦壓波動與機械微震動，構成失諧預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「珠拉場分佈與勞倫茲力失諧」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

通過垂直測試的腔被焊進鈦製氦槽，鈦與鈮的熱收縮相近且可電子束焊接；槽上裝慢速步進調諧器與快速壓電元件，透過拉伸整支腔改變頻率。基波功率耦合器把室溫波導功率經陶瓷窗送入 2 K 的腔，外部品質因數 Q_ext 依束流負載選定；高階模耦合器把束流激發的寄生模導出。八支腔在無塵室內串接成腔串，與雙相氦管、熱屏、磁屏蔽與真空容器一起組成低溫模組。靜態漏熱與動態射頻耗散共同決定 2 K 製冷機的規模。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

量產腔的驗收不是單一數字，而是一組可追溯的紀錄：板材 RRR 與掃描圖、焊接參數、化學移除量、退火與烘烤紀錄、珠拉數據、每次垂直測試的 Q₀(E_acc) 曲線、輻射劑量與崩潰位置。可用梯度定義為三者的最小值：崩潰梯度扣除安全邊際、Q₀ 仍高於規格的梯度、場發射輻射低於限值的梯度。未達標的腔依失效原因決定重做 HPR、重做輕度 EP 或退回重新焊接；統計上的良率決定需要多少備用腔。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A TESLA-type cavity chains nine elliptical cells in the π mode over about 1.038 m and builds the on-axis accelerating field E_acc at 1.3 GHz. The wall is niobium with a critical temperature of 9.25 K, immersed in 2 K superfluid helium; wall current flows only within the roughly 40 nm penetration depth, the surface resistance is at the nano-ohm level, and the quality factor Q₀ reaches the 10¹⁰ range. The system boundary includes the RF power coupler, higher-order-mode couplers, helium vessel and tuner; every watt dissipated in the wall becomes a 2 K heat load, and 2 K refrigeration costs several hundred watts of electricity per watt, so Q₀ is the economic core of the design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A superconductor still dissipates under RF because unpaired quasiparticles are accelerated by the alternating field and scatter. BCS theory gives a surface resistance R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T), where Δ is the energy gap and for niobium Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K; lower temperature and lower frequency reduce R_BCS. The real surface resistance is R_s = R_BCS + R_res, where the residual term comes from trapped magnetic flux, hydride precipitation and surface contamination and does not depend on temperature. The quality factor is Q₀ = G/R_s, with G a geometry factor fixed only by the cell shape, about 270 Ω for the TESLA shape. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Cavity niobium is purchased at a residual resistivity ratio RRR ≥ 300, the ratio of normal-state resistivity at 300 K and 4.2 K, which reflects interstitial (O, N, C, H) and metallic (Ta, W) impurities. The value of high RRR is not superconductivity itself but thermal conductivity below 4.2 K, approximately κ ≈ RRR/4 W/(m·K) at 4.2 K. A normal-conducting defect or inclusion on the RF surface heats locally and the heat must cross the roughly 2.8 mm wall to the helium bath; with insufficient conductivity the surrounding temperature exceeds T_c, the normal zone avalanches outward and the cavity quenches. Sheets are eddy-current or SQUID scanned for inclusions and tensile-tested for the ductility needed in deep drawing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Half-cells are deep-drawn from 2.8 mm niobium sheet, machined at the edges and electron-beam welded in vacuum: iris welds first join half-cells into dumbbells, then equator welds join the dumbbells into a nine-cell. The equator weld sits where the magnetic field is highest, so its underbead must be smooth and spatter-free. Welding leaves a damage layer of roughly 100 to 150 µm that is removed by electropolishing (EP, an HF–H₂SO₄ electrolyte) or buffered chemical polishing (BCP). A vacuum anneal at 800 °C for several hours then degasses hydrogen so that niobium hydride cannot precipitate on cooldown; a light final EP, ultrapure-water high-pressure rinsing (HPR), ISO 4 cleanroom assembly and a 120 °C bake for 48 hours follow, the bake strongly reducing the high-field Q drop. This course covers only public process logic, not recipes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The cavity hangs in a vertical dewar immersed in 2 K superfluid helium, RF is coupled through an adjustable antenna and a phase-locked loop tracks the cavity frequency. At low field the exponential decay time τ after switching the RF off gives the loaded quality factor Q_L = ω·τ; the coupling factor β from forward and reflected power yields Q₀ = Q_L(1 + β). The field is then raised step by step, and at each point the steady-state power balance gives P_diss and the stored energy U, producing the Q₀(E_acc) curve while the radiation dose rate (field emission) and the quench gradient are logged. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

All nine cells must resonate at the same frequency; otherwise the π-mode field differs cell to cell and the local peak field reaches the quench limit early. After fabrication a bead-pull measures the on-axis field: the frequency perturbation from a small bead moved along the axis is proportional to the local E² (Slater's theorem), giving each cell's relative amplitude; field flatness is defined as 1 − (E_max − E_min)/E_avg and acceptance usually requires ≥ 95%. A tuning machine then plastically stretches or squeezes individual cells and sets the overall frequency. In operation radiation pressure (the Lorentz force) dents the wall inward so the frequency drops with E_acc²; together with helium-pressure fluctuations and microphonics this forms the detuning budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bead-pull field profile and Lorentz-force detuning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A cavity that passes the vertical test is welded into a titanium helium vessel, titanium matching niobium in thermal contraction and being electron-beam weldable; the vessel carries a slow stepper tuner and a fast piezo element that change frequency by stretching the whole cavity. The fundamental power coupler brings room-temperature waveguide power through a ceramic window into the 2 K cavity, its external quality factor Q_ext chosen for the beam loading; higher-order-mode couplers extract beam-excited parasitic modes. Eight cavities are assembled into a string in the cleanroom and, with the two-phase helium line, thermal shields, magnetic shielding and vacuum vessel, form a cryomodule. Static heat leak plus dynamic RF dissipation set the size of the 2 K refrigerator. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of production cavities is a traceable record rather than one number: sheet RRR and scan maps, weld parameters, chemical removal, anneal and bake logs, bead-pull data, every vertical-test Q₀(E_acc) curve, radiation dose and quench location. The usable gradient is the minimum of three values: the quench gradient minus a safety margin, the gradient at which Q₀ still meets specification, and the gradient at which field-emission radiation stays below the limit. Cavities that fall short are routed by failure cause to a repeat HPR, a light EP or a return to welding; the statistical yield sets how many spare cavities to order. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把射頻耗散當成「可忽略的小量」而只按靜態熱負載設計低溫系統，實機在高梯度連續波運轉時 2 K 氦槽壓力無法維持，腔體被迫降梯度或脈衝化運轉。
耦合天線插太深使 β ≫ 1，反射功率量測的微小誤差被放大，Q₀ 被高估兩倍；反之在高場時衰減時間太短無法量測，只能靠功率平衡，電纜一有鬆動就把整條曲線平移。
pitfallsEn: Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty.

An antenna inserted too deep gives β ≫ 1, so a small error in reflected power is amplified and Q₀ is overestimated by a factor of two; conversely at high field the decay becomes too short to measure, leaving only the power balance, and a loose cable shifts the whole curve.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：加速器束流位置監測
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Accelerator beam-position monitoring
guides.concept: 以 3 GeV 儲存環的四鈕扣束流位置監測器為對象，從相對論束團的鏡像電流與電極轉移阻抗出發，推導差和比靈敏度與熱雜訊解析度，再處理增益失衡、束流基準對準、快速軌道回授與交接文件。
guides.conceptEn: Taking the four-button beam-position monitor of a 3 GeV storage ring, start from the image current of a relativistic bunch and the pickup transfer impedance, derive difference-over-sum sensitivity and thermal-noise resolution, then handle gain imbalance, beam-based alignment, fast orbit feedback and handoff documentation.
procedure: 電子束團以 γ ≫ 1 飛行時，其電場被勞倫茲收縮成張角約 1/γ 的薄盤，垂直於運動方向打在真空管壁上，在壁面感應出與束流電流大小相等、方向相反的鏡像電流。管壁上的任何電極只要截取一部分鏡像電流，就得到與束團縱向分佈相同時間形狀的訊號；因此位置監測器量的不是束團本身，而是鏡像電荷在圓周上的分佈。束團長度決定訊號頻寬，電極與電子學則在某個射頻諧波上處理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

圓管內束流偏離中心 x 時，壁面鏡像電荷密度對角度 θ 的分佈為 (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ))，小位移時近似 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ。四個鈕扣放在 ±45° 與 ±135°，把對角兩組的和相減再除以四者總和，得到與 x 成正比而與束流電流無關的差和比；y 方向同理。靈敏度由管半徑與電極位置決定，非線性項隨 (r/R)³ 增長，所以大位移需要用邊界元素計算或實驗室校正表修正。解析度則由各電極訊號的訊雜比與處理頻寬決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四鈕扣差和比」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鈕扣是一片直徑數毫米的金屬圓片，經陶瓷絕緣的 50 Ω 同軸饋通引出；它對管壁有數 pF 的電容 C_b。鏡像電流截取的比例近似於鈕扣面積除以管壁周長乘以束團長度，形成一個電流源推動 C_b 與 50 Ω 負載的並聯：低頻時訊號正比於 ω（微分特性），高於轉折頻率 1/(2π·50 Ω·C_b) 後趨於平坦。轉移阻抗 Z_t 把束流的頻譜分量轉成電極電壓，是設計電子學增益與功率預算的起點。條帶電極（stripline）與腔式 BPM 分別以行波方向性與偶極模共振取得更高靈敏度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鈕扣電極與 50 Ω 饋通」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

BPM 本體由不鏽鋼或鋁整體加工，四個饋通孔位的機械公差在數十微米，外側加工出測量基準面供雷射追蹤儀測量，把電極幾何中心連到儲存環的測量網。電氣中心與機械中心不一致的來源有：電極尺寸與電容差異、電纜衰減差異、電子學通道增益差異。因為差和比對四路增益極敏感，任何通道的 1% 差異就是數十微米的假偏移，所以工程上以通道交叉切換、導頻（pilot tone）或束流基準對準把增益誤差移出量測鏈。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「BPM 本體、基準面與電氣中心」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

軌道控制真正需要的是束流相對四極磁鐵磁中心的位置，因為通過四極中心的束流不受偏轉。束流基準對準的做法是改變某個四極的強度，若束流偏離其磁中心，就會產生與偏移成正比的踢角，造成全環軌道變化；調整局部軌道直到四極強度改變不再引起軌道變化，此時 BPM 讀數就是該 BPM 對四極中心的偏移。這個偏移同時包含電氣中心誤差與機械安裝誤差，是後續所有軌道校正的零點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四極磁鐵束流基準對準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

BPM 的誤差預算要分三個時間尺度：逐圈（turn-by-turn）量測受熱雜訊與 ADC 量化限制，解析度隨頻寬平方根變差；慢軌道量測以 10 kHz 以下頻寬把雜訊平均掉；長期穩定則由電纜、電子學與機械的溫度漂移主導。解析度不能只靠電子學自測，要用三 BPM 相關法：用兩個 BPM 的讀數經傳輸矩陣預測中間 BPM 的位置，殘差的分佈寬度反映真實解析度。束流電流變化、填充模式與束流尺寸也會透過電子學非線性混入讀數，都要在預算表中各佔一列。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三 BPM 相關法與漂移紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

數位 BPM 電子學把四路射頻訊號經帶通濾波與 ADC 取樣，在 FPGA 中做數位下變頻、濾波與差和比計算，輸出逐圈、快速（10 kHz）與慢速三種資料流。快速資料經低延遲網路送到軌道回授控制器，控制器用反應矩陣的奇異值分解求出校正磁鐵電流，壓制地面振動、冷卻水與電源波動造成的軌道雜訊。整合還包括時序（與迴旋頻率同步的觸發）、束流位置連鎖（保護插件磁鐵與真空腔）以及所有校正常數的集中管理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速軌道回授迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

交接的核心是一份可重現的校正常數集：每個 BPM 的 k_x、k_y 與非線性多項式、實驗室電氣中心偏移、束流基準對準偏移、通道增益歷史、三 BPM 解析度與長期漂移係數。試運轉時逐一驗證極性（移動軌道確認讀數方向）、增益（與已知磁鐵踢角比較）、時序（逐圈資料對應正確的束團）與連鎖門檻，並把結果寫入驗收報告。之後任何電纜更換或電子學維修都必須觸發對應項目的重新校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正常數資料庫與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: An electron bunch travelling with γ ≫ 1 has its field Lorentz-contracted into a thin disc of opening angle about 1/γ, which strikes the vacuum-chamber wall perpendicular to the motion and induces an image current equal and opposite to the beam current. Any electrode in the wall that intercepts part of this image current produces a signal with the same time shape as the longitudinal bunch profile, so a position monitor measures the azimuthal distribution of image charge rather than the bunch itself. Bunch length sets the signal bandwidth, and the pickup and electronics process one RF harmonic of it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bunch field and wall image current”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When the beam is displaced by x inside a round pipe, the wall image-charge density versus angle θ is (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ)), approximately 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ for small displacement. Four buttons at ±45° and ±135° give, by subtracting the two diagonal pair sums and dividing by the total, a difference-over-sum ratio proportional to x and independent of beam current; y follows the same logic. Sensitivity is set by pipe radius and electrode positions, and the nonlinear terms grow as (r/R)³, so large displacements need boundary-element calculations or a laboratory calibration map. Resolution is set by the signal-to-noise ratio of each electrode and the processing bandwidth. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four-button difference-over-sum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A button is a metal disc of a few millimetres diameter brought out through a ceramic-insulated 50 Ω coaxial feedthrough, with a capacitance C_b of a few picofarads to the wall. The fraction of image current it intercepts is about the button area divided by the wall circumference, forming a current source that drives C_b in parallel with the 50 Ω load: at low frequency the signal is proportional to ω (differentiating), and above the corner frequency 1/(2π·50 Ω·C_b) it flattens. The transfer impedance Z_t converts each spectral component of the beam current into electrode voltage and is the starting point for electronics gain and power budgets. Stripline pickups and cavity BPMs reach higher sensitivity through travelling-wave directivity and dipole-mode resonance respectively. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Button electrode and 50 Ω feedthrough”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The BPM block is machined from one piece of stainless steel or aluminium with the four feedthrough ports toleranced to tens of micrometres, and external fiducial surfaces are machined so that a laser tracker can tie the electrode geometric centre to the ring survey network. The electrical centre departs from the mechanical centre because of electrode size and capacitance differences, cable attenuation differences and electronics channel gains. Since difference-over-sum is extremely sensitive to the four gains, a 1% mismatch in any channel is a false offset of tens of micrometres, so engineering removes gain error from the chain by channel crossbar switching, a pilot tone or beam-based alignment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “BPM block, fiducials and electrical centre”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

What orbit control really needs is the beam position relative to the quadrupole magnetic centre, because a beam through that centre is not deflected. Beam-based alignment changes the strength of one quadrupole; if the beam is off its magnetic centre, a kick proportional to the offset appears and the whole-ring orbit changes. The local orbit is adjusted until a strength change no longer moves the orbit, and the BPM reading at that point is its offset from the quadrupole centre. This offset contains both the electrical-centre error and the mechanical installation error and becomes the zero point for all later orbit correction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-based alignment to the quadrupole”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The BPM error budget separates three time scales: turn-by-turn measurement is limited by thermal noise and ADC quantisation, with resolution degrading as the square root of bandwidth; slow orbit measurement averages the noise below about 10 kHz; long-term stability is dominated by temperature drift of cables, electronics and mechanics. Resolution cannot be certified by the electronics alone, so the three-BPM correlation is used: two BPM readings predict the middle one through transfer matrices and the residual width reflects the true resolution. Beam-current changes, fill pattern and beam size also leak into readings through electronics nonlinearity and each takes a line in the budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three-BPM correlation and drift log”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Digital BPM electronics band-pass filter and sample the four RF signals, then perform digital down-conversion, filtering and the difference-over-sum computation in an FPGA, delivering turn-by-turn, fast (10 kHz) and slow data streams. The fast stream goes over a low-latency network to the orbit-feedback controller, which inverts the response matrix by singular-value decomposition to set corrector-magnet currents that suppress orbit noise from ground motion, cooling water and power-supply ripple. Integration also covers timing (triggers locked to the revolution frequency), a beam-position interlock protecting insertion devices and the vacuum chamber, and central management of all calibration constants. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast orbit-feedback loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The heart of the handoff is a reproducible set of calibration constants: each BPM's k_x, k_y and nonlinearity polynomial, the laboratory electrical-centre offset, the beam-based alignment offset, channel-gain history, three-BPM resolution and long-term drift coefficients. Commissioning verifies polarity (move the orbit and check the sign), gain (compare with a known corrector kick), timing (turn-by-turn data mapped to the right bunch) and interlock thresholds one by one, and records the results in the acceptance report. Afterwards any cable replacement or electronics repair must trigger re-calibration of the affected items. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibration database and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。
以尚未做電子學增益校正的 BPM 做束流基準對準，得到的偏移把溫度相關的增益誤差也凍結進去；數月後電纜老化，零點已變，軌道卻被「校正」到錯誤位置。
pitfallsEn: Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity; the electrode signal is contaminated by trapped-mode ringing and the reading drifts by tens of micrometres with the fill pattern.

Running beam-based alignment with BPM electronics whose gains were never calibrated freezes temperature-dependent gain error into the offsets; months later the cables age, the zero point has moved and the orbit is 'corrected' to the wrong place.
