guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：天文自適應光學
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Astronomical adaptive optics
guides.concept: 以 ESO VLT 自適應光學設施（1170 致動器的變形副鏡）與 ELT 的 2.4 m、5000 餘致動器 M4 為範本：從 r0、Greenwood 頻率與等暈角推出變形鏡與波前感測器的規格，再把擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊與非共光路像差整合成 Strehl 預算，最後以即時控制迴路與天上驗證完成工程交接。
guides.conceptEn: Using the ESO VLT Adaptive Optics Facility with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and the 2.4 m, 5000-plus-actuator M4 of the ELT as templates: derive deformable-mirror and wavefront-sensor specifications from r0, the Greenwood frequency and the isoplanatic angle, assemble fitting, temporal, measurement and non-common-path terms into a Strehl budget, and close with real-time control dynamics and on-sky validation for engineering handoff.
procedure: 大氣折射率的隨機起伏由溫度微差造成，其結構遵循 Kolmogorov 統計，強度以 C_n²(h) 剖面描述。沿視線積分後得到 Fried 參數 r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5)，它是波前相位變異量達到 1 rad² 的孔徑直徑：直徑大於 r0 的望遠鏡，長曝光影像不再隨口徑變銳，而被視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0 限制。因為 k = 2π/λ，r0 ∝ λ^(6/5)，所以同一片大氣在紅外線顯得平靜得多，這是近紅外成為自適應光學主戰場的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

湍流層被風以速度 v 吹過孔徑，相位圖樣以 Taylor 凍結流假設平移，波前的特徵頻率是 Greenwood 頻率 f_G = 0.427·v/r0；若控制迴路的 −3 dB 頻寬是 f_3dB，殘餘的時間誤差為 σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3)。另一個限制是角度：相隔 θ 的兩條視線穿過不同的湍流，殘差 σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3)，等暈角 θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ 由湍流的加權平均高度 h̄ 決定。這兩個量分別規定了波前感測器的幀率與參考星必須離目標多近，也直接引出雷射導星與多共軛 AO 的需求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

變形鏡以一片薄殼承載連續反射面，由音圈致動器以電容感測閉迴路定位：VLT 的變形副鏡在約 1.1 m 的薄殼上有 1170 個致動器，ELT 的 M4 則是 2.4 m 平面鏡、六片 1.95 mm 厚的玻璃陶瓷薄殼、5000 餘個音圈致動器，每秒更新 1000 次、行程 ±50 µm。致動器投影到主鏡的間距 d 決定可校正的最高空間頻率，殘餘的擬合誤差 σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3)；致動器總數因此按 (D/d)² 隨口徑平方成長，行程則必須涵蓋湍流的峰谷值加上望遠鏡自身的像差與風擾。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「變形副鏡與 ELT M4」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Shack–Hartmann 感測器用微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個子孔徑的光點位移正比於該處的波前斜率；金字塔感測器則在焦點放一個四面稜鏡，以四個瞳影像的強度差量斜率，對小像差的靈敏度更高。光點位置的量測受光子雜訊限制，每個子孔徑每幀只有數十到數百個光子，所以必須用讀出雜訊低於 1 e⁻ 的 EMCCD 或專用低雜訊紅外偵測器（ELT 的 LISA 由 ESO 與 Teledyne 共同開發）。感測波長的相位誤差換算到科學波段要乘 (λ_s/λ_sci)²。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

控制器需要知道每個致動器動作時感測器看到什麼：逐一（或以 Hadamard 圖樣）推拉致動器，記錄斜率向量，組成交互矩陣 D；以奇異值分解取偽逆得到控制矩陣，並截去奇異值過小、雜訊放大過大的模態。感測器與科學相機之間的光路不同，科學焦點上存在感測器看不見的非共光路像差（NCPA），必須用相位分集或 PSF 最佳化在科學相機上量出，再轉成感測器的參考斜率偏置。模態基底（Karhunen–Loève）讓每個模態可以有不同的增益。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AO 的效能用 Strehl 比衡量：在小像差下 S ≈ exp(−σ²)，σ² 是所有殘餘相位變異的總和（以 rad² 計），各項彼此獨立時直接相加。主要項目是擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊、混疊（感測器對高頻的錯誤取樣，約為擬合項的三成）、非等暈、NCPA 與色散；影像抖動（tip-tilt 與振動）不屬於小像差，另以 S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²] 的因子乘上。預算表讓工程師知道哪一項值得花錢，也決定哪種視寧度下系統值得開迴路。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Strehl 預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

即時控制器每幀讀取相機、算出斜率、以控制矩陣做一次矩陣向量乘法得到致動器指令，再加上積分器；整個路徑的延遲包含曝光、讀出、計算與致動器響應。積分控制的開迴路交越頻率約為 g·f_s/(2π)，但純延遲 τ_d 在交越頻率處造成 360°·f·τ_d 的相位落後，疊加積分器的 90°，相位裕度隨增益上升而消失，所以迴路頻寬受延遲而非運算能力限制。ESO 的 SPARTA 平台與 ELT 的即時控制在 500–1000 Hz 下運作，ELT 的 M4 指令每秒 1000 次。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「即時控制器與迴路延遲」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

系統在天上的驗證包含：對不同星等與離軸角的參考星閉迴路，量 Strehl、FWHM 與包圍能量；同步記錄感測器與變形鏡遙測，重建殘餘相位的功率譜並反推 PSF；在一系列視寧度與相干時間下建立效能對台址條件的統計。交接文件必須給出操作限制（例如 τ0 下限、視寧度上限、星等範圍）、校正檔的版本（交互矩陣、NCPA 偏置、參考斜率）、振動與延遲的量測值，以及每次重新校正的觸發條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Random refractive-index fluctuations of the air arise from small temperature differences and follow Kolmogorov statistics, with strength described by the C_n²(h) profile. Integrating along the line of sight gives the Fried parameter r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5), the aperture diameter over which the wavefront phase variance reaches 1 rad²: a telescope larger than r0 gains no further sharpness in long exposures and is limited by the seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0. Because k = 2π/λ, r0 ∝ λ^(6/5), so the same atmosphere looks far calmer in the infrared, which is why the near-infrared is the main arena of adaptive optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Turbulent layers are carried across the aperture by wind at speed v, and under Taylor's frozen-flow hypothesis the phase pattern translates, giving the wavefront a characteristic Greenwood frequency f_G = 0.427·v/r0; with a control −3 dB bandwidth f_3dB, the residual temporal error is σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3). The other limit is angular: two lines of sight separated by θ cross different turbulence, leaving σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3) with the isoplanatic angle θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ set by the turbulence-weighted mean height h̄. These two quantities fix the wavefront-sensor frame rate and how close the reference star must be, and lead directly to laser guide stars and multi-conjugate AO. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A deformable mirror carries a continuous reflective facesheet on a thin shell positioned in closed loop by voice-coil actuators with capacitive sensing: the VLT deformable secondary has 1170 actuators behind a shell of about 1.1 m, while the ELT M4 is a 2.4 m flat built from six 1.95 mm glass-ceramic shells with more than 5000 voice coils, updated 1000 times per second with ±50 µm of stroke. The actuator pitch d projected onto the primary sets the highest correctable spatial frequency, leaving a fitting error σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3); the actuator count therefore grows as (D/d)², with the square of aperture, and the stroke must cover the turbulence peak-to-valley plus telescope aberrations and wind shake. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Deformable secondary and ELT M4”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A Shack–Hartmann sensor divides the pupil into subapertures with a lenslet array, and the spot displacement in each subaperture is proportional to the local wavefront slope; a pyramid sensor instead places a four-sided prism at the focus and measures slopes from intensity differences between four pupil images, with higher sensitivity to small aberrations. Spot positioning is photon-noise limited, with only tens to hundreds of photons per subaperture per frame, so EMCCDs with sub-electron read noise or dedicated low-noise infrared detectors (the ELT's LISA was co-developed by ESO and Teledyne) are required. Phase error at the sensing wavelength scales to the science band by (λ_s/λ_sci)². Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Shack–Hartmann and wavefront-sensing camera”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The controller must know what the sensor sees when each actuator moves: push–pull each actuator (or Hadamard patterns), record the slope vector and assemble the interaction matrix D; a singular-value decomposition gives the pseudo-inverse control matrix after truncating modes whose small singular values would amplify noise. Because the optical paths to the sensor and to the science camera differ, non-common-path aberrations (NCPA) invisible to the sensor exist at the science focus; they are measured on the science camera by phase diversity or PSF optimisation and converted into reference-slope offsets for the sensor. A modal basis (Karhunen–Loève) allows each mode its own gain. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

AO performance is judged by the Strehl ratio: for small aberrations S ≈ exp(−σ²), where σ² is the sum of all residual phase variances in rad², added directly when the terms are independent. The main terms are fitting, temporal delay, measurement noise, aliasing (the sensor mis-sampling high frequencies, roughly 30% of the fitting term), anisoplanatism, NCPA and chromatic effects; image jitter from tip-tilt and vibration is not a small aberration and is applied as a separate factor S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²]. The budget table tells the engineer which term is worth money and under what seeing the loop is worth closing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Strehl budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each frame the real-time controller reads the camera, computes slopes, performs one matrix-vector multiply with the control matrix to obtain actuator commands and applies an integrator; the end-to-end latency includes exposure, readout, computation and actuator response. For integral control the open-loop crossover is about g·f_s/(2π), but a pure delay τ_d adds a phase lag of 360°·f·τ_d at crossover on top of the integrator's 90°, so phase margin vanishes as gain rises and loop bandwidth is limited by latency rather than computing power. ESO's SPARTA platform and the ELT real-time control run at 500–1000 Hz, with M4 commands issued 1000 times per second. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Real-time controller and loop latency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On-sky validation closes the loop on reference stars of different magnitudes and off-axis angles, measuring Strehl, FWHM and encircled energy; sensor and deformable-mirror telemetry are recorded synchronously to reconstruct the residual-phase power spectrum and infer the PSF; performance statistics are built against site conditions across a range of seeing and coherence time. The handoff record must state operating limits (such as a τ0 floor, a seeing ceiling and the magnitude range), the versions of calibration files (interaction matrix, NCPA offsets, reference slopes), the measured vibration and latency, and the conditions that trigger recalibration. pitfalls: 把 r0 當成與波長無關的常數，用可見光的 r0 去設計紅外 AO，會把致動器數與迴路頻率高估數倍；反之用紅外的 r0 設計可見光感測器，則子孔徑太大而讓波前量測失效。
交互矩陣在望遠鏡水平位置量測，而觀測時重力改變了感測器與變形鏡的對位（註冊誤差），矩陣中的致動器與子孔徑錯位半格，迴路雖然收斂卻把能量推到錯誤的模態，Strehl 比預算低且隨高度角變化。
pitfallsEn: Treating r0 as wavelength-independent and designing an infrared AO system with the visible r0 overestimates actuator count and loop rate by several times; using the infrared r0 for a visible-light sensor instead makes the subapertures too large and the wavefront measurement fails.

An interaction matrix measured with the telescope horizontal no longer matches when gravity shifts the registration between sensor and deformable mirror during observation; actuators and subapertures are misaligned by half a cell, the loop converges but pushes energy into wrong modes, and the Strehl falls below budget and varies with elevation.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Active support of telescope primary mirrors
guides.concept: 以 VLT 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡與 150 支軸向致動器為主軸，理解為什麼薄鏡必須由力分佈定義面形，再把彎曲模態、仰角載重、溫度梯度、30 秒積分的 Shack–Hartmann 感測、查找表與力圖健康監測整合成可驗收的主動光學工程。
guides.conceptEn: Built around the VLT's 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus and its 150 axial actuators, this course shows why a thin mirror's figure must be defined by its force distribution, then integrates bending modes, elevation loads, thermal gradients, 30-second Shack–Hartmann sensing, look-up tables and force-map health monitoring into an acceptable active-optics engineering record.
procedure: 傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。VLT 改用直徑 8.2 m、厚 175 mm 的 Zerodur 薄彎月鏡，厚徑比約 1:47、質量約 23 噸；然而板的彎曲剛度 D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) 隨厚度三次方下降，鏡面在自身重量下已無法保持形狀。主動支撐的出發點就是承認這面鏡子是軟的，改由支撐力的分佈來定義面形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。把鏡面變形展開成自由圓板的彎曲模態最有效率，因為每個模態有各自的剛性：像散與三葉形等低階模態最軟，只需小力就能修正，高階模態所需的力則隨階數迅速增加。因此主動光學只修前十到二十個模態，更高階的誤差必須在拋光階段就做好；VLT 另把離焦與彗差交給副鏡的位置修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

VLT 主鏡由 150 支電腦控制的軸向力致動器支撐，每支透過三腳架與 invar 墊（共 450 個）把力分散到鏡背，避免點載重在鏡面留下印痕。致動器同時承擔被動重量並疊加主動修正力，所以設計重點是力控制而非位置控制：鏡子的剛體位置由少數定義點或分區的被動系統決定，其餘致動器負責在該位置下提供正確的力分佈。仰角改變時軸向分量按 cos z 減少，力設定點必須連續追隨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

望遠鏡傾斜時，鏡重的 sin z 分量由黏在鏡緣的側向支撐墊承擔；側向力若不通過鏡子的質心平面就會產生彎矩，把像散壓進鏡面，因此側向支撐的位置與力分配必須與軸向力修正搭配設計。溫度則有兩種效應：穿過厚度的溫度梯度使鏡面整體彎曲，主要表現為離焦；Zerodur 熱膨脹係數的不均勻則在整體溫變下產生高階變形。此外鏡面比夜間空氣暖時會在表面形成湍流邊界層，所以白天要把鏡子預冷到預期的夜間溫度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「側向支撐與鏡室熱環境」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動光學的波前感測器裝在導引探頭中，以視場邊緣的一顆星做 Shack–Hartmann 量測：微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個光點的位移正比於該處的局部波前斜率。因為要量的是鏡面而不是大氣，曝光必須長到把湍流造成的光點隨機抖動平均掉，VLT 以約 30 秒積分、約每分鐘修正一次。量到的斜率再以最小平方法投影到主鏡彎曲模態與副鏡的離焦、彗差，換算成力與位置修正量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Shack–Hartmann 主動光學感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動光學的核心校正是影響矩陣，也就是每一支致動器或每一組模態力分佈對波前感測量測值的響應。控制器用矩陣的擬反把量到的模態係數轉成力修正，並截斷奇異值太小的模態，以免把雜訊放大。修正後的殘差要進入誤差預算：拋光殘差、支撐印痕、主動光學殘差、熱變形與風載各項以均方根相加，再換算成不同波長的 Strehl 或影像寬度，才能判斷主鏡是否滿足儀器需求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影響矩陣與誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每次換目標都沒有時間從零收斂，所以主動光學以開迴路查找表為基礎：依鏡筒仰角與溫度預測主鏡力分佈與副鏡位置，再用閉迴路量測逐步修正殘差。主鏡負責像散、三葉形、球差等彎曲模態，副鏡以位置移動修正離焦與彗差，兩者共用同一組感測資料但頻寬不同；VLT 另有最高約 1 Hz 的快速修正，只處理最低階項。查找表的品質決定了換目標後多久才能開始科學曝光。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「仰角查找表與副鏡六軸平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動支撐的驗收必須在望遠鏡上完成：在各仰角與溫度條件下量閉迴路後的模態殘差與影像寬度，把主鏡對總影像品質的貢獻從大氣、導星與儀器中分離出來。運轉後，力圖是主鏡健康最直接的紀錄：每支致動器的力歷史、力總和與重量的一致性、主動力是否逐漸逼近極限，都能提前揭露卡滯、荷重元漂移或支撐墊脫膠。交接文件需包含影響矩陣版本、查找表、各致動器校正係數與安全限值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影像品質驗收與力圖監測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure. The VLT instead uses an 8.2 m diameter, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus with an aspect ratio near 1:47 and a mass of about 23 tonnes; however the plate bending stiffness D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) falls with the cube of thickness, so the mirror can no longer hold its shape under its own weight. Active support starts by accepting that the mirror is soft and letting the distribution of support forces define its figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8.2 m thin meniscus blank”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence. Expanding the deformation in the bending modes of a free circular plate is most efficient because each mode has its own stiffness: low-order modes such as astigmatism and trefoil are softest and need little force, while the force needed rises steeply with mode order. Active optics therefore corrects only the first ten to twenty modes, higher orders must be polished out, and the VLT hands defocus and coma to secondary-mirror position control. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bending modes and correction-force patterns”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The VLT primary rests on 150 computer-controlled axial force actuators, each spreading its load through a tripod and invar pads, 450 in total, so that point loads do not print through to the surface. The actuators carry the passive weight and add active correction forces on top, so the design emphasises force control rather than position control: the mirror's rigid-body position is fixed by a few defining points or passive zoned systems, and the remaining actuators supply the correct force distribution at that position. As elevation changes the axial component falls as cos z, and the force set points must follow continuously. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “150 axial actuators and load cells”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When the telescope tilts, the sin z component of the weight is carried by lateral pads bonded to the mirror edge; lateral forces that do not act through the plane of the centre of mass create bending moments that press astigmatism into the surface, so lateral-support placement and force sharing must be designed together with axial corrections. Temperature acts in two ways: a gradient through the thickness bends the whole mirror, mainly as defocus, while inhomogeneity of the Zerodur expansion coefficient produces higher-order deformation under uniform temperature change. A mirror warmer than the night air also grows a turbulent boundary layer above its surface, so it is pre-cooled during the day to the expected night temperature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lateral supports and cell thermal environment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The active-optics wavefront sensor sits in the guide probe and makes a Shack–Hartmann measurement on a star at the edge of the field: a lenslet array divides the pupil into subapertures, and each spot's displacement is proportional to the local wavefront slope. Because the target is the mirror and not the atmosphere, exposures must be long enough to average out turbulence-induced spot jitter, so the VLT integrates for about 30 s and corrects roughly once a minute. The measured slopes are projected by least squares onto the primary's bending modes and the secondary's defocus and coma, then converted into force and position corrections. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The central calibration of active optics is the influence matrix, the response of the wavefront-sensor measurements to each actuator or each modal force pattern. The controller uses its pseudo-inverse to turn measured mode coefficients into force corrections, truncating modes with small singular values so that noise is not amplified. The corrected residual then enters the error budget: polishing residual, support print-through, active-optics residual, thermal deformation and wind load are added root-sum-square and converted into Strehl or image width at several wavelengths to judge whether the primary meets instrument needs. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Influence matrix and error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

There is no time to converge from scratch after every slew, so active optics starts from open-loop look-up tables that predict primary forces and secondary position from tube elevation and temperature, and then trims the residual with closed-loop measurements. The primary handles bending modes such as astigmatism, trefoil and spherical aberration, while the secondary corrects defocus and coma by moving, both sharing the same sensor data at different bandwidths; the VLT also runs fast corrections up to about 1 Hz for the lowest-order terms only. Table quality decides how soon after a slew science exposures can start. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Elevation look-up table and M2 hexapod”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of active support must happen on the telescope: measure closed-loop mode residuals and image width over elevation and temperature, separating the primary's contribution to total image quality from atmosphere, guide star and instrument. In operation the force map is the most direct record of mirror health: each actuator's force history, the agreement of the force sum with the weight, and whether active forces creep towards their limits all reveal sticking, load-cell drift or debonding pads early. The handoff file must hold the influence-matrix version, look-up tables, per-actuator calibration coefficients and safety limits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Image-quality acceptance and force-map monitoring”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。
若積分只有幾秒，殘留的大氣像差被當成鏡面誤差送進致動器，主鏡每次修正都在追隨機雜訊，面形越修越差；參考零點若隨溫度漂移，則會穩定地把一個不存在的像差寫進鏡面。
pitfallsEn: Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely; even with enough supports, a wrong force allocation in one zone leaves a local depression of hundreds of nanometres there.

With only a few seconds of integration, residual atmospheric aberration is mistaken for mirror error and sent to the actuators, so each correction chases random noise and the figure degrades; a reference zero point that drifts with temperature steadily writes a non-existent aberration into the mirror.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：分段鏡共相控制
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Segmented-mirror co-phasing control
guides.concept: 以 Keck 10 m 主鏡的 36 片段鏡、108 支致動器與 168 個邊緣感測器為主軸，並對照 ELT 的 798 片段鏡，理解如何把數十片獨立鏡面維持在同一個波前上：從 piston 誤差與 Strehl、可觀測性、感測器漂移、寬頻與雙波長共相，到控制迴路與段鏡更換後的重新共相。
guides.conceptEn: Built around the Keck 10 m primary with 36 segments, 108 actuators and 168 edge sensors, and compared with the ELT's 798 segments, this course shows how dozens of separate mirrors are held on one wavefront: from piston error and Strehl, observability and sensor drift, to broadband and dual-wavelength phasing, control loops and re-phasing after segment exchange.
procedure: Keck 的 10 m 主鏡由 36 片對角約 1.8 m、厚 75 mm 的六角段鏡拼成，每片都是同一個母非球面上不同離軸位置的切片。只有當所有段鏡的高度（piston）與傾斜誤差遠小於波長時，各段反射的光才會在焦點同相疊加，得到 10 m 口徑的繞射極限；否則每片只像一台 1.8 m 的獨立望遠鏡，能量散進寬度約 λ/d 的段鏡繞射暈。反射使表面高度誤差在波前上加倍，所以共相要求是奈米級的表面精度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每片段鏡由三支位置致動器控制 piston、tip 與 tilt，相鄰段鏡共用的每條邊上裝兩個邊緣感測器，量兩片鏡緣的相對高度差。邊緣感測器只量相對值，所以整面鏡的整體 piston、tip、tilt 無法觀測，必須交給望遠鏡指向與副鏡焦距；另有一種讓所有段鏡沿徑向微傾、等效改變主鏡曲率的模態，只靠感測器對兩鏡夾角的微弱靈敏度觀測，雜訊放大最大。感測器只能維持相對位置，絕對的共相零點必須由光學量測給定，而光學相位只在一個波長內唯一，這就是 2π 模糊的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Keck 使用電容式邊緣感測器：一片段鏡邊緣裝驅動電極，相鄰段鏡裝感測電極，兩片的相對高度改變重疊面積或間隙，進而改變電容。奈米級解析對應的電容變化只有 aF 等級，所以感測器採差動或比例量測並以鎖相偵測抑制雜訊。真正困難的是長期穩定：支架熱膨脹、空氣濕度改變介電常數與電極污染都會產生看似真實的高度變化，而控制迴路會忠實地把這些漂移變成真實的段鏡移動。ELT 的感測器另外量測段鏡間隙與剪切。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電容式邊緣感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每片段鏡坐在三支位置致動器上，致動器之上是把重量平均分到鏡背多點的 whiffletree（ELT 為 27 點），以免段鏡在自重下彎曲；另有 warping harness 以小彈簧力修正段鏡本身的低階面形，ELT 每片 9 支。位置致動器同時要有毫米級行程，以吸收鋼構在仰角與溫度變化下的變形，又要有奈米級解析度，通常以粗動加細動的兩級設計達成；它還必須夠剛，否則圓頂內的風壓擾動會直接變成 piston 抖動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「位置致動器、鏡座與 whiffletree」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Keck 的共相相機在瞳面放置跨越段鏡邊界的小圓孔，每個孔同時收集兩片段鏡的光並形成一個繞射影像，兩片之間的 piston 階差會改變干涉圖樣的形狀。單一窄頻波長下，相位只在 λ/2（表面）範圍內唯一，超出就產生 2π 模糊；寬頻光的相干長度短，干涉對比隨階差衰減，可在數十微米範圍內粗略定出零點；雙波長則以合成波長 Λ = λ₁λ₂/|λ₁ − λ₂| 擴大唯一範圍。實務上先寬頻捕獲，再窄頻精調。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

共相相機只能在望遠鏡指向亮星時偶爾使用，平時主鏡靠邊緣感測器的設定點維持形狀：先以光學量測把主鏡共相，再記錄當時全部感測器的讀數作為目標值，迴路此後只負責維持這組讀數。因此誤差預算包含感測器雜訊經重建器放大的項、兩次校正之間的感測器漂移、共相相機的量測誤差、致動器解析度與風載擾動；各項以均方根相加後換算成 Strehl，並據此決定校正的頻率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主鏡主動控制系統以固定頻率讀取全部邊緣感測器，乘上重建矩陣得到每支致動器的修正量；重建器排除三個不可觀測模態並對弱模態加權，整體 piston、tip、tilt 交給望遠鏡指向與副鏡焦距。迴路頻寬要高到能抑制重力與溫度造成的緩慢變形，又要遠低於段鏡支撐的結構共振，以免激發機構。下游自適應光學的 Shack–Hartmann 對段鏡邊界的階差幾乎不敏感，所以不能指望 AO 補救共相誤差，兩個系統的分工必須寫進介面文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動控制系統與自適應光學介面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

分段主鏡的鍍膜會老化，必須輪流把段鏡拆下重鍍再裝回；更換後新段鏡的位置只準到數十微米，必須先以寬頻共相捕獲、再以窄頻精調，並重新設定與它相關的所有邊緣感測器零點。驗收要同時看光學量測（共相相機殘差、焦面影像的段鏡繞射暈）與感測器健康（雜訊、漂移、失效感測器的處理），失效的感測器要從重建器移除並重算矩陣。交接文件需列出每片段鏡的序號與位置、感測器設定點版本、重建矩陣版本與更換紀錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「段鏡更換與影像驗收」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The Keck 10 m primary is tiled from 36 hexagonal segments about 1.8 m across corners and 75 mm thick, each an off-axis piece of the same parent asphere. Only when every segment's height (piston) and tilt errors are far below the wavelength does light from all segments add in phase at focus to give the diffraction limit of a 10 m aperture; otherwise each segment behaves like a separate 1.8 m telescope and energy spreads into a segment-diffraction halo of width about λ/d. Reflection doubles surface height errors in the wavefront, so phasing demands nanometre-level surface accuracy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each segment has three position actuators for piston, tip and tilt, and every edge shared by neighbouring segments carries two edge sensors that measure the relative height of the two rims. Because edge sensors are relative, global piston, tip and tilt of the whole mirror are unobservable and are handed to telescope pointing and secondary focus; another mode, in which every segment tilts slightly radially to mimic a change of primary curvature, is seen only through the sensors' weak dihedral-angle sensitivity and suffers the largest noise amplification. Sensors only hold relative positions, so the absolute phasing zero must come from an optical measurement, and optical phase is unique only within one wavelength: this is the origin of the 2π ambiguity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Keck uses capacitive edge sensors: a drive electrode on one segment's edge faces a sense electrode on its neighbour, and a change in relative height alters overlap area or gap and hence capacitance. Nanometre resolution corresponds to attofarad changes, so the sensors use differential or ratiometric measurement with lock-in detection to suppress noise. The real difficulty is long-term stability: bracket thermal expansion, humidity-driven changes in air permittivity and electrode contamination all create apparent height changes, and the control loop faithfully converts these drifts into real segment motion. The ELT sensors additionally measure intersegment gap and shear. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Capacitive edge sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each segment sits on three position actuators topped by a whiffletree that spreads its weight over many points on the back, 27 for the ELT, so the segment does not bend under self-weight; a warping harness applies small spring forces to correct the segment's own low-order figure, nine per ELT segment. The position actuators need millimetre stroke to absorb steel-structure deformation with elevation and temperature yet nanometre resolution, usually achieved with a coarse-plus-fine two-stage design; they must also be stiff, otherwise wind-pressure fluctuations inside the dome turn directly into piston jitter. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Position actuators, segment cell and whiffletree”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The Keck phasing camera places small circular apertures across intersegment edges in the pupil; each aperture collects light from two segments and forms one diffraction image whose shape changes with the piston step between them. At a single narrowband wavelength the phase is unique only within λ/2 of surface height, beyond which the 2π ambiguity appears; broadband light has a short coherence length, so fringe contrast decays with step size and locates the zero coarsely over tens of micrometres; two wavelengths form a synthetic wavelength Λ = λ₁λ₂/|λ₁ − λ₂| that extends the unique range. In practice segments are captured broadband first and then refined narrowband. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The phasing camera can be used only occasionally while the telescope points at a bright star, so most of the time the mirror is held by edge-sensor set points: the primary is phased optically, every sensor reading at that moment is recorded as its target, and the loop thereafter only maintains those readings. The error budget therefore contains sensor noise amplified by the reconstructor, sensor drift between calibrations, phasing-camera measurement error, actuator resolution and wind disturbance, added root-sum-square and converted to Strehl to decide how often to recalibrate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor set-points and phasing budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The primary's active control system reads all edge sensors at a fixed rate and multiplies them by the reconstruction matrix to get each actuator's correction; the reconstructor excludes the three unobservable modes, weights the weak ones, and hands global piston, tip and tilt to telescope pointing and secondary focus. Loop bandwidth must be high enough to reject slow gravity and thermal deformation yet far below the structural resonances of the segment supports so as not to excite them. A downstream adaptive-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor is nearly blind to steps at segment edges, so AO cannot rescue phasing errors, and the division of labour must be written into the interface document. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active control system and AO interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Segment coatings age, so segments are removed, recoated and reinstalled in rotation; after exchange a new segment is positioned only to tens of micrometres and must be captured broadband, refined narrowband, and have the zero points of every associated edge sensor reset. Acceptance looks at optical measurements, namely phasing-camera residuals and the segment halo in focal-plane images, and at sensor health, namely noise, drift and handling of failed sensors, which must be removed from the reconstructor with the matrix recomputed. The handoff file lists each segment's serial number and position, the set-point version, the reconstructor version and the exchange log. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Segment exchange and image acceptance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 可見光觀測時段鏡 piston 誤差不易察覺，因為大氣視寧度主導了影像寬度；一旦接上自適應光學在近紅外觀測，影像核心被一圈六角形繞射暈包圍，Strehl 明顯低於預期，而且無論怎麼調 AO 增益都無法改善。
若只用窄頻量測一片剛裝上、piston 誤差 0.5 µm 的段鏡，波前誤差 1.0 µm 被折疊成看似 0.075 µm 的小誤差，控制器修正後段鏡穩定鎖在錯誤的條紋上，相鄰段鏡也被重建器拉偏，整面鏡出現難以診斷的階梯。
pitfallsEn: In seeing-limited visible observing, segment piston errors hide behind atmospheric seeing; once adaptive optics feeds a near-infrared camera, the core sits inside a hexagonal diffraction halo, Strehl falls well short of prediction, and no adjustment of the AO gains helps.

Measuring a newly installed segment with 0.5 µm of piston using narrowband light alone folds its 1.0 µm wavefront error into an apparent 0.075 µm, the controller locks the segment onto the wrong fringe, the reconstructor drags its neighbours off as well, and the mirror develops a hard-to-diagnose staircase.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：天文雷射導引星
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Astronomical laser guide stars
guides.concept: 以約 90 km 高的中氣層鈉層與 ESO VLT 4LGSF 的四道 22 W 鈉雷射為主軸，從 D2 線吸收截面推到每平方公尺每秒的回波光子數，再處理錐效應、無法由雷射量測的 tip-tilt、光點拉長、鈉層高度造成的假離焦與多雷射互擾，最後落到運轉協調與驗收紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Built around the mesospheric sodium layer near 90 km and the four 22 W sodium lasers of ESO's VLT 4LGSF, this course goes from the D2 absorption cross-section to returned photons per square metre per second, then handles the cone effect, the tip-tilt a laser cannot measure, spot elongation, false defocus from sodium altitude and multi-laser cross-talk, ending with operational coordination and acceptance records.
procedure: 流星燒蝕留下的鈉原子在約 90 km 高、厚約 10 km 的中氣層形成一層稀薄的原子層，柱密度通常為每平方公分數十億個原子，並隨季節、緯度與夜間時間變化。把雷射調到鈉 D2 線 589.16 nm，鈉原子吸收後自發輻射，向各方向發出同波長的光，從地面看就像一顆位於 90 km 的人造星。鈉原子溫度約 190 K，都卜勒展寬約 1 GHz，遠大於約 10 MHz 的自然線寬，所以雷射的線寬、頻率準確度與偏振直接決定能激發多少原子。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「中氣層鈉原子層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

自然星的光以平行光柱穿過大氣，雷射導引星卻位於有限高度，回波光在望遠鏡瞳面形成一個光錐；高度 h 的湍流層只被半徑縮小為 (1 − h/H) 的部分取樣，邊緣的湍流沒被量到，這就是錐效應，也稱焦點非等暈。導引星越低、口徑越大，問題越嚴重。此外雷射上行與回波下行穿過同一段大氣，導引星在天空的位置抖動同時包含上行與下行的傾斜，兩者無法分離，所以整體 tip-tilt 必須另由一顆自然星量測。瑞利導引星利用 10 到 20 km 高的空氣分子散射，亮度高，但錐效應遠比鈉導引星嚴重，多用於地表層自適應光學。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

現代鈉導引星雷射多為連續波系統：窄線寬二極體種子雷射在 1178 nm 起振，經拉曼光纖放大器放大到數十瓦，再以共振腔倍頻得到 589 nm，ESO 4LGSF 每道約 22 W。拉曼光纖放大的難點是在高功率下抑制受激布里淵散射，同時把線寬維持在遠窄於鈉超精細結構的程度。為了提高回波，雷射採圓偏振，以光泵把原子推進循環躍遷，並把約一成功率移到 D2b 頻率做回泵，避免原子停在不吸收的基態；地磁場造成的拉莫進動會削弱光泵效果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1178 nm 拉曼光纖放大與倍頻器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雷射經光束傳輸系統送到發射望遠鏡，ESO 4LGSF 每道光束直徑 30 cm；發射口徑太小時繞射使光點變大，太大則上行光束被湍流破碎，最佳值約為數倍 r₀。中氣層光點的大小決定回波的亮度分佈與波前感測器看到的光點寬度。回波光子預算是一條鏈：雷射功率、上行透過率、鈉層吸收比例、近乎等向的再發射、隨距離平方衰減、下行透過率、望遠鏡與感測器效率，每一環都要能量測並互相對得上。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射發射望遠鏡與回波通量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鈉層有約 10 km 的厚度，從偏離發射點的子孔徑看過去，雷射光柱在天空上呈一條線段而不是一個點，這種透視拉長與子孔徑到發射點的距離成正比，方向在瞳面上呈放射狀排列。拉長方向的質心雜訊變大；鈉層剖面隨時間改變時光點質心也會位移，被誤讀成波前斜率。因此 LGS 波前感測器需要比自然星感測器更大的子孔徑視場與更多像素，並採用能處理拉長光點的質心演算法。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「LGS Shack–Hartmann 子孔徑光點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雷射導引星位於有限距離，影像落在自然星焦面之後，且距離隨天頂角以 H/cos z 變化，所以 LGS 波前感測器必須裝在可移動的對焦平台上持續追蹤。更棘手的是鈉層重心高度本身會在數分鐘內變動數百公尺，LGS 看到的離焦一部分是大氣真實離焦、一部分是鈉層移動，兩者無法分辨。解法是讓 LGS 迴路的離焦只作為快速的相對量，再以自然星的低階真值感測器慢速校正絕對焦距，同一顆自然星通常也提供 tip-tilt。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鈉層高度變化與焦距追蹤」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

單顆雷射導引星的錐效應，以多顆導引星圍繞目標排成星組來補償：各導引星的光錐在不同高度的湍流層上覆蓋不同區域，斷層重建把各方向的量測合成三維湍流分佈，再投影到目標方向。VLT UT4 的 4LGSF 以四道 22 W 雷射服務 MUSE 與 HAWK-I 的自適應光學模組。多雷射同時運轉帶來新的整合問題：連續波雷射在低空的瑞利散射光柱會落進其他雷射的感測器視場形成互擾，各雷射的指向、功率與偏振必須一致，而星組幾何決定高層湍流的覆蓋程度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多雷射星組與斷層重建」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雷射導引星的運轉必須遵守當地航空主管機關與天文台的安全規範：依核准程序協調空域，運轉中由觀察員或自動偵測系統在航機接近時中止發射，並依衛星協調單位提供的預測關閉時段暫停發射；這些是程序與紀錄要求，不是雷射操作細節。性能驗證則把前面各單元的模型對上天上的量測：回波通量、光點尺寸、LGS 與 NGS 模式的 Strehl、斷層重建的視場均勻性。交接文件要記錄雷射頻率與功率設定、偏振與回泵狀態、互擾遮罩、對焦追蹤參數與每晚的關閉事件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「航空與衛星協調及驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Sodium deposited by meteor ablation forms a thin atomic layer in the mesosphere about 90 km high and roughly 10 km thick, with a column density of a few billion atoms per square centimetre that varies with season, latitude and time of night. A laser tuned to the sodium D2 line at 589.16 nm is absorbed and re-emitted spontaneously in all directions at the same wavelength, so from the ground it looks like an artificial star at 90 km. At about 190 K the sodium Doppler width is near 1 GHz, far larger than the roughly 10 MHz natural linewidth, so the laser's linewidth, frequency accuracy and polarisation directly decide how many atoms are excited. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mesospheric sodium layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Light from a natural star crosses the atmosphere as a parallel column, but a laser guide star sits at finite altitude and its return forms a cone at the pupil; a layer at height h is sampled only over a region shrunk by (1 − h/H), leaving turbulence at the edge unmeasured, which is the cone effect or focal anisoplanatism, worse for lower beacons and larger apertures. The laser also travels up and the return comes down through the same air, so the beacon's position jitter on the sky mixes uplink and downlink tilt that cannot be separated, and overall tip-tilt must come from a natural star. Rayleigh beacons use molecular scattering at 10 to 20 km and are bright, but their cone effect is far worse than sodium's, so they mainly serve ground-layer adaptive optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser cone and turbulent layers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Modern sodium guide-star lasers are mostly continuous-wave systems: a narrow-linewidth diode seed at 1178 nm is amplified to tens of watts in a Raman fibre amplifier and frequency-doubled in a resonant cavity to 589 nm, about 22 W per beam for ESO's 4LGSF. The hard part of Raman fibre amplification is suppressing stimulated Brillouin scattering at high power while keeping the linewidth far narrower than the sodium hyperfine structure. To raise the return, the laser is circularly polarised to optically pump atoms into the cycling transition, and about a tenth of the power is shifted to the D2b frequency as a repumper so atoms do not stay in the non-absorbing ground state; Larmor precession in the geomagnetic field weakens the pumping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1178 nm Raman fibre amplifier and doubler”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The laser travels through a beam-transfer system to a launch telescope, 30 cm in beam diameter per beam for ESO's 4LGSF; too small a launch aperture enlarges the spot by diffraction, while too large a beam is broken up by turbulence on the way up, so the optimum is a few times r₀. The mesospheric spot size sets the return brightness distribution and the spot width seen by the wavefront sensor. The return-photon budget is a chain of laser power, uplink transmission, sodium absorption fraction, nearly isotropic re-emission, inverse-square dilution, downlink transmission and telescope and sensor efficiency, and every link must be measurable and consistent with the others. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Launch telescope and return flux”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Because the sodium layer is about 10 km thick, a subaperture displaced from the launch point sees the laser column as a line segment on the sky rather than a point; this perspective elongation grows with the distance between subaperture and launcher and points radially across the pupil. Centroid noise rises along the elongation, and when the sodium profile changes with time the spot centroid moves and is misread as a wavefront slope. LGS wavefront sensors therefore need larger subaperture fields and more pixels than natural-star sensors, together with centroid algorithms that handle elongated spots. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “LGS Shack–Hartmann subaperture spots”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A laser guide star at finite range images behind the natural-star focus, and its range changes as H/cos z with zenith angle, so the LGS wavefront sensor must ride on a moving focus stage. Worse, the sodium centroid altitude itself wanders by hundreds of metres within minutes, so the defocus the LGS reports is partly real atmospheric defocus and partly layer motion, and the two cannot be separated. The remedy is to treat LGS defocus only as a fast relative quantity and to correct absolute focus slowly with a natural-star low-order truth sensor, the same natural star that usually supplies tip-tilt. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sodium altitude variations and focus tracking”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The cone effect of a single beacon is compensated by an asterism of several laser guide stars around the target: each beacon's cone covers a different region of each turbulent layer, and tomographic reconstruction combines the directions into a three-dimensional turbulence estimate projected onto the target direction. The 4LGSF on VLT UT4 uses four 22 W lasers to serve the adaptive-optics modules of MUSE and HAWK-I. Running several lasers at once creates new integration issues: the low-altitude Rayleigh plume of each continuous-wave beam falls into other lasers' sensor fields as cross-talk, pointing, power and polarisation must match across lasers, and asterism geometry sets how well high layers are covered. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multi-LGS asterism and tomography”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Laser guide-star operation must follow the rules of the local aviation authority and the observatory: airspace is coordinated under an approved procedure, propagation is halted by spotters or automatic detection systems when aircraft approach, and it is paused during predicted closure windows supplied by a satellite-coordination body; these are procedural and record-keeping requirements, not laser operating details. Performance validation matches the earlier models against on-sky data: return flux, spot size, Strehl in LGS and NGS modes and field uniformity of the tomographic reconstruction. The handoff file records laser frequency and power settings, polarisation and repump state, cross-talk masks, focus-tracking parameters and each night's closure events. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aircraft and satellite coordination and acceptance log”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 雷射頻率偏離 D2a 峰數百 MHz 時，回波光子數依都卜勒輪廓迅速下降，自適應光學看到的導引星變暗、波前感測雜訊升高；若把回波下降誤歸因於鈉層季節變化而不檢查頻率鎖定，問題會持續整夜。
子孔徑視場太小時，拉長光點被截斷，質心被拉向視場中心，鈉層剖面一變就產生假的波前斜率；這些假訊號在瞳面上呈放射對稱，AO 會當成真實離焦或球差去修正，使科學影像模糊。
pitfallsEn: When the laser drifts a few hundred megahertz off the D2a peak, return photons fall rapidly along the Doppler profile, the guide star dims for the adaptive optics and wavefront-sensor noise rises; blaming the drop on seasonal sodium changes instead of checking the frequency lock lets the problem persist all night.

With too small a subaperture field the elongated spot is truncated and its centroid pulled towards the field centre, so every change in the sodium profile creates false slopes; these false signals are radially symmetric across the pupil, and the AO corrects them as real defocus or spherical aberration, blurring the science image.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：天文高解析光譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: High-resolution astronomical spectrographs
guides.concept: 以 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 這類光纖饋入、真空溫控的階梯光柵光譜儀為對象，說明為何 1 m/s 的恆星速度只相當於偵測器上 18.7 nm 的譜線位移，再把階梯光柵與交叉色散、光展量與擾頻、環境穩定、ThAr／標準具／頻率梳校正、CCD 系統誤差與重心修正整合成可驗收的徑向速度量測鏈。
guides.conceptEn: Using fibre-fed, vacuum-stabilised echelle spectrographs such as HARPS and ESPRESSO, show why a 1 m/s stellar velocity is only an 18.7 nm line shift on the detector, then integrate echelle and cross-dispersion, étendue and scrambling, environmental stability, ThAr, etalon and comb calibration, CCD systematics and barycentric correction into an acceptable radial-velocity measurement chain.
procedure: 系外行星繞行時使恆星沿視線方向週期性前後運動，恆星吸收譜線因都卜勒效應位移 δλ/λ = v/c。地球質量行星繞類太陽恆星一年軌道只造成約 9 cm/s 的速度半振幅，木星約 12.5 m/s，因此光譜儀必須在數千條譜線上量出遠小於一個像素的位移。解析力 R = λ/Δλ 決定譜線被分開與取樣的程度：R 越高譜線側翼越陡、每條線攜帶的速度資訊越多，但每個解析元素分到的光子越少，所以 R 的選擇是解析度、通量與儀器尺寸之間的取捨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

階梯光柵以每毫米數十條的粗刻線在大入射角、高繞射級（m 約 60 到 160）下工作，滿足 mλ = d(sinα + sinβ)。在 Littrow 配置 α ≈ β ≈ θ_B，角色散 dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ 只取決於閃耀角，因此 R4（tanθ_B = 4）光柵的角色散比一般一級光柵高一個數量級。代價是相鄰繞射級重疊，每一級只有很窄的自由光譜範圍 FSR = λ/m，所以要用稜鏡或低刻線密度光柵在垂直方向做交叉色散，把數十個繞射級排成二維梯狀影像鋪滿大面積 CCD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

對狹縫限制的光譜儀，R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B：望遠鏡口徑 D_T 越大、天空孔徑 φ 越大，要維持同樣的 R 就需要越大的準直光束與光柵，這是 8 m 級望遠鏡高解析光譜儀體積龐大的根源。光纖把望遠鏡焦面與溫控光譜儀分開，並以擾頻讓輸出的近場與遠場不再跟隨輸入光點位置；八角形或方形芯光纖改善近場擾頻，雙擾頻器以透鏡交換近場與遠場。瞳切割與變形光學把光束切半或壓縮單一方向，等效縮小所需的光柵尺寸。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光纖饋入與擾頻器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光譜儀內任何環境變化都會直接變成譜線位移：空氣折射率 n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ 隨壓力改變而使所有波長整體平移，溫度則改變光柵週期、光學座長度與偵測器位置。因此 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 類儀器把光學平台放進真空容器，外加多層主動溫控屏蔽，以 mK 等級的長期穩定為目標；光學座採用低膨脹材料或同材料對稱結構，偵測器有獨立的低溫恆溫器，電子設備與真空泵等熱源移到容器之外。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「真空容器與溫控屏蔽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

波長解把像素位置對應到真空波長，校正源決定能達到的精度。ThAr 空心陰極燈提供數千條絕對波長已知的譜線，但亮度差異大、彼此混疊，氬線隨燈壓位移且燈管會老化；Fabry–Pérot 標準具產生間距均勻、亮度一致的密集譜線，適合描繪像素尺度的色散，但絕對位置隨腔長漂移，需要用 ThAr 或原子譜線錨定。雷射頻率梳的每條梳齒 f_n = f_ceo + n·f_rep 由原子鐘參考，間距需經濾波腔放大到 15 至 30 GHz 才能被光譜儀解析，提供最高的準確度與可重現性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ThAr 燈、標準具與雷射頻率梳」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在光子雜訊限制下，RV 不確定度 σ_v = c/(Q·√N_e)，N_e 是全部光譜收集到的光電子數，品質因子 Q 描述光譜中譜線的密度與陡度：低溫、慢自轉的 K 矮星 Q 高，高溫、快自轉的 A 型星 Q 很低。實際精度還要加上儀器項：校正源、光纖照明變化、偵測器、熱機構漂移與地球大氣吸收線污染，各項以均方根相加。預算表的目的是讓每個子系統負責人事先知道自己能分到多少誤差，而不是事後找解釋。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子雜訊與 RV 誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

二維梯狀影像要經過級追蹤、散射光扣除、最佳萃取與閃耀函數平場校正，才得到每一級的一維光譜，再以交叉相關遮罩或模板比對求 RV。大面積 CCD 帶進三種與速度相關的系統誤差：電荷轉移效率不足使譜線向讀出方向拖尾，且拖尾比例隨通量改變；光罩拼接造成週期性的像素尺寸誤差；像素內量子效率不均。地球公轉使恆星譜線一年內在偵測器上來回移動數十個像素，這些誤差因此被轉成週期一年的假訊號。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「大面積 CCD 與萃取管線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

量到的速度包含地球自轉與公轉，必須修正到太陽系重心，而修正要用曝光期間光通量加權的中點時間，不是幾何中點；雲層或導星變化會讓兩者不同。曝光計在光譜儀內分出一小部分光，記錄通量隨時間的變化以求出加權時間。最後以多顆長期穩定的 RV 標準星、太陽光與校正源夜間漂移紀錄驗收整機，並把光纖組、溫控設定、校正序列與管線版本寫入交接文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: When an exoplanet orbits, its star moves periodically toward and away from us and its absorption lines shift by δλ/λ = v/c. An Earth-mass planet in a one-year orbit around a Sun-like star produces a velocity semi-amplitude of only about 9 cm/s and Jupiter about 12.5 m/s, so the spectrograph must measure shifts far smaller than a pixel across thousands of lines. Resolving power R = λ/Δλ sets how well lines are separated and sampled: higher R steepens line flanks and gives each line more velocity information, but spreads photons over more resolution elements, so choosing R trades resolution, throughput and instrument size. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Doppler shift of stellar lines”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An echelle uses coarse rulings of tens of grooves per millimetre at steep incidence and high orders, m of about 60 to 160, obeying mλ = d(sinα + sinβ). In Littrow, α ≈ β ≈ θ_B, the angular dispersion dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ depends only on the blaze angle, so an R4 grating with tanθ_B = 4 disperses an order of magnitude more than a first-order grating. The price is overlapping orders, each with a narrow free spectral range FSR = λ/m, so a prism or low-groove-density grating cross-disperses perpendicular to the echelle and stacks dozens of orders into a two-dimensional ladder that tiles a large CCD. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “R4 echelle and cross-disperser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

For a slit-limited spectrograph R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B: a larger telescope aperture D_T or sky aperture φ demands a larger collimated beam and grating for the same R, which is why high-resolution spectrographs on 8 m telescopes are so large. Fibres separate the telescope focus from the thermally controlled spectrograph and scramble the light so the output near and far fields no longer follow the input spot position; octagonal or square cores improve near-field scrambling and a double scrambler swaps near and far fields with lenses. Pupil slicing and anamorphic optics split the beam or compress one axis, effectively shrinking the grating required. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fibre feed and scrambler”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Any environmental change inside a spectrograph becomes a line shift: the refractive index of air, n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴, varies with pressure and translates all wavelengths together, while temperature changes grating period, bench length and detector position. HARPS- and ESPRESSO-class instruments therefore put the optical bench inside a vacuum vessel wrapped in nested actively controlled thermal shields aiming at mK-level long-term stability; benches use low-expansion or symmetric same-material structures, the detector has its own cryostat, and heat sources such as electronics and vacuum pumps are moved outside the vessel. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vacuum vessel and thermal shields”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The wavelength solution maps pixel position to vacuum wavelength, and the calibration source sets the attainable precision. ThAr hollow-cathode lamps give thousands of lines with known absolute wavelengths, but their brightness varies widely, lines blend, argon lines shift with lamp pressure and lamps age; Fabry–Pérot etalons give dense, evenly spaced lines of uniform brightness that map dispersion at pixel scale, but their absolute positions drift with cavity length and must be anchored to ThAr or atomic lines. A laser frequency comb, with each tooth at f_n = f_ceo + n·f_rep referenced to an atomic clock, needs filter cavities to raise its spacing to 15 to 30 GHz so the spectrograph can resolve it, and delivers the highest accuracy and repeatability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ThAr lamp, etalon and laser frequency comb”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

In the photon-noise limit the RV uncertainty is σ_v = c/(Q·√N_e), where N_e is the number of photoelectrons collected over the spectrum and the quality factor Q describes line density and steepness: cool, slowly rotating K dwarfs have high Q while hot, fast-rotating A stars have very low Q. Real precision adds instrumental terms, namely calibration source, fibre-illumination changes, detector, thermo-mechanical drift and telluric-line contamination, combined root-sum-square. The budget table tells each subsystem owner in advance how much error they may consume rather than explaining failures afterwards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon noise and RV budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The two-dimensional ladder becomes one-dimensional spectra per order only after order tracing, scattered-light subtraction, optimal extraction and blaze flat-field correction, and RV is then derived by cross-correlation masks or template matching. Large CCDs add three velocity-related systematics: charge-transfer inefficiency trails lines toward the readout with a flux-dependent fraction, mask stitching creates periodic pixel-size errors, and quantum efficiency varies within each pixel. Earth's orbit sweeps stellar lines tens of pixels across the detector each year, turning these errors into spurious annual signals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Large CCD and extraction pipeline”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Measured velocities contain Earth's rotation and orbital motion and must be corrected to the solar-system barycentre using the flux-weighted midpoint of the exposure rather than its geometric midpoint, since clouds or guiding changes make the two differ. An exposure meter picks off a small fraction of the light inside the spectrograph and records flux versus time to obtain that weighted time. Final acceptance uses several long-term RV-stable standards, sunlight and nightly calibration-drift records, and the handoff document fixes the fibre link, thermal set points, calibration sequence and pipeline version. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 只看解析力規格而忽略取樣，每個解析元素少於 2 個像素時譜線欠取樣，像素內響應差異會轉成隨地球公轉速度改變的假訊號；反之若在口徑不足的望遠鏡上把 R 推得過高，每個解析元素的光子不足，RV 精度反而變差。
頻率梳濾波腔失鎖時，被抑制的鄰近梳齒重新出現，每條譜線變成不對稱的混疊，重心偏移數 m/s 卻仍看似正常譜線；更換 ThAr 燈管後若沒有重新建立參考，氬線壓力位移會讓整個波長解出現跳點。
pitfallsEn: Quoting resolving power while ignoring sampling leaves lines undersampled below 2 pixels per resolution element, so intrapixel response differences become spurious signals that vary with Earth's orbital velocity; conversely, pushing R too high on a small aperture starves each element of photons and degrades RV precision.

When a comb's filter cavity loses lock, suppressed neighbouring modes reappear and each line becomes an asymmetric blend whose centroid moves several m/s while still looking normal; replacing a ThAr lamp without re-establishing the reference lets argon pressure shifts introduce a jump into the whole wavelength solution.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：天文干涉儀光程控制
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers
guides.concept: 以 ESO VLTI（GRAVITY，四台望遠鏡、K 波段）與 CHARA 陣列（六台 1 m 望遠鏡、331 m 基線）為對象，從相干長度與地球自轉造成的光程差變化出發，建立延遲線機構、雷射計量、條紋追蹤、可見度校正與天體測量誤差預算的完整工程鏈。
guides.conceptEn: Using the ESO VLTI with GRAVITY (four telescopes, K band) and the CHARA Array (six 1 m telescopes, 331 m baseline) as the reference instruments, the course starts from coherence length and the Earth-rotation delay rate and builds the full engineering chain of delay-line mechanics, laser metrology, fringe tracking, visibility calibration and astrometric error budgets.
procedure: 兩台相距基線 B 的望遠鏡接收同一顆星的光，星光到達兩鏡的時間差對應幾何光程差 D = B·ŝ，其中 ŝ 是指向天體的單位向量；只有把這段光程差補償到遠小於相干長度，兩道光才能在合成實驗室裡形成干涉條紋。條紋的角週期為 λ/B，因此干涉儀的角解析度由基線而非單鏡口徑決定；條紋對比（可見度）則依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理等於天體亮度分佈在空間頻率 B/λ 上的傅立葉分量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基線向量與幾何延遲」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

寬頻光的干涉條紋被一個包絡調制，包絡寬度就是相干長度 L_c = λ²/Δλ；光程差超出 ±L_c/2 左右條紋對比便迅速下降，因此延遲線不只要補償幾何延遲，還必須找到並停留在零光程差附近。大氣活塞項（piston）讓這個點隨機抖動數微米，而延遲線隧道中的空氣色散會讓不同波長的零光程差位置分開，把條紋包絡拉長並降低對比；CHARA 為此把望遠鏡到實驗室的光路放在真空管內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相干長度與條紋包絡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

VLTI 的延遲線是沿隧道軌道行走的台車，上面裝著貓眼式反射鏡，光束來回兩次，所以台車走 60 m 可補償 120 m 的光程差；粗動由輪驅台車負責，細動由貓眼次鏡上的壓電致動器負責，兩者由雷射計量閉迴路串接。因為地球自轉，幾何延遲以 dD/dt = ω_E·B·cosθ 的速率連續變化，台車必須以毫米每秒等級平滑追蹤，而不是定點停住。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「延遲線台車與貓眼反射鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

延遲線位置由氦氖雷射干涉儀連續量測，但雷射量到的是光學長度 n·L，而空氣折射率隨壓力、溫度與濕度變化（Edlén 公式），隧道內的溫度梯度會把幾何長度與星光看到的光程分開。GRAVITY 另外從合成器反向注入一道 1908 nm 計量雷射，一路量到望遠鏡上，直接量測科學光束與條紋追蹤光束之間的差分光程，因為微角秒天體測量需要的是奈米級的差分光程知識，而不是絕對光程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射計量與真空光管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每台望遠鏡上方的大氣各自加上隨機的活塞相位，兩鏡之間的差分活塞在 K 波段有數微米均方根，而且在相干時間 τ₀ 內就會換一次。條紋追蹤器以數百赫茲到 1 kHz 的速率量測條紋相位，命令快速壓電鏡或音圈鏡即時修正光程，讓科學相機能以秒級曝光累積訊號；τ₀ 隨波長以 λ^(6/5) 成長，所以在 K 波段追蹤比在可見光容易。GRAVITY 的條紋追蹤器正是以這種方式把四台望遠鏡的六條基線同時鎖住。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「條紋追蹤器與大氣活塞」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

量到的可見度 V_meas = T·V_true，其中系統傳遞函數 T < 1 包含殘餘活塞抖動、兩臂強度不等、偏振失配、波前殘差與色散等項，每一項都能用簡單公式估計並列成預算表。T 無法只靠模型決定，必須在科學目標前後觀測直徑已知的校正星，用它的理論可見度反推當時的 T，再內插到科學觀測；校正星的直徑不確定度因此直接進入最終結果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可見度校正與傳遞函數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

GRAVITY 用一片積體光學晶片把四道光束兩兩配對成六條基線，每條基線輸出四個相位各差 90° 的通道（A、B、C、D），共 24 個輸出同時落在偵測器上；由四個通道的強度差可以直接解出條紋的可見度與相位，不需要機械掃描。四台望遠鏡繞任一三角形把三條基線的相位相加得到閉合相位，望遠鏡各自的活塞誤差在相加時互相抵消，使閉合相位成為不受大氣影響的影像觀測量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「積體光學合成器與 ABCD 輸出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光程控制系統的驗收不是看延遲線在實驗室的定位精度，而是看整條鏈在天上的表現：條紋鎖定比例隨視寧度與 τ₀ 的分佈、殘餘光程差均方根、延遲線可用度，以及跨夜的天體測量重複性。交接文件必須包含基線解、計量零點、P2VM、延遲線校正表與維護週期（軌道清潔、真空泵、雷射頻率檢查），因為這些參數任何一項靜悄悄地改變，都會以假的科學訊號出現。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Two telescopes separated by baseline B receive the same starlight, and the arrival-time difference corresponds to a geometric path difference D = B·ŝ, with ŝ the unit vector toward the object; only when this difference is compensated to far less than the coherence length do the two beams form fringes in the combination laboratory. The angular fringe period is λ/B, so the resolution is set by the baseline rather than the single-aperture diameter, and by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem the fringe contrast (visibility) equals the Fourier component of the brightness distribution at spatial frequency B/λ. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Baseline vector and geometric delay”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Broadband fringes are modulated by an envelope whose width is the coherence length L_c = λ²/Δλ; contrast collapses once the OPD leaves roughly ±L_c/2, so the delay line must not only compensate the geometric delay but find and hold the zero-OPD point. Atmospheric piston jitters that point by several micrometres, and air dispersion in the delay tunnel separates the zero-OPD positions of different wavelengths, stretching the packet and lowering contrast; CHARA therefore carries the telescope-to-laboratory beams in vacuum pipes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coherence length and fringe envelope”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A VLTI delay line is a carriage running on rails in the tunnel carrying a cat's-eye retroreflector; the beam passes twice, so 60 m of carriage travel compensates 120 m of OPD. Coarse motion is the wheel-driven carriage, fine motion is a piezo actuator on the cat's-eye secondary, and both are closed through the laser metrology. Because the Earth rotates, the geometric delay changes continuously at dD/dt = ω_E·B·cosθ, so the carriage must track smoothly at millimetres per second rather than park at a point. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Delay-line carriage and cat's-eye retroreflector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The delay-line position is read continuously by a helium–neon laser interferometer, but the laser measures optical length n·L and the air index varies with pressure, temperature and humidity (Edlén equation), so temperature gradients in the tunnel separate the geometric length from the path the starlight sees. GRAVITY additionally injects a 1908 nm metrology laser backwards from the combiner all the way to the telescopes to measure the differential path between the science and fringe-tracking beams directly, because microarcsecond astrometry needs nanometre knowledge of the differential path, not of the absolute path. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser metrology and vacuum beam pipes”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The atmosphere above each telescope adds its own random piston phase; the differential piston between two telescopes has an rms of several micrometres in the K band and changes within the coherence time τ₀. The fringe tracker measures the fringe phase at several hundred hertz to 1 kHz and commands a fast piezo or voice-coil mirror to correct the path in real time, so the science camera can integrate for seconds; τ₀ grows as λ^(6/5), which makes tracking easier in the K band than in the visible. The GRAVITY fringe tracker locks all six baselines of the four telescopes this way. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fringe tracker and atmospheric piston”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The measured visibility is V_meas = T·V_true, where the system transfer function T < 1 collects residual piston jitter, unequal arm intensities, polarisation mismatch, residual wavefront error and dispersion, each estimable with a simple formula and tabulated into a budget. T cannot be fixed by modelling alone: calibrator stars of known diameter are observed before and after the science target, their theoretical visibility yields T at that time and it is interpolated to the science observation, so the calibrator's diameter uncertainty enters the final result directly. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Visibility calibration and transfer function”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

GRAVITY pairs four beams into six baselines on one integrated-optics chip, and each baseline delivers four outputs phase-shifted by 90° (A, B, C, D), 24 outputs landing simultaneously on the detector; the visibility and phase follow directly from the intensity differences without mechanical scanning. Summing the phases of the three baselines around any telescope triangle gives the closure phase, in which telescope-specific piston errors cancel, so it is an atmosphere-free imaging observable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Integrated-optics combiner and ABCD outputs”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of the path-control system is judged not by the laboratory positioning accuracy of a delay line but by the whole chain on sky: fringe-lock fraction binned by seeing and τ₀, residual OPD rms, delay-line availability and night-to-night astrometric repeatability. The handoff record must carry the baseline solution, metrology zero points, the P2VM, delay-line calibration tables and maintenance intervals (rail cleaning, vacuum pumps, laser-frequency checks), because a silent change in any of these shows up as a false scientific signal. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “End-to-end acceptance and operations record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 基線向量若有毫米級誤差，計算出的幾何延遲會隨時角漂移，延遲線追到錯誤位置，條紋在幾分鐘內移出相干包絡並消失；若誤差較小而未被發現，則轉成天體測量的系統偏差。
訊噪比下降時相位量測出現 2π 模糊，追蹤器鎖到相鄰一個波長的條紋（fringe jump），若科學相機仍在曝光，累積的可見度與相位會被系統性拉低；需要群延遲量測同時監看才能偵測並回復。
pitfallsEn: A millimetre-level error in the baseline vector makes the computed geometric delay drift with hour angle, the delay line tracks to the wrong position, and the fringes walk out of the coherence envelope within minutes; a smaller unnoticed error becomes a systematic astrometric bias.

When the signal-to-noise ratio drops, the phase measurement becomes 2π-ambiguous and the tracker locks one wavelength away (a fringe jump); if the science camera keeps integrating, the accumulated visibility and phase are biased low, and only a simultaneous group-delay measurement can detect and recover it.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Radio-telescope low-noise receivers
guides.concept: 以 ALMA 前端（4 K SIS 混頻器與 15 K 低溫 HEMT 中頻放大器）與綠堤 100 m 望遠鏡（GBT）的公分波接收機為對象，從輻射計方程與 SEFD 出發，拆解饋源照明、Friis 雜訊級聯、量子雜訊極限、Y 因子校正、Allan 變異數與低溫恆溫器整合，最後落到接收機驗收與交接。
guides.conceptEn: Using the ALMA front end (4 K SIS mixers with 15 K cryogenic HEMT IF amplifiers) and the centimetre-wave receivers of the 100 m Green Bank Telescope as reference designs, the course starts from the radiometer equation and SEFD and works through feed illumination, the Friis noise cascade, the quantum noise limit, Y-factor calibration, Allan variance and cryostat integration, ending with receiver acceptance and handoff.
procedure: 電波望遠鏡收到的天體訊號本身就是雜訊狀的隨機電壓，功率為 P = k·T·B·G；系統雜訊溫度 Tsys 把天空、地面溢出與接收機本身的貢獻加總成一個等效溫度。輻射計方程 ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) 說明靈敏度只能靠降低 Tsys、加寬頻寬或拉長積分時間；把天線有效面積一起考慮，系統等效流量密度 SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff 就是接收機與天線合起來的靈敏度指標，單位是 Jy。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

波紋饋源喇叭產生近似高斯的對稱波束去照明副反射鏡，邊緣照明強度（edge taper）決定了兩個互相拉扯的效率：照明越均勻，照明效率越高，但從副鏡邊緣溢出的能量也越多；溢出的波束若看到 280 K 的地面，就直接把地面雜訊加進 Tsys。總孔徑效率還要乘上表面精度造成的 Ruze 因子與遮擋損失，所以毫米波望遠鏡的面板精度與饋源設計是一體考慮的。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波紋饋源喇叭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

公分波與 ALMA 的中頻放大都靠 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器，冷到 4–15 K 時雜訊溫度可到幾個 K，增益 30–40 dB。Friis 公式 T_cas = T₁ + T₂/G₁ + T₃/(G₁G₂) + … 說明只要第一級增益夠高，後級雜訊就被壓到可以忽略；相反地，放在第一級之前的任何損耗 L 都把後面所有雜訊乘上 L，並自己加入 (L−1)·T_phys 的雜訊，因此饋源、正交模轉換器與波導必須做到最短、最冷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「低溫 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在 ALMA 的毫米／次毫米波段（84–950 GHz），HEMT 放大器的雜訊已不夠低，所以前端改用 4 K 的 Nb/AlOx/Nb 超導–絕緣–超導（SIS）穿隧接面當混頻器：本振光子協助電子穿隧，把天體訊號降頻到 4–12 GHz 的中頻，再交給低溫 HEMT 放大。SIS 混頻器的雜訊可以接近量子極限 hν/k，而 Nb 的能隙限制了可用頻率，更高頻段改用 NbTiN 電極；混頻器、本振耦合與中頻放大器都裝在同一個卡匣裡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SIS 混頻器與本振」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

接收機雜訊以 Y 因子法量測：對溫度 T_hot 與 T_cold 的兩個黑體負載記錄輸出功率比 Y = P_hot/P_cold，解得 T_rx = (T_hot − Y·T_cold)/(Y − 1)。日常觀測不方便搬負載，改用耦合進前端的雜訊二極體：它注入已知的 T_cal，由開／關功率比得到 Tsys = T_cal/(P_on/P_off − 1)，而 T_cal 本身必須定期用負載回溯校正。毫米波系統（如 ALMA 的校正裝置）用常溫與加熱負載，再配合天空傾角掃描求大氣不透明度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱／冷負載與雜訊二極體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

輻射計雜訊隨 1/√τ 下降，但放大器的 1/f 增益漲落與大氣發射的起伏會隨 τ 增加而上升，兩者相加在 Allan 變異數圖上形成一個最小值，對應的 τ_A 就是單次積分的上限。超過 τ_A 再積分只會更差，因此總功率觀測必須以快於 τ_A 的節奏做位置、波束或頻率切換；對 ALMA 這種寬頻系統，增益穩定度的規格比雜訊溫度更難達成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「增益穩定度與 Allan 變異數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

ALMA 的前端把多個波段卡匣裝進同一個低溫恆溫器，三級 GM 低溫機提供約 110 K、15 K 與 4 K 的平台；熱負載來自輻射、波導與同軸線的傳導，以及放大器本身的耗散，每一級的預算都要算清楚。真空窗與紅外濾片必須在該波段低損耗，但窗與饋源之間任何殘餘反射都會形成駐波，使頻帶響應出現週期性漣波，週期為 c/(2L)，L 是兩反射面的間距。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前端低溫恆溫器與真空窗」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

一個接收機卡匣的驗收包含：各本振設定下 T_rx 對頻率曲線、邊帶分離比、中頻通帶平坦度、Allan 穩定度、波束方向圖與交叉極化、雜散訊號；上望遠鏡後再用行星量孔徑效率、量各波段的指向與焦點偏移、量 Tsys 對可降水量的關係。交接文件必須有校正表、T_cal、相位中心位置與操作限制，否則實驗室合格的接收機在望遠鏡上無法重現相同靈敏度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「接收機驗收與性能紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The signal a radio telescope collects is itself a noise-like random voltage with power P = k·T·B·G; the system noise temperature Tsys lumps sky, ground spillover and the receiver into one equivalent temperature. The radiometer equation ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) shows that sensitivity improves only through lower Tsys, wider bandwidth or longer integration; folding in the antenna effective area, the system equivalent flux density SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff is the combined antenna-plus-receiver sensitivity figure in Jy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “System noise temperature Tsys”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A corrugated feed horn produces a nearly Gaussian symmetric beam that illuminates the subreflector, and the edge taper sets two competing efficiencies: a flatter illumination raises illumination efficiency but spills more power past the subreflector edge, and spillover that sees the 280 K ground adds ground noise straight into Tsys. The total aperture efficiency is further multiplied by the Ruze factor from surface accuracy and by blockage, so panel accuracy and feed design of a millimetre telescope are considered together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Corrugated feed horn”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Centimetre-wave front ends and the ALMA IF chains rely on InP HEMT low-noise amplifiers that reach a few kelvin of noise temperature with 30–40 dB gain when cooled to 4–15 K. The Friis formula T_cas = T₁ + T₂/G₁ + T₃/(G₁G₂) + … shows that with enough first-stage gain the later stages become negligible; conversely any loss L ahead of the first stage multiplies everything behind it by L and adds (L−1)·T_phys of its own, which is why the feed, orthomode transducer and waveguide must be as short and as cold as possible. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cryogenic InP HEMT low-noise amplifier”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

In the ALMA millimetre and submillimetre bands (84–950 GHz) HEMT amplifiers are no longer quiet enough, so the front end uses 4 K Nb/AlOx/Nb superconductor–insulator–superconductor (SIS) tunnel junctions as mixers: local-oscillator photons assist electron tunnelling and the sky signal is down-converted to a 4–12 GHz IF that is then amplified by cryogenic HEMTs. SIS mixer noise can approach the quantum limit hν/k, and the niobium gap limits the usable frequency, so higher bands use NbTiN electrodes; mixer, LO coupling and IF amplifier sit together in one cartridge. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SIS mixer and local oscillator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Receiver noise is measured by the Y-factor method: record the output-power ratio Y = P_hot/P_cold for two blackbody loads at T_hot and T_cold and solve T_rx = (T_hot − Y·T_cold)/(Y − 1). Since loads are impractical during routine observing, a noise diode coupled into the front end injects a known T_cal, and the on/off power ratio gives Tsys = T_cal/(P_on/P_off − 1), with T_cal itself traced back to the loads periodically. Millimetre systems such as the ALMA calibration device use ambient and heated loads together with sky dips to obtain the atmospheric opacity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hot/cold loads and noise diode”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Radiometer noise falls as 1/√τ, but 1/f gain fluctuations of the amplifiers and fluctuations of atmospheric emission rise with τ; their sum produces a minimum in the Allan-variance plot, and the corresponding τ_A is the ceiling on a single integration. Integrating beyond τ_A only makes things worse, so total-power observing must switch position, beam or frequency faster than τ_A; for a wideband system such as ALMA the gain-stability specification is harder to meet than the noise temperature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gain stability and Allan variance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The ALMA front end packs several band cartridges into one cryostat whose three-stage GM cryocooler provides stages near 110 K, 15 K and 4 K; heat loads come from radiation, conduction through waveguides and coaxial lines, and the dissipation of the amplifiers themselves, and every stage needs its own budget. The vacuum window and infrared filter must be low-loss in band, yet any residual reflection between the window and the feed forms a standing wave that imprints periodic ripple on the bandpass with period c/(2L), L being the spacing of the two reflecting surfaces. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Front-end cryostat and vacuum window”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of a receiver cartridge covers T_rx versus frequency at each LO setting, sideband-separation ratio, IF passband flatness, Allan stability, beam pattern with cross-polarisation and spurious signals; on the telescope it continues with aperture efficiency from planets, pointing and focus offsets per band and Tsys versus precipitable water vapour. The handoff record must contain calibration tables, T_cal, phase-centre positions and operating limits, otherwise a receiver that passed in the lab cannot reproduce the same sensitivity on the telescope. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Receiver acceptance and performance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若接收機增益有 ΔG/G = 1e−3 的漲落，等效雜訊下限為 Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK，在 Bτ = 1e6 時就與輻射計雜訊相等；再積分也不會更好，必須改用 Dicke 切換或頻率切換。
雜訊二極體的輸出隨其物理溫度與老化漂移，若未回溯校正，每 5% 的 T_cal 誤差就直接變成 5% 的流量尺度誤差，而且會悄悄進入所有觀測資料。
pitfallsEn: A gain fluctuation ΔG/G = 1e−3 sets an equivalent noise floor of Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK, equal to the radiometer noise already at Bτ = 1e6; further integration does not help, and Dicke or frequency switching becomes necessary.
The noise-diode output drifts with its physical temperature and ageing; without re-tracing, every 5% error in T_cal becomes a 5% flux-scale error that silently enters every observation.
