guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：CERN Linac4 直線加速器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: CERN Linac4 linear accelerator
guides.concept: 以取代 Linac2、自 2020 年起為 CERN 全部質子束流源頭的 86 m 長 Linac4 為對象，說明為何把注入能量從 50 MeV 提高到 160 MeV 並改用 H⁻ 能讓 PS Booster 亮度約加倍，再把 45 keV 離子源、3 MeV RFQ、斬波線、三種 352.2 MHz 加速結構、飛行時間相位掃描、損失與剝離預算、碳膜電荷交換注入與可靠度驗收整合成可交接的加速器紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: For the 86 m Linac4 that replaced Linac2 and since 2020 sources every proton beam at CERN, show why raising injection energy from 50 to 160 MeV with H⁻ ions roughly doubles PS Booster brightness, then integrate the 45 keV source, 3 MeV RFQ, chopper line, three 352.2 MHz accelerating structures, time-of-flight phase scans, loss and stripping budgets, carbon-foil charge-exchange injection and reliability acceptance into a transferable accelerator record.
procedure: LHC 束流的亮度在注入鏈最前端就被決定：PS Booster 在低能注入時，束流自身的空間電荷使橫向工作點偏移 ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²)，偏移過大就會跨越共振造成發射度成長與損失。把注入能量從 Linac2 的 50 MeV 提高到 160 MeV，β·γ² 增加約一倍，同樣的工作點偏移可容納約兩倍粒子。改用帶兩個電子的 H⁻ 則可做電荷交換注入：剝離膜在環內把 H⁻ 變成質子，這是非保守的過程，新進束流可以疊放在已循環束流的相空間上而不受劉維定理限制，多圈累積時損失與發射度成長都比質子隔板注入小。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Linac4 所有加速結構都在 352.2 MHz 工作，這也是 LEP 的頻率，讓它能沿用 LEP 的速調管與波導。粒子必須在每個加速間隙都遇到同一個 RF 相位：在 0 模的 Alvarez 型 DTL 中，相鄰間隙相距 βλ，即粒子在一個 RF 週期飛過的距離；在 π 模結構中相鄰單元相位相反，間距為 βλ/2。由於 β 從 0.08 增加到 0.52，單元沿線逐漸變長，每種結構只在某一 β 範圍內效率最高。同步相位取負值（例如 −20°），讓早到的粒子得到較少能量、晚到的得到較多，形成縱向聚焦，代價是能量增益乘以 cosφ_s。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「352.2 MHz 加速間隙與單元長度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Linac4 的離子源以數十 kW 的射頻加熱氫電漿，配合銫降低表面功函數以增加 H⁻ 產額，同時被引出的電子由偏轉磁場導到電子收集器，H⁻ 以 45 keV 引出。低能傳輸線以螺線管把束流匹配進 RFQ，殘氣電離產生的正離子部分中和空間電荷。3 m 長的 RFQ 把束流從 45 keV 加速到 3 MeV：四片電極的正弦調制同時提供與速度無關的電四極聚焦與縱向加速場，並把直流束流絕熱地聚束成 352.2 MHz 的微束團，這正是低 β 時磁聚焦無效、空間電荷最強時所需的功能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「RF 驅動 H⁻ 離子源與 RFQ」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

3 MeV 的中能傳輸線上有靜電偏轉板斬波器，依 PSB 約 1 MHz 的 RF 桶結構移除特定微束團，約 65% 的束流保留，被移除的束團在 3 MeV 打到吸收器，那裡活化最小，避免它們在 PSB 捕獲時於 160 MeV 損失。斬波器上升時間必須短於 2.84 ns 的束團間距。之後 DTL 以漂移管內的永久磁鐵四極聚焦把能量提高到 50 MeV；50 到約 102 MeV 用七個模組的耦合腔 DTL，四極磁鐵放在腔外，便於對準與冷卻；102 到 160 MeV 用十二個 π 模結構，在 β 約 0.5 時有較高的有效分路阻抗。所有結構以 LEP 遺留的 352 MHz 速調管與新增速調管供電。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「斬波線、DTL、CCDTL 與 PIMS」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每個加速腔的 RF 振幅與相位都要設定在讓束流以同步相位到達的位置，否則能量誤差會一路累積。做法是讓某一腔的相位掃過 360°，同時以下游兩個束流位置監測器的相位訊號量測飛行時間，換算束流能量；把量到的能量對相位曲線與模擬的特徵曲線擬合，得到該腔的振幅與相位偏差。腔體依序調整，前一腔確定後作為下一腔的參考。H⁻ 還可以用雷射把多餘電子光剝離，做不攔截的束流剖面量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「BPM 之間的飛行時間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

亮度是流強除以發射度，設計要求在 PSB 注入處的正規化 rms 橫向發射度約 0.4 mm·mrad，沿線成長約 40%，其中約一半發生在斬波線。空間電荷失配與 RF 誤差會在束流周圍形成暈，暈粒子打到管壁成為損失；為了能人工維護，常用每公尺約 1 W 的損失上限。H⁻ 另有特有的損失途徑：與殘氣碰撞失去一個電子變成中性 H⁰，不再受四極磁鐵與偏轉磁鐵控制，沿直線飛到下一個轉彎處撞上真空管；束內碰撞與強磁場中的勞侖茲剝離則在更高能量才變得重要。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「發射度量測與束流損失監測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

160 MeV 的 H⁻ 經傳輸線送到 PSB，以脈衝式踢束磁鐵與隔板把連續的束流段依序分配到上下堆疊的四個環。每個環的注入區以局部軌道凸起讓 H⁻ 與循環質子會合，H⁻ 穿過薄碳膜時兩個電子被剝離，變成質子留在環內；未完全剝離的 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 被導向內部吸收器。注入期間逐步改變凸起高度做橫向相空間塗佈，以得到目標發射度與分布；但循環質子每圈都可能再穿過碳膜，引起多重庫侖散射、核反應損失與碳膜加熱，因此塗佈與凸起收回時序必須讓穿膜次數最少。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Linac4 依結構安裝順序分段試運轉：先在測試站驗證離子源、RFQ 與斬波線，再於隧道內逐段把能量推進到 50、100 與 160 MeV，2016 年達到 160 MeV，之後以可靠度運轉累積故障統計，再於 2019 到 2020 年的長停機期間接上 PSB。整機可用率是串聯子系統可用率的乘積，所以離子源、每一座 RF 站、真空、電源與控制都要分配可用率預算。交接紀錄要包含 RF 設定點與相位掃描結果、離子源操作參數、損失地圖、聯鎖門檻與備品策略，讓營運團隊能在更換元件後快速回到已知狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: LHC beam brightness is fixed at the very front of the injector chain: at low-energy injection into the PS Booster the beam's own space charge shifts the transverse tune by ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²), and too large a shift crosses resonances, growing emittance and causing losses. Raising injection energy from Linac2's 50 MeV to 160 MeV roughly doubles β·γ², so the same tune shift accommodates about twice the particles. Switching to H⁻ ions carrying two electrons enables charge-exchange injection: a stripping foil converts H⁻ to protons inside the ring, a non-conservative process that lets incoming beam be stacked onto the circulating beam's phase space without the Liouville constraint, so multi-turn accumulation produces less loss and emittance growth than proton septum injection. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

All Linac4 structures run at 352.2 MHz, the LEP frequency, which lets the linac reuse LEP klystrons and waveguides. A particle must meet the same RF phase at every gap: in a 0-mode Alvarez DTL adjacent gaps are βλ apart, the distance travelled in one RF period, while in a π-mode structure adjacent cells are in opposite phase and spaced βλ/2. Because β grows from 0.08 to 0.52, cells lengthen along the linac and each structure type is most efficient only in a certain β range. The synchronous phase is negative, for example −20°, so early particles gain less energy and late ones more, giving longitudinal focusing at the cost of multiplying energy gain by cosφ_s. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “352.2 MHz gaps and cell length”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The Linac4 source heats a hydrogen plasma with tens of kilowatts of RF and uses caesium to lower the surface work function and raise H⁻ yield, while co-extracted electrons are bent onto an electron dump and the H⁻ ions are extracted at 45 keV. The low-energy transport line matches the beam into the RFQ with solenoids, and positive ions from residual-gas ionisation partly neutralise space charge. The 3 m RFQ accelerates from 45 keV to 3 MeV: the sinusoidal modulation of its four vanes provides velocity-independent electric quadrupole focusing and a longitudinal accelerating field, and adiabatically bunches the DC beam into 352.2 MHz micro-bunches, exactly what is needed when magnetic focusing is weak at low β and space charge is strongest. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF-driven H⁻ source and RFQ”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The 3 MeV medium-energy line carries an electrostatic deflecting-plate chopper that removes selected micro-bunches to match the roughly 1 MHz RF bucket pattern of the PSB, keeping about 65% of the beam; removed bunches hit an absorber at 3 MeV where activation is minimal instead of being lost at 160 MeV during PSB capture. The chopper rise time must be shorter than the 2.84 ns bunch spacing. The DTL then reaches 50 MeV with permanent-magnet quadrupoles inside its drift tubes; seven cell-coupled DTL modules take the beam from 50 to about 102 MeV with quadrupoles outside the cavities for easier alignment and cooling; twelve π-mode structures go from 102 to 160 MeV with higher effective shunt impedance near β ≈ 0.5. All structures are powered by reused LEP 352 MHz klystrons and newer klystrons. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Chopper line, DTL, CCDTL and PIMS”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each cavity's RF amplitude and phase must be set so the beam arrives at the synchronous phase, otherwise energy errors accumulate down the line. One cavity's phase is swept through 360° while the time of flight between two downstream beam-position monitors is measured from their phase signals and converted to beam energy; fitting the measured energy-versus-phase curve to the simulated signature yields that cavity's amplitude and phase offsets. Cavities are set in sequence, each settled one serving as reference for the next. H⁻ beams also allow non-intercepting profile measurement by laser photodetachment of the extra electron. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Time of flight between BPMs”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Brightness is current divided by emittance, and the design calls for a normalised rms transverse emittance of about 0.4 mm·mrad at PSB injection, with roughly 40% growth along the line, about half of it in the chopper line. Space-charge mismatch and RF errors build a halo whose particles strike the beam pipe as losses, and a limit of about 1 W per metre is commonly used to keep hands-on maintenance possible. H⁻ has its own loss channels: a collision with residual gas strips one electron to make neutral H⁰, which no longer responds to quadrupoles or dipoles and flies straight into the vacuum pipe at the next bend; intra-beam stripping and Lorentz stripping in strong magnetic fields matter only at higher energies. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Emittance meters and beam-loss monitors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The 160 MeV H⁻ beam travels down the transfer line to the PSB, where pulsed kickers and septa distribute successive slices to four vertically stacked rings. In each ring a local orbit bump brings the H⁻ beam alongside the circulating protons, and on crossing a thin carbon foil both electrons are stripped, leaving protons that stay in the ring; partially stripped H⁰ and unstripped H⁻ are steered to an internal dump. The bump height is changed during injection to paint transverse phase space to the target emittance and distribution, but circulating protons can cross the foil every turn, causing multiple Coulomb scattering, nuclear losses and foil heating, so painting and bump-collapse timing must minimise foil traversals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Linac4 was commissioned in stages following installation: source, RFQ and chopper line were first validated on a test stand, then energy was pushed in the tunnel to 50, 100 and 160 MeV, reaching 160 MeV in 2016, followed by a reliability run to accumulate fault statistics before connection to the PSB during the 2019–2020 long shutdown. Overall availability is the product of series subsystem availabilities, so source, every RF station, vacuum, power supplies and controls each receive an availability budget. The handoff record holds RF set points and phase-scan results, source operating parameters, loss maps, interlock thresholds and the spares policy so operations can return to a known state quickly after any component change. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reliability run and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若只提高直線加速器的流強而不提高注入能量，PSB 注入時空間電荷工作點偏移超過允許範圍，束流跨越整數或半整數共振，發射度成長並在環內損失，下游 LHC 的亮度目標無法達成，還造成環內活化。
BPM 電纜延遲隨溫度漂移 20 ps，對應約 2.5° 的相位誤差與約 40 keV 的能量誤讀，操作員據此把腔體相位設偏，束流偏離波峰進入下一段結構，縱向失配在高能段轉為損失；若沒有保存掃描結果，下次更換速調管後只能從頭重做。
pitfallsEn: Raising linac current without raising injection energy pushes the space-charge tune shift at PSB injection beyond its allowance, the beam crosses integer or half-integer resonances, emittance grows and particles are lost in the ring, so the LHC brightness target is missed and the ring is activated as well.

A 20 ps temperature drift in BPM cable delay corresponds to about 2.5° of phase and roughly 40 keV of misread energy, so operators set the cavity phase wrongly, the beam enters the next structure off crest and the longitudinal mismatch becomes losses at high energy; without saved scan results, every klystron replacement forces the procedure to start from scratch.

guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: CERN Super Proton Synchrotron
guides.concept: 以 SPS 的 744 台常溫偶極磁鐵與 Bρ = 3.3356·p 為起點，理解它如何把 26 GeV/c 質子加速到 450 GeV/c，再把 200 MHz 行波腔與固態放大器、非晶碳鍍膜、線掃描器發射度量測、三階共振慢引出損失預算與向 LHC 轉移的機器保護整合成可驗收的注入器工程。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the SPS's 744 warm dipoles and Bρ = 3.3356·p, see how it takes protons from 26 GeV/c to 450 GeV/c, then integrate 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities with solid-state amplifiers, amorphous-carbon coating, wire-scanner emittance measurement, the third-integer slow-extraction loss budget and LHC-transfer machine protection into an acceptable injector engineering record.
procedure: SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。粒子動量 p、磁場 B 與彎轉半徑 ρ 滿足 Bρ = p/e，工程上寫成 Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]。因為 ρ 被隧道幾何固定，同步加速器必須讓磁場隨動量同步上升，並以射頻頻率鎖住軌道長度；注入端的低場與頂端的高場相差十幾倍，兩端的場品質都要顧到。總彎轉角 2π 由所有偶極的磁長分攤，其餘周長留給四極、直線段、射頻腔與注入引出設備。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPS 以 200 MHz 行波腔加速，諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev 決定環上射頻「桶」的數目；LHC 型束流以 25 ns 間隔佔據每 5 個 5 ns 桶中的 1 個。縱向穩定取決於滑相因子 η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²：高於轉變能時，動量較高的粒子繞一圈反而較慢。SPS 從 Q26 改用 Q20 光學，把轉變能 γt 由約 22.8 降到約 18，使 26 GeV/c 注入時 |η| 變大，同步頻率與不穩定性門檻跟著提高；固定靶束流若以 14 GeV/c（γ ≈ 15）注入，仍須在斜坡中穿越轉變能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「200 MHz 行波加速腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPS 共有 1317 台常溫電磁鐵，其中 744 台為偶極，由疊片低碳鋼鐵芯與水冷銅線圈構成，場形由極面形狀決定。鐵芯在 2 T 附近開始飽和，因此 450 GeV 已接近常溫鐵磁鐵的實用上限，這也是 LHC 必須改用超導磁鐵的原因。疊片抑制斜坡時的渦電流，但鐵的磁滯使同一電流下的磁場取決於前一循環的最高場；SPS 在超循環中交錯 LHC、固定靶與其他用戶循環，磁場歷史不斷改變。偶極分為兩種孔徑型式，以配合不同位置的束流尺寸。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

25 ns 間隔的高強度質子束團會把真空室壁上的殘餘電子吸向束流中心並加速，電子撞牆時若二次電子產率（SEY）大於 1，電子數隨每個束團倍增而形成電子雲，造成橫向不穩定、發射度增長、壓力上升與熱負載。SPS 在 LS2 期間把 88 支聚焦四極（QF）的束管、相鄰短直線段與部分漂移段鍍上非晶碳，平均最大 SEY 約 0.99，低於漂移管約 1.1、QF 約 1.25 的倍增門檻；MBB 偶極的鍍膜規劃在 LS3 進行。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPS 送往 LHC 的束流品質以正規化發射度 ε_n 衡量：無擾動時 ε_n 在加速中守恆，而幾何發射度隨 1/(βγ) 縮小。線掃描器以細碳纖維線快速穿過束流，由下游閃爍體量二次粒子簇射得到橫向剖面 σ，再以 ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w 換算，其中 β_w 為量測點的 Twiss β 函數、D·δ 為動量分散造成的寬度。誤差來源包括 β_w 的光學誤差、線速度與位置編碼、線材受熱以及量測點色散的修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速線掃描器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

送往北區（North Area）固定靶的 400 GeV/c 質子以三階共振慢引出：六極磁鐵在相空間形成三角形穩定區，水平工作點逐漸逼近 80/3 ≈ 26.667，穩定區縮小，粒子沿分離軌跡每三圈向外跨一步，越過靜電分離器（ZS）的細線陣列後被電場偏轉進入引出通道。ZS 由五個各長 3.15 m、每個含 2080 根鎢錸細線的槽構成。約 4.8 s 的平頂把約 3.5×10¹³ 顆質子均勻送出，形成實驗所需的長 spill；打在線上的質子造成損失與活化，是慢引出的核心限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPS 把 450 GeV 束串經 TI2 與 TI8 兩條長度約 2.5 至 2.7 km 的傳輸線分別送進 LHC 的兩個環。引出踢磁鐵必須在束串間隙內上升到位，任何時序或強度錯誤都可能讓整串高能束流打到傳輸線或 LHC 注入區，因此傳輸線末端設有可移動的注入保護準直器（TCDI），引出前由互鎖系統檢查軌道、強度與磁鐵電流，並先以低強度探針束驗證路徑。束串的強度與發射度決定 LHC 亮度，也決定出錯時的破壞力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TI2/TI8 傳輸線與注入保護準直器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPS 同時服務 LHC、北區固定靶、HiRadMat、AWAKE 與離子運轉，控制系統把不同循環排成超循環，每個循環有自己的磁場斜坡、射頻程式與引出設定。LIU 升級把 200 MHz 行波腔由 4 座增為 6 座，並由 Thales 交付兩套固態功率放大器：每套 16 座 144 kW 放大塔、每塔 80 個 1.8 kW 功率模組，全系統 5120 顆電晶體，以大量並聯換取優雅降級與高可用度。驗收必須同時證明束流參數與系統可用度達標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「200 MHz 固態功率放大器與超循環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets. Momentum p, field B and bending radius ρ obey Bρ = p/e, written in engineering units as Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]. Because ρ is fixed by the tunnel geometry, a synchrotron must raise the field in step with momentum while the RF frequency locks the orbit length; injection and top fields differ by more than a factor of ten, and field quality matters at both ends. The total 2π bend is shared among the dipoles' magnetic lengths, and the rest of the circumference holds quadrupoles, straight sections, RF cavities and injection and extraction equipment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “744 main dipole magnets”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The SPS accelerates with 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities, and the harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev sets how many RF buckets fit around the ring; LHC-type beams at 25 ns spacing fill one in every five 5 ns buckets. Longitudinal stability depends on the slip factor η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²: above transition, higher-momentum particles take longer per turn. Moving from Q26 to Q20 optics lowered the transition gamma from about 22.8 to about 18, enlarging |η| at 26 GeV/c injection and raising both the synchrotron frequency and instability thresholds; fixed-target beams injected at 14 GeV/c (γ ≈ 15) still cross transition during the ramp. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The SPS has 1317 warm electromagnets, 744 of them dipoles, built from laminated low-carbon steel yokes and water-cooled copper coils, with the field shape set by the pole profile. The iron begins to saturate near 2 T, so 450 GeV is close to the practical limit of warm iron magnets, which is why the LHC had to use superconducting magnets. Laminations suppress eddy currents during the ramp, but iron hysteresis makes the field at a given current depend on the previous cycle's peak; the SPS interleaves LHC, fixed-target and other users in a supercycle, so the magnetic history keeps changing. The dipoles come in two aperture types matched to the local beam size. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

High-intensity proton bunches at 25 ns spacing pull residual electrons off the chamber wall towards the beam and accelerate them; if the secondary-electron yield (SEY) on impact exceeds 1, the electron population multiplies bunch after bunch into an electron cloud, causing transverse instabilities, emittance growth, pressure rise and heat load. During LS2 the SPS coated the beam pipes of its 88 focusing quadrupoles (QF), the adjacent short straight sections and some drifts with amorphous carbon, reaching an average maximum SEY of about 0.99, below multipacting thresholds of about 1.1 in drift tubes and 1.25 in QF chambers; coating of the MBB dipoles is planned for LS3. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The quality of beam sent to the LHC is measured by normalized emittance ε_n, which is conserved during unperturbed acceleration while geometric emittance shrinks as 1/(βγ). A wire scanner sweeps a thin carbon fibre rapidly through the beam, a downstream scintillator records the secondary shower to give the transverse profile σ, and ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w converts it, with β_w the Twiss beta at the scanner and D·δ the width from momentum spread. Error sources include optics error in β_w, wire speed and position encoding, wire heating and the dispersion correction at the scanner. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast wire scanners”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Protons at 400 GeV/c for North Area fixed targets leave by third-integer slow extraction: sextupoles create a triangular stable region in phase space, the horizontal tune is driven towards 80/3 ≈ 26.667, the stable area shrinks, and particles step outward along separatrices every three turns, jumping over the thin-wire array of the electrostatic septum (ZS) whose field deflects them into the extraction channel. The ZS consists of five 3.15 m tanks, each with 2080 tungsten–rhenium wires. A flat top of about 4.8 s spreads roughly 3.5×10¹³ protons into the long spill experiments need, and protons striking the wires cause loss and activation, the central limit of slow extraction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electrostatic-septum tungsten–rhenium wire array”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The SPS sends 450 GeV trains into the LHC's two rings through the TI2 and TI8 transfer lines, each roughly 2.5 to 2.7 km long. Extraction kickers must reach full field inside the inter-train gap, and any timing or strength error can steer a whole high-energy train into the transfer line or the LHC injection region; movable injection-protection collimators (TCDI) therefore sit at the end of the lines, an interlock system checks orbit, intensity and magnet currents before extraction, and a low-intensity probe beam validates the path first. Train intensity and emittance set LHC luminosity and also the damage potential of a mistake. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TI2/TI8 lines and injection-protection collimators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The SPS serves the LHC, North Area fixed targets, HiRadMat, AWAKE and ion runs, and the control system arranges their cycles into a supercycle, each with its own field ramp, RF programme and extraction settings. The LIU upgrade increased the 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities from four to six and Thales delivered two solid-state transmitters, each with sixteen 144 kW amplifier towers of eighty 1.8 kW RF modules, 5120 transistors in all, trading massive parallelism for graceful degradation and high availability. Acceptance must demonstrate both beam parameters and system availability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “200 MHz solid-state amplifiers and the supercycle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若注入平台的磁場因前一循環的磁滯歷史偏離 0.1%，在固定 RF 頻率下束流動量與磁場不匹配，色散 D = 3 m 處閉合軌道徑向偏移約 3 mm，注入效率下降，束流在色散大的位置刮到孔徑並造成活化。
束流強度高而線速度不足時，線材被加熱到昇華或斷裂，掃描器失效，碎片落入真空室；若 β_w 校正過時，報告的發射度系統性偏低，直到 LHC 亮度不如預期才被發現。
pitfallsEn: If the injection-plateau field departs by 0.1% because of the previous cycle's hysteresis history, beam momentum and field no longer match at fixed RF frequency, the closed orbit moves about 3 mm radially where D = 3 m, injection efficiency drops and the beam scrapes the aperture in high-dispersion regions, activating them.

With high intensity and insufficient wire speed the fibre heats until it sublimates or breaks, disabling the scanner and dropping debris into the vacuum chamber; an outdated β_w calibration biases reported emittances low until disappointing LHC luminosity reveals it.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：CERN 反質子減速器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: CERN Antiproton Decelerator
guides.concept: 以 26 GeV/c 質子打銥靶、在 3.57 GeV/c 收集反質子為起點，理解 AD 如何把它們逐平台減速到 100 MeV/c，再由周長 30.4 m 的 ELENA 降到 100 keV，並把隨機冷卻、電子冷卻、Schottky 診斷、極高真空與效率鏈整合成可交接給 ALPHA、AEgIS、BASE 等實驗的低能反物質工程。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from 26 GeV/c protons on an iridium target and antiproton collection at 3.57 GeV/c, see how the AD decelerates them plateau by plateau to 100 MeV/c and the 30.4 m ELENA ring takes them to 100 keV, then integrate stochastic and electron cooling, Schottky diagnostics, extreme-high vacuum and the efficiency chain into low-energy antimatter engineering handed to experiments such as ALPHA, AEgIS and BASE.
procedure: 反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。PS 約每 100 s 送出約 1.5×10¹³ 顆 26 GeV 質子，打在長 50 mm 的銥靶上；高密度短靶讓產生點接近點光源，產物向前錐形飛出，再由脈衝磁喇叭的方位角磁場把發散的負電粒子聚焦成近平行束，選取動量約 3.57 GeV/c 的反質子送入周長約 182 m 的 AD。每個質子只換得約百萬分之三的可收集反質子，後續每一步的效率因此都非常珍貴。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「銥靶與磁喇叭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AD 是倒著運轉的同步加速器：磁場與射頻頻率同步下降，把反質子由 3.57 GeV/c 依序減到 2 GeV/c、300 MeV/c 與 100 MeV/c。加速器以動量描述粒子，因為磁剛度 Bρ 正比於動量；實驗端則關心動能。減速時幾何發射度按 1/(βγ) 反向增長、相對動量分散也變大，就像加速時的絕熱阻尼倒過來；若不在平台上冷卻，束流會在減速途中撐滿孔徑而流失。射頻系統還必須追蹤速度由 0.97c 降到 0.1c 的大幅頻率變化。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在 3.57 與 2 GeV/c 的高動量平台，AD 使用隨機冷卻：拾取電極量測束流某一取樣片段的平均位置或動量偏差，訊號經寬頻放大後沿環的弦線捷徑傳送，在同一批粒子抵達踢擊器時施加修正。每次修正只作用在約 1/(2W) 時間片內粒子的平均值，粒子數越少、頻寬越寬，冷卻越快；這是 van der Meer 為 SppS 對撞機累積反質子所發明的技術。放大器熱雜訊與粒子在拾取器到踢擊器之間混合不足，都會抵消冷卻效果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「隨機冷卻拾取器與踢擊器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在 300 與 100 MeV/c 的低動量平台改用電子冷卻：在一段直線段內讓一束約數 A、橫向溫度很低的電子與反質子以相同平均速度同行，反質子經庫侖碰撞把多餘的熱運動交給電子，電子束持續更新，並在收集極回收大部分能量。速度匹配要求電子的 γ 與反質子相同，即電子動能 T_e = (γ − 1)m_ec²；導引螺線管把電子約束成磁化的冷電子束。冷卻力在相對速度小時最強，所以電子冷卻擅長把已預冷的束流壓到極小的發射度與動量分散。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子冷卻器電子槍、螺線管與收集極」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AD 每循環只有 10⁷ 量級的反質子，平均電流低於一般直流電流變壓器的有效解析度，因此強度與動量分散主要靠縱向 Schottky 訊號量測：粒子隨機分佈在環上，在每個迴轉諧波 n·f₀ 附近產生雜訊帶，帶的功率正比於粒子數，寬度正比於動量分散。由頻寬換算 Δp/p 需要滑相因子 η，而 η 取決於晶格的動量壓縮因子，必須以獨立量測校正，否則所有冷卻效果的評估都帶有系統誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Schottky 拾取器與低強度診斷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

反質子速度越低，與殘氣分子的散射截面越大，停留在平台上的時間也越長，因此真空要求隨能量下降而急遽提高。AD 平均真空約 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr，ELENA 則要求約 3×10⁻¹² Torr 的極高真空：真空室以低導磁率不鏽鋼（如 316LN）製作並可烘烤至 300 °C，廣泛採用 NEG（非蒸散型吸氣劑）鍍膜提供分布式抽氣，每台偶極與每段直線段配置 NEG 與離子泵組合，並使用全金屬閥門與 ConFlat 接頭。此壓力下殘氣以氫為主，損失與發射度增長主要來自單次散射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NEG 鍍膜與極高真空」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

過去 AD 直接把 5.3 MeV 反質子送給實驗，實驗再以降能箔片把能量降到可捕捉的 keV 等級，絕大多數反質子在箔片中湮滅或散開。ELENA 是周長 30.4 m 的小型減速環，把動量由 100 MeV/c 降到 13.7 MeV/c（動能 5.3 MeV 到 100 keV），在中間平台與末端以電子冷卻縮小束流，再分成 4 個束團經靜電傳輸線送到不同實驗區；在 100 keV 時靜電偏轉元件輕巧且沒有磁滯。結果使可捕捉的反質子數增加 10 到 100 倍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ELENA 環與靜電傳輸線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AD 與 ELENA 的價值以每天送進實驗阱的反質子數衡量，它是產額、捕獲、各段減速與冷卻效率、ELENA 傳輸與實驗端捕捉效率的乘積。循環時間約 100 至 110 s，主要由各平台冷卻時間決定；縮短冷卻會降低束流品質，延長則降低速率。交接紀錄需列出每個平台的強度、發射度、動量分散、循環時間與可用度，讓 ALPHA、AEgIS、ASACUSA、BASE、GBAR 等實驗共享同一份基準，才能把阱內數量的變化追溯到加速器端或實驗端。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「約 100 s 的 AD 循環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target. About every 100 s the PS delivers roughly 1.5×10¹³ protons at 26 GeV onto a 50 mm iridium target; the short, dense target makes the production point nearly a point source, products fly forward in a cone, and the azimuthal field of a pulsed magnetic horn focuses the diverging negative particles into a near-parallel beam from which antiprotons near 3.57 GeV/c are selected for the AD, a ring of about 182 m circumference. Each proton yields only about three collectable antiprotons per million, so every later efficiency is precious. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Iridium target and magnetic horn”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The AD is a synchrotron run in reverse: field and RF frequency fall together, taking antiprotons from 3.57 GeV/c to 2 GeV/c, 300 MeV/c and 100 MeV/c. Accelerator physicists describe particles by momentum because magnetic rigidity Bρ is proportional to it, while experiments care about kinetic energy. During deceleration geometric emittance grows as 1/(βγ) and relative momentum spread widens, adiabatic damping run backwards; without cooling on the plateaus the beam would fill the aperture and be lost on the way down. The RF system must also follow the large frequency swing as speed drops from 0.97c to 0.1c. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On the high-momentum plateaus at 3.57 and 2 GeV/c the AD uses stochastic cooling: a pickup measures the mean position or momentum error of a sample slice of the beam, the signal is amplified over a wide band and sent along a chord across the ring, and a kicker corrects the same particles when they arrive. Each correction acts only on the average of the particles within a time slice of about 1/(2W), so fewer particles and wider bandwidth cool faster; van der Meer invented the technique to accumulate antiprotons for the SppS collider. Amplifier thermal noise and poor mixing between pickup and kicker both erode the cooling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Stochastic-cooling pickups and kickers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On the low-momentum plateaus at 300 and 100 MeV/c the AD switches to electron cooling: over a straight section an electron beam of a few amperes with very low transverse temperature travels at the same mean velocity as the antiprotons, which hand their excess thermal motion to the electrons through Coulomb collisions; the electron beam is continuously renewed and most of its energy is recovered in a collector. Velocity matching requires the same γ, so the electron kinetic energy is T_e = (γ − 1)m_ec², and a guiding solenoid keeps the electrons as a cold magnetized beam. The cooling force is strongest at small relative velocity, so electron cooling excels at squeezing a pre-cooled beam to tiny emittance and momentum spread. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron-cooler gun, solenoid and collector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

With only about 10⁷ antiprotons per cycle, the AD's mean current is below the useful resolution of ordinary DC current transformers, so intensity and momentum spread are measured mainly from longitudinal Schottky signals: particles randomly distributed around the ring create noise bands near each revolution harmonic n·f₀, whose power is proportional to particle number and whose width is proportional to momentum spread. Converting width to Δp/p needs the slip factor η, which depends on the lattice momentum compaction and must be calibrated independently, or every assessment of cooling carries a systematic error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Schottky pickups and low-intensity diagnostics”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The slower the antiproton, the larger its scattering cross-section on residual gas and the longer it sits on a plateau, so vacuum requirements tighten sharply as energy falls. The AD averages about 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr, while ELENA needs extreme-high vacuum near 3×10⁻¹² Torr: chambers of low-permeability stainless steel such as 316LN bakeable to 300 °C, extensive NEG (non-evaporable getter) coating for distributed pumping, combined NEG and ion pumps at every dipole and straight section, and all-metal valves with ConFlat joints. At this pressure the residual gas is mostly hydrogen and losses and emittance growth come mainly from single scattering events. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “NEG coating and extreme-high vacuum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The AD used to deliver 5.3 MeV antiprotons directly and experiments slowed them to trappable keV energies with degrader foils, where most annihilated or scattered away. ELENA is a 30.4 m decelerator ring that lowers momentum from 100 MeV/c to 13.7 MeV/c (5.3 MeV to 100 keV kinetic energy), electron-cools the beam on an intermediate plateau and at the end, and splits it into 4 bunches sent through electrostatic transfer lines to different experimental zones; at 100 keV electrostatic deflectors are compact and free of hysteresis. The result is 10 to 100 times more trappable antiprotons. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ELENA ring and electrostatic transfer lines”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The value of the AD and ELENA is measured in antiprotons delivered into experiment traps per day, the product of production yield, capture, each deceleration and cooling efficiency, ELENA transfer and trapping efficiency. The cycle lasts about 100 to 110 s, dominated by cooling time on the plateaus; shortening cooling degrades beam quality while lengthening it lowers the rate. The handoff record must list intensity, emittance, momentum spread, cycle time and availability for every plateau so that ALPHA, AEgIS, ASACUSA, BASE, GBAR and others share one baseline and changes in trapped numbers can be traced to the accelerator or the experiment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The roughly 100 s AD cycle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 靶材在多年脈衝熱衝擊下出現內部裂紋與密度降低，或質子束點偏離靶心，產額逐漸下降 10–30% 而不易察覺；磁喇叭導體疲勞斷裂則使聚焦消失，捕獲數驟降到原本的一小部分，所有反物質實驗同時停擺。
前置放大器增益隨溫度漂移 1 dB 而未重新校正時，Schottky 推算的強度誤差約 26%，實驗端收到的數量與報告不符；諧波選得太高使相鄰雜訊帶重疊，寬度量測失真，冷卻效果被誤判。
pitfallsEn: Years of pulsed thermal shock crack the target internally and lower its density, or the proton spot drifts off centre, and the yield sinks by 10–30% unnoticed; a fatigue fracture in the horn conductor removes the focusing, capture collapses to a small fraction of normal, and every antimatter experiment stops at once.

If preamplifier gain drifts by 1 dB with temperature and is not recalibrated, Schottky-derived intensity errs by about 26% and experiments receive numbers that disagree with reports; choosing too high a harmonic makes adjacent bands overlap, distorting width measurements and misjudging cooling.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：台灣光子源 TPS
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Taiwan Photon Source
guides.concept: 以 TPS 的 48 台 1.19 T 偶極與每圈 853 keV 的輻射損失為起點，理解 24 單元 DBA 晶格如何達到 1.6 nm·rad 的發射度，再把 240 台四極的磁中心對準、KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔、束流壽命預算、250 Hz 快速軌道回授、同隧道 496.8 m 增能環與真空內波盪器整合成可交接的 3 GeV 光源工程。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from TPS's 48 dipoles at 1.19 T and its 853 keV energy loss per turn, see how a 24-cell DBA lattice reaches 1.6 nm·rad emittance, then integrate magnetic-centre alignment of 240 quadrupoles, KEKB-type 500 MHz superconducting cavities, the lifetime budget, 250 Hz fast orbit feedback, a 496.8 m booster in the same tunnel and in-vacuum undulators into a transferable 3 GeV light-source record.
procedure: TPS 儲存環把 3 GeV 電子以 48 台偶極磁鐵彎轉一圈，每台彎 7.5°、長約 1.1 m。電子在偏轉時沿切線方向發出同步輻射，光譜由臨界能量 E_c 描述，E_c 與 E³/ρ 成正比；每圈損失的能量 U₀ 與 E⁴/ρ 成正比，必須由射頻腔每圈補回。500 mA 的儲存電流使偶極輻射功率達數百 kW，這些功率幾乎全部打在真空室下游的光子吸收器與光束線前端上，因此臨界能量與 U₀ 同時決定了光源的光譜、射頻功率需求與熱負載設計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

儲存環的水平發射度來自量子激發與輻射阻尼的平衡，與 γ²θ³ 成正比，因此增加偶極數、減小每台彎角是降低發射度的主要手段。TPS 採 24 單元雙彎消色散（DBA）晶格，共 48 台偶極，留出 6 段 12 m 與 18 段 7 m 的直線段給插件磁鐵與射頻腔。嚴格消色散時直線段色散為零，但發射度有理論下限；TPS 允許直線段帶少量色散，把發射度壓到低於嚴格 DBA 下限的 1.6 nm·rad，代價是光源點的有效束流尺寸要加上色散與能量分散的貢獻。垂直發射度 16 pm·rad，對應約 1% 的耦合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「24 個雙彎消色散單元」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

四極磁鐵若偏離理想軌道 Δ，等於對束流施加 K·L·Δ 的偶極踢擊，全環所有四極的隨機偏移經 β 函數與工作點放大成閉合軌道誤差。TPS 儲存環有 240 台四極與 168 台六極，以墊片調整支腳後機械中心偏差小於 0.01 mm，旋轉線圈量得的磁中心偏差在 0.02 mm 以內，再把磁鐵整組安裝在梗架上對準。2014 年 12 月 31 日在 3 GeV 未開任何修正磁鐵即觀測到首道同步光，顯示對準品質足以讓束流直接繞行。研究也指出被磁化的真空室會擾動磁場並引入多極誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「240 台四極與 168 台六極」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

TPS 儲存環以 499.654 MHz、諧波數 864 的射頻補回每圈輻射損失。三菱重工交付的 KEKB 型模組為單 cell 純鈮超導腔，在 4.5 K 運轉，加速電壓 2.4 MV、Q 值 5×10⁸，搭配額定 300 kW 連續波的功率耦合器。單 cell 加大口徑束管讓高次模傳出腔外，由束管上的吸收體消耗，避免與 500 mA 的束流產生耦合束團不穩定。超導腔壁損極小，但這少量熱量必須在 4.5 K 移除，每瓦都換算成數百瓦的室溫製冷功率，所以腔電壓、Q 值與低溫系統要一起規劃。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔模組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

低發射度光源的束流壽命主要受 Touschek 散射限制：同一束團內電子互相碰撞，把橫向動量轉成縱向動量偏差，超出能量接受度的電子便會流失。能量接受度取射頻接受度與晶格動量孔徑兩者中較小的一個；射頻接受度由過電壓比 q = eV/U₀ 與動量壓縮因子決定。Touschek 壽命近似與接受度的三次方成正比、與束團密度成反比，因此垂直發射度越小、束團電流越高，壽命越短。殘氣散射與量子壽命則構成其餘項目。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「射頻電壓與能量接受度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光束線要求光源位置與角度的穩定度約為束流尺寸與發散角的 10%。TPS 的垂直發射度只有 16 pm·rad，直線段的垂直束流尺寸只有數 µm，因此軌道必須穩到次微米。擾動來源包括地面振動、冷卻水流動、磁鐵電源漣波、溫度漂移與插件間隙變化。快速軌道回授以全環 BPM 讀值每秒更新數千次，經響應矩陣反解後驅動修正磁鐵，水平約 250 Hz、垂直約 300 Hz 的頻寬內可壓低擾動，頻寬以上則無能為力，甚至可能放大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速軌道回授（FOFB）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

TPS 的增能環周長 496.8 m，與儲存環同心並共用同一條隧道，是運轉中光源設施最大的增能環之一；大周長讓組合功能 FODO 晶格在 3 GeV 達到約 10 nm·rad 的發射度，提高注入效率，也省下另一座隧道的土建。直線加速器的電子在增能環內由 150 MeV 升到 3 GeV，再注入儲存環。頂注運轉每隔數分鐘補充少量電荷，使儲存電流維持近乎恆定，光束線光學元件的熱負載因此穩定。增能環於 2014 年 12 月 12 日開始束流試運轉，12 月 16 日達到 3 GeV。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同隧道 496.8 m 增能環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

TPS 的硬 X 光主要來自直線段內的插件磁鐵，例如蛋白質結晶學光束線 TPS 05A 與 07A 使用長 3 m、週期 22 mm 的真空內波盪器 IU22，涵蓋 5.7 至 20 keV。真空內設計讓磁鐵陣列直接置於真空中，間隙可縮到數 mm，提高場強與 K 值；但小間隙也讓磁鐵暴露於束流損失與尾場加熱。改變間隙會擾動軌道與工作點，必須以前饋表補償。交接以里程碑與驗收紀錄為準：2014 年底首光、2015 年 12 月儲存電流超過 520 mA、2016 年起開放用戶，規劃容量約 40 條光束線。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「IU22 真空內波盪器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The TPS storage ring bends 3 GeV electrons around the circle with 48 dipoles, each deflecting 7.5° over about 1.1 m. While bending, electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially with a spectrum characterized by the critical energy E_c, proportional to E³/ρ; the energy lost per turn U₀ scales as E⁴/ρ and must be restored by the RF cavities every turn. At 500 mA stored current the dipole radiation reaches hundreds of kilowatts, almost all of it landing on photon absorbers downstream in the chambers and on beamline front ends, so the critical energy and U₀ together set the spectrum, the RF power demand and the heat-load design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “48 dipoles at 1.19 T”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Horizontal emittance comes from the balance of quantum excitation and radiation damping and scales as γ²θ³, so more dipoles with smaller bends are the main route to low emittance. TPS uses a 24-cell double-bend achromat (DBA) with 48 dipoles, leaving six 12 m and eighteen 7 m straights for insertion devices and RF cavities. A strict achromat keeps zero dispersion in the straights but has a theoretical emittance floor; TPS allows slight dispersion in the straights to reach 1.6 nm·rad, below that strict-DBA floor, at the cost of adding a dispersion-times-energy-spread term to the effective source size. The vertical emittance of 16 pm·rad corresponds to about 1% coupling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “24 double-bend achromat cells”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A quadrupole offset Δ from the ideal orbit acts as a dipole kick K·L·Δ, and random offsets of all quadrupoles are amplified through the beta functions and tune into closed-orbit error. The TPS ring has 240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles; after foot shimming the mechanical centres were within 0.01 mm and rotating-coil measurements placed magnetic centres within 0.02 mm before the magnets were aligned as groups on girders. First synchrotron light was observed at 3 GeV on 31 December 2014 with no correctors powered, showing alignment good enough for the beam to circulate directly. Studies also showed that a magnetized vacuum chamber can distort the field and add multipole errors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The TPS ring restores its radiation loss with RF at 499.654 MHz and harmonic number 864. The KEKB-type modules delivered by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries are single-cell pure-niobium cavities operating at 4.5 K with 2.4 MV accelerating voltage and Q of 5×10⁸, fed by power couplers rated 300 kW continuous wave. The single cell with large beam pipes lets higher-order modes propagate out to absorbers on the pipes, avoiding coupled-bunch instabilities with the 500 mA beam. Wall loss in a superconducting cavity is tiny, but it must be removed at 4.5 K, where each watt costs hundreds of watts of room-temperature refrigeration, so cavity voltage, Q and cryogenics are planned together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “KEKB-type 500 MHz SRF modules”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The lifetime of a low-emittance source is limited mainly by Touschek scattering: electrons colliding within a bunch convert transverse momentum into longitudinal deviation, and those beyond the energy acceptance are lost. The energy acceptance is the smaller of the RF acceptance and the lattice momentum aperture, and the RF acceptance depends on the overvoltage ratio q = eV/U₀ and the momentum compaction. Touschek lifetime scales roughly with the cube of the acceptance and inversely with bunch density, so smaller vertical emittance and higher bunch current both shorten it. Residual-gas scattering and quantum lifetime make up the remaining terms. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF voltage and energy acceptance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Beamlines need source position and angle stable to about 10% of beam size and divergence. With a vertical emittance of only 16 pm·rad, the vertical beam size in a straight is a few micrometres, so the orbit must be stable to below a micrometre. Disturbances come from ground vibration, cooling-water flow, magnet power-supply ripple, temperature drift and insertion-device gap changes. Fast orbit feedback reads all BPMs thousands of times per second, inverts the response matrix and drives correctors, suppressing disturbances within a bandwidth of about 250 Hz horizontally and 300 Hz vertically; above that it cannot help and may even amplify. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast orbit feedback (FOFB)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The TPS booster, 496.8 m in circumference, is concentric with the storage ring in the same tunnel and among the largest boosters at an operating light source; its large circumference lets a combined-function FODO lattice reach about 10 nm·rad at 3 GeV, improving injection efficiency and saving a second tunnel. Electrons from the linac are ramped in the booster from 150 MeV to 3 GeV and injected into the storage ring. Top-up adds a small charge every few minutes so the stored current stays nearly constant and beamline optics see a steady heat load. Booster beam commissioning began on 12 December 2014 and reached 3 GeV on 16 December. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “496.8 m booster in the shared tunnel”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

TPS hard X-rays come mainly from insertion devices in the straights; the protein-crystallography beamlines TPS 05A and 07A, for example, use 3 m in-vacuum undulators IU22 with a 22 mm period, covering 5.7 to 20 keV. Placing the magnet arrays inside the vacuum lets the gap close to a few millimetres for higher field and K, but small gaps also expose the magnets to beam loss and wakefield heating. Gap changes perturb orbit and tune and must be compensated with feedforward tables. Handoff follows milestones and acceptance records: first light at the end of 2014, more than 520 mA stored in December 2015, user operation from 2016, and a planned capacity of about 40 beamlines. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “IU22 in-vacuum undulators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣；電流愈高問題愈明顯，常在提升電流試運轉時才暴露。
一組射頻模組跳脫使總電壓由 3.6 MV 掉到 2.4 MV，q 降到約 2.1，射頻接受度隨之縮小，壽命驟降甚至無法維持束流；若誤以為壽命短是真空問題而去做烘烤，真正的動量孔徑或電壓問題被延誤處理。
pitfallsEn: A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks; the higher the current the worse it gets, so it often appears only during current ramp-up trials.

A tripped RF module dropping total voltage from 3.6 MV to 2.4 MV lowers q to about 2.1, the RF acceptance shrinks and lifetime collapses or the beam cannot be held; mistaking the short lifetime for a vacuum problem and baking chambers delays fixing the real momentum-aperture or voltage issue.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：台灣同步輻射光源 TLS
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Taiwan Light Source
guides.concept: 以 TLS 的 18 台偶極（ρ = 3.495 m）與 1.3 → 1.5 GeV 的能量提升為起點，理解這座亞洲第一座第三代光源如何用 6 T 超導波長位移器與超導扭擺器把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光，再把 CESR 型超導射頻、每 60 s 的頂注、TPS 施工期間的地層監測與軟 X 光波盪器整合成與 TPS 並行運轉的工程交接。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from TLS's 18 dipoles (ρ = 3.495 m) and its 1.3 → 1.5 GeV energy upgrade, see how Asia's first third-generation source used a 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter and superconducting wigglers to push a 1.5 GeV ring into hard X-rays, then integrate the CESR-type SRF cavity, 60 s top-up, ground monitoring during TPS construction and soft-X-ray undulators into a handoff for operation alongside TPS.
procedure: TLS 是周長 120 m 的電子儲存環，由 6 個三彎消色散（TBA）超週期、共 18 台偶極磁鐵組成，彎轉半徑 3.495 m。它原本以 1.3 GeV、1.24 T 設計並於 1993 年啟用，1996 年起把運轉能量提升到 1.5 GeV；由於 ρ 固定，偶極場必須按比例升到約 1.43 T，鐵芯更接近飽和。能量提升使臨界能量按 E³ 上升、每圈輻射損失按 E⁴ 上升，光譜往較硬的 X 光延伸，代價是射頻功率與真空熱負載同步增加。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「18 台偶極磁鐵（ρ = 3.495 m）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

第三代光源的關鍵是用消色散晶格壓低發射度，並把插件磁鐵放在零色散的直線段。TLS 每個超週期用三台偶極，6 段約 6 m 長的直線段供插件、射頻與注入使用；設計發射度在 1.3 GeV 為 19.2 nm·rad，按 E² 標度在 1.5 GeV 約 25.6 nm·rad，公開資料依運轉光學列 22 至 25 nm·rad。發射度隨 γ²θ³ 與晶格因子 F 標度：TLS 每台偶極彎 20°，TPS 每台只彎 7.5° 且能量加倍，兩者的發射度相差約 16 倍。設計工作點 7.18／4.13、動量壓縮因子 6.78×10⁻³。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「六重對稱 TBA 晶格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

1.5 GeV 環的偶極臨界能量只有 2.14 keV，硬 X 光通量不足；TLS 的解法是局部提高磁場：2002 年起運轉的 6 T 超導波長位移器（SWLS）、3.2 T 的 SW6 超導扭擺器，以及安裝在消色散段內、不佔用直線段的 3.1 T 超導扭擺器 IASW（週期 61 mm、16 極、長 960 mm、極間隙 19 mm）。臨界能量正比於 E²B，6 T 磁場把同一環的臨界能量提高約 4 倍。這些插件浸在 4.5 K 液氦中，啟用時需以四極補償工作點偏移，並評估它們對發射度與能量分散的影響。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「6 T 超導波長位移器與超導扭擺器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

TLS 原本使用銅製 Doris 腔，其高次模與束流相互作用引起耦合束團不穩定，限制了儲存電流。2004 年底改裝以 Cornell CESR-III 設計為基礎、由 ACCEL 製造的單 cell 鈮超導腔，2005 年 2 月起例行運轉：超導腔可用大口徑束管讓高次模傳出腔外吸收，並以單一腔提供足夠電壓。配合 100 kW 速調管發射機，電流由 200 mA 提升到 300 mA，再到 360 mA；但高電流下束流負載很重，低階射頻迴路需精細調整才能穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CESR 型 500 MHz 超導腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

TLS 於 2005 年 10 月由衰減模式改為頂注運轉：約每 60 s 由全能量增能環補注一次，使儲存電流維持在 ±0.25% 之內，光束線熱負載近乎恆定，光學元件不再隨電流衰減而漂移。量測核心是直流電流變壓器（DCCT），它的解析度與零點漂移決定能否分辨 0.1% 等級的電流變化，並用來推算壽命與每次補注的電荷。補注瞬間踢擊磁鐵造成的擾動以閘控訊號通知用戶，讓實驗資料可排除注入時段。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「直流電流變壓器與頂注閘控」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

TPS 緊鄰 TLS 興建，開挖與基礎施工會造成地層沉陷與傾斜；若 TLS 的四極磁鐵隨地面移動數十微米，閉合軌道誤差就會被放大到與束流尺寸同量級。NSRRC 在 TLS 儲存環與光束線安裝流體靜力水準系統（HLS）與 Leica Nivel 220 精密傾斜儀，持續記錄垂直沉陷與地板傾斜，作為 TLS 能否維持正常運轉的判據，也讓軌道回授與重新對準有量化依據。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「流體靜力水準系統與精密傾斜儀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

1.5 GeV 的 TLS 在真空紫外到軟 X 光波段特別有效率：週期 9 cm 的 U9、5 cm 的 U5 與可變偏振的 EPU5.6 等波盪器，把基頻放在數十到數百 eV。波盪器光子能量隨 E² 標度，同一支波盪器搬到 3 GeV 的 TPS，能量會提高 4 倍。偶極光源的 2.14 keV 臨界能量涵蓋到數 keV，更硬的 X 光則交給超導扭擺器。因此 TLS 的光束線以軟 X 光、紅外與成熟的常規技術為主，與 TPS 的硬 X 光高亮度定位互補。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「U9、U5 與 EPU5.6 波盪器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

TPS 開放用戶後，TLS 並未退役，而是與 TPS 一起由 NSRRC 營運：TLS 提供 22 條光束線、約 50 個實驗站，偏重軟 X 光、紅外與成熟技術，TPS 承擔需要低發射度與高亮度的實驗。決定實驗留在哪座光源的工程依據之一是相干分率：當電子發射度遠大於光子繞射極限 λ/4π 時，相干光比例很低。交接需記錄每條光束線的光源參數、可用度與老化設備的維護計畫，避免兩座光源共用的人力、低溫與電力資源互相排擠。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TLS 與 TPS 的雙光源分工」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: TLS is an electron storage ring of 120 m circumference built from six triple-bend-achromat (TBA) superperiods with 18 dipoles of 3.495 m bending radius. Designed for 1.3 GeV at 1.24 T and opened in 1993, it moved to 1.5 GeV operation from 1996; with ρ fixed, the dipole field had to rise proportionally to about 1.43 T, closer to iron saturation. The upgrade raises the critical energy as E³ and the energy loss per turn as E⁴, extending the spectrum to harder X-rays at the price of more RF power and vacuum heat load. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “18 dipoles with ρ = 3.495 m”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The key to a third-generation source is an achromatic lattice that lowers emittance and places insertion devices in dispersion-free straights. TLS uses three dipoles per superperiod and six straights of about 6 m for insertion devices, RF and injection; the design emittance of 19.2 nm·rad at 1.3 GeV scales as E² to about 25.6 nm·rad at 1.5 GeV, with public values of 22 to 25 nm·rad depending on the operating optics. Emittance scales with γ²θ³ and a lattice factor F: each TLS dipole bends 20° while each TPS dipole bends only 7.5° at twice the energy, and their emittances differ by about 16 times. Design tunes are 7.18/4.13 and the momentum compaction is 6.78×10⁻³. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Six-fold TBA lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A 1.5 GeV ring's dipoles give a critical energy of only 2.14 keV and little hard-X-ray flux; TLS raised the field locally instead: a 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter (SWLS) operating since 2002, the 3.2 T SW6 superconducting wiggler, and the 3.1 T in-achromat superconducting wiggler IASW (61 mm period, 16 poles, 960 mm long, 19 mm pole gap), which sits inside the achromat without using a straight. Critical energy scales as E²B, so 6 T raises it about fourfold on the same ring. These devices are immersed in 4.5 K liquid helium, and switching them on requires quadrupole compensation of the tune shift and assessment of their effect on emittance and energy spread. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “6 T wavelength shifter and superconducting wigglers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

TLS originally used copper Doris cavities whose higher-order modes drove coupled-bunch instabilities that capped the stored current. At the end of 2004 it installed a single-cell niobium cavity based on Cornell's CESR-III design and built by ACCEL, in routine use from February 2005: the superconducting cavity can use large beam pipes that let higher-order modes escape to absorbers, and one cavity supplies enough voltage. With a 100 kW klystron transmitter the current rose from 200 mA to 300 mA and later 360 mA, but beam loading at high current is heavy and the low-level RF loops needed careful tuning to stay stable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CESR-type 500 MHz SRF cavity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

TLS moved from decay mode to top-up in October 2005: about every 60 s the full-energy booster tops up the ring, holding stored current within ±0.25%, so beamline heat loads stay nearly constant and optics no longer drift with decaying current. The key measurement is the DC current transformer (DCCT), whose resolution and zero drift determine whether 0.1%-level current changes can be seen and which is used to infer lifetime and the charge per top-up. The kicker disturbance at each injection is announced to users by a gating signal so experiments can exclude those intervals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DCCT and top-up gating”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

TPS was built right next to TLS, and excavation and foundation work cause ground settlement and tilt; if TLS quadrupoles move tens of micrometres with the floor, closed-orbit errors are amplified to the scale of the beam size. NSRRC installed a hydrostatic levelling system (HLS) and Leica Nivel 220 precision inclinometers in the TLS storage ring and beamlines to record vertical settlement and floor tilt continuously, providing the criterion for keeping TLS in normal operation and a quantitative basis for orbit feedback and realignment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hydrostatic levelling and precision inclinometers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The 1.5 GeV TLS is especially efficient from the vacuum ultraviolet to soft X-rays: undulators such as U9 with a 9 cm period, U5 with 5 cm and the variable-polarization EPU5.6 put their fundamentals at tens to hundreds of eV. Undulator photon energy scales as E², so the same device moved to 3 GeV TPS would give four times the energy. The 2.14 keV bending-magnet critical energy covers up to a few keV, and harder X-rays come from the superconducting wigglers. TLS beamlines therefore focus on soft X-rays, infrared and mature routine techniques, complementing the hard-X-ray, high-brightness role of TPS. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “U9, U5 and EPU5.6 undulators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

After TPS opened to users, TLS was not retired; NSRRC operates both: TLS provides 22 beamlines with about 50 end stations focused on soft X-rays, infrared and mature techniques, while TPS takes experiments needing low emittance and high brightness. One engineering criterion for which source hosts an experiment is the coherent fraction: when electron emittance far exceeds the photon diffraction limit λ/4π, little of the light is coherent. The handoff must record source parameters, availability and maintenance plans for ageing equipment on every beamline so that staff, cryogenics and electrical power shared by the two sources do not crowd each other out. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Dual-source division between TLS and TPS”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 能量提升後若未重新評估偶極的飽和與多極場，六極成分改變色品與動力孔徑，注入效率與壽命下降；光子吸收器若仍按 1.3 GeV 的熱負載設計，局部過熱造成壓力上升，所有光束線同時受影響。
注入凸軌不完全閉合時，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性的強度尖峰；DCCT 零點漂移 0.5 mA 而未校正時，頂注控制把電流維持在錯誤的值，用戶以電流歸一化的數據出現系統誤差。
pitfallsEn: If dipole saturation and multipoles are not re-evaluated after the upgrade, a changed sextupole component alters chromaticity and dynamic aperture, lowering injection efficiency and lifetime; photon absorbers still designed for 1.3 GeV heat loads overheat locally, pressure rises and every beamline suffers.

An imperfectly closed injection bump makes the stored beam oscillate for milliseconds at every top-up, and beamlines see periodic intensity spikes; an uncorrected 0.5 mA DCCT zero drift makes top-up regulate to the wrong current, introducing systematic error into user data normalized by current.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: European Synchrotron Radiation Facility
guides.concept: 從 6 GeV 電子在 844 m 儲存環中輻射的臨界能量與功率出發，理解 ESRF-EBS 為何以每單元 7 個彎轉磁鐵的混合多彎消色散（HMBA）晶格把水平發射度從約 4 nm·rad 壓到約 130 pm·rad，再把磁鐵、真空、束流位置監測、亮度計算與軌道回授整合成可驗收的光源工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the critical energy and radiated power of 6 GeV electrons in the 844 m ring to see why ESRF-EBS uses a seven-bend hybrid multi-bend achromat (HMBA) lattice to cut horizontal emittance from about 4 nm·rad to about 130 pm·rad, then integrate magnets, vacuum, beam-position monitors, brilliance calculation and orbit feedback into an acceptable light-source engineering record.
procedure: 6 GeV 電子的勞侖茲因子 γ = E/mc² ≈ 11 742，在彎轉磁鐵中沿切線方向發出張角約 1/γ 的連續譜。臨界能量 ε_c 把輻射功率分成相等的兩半，由電子能量平方與磁場決定；每圈損失的能量 U₀ 正比於 E⁴/ρ，必須由 352.2 MHz 射頻腔每圈補回。ESRF-EBS 的儲存電流為 200 mA，所以射頻系統的功率預算直接由 U₀ 與電流的乘積決定，再加上插件磁鐵的額外損失。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「6 GeV 儲存環與彎轉磁鐵輻射」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

自然發射度來自量子激發與輻射阻尼的平衡，近似為 ε_x ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³，其中 θ 是單一彎轉磁鐵的偏轉角，F 由晶格型式決定。把 2π 切成更多、更弱的彎轉可以用 θ³ 壓低發射度：ESRF-EBS 以 32 個單元、每單元 7 個彎轉共 224 個取代舊 DBA 的 64 個。混合式設計在兩端以色散凸起放置六極磁鐵，兩組之間用 −I 轉換抵銷非線性，保留動態孔徑與注入效率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「HMBA 晶格單元（27 m，7 彎）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每個 27 m 單元有 31 個磁鐵：小孔徑、梯度達 90 T/m 等級的四極磁鐵，不耗電的永磁縱向梯度彎轉磁鐵，以及同時彎轉與聚焦的組合功能磁鐵。強聚焦意味著四極磁鐵的橫向位移會給束流一個踢角，並在全環被放大成閉軌畸變；因此磁鐵先在樑架上以 50 µm 等級互相對準，再以束流為基準微調。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高梯度四極磁鐵與永磁彎轉」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

緊湊的強磁鐵迫使真空腔內徑縮到 20 mm 等級。分子流狀態下細長管的導流量正比於 d³/L，集中式幫浦抽不到腔體中段，所以 EBS 腔體內壁鍍 TiZrV 非蒸發吸氣劑（NEG），把整段腔壁變成分布式幫浦並降低光致脫附。小孔徑同時提高電阻壁阻抗（正比於 1/b³），因此腔體用高導電材料並把所有截面變化做成平滑的射頻過渡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NEG 鍍膜真空腔（每單元 14 段）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

發射度 130 pm×10 pm 代表直線段內的束流只有數十微米乘 5 µm，使用者要求光源點位置與角度的穩定度約為尺寸與發散角的 10%。每單元 10 個、全環 320 個鈕扣式 BPM 以次微米解析度把軌道送進快速軌道回授，驅動校正磁鐵抑制地面振動、樑架共振與插件磁鐵開合造成的軌道擾動，頻寬需達數百赫茲。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流位置監測器與快速軌道回授」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

亮度 B = F/(4π²·Σx·Σy·Σx'·Σy')，F 是 0.1% 頻寬內的通量，Σ 由電子束尺寸、發散角與單電子輻射的繞射項 σ_r = √(2λL)/4π、σ_r' = √(λ/2L) 平方相加而成。當發射度小於 λ/4π 時光源進入繞射極限：在 1 Å 這個值約 8 pm，EBS 的垂直 10 pm 幾乎達到，水平 130 pm 則仍由電子束主導，這決定了同調分率與聚焦極限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「亮度計算表（通量除以相空間）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

844 m 的環由 32 個單元的樑架組成，先用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平系統建立全環網，再把相鄰磁鐵的相對誤差壓到 50 µm 等級；對束流而言相鄰元件的平滑度比絕對座標更重要。隧道溫度、冷卻水與地面振動都會透過樑架改變磁鐵位置，而磁鐵位置的誤差經閉軌放大後進入光源點，所以熱控、樑架剛性與回授頻寬必須一起設計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「對準網、溫控與地面振動」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

升級後的調試分階段推進：第一圈、儲存束流、以軌道響應矩陣（LOCO）修正線性晶格、耦合校正、電流爬到 200 mA、壽命與注入效率，最後交給使用者。驗收不是單一指標，而是發射度、壽命、軌道穩定度、注入效率與光束線通量比值的整組紀錄；頂注運轉把電流維持在 ±1% 內，使光學元件的熱負載恆定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「調試里程碑與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A 6 GeV electron has Lorentz factor γ = E/mc² of about 11 742 and radiates a continuum into a cone of roughly 1/γ along its tangent in each bend. The critical energy ε_c splits the radiated power into two equal halves and is set by the square of the electron energy times the magnetic field; the energy lost per turn U₀ scales as E⁴/ρ and must be restored every turn by the 352.2 MHz RF cavities. With 200 mA stored, the RF power budget follows directly from U₀ times current, plus the extra loss in insertion devices. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “6 GeV ring and bending-magnet radiation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Natural emittance is the balance between quantum excitation and radiation damping, approximately ε_x ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³, where θ is the deflection of one dipole and F depends on the lattice type. Splitting 2π into more, weaker bends lowers emittance through θ³: ESRF-EBS uses 32 cells with seven bends each, 224 in all, instead of the old double-bend achromat's 64. The hybrid design places sextupoles in dispersion bumps at both ends of the cell with a −I transformation between them so their nonlinearities cancel, preserving dynamic aperture and injection efficiency. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “HMBA cell (27 m, seven bends)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each 27 m cell carries 31 magnets: small-bore quadrupoles with gradients of order 90 T/m, permanent-magnet longitudinal-gradient dipoles that draw no power, and combined-function magnets that bend and focus at once. Strong focusing means a transverse offset of a quadrupole kicks the beam, and the kick is amplified around the ring into closed-orbit distortion; magnets are therefore aligned to each other on girders at the 50 µm level and then trimmed with beam-based alignment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-gradient quadrupoles and permanent-magnet bends”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Compact strong magnets force the chamber bore down to the 20 mm class. In molecular flow the conductance of a long tube scales as d³/L, so lumped pumps cannot reach the middle of a chamber; EBS chambers are therefore coated inside with TiZrV non-evaporable getter (NEG), turning the whole wall into a distributed pump and lowering photon-stimulated desorption. The small bore also raises resistive-wall impedance (proportional to 1/b³), so chambers use high-conductivity material and every cross-section change is made a smooth RF transition. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “NEG-coated vacuum chambers (14 per cell)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Emittances of 130 pm by 10 pm mean the beam in a straight is only tens of micrometres by 5 µm, and users require source position and angle stability of about 10% of size and divergence. Ten button BPMs per cell, 320 around the ring, feed sub-micrometre orbit readings into a fast orbit feedback that drives correctors to suppress ground motion, girder resonances and the orbit kicks from insertion-device gap changes, with a bandwidth of hundreds of hertz. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “BPMs and fast orbit feedback”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Brilliance is B = F/(4π²·Σx·Σy·Σx'·Σy'), where F is the flux in 0.1% bandwidth and each Σ adds in quadrature the electron size or divergence and the single-electron diffraction terms σ_r = √(2λL)/4π and σ_r' = √(λ/2L). When emittance falls below λ/4π the source becomes diffraction limited: at 1 Å that is about 8 pm, which the 10 pm vertical emittance of EBS nearly reaches while the 130 pm horizontal is still electron dominated, and that sets the coherent fraction and focusing limit. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Brilliance table (flux over phase space)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The 844 m ring is assembled from the girders of 32 cells: a laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling build the ring-wide network, then neighbouring magnets are aligned to each other at the 50 µm level, because for the beam the smoothness between neighbours matters more than absolute coordinates. Tunnel temperature, cooling water and ground vibration all move magnets through the girders, and magnet errors reach the source point amplified by the closed orbit, so thermal control, girder stiffness and feedback bandwidth must be designed together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Alignment network, thermal control and ground vibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Post-upgrade commissioning proceeds in stages: first turn, stored beam, linear-lattice correction from the orbit response matrix (LOCO), coupling correction, current ramp to 200 mA, lifetime and injection efficiency, then user delivery. Acceptance is not one number but a set of records: emittance, lifetime, orbit stability, injection efficiency and beamline flux ratios; top-up operation keeps the current within ±1% so that the heat load on optics stays constant. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Commissioning milestones and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Diamond Light Source
guides.concept: 以 Diamond 的 3 GeV、561.6 m、24 單元雙彎消色散儲存環為對象，從 499.68 MHz 射頻與 936 個束團桶出發，理解中能量光源如何靠真空內波盪器的高次諧波取得硬 X 光、如何管理前端熱負載，再推導 Diamond-II 把能量提高到 3.5 GeV 並換成 DTBA 晶格後，發射度、光子能量與光束線必須同步調整的工程邏輯。
guides.conceptEn: Using Diamond's 3 GeV, 561.6 m, 24-cell double-bend achromat ring, start from the 499.68 MHz RF and 936 buckets to see how a medium-energy source reaches hard X-rays through the high harmonics of in-vacuum undulators and manages front-end heat load, then derive why Diamond-II's move to 3.5 GeV and a DTBA lattice forces emittance, photon energy and beamlines to be re-engineered together.
procedure: 儲存環的周長與射頻頻率決定諧波數 h = C/λ_RF，也就是能放束團的桶數；Diamond 周長 561.571 m、射頻 499.680 MHz，迴轉頻率 533.8 kHz，最多 936 個束團，相鄰束團間隔 2 ns。1.4 T 的彎轉磁鐵決定臨界能量與每圈的輻射損失，而 300 mA 的儲存電流決定射頻系統必須送進束流的功率。使用者看到的時間結構（混合填充、單束團模式）全由這組參數定義。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Diamond 原始晶格是 24 單元雙彎消色散，水平發射度 3.14 nm·rad，垂直 8 pm·rad。發射度隨 γ²θ³ 變化：Diamond-II 一方面把能量提高到 3.5 GeV（γ² 增加 36%），另一方面以雙三彎消色散（DTBA）把每單元彎轉數從 2 增到 6，θ³ 的縮減遠勝 γ² 的增加，同時在單元中段多出一個直線段，讓原本的彎轉磁鐵光束線改由短插件供光。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「DBA 晶格與 Diamond-II DTBA 晶格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

中能量環要取得硬 X 光，依賴短週期真空內波盪器與高次諧波。NdFeB 永磁與釩鐵鈷極頭組成的混合式磁列放在真空腔內，間隙可關到 5 mm；峰值磁場隨間隙近似指數下降，偏轉參數 K = 0.934·B₀[T]·λ_u[cm] 決定基頻波長與各諧波的相對強度。基頻與奇數諧波在軸上最強，相位誤差則優先削弱高次諧波，所以磁列的機械精度直接換成硬 X 光通量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 23 mm）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

射頻腔不只補回每圈損失，還以電壓高度決定縱向的射頻桶大小，也就是動量接受度；Touschek 散射讓束團內電子互相把能量踢出接受度，壽命對接受度非常敏感。Diamond 以 936 個束團高電流運轉，腔體的高階模（HOM）會驅動耦合束團不穩定，因此 Diamond-II 採用高階模阻尼的常溫腔。同步振盪頻率是檢驗電壓與動量壓縮因子的直接量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「射頻腔、電壓與動量接受度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Diamond 在彎轉磁鐵光口用 X 光針孔相機成像束流：針孔把光源投影到螢幕，影像寬度包含束流尺寸乘放大率、針孔繞射與幾何模糊、螢幕與鏡頭的點擴散。垂直發射度只有 8 pm·rad，束流只有十幾微米，所以必須先獨立量出系統點擴散函數再做平方相減；水平方向則還要扣除色散與能散的貢獻，否則發射度會被高估。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「X 光針孔相機與發射度量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

300 mA 下一支波盪器的總功率達數千瓦，軸上功率密度達數十 kW/mrad²；前端的固定光闌與可動吸收器先截掉大部分功率，第一片矽晶體仍要承受數百瓦。晶體的熱變形正比於熱膨脹係數除以熱導率（α/k），矽在液氮溫度附近 α 趨近零而 k 大幅上升，所以第一晶體以液氮冷卻，把熱凸起造成的斜率誤差壓到微弧度級，保住單色器的能量解析與光束位置。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前端吸收器與低溫矽單色器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Diamond-II 在同一隧道內更換整座儲存環，前提是保住既有光束線的光源點位置與方向，否則前端與光學全部重建。能量從 3 提高到 3.5 GeV 後，每支波盪器在相同間隙下的光子能量全部上移 36%，光束線若要維持原工作能量，必須改變 K 值（縮小間隙）或更換磁列週期；DTBA 晶格新增的中段直線段則讓原本的彎轉磁鐵光束線改接短插件，光源特性整個改變。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同一隧道換環：光源點與光束線匹配」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收一座使用者設施不只看峰值參數，還要看頂注運轉是否把電流維持在窄帶內、每年排定的使用者時數中有多少真正供光、以及故障後多快恢復。頂注的頻率由壽命與允許的電流變化決定；可用度由平均故障間隔與平均修復時間決定，而每次注入的束流損失與輻射劑量也要列入紀錄，讓光束線的熱負載、劑量與資料品質可以追溯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「機器驗收與可用度紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Circumference and RF frequency fix the harmonic number h = C/λ_RF, the number of buckets that can hold bunches: Diamond has C = 561.571 m, RF at 499.680 MHz, a revolution frequency of 533.8 kHz, up to 936 bunches and a 2 ns spacing between neighbours. The 1.4 T dipoles set the critical energy and the radiation loss per turn, while the 300 mA stored current sets the power the RF system must deliver to the beam. Every time structure users see, hybrid fills or single-bunch mode, is defined by this parameter set. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Diamond's original lattice is a 24-cell double-bend achromat with 3.14 nm·rad horizontal and 8 pm·rad vertical emittance. Emittance scales as γ²θ³: Diamond-II raises the energy to 3.5 GeV, a 36% increase in γ², but the double-triple-bend achromat (DTBA) raises the bends per cell from 2 to 6, and the θ³ reduction far outweighs the γ² increase, while a new mid-cell straight lets former bending-magnet beamlines be fed by short insertion devices. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DBA lattice and the Diamond-II DTBA lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A medium-energy ring reaches hard X-rays through short-period in-vacuum undulators and their high harmonics. A hybrid array of NdFeB magnets and vanadium-permendur poles sits inside the vacuum chamber so the gap can close to 5 mm; the peak field falls roughly exponentially with gap, and the deflection parameter K = 0.934·B₀[T]·λ_u[cm] sets the fundamental wavelength and the relative strength of each harmonic. The fundamental and odd harmonics are strongest on axis, and phase errors weaken the high harmonics first, so the mechanical precision of the array converts directly into hard X-ray flux. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 23 mm)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

RF cavities do more than restore the loss per turn: the voltage sets the height of the longitudinal RF bucket, that is the momentum acceptance, and Touschek scattering inside each bunch kicks electrons out of that acceptance, so lifetime is very sensitive to it. Diamond runs 936 bunches at high current, where cavity higher-order modes (HOMs) drive coupled-bunch instabilities, which is why Diamond-II adopts HOM-damped normal-conducting cavities. The synchrotron frequency is the direct check of voltage and momentum compaction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF cavities, voltage and momentum acceptance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Diamond images the beam through an X-ray pinhole camera on a bending-magnet port: the pinhole projects the source onto a screen, and the image width contains the beam size times magnification, pinhole diffraction and geometric blur, and the point spread of screen and lens. With only 8 pm·rad vertical emittance the beam is a dozen micrometres, so the system point-spread function must be measured independently and subtracted in quadrature; horizontally the dispersion and energy-spread contribution must also be removed or emittance is overestimated. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “X-ray pinhole camera and emittance measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

At 300 mA one undulator radiates several kilowatts in total with an on-axis power density of tens of kW/mrad²; fixed masks and movable absorbers in the front end strip most of it, but the first silicon crystal still takes hundreds of watts. Crystal thermal deformation scales with thermal expansion over conductivity (α/k), and near liquid-nitrogen temperature silicon's α approaches zero while k rises sharply, so the first crystal is cooled with liquid nitrogen to keep the slope error of the thermal bump at the microradian level, preserving monochromator energy resolution and beam position. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Front-end absorbers and cryogenic silicon monochromator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Diamond-II replaces the entire storage ring inside the same tunnel, which only works if the source positions and directions of existing beamlines are preserved; otherwise front ends and optics would all be rebuilt. With energy raised from 3 to 3.5 GeV every undulator's photon energy at a given gap shifts up by 36%, so a beamline that must keep its working energy has to change K by closing the gap or replace the array period; the new mid-cell straights of the DTBA lattice let former bending-magnet beamlines be fed by short insertion devices, changing their source properties entirely. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Same-tunnel ring replacement: source points and beamline matching”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Accepting a user facility is not only about peak parameters: it covers whether top-up holds the current in a narrow band, how many of the scheduled user hours actually deliver light, and how fast the machine recovers after a fault. Top-up frequency follows from lifetime and the allowed current variation; availability follows from mean time between failures and mean time to repair, and the beam loss and radiation dose of every injection are logged so that beamline heat load, dose and data quality remain traceable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Machine acceptance and availability record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

把影像寬度直接除以放大率而不扣點擴散，垂直發射度會被報成兩倍以上；若螢光屏因輻射老化而變厚、變模糊，同一算法會讓發射度看起來隨時間變差，其實束流根本沒變。
pitfallsEn: If the circumference changes through ground settlement and the RF frequency does not follow, the beam is forced onto an off-energy orbit, the energy offset turns into an orbit offset through dispersion, and the photon energy on every beamline drifts slightly at once without any single device raising an alarm.

Dividing the image width by the magnification without subtracting the point spread reports vertical emittance more than twice too high; if the scintillator thickens and blurs with radiation ageing, the same algorithm makes emittance appear to degrade over time while the beam has not changed at all.
