guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: SPring-8 synchrotron facility
guides.concept: 以 SPring-8 的 8 GeV、1436 m 儲存環為對象，先理解高電子能量如何讓真空內波盪器的基頻直接落在硬 X 光，再拆解 SACLA 直線加速器直接注入、束團純度量測與同調分率的工程，最後推導 SPring-8-II 為何改用 6 GeV 五彎消色散晶格加阻尼扭擺磁鐵，把發射度從 2.4 nm·rad 壓到 50 pm·rad 並在同一隧道內更換整座環。
guides.conceptEn: Using SPring-8's 8 GeV, 1436 m ring, first see how high electron energy puts the fundamental of an in-vacuum undulator directly in the hard X-ray range, then work through direct injection from the SACLA linac, bunch-purity measurement and coherent-fraction engineering, and finally derive why SPring-8-II moves to a 6 GeV five-bend achromat with damping wigglers to cut emittance from 2.4 nm·rad to 50 pm·rad while replacing the whole ring inside the same tunnel.
procedure: SPring-8 選擇 8 GeV，是為了讓彎轉磁鐵的臨界能量落在數十 keV，並讓波盪器的基頻直接涵蓋 10 keV 以上的硬 X 光。代價是輻射損失隨 E⁴ 暴增：每圈損失接近 10 MeV，必須由 508.58 MHz 的射頻系統補回；周長 1435.95 m 給出 2436 個束團桶與 208.8 kHz 的迴轉頻率，4 段 30 m 長直線段則容納超長波盪器。這組邊界條件決定了射頻功率、真空腔的熱負載與整座設施的用電。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPring-8 現行雙彎消色散晶格的水平發射度約 2.4 nm·rad。SPring-8-II 把能量降到 6 GeV 並換成每單元五個彎轉的五彎消色散，彎轉角立方的縮減讓裸晶格發射度降到約 111 pm·rad；再用阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加輻射阻尼，把發射度壓到約 50 pm·rad，電流提高到 200 mA。降能損失的光子能量由更短週期的真空內波盪器補回，而輻射損失與用電反而下降，這是「綠色升級」的核心取捨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「DBA 晶格與 SPring-8-II 五彎消色散」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPring-8 是真空內波盪器的發源地之一：磁列放進真空腔，間隙可關到數毫米，讓 32 mm 週期在 8 GeV 下的基頻就落在 5 到 13 keV，不必依賴高次諧波。但 8 GeV 的功率密度極高：軸上功率密度隨 E⁴ 增加，標準 4.5 m 波盪器達數百 kW/mrad²，30 m 直線段內的 25 m 超長波盪器更高一個量級，因此前端光闌、吸收器與第一光學元件的熱設計是這類光束線的核心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 32 mm，4.5 m）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

自 2020 年起 SPring-8 以相鄰的 SACLA 8 GeV C 頻段直線加速器直接注入儲存環，取代原本的 1 GeV 直線加速器加 8 GeV 增能環。直線加速器的束流歸一化發射度約 1 µm·rad，在 8 GeV 下幾何發射度只有數十 pm，比儲存環的接受度小得多，因此注入束流可以用很小的振幅進入，減少損失與對儲存束流的擾動；這也是 SPring-8-II 小孔徑真空腔與低發射度環所必需的。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

時間解析實驗需要隔離的單束團，其相鄰桶的雜散電荷必須低到 10⁻⁹ 到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度等級。SPring-8 以時間相關單光子計數（TCSPC）量束團純度：光二極體或 APD 計數每個光子相對射頻的到達時間，建立 2436 個桶的直方圖；再以共振的 RF 擊出把不要的桶內電子激發到孔徑外。要量到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度，統計計數必須累積到 10¹¹ 以上，所以量測時間與偵測器的計數率、死時間直接相關。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

同調成像、X 光光子相關光譜與奈米聚焦使用的是光束中橫向同調的部分，其比例近似為 (λ/4π)² 除以電子束與繞射項合成的相空間面積。在 1 Å 波長，λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad；SPring-8 現行水平發射度 2.4 nm·rad 使同調分率只有千分之幾，而 SPring-8-II 的 50 pm·rad 把它提高數十倍，這才是升級真正的驅動力，而不是總通量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同調分率計算（1 Å）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。新晶格的周長 1435.428 m 比現行 1435.949 m 短 0.521 m，諧波數若維持 2436，射頻頻率必須上移；所有磁鐵與真空腔先在樑架上預組裝並完成對準，停機期只做拆舊、吊裝與連接。光束線的光源點必須保留，而降能後每支波盪器都要換成更短週期的 IVU-II 才能維持原有的光子能量範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPring-8-II 的驗收同時包含光源性能與用電：發射度 50 pm·rad、電流 200 mA、亮度提升、以及永磁彎轉磁鐵與降能帶來的電力節省。射頻功率由 U₀·I 決定，彎轉磁鐵改用永磁後磁鐵電源的用電歸零，但阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加的輻射損失要由射頻補回；交接文件必須把每一項性能指標對應到量測方法、不確定度與運轉條件，使用者設施才能據此排程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: SPring-8 chose 8 GeV so that the bending-magnet critical energy lands at tens of keV and undulator fundamentals cover hard X-rays above 10 keV directly. The price is radiation loss growing as E⁴: nearly 10 MeV per turn must be restored by the 508.58 MHz RF system; the 1435.95 m circumference gives 2436 buckets and a 208.8 kHz revolution frequency, and four 30 m straights house very long undulators. These boundary conditions fix RF power, chamber heat load and the facility's electricity use. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The present double-bend achromat of SPring-8 has a horizontal emittance of about 2.4 nm·rad. SPring-8-II lowers the energy to 6 GeV and adopts a five-bend achromat with five bends per cell; the cube of the smaller bend angle brings the bare-lattice emittance to about 111 pm·rad, damping wigglers then add radiation damping to reach about 50 pm·rad, and the current rises to 200 mA. The photon energy lost by lowering the energy is recovered with shorter-period in-vacuum undulators, while radiation loss and electricity fall, which is the central trade-off of the green upgrade. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DBA lattice and the SPring-8-II five-bend achromat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

SPring-8 is one of the birthplaces of the in-vacuum undulator: the magnet array sits inside the vacuum chamber and the gap closes to a few millimetres, so a 32 mm period at 8 GeV puts the fundamental itself at 5 to 13 keV without relying on high harmonics. But the power density at 8 GeV is extreme: the on-axis power density grows as E⁴, a standard 4.5 m undulator reaches hundreds of kW/mrad², and the 25 m undulator in a 30 m straight is another order of magnitude higher, so the thermal design of front-end masks, absorbers and first optics is the heart of these beamlines. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 32 mm, 4.5 m)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Since 2020 SPring-8 has been injected directly from the neighbouring SACLA 8 GeV C-band linac, replacing the original 1 GeV linac plus 8 GeV booster. The linac beam has a normalised emittance of about 1 µm·rad, which at 8 GeV is a geometric emittance of only tens of picometres, far below the ring acceptance, so the injected beam enters with a very small amplitude, reducing losses and disturbance to the stored beam; this is also a prerequisite for the small-aperture chambers and low-emittance ring of SPring-8-II. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Time-resolved experiments need isolated single bunches whose neighbouring buckets carry stray charge at the 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻¹⁰ purity level. SPring-8 measures bunch purity with time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC): a photodiode or APD timestamps each photon against the RF and builds a histogram over the 2436 buckets, and a resonant RF knock-out drives electrons in unwanted buckets out of the aperture. Measuring a purity of 10⁻¹⁰ requires more than 10¹¹ accumulated counts, so measurement time is tied directly to detector count rate and dead time. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Coherent imaging, X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy and nanofocusing use only the transversely coherent part of the beam, whose fraction is roughly (λ/4π)² divided by the phase-space area of electron beam plus diffraction terms. At 1 Å wavelength λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad; the present SPring-8 horizontal emittance of 2.4 nm·rad leaves a coherent fraction of a few tenths of a percent, while the 50 pm·rad of SPring-8-II raises it by tens of times, and that gain, not total flux, is the real driver of the upgrade. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coherent-fraction calculation (1 Å)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year. The new lattice circumference of 1435.428 m is 0.521 m shorter than the present 1435.949 m, so with the harmonic number kept at 2436 the RF frequency must rise; all magnets and chambers are pre-assembled and aligned on girders so that the blackout covers only removal, rigging and connection. Beamline source points must be preserved, and after the energy reduction every undulator is replaced by a shorter-period IVU-II to keep its photon-energy range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of SPring-8-II covers both source performance and electricity: 50 pm·rad emittance, 200 mA, the brilliance gain, and the power saved by permanent-magnet bends and the lower energy. RF power follows from U₀·I; permanent-magnet dipoles eliminate magnet power-supply consumption, but the extra radiation loss of damping wigglers must be restored by the RF; the handoff document must map every performance metric to a measurement method, an uncertainty and an operating condition before users can schedule on it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把低能量環的設計經驗直接放大到 8 GeV，會低估 E⁴ 的輻射損失：射頻腔數量或冷卻不足，電流爬升到一半就因腔體過熱或射頻桶縮小而丟束。
偵測器的餘輝或電纜反射在主束團之後 2 ns 處產生假訊號，被誤判成衛星束團；操作人員據此加強擊出，反而把主束團的電荷也擊掉一部分，壽命與通量一起下降而純度數字沒有變好。
pitfallsEn: Scaling a low-energy ring design straight to 8 GeV underestimates the E⁴ radiation loss: with too few cavities or too little cooling, the current ramp stalls halfway as cavities overheat or the RF bucket shrinks and the beam is lost.

Detector afterpulsing or cable reflections create a false signal 2 ns after the main bunch that is mistaken for a satellite; operators then strengthen the knock-out, which also removes part of the main bunch, so lifetime and flux fall while the purity figure never improves.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source
guides.concept: 以 SLAC 的 LCLS 為對象：常溫銅直線加速器以 120 Hz 提供 13.6 GeV 電子，在 112 m 波盪器中以自放大自發輻射（SASE）產生 1.5 Å 的飛秒 X 光脈衝；本課推導 Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和功率，拆解光陰極注入、束流壓縮與雷射加熱器，再把單發診斷、脈衝統計與 LCLS-II 的 4 GeV 超導連續波直線加速器（最高 1 MHz）整合成可驗收的工程邏輯。
guides.conceptEn: Taking SLAC's LCLS: a normal-conducting copper linac delivers 13.6 GeV electrons at 120 Hz, and a 112 m undulator produces femtosecond 1.5 Å X-ray pulses by self-amplified spontaneous emission (SASE). The course derives the Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation power, works through the photoinjector, bunch compression and laser heater, then integrates single-shot diagnostics, pulse statistics and the LCLS-II 4 GeV superconducting continuous-wave linac (up to 1 MHz) into an acceptable engineering logic.
procedure: LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 裝入 1.3 GHz 鈮超導加速模組，在 2 K 下壁損耗低了五個數量級以上，可以連續波運轉，把重複率推到 1 MHz。兩種直線加速器共用同一個波盪器大廳，重複率、束流功率與光學熱負載因此差了四個數量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。成長率由 Pierce 參數 ρ 決定：ρ 由峰值電流、電子束尺寸、K 值與能量共同給出，典型只有 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級。功率每隔一個增益長度 L_g 增加 e 倍，約 20 個 L_g 後飽和；飽和功率約為 ρ 乘以電子束功率，頻寬也約為 ρ。LCLS 用 33 段共 112 m 的固定間隙波盪器就是為了在 8 keV 附近確保飽和。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SASE 的共振條件要求整段波盪器的 K 值一致到 ρ 的量級，否則不同段輻射的波長錯開、增益中斷。LCLS 波盪器以 NdFeB 永磁混合磁列組成，K 以微調磁極間隙的斜置機構校正；相鄰段之間的相位整合器（phase shifter）讓電子與光在段間漂移區保持同相；由於 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，波盪器大廳的溫度穩定度直接變成 K 的穩定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「固定間隙波盪器段（λ_u = 30 mm，K = 3.5）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高峰值電流來自壓縮：光陰極射頻槍產生約 250 pC、數十安培的束團，在直線加速器中以離峰相位加速得到能量啁啾，再經兩個磁性壓縮器（chicane）讓高能電子走短路徑追上低能電子，把長度壓縮約百倍到 3 kA。壓縮同時放大縱向密度調變與相干同步輻射（CSR）造成的微束團不穩定，所以在注入器加一台雷射加熱器，刻意把能散從幾 keV 提高到約 20 keV 以藍道阻尼抑制不穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SASE 是由雜訊啟動的隨機過程，每一發的能量、光譜與時間結構都不同，所以 LCLS 的診斷全部必須逐發記錄並與實驗資料同標籤。氣體偵測器以 X 光游離稀薄氣體並收集離子或電子電流，無損地量每發脈衝能量；彎晶單發光譜儀把頻譜展開到條狀偵測器上；時序工具以 X 光在薄膜上誘發的折射率跳變，用啁啾的光學脈衝把 X 光到達時間量到飛秒等級，事後把資料按真實延遲重新排序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SASE 脈衝由許多彼此不相干的縱向模式（尖峰）組成，尖峰的持續時間約為同調時間，由頻寬 ρ 決定；脈衝能量的逐發相對抖動近似為 1/√M，M 是模式數。長脈衝含數十到上百個尖峰，抖動只有百分之十幾；把束團壓到只含幾個模式時，抖動升到接近 100%，這正是 LCLS 短脈衝模式必須搭配逐發診斷的統計根源，也是「單尖峰」模式產生完全相干脈衝的原理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「脈衝統計：模式數與能量抖動」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 安裝 1.3 GHz 的 TESLA 型超導加速模組（每模組 8 個九腔鈮腔，另加 3.9 GHz 線性化模組），以約 16 MV/m 的連續波梯度把電子加速到 4 GeV；腔體以氮摻雜製程把 Q₀ 提高到 2.7×10¹⁰ 以壓低 2 K 熱負載。模組由 Fermilab 與 Jefferson Lab 組裝、測試後運到 SLAC 串接；2 K 低溫站的容量由所有腔體的動態損耗加靜態漏熱決定，再乘上 2 K 制冷的效率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

1 MHz 連續波束流的平均功率達數百千瓦，任何導向錯誤都會在毫秒內熔穿真空腔，所以機器保護系統（MPS）必須以束流損失監視器、電流差分與溫度感測在百微秒內切斷注入器雷射。使用者驗收規格則包含光子能量範圍、脈衝能量、到達時間抖動、重複率與可用度；每一項都要綁定運轉模式（電荷、壓縮、波盪器設定），因為同一台機器在不同模式下的性能差異很大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「機器保護系統與使用者交付規格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz. LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz niobium superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel, where wall losses at 2 K are more than five orders of magnitude lower, allowing continuous-wave operation and a repetition rate up to 1 MHz. Both linacs feed the same undulator hall, so repetition rate, beam power and optics heat load differ by four orders of magnitude. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE. The growth rate is set by the Pierce parameter ρ, which combines peak current, beam size, K and energy and is typically only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³. Power grows by e every gain length L_g and saturates after about 20 L_g; the saturated power is about ρ times the electron-beam power and the bandwidth is also about ρ. LCLS used 33 fixed-gap segments totalling 112 m precisely to guarantee saturation near 8 keV. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “112 m undulator and SASE gain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The SASE resonance requires K to be uniform along the whole undulator to the order of ρ, otherwise the segments radiate at different wavelengths and the gain breaks. LCLS undulators are hybrid NdFeB arrays whose K is trimmed by a mechanism that slightly cants the gap; phase shifters between segments keep electrons and light in phase across the drift sections; and because NdFeB remanence changes by about −0.1 %/K, the undulator-hall temperature stability becomes the K stability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fixed-gap undulator segments (λ_u = 30 mm, K = 3.5)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

High peak current comes from compression: the photocathode RF gun produces about 250 pC at tens of amperes, off-crest acceleration imprints an energy chirp, and two magnetic chicanes let high-energy electrons take the shorter path and catch up with low-energy ones, compressing the length about a hundredfold to 3 kA. Compression also amplifies longitudinal density modulations and the coherent-synchrotron-radiation (CSR) driven microbunching instability, so a laser heater in the injector deliberately raises the energy spread from a few keV to about 20 keV to suppress it by Landau damping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

SASE starts from noise, so every shot differs in energy, spectrum and time structure, and all LCLS diagnostics must record shot by shot and share tags with the experiment data. Gas detectors ionise dilute gas with the X-rays and collect ion or electron current to measure pulse energy non-destructively; a bent-crystal single-shot spectrometer spreads the spectrum onto a strip detector; and the timing tool uses the X-ray-induced refractive-index step in a thin film, probed by a chirped optical pulse, to measure X-ray arrival time at the femtosecond level so data can be re-sorted by true delay afterwards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A SASE pulse consists of many mutually incoherent longitudinal modes (spikes); each spike lasts about one coherence time, set by the bandwidth ρ, and the shot-to-shot relative fluctuation of pulse energy is about 1/√M for M modes. A long pulse contains tens to a hundred spikes and fluctuates by only ten-odd percent; compressing the bunch to a few modes drives the fluctuation toward 100%, which is the statistical reason LCLS short-pulse modes need shot-by-shot diagnostics, and also the principle behind single-spike modes that yield fully coherent pulses. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pulse statistics: mode count and energy fluctuation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz TESLA-type superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel (eight nine-cell niobium cavities per module, plus 3.9 GHz linearising modules), accelerating electrons to 4 GeV at a continuous-wave gradient of about 16 MV/m; nitrogen doping raises the cavity Q₀ to 2.7×10¹⁰ to limit the 2 K heat load. The modules were assembled and tested at Fermilab and Jefferson Lab and then strung together at SLAC; the 2 K cryoplant capacity follows from the dynamic loss of all cavities plus static heat leak, multiplied by the efficiency of 2 K refrigeration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cryomodule string and the 2 K cryoplant”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A 1 MHz continuous-wave beam carries hundreds of kilowatts of average power, and any steering error would melt through a chamber within milliseconds, so the machine protection system (MPS) must cut the injector laser within about a hundred microseconds using beam-loss monitors, current differencing and temperature sensors. The user-acceptance specification covers photon-energy range, pulse energy, arrival-time jitter, repetition rate and availability, each bound to an operating mode (charge, compression, undulator settings) because the same machine performs very differently across modes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Machine protection and user-delivery specification”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現；反過來把超導腔的連續波負載估成脈衝模式，2 K 低溫系統在數分鐘內失壓。
若實驗只用平均脈衝能量與名義延遲，泵浦-探測資料被 50 fs 的到達時間抖動塗抹，100 fs 的動力學訊號消失；更糟的是時間戳記錯位一發，整批資料與診斷配對錯誤而無法事後修正。
pitfallsEn: Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once; conversely, estimating the superconducting cavities' CW load as if pulsed lets the 2 K cryogenic system lose pressure within minutes.

If an experiment uses only average pulse energy and nominal delay, 50 fs of arrival jitter smears the pump-probe data and a 100 fs dynamic signal disappears; worse, a one-shot offset in time stamps mispairs an entire run with its diagnostics beyond later repair.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: European XFEL
guides.concept: 從 European XFEL 的 3.4 km 超導直線加速器與每秒 10 列、每列最多 2700 發的突發模式出發，理解射頻脈衝預算、波盪器共振與段間相位、2 K 低溫負載、掠射反射鏡面形、AGIPD 記憶格校正、束團分配與機器保護如何串成一座可交接的硬 X 光雷射設施。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the 3.4 km superconducting linac of European XFEL and its burst mode of 10 trains per second with up to 2700 pulses each, see how the RF pulse budget, undulator resonance and inter-segment phase, 2 K cryogenic load, grazing-mirror figure, AGIPD memory-cell calibration, bunch distribution and machine protection combine into a hard X-ray laser facility that can be handed over.
procedure: European XFEL 全長 3.4 km，從漢堡 DESY 延伸到 Schenefeld；其中 2.1 km 的加速器以 1.3 GHz TESLA 型鈮超導腔在約 2 K 運轉。超導腔壁的表面電阻極低，射頻能量幾乎不在腔壁耗散，因此可以使用約 1.5 ms 的長射頻脈衝，每秒 10 列，每列以 4.5 MHz（間隔約 222 ns）放入最多 2700 個電子束團，合計每秒最多 27,000 發 X 光脈衝。列與列之間約 99.4 ms 的空檔留給低溫系統、偵測器讀出與機器保護恢復。這種突發模式與每秒百餘發的常溫銅腔或連續波機器是完全不同的系統邊界。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

電子在週期 λu 的交替磁場中蛇行，在電子座標中看到被勞侖茲收縮的磁場週期，發出的輻射再經都卜勒壓縮回實驗室，因此共振波長為 λ = λu/(2γ²)·(1 + K²/2)，K = 0.934·B[T]·λu[cm]。European XFEL 的 SASE1 與 SASE2 為 175 m 長的可變間隙波盪器，涵蓋約 3 keV 到 25 keV 以上；SASE3 長 105 m，涵蓋 0.26 到 3 keV。改變磁鐵間隙就改變 B 與 K，因此電子能量固定時各波盪器仍可獨立調整光子能量，這是多條光束線同時服務使用者的物理基礎。SASE 從電子的散粒雜訊起振，單程通過中指數放大並在飽和前形成微束團。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可變間隙波盪器共振」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主加速器有 96 個低溫模組（注入器另有 2 個，其中一個是 3.9 GHz 三次諧波模組，用來線性化縱向相空間），每個模組裝 8 個 1.3 GHz 九格鈮腔。腔體以高純度鈮板深抽成型、電子束焊接，再經電解拋光、高壓超純水沖洗與無塵室組裝，任何殘留微粒都可能成為場發射源。腔體浸在約 2 K 的超流氦中，Q₀ 可達 10¹⁰，但每瓦在 2 K 移除的熱，在室溫端要付出數百瓦以上的壓縮機功率，因此 Q₀ 與工作比直接決定營運成本。腔體由 E. Zanon 與 Research Instruments 兩家廠商各製作一半，模組在 CEA Saclay 組裝後於 DESY 進行射頻測試。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SASE1 與 SASE2 各由 35 段 5 m 長的永久磁鐵波盪器組成，段與段之間留 1.1 m 間隔，放置四極磁鐵、束流位置監測器與相位移相器。每段的間隙由馬達與編碼器控制，微米級的間隙差就會改變 K；磁量測後以墊片修正電子軌跡與相位誤差。電子在無磁場的間隔中相對於光的落後量與在波盪器中不同，若不補償，各段的輻射以錯誤相位疊加，增益長度變長甚至無法飽和。相位移相器是一個小型磁鐵彎道，加長電子路徑使總落後量為波長的整數倍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「5 m 波盪器段與移相器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

X 光在材料中的折射率為 n = 1 − δ，只有在掠射角小於臨界角 θc ≈ √(2δ) 時才會全外反射，所以 European XFEL 以約 1 m 長、B₄C 鍍膜的矽鏡在數 mrad 的掠射角下導光、偏移與分流。光束在鏡面上的足跡被拉長為 w/θ，因此鏡長要以公尺計；高度誤差 h 在反射時造成 2h·sinθ 的光程差，對 0.1 nm 的波長，奈米級的高度誤差就足以破壞聚焦與同調波前。突發模式在 0.6 ms 內送來數千發脈衝，鏡面局部吸熱形成熱凸起，需要以冷卻設計與幾何最佳化控制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「B₄C 鍍膜掠射矽鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

一般積分型偵測器每秒只讀數十到數百張影像，跟不上 4.5 MHz 的脈衝。AGIPD 在每個 200 µm 畫素下方的讀出晶片內放了 352 個類比記憶格，在脈衝列中以最高 4.5 MHz 逐張存下電荷，再利用列間約 99.4 ms 的空檔讀出並數位化。為了在同一張影像內同時記錄單光子與 12.4 keV 下超過一萬個光子的布拉格峰，每個畫素有高、中、低三段自動增益切換；500 µm 厚的矽感測層決定硬 X 光的吸收效率。代價是每個畫素、每個記憶格、每段增益都有自己的偏移與增益係數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「AGIPD 百萬畫素偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

加速器末端以快速踢磁鐵與平頂踢磁鐵把同一列中的束團分到兩條電子束線：一條通往 SASE2，另一條依序通過 SASE1 與 SASE3，SASE3 使用 SASE1 下游的同一批電子。三台波盪器因此共用電子能量，但以各自的間隙設定光子能量；分配切換需要一段時間空檔，各光束線的束團數會互相牽動。實驗站（SPB/SFX、FXE、MID、HED、SQS、SCS）再依偵測器與樣品更新速度選擇列內重複率，不用的束團由踢磁鐵送入束流捕集器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在 17.5 GeV、每秒 27,000 個束團下，電子束平均功率可達百 kW 級以上，一整列打到真空管或波盪器磁鐵都可能造成損傷，或讓 NdFeB 永久磁鐵受輻射去磁。機器保護系統以束流損失監測器、軌跡與入出口電荷差在脈衝列內即時判斷，在微秒級時間內停止後續束團；波盪器旁的劑量計長期追蹤累積輻射。X 光側也要限制每列的總能量，避免反射鏡與樣品前光學元件被熱負載或燒蝕破壞。交接時要把能量、電荷、列長、波盪器設定、偵測器模式與保護門檻一起記錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流損失監測與捕集器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: European XFEL is 3.4 km long, running from DESY in Hamburg to Schenefeld; its 2.1 km accelerator uses 1.3 GHz TESLA-type niobium superconducting cavities at about 2 K. Because the superconducting wall resistance is tiny, almost no RF energy is dissipated in the walls, so RF pulses of about 1.5 ms are possible: 10 trains per second, each holding up to 2700 electron bunches at 4.5 MHz (about 222 ns apart), for up to 27,000 X-ray pulses per second. The roughly 99.4 ms gap between trains lets the cryogenics, detector readout and machine protection recover. This burst mode is a completely different system boundary from a copper linac firing about a hundred pulses per second or a continuous-wave machine. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Electrons wiggle through an alternating field of period λu; in their own frame they see a Lorentz-contracted period, and the emitted radiation is Doppler-compressed back into the laboratory, giving the resonant wavelength λ = λu/(2γ²)·(1 + K²/2) with K = 0.934·B[T]·λu[cm]. At European XFEL, SASE1 and SASE2 are 175 m variable-gap undulators covering about 3 keV to beyond 25 keV, and SASE3 is 105 m long covering 0.26 to 3 keV. Opening or closing the magnet gap changes B and K, so each undulator tunes its photon energy independently at a fixed electron energy, which is the physical basis for serving several beamlines at once. SASE starts from electron shot noise, amplifies exponentially in a single pass and microbunches the beam before saturation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Variable-gap undulator resonance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The main linac has 96 cryomodules (the injector has 2 more, one a 3.9 GHz third-harmonic module that linearises the longitudinal phase space), each holding eight 1.3 GHz nine-cell niobium cavities. Cavities are deep-drawn from high-purity niobium sheet, electron-beam welded, electropolished, rinsed with high-pressure ultrapure water and assembled in a clean room; any residual particle can become a field-emission site. Immersed in superfluid helium near 2 K they reach Q₀ of 10¹⁰, yet every watt removed at 2 K costs hundreds of watts or more of compressor power at room temperature, so Q₀ and duty factor set operating cost directly. Production was split between E. Zanon and Research Instruments, and modules were assembled at CEA Saclay before RF testing at DESY. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

SASE1 and SASE2 each consist of 35 permanent-magnet undulator segments 5 m long, separated by 1.1 m intersections that hold a quadrupole, a beam-position monitor and a phase shifter. Each gap is driven by motors with encoders, and a micrometre gap difference already changes K; after magnetic measurement, shims correct the electron trajectory and phase errors. In the field-free intersection the electron falls behind the light by a different amount than inside the undulator, so without compensation the segments radiate with the wrong relative phase, the gain length grows and saturation may never be reached. The phase shifter is a small magnetic chicane that lengthens the electron path so the total slippage is an integer number of wavelengths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “5 m undulator segments and phase shifters”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Inside matter X-rays see n = 1 − δ and are totally externally reflected only below the critical angle θc ≈ √(2δ), so European XFEL steers, offsets and distributes its beams with B₄C-coated silicon mirrors about 1 m long at grazing angles of a few milliradians. The footprint on the mirror stretches to w/θ, which is why the mirrors are metre-scale, and a height error h produces a path difference 2h·sinθ on reflection; at a 0.1 nm wavelength, nanometre height errors already spoil focusing and the coherent wavefront. Burst mode delivers thousands of pulses within 0.6 ms, so local absorption raises a thermal bump that must be managed by cooling design and geometry. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “B₄C-coated grazing silicon mirror”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Ordinary integrating detectors read tens to hundreds of frames per second and cannot follow 4.5 MHz pulses. AGIPD places 352 analogue memory cells in the readout chip beneath every 200 µm pixel, stores charge frame by frame at up to 4.5 MHz during the train, and reads out and digitises during the roughly 99.4 ms gap between trains. To record single photons and Bragg peaks of more than ten thousand 12.4 keV photons in one image, each pixel switches automatically between high, medium and low gain, while the 500 µm silicon sensor sets the hard X-ray absorption efficiency. The price is that every pixel, memory cell and gain stage has its own offset and gain coefficient. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “AGIPD megapixel detector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

At the end of the linac, fast and flat-top kickers distribute bunches of the same train into two electron beamlines: one feeds SASE2 and the other passes through SASE1 and then SASE3, which uses the same electrons downstream of SASE1. The three undulators therefore share one electron energy but set their photon energies with their own gaps; switching needs a time gap, so the bunch counts of the beamlines are coupled. Instruments (SPB/SFX, FXE, MID, HED, SQS, SCS) then choose an intra-train repetition rate to suit detector and sample refresh, and unused bunches are kicked into beam dumps. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast kickers and bunch pattern”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

At 17.5 GeV and 27,000 bunches per second the average electron-beam power reaches the hundred-kilowatt class, and a whole train hitting the vacuum pipe or undulator magnets can cause damage or radiation-induced demagnetisation of the NdFeB magnets. Machine protection judges beam-loss monitors, orbit and the charge difference between entrance and exit within the train and stops the following bunches within microseconds, while dosimeters beside the undulators track accumulated radiation. On the X-ray side the energy per train must also be limited so that mirrors and optics in front of the sample are not destroyed by heat or ablation. The handoff records energy, charge, train length, undulator settings, detector mode and protection thresholds together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-loss monitors and dumps”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若負載 Q 設錯或腔體失諧，充填時間變長、平頂縮短，列尾束團在場強下降處被加速而能量偏低，波盪器共振波長跟著偏移，脈衝列後段失去雷射增益；使用者只在列的前段看到 X 光，卻常被誤判為波盪器或光學問題。
夾持應力或冷卻管路扭力可以把合格鏡面壓出數奈米的二次曲率，焦點沿光軸偏移；若聚焦光超過鍍膜損傷閾值，B₄C 會剝離，留下散射條紋與不可逆的反射率損失。
pitfallsEn: With a wrong loaded Q or a detuned cavity, the fill lengthens and the flat top shrinks; bunches at the end of the train are accelerated on a falling field and arrive low in energy, their undulator resonance shifts and the tail of the train loses lasing. Users see X-rays only at the start of the train, which is often misdiagnosed as an undulator or optics problem.

Clamping stress or torque from cooling lines can press a few nanometres of quadratic curvature into a passing mirror and move the focus along the axis; if focused light exceeds the coating damage threshold, the B₄C delaminates and leaves scatter streaks and an irreversible reflectance loss.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: ESO Very Large Telescope
guides.concept: 以 Paranal 山頂四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡為對象，從視寧度與繞射的差距出發，拆解 Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與多焦點、177 mm 薄 Zerodur 主鏡製作、1170 致動器可變形副鏡、四雷射導引星、VLTI 延遲線與 ESPRESSO 的 10 cm/s 量測，最後整合成多望遠鏡的營運交接。
guides.conceptEn: Taking the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes on Cerro Paranal, start from the gap between seeing and diffraction and work through the Ritchey–Chrétien train and its foci, the 177 mm thin Zerodur primary, the 1170-actuator deformable secondary, four laser guide stars, VLTI delay lines and ESPRESSO's 10 cm/s measurement, ending in a multi-telescope operational handoff.
procedure: VLT 由四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡、四座可移動的 1.8 m 輔助望遠鏡與地下干涉實驗室組成，涵蓋近紫外到 25 µm。口徑帶來兩種好處：集光面積讓暗弱天體在有限時間內達到訊雜比，角解析度則理論上隨 λ/D 變好；但大氣湍流把波前切成尺寸約 Fried 參數 r₀ 的同調區塊，未修正時影像寬度由 λ/r₀ 決定，與口徑無關。因此 VLT 的工程設計一直沿著兩條線前進：把四座望遠鏡的光合在一起增加集光或基線，以及以主動與自適應光學把影像拉回繞射極限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每座 UT 為 Ritchey–Chrétien 設計：f/1.8 的薄主鏡與剛性輕量化的凸雙曲面副鏡共同消除球差與彗差，經地平式機架指向全天。光可以送到主鏡下方的 Cassegrain 焦點、兩側的 Nasmyth 焦點，或再經轉折送到地下的 coudé 焦點，讓大型穩定儀器固定不動。副鏡單元以五個自由度定位：一軸對焦、兩軸置中、兩軸指向；因為副鏡把主鏡焦比放大約 8 倍，副鏡的微小軸向位移會在焦面被放大，所以副鏡對焦是主動光學閉環中最頻繁的修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

UT 主鏡是直徑 8.2 m、厚約 177 mm 的 Zerodur 彎月鏡，成品重約 23 t；每片由 SCHOTT 澆鑄約 45 t 的玻璃陶瓷，經約 3 個月退火與 9 個月陶瓷化，膨脹係數規格 0 ± 0.15×10⁻⁶/K，交貨量測約 −0.03 到 −0.04×10⁻⁶/K。REOSC 在模擬最終鏡室的 150 點氣動支撐上研磨拋光，因為薄鏡本身不保形，驗收必須在主動模式下進行：允許致動器以有限的力修正低階面形，交付的波前約 40 nm RMS。薄鏡的另一個好處是熱慣量小，能跟上夜間氣溫，減少鏡面視寧度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

UT4 的自適應光學設施把原本的剛性副鏡換成直徑 1120 mm、厚約 2 mm 的 Zerodur 薄殼可變形副鏡，背後以 1170 個音圈致動器推動；薄殼由 SAGEM 製作，參考體由 SESO 以輕量化 Zerodur 製造，系統由 Microgate 與 ADS International 整合。每個致動器旁有電容感測器量測薄殼與參考體的約 90 µm 間隙，內迴路以 80 kHz 維持形狀，這層空氣膜同時提供阻尼。把自適應元件放在副鏡，讓所有焦點共用修正且不增加額外反射面與熱背景。致動器與電子機箱的熱必須以液冷帶走，否則副鏡附近形成局部湍流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1170 致動器可變形副鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

自然亮星很少落在目標附近，因此 UT4 以四雷射導引星設施在約 90 km 高的鈉層激發四顆人造星。四顆導引星環繞視場，GRAAL 模組把地表層湍流修正後的影像送給 HAWK-I，GALACSI 則為 MUSE 做地表層或雷射斷層修正。雷射星位於有限高度，光錐只取樣部分湍流（錐效應），且鈉層有約 10 km 厚度，從望遠鏡不同位置看到的雷射光點會被拉長，次孔徑離發射點越遠拉得越長。雷射星也無法量測整體傾斜，所以仍需要一顆暗的自然星提供傾斜資訊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四雷射導引星設施」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

VLTI 把兩到四座望遠鏡的光經地下光管送到延遲線，延遲線是放在長軌道上的貓眼反射車，隨地球自轉連續移動以補償幾何光程差，使各路光在合光器處等光程而產生干涉條紋。UT 間基線可達約 130 m，輔助望遠鏡可移到不同基座組成約 200 m 的基線。條紋對比（可見度）攜帶目標的空間頻率資訊，但只要各路光程差抖動接近波長的十分之一，可見度就明顯下降；GRAVITY 等儀器以條紋追蹤器在 K 波段即時量測並回授到延遲線，再以雷射計量量測內部光程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「VLTI 延遲線隧道」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

ESPRESSO 位於合併 coudé 實驗室，可經 coudé 光路收單一 UT 的光，或同時收四座 UT 的光（非同調合併），以換取更暗目標的訊雜比。它的目標是在十年尺度上達到 10 cm/s 的徑向速度精度，解析度依模式約 70,000、140,000 或 190,000。要量到如此小的都卜勒位移，光譜儀必須放在真空、毫開爾文級溫控的環境中，以光纖與散射器穩定照明，並以頻率梳或 Fabry–Pérot 標準具同時記錄波長參考；望遠鏡端的導星與大氣色散補償則決定光纖入口的照明穩定性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ESPRESSO 與合併 coudé 實驗室」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

四座 UT 各有不同焦點的常駐儀器，營運上要協調哪座望遠鏡做 VLTI、哪座做自適應光學、哪座提供 coudé 光，維護計畫也必須錯開。主鏡單元約 50 t，需從望遠鏡卸下送到山上的鍍膜廠清洗並重鍍鋁膜；灰塵沉積會逐步降低反射率並增加熱輻射背景，對中紅外儀器尤其不利。交接紀錄要包含每座望遠鏡的影像品質、主動光學力圖、自適應光學性能、延遲線狀態與反射率歷史，才能讓下一個觀測期的排程以實際能力為準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主鏡單元維護與鍍膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The VLT comprises four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes, four relocatable 1.8 m Auxiliary Telescopes and an underground interferometric laboratory, covering the near ultraviolet to 25 µm. Aperture brings two benefits: collecting area lets faint targets reach a useful signal-to-noise ratio in finite time, and angular resolution in principle improves as λ/D. Atmospheric turbulence, however, breaks the wavefront into coherent patches of about the Fried parameter r₀, so the uncorrected image width is set by λ/r₀ regardless of aperture. VLT engineering has therefore advanced along two lines: combining the four telescopes for more collecting area or longer baselines, and using active and adaptive optics to pull images back toward the diffraction limit. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each UT is a Ritchey–Chrétien design: an f/1.8 thin primary and a rigid, lightweight convex hyperboloidal secondary jointly cancel spherical aberration and coma, pointed over the whole sky by an alt-azimuth mount. Light can go to the Cassegrain focus below the primary, to the two Nasmyth foci at the sides, or be relayed to a coudé focus in the basement so that large, stable instruments stay fixed. The secondary unit is positioned in five degrees of freedom: one for focus, two for centring and two for pointing. Because the secondary magnifies the primary focal ratio about eightfold, small axial secondary motions are amplified at the focal plane, which makes secondary focus the most frequent correction in the active-optics loop. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each UT primary is a Zerodur meniscus 8.2 m across and about 177 mm thick, weighing about 23 t finished; SCHOTT cast about 45 t of glass ceramic per blank, followed by roughly 3 months of annealing and 9 months of ceramisation, to a thermal-expansion specification of 0 ± 0.15×10⁻⁶/K, with delivered blanks measuring about −0.03 to −0.04×10⁻⁶/K. REOSC ground and polished on a 150-point pneumatic support that mimics the final cell; because a thin mirror cannot hold its own shape, acceptance is done in active mode, letting actuators correct low-order figure with limited forces, and delivered wavefronts were about 40 nm RMS. The thin mirror's low thermal inertia also lets it follow the night-time air temperature, reducing mirror seeing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The UT4 Adaptive Optics Facility replaced the rigid secondary with a deformable secondary: a Zerodur shell 1120 mm across and about 2 mm thick, pushed by 1170 voice-coil actuators. SAGEM produced the shell, SESO the lightweighted Zerodur reference body, and Microgate with ADS International integrated the system. A capacitive sensor beside each actuator measures the roughly 90 µm gap between shell and reference body, an internal loop at 80 kHz holds the shape, and the air film provides damping. Putting the adaptive element at the secondary lets all foci share the correction without extra reflections or thermal background. Heat from actuators and electronics must be carried away by liquid cooling, or local turbulence forms around the secondary. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1170-actuator deformable secondary”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Bright natural stars rarely lie near a target, so UT4 uses the Four Laser Guide Star Facility to excite four artificial stars in the sodium layer at about 90 km. The four guide stars surround the field; the GRAAL module feeds ground-layer-corrected images to HAWK-I, and GALACSI provides ground-layer or laser-tomography correction for MUSE. Because a laser star sits at finite altitude, its light cone samples only part of the turbulence (the cone effect), and because the sodium layer is about 10 km thick, the spot seen from different parts of the pupil is elongated, more so for subapertures farther from the launch point. Laser stars also cannot measure overall tilt, so a faint natural star is still needed for tip-tilt. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four Laser Guide Star Facility”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

VLTI sends light from two to four telescopes through underground light ducts to the delay lines, cat's-eye carriages on long rails that move continuously with Earth rotation to cancel the geometric path difference so that all beams arrive at the combiner with equal path and form fringes. Baselines between UTs reach about 130 m, and the Auxiliary Telescopes can be moved between stations to form baselines of about 200 m. Fringe contrast (visibility) carries the target's spatial-frequency information, but once the path-difference jitter approaches a tenth of the wavelength the visibility drops markedly; instruments such as GRAVITY measure fringes in K band with a fringe tracker that feeds back to the delay lines, and laser metrology measures internal paths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “VLTI delay-line tunnel”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

ESPRESSO sits in the combined coudé laboratory and receives light from one UT through its coudé train, or from all four UTs at once (incoherent combination) to gain signal-to-noise on fainter targets. Its goal is 10 cm/s radial-velocity precision over a decade, with resolving power of about 70,000, 140,000 or 190,000 depending on mode. Measuring such tiny Doppler shifts requires the spectrograph to sit in vacuum with millikelvin-class temperature control, fibre feeds with scramblers to stabilise illumination, and a frequency comb or Fabry–Pérot etalon recorded simultaneously as wavelength reference; guiding and atmospheric-dispersion correction at the telescope set how stable the fibre entrance illumination is. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ESPRESSO and the combined coudé laboratory”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The four UTs carry resident instruments at different foci, so operations must coordinate which telescope serves VLTI, which runs adaptive optics and which feeds the coudé laboratory, and maintenance must be staggered. The roughly 50 t primary-mirror unit is removed from the telescope and taken to the on-site coating plant for cleaning and aluminium recoating; dust gradually lowers reflectance and raises thermal background, which hurts mid-infrared instruments in particular. The handoff record must include each telescope's image quality, active-optics force maps, AO performance, delay-line status and reflectance history so that the next period's schedule rests on actual capability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Primary-mirror unit maintenance and coating”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若只看口徑而忽略站址與局部湍流，8 m 級望遠鏡的影像會和 1 m 級望遠鏡一樣寬，只多了集光；更常見的是把圓頂內熱湍流誤當成大氣視寧度，導致錯誤地升級光學而非改善熱控。
鈉層高度在夜間變化數公里時，雷射星的對焦也跟著改變；若沒有以自然星的慢速對焦感測修正，系統會把鈉層高度變化誤當成望遠鏡離焦，科學影像持續失焦。
pitfallsEn: Judging a telescope by aperture alone, without site and local turbulence, leaves an 8 m class telescope with images as wide as a 1 m telescope and only more light; more commonly, dome thermal turbulence is mistaken for atmospheric seeing and the optics are upgraded instead of the thermal control.

When the sodium-layer altitude changes by kilometres during the night, the laser-star focus changes with it; without slow natural-star focus sensing, the system interprets sodium-height changes as telescope defocus and the science image stays out of focus.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: ESO Extremely Large Telescope
guides.concept: 以 Cerro Armazones 上的 39 m ELT 為對象，從繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度出發，拆解五鏡設計、798 片六角鏡段的 133 種段型與 8 nm 拋光、六片 1.95 mm 薄殼組成的 M4、約 9000 個邊緣感測器的共相控制、M4／M5 的頻段分工，以及分段重鍍與初光驗收的工程邏輯。
guides.conceptEn: Taking the 39 m ELT on Cerro Armazones, start from the diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity, then work through the five-mirror design, the 133 segment types and 8 nm polish of 798 hexagonal segments, the M4 built from six 1.95 mm shells, phasing control with about 9000 edge sensors, the M4/M5 frequency split, and the engineering logic of segment recoating and first-light acceptance.
procedure: ELT 的科學理由不只是集光：當自適應光學把影像修正到接近繞射極限時，點源影像的角大小隨 λ/D 縮小，背景只在更小的立體角內與訊號競爭，因此在背景主導的條件下，達到相同訊雜比所需時間按 D⁴ 縮短，其中 D² 來自集光、另一個 D² 來自影像面積縮小。這也意味著 ELT 的價值高度依賴自適應光學與分段共相：若影像只有視寧度寬度，就只剩 D² 的集光收益。主鏡外徑 39 m、中央遮擋約 11 m，集光面積接近 1000 m²。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「39 m 分段主鏡口徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

ELT 的光學由五面鏡組成：M1 為曲率半徑約 68.7 m 的 39 m 分段凹面橢球鏡，M2 為 4.2 m 凸面薄彎月鏡，M3 為 3.8 m 主動凹面鏡，三者構成在較大視場內同時校正球差、彗差與像散的三鏡消像散系統。M4 是約 2.4 m 的平面自適應鏡，修正大氣湍流與望遠鏡振動；M5 是約 2.6 m × 2.1 m 的平面橢圓鏡，負責數 Hz 以下的影像穩定並把光送到 Nasmyth 平台。把自適應鏡做在望遠鏡內，所有儀器都能共用修正，但也代表每多一面鏡就多一次反射損失與熱發射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

M1 由 798 片約 1.45 m、厚約 5 cm 的六角形 Zerodur 鏡段組成，分成六個相同的扇區，每扇區 133 片各不相同，另備第七組 133 片供輪替重鍍，共 931 片。因為 M1 是接近拋物面的橢球，每個鏡段都是主鏡不同位置的離軸片，越外圈的鏡段非球面偏離越大。SCHOTT 製作鏡坯，Safran Reosc 研磨、拋光、切邊並整合，表面不規則度約 8 nm 以內。每片背後有 27 點 whiffletree 支撐、9 個翹曲調整器修正低階面形，以及 3 個定位致動器控制活塞與傾斜。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.45 m 六角形 Zerodur 鏡段」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

M4 是約 2.4 m 的平面自適應鏡，由六片 60° 扇形 Zerodur 薄殼組成，每片從約 35 mm 的鏡坯磨薄到 1.95 mm，厚度均勻度優於 15 µm。薄殼漂浮在 2.7 m 碳化矽參考結構前約 90 µm 處，背後超過 5000 個音圈致動器以最高每秒 1000 次的速率改變形狀，位置則以每秒 70,000 次量測，行程可達 50 µm。SCHOTT 供應鏡坯，Safran Reosc 磨薄與拋光，AdOptica 聯盟製作殼體組件與支撐單元。由於薄殼也需定期重鍍，共製作 12 片薄殼，重鍍時可整組替換而不停機太久。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「M4 六片薄殼與 SiC 參考體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

798 片鏡段必須在整個 39 m 範圍內對齊到數十奈米，否則 M1 會變成許多彼此不相干的小鏡子。相鄰鏡段的邊上裝有成對的邊緣感測器，量測彼此的高度差與間隙，精度為數奈米；控制器把約 9000 個感測器讀值反解成每片 3 個定位致動器的命令，致動器精度約 2 nm、行程 10 mm。邊緣感測器只量相對高度，因此整體活塞、整體傾斜與類似離焦的碗狀模態幾乎看不到，必須由望遠鏡的波前感測器或專用共相相機定期量測，並重設感測器的參考值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「邊緣感測器與定位致動器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

ELT 的主結構與鏡面在風載、追蹤與機械振動下會讓影像移動，影像移動若不修正，即使波前其他部分完美也會把繞射極限的影像抹寬。M5 以大行程、低頻寬的傾斜修正吸收數 Hz 以下的風振與追蹤誤差；M4 以小行程、高頻寬的傾斜加上高階形狀修正處理較快的振動與湍流，並持續把平均傾斜卸載給 M5，避免 M4 行程飽和。工程上要分別為每個頻段估計干擾振幅，再乘上各迴路的抑制函數，最後把殘餘影像移動換算成 Strehl 損失。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「M5 傾斜鏡與 M4 頻段分工」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

ELT 位於海拔約 3000 m 的 Cerro Armazones，灰塵與高紫外輻射會逐漸降低鏡面反射率並增加散射。M1 的每片鏡段約每 18 個月重鍍一次，因此營運上是一條連續的生產線：每天卸下約兩片、送到山上的鍍膜設施清洗重鍍，再裝回並重新共相。第七組 133 片備用鏡段讓卸下的位置能立即補上已鍍好的鏡段，避免主鏡出現空洞。每次更換都會擾動邊緣感測器的參考值，所以交換流程必須和共相校正綁在一起。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡段輪替重鍍與備用扇區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

依 ESO 的時程，ELT 預計 2029 年進行首次測試觀測，2030 年 12 月交付第一批以科學儀器完成的觀測。第一代儀器包括近紅外成像儀 MICADO、積分場光譜儀 HARMONI 與中紅外儀器 METIS，並以 MORFEO 等自適應光學模組提供多共軛修正。驗收不能只看單一系統合格：必須在天上以點擴散函數量測 Strehl、共相殘差、影像穩定與通量，並與預算表逐項對照，才能決定哪些觀測模式可以交給使用者。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「初光與第一代儀器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The scientific case for the ELT is not only light grasp: once adaptive optics brings images close to the diffraction limit, a point-source image shrinks as λ/D and the background competes with the signal over a much smaller solid angle, so in the background-limited regime the time to reach a given signal-to-noise ratio falls as D⁴, with D² from collecting area and another D² from the smaller image. It follows that the ELT's value depends heavily on adaptive optics and segment phasing: with seeing-limited images only the D² gain from area remains. The primary is 39 m across with a central obstruction of about 11 m, giving a collecting area close to 1000 m². Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “39 m segmented aperture”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

ELT optics consist of five mirrors: M1 is a 39 m segmented concave ellipsoid with a radius of curvature of about 68.7 m, M2 a 4.2 m convex thin meniscus and M3 a 3.8 m active concave mirror, together forming a three-mirror anastigmat that corrects spherical aberration, coma and astigmatism over a wide field. M4 is a flat adaptive mirror about 2.4 m across that corrects atmospheric turbulence and telescope vibration; M5 is a flat elliptical mirror of about 2.6 m × 2.1 m that stabilises the image below a few hertz and sends the beam to the Nasmyth platforms. Building the adaptive mirror into the telescope lets every instrument share the correction, but each extra mirror adds a reflection loss and thermal emission. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “M1 to M5 five-mirror train”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

M1 is made of 798 hexagonal Zerodur segments about 1.45 m across and 5 cm thick, arranged in six identical sectors of 133 different segments each, plus a seventh set of 133 for rotation through recoating, 931 in all. Because M1 is a near-paraboloidal ellipsoid, each segment is an off-axis piece of the parent mirror, and the outer rings depart more from a sphere. SCHOTT makes the blanks and Safran Reosc grinds, polishes, cuts and integrates them, holding surface irregularities to about 8 nm. Behind each segment sit a 27-point whiffletree support, 9 warping-harness actuators for low-order figure and 3 position actuators controlling piston and tilt. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1.45 m hexagonal Zerodur segment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

M4 is a flat adaptive mirror about 2.4 m across made of six 60° Zerodur shell petals, each thinned from a roughly 35 mm blank to 1.95 mm with thickness uniformity better than 15 µm. The shells float about 90 µm in front of a 2.7 m silicon-carbide reference structure, and more than 5000 voice-coil actuators reshape them up to 1000 times per second while position is sensed 70,000 times per second, with up to 50 µm of stroke. SCHOTT supplies the blanks, Safran Reosc thins and polishes them, and the AdOptica consortium builds the shell assemblies and support unit. Since the shells also need periodic recoating, 12 are made so that a full set can be swapped during recoating without long downtime. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “M4 six shells and SiC reference body”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The 798 segments must be aligned to tens of nanometres across the whole 39 m, or M1 becomes many mutually incoherent small mirrors. Pairs of edge sensors along adjacent edges measure relative height and gap to a few nanometres; the controller inverts about 9000 sensor readings into commands for the 3 position actuators of each segment, which have about 2 nm precision and 10 mm stroke. Edge sensors only see relative height, so global piston, global tilt and a defocus-like bowl mode are nearly invisible to them and must be measured periodically by the telescope's wavefront sensors or a dedicated phasing camera, which then resets the sensor reference values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Edge sensors and position actuators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Wind load, tracking and mechanical vibration make the ELT image move, and uncorrected image motion smears a diffraction-limited image even if the rest of the wavefront is perfect. M5 provides large-stroke, low-bandwidth tip-tilt to absorb wind shake and tracking errors below a few hertz; M4 adds small-stroke, high-bandwidth tip-tilt and high-order shape correction for faster vibration and turbulence, continuously offloading its average tilt to M5 so its stroke does not saturate. The engineering task is to estimate disturbance amplitude in each frequency band, multiply by the rejection function of each loop and convert the residual image motion into a Strehl loss. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “M5 tip-tilt and M4 frequency split”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The ELT sits at about 3000 m on Cerro Armazones, where dust and strong ultraviolet gradually lower reflectance and increase scatter. Each M1 segment is recoated roughly every 18 months, so operations run as a continuous production line: about two segments per day are removed, cleaned and recoated in the on-site coating facility, reinstalled and rephased. The seventh set of 133 spare segments lets a freshly coated segment fill each vacated position immediately, so the primary never has holes. Every exchange disturbs the edge-sensor references, so the exchange procedure must be tied to phasing calibration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Segment rotation recoating and spare sector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

According to ESO's schedule, the ELT is planned to make its first test observations in 2029 and deliver the first observations with scientific instruments in December 2030. First-generation instruments include the near-infrared imager MICADO, the integral-field spectrograph HARMONI and the mid-infrared instrument METIS, with adaptive-optics modules such as MORFEO providing multi-conjugate correction. Acceptance cannot rest on individual subsystems passing: Strehl, phasing residual, image stability and throughput must be measured on sky from the point-spread function and compared item by item with the budget before deciding which observing modes can be released to users. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “First light and first-generation instruments”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若專案只追求主鏡面積而低估共相與自適應光學的難度，完成的望遠鏡會變成昂貴的視寧度受限光桶，在背景主導的紅外觀測中只得到約 23 倍而非數百倍的時間收益。
若感測器零點隨溫度漂移而沒有以共相相機重設，邊緣感測器迴路會忠實地把錯誤維持住，鏡段逐漸形成碗狀或鋸齒狀的活塞誤差；在可見光與近紅外短波，Strehl 會先受害，而長波仍看似正常，讓問題延遲被發現。
pitfallsEn: If a project chases mirror area while underestimating phasing and adaptive optics, the finished telescope becomes an expensive seeing-limited light bucket that gains only about 23 times, not hundreds of times, in background-limited infrared observing time.

If sensor zero points drift with temperature and are not reset by the phasing camera, the edge-sensor loop faithfully holds the error, and the segments develop a bowl-shaped or sawtooth piston pattern; Strehl suffers first in the visible and short near-infrared while long wavelengths still look normal, delaying discovery.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array
guides.concept: 從查南托高原的大氣透射出發，建立 ALMA 以 54 座 12 m 與 12 座 7 m 天線、最長 16 km 基線在 0.32–3.6 mm 波段合成孔徑的工程鏈：天線面形與 Ruze 效率、4 K SIS 前端、183 GHz 水汽輻射計相位校正、校正誤差預算、相關器資料流與陣列驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from atmospheric transmission on the Chajnantor plateau, this course builds the engineering chain by which ALMA synthesises an aperture from 54 twelve-metre and 12 seven-metre antennas on baselines up to 16 km at 0.32–3.6 mm: surface accuracy and Ruze efficiency, 4 K SIS front ends, 183 GHz water-vapour-radiometer phase correction, calibration error budgets, correlator data flow and array acceptance.
procedure: 毫米與次毫米波段的主要吸收體是大氣水汽，其壓力增寬的轉動譜線在 183 GHz、325 GHz 等處形成強吸收帶，帶間才是可觀測的大氣視窗。ALMA 選址在海拔約 5000 m 的查南托高原，可沉降水汽（PWV）中位數約 1 mm，使 0.32–3.6 mm（35–950 GHz）十個接收波段都有可用的透射率。大氣不只吸收訊號，也以自身溫度發射雜訊，因此站址同時決定訊號損失與系統雜訊的下限；這是整個陣列的第一道系統邊界。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「查南托高原大氣視窗」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

干涉儀把每一對天線的相關輸出視為天空亮度分佈的一個空間頻率分量（可見度），空間頻率由基線向量在垂直於視線方向的投影除以波長決定。ALMA 的角解析度由最長基線 B_max 決定，約為 λ/B_max；最大可回復的擴散結構則由最短基線 B_min 決定。50 座 12 m 天線可在 150 m 到 16 km 之間重組，12 座 7 m 天線與 4 座 12 m 全功率天線組成的 Morita 緊湊陣列補足短基線與零基線資訊，使擴散結構的總流量不致流失。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基線向量與 uv 平面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

ALMA 的 12 m 天線使用碳纖維複合材料（CFRP）背架與鋁質（部分為鍍鎳）面板，在 5000 m 的日照、風與 −20 °C 到 +20 °C 溫差下仍要維持 25 µm 的面形精度與 0.6″ 的絕對指向，主鏡以卡塞格林光學把訊號饋入接收機艙。面板的隨機誤差把部分功率散射到主波束外，損失依 Ruze 公式隨 (ε/λ)² 指數增長，因此次毫米波段對面形最敏感；指向誤差則讓源偏離主波束中心而損失增益。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「12 m 天線碳纖維背架與面板」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每座天線的前端在同一個三級低溫恆溫器內裝十個波段的接收卡匣，Band 3 到 10 使用超導-絕緣體-超導（SIS）穿隧接面混頻器，在約 4 K 工作，把天空訊號與本地振盪器（LO）訊號混頻降到中頻；低頻的 Band 1 與 2 則使用 HEMT 低雜訊放大器。SIS 混頻器的雜訊可接近量子極限 hν/k 的數倍，因此接收機雜訊、天空雜訊與光學損耗合起來的系統溫度 T_sys 才是靈敏度的真正決定因素。LO 參考由中央光子產生器經光纖分送到各天線並鎖相，以保持陣列相位一致。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「4 K 低溫恆溫器與 SIS 混頻器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

水汽的折射率使電波在大氣中多走一段「濕路徑」，約為每毫米 PWV 多出 6.5 mm 的等效路徑。兩座天線上方的水汽量因亂流而不同且隨秒級時間變化，造成基線相位的隨機起伏，在次毫米波段一小段路徑差就是好幾個波長，相干性會被摧毀。每座 12 m 天線因此裝有 183 GHz 水汽輻射計，以約 1 s 的節奏量測視線上的水汽發射，推算瞬時濕路徑並在相關後資料中逐一修正相位；殘餘的慢變化再以快速切換校正源（phase referencing）去除。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「183 GHz 水汽輻射計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

ALMA 的每次觀測都包含一組校正：以行星或衛星與監測過的類星體定流量尺度，以強連續譜源定頻寬響應，以鄰近類星體做相位參考，並定期做指向與焦點校正。天線在搬移後的位置（基線向量）要以多個類星體的相位解到次毫米精度，否則校正源與目標之間的相位會隨角距離產生系統誤差。工程師要把這些項目列成誤差預算，量化每一項對振幅與相位的貢獻，才知道影像的流量不確定度（通常 5–10%）由誰主導。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正鏈與誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每座天線把 4 個 2 GHz 基頻、兩個極化的中頻以 3 位元、4 GS/s 取樣，約 96 Gb/s 的資料經光纖送到海拔 5000 m 的陣列運作站（AOS）相關器；相關器對每一對天線在每個頻道做乘積累加，產生可見度，再以 ACA 相關器處理緊湊陣列。相關器的運算量隨基線數 N(N−1)/2 與頻道數成長，而陣列靈敏度則隨 √(N(N−1)·Δν·τ) 改善，因此天線數、頻寬與整合時間是同一條方程式的三個旋鈕。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高原相關器與資料傳輸」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

天線先在 OSF 組裝並完成全像、指向與伺服測試，再由 28 輪的運輸車載上 5000 m 高原的 192 個基座之一；每次重組後要重解天線位置、確認光纖長度補償（線長校正器）與 LO 鎖相，並以閉合相位檢驗相關器與資料鏈。陣列的驗收不是逐天線合格，而是以整體指標判定：相位穩定度對基線長度的關係、影像動態範圍、流量尺度一致性與可觀測時間比例，這些數字進入系統驗證紀錄並成為每個觀測週期的基準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「陣列重組與系統驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: At millimetre and submillimetre wavelengths the dominant absorber is atmospheric water vapour, whose pressure-broadened rotational lines near 183 GHz and 325 GHz form strong absorption bands; the gaps between them are the observable windows. ALMA sits on the Chajnantor plateau at about 5000 m, where the median precipitable water vapour (PWV) is near 1 mm, so all ten receiver bands between 0.32 and 3.6 mm (35–950 GHz) have usable transmission. The atmosphere not only attenuates the signal but radiates noise at its own temperature, so the site fixes both the signal loss and the noise floor; it is the first system boundary of the array. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Chajnantor atmospheric window”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An interferometer treats the correlated output of each antenna pair as one spatial-frequency component of the sky brightness (a visibility), with spatial frequency set by the baseline vector projected perpendicular to the line of sight divided by wavelength. ALMA's angular resolution is set by the longest baseline B_max, roughly λ/B_max, while the largest recoverable extended structure is set by the shortest baseline B_min. Fifty 12 m antennas can be reconfigured between 150 m and 16 km, and the Morita compact array of twelve 7 m antennas plus four 12 m total-power antennas supplies short and zero spacings so that the flux of extended emission is not lost. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Baseline vectors and the uv plane”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

ALMA's 12 m antennas use carbon-fibre-reinforced-plastic (CFRP) backup structures with aluminium (partly nickel-plated) panels, and must hold a 25 µm surface accuracy and 0.6″ absolute pointing under the sun, wind and −20 °C to +20 °C swings of the 5000 m site; Cassegrain optics feed the receiver cabin. Random panel errors scatter power out of the main beam with a loss that grows exponentially with (ε/λ)² according to the Ruze formula, so the submillimetre bands are the most sensitive to surface figure, while pointing errors move the source off the beam centre and lose gain. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “12 m antenna CFRP backup structure and panels”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each antenna's front end holds ten band cartridges inside one three-stage cryostat; Bands 3 to 10 use superconductor-insulator-superconductor (SIS) tunnel-junction mixers operating near 4 K that mix the sky signal with a local-oscillator (LO) tone down to an intermediate frequency, while the low-frequency Bands 1 and 2 use HEMT low-noise amplifiers. SIS mixer noise can approach a few times the quantum limit hν/k, so the system temperature T_sys, combining receiver noise, sky noise and optical loss, is what really sets sensitivity. The LO reference is generated photonically at the central building, distributed over fibre to every antenna and phase-locked to keep the array coherent. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “4 K cryostat and SIS mixers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The refractive index of water vapour adds a wet path to the radio signal, roughly 6.5 mm of excess path per millimetre of PWV. The vapour above two antennas differs because of turbulence and changes on second time scales, producing random baseline phase fluctuations; at submillimetre wavelengths a small path difference is several wavelengths and coherence is destroyed. Each 12 m antenna therefore carries a 183 GHz water-vapour radiometer that measures line-of-sight vapour emission about once per second, infers the instantaneous wet path and corrects the phase of the correlated data sample by sample; the remaining slow drift is removed by fast switching to a phase calibrator. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “183 GHz water-vapour radiometer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Every ALMA observation carries a calibration set: the flux scale from planets or moons and monitored quasars, the bandpass from a strong continuum source, phase referencing on a nearby quasar, and periodic pointing and focus checks. After antennas are moved, their positions (baseline vectors) must be solved from the phases of several quasars to submillimetre precision, otherwise the phase between calibrator and target drifts systematically with their angular separation. The engineer tabulates these items in an error budget, quantifying each contribution to amplitude and phase, to learn which term dominates the image flux uncertainty, typically 5–10%. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibration chain and error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each antenna samples four 2 GHz basebands in two polarisations at 3 bits and 4 GS/s, and about 96 Gb/s of data travel over fibre to the correlator at the 5000 m Array Operations Site (AOS); the correlator multiplies and accumulates every antenna pair in every channel to produce visibilities, with a separate ACA correlator for the compact array. Correlator load grows with the number of baselines N(N−1)/2 and with channel count, while array sensitivity improves as √(N(N−1)·Δν·τ), so antenna count, bandwidth and integration time are three knobs on the same equation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Plateau correlator and data transport”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An antenna is first assembled at the OSF, passing holography, pointing and servo tests, then carried by a 28-wheel transporter to one of 192 pads on the 5000 m plateau; after each reconfiguration the antenna positions are re-solved, the fibre length compensation (line-length corrector) and LO phase lock are confirmed, and closure phases check the correlator and data chain. The array is accepted not antenna by antenna but on system metrics: phase stability versus baseline length, image dynamic range, flux-scale consistency and the fraction of usable observing time, all recorded in the system-verification record that becomes the baseline for each observing cycle. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Array reconfiguration and system-acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若用低海拔站址的 τ₀ 經驗值排程，次毫米波段（Band 9、10）會在 PWV 稍高時完全不透明，觀測資料的訊噪比遠低於預期，且校正源的流量也因透射率估錯而系統性偏低。
雲層或液態水出現時，183 GHz 發射不再只來自水汽，輻射計推算的濕路徑偏高，套用修正反而把相位弄得更差；若流程沒有偵測液態水並關閉修正，長基線影像會模糊且峰值流量下降。
pitfallsEn: Scheduling with opacity values from a low-altitude site makes the submillimetre bands (Band 9 and 10) fully opaque at slightly elevated PWV; the data arrive with far lower signal-to-noise than planned and the calibrator fluxes are also biased low because transmission was misestimated.

When clouds or liquid water are present the 183 GHz emission no longer comes only from vapour, the inferred wet path is too large and applying the correction makes the phase worse; if the pipeline does not detect liquid water and disable the correction, long-baseline images blur and peak fluxes drop.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: ESO New Technology Telescope
guides.concept: 以 ESO 1989 年啟用的 NTT 為對象，解析為何 24 cm 厚的 3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡必須靠 75 個軸向主動支撐與離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 分析儀維持面形，八角形旋轉圓頂與鏡面溫控如何壓低局部視寧度，以及如何把光學、追蹤、鏡面視寧度與大氣視寧度合成可驗收的影像品質預算。
guides.conceptEn: Using ESO's NTT, commissioned in 1989, this course explains why a 3.58 m Zerodur meniscus only 24 cm thick must rely on 75 active axial supports and an off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann analyser to hold its figure, how the octagonal rotating enclosure and mirror temperature control suppress local seeing, and how optics, tracking, mirror seeing and atmospheric seeing combine into an acceptable image-quality budget.
procedure: 傳統望遠鏡主鏡以直徑／厚度約 6 到 8 的厚鏡坯靠自身剛性維持面形，但重量與熱慣性隨尺寸急速增長。NTT 改用厚度僅 24 cm、直徑 3.58 m 的 Zerodur 彎月薄鏡，重量約 6 t，自重彎曲與溫度梯度造成的面形誤差不再靠剛性抵抗，而是由支撐系統中的主動力與量測回授來修正。這把望遠鏡從「做得夠硬」改成「量得準、修得快」，是主動光學的核心轉變，也讓後來 8 m 級 VLT 的 17.5 cm 薄鏡成為可能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NTT 是 f/2.2 主鏡、f/11 Nasmyth 焦點的 Ritchey–Chrétien 經緯儀望遠鏡，兩個 Nasmyth 平台各掛一組儀器。地面望遠鏡的影像由大氣視寧度主導，主動光學的目標不是達到繞射極限，而是讓望遠鏡本身的像差、追蹤與局部視寧度貢獻遠小於大氣項。主動修正的對象是重力、溫度與製造殘差這些變化慢的低階像差，因此修正週期以數十秒到數分鐘計；高頻的大氣擾動留給之後的自適應光學。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與 Nasmyth 焦點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NTT 主鏡坯由 Schott 製造的 Zerodur 玻璃陶瓷鑄成，熱膨脹係數接近零，研磨拋光後裝在 75 個軸向支撐與一組側向支撐上。每個軸向支撐是帶可動配重的靜力槓桿（astatic lever），被動地承擔隨姿態變化的大部分重量，再由電動致動器疊加一個小的修正力；三個固定點定義鏡面位置。修正力的空間分佈決定能產生哪些彎曲模態：像散、三葉、四葉等低階模態只需要幾十牛頓級的力，而高階模態需要的力迅速增大且會引入支撐印痕。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「75 個軸向主動支撐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NTT 的圓頂是高約 18 m、直徑約 17 m 的八角形建築，整棟隨望遠鏡旋轉，牆面靠近望遠鏡以減少內部熱源與滯留空氣，側壁的通風百葉與擋風網讓夜風以可控方式流過主鏡，把鏡面與周圍空氣的溫差帶走。鏡面比空氣熱時，貼近鏡面的空氣層產生對流與折射率擾動，形成所謂鏡面視寧度，其影響可超過光學誤差；因此白天把鏡室降溫至預期夜間氣溫、夜間維持通風，是影像品質預算的一部分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「八角形旋轉圓頂與通風百葉」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NTT 的影像分析儀在科學視場之外取一顆參考星，用微透鏡陣列把出瞳分成子孔徑，每個子孔徑在 CCD 上成一個光點，光點相對參考位置的位移正比於該處的波前斜率。把所有斜率最小平方擬合成 Zernike 或鏡面的彈性模態後，離焦交給副鏡的軸向位移、彗差交給副鏡的橫向位移或傾斜，像散、三葉與球差則轉成主鏡的支撐力修正。量測在數十秒的積分中把大氣擾動平均掉，因此參考星的亮度與積分時間共同決定波前精度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 影像分析儀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NTT 的指向誤差約 1.5″ RMS，由含數十項幾何與撓曲項的指向模型修正；追蹤抖動、風荷載與軸承摩擦則以導星回授壓低。影像品質預算把光學殘差、追蹤抖動、鏡面視寧度與圓頂視寧度各自換成等效的 FWHM 貢獻，先以均方根合成望遠鏡項，再與大氣視寧度以 5/3 次方合成；每一項都要有量測方法與允收值，才能在影像變差時快速定位責任項目。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影像品質預算表與指向模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動光學的控制分兩層：開環以天頂距與溫度為索引的查表預先設定支撐力與副鏡位置，閉環則用影像分析儀每隔數十秒量一次殘餘像差並以低增益修正。閉環量測中混有大氣造成的低階像差，其相關時間約為口徑除以風速，所以積分時間越長，大氣項平均得越乾淨；增益則在收斂速度與雜訊放大之間取捨。NTT 在 1997 年的全面升級中把控制系統改成 VLT 架構，成為後者的原型。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動光學控制迴路與查表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

望遠鏡交接時，工程師要交付的不是一台「裝好的機器」，而是一套可重現的狀態：致動器校正曲線、影響矩陣、查表、指向模型、影像分析儀零點與影像品質驗收數據。驗收以全系統指標進行：在量測視寧度下的星像 FWHM 與 80% 能量集中直徑、主動光學從大誤差起始的收斂時間、指向與追蹤殘差，以及儀器更換（Nasmyth 兩側）後的重現性。NTT 之後持續承接 EFOSC2、SOXS 等儀器，每次換裝都要重做這組驗證。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「調試紀錄與驗收影像品質」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A classical primary with diameter-to-thickness ratio of about 6 to 8 holds its figure by stiffness alone, but mass and thermal inertia grow rapidly with size. The NTT instead uses a Zerodur meniscus 3.58 m across and only 24 cm thick, about 6 t, whose self-weight bending and thermal-gradient errors are no longer resisted by stiffness but corrected by active forces in the support system under measurement feedback. This shifts the telescope from being built stiff enough to being measured accurately and corrected quickly, the central change of active optics, and it made the 17.5 cm meniscus of the later 8 m VLT possible. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “3.58 m Zerodur meniscus”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The NTT is an alt-azimuth Ritchey–Chrétien telescope with an f/2.2 primary and f/11 Nasmyth foci, with an instrument on each Nasmyth platform. Ground-based images are dominated by atmospheric seeing, so the aim of active optics is not the diffraction limit but to keep the telescope's own aberrations, tracking and local seeing far below the atmospheric term. Active correction targets slowly varying low-order aberrations from gravity, temperature and manufacturing residuals, so the correction cycle is tens of seconds to minutes; fast atmospheric turbulence is left to later adaptive optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ritchey–Chrétien train and Nasmyth foci”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The NTT primary is cast in Zerodur glass ceramic by Schott, with near-zero thermal expansion, and after figuring it rests on 75 axial supports plus a set of lateral supports. Each axial support is an astatic lever with a movable counterweight that passively carries most of the attitude-dependent load, while an electric actuator superimposes a small correction force; three fixed points define the mirror position. The spatial pattern of the correction forces determines which bending modes can be generated: low-order modes such as astigmatism, trefoil and quadrafoil need only tens of newtons, while higher modes demand rapidly growing forces and introduce support print-through. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “75 active axial supports”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The NTT enclosure is an octagonal building about 18 m high and 17 m across that rotates with the telescope; its walls sit close to the telescope to limit internal heat sources and trapped air, and side louvres with a windscreen let the night wind flush the primary in a controlled way, carrying off the temperature difference between mirror and air. A mirror warmer than the air drives convection and refractive-index turbulence in the boundary layer, the so-called mirror seeing, whose effect can exceed the optical errors; cooling the mirror cell by day to the expected night temperature and ventilating at night is therefore part of the image-quality budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Octagonal rotating enclosure and ventilation louvres”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The NTT image analyser picks a reference star outside the science field, divides the exit pupil into sub-apertures with a lenslet array and forms one spot per sub-aperture on a CCD; each spot's displacement from its reference position is proportional to the local wavefront slope. After least-squares fitting the slopes to Zernike or mirror elastic modes, defocus is assigned to the axial motion of the secondary, coma to its lateral motion or tilt, and astigmatism, trefoil and spherical to primary-support force corrections. The integration of tens of seconds averages atmospheric turbulence, so the reference star brightness and the integration time together set the wavefront accuracy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann image analyser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The NTT points to about 1.5″ RMS using a pointing model with tens of geometric and flexure terms, while tracking jitter, wind load and bearing friction are suppressed by autoguider feedback. The image-quality budget converts optical residual, tracking jitter, mirror seeing and dome seeing into equivalent FWHM contributions, combines them root-sum-square into a telescope term and then combines that with atmospheric seeing in 5/3 power; every item needs a measurement method and an allowance so that a degraded image can be traced quickly to the responsible term. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Image-quality budget and pointing model”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Active-optics control has two layers: an open-loop table indexed by zenith distance and temperature presets the support forces and secondary position, and a closed loop measures the residual aberration with the image analyser every few tens of seconds and corrects it with low gain. The closed-loop measurement is contaminated by atmospheric low-order aberrations whose correlation time is roughly the aperture divided by wind speed, so longer integrations average the atmosphere more cleanly, while the gain trades convergence speed against noise amplification. In its 1997 overhaul the NTT control system was rebuilt on the VLT architecture and became its prototype. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active-optics control loop and lookup tables”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

At handoff the engineer delivers not an assembled machine but a reproducible state: actuator calibration curves, the influence matrix, lookup tables, the pointing model, image-analyser zero points and the image-quality acceptance data. Acceptance uses whole-system metrics: stellar FWHM and 80% encircled-energy diameter at the measured seeing, the convergence time of active optics from a large initial error, pointing and tracking residuals, and repeatability after instrument changes between the two Nasmyth sides. The NTT went on to host instruments such as EFOSC2 and SOXS, and each installation repeats this verification set. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Commissioning log and accepted image quality”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把薄鏡當成剛性鏡安裝、支撐力只按靜態平均分配時，鏡面隨天頂距變化會出現數微米的像散，星像變成橢圓並隨指向方向轉動，任何固定的光學校準都無法消除。
參考星附近有伴星或分析儀出瞳對不準微透鏡陣列時，部分子孔徑的光點質心偏移，擬合出假的三葉像差並送到主鏡支撐，星像被修出三角形；只看殘差 RMS 不看光點品質的流程不會發現。
pitfallsEn: Mounting the thin mirror as if it were rigid, with support forces set only to the static average, produces micrometres of astigmatism that change with zenith distance; star images become elliptical and rotate with pointing direction, and no fixed optical alignment can remove it.

A companion star near the reference or a pupil misregistered on the lenslet array shifts the centroids of some sub-apertures, the fit produces false trefoil that is sent to the primary supports and star images are corrected into triangles; a procedure that watches only the residual RMS and not spot quality never notices.
