guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：瀨戶大橋橋群
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Seto Ohashi bridge network
guides.concept: 瀨戶大橋是連接本州岡山與四國香川的六座橋梁，海峽段約 9.4 km，全部為上層公路、下層鐵路的雙層結構，1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車。本課從如何沿海峽配置三座懸索橋、兩座斜張橋與一座桁架橋出發，說明南北備讚瀨戶大橋的三跨連續構造與索股交叉的共用錨碇、11 座設置沉箱與預壘骨材水中混凝土、起重船牽引導索與工廠全尺寸預組，最後談鍍鋅鋼絲防蝕、乾燥空氣與公路鐵路並存下的維護。
guides.conceptEn: Seto Ohashi is a group of six bridges linking Okayama on Honshu with Kagawa on Shikoku across about 9.4 km of sea, all double-deck with road above and rail below, opened together on 10 April 1988. The course starts from how three suspension bridges, two cable-stayed bridges and a truss bridge were arranged along the strait, explains the three-span continuous Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto bridges and their shared anchorage where strands cross, eleven placed caissons with prepacked underwater concrete, crane-ship pilot ropes and full factory trial assembly, and ends with galvanised-wire protection, dry air and maintenance with road and rail side by side.
procedure: 瀨戶大橋並非單一橋梁，而是一條跨越塩飽諸島的鏈：下津井瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，中央跨 940 m）、櫃石島橋與岩黑島橋（斜張橋，各 420 m）、與島橋（桁架橋，最大跨 245 m）、北備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，990 m）與南備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，1,100 m）。主要航道與深水處用懸索橋大跨越過，島嶼之間較淺且船舶較小的水道用斜張橋與桁架橋，讓每一段的跨徑與基礎數量都配合水深、航道與島嶼位置。海中基礎是最昂貴、最受潮流與天候限制的工作，因此減少海中基礎數量是配置的核心考量。
業主將北、南備讚瀨戶大橋描述為三跨連續加勁桁架懸索橋。一般公路懸索橋常在橋塔處把加勁梁分開以鉸接或伸縮縫連接，鐵路卻難以接受橋塔處的折角：列車通過時主跨下垂、邊跨上揚，兩側梁端轉角相加，形成軌道的突然轉折。把加勁桁在塔處做成連續，能大幅減少這個折角，代價是塔處的彎矩與支承反力增加，以及溫度與活載下更複雜的縱向位移。這是瀨戶大橋作為公路鐵路兩用懸索橋的關鍵選擇之一。

北、南備讚瀨戶大橋相鄰而建，兩橋之間共用一座錨碇，兩側主纜的索股在錨碇內交叉錨定：北備讚為 234 股、南備讚為 271 股，業主稱這種構造為世界首例。每股由 127 根直徑約 5 mm 的平行鋼絲排成六角形，不扭絞。南備讚瀨戶大橋的主纜最大，直徑 107 cm，承受約 45,000 t 的張力。共用錨碇節省了一座巨大的重力式構造，但必須同時承受兩橋方向相反的主纜力，並在兩橋荷重不平衡時保持穩定。

瀨戶大橋的海中基礎採用設置沉箱工法：在完成整平的岩盤上放置巨大的箱形鋼製模板，再在內部填充水中混凝土，共製作 11 座。以其中一例而言，沉箱寬 59 m、長 75 m、高 55 m、重約 18,000 t，在造船廠船塢製作近 2 年，與現場作業平行進行以縮短工期。沉箱內的水中混凝土採用預壘骨材工法：先在海水中投放 80 至 150 mm 的大粒徑骨材，再從注入管壓入砂漿，把骨材間的海水擠出；砂漿船「世紀」每日最多可製造 5,800 m³ 砂漿，一旦開始注入就必須三晝夜連續作業。
過去的懸索橋把第一條導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過海峽，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋航道繁忙，因此改以起重船把導索吊在高處跨越。導索就位後，約 10 條較粗的鋼索架在其上，鋪上鋼絲網與雙層纖維網，形成寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m 的貓道，貓道之間以橫向便橋連接。索股在架設前 4 年以上就開始製造，每股捲在重近 40 t 的捲盤上，以貨運列車陸運，再以牽引索在兩座錨碇間拉送。

業主記載加勁桁在工廠先做全尺寸立體預組以確認精度，再塗裝並依現場進度出貨。南備讚瀨戶大橋把每座塔附近四個格間約 1,500 t 在工廠組成大塊，由起重船一次吊放，提早騰出橋上空間給後續的架設設備；之後以兩個格間為一組，以船運到塔邊吊起、用台車往前送，再由前端吊機安裝，反覆循環。隨著架設推進主纜形狀大幅變化，需要測量並平衡兩側進度。架設約一年後兩側在跨中會合，最後一段合龍前以塔邊的千斤頂把桁架往塔方向拉，擴大合龍間隙，嵌入後再放鬆。
懸索橋加勁桁由數百個構件與接頭組成，每個接頭的小誤差在長跨中累積，最後決定合龍處能否對上、吊索位置是否與索夾一致，以及鐵路軌道是否平順。工廠全尺寸立體預組讓誤差在地面上就被發現並修正，而不是到了海上高空才發現孔位不合。誤差分為隨機誤差與系統誤差：隨機誤差會部分互相抵消，系統誤差（例如量尺溫度未修正、模具偏差）則每一節都朝同一方向累積，是預組最需要抓出來的對象。
業主記載沉箱出塢後以 12 艘拖船慢速拖到橋位，一旦開始拖航就不能中途停下，因此只在氣象與海象資料顯示至少 4 天穩定時才出發。沉放時先在海底預埋重約 900 t 的錨，沉箱上的絞車以鋼索連到錨上抵抗潮流，一邊注水下沉一邊調整位置，最後由大型起重船扶持控制姿態軟著陸。容許的設置誤差為 50 cm，業主指出所有沉箱都在此範圍內完成。
業主說明，因島、大鳴門、大島與瀨戶大橋等較早的懸索橋，主纜採用鍍鋅鋼絲加防鏽劑與纏絲包覆；後來檢查舊有懸索橋時，拆開纏絲發現鋼絲已有鏽蝕，於是開發把乾燥空氣送入主纜的系統，並裝設在本州四國連絡橋的所有懸索橋。鍍鋅層是犧牲性的：只要纜內潮濕，鋅就逐年消耗，耗盡後鋼絲本體才開始生鏽。乾燥空氣不是取代鍍鋅，而是把鋅的消耗速度降到幾乎為零，讓既有的保護層長期有效。
本州四國連絡橋共約 400 萬 m² 的塗裝面積，業主預估塗裝將佔未來維護費用約一半，因此延長重塗週期是生命週期成本的主要策略；瀨戶大橋使用了抗紫外線的塗料，並以在固定點定期量測塗膜厚度決定重塗時機。加勁桁上設有供檢修車行駛的軌道，維護人員可沿桁架移動檢查。瀨戶大橋上層是高速公路、下層是鐵路，任何檢查或修繕都要同時協調道路交通管制與鐵路的夜間作業時段，近年業主仍持續進行夜間的打音檢查。
procedureEn: Seto Ohashi is not one bridge but a chain across the Shiwaku Islands: Shimotsui-Seto (suspension, 940 m centre span), the Hitsuishijima and Iwakurojima bridges (cable-stayed, 420 m each), Yoshima (truss, 245 m maximum span), Kita Bisan-Seto (suspension, 990 m) and Minami Bisan-Seto (suspension, 1,100 m). Main channels and deep water are crossed by long suspension spans, while shallower inter-island waters with smaller ships use cable-stayed and truss bridges, so each segment's span and foundation count fit water depth, navigation and island positions. Marine foundations are the most expensive work and the most constrained by currents and weather, so reducing their number is central to the layout.

The owner describes Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto as three-span continuous truss-stiffened suspension bridges. Road suspension bridges often separate the stiffening girder at the towers with hinges or expansion joints, but rail cannot easily accept an angle break there: as a train crosses, the main span sags and the side span rises, and the two girder-end rotations add up to a sudden kink in the track. Making the stiffening truss continuous over the towers greatly reduces this kink, at the price of larger bending moments and bearing reactions at the towers and more complex longitudinal movement under temperature and live load. This was one of the key choices that made Seto Ohashi a road–rail suspension bridge.

Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto stand side by side and share one anchorage between them, where the strands of both cables cross and are anchored: 234 strands for Kita Bisan-Seto and 271 for Minami Bisan-Seto, a structure the owner calls a world first. Each strand is 127 parallel wires of about 5 mm laid in a hexagon, not twisted. Minami Bisan-Seto's cable is the largest, 107 cm in diameter and carrying about 45,000 t of tension. The shared anchorage saved one huge gravity structure, but it must resist cable forces from both bridges in opposite directions and stay stable when their loads are unbalanced.

Seto Ohashi's marine foundations used the placed-caisson method: a huge box-shaped steel form is set on a levelled rock surface and filled with underwater concrete, eleven in all. One example caisson is 59 m wide, 75 m long and 55 m high, weighs about 18,000 t and took nearly two years to build in a shipyard dock, in parallel with site work to shorten the schedule. The underwater concrete inside used the prepacked-aggregate method: 80 to 150 mm aggregate is first placed in the seawater, then mortar is pumped in through injection pipes to displace the water between stones; the mortar plant ship Seiki could produce up to 5,800 m³ a day, and once injection started it ran continuously for three days and nights.

Earlier suspension bridges floated the first pilot rope on buoys and towed it across by boat, which meant closing the channel; Seto Ohashi's channels were too busy, so a crane ship held the pilot rope high as it crossed. With the pilot rope in place, about ten heavier ropes were laid on it and covered with wire mesh and a double fibre net to form a catwalk 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails, linked by cross-bridges. Strand fabrication began more than four years before erection; each strand was wound on a reel weighing nearly 40 t, carried overland by freight train and hauled between the anchorages by a traction rope.

The owner records that the stiffening truss was fully trial-assembled in three dimensions at the factory to confirm accuracy before painting and shipping to suit the site schedule. At Minami Bisan-Seto the four panels near each tower, about 1,500 t, were assembled into a large block and set by a crane ship in one lift, clearing the deck early for the following erection equipment; after that two-panel units were shipped to the tower, lifted, moved forward on carriages and placed by a crane at the leading end, in a repeating cycle. The cable shape changed greatly as erection advanced, requiring surveys and balanced progress on both sides. After about a year the two fronts met at mid-span; before the closure panel went in, jacks at the towers pulled the truss toward the towers to widen the gap, then were released.

A suspension stiffening truss is made of hundreds of members and joints, and small errors at each joint accumulate along a long span, deciding whether the closure fits, whether hanger positions match the cable bands and whether the rail track is smooth. Full three-dimensional trial assembly in the factory finds and fixes errors on the ground rather than discovering mismatched holes high above the sea. Errors are random or systematic: random errors partly cancel, while systematic ones, such as an uncorrected tape temperature or a jig offset, accumulate in the same direction at every panel and are what trial assembly most needs to catch.

The owner records that after leaving the dock each caisson was towed slowly to site by 12 tugs; once towing began it could not stop, so departure waited for weather and sea data showing at least four stable days. For sinking, an anchor of about 900 t was pre-placed on the seabed and winches on the caisson pulled on wires to it against the tide, adjusting position as water was admitted, with a large crane vessel finally holding the caisson to control its attitude for a soft landing. The allowable placement error was 50 cm, and the owner states every caisson was placed within it.

The owner explains that earlier suspension bridges such as Innoshima, Ohnaruto, Ohshima and Seto Ohashi used galvanised wire with a rust inhibitor and wrapping; later inspections of existing suspension bridges found rust on wires once the wrapping was removed, so a system blowing dry air into the main cables was developed and installed on all the Honshu-Shikoku suspension bridges. Galvanising is sacrificial: while the cable interior is damp, zinc is consumed year by year, and only when it is gone does the steel itself rust. Dry air does not replace galvanising; it cuts zinc consumption to nearly zero so the existing protection stays effective for the long term.

The Honshu-Shikoku bridges have about 4 million m² of painted surface, and the owner expects painting to make up about half of future maintenance cost, so extending the repainting cycle is the main life-cycle cost strategy; Seto Ohashi used a UV-resistant paint, and repainting is timed by periodically measuring film thickness at fixed points. Rails on the stiffening truss carry maintenance vehicles so crews can travel along it. With an expressway above and a railway below, every inspection or repair must coordinate road traffic management with night-time railway work windows, and the owner continues night-time hammer-sounding inspections.
evidence: 大型跨海工程的配置報告應以表格比較各段的水深、航道、基礎數與橋型方案，並保存被淘汰方案的理由；日後若有新增航道需求或維修策略變更，可回到此基準評估影響。
公路鐵路兩用橋應由橋梁與鐵路單位共同制定軌道折角、伸縮量與支承反力的設計表，並在竣工後建立塔處與梁端的長期位移與轉角監測，作為維護與限速決策的依據。
共用錨碇的設計基準應列出所有不平衡荷重組合與容許偏心，並在錨碇內保留足夠的檢查通道與照明，讓每一個索股錨頭都能定期目視與量測。
預壘骨材工法應訂定骨材清洗與投放後的最長等待時間、注入管間距、連續作業的備援（第二套泵與發電機）與中斷處理程序，並以鑽心結果作為驗收停留點。
貓道與牽引設備屬於臨時結構，必須有獨立的設計計算、風速停工準則與每日檢查表，並由臨時工程設計者與施工主管共同簽認；導索跨越作業須取得海事主管機關的許可與航行警告。
evidenceEn: The layout report for a major sea crossing should tabulate water depth, channel, foundation count and type options for each segment and keep the reasons for rejected options, so later new channel demands or maintenance strategy changes can be assessed against that baseline.

For road–rail bridges the bridge and railway parties should jointly fix design tables for track kink, expansion and bearing reaction, and after completion set up long-term movement and rotation monitoring at towers and girder ends as the basis for maintenance and speed decisions.

The design basis for a shared anchorage should list every unbalanced load combination and the allowable eccentricity, and the anchorage must keep enough inspection access and lighting so every strand socket can be seen and measured periodically.

The prepacked method needs limits on aggregate washing and the maximum wait after placement, injection-pipe spacing, back-up for continuous work (spare pumps and generators) and a procedure for interruptions, with core results as the acceptance hold point.

Catwalks and hauling gear are temporary structures needing their own design calculations, stop-work wind speeds and daily checklists, signed by the temporary-works designer and the site manager; the pilot-rope crossing requires marine-authority approval and a navigation warning.
pitfalls: 若為追求單一橋型而在淺水區也使用大跨懸索橋，錨碇與塔的成本會不成比例；反之在主航道使用短跨，海中基礎增加，不僅工期與潮流風險上升，也增加船舶撞擊機率。
若只檢核兩橋對稱受力，單側滿載時錨碇的合力偏心可能使基底一側壓力過大或另一側脫開；索股交叉區排列錯誤則造成錨頭擁擠、受力不均，日後也難以檢查與更換。
導索若在跨越時下垂到航道淨空以下，可能與船舶勾掛；貓道網片或橫向便橋固定不良，強風中晃動劇烈，危及作業人員並損傷已架設索股；捲盤運輸或展開時刮傷鋼絲鍍鋅層，日後成為腐蝕起點。
若省略預組或只做局部預組，系統誤差到現場才浮現，可能必須在海上擴孔、加墊板或重新製造構件，延誤工期並在接頭留下疲勞弱點；鐵路軌道也可能因累積線形誤差而需要大量調整。
若以為鍍鋅加纏絲就足以長期保護，水分可能在主纜低點與索夾下累積多年，鋅層耗盡後鋼絲開始點蝕甚至斷絲；送氣系統若只照顧容易到達的區段，遠端與高處可能仍維持潮濕。
pitfallsEn: Using long suspension spans even in shallow water for the sake of a single type makes anchorages and towers disproportionately costly; short spans in the main channel multiply marine foundations, raising schedule and tidal risk as well as ship-collision probability.

Checking only symmetric loading can miss the eccentric resultant when one bridge is loaded, overstressing one side of the base or lifting the other; misarranged strands in the crossing zone crowd sockets, share load unevenly and are hard to inspect or replace later.

A pilot rope sagging below the clearance during the crossing can snag a ship; poorly fixed catwalk mesh or cross-bridges swing violently in strong wind, endangering workers and damaging strands already erected; scratching galvanising during reel transport or unwinding creates future corrosion sites.

Skipping or limiting trial assembly lets systematic errors surface on site, forcing hole reaming, shims or refabrication at sea, delaying the work and leaving fatigue weak spots at joints; accumulated profile error may also require extensive rail-track adjustment.

Assuming galvanising and wrapping are enough lets water collect for years at low points and under bands, until zinc runs out and wires pit or break; a dry-air system that serves only easily reached sections can leave remote and high zones damp.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.concept: 從工法選擇、裸纜幾何、鋼絲與索鞍細部，到導索貓道、擠壓纏絲、量測允收與開纜檢查的主纜架設全流程。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: The whole main-cable process: method choice, bare-cable geometry, wire and saddle details, pilot rope and catwalk, compaction and wrapping, survey and acceptance, and internal inspection. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: 預製平行鋼絲索股常見每股 127 根鋼絲，明石海峽、瀨戶大橋與 1915 恰納卡萊大橋皆採用
金門大橋每纜 27,572 根 0.192 in 鋼絲、61 束，紡線歷時 6 個月又 9 天
大貝爾特東橋每纜 18,648 根 5.38 mm 鋼絲，在錨碇分成 37 束

瀨戶大橋索股捲盤重近 40 t，以貨運列車運輸；貓道寬 4.5 m
日本約半世紀使用 1,570 MPa 級鋼絲，1,770 MPa 級首用於明石海峽大橋，1,960 MPa 級用於 1915 恰納卡萊大橋
長大橋鋼絲鍍鋅量一般在 300 g/m² 以上

factsEn: Prefabricated parallel-wire strands commonly hold 127 wires, as on Akashi Kaikyo, Seto Ohashi and the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge
Golden Gate has 27,572 wires of 0.192 in in 61 strands per cable, spun in six months and nine days
The Great Belt East Bridge has 18,648 wires of 5.38 mm per cable, split into 37 bundles at the anchorages
Akashi Kaikyo has 290 strands of 127 wires of 5.23 mm per cable
Seto Ohashi strand reels weighed nearly 40 t and travelled by freight train; catwalks were 4.5 m wide

Long-span bridge wire usually carries 300 g/m² or more of zinc
FHWA suggests a baseline internal inspection at about 30 years, shortened to five-year intervals when Stage 4 wires exceed 10%

timelineEn: 1883 — The Brooklyn Bridge opens, the first to spin its cables from galvanised steel wire
1937 — The Golden Gate Bridge opens; its aerial spinning took six months and nine days

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。

Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：懸索橋主纜架設
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Suspension-bridge main-cable erection
guides.concept: 主纜是懸索橋唯一幾乎無法更換的主構件，它的品質在架設時就已決定。本課比較空中紡線（金門大橋、大貝爾特東橋）與預製平行鋼絲索股（明石海峽大橋、瀨戶大橋、1915 恰納卡萊大橋）兩種工法，計算裸纜懸鏈線、索鞍彎曲應力、貓道張力與擠壓後直徑，說明鋼絲等級與鍍層、索股量測與統計允收，並依美國聯邦公路總署的指引談開纜檢查、腐蝕分級與剩餘強度評估。
guides.conceptEn: The main cable is the one primary member of a suspension bridge that can almost never be replaced, and its quality is fixed during erection. This course compares aerial spinning (Golden Gate, Great Belt East) with prefabricated parallel-wire strands (Akashi Kaikyo, Seto Ohashi, 1915 Çanakkale), computes bare-cable catenaries, saddle bending stress, catwalk tension and compacted diameter, explains wire grades and coatings, strand survey and statistical acceptance, and, following US Federal Highway Administration guidance, covers cable openings, corrosion staging and remaining-strength evaluation.
procedure: 空中紡線法讓紡線輪沿貓道上方往返，每趟帶著鋼絲環從一座錨碇走到另一座，在現場把數百根鋼絲累積成一束：金門大橋每纜 61 束、平均每束約 452 根；大貝爾特東橋每纜 18,648 根鋼絲分成 37 束。預製平行鋼絲索股（PWS）則在工廠把鋼絲排成六角形索股並預裝錨頭，再整股牽引過海峽：明石海峽大橋每纜 290 股、瀨戶大橋與 1915 恰納卡萊大橋每股都是 127 根。空中紡線運輸輕便、錨固點少，但現場時間長且受風影響；PWS 現場快、品質在工廠控制，但索股重、錨頭多，需要大型捲盤與牽引設備。
主纜在橋面掛上之前只承受自重，自重沿纜長均勻分布，形狀是懸鏈線；掛上沿水平均勻分布的橋面後，形狀才接近拋物線。設計者先決定完工狀態的線形，再以逆向分析扣除橋面荷重與彈性伸長，求出主纜在無應力狀態下的長度，以及裸纜階段各跨應有的垂度與索鞍位置。架設時第一根基準索股或基準鋼絲就是按這個裸纜幾何設定，之後所有鋼絲都以它為準，因此裸纜計算的誤差會一路傳到完工線形。

主纜鋼絲是經鉛浴或替代熱處理、冷拉成形的高碳鋼絲，再熱浸鍍鋅。日本製鐵的技術報告指出，日本約半世紀使用 1,570 MPa 級鋼絲，1,770 MPa 級 5 mm 鋼絲首次用於明石海峽大橋，近年已試製 1,960 MPa 級；長大橋鋼絲的鍍鋅量一般在 300 g/m² 以上，近年也採用鋅鋁合金鍍層。強度越高，所需鋼絲越少、自重越輕，但對缺口、氫脆與彎曲越敏感，扭轉與伸長率等延性指標必須同時控制。鍍層是犧牲性防蝕，架設時的刮傷會成為日後腐蝕的起點。
主纜在塔頂索鞍處改變方向，在錨碇前的分束鞍處散開成一束束，再以索靴（空中紡線）或錨頭（預製索股）連接到錨碇拉桿。鋼絲繞過彎曲面時，除了軸向應力外還有與曲率成正比的彎曲應力，並在接觸面上承受側壓與摩擦；索鞍槽的半徑、隔板與填充材決定這些附加應力的大小，也決定主纜在索鞍內是否會滑動。分束處的鋼絲排列若與錨固點對不上，部分鋼絲會被拉長、部分鬆弛。

主纜架設的第一步是把一條細導索跨過兩座塔：早期做法是讓導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋改以起重船把導索吊高跨越，本州四國連絡橋在潮流強、船多的海域也以直升機牽引導索。導索就位後依序拉上較粗的鋼索，架成貓道：瀨戶大橋的貓道由約 10 條鋼索承托，鋪鋼絲網與雙層纖維網，寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m，並以橫向便橋連接。貓道本身就是一座臨時懸索橋，其線形必須與主纜平行，並能承受作業荷重與強風。

所有鋼絲架好後，主纜還是由許多六角形或圓形的束鬆散組成，需要以液壓擠壓機沿全長逐段把它壓成接近圓形的緊密斷面，並暫時以鋼帶綁住。擠壓品質決定空隙率：空隙太大，水分容易進入並滯留在纜內；擠壓不均則讓索夾無法均勻夾緊。之後安裝索夾（兩個半圓柱以螺栓夾緊，坡度越陡需要越多螺栓），掛上吊索，最後以纏絲機把鍍鋅軟鋼線（美國常用 No. 9 線）緊密纏繞在主纜外，並塗上防蝕膏與塗料，或改用彈性體包覆配合乾燥空氣。
主纜每一股（或每一束）都要與基準索股的垂度一致，量測分兩層：基準索股以全站儀或精密水準做絕對量測，其餘索股則以安裝在跨中與邊跨的量規或雷射，量測與基準索股的相對高差。絕對量測的誤差主要來自儀器角度精度、距離、大氣折射與目標偏心；相對量測較不受大氣影響，但量規本身的定位與讀值方法必須統一。量測結果要與溫度紀錄一起判讀，並在調整後重新量測確認。
主纜由數萬根鋼絲組成，設計使用的是規格的最低強度或特徵值，而不是平均值；鋼絲強度呈統計分布，同一批次內也有差異。因此允收不能只看平均值，必須估計低分位值是否高於規格，並同時檢查伸長率、扭轉次數等延性指標與鍍層。製造過程任一環節（線材成分、熱處理、拉拔、鍍鋅）改變，都可能讓分布偏移，所以批次劃分與追溯同樣重要。

主纜外表的纏絲與塗裝看不出內部狀況，唯一直接的方法是拆開包覆、以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查。美國聯邦公路總署的入門手冊建議首次內部檢查每條主纜至少三處，每處在周圍四個位置打入楔子；若腐蝕超過第 2 級，開口擴大到整個格間並使用八條楔線。腐蝕分為四級：第 1 級鋼絲表面有白點，第 2 級整個表面白色鋅氧化，第 3 級部分出現褐色鏽點，第 4 級褐色鏽點覆蓋 3 至 6 in 長度內超過 30% 的表面。實驗顯示約 60% 的第 4 級鋼絲可能含有裂紋。

主纜剩餘強度評估把開纜觀察、鋼絲試驗與統計模型結合起來。美國的 NCHRP 534 號報告提出三種模型：裂紋鋼絲不超過總數約 10% 時可用簡化模型，它在多數情況下低估強度，適合找出最不利格間；超過時改用脆性鋼絲模型；鋼絲強度變異異常時用有限延性模型。聯邦公路總署建議在發現第 3 級以上腐蝕時裝設聲學監測，在下次開纜前持續 12 至 18 個月；當第 4 級鋼絲超過 10% 或格間內出現斷絲時，強烈建議以聲學監測偵測斷絲。這些資料都必須在交接時從施工記錄開始累積。
procedureEn: Aerial spinning runs spinning wheels back and forth above the catwalk, each trip carrying a loop of wire from one anchorage to the other, building bundles of several hundred wires on site: Golden Gate has 61 strands per cable averaging about 452 wires, and the Great Belt East Bridge splits 18,648 wires per cable into 37 bundles. Prefabricated parallel-wire strands (PWS) are laid up in the factory into hexagonal strands with sockets already fitted, then hauled across whole: Akashi Kaikyo has 290 strands per cable, and Seto Ohashi and the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge both use 127 wires per strand. Aerial spinning needs only light transport and few anchorage points but long, wind-sensitive site work; PWS is fast on site with factory-controlled quality but has heavy strands and many sockets, needing large reels and hauling gear.

Before the deck is hung, the main cable carries only its own weight, distributed evenly along its length, so its shape is a catenary; once a deck load distributed evenly along the horizontal is added, the shape approaches a parabola. Designers fix the completed profile first, then back-analyse by removing deck load and elastic stretch to find the unstressed cable length and the bare-cable sag and saddle positions for each span. The first reference strand or reference wire is set to this bare-cable geometry and every later wire follows it, so errors in the bare-cable calculation pass straight into the final profile.

Cable wire is high-carbon steel, heat-treated by lead patenting or an alternative, cold-drawn and hot-dip galvanised. A Nippon Steel technical report notes that Japan used 1,570 MPa wire for about half a century, that 1,770 MPa 5 mm wire was first used on the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, and that 1,960 MPa wire has since been trial-produced; long-span bridge wire usually carries 300 g/m² or more of zinc, with zinc–aluminium coatings used in recent years. Higher strength means fewer wires and less self-weight but more sensitivity to notches, hydrogen embrittlement and bending, so ductility indicators such as torsion and elongation must be controlled too. The coating is sacrificial, and scratches during erection become future corrosion sites.

The main cable changes direction at the tower-top saddles and fans out at splay saddles in front of the anchorages, where bundles connect to anchor rods through strand shoes (aerial spinning) or sockets (PWS). Where wires pass over a curved surface they carry bending stress proportional to curvature on top of axial stress, plus side pressure and friction at the contact; saddle groove radius, spacers and fillers set the size of these extra stresses and whether the cable slips in the saddle. If the wire arrangement at the splay does not match the anchorage points, some wires are stretched and others go slack.

The first step of cable erection is to get a thin pilot rope across the two towers: the old way floated it on buoys and towed it across by boat, closing the channel; Seto Ohashi held it high from a crane ship instead, and in Honshu-Shikoku waters with strong currents and heavy traffic it was also flown across by helicopter. Heavier ropes are then pulled across in turn to build the catwalk: Seto Ohashi's catwalks rested on about ten ropes with wire mesh and a double fibre net, 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails, linked by cross-bridges. A catwalk is itself a temporary suspension bridge whose profile must parallel the main cable and carry working loads and strong wind.

Once all wires are in place, the cable is still a loose group of hexagonal or round bundles, and hydraulic compactors work along its length to press it into a dense, nearly round section, temporarily banded with steel straps. Compaction sets the void ratio: too many voids let water enter and stay in the cable, and uneven compaction stops cable bands from clamping evenly. Cable bands are then installed, two half-cylinders bolted together, with more bolts on steeper slopes, the hangers are hung, and finally a wrapping machine winds soft galvanised wire (No. 9 wire in US practice) tightly around the cable over a corrosion-inhibiting paste and paint, or an elastomeric wrap is used with dry air.

Every strand or bundle must match the sag of the reference strand, and the survey works in two layers: the reference strand is measured absolutely by total station or precise levelling, while the others are measured relative to it with gauges or lasers mounted at mid-span and in the side spans. Absolute survey error comes mainly from instrument angular accuracy, distance, atmospheric refraction and target eccentricity; relative measurement is less affected by the atmosphere, but gauge positioning and reading method must be standardised. Results are interpreted with temperature records and re-measured after adjustment.

A main cable contains tens of thousands of wires, and design uses the specified minimum or characteristic strength rather than the mean; wire strength follows a statistical distribution and varies within a lot. Acceptance therefore cannot rely on the mean alone: the lower fractile must be shown to exceed the specification, while ductility indicators such as elongation and torsion turns and the coating are checked too. A change in any manufacturing step, whether rod chemistry, heat treatment, drawing or galvanising, can shift the distribution, so lot definition and traceability matter as much.

Wrapping and paint hide the inside of a cable, and the only direct method is to remove the covering and drive wedges to spread the wires. The US Federal Highway Administration primer recommends that a first internal inspection open at least three locations per cable, with wedges at four points around the circumference; if corrosion exceeds Stage 2, the opening extends to a full panel with eight wedge lines. Corrosion has four stages: Stage 1 white spots on the wire surface, Stage 2 white zinc oxide over the whole surface, Stage 3 some brown rust spots, and Stage 4 brown spots covering more than 30% of a 3 to 6 in length of wire. Laboratory tests showed that about 60% of Stage 4 wires may contain cracks.

Remaining-strength evaluation combines cable observations, wire tests and statistical models. US NCHRP Report 534 offers three: a simplified model when cracked wires are no more than about 10% of the total, which usually underestimates strength and is useful for finding the worst panel; a brittle-wire model beyond that; and a limited-ductility model when wire strength varies unusually. The Federal Highway Administration recommends acoustic monitoring once Stage 3 or worse corrosion is found, running 12 to 18 months before the next opening, and strongly recommends it for detecting wire breaks when Stage 4 wires exceed 10% or broken wires appear in a panel. All these data must accumulate from the construction records handed over at completion.
evidence: 工法比選應在基本設計階段完成，並把結果寫入錨碇、索鞍與貓道的設計條件；投標文件可允許替代工法，但必須要求承包商提出相應的錨固與幾何控制方案，並經設計者核可。
架設手冊應列出裸纜階段的目標垂度、索鞍預偏量、參考溫度與量測點位置，並附上兩套獨立計算的比對結果；基準索股定位是全工程最重要的停留點之一，須由設計者與監造共同見證。
鋼絲規格須同時訂定強度、延性與鍍層指標及抽樣頻率，並要求從線材爐號到成品捲號的完整追溯；牽引與擠壓設備的接觸面材料與狀態應列入每日檢查表。
索鞍、分束鞍與錨固細部應在設計圖中標明最小彎曲半徑、鋼絲排列圖與抗滑檢核，並把錨頭試驗、錨頭回縮量與錨固位置列為停留點；完工後保留可目視錨頭與索靴的檢查通道。
貓道屬於臨時結構，須有獨立設計計算、抗風穩定檢核、每日檢查表與撤離程序，並由臨時工程設計者簽認；牽引系統的最大拉力、制動與通訊要在試運轉中驗證後才可牽引第一股。
evidenceEn: Settle the method comparison at basic design and write the outcome into the design conditions for anchorages, saddles and catwalks; tender documents may allow alternatives, but the contractor must then submit matching anchorage and geometry-control proposals for the designer's approval.

The erection manual should list target bare-cable sags, saddle offsets, reference temperature and survey points, with the comparison of two independent calculations; setting the reference strand is one of the most important hold points of the whole job and must be witnessed jointly by the designer and the supervising engineer.

The wire specification must set strength, ductility and coating requirements with sampling frequencies and require full traceability from rod heat to finished coil; the material and condition of contact surfaces on hauling and compaction equipment belong on the daily checklist.

Drawings for saddles, splay saddles and anchorage details should show minimum bending radius, wire arrangement and slip checks, with socket tests, draw-in and anchorage positions as hold points; keep inspection access to see sockets and strand shoes after completion.

A catwalk is temporary works needing its own design calculations, wind-stability check, daily checklist and evacuation procedure signed by the temporary-works designer; the hauling system's maximum pull, braking and communications must be proven in a trial run before the first strand is hauled.
pitfalls: 在強風頻繁的海峽採用空中紡線而未預留停工天數，進度落後時容易壓縮垂度調整時間；採用 PWS 卻低估捲盤重量與運輸限制，可能必須縮短索股長度或增加接頭，影響錨固設計。
鍍鋅層在牽引或擠壓時被大面積刮除，日後在纜內潮濕環境中最先出現鏽點；超高強度鋼絲若延性不足，在索鞍或索夾附近的局部彎曲處可能脆斷，而且斷絲藏在纜內不易被發現。
導索在跨越時下垂進入航道淨空可能勾到船舶；貓道與主纜線形不平行，鋼絲在某些區段會摩擦網片或被迫偏折；強風中貓道過度擺動，曾在多座橋的施工中造成停工與設備損壞。
若基準索股量測含系統誤差，之後所有索股都會跟著錯，最後整條主纜垂度偏離設計；相對量規若在多股之後鬆動未被發現，造成一連串索股同向偏差，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲受力過大。
若只在容易到達的高處開纜，可能錯過積水最嚴重的低點；檢查後重新包覆不良，開口本身反而成為新的進水點；把第 4 級鋼絲當作完好鋼絲計算，會高估主纜強度。
pitfallsEn: Choosing aerial spinning over a windy strait without allowing for downtime tempts crews to cut sag adjustment when behind; choosing PWS while underestimating reel weight and transport limits may force shorter strands or extra splices that affect anchorage design.

Large areas of zinc scraped off during hauling or compaction are where rust first appears in a damp cable; ultra-high-strength wire with poor ductility can break brittly where it bends locally at saddles or bands, hidden inside the cable.

A pilot rope sagging into the navigation clearance can snag a ship; a catwalk not parallel to the cable makes wires rub the mesh or bend in places; excessive catwalk sway in strong wind has stopped work and damaged equipment on many bridge projects.

A systematic error in the reference-strand survey carries into every strand that follows, leaving the whole cable off design sag; a relative gauge that loosens unnoticed after several strands produces a run of strands offset the same way, overloading some wires once compacted.

Opening only where access is easy can miss the wettest low points; poor rewrapping after inspection turns the opening into a new water entry; counting Stage 4 wires as sound overstates cable strength.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：懸索橋主纜除濕系統
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Suspension-cable dehumidification systems
guides.concept: 主纜內部的水分會先消耗鍍鋅層、再腐蝕高強度鋼絲，而主纜幾乎無法更換。本課以本州四國連絡橋首創的主纜乾燥空氣送氣（管理目標相對濕度 40%）與大貝爾特東橋 2014 至 2015 年的除濕改造為主軸，說明腐蝕門檻與露點、送氣與排氣流路、彈性體包覆與索夾密封、除濕機與預冷、改造施工與啟動乾燥曲線、感測器判讀與開纜比對，最後以能耗與生命週期比較說明業主如何決策。
guides.conceptEn: Moisture inside a main cable first consumes the zinc and then corrodes high-strength wire, and the cable can almost never be replaced. Built around the Honshu-Shikoku bridges' pioneering dry-air cable injection (managed to 40% relative humidity) and the 2014–2015 dehumidification retrofit of the Great Belt East Bridge, this course explains corrosion thresholds and dew point, injection and exhaust flow paths, elastomeric wrapping and cable-band seals, dehumidifiers and pre-coolers, retrofit construction and the start-up dry-out curve, sensor interpretation and comparison with cable openings, and finally energy use and the life-cycle comparison behind an owner's decision.
procedure: 主纜由數萬根鋼絲平行排列，鋼絲之間約有兩成空隙。水分在紡線或牽引期間隨雨水進入，也會從纏絲裂縫、索夾邊緣與吊索附近滲入，並在主纜低點聚積。白天日照加熱、夜間輻射冷卻，主纜內部空氣反覆「呼吸」，帶入潮濕空氣；當鋼絲表面溫度低於空氣露點，水氣就凝結在鋼絲上。本州四國連絡橋拆開舊橋纏絲時發現鋼絲已經生鏽，大貝爾特東橋的業主也參考了福斯公路橋的腐蝕教訓，這些經驗說明外部塗裝無法保證內部乾燥。
主纜除濕系統由除濕機組、風機、送氣管、送氣套筒、氣密包覆、排氣套筒與感測器組成。乾燥空氣從送氣套筒進入主纜，沿鋼絲間的空隙向兩側流動，一路吸收水分，再從一定距離外的排氣套筒排出。主纜空隙像多孔介質，流量與壓差成正比、與流動距離成反比，因此送氣與排氣的間距、送氣壓力與包覆所能承受的壓力，三者必須一起設計。大貝爾特東橋的業主說明，包覆與索夾周圍的密封就是為了讓空氣能在進氣與排氣套筒之間流動。
傳統的鍍鋅軟鋼纏絲加防蝕膏與塗裝並不氣密，乾燥空氣會從纏絲縫隙大量逸出。除濕系統因此改用強化彈性體帶材包覆，以重疊纏繞並加熱熔合成連續的氣密外殼；大貝爾特東橋即以 Cableguard 強化彈性體包覆主纜，並在索夾周圍密封。系統的弱點通常不在包覆本身，而在不連續處：索夾兩端、吊索穿出處、送排氣套筒與檢查開口。這些位置要用專用的密封件與填充材，並能承受溫度循環與主纜的微小變形。
主纜除濕常用吸附式除濕機：空氣通過含吸濕劑的轉輪，水氣被吸附，轉輪另一側以加熱空氣再生，把水分排到外面。吸附式在低溫下仍能產生很低露點的空氣，適合送入主纜。本州四國連絡橋在夏季高濕時加裝預冷設備，先以冷卻盤管把外氣降溫凝結出一部分水，再送入除濕機，減輕轉輪負荷。機組容量必須依最不利季節的外氣條件、總送氣量與目標送氣濕度決定，並保留備援。
大貝爾特東橋的主纜除濕系統於 2014 年開始安裝、2015 年 9 月完成，是在橋梁持續通車下進行的改造。典型流程是：清理既有纏絲與塗裝表面、修補局部損傷，在索夾兩端與吊索處安裝密封件，在選定位置安裝送氣與排氣套筒，然後以彈性體帶材沿主纜纏繞並熱熔，最後連接送氣管、機組與感測器。作業沿主纜在臨時平台或纜上移動式設備上進行，進度受風、雨與溫度限制，因為熔合需要乾燥表面與足夠溫度。
系統啟動時，主纜內可能有多年累積的水分，排氣口的相對濕度一開始接近飽和，隨著殘留水分被帶走而逐漸下降，最後趨近由送氣濕度與持續滲入量決定的穩定值。下降曲線通常近似指數衰減，時間常數取決於殘留水量、送氣流量與水分從鋼絲間隙蒸發的速度。本州四國連絡橋以 40% RH 為管理目標，比會發生腐蝕的約 60% 留有餘裕；調試時就是看排氣濕度何時、能否穩定落在目標以下。
除濕系統的效果只能透過量測看見，感測器至少包括各送氣口與排氣口的溫度、相對濕度與流量，以及代表性位置的鋼絲表面溫度。電容式濕度感測器會隨時間漂移，在高濕或含鹽環境下更快，因此需要定期校正或以可攜式參考儀比對。判讀時不應只看相對濕度，而要把空氣露點與鋼絲溫度比較：相對濕度看似達標，若夜間鋼絲溫度接近露點，仍可能結露。

除濕的目的不是讀值好看，而是讓鋼絲不再腐蝕，因此最終驗證要回到鋼絲本身。ISO 9223 以相對濕度高於 80% 且溫度高於 0 °C 的累計時數定義濕潤時間，作為大氣腐蝕性的指標之一；把纜內監測資料換算成濕潤時間，可以量化除濕前後的腐蝕環境差異。美國聯邦公路總署的入門手冊指出，膜包覆與除濕在亞洲已廣泛使用、歐洲也有應用，並建議在發現第 3 級以上腐蝕時以聲學監測偵測斷絲；監測資料與下一次開纜檢查的腐蝕分級、斷絲數比對，才能確認系統真正有效。
除濕系統需要數十年連續運轉，能耗與設備維護是營運成本的主要部分。能耗來自兩處：推動空氣通過管路與主纜空隙的風機，以及加熱再生空氣使吸附轉輪恢復吸濕能力的加熱器，後者通常較大。維護項目包括過濾器更換、轉輪與密封檢查、風機軸承、預冷盤管清潔與凝結水排放、控制系統與感測器校正。本州四國連絡橋的經驗也顯示，系統需要依實際運轉持續改善，例如針對夏季高濕加裝預冷設備。

公開資料指出，大貝爾特東橋通車約 15 年時主纜尚未發現鏽蝕，原本規劃的是重新塗裝，業主最後選擇投入更高的初始費用安裝密封除濕系統。這個決策的關鍵在於：重新塗裝只能維持外層，無法處理已進入主纜內部或日後滲入的水分；而主纜一旦因腐蝕需要補強或限載，代價遠高於任何防蝕措施。本州四國連絡橋以 200 年以上的使用為目標、以預防保全降低生命週期成本，也是同一邏輯。決策時必須把不確定的未來劣化風險放進比較。
procedureEn: A main cable holds tens of thousands of parallel wires with about one-fifth of its section as voids. Water enters with rain during spinning or hauling and later seeps in through cracked wrapping, cable-band edges and around hangers, collecting at low points. Daytime sun heats the cable and night-time radiation cools it, so the air inside breathes in and out, drawing in humid air; when the wire surface falls below the air's dew point, vapour condenses on the wires. The Honshu-Shikoku authority found rust on wires when it removed the wrapping of older bridges, and the Great Belt owner drew on corrosion found on the Forth Road Bridge, showing that external paint cannot guarantee a dry interior.

A cable dehumidification system consists of dehumidifier units, fans, supply ducts, injection sleeves, an airtight wrap, exhaust sleeves and sensors. Dry air enters the cable at an injection sleeve, flows both ways through the voids between wires picking up moisture, and leaves at exhaust sleeves some distance away. The cable voids behave like a porous medium, with flow proportional to pressure difference and inversely proportional to flow distance, so sleeve spacing, supply pressure and the pressure the wrap can hold must be designed together. The Great Belt owner explains that the wrapping and the seals around the clamps exist precisely so that air can flow between the inlet and exhaust sleeves.

Traditional soft galvanised wrapping wire with paste and paint is not airtight, and dry air escapes in quantity through its gaps. Dehumidification systems therefore use reinforced elastomeric tape wound with overlaps and heat-fused into a continuous airtight skin; the Great Belt East Bridge was wrapped with Cableguard reinforced elastomer and sealed around its cable clamps. The weak points are usually not the wrap itself but the discontinuities: both ends of each band, hanger exits, injection and exhaust sleeves and inspection openings. These need dedicated seals and fillers that tolerate temperature cycles and small cable movements.

Cable systems commonly use desiccant dehumidifiers: air passes through a rotor carrying a desiccant that adsorbs vapour, while the other side of the rotor is regenerated with heated air that carries the moisture outside. Desiccant units deliver very low dew-point air even at low temperatures, which suits cable injection. The Honshu-Shikoku bridges added pre-coolers for humid summers: cooling coils lower outdoor air temperature and condense part of its water before it reaches the dehumidifier, easing the load on the rotor. Unit capacity must be set from outdoor air in the worst season, total supply flow and target supply humidity, with redundancy.

The Great Belt East Bridge cable dehumidification system was installed from 2014 and completed in September 2015 while the bridge stayed open. A typical sequence is to clean the existing wrapping and paint, repair local damage, fit seals at both ends of each band and at hanger exits, install injection and exhaust sleeves at chosen positions, wind and heat-fuse elastomeric tape along the cable, then connect ducts, units and sensors. Work proceeds along the cable from temporary platforms or travelling equipment, and progress is limited by wind, rain and temperature, because fusion needs a dry surface and enough warmth.

At start-up the cable may hold years of accumulated moisture, so exhaust relative humidity begins near saturation, falls as trapped water is carried away and finally approaches a steady value set by supply humidity and continuing ingress. The decline is usually close to exponential, with a time constant set by the amount of trapped water, supply flow and how fast water evaporates from the wire interstices. The Honshu-Shikoku bridges manage to 40% RH, a margin below the roughly 60% at which corrosion occurs; commissioning watches when, and whether, exhaust humidity settles below that target.

The effect of a dehumidification system can only be seen through measurement: at minimum temperature, relative humidity and flow at each injection and exhaust point, plus wire-surface temperature at representative locations. Capacitive humidity sensors drift with time, faster in humid or salty conditions, so they need periodic calibration or comparison with a portable reference. Interpretation should not rest on relative humidity alone but compare air dew point with wire temperature: humidity may look on target while night-time wire temperature approaches the dew point and condensation still occurs.

The aim of dehumidification is not good readings but wires that stop corroding, so final verification returns to the wires themselves. ISO 9223 defines time of wetness as accumulated hours with relative humidity above 80% and temperature above 0 °C, one indicator of atmospheric corrosivity; converting in-cable monitoring data into time of wetness quantifies the change in corrosive environment before and after dehumidification. The US Federal Highway Administration primer notes that membrane wrapping and dehumidification are widely used in Asia and also in Europe, and recommends acoustic monitoring for wire breaks once Stage 3 or worse corrosion is found; only comparing monitoring data with corrosion stages and broken-wire counts at the next cable opening confirms that the system works.

A dehumidification system runs continuously for decades, so energy and plant maintenance dominate operating cost. Energy goes in two places: fans that push air through ducts and cable voids, and heaters that warm regeneration air to restore the desiccant rotor, the latter usually being larger. Maintenance covers filter changes, rotor and seal checks, fan bearings, pre-cooler coil cleaning and condensate drainage, and control-system and sensor calibration. The Honshu-Shikoku experience also shows that a system needs continuous improvement from operating data, such as adding pre-coolers for humid summers.

Public accounts note that after about 15 years in service no rust had been found in the Great Belt East Bridge cables; repainting had been planned, but the owner chose a higher initial outlay on a sealed dehumidification system. The key is that repainting only maintains the outer skin and does nothing about water already inside the cable or entering later, while a cable that needs strengthening or load limits because of corrosion costs far more than any protection. The Honshu-Shikoku bridges' target of 200 years or more, with preventive maintenance to minimise life-cycle cost, follows the same logic. The decision must bring the uncertain risk of future deterioration into the comparison.
evidence: 新建懸索橋應在設計階段就把主纜除濕列為防蝕系統的一部分，並在施工期間限制雨中紡線或牽引、在擠壓前排水；既有橋梁則以溫濕度量測與開窗檢查建立現況基準，再決定是否改造。
系統設計報告應列出每個區段的長度、預估滲透率、設計壓力與流量、包覆容許壓力與排氣目標，並在試運轉時以實測值更新；任何區段流量偏低都要在交接前處理。
施工規範應規定熔合的環境條件、搭接寬度、索夾與套筒的標準密封細部，以及每區段的氣密驗收；索夾螺栓再張拉、吊索更換或檢查開口後，都必須按同一細部恢復密封並重新試驗。
採購規範應以設計外氣條件、送氣露點、流量、備援數量、遠端監控介面與維修可及性定義機組；機房位置要考慮維修人員的安全通道與設備吊運路線，並保留更換整台機組的空間。
改造合約應把天候限制、熔合參數、逐段氣密試驗與纜上作業安全列為停留點，並要求承包商提交每日紀錄；交通管制與高空作業許可由業主統一協調，任何設備附掛在主纜上都需要結構工程師核可。
evidenceEn: New suspension bridges should include cable dehumidification in the corrosion-protection design from the start, limiting spinning or hauling in rain and draining before compaction; for existing bridges, establish a baseline by humidity measurement and inspection windows before deciding on a retrofit.

The system design report should list each section's length, estimated permeability, design pressure and flow, wrap pressure limit and exhaust target, updated with measured values at commissioning; any section with low flow must be resolved before handover.

The specification should set environmental limits for fusion, lap width, standard seal details at bands and sleeves and airtightness acceptance per section; after bolt re-tensioning, hanger replacement or inspection openings, the seal must be restored to the same detail and retested.

Define units in the procurement specification by design outdoor conditions, supply dew point, flow, redundancy, remote-monitoring interface and maintainability; locate plant rooms with safe access for maintenance staff and a lifting route, leaving space to replace a complete unit.

The retrofit contract should make weather limits, fusion parameters, section-by-section airtightness tests and safety of work on the cable hold points, with daily records from the contractor; the owner coordinates traffic management and work-at-height permits, and anything attached to the cable needs the structural engineer's approval.
pitfalls: 主纜低點長期積水時，鍍鋅層先被消耗，接著鋼絲出現點蝕與應力腐蝕裂紋；由於外層纏絲完好，問題往往在數十年後開纜檢查才被發現，屆時斷絲與強度損失可能已需要限載或補強。
一個未密封的索夾端或破損的搭接，就能讓大部分乾燥空氣在近端逸出，下游區段持續潮濕；包覆在低溫或潮濕時熔合，日後在溫度循環下沿搭接開裂，雨水反而從裂縫進入。
為趕進度在潮濕或低溫天候熔合，搭接黏結不良，系統啟動後才發現大量洩漏；清理不完全時，既有塗料或防蝕膏夾在包覆下方，影響黏結並可能積水。纜上設備若固定不當，也可能刮傷包覆或纏絲。
感測器漂移讀值偏低時，系統看似達標而主纜實際潮濕；感測器故障輸出固定值若未被偵測，可能多年沒有人發現某區段已失去送氣。
為節省能源而降低送氣量或關閉部分機組，排氣濕度在數週內回升；過濾器長期未更換使壓降增加、流量下降，而控制系統若只看風機運轉狀態，可能不會發出警報。
pitfallsEn: Where water sits at low points for years, zinc is consumed first and then wires pit and develop stress-corrosion cracks; because the outer wrapping looks intact, the problem is often found only at a cable opening decades later, when broken wires and strength loss may already require load limits or strengthening.

One unsealed band end or broken lap can vent most of the dry air near the inlet while downstream sections stay damp; wrap fused in cold or wet weather can split along laps under later thermal cycles, letting rain in through the cracks.

Fusing in damp or cold weather to catch up leaves weak laps that leak heavily once the system starts; incomplete cleaning traps old paint or paste under the wrap, spoiling adhesion and possibly holding water; poorly secured on-cable equipment can also scratch the wrap or wrapping wire.

A sensor drifting low makes the system look on target while the cable is actually damp; a failed sensor stuck at a constant value, if undetected, can hide for years that a section has lost its supply.

Cutting supply flow or switching off units to save energy lets exhaust humidity climb within weeks; filters left unchanged raise pressure drop and cut flow, and a control system that watches only whether fans are running may never alarm.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

factsEn: Main span 1,018 m with two 289 m back spans; overall length 1,596 m
The towers reach about +298 mPD, with concrete up to about +175 mPD
The deck is about 53 m wide, and the main-span steel deck weighs about 33,500 t
There are 224 stays, the longest about 540 m, totalling about 7,200 t
Mid-span deflection is about 1.8 m under traffic and about 2.2 m under wind
Minimum navigation headroom is about 73.5 m
Flutter speed is about 95 m/s at zero incidence without traffic and about 50 m/s at ±5°
The main contract was about HK$2.76 billion, starting April 2004 and opening December 2009
The bridge used about 136,000 m³ of concrete and about 1,100 t of stainless steel

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：昂船洲大橋
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Stonecutters Bridge
guides.concept: 昂船洲大橋以 1,018 m 主跨橫越香港藍巴勒海峽，主跨為中央開槽的流線形雙鋼箱梁，背跨為預力混凝土雙箱梁，兩座單柱塔下段為混凝土、上段為雙相不鏽鋼外皮的鋼—混凝土複合結構。本課從颱風風荷載、塔梁液壓緩衝器、224 根斜拉索、鋼箱梁吊裝與鋼混接頭，一路到雷諾數效應的風洞試驗、跨中撓度監測與長索維護。
guides.conceptEn: Stonecutters Bridge crosses Hong Kong’s Rambler Channel with a 1,018 m main span of streamlined twin steel boxes separated by a central gap, prestressed concrete twin-box back spans and two monopole towers whose lower parts are concrete and upper parts steel–concrete composite with a duplex stainless skin. The course runs from typhoon wind load, tower–deck hydraulic buffers, the 224 stays, deck-segment lifting and the steel–concrete junction to Reynolds-number effects in wind testing, mid-span deflection monitoring and long-stay maintenance.
procedure: 昂船洲大橋位於葵青貨櫃碼頭入口，颱風季的強風紊流度高，主跨 1,018 m 的橋面又輕又柔，風力同時造成橫向彎曲、扭轉與可能的顫振。設計者把約 53 m 寬的橋面分成兩個流線形鋼箱梁，中間留空並以橫梁連接：開槽讓上下表面的壓力差得以洩放，提高扭轉顫振的臨界風速，並降低渦流鎖定的振幅。公開設計資料顯示，零攻角無車時顫振臨界風速約 95 m/s，但攻角變為 ±5° 時降到約 50 m/s，說明颱風紊流造成的攻角變化才是控制因素。

昂船洲大橋兩側背跨各長 289 m，由 79.75、70、70、69.25 m 四跨預力混凝土雙箱梁組成，混凝土的重量提供平衡主跨鋼梁的壓重，密布的背跨橋墩則讓背索錨固點接近固定，提高整體勁度。主跨與背跨連成連續橋面，溫度造成的伸縮必須能自由發生；但颱風陣風、地震與煞車屬於快速荷載，橋面不能任意滑動。因此塔與梁之間在橋面高程設置液壓緩衝器：慢速溫度位移時油可通過孔道，幾乎不產生力；快速荷載時閥門鎖住，緩衝器像剛性連桿把縱向力傳給橋塔。

昂船洲大橋的塔為中空單柱，斷面由下方的橢圓形逐漸收成上方的圓形，塔頂達主水平基準以上約 298 m。約 +175 m 以下為鋼筋混凝土，以上改為鋼—混凝土複合段，外層是雙相不鏽鋼板，不只是飾面，而是與內部混凝土共同受力的結構元件。斜索錨固集中在上塔，需要高勁度與高強度；不鏽鋼外皮同時省去日後高空重新塗裝，降低維護成本與風險。複合段設計重點在剪力釘或連接件把鋼皮與混凝土結合，避免溫差與乾縮使兩者分離。

全橋 224 根斜拉索以雙索面修正扇形配置，主跨錨距約 18 m、背跨約 10 m，最長約 540 m、單根約 70 t，全部斜索合計約 7,200 t。公開設計資料顯示索的外徑由塔附近的 113 mm（163 根鋼線）增到背跨端的 192 mm（499 根鋼線），因為越靠背跨端的背索要平衡越多主跨重量。上塔內約 1,200 t 的鋼錨箱把各索的集中力分散到塔壁，同時讓張拉設備有作業空間。索徑與鋼線數的變化正好反映了扇形配置下索力的分布。
昂船洲大橋主跨鋼梁在工廠分片製造、再組成節段，以駁船運到橋下，由懸臂端的起重門架垂直吊升，逐段焊接並安裝對應的斜索；靠近塔的一小段鋼梁則在臨時支架上架設。懸臂越伸越長時，結構是兩支各約 500 m 的懸臂，橫向只有塔與斜索支撐，對颱風最為脆弱；吊裝作業又受海峽航運與潮流限制。施工團隊必須規劃颱風來臨前的停工、門架固定與臨時抗風措施，並預估懸臂端在風中的位移與塔底的附加彎矩。
昂船洲大橋的鋼主梁並不在塔處結束，而是伸入背跨約 49.75 m 後才與混凝土雙箱梁接合。接頭位置選在彎矩與剪力相對溫和處，但仍要傳遞斜索在橋面累積的巨大水平壓力、彎矩與剪力。常見做法是在鋼梁端部設承壓板與格室，內部填混凝土，以剪力釘、開孔鋼板連接件與預力鋼腱把鋼與混凝土綁成一體。接頭兩側勁度差異很大，溫度、乾縮與徐變都會在界面集中應力，因此是全橋細部最複雜的區域之一。

公開設計資料指出，昂船洲大橋做了 1:80 與 1:20 兩種比例的橋面斷面風洞試驗、1:1 的斜索試驗以及 1:1,500 的地形模型試驗。原因在於風洞模型無法同時滿足所有相似律：小比例模型的雷諾數比實橋小數百倍，流線形箱梁圓角處的分離點可能與實橋不同，使渦振與氣動係數失真；較大的 1:20 模型提高雷諾數以檢核這種敏感性。地形模型則用來取得周邊山體與城市對來風的紊流與風速剖面，作為斷面試驗的輸入。
香港路政署公開資料指出，昂船洲大橋跨中在交通荷載下撓度可達約 1.8 m，在風荷載下可達約 2.2 m。這樣大的位移是千米跨斜張橋的正常行為，而非缺陷，但也代表伸縮縫、支承、緩衝器與路面都必須容許相應的變形。監測系統以 GNSS、加速度計、應變計、溫度計與風速計記錄橋梁反應，工程師要把實測撓度依溫度、交通與風況分類，才能和設計預測公平比較，並從長期趨勢找出支承卡滯、索力變化或基礎沉陷的徵兆。
昂船洲大橋下塔位於海水飛濺與潮汐乾濕交替區，氯離子是鋼筋腐蝕的主要驅動力。公開資料指出下塔為使用不鏽鋼鋼筋的鋼筋混凝土，基礎為擴底鑽掘樁，岩盤深度約在 −40 m 至 −90 m 之間，並考慮負摩擦力。氯離子由表面向內擴散，到達鋼筋位置且濃度超過臨界值後，碳鋼鋼筋開始腐蝕並膨脹剝落；不鏽鋼鋼筋的臨界氯離子濃度高得多，可大幅延後腐蝕起始，適合用在最難維修的高風險區。
最長約 540 m 的斜拉索質量大、垂度明顯，第一振動頻率只有零點幾赫茲，容易受風雨激振，也不易以千斤頂直接量測索力。營運期最實用的方法是以加速度計量測索的自然頻率，再以張緊弦公式換算索力，長索需另行修正垂度與彎曲勁度的影響。定期比對索力趨勢可以發現錨具滑移、鋼線斷絲或阻尼器失效；交接文件則要把每根索的基準頻率、溫度與量測方法完整保存，讓下一代維護工程師能重複同樣的量測。
procedureEn: Stonecutters Bridge sits at the entrance to the Kwai Tsing container terminals, where typhoon winds are highly turbulent, and the 1,018 m main-span deck is light and flexible, so wind causes lateral bending, torsion and potentially flutter. The designers split the roughly 53 m deck into two streamlined steel boxes with an open gap between them, linked by cross girders: the gap vents the pressure difference between upper and lower surfaces, raising the torsional flutter speed and reducing vortex lock-in amplitudes. Published design data show a flutter speed of about 95 m/s at zero incidence without traffic, falling to about 50 m/s at ±5°, so the angle-of-attack changes caused by typhoon turbulence govern.

Each back span of Stonecutters Bridge is 289 m long, made of four prestressed concrete twin-box spans of 79.75, 70, 70 and 69.25 m; the concrete weight ballasts the steel main span, and the closely spaced back-span piers make the back-stay anchor points nearly fixed, raising global stiffness. The main and back spans form a continuous deck whose thermal expansion must occur freely, but typhoon gusts, earthquakes and braking are fast loads under which the deck must not slide. Hydraulic buffers between tower and deck at deck level therefore let oil pass through orifices during slow thermal movement, producing almost no force, and lock under fast loads so the buffer acts as a rigid link carrying longitudinal force to the tower.

The Stonecutters towers are hollow monopoles whose section tapers from an ellipse below to a circle above, reaching about +298 mPD. Below about +175 m they are reinforced concrete; above, a steel–concrete composite section with a duplex stainless steel outer skin that is a structural element acting with the concrete, not cladding. Stay anchorages concentrate in the upper tower and need high stiffness and strength, and the stainless skin avoids repainting at height, reducing maintenance cost and risk. The composite design hinges on studs or connectors that bond skin and concrete so temperature differences and shrinkage do not separate them.

The bridge has 224 stays in two planes in a modified fan, anchored at about 18 m spacing in the main span and about 10 m in the back spans; the longest is about 540 m and about 70 t, and all stays total about 7,200 t. Published design data show outside diameters rising from 113 mm (163 wires) near the towers to 192 mm (499 wires) toward the back-span ends, because the back stays nearest the ends balance the most main-span weight. Steel anchor boxes of about 1,200 t in the upper towers spread each concentrated stay force into the tower walls and give room for stressing equipment. The change of diameter and wire count mirrors the force distribution in a fan arrangement.

The main-span steel was fabricated as panels, assembled into segments, barged under the bridge and lifted vertically by gantries at the cantilever tips, each segment welded in and its stays installed; the short section next to each tower was erected on temporary falsework. As the cantilevers grow, the structure becomes two cantilevers of roughly 500 m supported laterally only by the tower and stays, its most typhoon-vulnerable state, while lifts are also constrained by channel shipping and currents. The team must plan stoppages, gantry tie-downs and temporary wind measures before a typhoon and predict cantilever-tip displacement and the added moment at the tower base.

The Stonecutters steel girder does not stop at the towers; it extends about 49.75 m into each back span before joining the concrete twin boxes. The junction is placed where moment and shear are relatively moderate but must still transfer the large horizontal compression accumulated from the stays, plus moment and shear. A common solution uses end bearing plates and cells filled with concrete, with shear studs, perforated-plate connectors and prestressing tendons binding steel and concrete together. Stiffness changes sharply across the junction, and temperature, shrinkage and creep concentrate stress at the interface, making it one of the most complex details of the bridge.

Published design data state that Stonecutters Bridge was tested with deck section models at 1:80 and 1:20, full-scale 1:1 stay tests and a 1:1,500 terrain model. No wind-tunnel model can satisfy every similarity law: a small model’s Reynolds number is hundreds of times below full scale, so flow separation at the rounded corners of a streamlined box may differ from reality and distort vortex response and aerodynamic coefficients; the larger 1:20 model raises the Reynolds number to check this sensitivity. The terrain model provides turbulence and wind profiles from the surrounding hills and city as input to the section tests.

Hong Kong Highways Department data state that Stonecutters Bridge can deflect about 1.8 m at mid-span under traffic and about 2.2 m under wind. Such movements are normal for a 1 km cable-stayed span, not defects, but they require joints, bearings, buffers and surfacing to accommodate them. The monitoring system records response with GNSS, accelerometers, strain gauges, thermometers and anemometers, and engineers must sort measured deflections by temperature, traffic and wind before comparing them fairly with predictions, then look for signs of seized bearings, stay-force change or foundation settlement in long-term trends.

The Stonecutters lower towers sit in the seawater splash and tidal zone, where chloride drives reinforcement corrosion. Published data state the lower towers are reinforced concrete with stainless steel bars, and the foundations are bored piles with enlarged bases, with bedrock at roughly −40 m to −90 m and negative skin friction considered. Chlorides diffuse inward from the surface, and once they reach the bars above a threshold, carbon-steel bars start corroding, expand and spall the cover; stainless bars tolerate a much higher chloride threshold, greatly delaying corrosion onset, which suits the highest-risk zones that are hardest to repair.

The longest stay, about 540 m, is heavy and sags noticeably, with a first natural frequency of only a few tenths of a hertz; it is prone to wind–rain excitation and hard to measure directly with jacks. The most practical in-service method measures the natural frequency with an accelerometer and converts it to force with the taut-string formula, with corrections for sag and bending stiffness on long stays. Comparing force trends over time reveals anchor slip, broken wires or damper failure, and the handover file must preserve each stay’s baseline frequency, temperature and method so the next generation of engineers can repeat the measurement.
evidence: 風工程報告應明列各攻角的顫振臨界風速、有無交通的差異與試驗模型所含的附屬物；任何欄杆、防撞護欄或檢修軌道的形狀變更都要回到風工程顧問複核。
維護手冊應規定緩衝器的檢查頻率、漏油判定、行程刻度讀數與颱風後的專項檢查；更換緩衝器時須有臨時縱向約束方案與交通管制。
複合塔段的施工計畫要規定每節鋼皮的定位公差、混凝土分層澆置高度與側壓限制，以及脫空檢測的抽樣比例；不同金屬接觸點的絕緣細部須在圖上標示。
交接時要留下每根索的編號、鋼線數、外徑、設計與實測索力、錨具型號及出廠試驗報告；錨箱內要設照明、通風與檢查通道，確保日後能接近錨頭。
施工計畫要訂出各懸臂長度的作業風速上限、颱風警報分級對應的固定程序與人員撤離時點，並把最大懸臂的抗風措施列為停留檢查點，由設計與施工工程師共同確認。
evidenceEn: The wind report should tabulate flutter speeds by angle of attack, with and without traffic, and list the attachments modelled; any change to railings, barriers or inspection rails goes back to the wind consultant for review.

The maintenance manual should set buffer inspection frequency, leak criteria, stroke-scale readings and post-typhoon special checks; buffer replacement needs a temporary longitudinal restraint scheme and traffic management.

The composite-tower method statement should set positioning tolerances for each skin segment, concrete lift heights and lateral-pressure limits, and the sampling rate for void detection; insulation details at dissimilar-metal contacts must be shown on the drawings.

At handover keep each stay’s number, wire count, diameter, design and measured force, anchorage type and test reports; anchor boxes need lighting, ventilation and access so anchor heads can be reached later.

The method statement should set working wind limits for each cantilever length, securing procedures and evacuation times for each typhoon-signal level, with the maximum-cantilever wind measures a hold point confirmed jointly by the design and construction engineers.
pitfalls: 若只以零攻角的試驗結果判定顫振安全，強紊流下的實際攻角可能使臨界風速降低近一半；開槽寬度或橫梁形狀在細部設計中被修改而未重新試驗，也可能出現未預期的渦振或扭轉不穩定。
若鋼皮與混凝土間灌漿不密實或連接件不足，鋼皮在日照溫差下局部鼓起，複合作用消失，錨固區的應力集中提高；不同金屬接觸處若未隔離，也可能出現電化學腐蝕。
颱風預警時若懸臂端門架或未焊完的節段沒有可靠固定，強風可能使吊具擺動撞擊結構；最大懸臂狀態下若臨時抗風措施不足，側向位移與塔底彎矩可能超出設計，甚至出現施工期的氣彈振動。
若只依小比例模型認定沒有渦振，實橋在較高雷諾數下的分離行為改變，可能出現模型未預測的振動；反之也可能因模型過度保守而增加不必要的導流板或阻尼裝置。
飛濺區保護層不足或混凝土蜂窩，會讓氯離子提早到達鋼筋，造成鏽脹裂縫與剝落；若不同材質鋼筋混用而未隔離，接觸處也可能加速碳鋼腐蝕。
pitfallsEn: Judging flutter safety only from zero-incidence results can overlook that real angles of attack in strong turbulence nearly halve the critical speed; altering the gap width or cross-girder shape in detailed design without retesting can introduce unexpected vortex vibration or torsional instability.

Incomplete concrete fill or too few connectors lets the skin bulge locally under solar temperature differences, losing composite action and raising stress concentrations in the anchorage zone; contact between dissimilar metals without isolation can also cause galvanic corrosion.

If gantries or partly welded segments at the tip are not secured when a typhoon warning is issued, rigging can swing into the structure; at the maximum cantilever, inadequate temporary wind measures can push lateral displacement and tower-base moment beyond design or even trigger construction-stage aeroelastic motion.

Relying on a small model alone to rule out vortex vibration can miss oscillation that appears at full-scale Reynolds numbers where separation changes; the opposite error adds unnecessary fairings or dampers because the model was over-conservative.

Insufficient cover or honeycombing in the splash zone lets chlorides reach the bars early, causing rust cracking and spalling; mixing reinforcement types without isolation can accelerate carbon-steel corrosion at contacts.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 長江口軟弱深厚地層上的 1,088 m 斜張橋：摩擦樁群、300 m 塔、阻尼限位體系與長索控制。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: A 1,088 m cable-stayed span on deep soft estuary ground: friction pile groups, 300 m towers, damper–limiter system and long-stay control. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: 倒 Y 形混凝土主塔高 300.4 m
最長斜拉索約 577 m
每座主塔由 131 根鑽孔灌注樁支承，直徑達 2.8 m、長約 120 m
主塔群樁平面約 114 m × 48 m
通航淨空寬 891 m、高 62 m
鋼箱梁含風嘴寬約 41 m
樁垂直度設計容許 1/200，實際達約 1/400
跨江大橋全長約 8,206 m，整體路線約 32.4 km
factsEn: The inverted-Y concrete towers are 300.4 m tall
The longest stay is about 577 m
Each main tower stands on 131 bored piles up to 2.8 m in diameter and about 120 m long
Each main-tower pile group is about 114 m × 48 m in plan
Navigation clearance is 891 m wide and 62 m high
The steel box deck is about 41 m wide including fairings
Pile verticality tolerance was 1/200, with about 1/400 achieved
The river crossing is about 8,206 m long within a route of about 32.4 km
timeline: 2003　6 月 27 日主體工程開工，先建深水施工平台
2007　6 月 18 日鋼箱梁主跨合龍，全橋貫通
2008　5 月試通車，6 月 30 日正式通車，主跨 1,088 m 創斜張橋紀錄
2010　獲美國土木工程師學會傑出土木工程成就獎
timelineEn: 2003 — Main construction starts on 27 June, beginning with deep-water work platforms
2007 — The steel box main span closes on 18 June, joining the whole bridge
2008 — Trial traffic in May and official opening on 30 June with a record 1,088 m cable-stayed span
2010 — Receives ASCE’s Outstanding Civil Engineering Achievement award
codes: JTG/T D65-01-2007 公路斜拉橋設計細則
JTG/T D60-01-2004 公路橋梁抗風設計規範
PTI DC45.1-18 斜拉索設計、試驗與安裝建議
codesEn: JTG/T D65-01-2007 Guidelines for Design of Highway Cable-Stayed Bridges
JTG/T D60-01-2004 Wind-Resistant Design Specification for Highway Bridges
PTI DC45.1-18 Recommendations for Stay Cable Design, Testing and Installation
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：蘇通長江公路大橋
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Sutong Yangtze River Bridge
guides.concept: 蘇通長江公路大橋以 1,088 m 主跨跨越寬約 6 km 的長江口，主橋孔跨為 (100+100+300)+1,088+(300+100+100) m，倒 Y 形混凝土塔高 300.4 m，鋼箱梁含風嘴寬約 41 m，最長斜索約 577 m。本課從縱向阻尼限位體系、高空風剖面、每塔 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁、鋼錨箱錨固區出發，經施工平台與節段同步提升，到氣彈模型、沖刷監測、塔柱徐變與長索多模態振動。
guides.conceptEn: Sutong Yangtze River Bridge spans the roughly 6 km wide Yangtze estuary with a 1,088 m main span in a (100+100+300)+1,088+(300+100+100) m arrangement, 300.4 m inverted-Y concrete towers, a steel box deck about 41 m wide including fairings and stays up to about 577 m long. The course runs from the longitudinal damper–limiter system, wind profiles at height, the 131 bored friction piles per tower and steel anchor boxes, through work platforms and synchronised segment lifting, to aeroelastic testing, scour monitoring, tower creep and multi-mode vibration of long stays.
procedure: 蘇通大橋主橋全長 2,088 m，若橋面在塔處完全固定，溫度伸縮與混凝土塔的徐變會在塔底產生巨大彎矩；若完全漂浮，颱風、船撞與地震又會讓橋面大幅縱飄，撞壞伸縮縫。設計團隊比較多種體系後，採用附加位移限制裝置的超大型液體黏滯阻尼器，公開論文指出這是此類裝置在橋梁工程的首次應用。慢速的溫度位移幾乎不受阻；快速的風振與地震由阻尼器耗能；位移一旦達到限位值，限位裝置接手，防止極端事件中橋面超出伸縮縫與支承的行程。
蘇通大橋位於開闊的長江口，地表粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加明顯。主塔高 300.4 m，塔頂的風速遠高於橋面高度，而風壓又與風速平方成正比，所以塔上段承受的單位面積風力可比橋面高出四成以上。公開論文指出，300 m 高塔對風極為敏感，施工期的抗風問題尤其重要：塔柱在自立狀態下頻率低、沒有斜索與橋面約束，容易出現渦致振動與大幅擺動，需以臨時連接或阻尼措施控制。

長江口的沉積層極厚，岩盤深達約 300 m，基樁無法嵌岩，只能靠樁側摩擦與樁端承載把荷重傳到砂土層。公開報導指出每座主塔由 131 根直徑達 2.8 m、長約 120 m 的鑽孔灌注樁支承，群樁平面約 114 m × 48 m。摩擦樁的承載主要來自深部砂層的側阻，群樁中各樁應力球重疊，群樁沉陷大於單樁；同時水流沖刷會把上部土層移走，降低有效埋深與側阻。因此設計同時檢查單樁承載、群樁沉陷與沖刷後的承載折減。
公開論文指出，蘇通大橋塔的斜索錨固區採鋼—混凝土組合結構，構造與受力都相當複雜，長期耐久性需特別關注。斜索的水平分力會把塔壁向外拉開，若只靠混凝土承受就需要大量環向預力；把鋼錨箱嵌入塔內後，兩側斜索的水平分力大部分在鋼錨箱內自我平衡，剩餘部分再經剪力連接件傳給混凝土。力量如何在鋼與混凝土之間分配，取決於兩者的相對勁度與連接件的滑移，因此錨固區的設計需要精細的局部分析與試驗。

在浪高約 3 m、潮差約 4 m、每天約 3,000 艘船通過的江面上鑽 131 根百米長樁，第一步是建立穩定的施工平台。公開報導指出，承包商原計畫以約 130 根 60 m 長臨時鋼管支撐約 117 m × 55 m 的平台，但試打的 12 根不穩定，後改用 120 m 長的永久鋼護筒兼作平台支撐。鋼護筒提供鑽孔導向並保護孔壁，其垂直度直接決定樁身在深處是否偏離設計位置；樁偏斜會改變群樁受力分配並與相鄰樁碰撞。報導指出設計垂直度容許 1/200，實際達到約 1/400。

蘇通大橋鋼箱梁以船運到位後，由懸臂端吊機或提升設備垂直吊起再與既有梁段焊接，鋼梁架設須趕在颱風季前完成。大型節段常以四個或更多吊點同步提升，節段本身與吊架都很剛硬，任何一個吊點多升或少升幾毫米，荷重就會在吊點間大幅重分配。公開報導中重型提升分包商指出，吊點間 10 mm 的相對位移就可能轉移約 35% 的荷重。因此提升系統需要電腦同步控制、每點荷重即時顯示與自動停機。全橋合龍則在 2007 年 6 月完成。
千米級斜張橋最危險的風況往往出現在施工中：雙懸臂接近最大長度時，橋面只靠塔與斜索支撐，頻率低且沒有合龍後的整體勁度。全橋氣彈模型以縮尺重現質量、勁度與幾何，讓風洞中的模型與實橋有相同的折算風速，才能觀察抖振、渦振與顫振的整體行為。AECOM 公開資料指出其為承包商提供了橋梁氣動、風洞試驗與振動抑制等施工工程服務，說明施工單位也需要自己的風工程驗證，而不只依賴設計階段的成果。
主塔承台平面約 114 m × 48 m，是長江口中的巨大障礙物，水流在其上游側形成下沉流與馬蹄形渦流，把承台周圍的砂土帶走。潮汐每天兩次反向，加上汛期大流量，沖刷坑會隨季節加深或回淤。摩擦樁的承載仰賴上部土層的圍束，沖刷深度增加就等於縮短有效樁長並增加樁的自由長度，降低側向勁度。大型深水基礎因此常在施工前後鋪設拋石或袋裝砂的護底層，並在營運期定期測深，確認防護層沒有被掏空。
混凝土塔在自重、斜索垂直分力與後期鋪面荷載下會彈性壓縮，之後還有收縮與徐變持續縮短。300 m 高的塔累積縮短量可達十公分量級，直接使錨點下降、斜索幾何改變，進而影響橋面線形與索力。公開論文把塔形控制列為蘇通大橋塔施工的重點之一。施工時要以預抬量把每個錨點設在略高的位置，讓長期縮短後回到設計高程；營運期則需追蹤塔頂高程與索力的長期趨勢，分辨徐變造成的正常變化與異常沉陷。
蘇通大橋最長斜索約 577 m，第一頻率極低，風雨、渦流與橋面運動可能激發其第 5 階甚至第 10 階以上的模態。外置阻尼器只能裝在靠近橋面錨點的位置，而每個模態的最佳阻尼係數不同：對低階模態最佳的係數，對高階模態可能太硬或太軟。因此長索的減振設計要先找出可能被激發的頻率範圍，再選擇在該範圍內都能提供足夠附加阻尼的阻尼器參數，並在營運期定期檢查阻尼器是否漏油、卡滯或支架鬆動。
procedureEn: The Sutong main bridge is 2,088 m long. Fixing the deck to the towers would let thermal movement and tower creep create huge tower-base moments; a fully floating deck would let typhoons, ship impact and earthquakes push it far enough to wreck the expansion joints. After comparing systems, the design team adopted very large fluid viscous dampers with an added displacement limiter, described in a published paper as the first use of such a device in bridge engineering. Slow thermal movement is almost unresisted, fast wind and seismic motion is dissipated by the dampers, and once displacement reaches the limit the limiter takes over so the deck cannot exceed joint and bearing travel in an extreme event.

Sutong Bridge sits in the open Yangtze estuary, where low surface roughness makes wind speed rise markedly with height. The towers are 300.4 m tall, so wind speed at the top is far above that at deck level, and because pressure goes with the square of speed, the upper tower can see over four-tenths more pressure per unit area than the deck. Published papers stress that a 300 m tower is highly wind-sensitive, especially during construction: a free-standing tower has low frequencies and no restraint from stays or deck, so it is prone to vortex-induced vibration and large sway that must be controlled with temporary ties or damping.

The Yangtze estuary sediments are extremely thick, with rock about 300 m down, so piles cannot be socketed into rock and must carry load by shaft friction and end bearing in sand layers. Public reports state that each main tower stands on 131 bored cast-in-place piles up to 2.8 m in diameter and about 120 m long, in a group about 114 m × 48 m in plan. Friction-pile capacity comes mainly from shaft resistance in deep sands; stress bulbs overlap within the group, so group settlement exceeds single-pile settlement, and scour removes upper soil, reducing embedment and shaft resistance. Design therefore checks single-pile capacity, group settlement and capacity after scour together.

Published papers state that the Sutong tower anchorage zone uses a steel–concrete composite structure whose construction and load behaviour are complex, with long-term durability needing close attention. The horizontal components of the stays try to split the tower walls apart, and resisting them with concrete alone needs heavy circumferential prestress; with steel anchor boxes embedded in the tower, most of the horizontal force from opposite stays is balanced inside the box, and the remainder passes to the concrete through shear connectors. How force is shared between steel and concrete depends on their relative stiffness and connector slip, so the anchorage zone needs detailed local analysis and testing.

Drilling 131 piles each about 100 m long in a river with waves of about 3 m, tides of about 4 m and some 3,000 ships a day starts with a stable work platform. Public reports state that the contractor planned about 130 temporary 60 m steel pipes to support a platform of about 117 m × 55 m, but 12 trial pipes proved unstable, so 120 m permanent steel casings were used to support the platform. The casings guide drilling and protect the bore, and their verticality determines whether the pile drifts from position at depth; inclined piles change load sharing in the group and can clash with neighbours. The reports cite a design verticality tolerance of 1/200 and achieved values of about 1/400.

At Sutong the steel box segments were barged into position, lifted vertically by cantilever-tip cranes or lifting gear and welded to the previous segment, and girder erection had to finish before the typhoon season. Large segments are usually lifted at four or more points in synchrony; the segment and lifting frame are stiff, so if one point rises a few millimetres more or less, load redistributes sharply among the points. In public reports the heavy-lift subcontractor noted that a 10 mm relative movement between jacking points could shift about 35% of the load. Lifting systems therefore need computer synchronisation, live load display at each point and automatic stops. Full closure of the deck was achieved in June 2007.

For a 1 km class cable-stayed bridge the most dangerous wind case often occurs during construction: as the twin cantilevers approach maximum length, the deck is supported only by tower and stays, with low frequencies and none of the stiffness gained after closure. A full aeroelastic model reproduces mass, stiffness and geometry at scale so the model and bridge share the same reduced velocity, allowing buffeting, vortex vibration and flutter of the whole structure to be observed. AECOM’s public material states that it provided the contractor with construction engineering services including bridge aerodynamics, wind-tunnel testing and vibration mitigation, showing that the builder also needs its own wind verification rather than relying only on design-stage results.

The main-tower caps, about 114 m × 48 m in plan, are huge obstacles in the estuary; flow forms a down-flow and horseshoe vortex on their upstream side and carries away sand around the cap. Tides reverse twice a day and flood seasons bring large discharges, so the scour hole deepens or refills seasonally. Friction piles rely on confinement by the upper soil, so deeper scour shortens effective pile length and increases free length, reducing lateral stiffness. Large deep-water foundations therefore commonly receive riprap or sand-bag aprons before and after construction, with periodic soundings in service to confirm the apron has not been undermined.

A concrete tower shortens elastically under self-weight, the vertical components of stay forces and later surfacing loads, and then keeps shortening by shrinkage and creep. In a 300 m tower the accumulated shortening can reach the order of ten centimetres, lowering anchor points, changing stay geometry and thus the deck profile and stay forces. Published papers list tower shape control as a key issue in building the Sutong towers. During construction anchor points are set higher by a pre-elevation so they return to design level after long-term shortening; in service, long-term trends in tower-top level and stay forces must be tracked to separate normal creep from abnormal settlement.

The longest Sutong stay is about 577 m, with a very low first frequency, so rain, wind, vortices and deck motion can excite its fifth or even tenth mode and above. External dampers can only be installed near the deck anchorage, and the optimum damping coefficient differs for each mode: a value optimal for low modes can be too stiff or too soft for higher ones. Vibration control for long stays therefore starts by identifying the frequency range likely to be excited, then chooses damper parameters that give enough added damping across that range, with periodic in-service checks for leaks, seizure or loose brackets.
evidence: 阻尼器與限位裝置的參數要與伸縮縫、支承的設計行程一起列表核對，並在維護手冊規定行程刻度巡檢、漏油判定與更換時的臨時約束方案。
施工計畫應依高度分段訂出塔吊與爬模的停工風速，並把自立塔最高狀態的抗風措施列為停留檢查點；塔上風速計資料要與施工日誌同步保存。
大型摩擦樁群要先做試樁再定案樁長，並把鑽孔垂直度、泥漿性質、沉渣厚度與灌注連續性列為每根樁的檢查項目；試樁報告要回饋到設計並由設計單位確認。
錨箱節段應在工廠預拼並量測斜索出口角度，現場以測量控制每節錨箱的空間位置；錨固區混凝土要有裂縫寬度檢查與記錄，作為營運期比較的基準。
深水平台要有獨立的臨時工程設計、浪流與船撞檢核、颱風前的撤離與加固程序；樁位與垂直度量測結果應逐根簽認，超限樁由設計單位決定處理方式。
evidenceEn: Tabulate damper and limiter parameters against the design travel of joints and bearings, and specify stroke-scale inspections, leak criteria and a temporary restraint scheme for replacement in the maintenance manual.

The method statement should set stop-work wind speeds for cranes and climbing forms by height band, with wind measures for the tallest free-standing state a hold point; tower anemometer data should be archived alongside the site diary.

For large friction-pile groups, test trial piles before finalising pile length, make drilling verticality, slurry properties, base sediment and continuity of concreting checklist items for every pile, and feed trial-pile reports back to the designer for confirmation.

Pre-assemble anchor-box segments in the shop and measure stay exit angles, control each box’s spatial position by survey on site, and record crack widths in the anchorage concrete as a baseline for in-service comparison.

A deep-water platform needs its own temporary-works design, wave, current and ship-impact checks and pre-typhoon evacuation and securing procedures; pile position and verticality results are signed off pile by pile, with the designer deciding treatment of out-of-tolerance piles.
pitfalls: 若限位值設得太小，日常溫度位移就會頂到限位，塔底承受不必要的彎矩；阻尼器漏油或密封磨耗會讓阻尼下降，強風時橋面縱向擺幅增加，伸縮縫與支承加速損壞。
樁底沉渣過厚或泥漿護壁形成厚泥皮，會大幅降低端阻與側阻，使單樁沉陷超出預期；群樁不均勻沉陷會使承台傾斜，進而改變塔軸與斜索索力分布。
臨時平台支撐失穩可能導致鑽機傾覆與人員傷亡；樁身偏斜超限時若未重新分析，承台受力與沉陷分布會偏離設計，甚至需要補樁。
若模型阻尼過高或勁度不符，試驗會低估施工期振幅，現場在中等風速下出現模型未預測的大幅擺動；未把吊機、臨時設備的質量與迎風面積納入模型，也會使結果失真。
若預抬量只算彈性縮短而忽略徐變，數年後錨點持續下沉，主跨跨中下撓、索力重分配，鋪面與伸縮縫出現異常；若量測不分離溫度效應，又可能把季節變化誤判為徐變。
pitfallsEn: A limit set too small lets daily thermal movement hit it, imposing unnecessary tower-base moments; oil leakage or seal wear reduces damping so the deck swings further longitudinally in strong wind, accelerating joint and bearing damage.

Thick base sediment or a heavy bentonite filter cake sharply reduces end and shaft resistance so single piles settle more than predicted; uneven group settlement tilts the cap, changing the tower axis and the distribution of stay forces.

Instability of temporary platform supports can topple drilling rigs and injure crews; piles beyond tolerance that are not reanalysed shift cap forces and settlement away from the design and may require additional piles.

Excess damping or wrong stiffness in the model underestimates construction-stage amplitudes, so the site sees large sway at moderate wind that the model missed; leaving out crane and temporary-equipment mass and area also distorts the results.

Pre-elevation based on elastic shortening only lets anchors keep sinking for years, sagging the main span, redistributing stay forces and distressing surfacing and joints; measurements that do not separate temperature may also mistake seasonal change for creep.

facts: 四座塔基礎直徑 90 m，坐於 3 m 厚礫石層
水深達 65 m，沉積層厚度超過 500 m
加勁鋼管直徑 2 m、長 25 至 30 m、間距 7 m
設計地表加速度 0.48 g，回歸期 2,000 年，相鄰墩可相對位移 2 m

factsEn: The cable-stayed section is 286+3×560+286 = 2,252 m with a continuous fully suspended deck
The four pylon footings are 90 m in diameter and rest on a 3 m gravel layer
Water depth reaches 65 m, with sediments over 500 m thick
Reinforcing steel pipes are 2 m in diameter, 25 to 30 m long and 7 m apart
Design PGA is 0.48 g with a 2,000-year return period and 2 m relative movement between piers
Main-pier fuse restrainers are 10.5 MN and viscous dampers 3.5 MN each
The 27.2 m composite deck was erected in 12 m segments of about 340 t at up to about 60 m a week
Each stay has 43 to 73 galvanised strands
Ship impact design covers a 180,000 dwt tanker at 16 knots
The monitoring system has over 100 sensors, about 300 channels and 100 Hz sampling

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。

從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.

Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.
