guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：里翁—安提里翁大橋
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Rion–Antirion Bridge
guides.concept: 里翁—安提里翁大橋以 286+3×560+286 m 共 2,252 m 的連續全懸吊橋面跨越希臘科林斯灣口，四座塔立在直徑 90 m、坐於 3 m 礫石層上的基礎，下方以 2 m 鋼管插入物加勁軟弱海床。本課從 0.48 g 地震與 2 m 斷層位移、熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器、加勁土壤與沉箱浮運，到張力腿駁船的海床整備、平衡懸臂架設、WEASHM 監測、雷擊斷索與混凝土耐久。
guides.conceptEn: The Rion–Antirion Bridge crosses the mouth of the Gulf of Corinth with a 2,252 m continuous fully suspended deck of 286+3×560+286 m; its four pylons stand on 90 m diameter footings resting on a 3 m gravel layer above soft seabed reinforced with 2 m steel-pipe inclusions. The course runs from 0.48 g shaking and 2 m fault movement, fuse restrainers and viscous dampers, reinforced soil and floating caissons, to seabed preparation from a tension-leg barge, balanced-cantilever erection, the WEASHM monitoring system, the lightning-caused stay failure and concrete durability.
procedure: 橋址位於構造活躍的科林斯灣，營運單位公開的設計條件包括：地表尖峰加速度 0.48 g、0.2 至 1.0 s 週期的最大譜加速度 1.2 g、回歸期 2,000 年（120 年設計年限內 5% 超越機率），且相鄰橋墩之間須容許任何方向達 2 m 的斷層相對位移，塔的傾斜容許 1/500。這些需求使傳統「把結構牢牢固定」的做法行不通：基礎必須能在海床上滑移，橋面必須與塔分離懸吊，讓地震與構造位移由可控制的滑動、擺動與阻尼吸收，而不是由構件強度硬抗。最不利的設計組合是設計地震加上 50% 的構造位移。

里翁—安提里翁大橋的橋面在全長 2,252 m 連續，並完全由斜索懸吊，不直接坐在塔上，地震時橋面像巨大的擺錘相對塔擺動。營運單位公開的配置是：主墩設 10.5 MN、過渡墩設 3.5 MN 的熔斷限制器，平時在強風下把橋面固定，地震時降伏斷開；同時並聯每支 3.5 MN 的黏滯阻尼器，塔位 4 支、過渡墩 2 支，主墩行程 −1,650 至 +1,850 mm，過渡墩 ±2,600 mm。熔斷限制器提供常時剛度，阻尼器在熔斷後限制擺幅並消耗能量，兩者分工讓風與地震的需求不必用同一個元件妥協。

海床沉積層厚度超過 500 m，以黏土為主夾砂與粉土，調查至海床下 100 m 仍未見岩盤，打樁到岩盤不可行。營運單位公開資料指出，設計在每座墩下打入約 150 至 200 根直徑 2 m、長 25 至 30 m、間距 7 m 的中空鋼管，改良上部 20 m 土層，再鋪 3 m 厚礫石層，基礎直接坐在礫石上而不與鋼管連接。鋼管提高土壤的剪力強度與承載，避免基礎傾覆或大量沉陷；礫石層則讓基礎在強震時可以水平滑移，限制傳入上部結構的力量，這是「容量設計」觀念在基礎上的應用。

每座塔基礎直徑 90 m，上接由 38 m 漸縮到 26 m 的錐形墩身，再接邊長 38 m、由四支 4 m × 4 m 混凝土腿組成的塔座。營運單位公開資料指出，基礎底部在長 200 m、寬 100 m、深 14 m 的乾塢中製作，可同時做兩座；底部澆到約 15 m 高、具備足夠浮力後灌水浮出，拖到濕塢繼續在浮動狀態下接高錐形段，最後拖到墩位以壓艙水下沉就位。這個方法把大量混凝土作業移到岸邊受控環境，但浮運期間的吃水、穩定性與拖航條件都必須精確計算。

在水深達 65 m 的海峽中，浚挖海床、打入數百根鋼管插入物並鋪設 3 m 礫石層，都必須在穩定的平台上進行。營運單位公開資料指出，承包團隊為此打造專用的張力腿駁船：以錨鏈或錨索拉緊固定在海床上的重物，使駁船在波浪中幾乎不上下起伏，成為深水中的穩定工作平台。礫石層的平整度直接決定沉箱坐落後的傾斜，而塔的傾斜容許只有 1/500，所以水下鋪設的公差比一般海事工程嚴格得多，需要以精密測深與耙平工具反覆修整。

里翁—安提里翁大橋的組合橋面寬 27.2 m，每側兩根 2.2 m 高的鋼板梁，每 4 m 一道橫梁，上覆混凝土橋面板。營運單位公開資料指出，橋面以 12 m 長、約 340 t 的預製節段由浮吊放置，從每座塔向兩側平衡懸臂推進，最快每週約 60 m。平衡懸臂的關鍵在於兩側重量與斜索力保持對稱：只要一側先放節段，塔就要承受一個節段重量乘上懸臂長度的不平衡彎矩，懸臂愈長愈大。因此架設順序、臨時配重與斜索張拉步驟都必須事先排定。

營運單位公開資料指出，大橋的監測系統（WEASHM）有超過 100 個感測器、約 300 個通道，分布於塔、橋面、斜索與伸縮縫，以 100 Hz 取樣，量測荷重、斜索振動、橋面與塔振動、伸縮縫位移，以及風速風向與氣溫、橋面溫度。資料在四座塔內先以硬體處理並與門檻比較，再經光纖送到營運大樓與控制室；地震或強風等特殊事件開始 5 分鐘後會自動寄出報告。限制器上的荷重計特別重要，因為它直接告訴營運者熔斷元件是否接近或已經斷開，以及地震後是否需要重新校準。
感測器擅長記錄動態反應，但緩慢的構造位移、基礎沉陷與塔的傾斜需要另一種工具。營運單位公開資料指出，大橋定期以傳統測地方法（非永久系統）量測橋梁幾何以及兩岸與各墩位的構造位移。這些量測把每座塔、每個基礎放進同一個座標系統，追蹤多年下來的相對位移、沉陷與傾斜是否仍在設計預算內。塔高很大，即使很小的傾斜也會在塔頂放大成明顯位移，進而改變斜索幾何與索力，因此傾斜量測同時是結構與斜索系統的健康指標。
2005 年 1 月 28 日，通車約半年後，大橋 M1 塔頂附近一根斜索因雷擊引起火災而斷落橋面，交通隨即中斷，修復後重新開放。斜索系統供應商公開資料指出，其後在更換受損斜索的同時，為斜索加裝了雷擊防護。斜索斷失是斜張橋必須設計的意外工況：斷索瞬間釋放的能量使相鄰斜索與橋面產生動力放大，力量重新分配到鄰索；設計必須確認鄰索與橋面在這個工況下不會連鎖破壞，同時要有可以在交通管制下更換單索的程序。

大橋設計使用年限 120 年，營運單位公開的檢查與維護手冊經獨立工程師核可，將混凝土耐久列為主要風險之一：海水化學侵蝕、氯離子引致的鋼筋腐蝕與二氧化碳造成的中性化腐蝕。防護依暴露分區規定保護層厚度與混凝土性質；營運期以平板電腦搭配客製軟體做目視檢查，缺陷分類後標在電子圖上，並以定期試驗量測氯離子滲透與擴散係數以推估剩餘壽命。檢查方式涵蓋橋面檢修車、墩座吊籃、繩索技術檢查塔與斜索，以及以水下遙控載具或潛水員檢查墩座與沖刷防護。
procedureEn: The site lies in the tectonically active Gulf of Corinth. The operator’s published design criteria include a peak ground acceleration of 0.48 g, maximum spectral acceleration of 1.2 g for periods of 0.2 to 1.0 s, a 2,000-year return period (5% exceedance in the 120-year design life), up to 2 m of fault movement in any direction between adjacent piers and a pylon tilt allowance of 1/500. These demands rule out simply fixing the structure firmly: the foundations must be able to slide on the seabed and the deck must hang free of the pylons, so that seismic and tectonic movement is absorbed by controlled sliding, swinging and damping rather than resisted by member strength. The governing combination is the design earthquake plus 50% of the tectonic movements.

The Rion–Antirion deck is continuous over its full 2,252 m and fully suspended by stays rather than resting on the pylons, so in an earthquake it swings like a giant pendulum relative to them. The operator’s published layout has fuse restrainers of 10.5 MN at the main piers and 3.5 MN at the transition piers that hold the deck in strong wind and yield in an earthquake, in parallel with viscous dampers of 3.5 MN each, 4 at the pylons and 2 at the transition piers, with strokes of −1,650 to +1,850 mm at main piers and ±2,600 mm at transition piers. The fuses provide everyday stiffness and the dampers limit swing and dissipate energy after the fuses break, so wind and seismic demands need not be compromised in one device.

The seabed sediments are over 500 m thick, mainly clay with sand and silt, and no rock was found within 100 m below the seabed, so piling to rock was not possible. Operator data state that about 150 to 200 hollow steel pipes, 2 m in diameter, 25 to 30 m long and 7 m apart, were driven under each pier to improve the top 20 m of soil, then a 3 m gravel layer was placed and the footing rests on the gravel without connection to the pipes. The inclusions raise the soil’s shear strength and bearing to prevent overturning or large settlement, while the gravel lets the footing slide horizontally in a strong earthquake, capping the force transmitted to the superstructure: capacity design applied to a foundation.

Each pylon footing is 90 m in diameter, topped by a conical shaft tapering from 38 m to 26 m and a 38 m square pylon base with four 4 m × 4 m concrete legs. Operator data state that the footing bases were cast in a dry dock 200 m long, 100 m wide and 14 m deep, two at a time; once about 15 m high and buoyant, they were floated out, towed to a wet dock where the conical part was built while floating, then towed to position and sunk with ballast water. The method moves most concrete work to a controlled shore site, but draft, stability and towing conditions while afloat must be calculated precisely.

In a strait up to 65 m deep, dredging the seabed, driving hundreds of steel inclusions and placing a 3 m gravel layer all need a stable platform. Operator data state that the team built a purpose-made tension-leg barge, held down by taut lines to anchors on the seabed so it barely heaves in waves, giving a stable work platform in deep water. The flatness of the gravel bed determines the tilt of the caisson once landed, and the pylon tilt allowance is only 1/500, so underwater placement tolerances are much tighter than in ordinary marine work and need repeated precise soundings and screeding.

The Rion–Antirion composite deck is 27.2 m wide, with two 2.2 m deep steel plate girders on each side, cross girders every 4 m and a concrete deck slab. Operator data state that it was erected in 12 m precast segments of about 340 t placed by floating crane, advancing as balanced cantilevers from each pylon at up to about 60 m a week. The key is keeping weights and stay forces symmetrical on both sides: whenever one side receives a segment first, the pylon carries an unbalanced moment equal to a segment’s weight times the cantilever length, growing as the cantilever lengthens. Erection order, temporary counterweights and stay-stressing steps must therefore be planned in advance.

Operator data state that the bridge’s monitoring system (WEASHM) has more than 100 sensors and about 300 channels on pylons, deck, stays and expansion joints, sampling at 100 Hz to measure loads, stay vibration, deck and pylon vibration and joint displacement, as well as wind speed and direction, air and deck temperature. Data are processed in hardware inside the four pylons and compared with thresholds, then sent by optical fibre to the operations building and control room; an automatic report is emailed 5 minutes after a special event such as an earthquake or high wind begins. The load cells on the restrainers are especially important, telling the operator whether the fuses are near breaking or have broken and whether recalibration is needed after an earthquake.

Sensors excel at dynamic response, but slow tectonic movement, foundation settlement and pylon tilt need another tool. Operator data state that bridge geometry and tectonic movements at the shores and pier locations are measured at regular intervals by classical geodetic survey rather than a permanent system. These surveys place every pylon and footing in one coordinate system and track whether relative displacement, settlement and tilt over the years remain within the design budget. Because the pylons are tall, even a small tilt is magnified into a visible top displacement that changes stay geometry and forces, so tilt is a health indicator for both the structure and its stay system.

On 28 January 2005, about six months after opening, a stay near the top of pylon M1 failed after a lightning strike started a fire, and fell onto the deck; traffic was stopped and the bridge reopened after repair. The stay supplier’s public material states that lightning protection was installed while the damaged stay was replaced. Stay loss is an accidental case every cable-stayed bridge must be designed for: the sudden release of energy dynamically amplifies the response of neighbouring stays and the deck as force redistributes; design must confirm that neighbours and deck do not fail progressively and that a single stay can be replaced under traffic management.

The bridge has a 120-year design life, and the operator’s inspection and maintenance manual, approved by the independent engineer, lists concrete durability as a main risk: chemical attack by seawater, chloride-induced reinforcement corrosion and carbonation-induced corrosion. Protection relies on cover and concrete properties defined by exposure zone; in service, visual inspections use tablet PCs with customised software, classify defects and mark them on electronic drawings, and regular tests measure chloride penetration and diffusivity to estimate remaining life. Access includes the deck gantry, pier-base cradles, rope access for pylons and stays, and ROVs or divers for pier bases and scour protection.
evidence: 設計基準文件要同時列出地震、構造位移、溫度與風的位移需求，並以「位移預算」逐項分配給基礎滑移、阻尼器行程、伸縮縫與支承；任何預算超支都需設計者書面確認。
熔斷元件應設計為地震後可快速更換的消耗件，並在現場或倉庫保留備品；監測系統要把限制器荷重與阻尼器行程列為事件後自動報告的必要內容。
基礎設計報告要清楚區分「加勁土壤」與「樁基礎」的力學假設，並在圖上註明礫石層與基礎之間不得有任何連接；水下施工記錄（插入物位置、礫石厚度）要完整交接給營運單位。
浮運與下沉計畫要由海事工程師與結構設計者共同簽認，列出每個階段的重量、吃水、穩定性、氣象門檻與中止條件；乾塢閘門與排水系統的檢查要列為浮出前的停留檢查點。
水下作業的檢查計畫要訂出測深頻率、網格大小、容許高差與重整條件，並把礫石面驗收列為沉箱下沉前的停留檢查點，由業主代表與設計者共同簽認。
evidenceEn: The design basis should list displacement demands from earthquake, tectonic movement, temperature and wind together and allocate them in a displacement budget to foundation sliding, damper stroke, joints and bearings; any overrun requires the designer’s written confirmation.

Design fuses as sacrificial parts that can be replaced quickly after an earthquake, keep spares on site or in store, and make restrainer loads and damper strokes mandatory content of automatic post-event reports.

The foundation report must clearly separate the mechanics of reinforced soil from piled foundations and the drawings must state that nothing connects the footing to the gravel; underwater construction records of inclusion positions and gravel thickness must be handed over completely to the operator.

Float-out and sinking plans need joint sign-off by the marine engineer and the structural designer, listing weight, draft, stability, weather limits and abort criteria for each stage; inspection of the dock gate and dewatering systems is a hold point before float-out.

The underwater inspection plan should set sounding frequency, grid size, allowable differences and rework triggers, with gravel-bed acceptance a hold point before caisson sinking, signed jointly by the owner’s representative and the designer.
pitfalls: 若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。
若把插入物當成樁並與基礎剛接，地震時樁頭承受巨大剪力與彎矩，可能破壞；礫石層摩擦過高則基礎不滑移，上部結構承受遠超預期的地震力；插入物不足則基礎可能傾覆或產生不均勻沉陷。
礫石面不平或局部鬆散，沉箱坐落後產生初始傾斜與不均勻接觸，地震時滑移行為也偏離設計；張力腿系統若失效，駁船起伏使插入物定位與打設深度出現誤差。
門檻設定只依設計值而未考慮正常季節變化，會產生大量誤報，使營運人員忽略警報；感測器失效或時間不同步若未被發現，地震後的報告可能遺漏關鍵資訊，延誤檢查與交通管制決策。
未設計斷索工況時，一根斜索失效可能使鄰索超載連鎖斷裂；HDPE 套管可燃，若未考慮雷擊或車輛火災，火勢可能沿套管蔓延，使鋼絞線高溫失去強度。
pitfallsEn: Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses; relative pier movement beyond joint and damper travel could make the deck collide or unseat.

Treating the inclusions as piles rigidly tied to the footing would load their heads with huge shear and moment in an earthquake; gravel friction that is too high prevents sliding and exposes the superstructure to far larger forces; too few inclusions risk overturning or differential settlement.

An uneven or locally loose gravel surface gives the landed caisson an initial tilt and uneven contact, and makes its seismic sliding behaviour depart from design; if the tension-leg system fails, barge heave introduces errors in inclusion position and driving depth.

Thresholds set from design values without normal seasonal variation generate floods of false alarms that operators learn to ignore; undetected sensor failure or loss of synchronisation can leave key information out of a post-earthquake report, delaying inspection and traffic decisions.

Without a stay-loss case, one failure can overload neighbours in a chain; HDPE ducts are combustible, and without consideration of lightning or vehicle fire, flames can spread along the duct and heat the strands until they lose strength.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 以近塔混凝土、跨中鋼箱梁的混合主梁與倒 Y 形塔，把斜張橋跨徑推進到 856 m。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Pushing the cable-stayed span to 856 m with a hybrid concrete-near-pylon, steel-at-midspan deck and inverted-Y pylons. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: 主跨 856 m = 116 m 混凝土 + 624 m 鋼 + 116 m 混凝土
倒 Y 形混凝土塔高約 214 m，每座約 20,000 t
共 184 根斜索（8×23），每根 31 至 53 股 15.7 mm 鋼絞線
最短斜索約 95 m，最長約 460 m
每股鋼絞線的破斷力約 27 t，使用拉力約 10 t
鋼橋面約 5,600 t，由 32 個約 19.65 m 標準節段與中央合龍段組成
混凝土橋面每公尺約 33 至 50 t，鋼橋面約 8 至 11 t
橋面寬約 23.6 m，最高水位時淨空超過 50 m
塔基共 56 根直徑 2.10 m 樁，深約 40 至 55 m，每根承載約 3,000 t
factsEn: The 856 m main span is 116 m concrete + 624 m steel + 116 m concrete
The inverted-Y concrete pylons are about 214 m tall and about 20,000 t each
There are 184 stays (8×23), each of 31 to 53 strands of 15.7 mm
Stays range from about 95 m to 460 m long
Each strand breaks at about 27 t with a service tension of about 10 t
The steel deck is about 5,600 t, made of 32 standard segments of about 19.65 m plus a central closure
The concrete deck weighs about 33 to 50 t per metre and the steel deck about 8 to 11 t
The deck is about 23.6 m wide with over 50 m clearance at highest water
The pylons stand on 56 piles of 2.10 m diameter, about 40 to 55 m deep, each carrying about 3,000 t
timeline: 1988　諾曼第大橋開工，先施作基礎與橋墩
1994　主體工程完成，主跨鋼梁合龍
1995　1 月 20 日通車，以 856 m 創斜張橋跨徑紀錄
1999　日本多多羅大橋以更長跨徑打破紀錄
timelineEn: 1988 — Construction of the Pont de Normandie begins with foundations and piers
1994 — Main works are completed and the steel main span is closed
1995 — Opens on 20 January with a record 856 m cable-stayed span
1999 — Japan’s Tatara Bridge takes the span record

EN 1993-1-11 鋼結構：受拉構件設計
EN 1991-1-4 結構作用：風作用

EN 1993-1-11 Design of steel structures: Tension components
EN 1991-1-4 Actions on structures: Wind actions
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：諾曼第大橋
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Pont de Normandie
guides.concept: 諾曼第大橋 1995 年通車時以 856 m 主跨創下斜張橋紀錄：主跨中央 624 m 為正交異性鋼箱梁，兩端各 116 m 與背跨為預力混凝土，184 根鋼絞線斜索掛在兩座約 214 m 高的倒 Y 形混凝土塔上。本課從混合主梁的重量配置、倒 Y 形塔的抗扭貢獻、斜索與樁基，經混凝土平衡懸臂與鋼節段吊裝，到現地風量測、長索振動與阻尼器加裝、斜索多層防腐與單股更換。
guides.conceptEn: When it opened in 1995 the Pont de Normandie set the cable-stayed span record at 856 m: the central 624 m of the main span is an orthotropic steel box, while 116 m at each end and the back spans are prestressed concrete, and 184 strand stays hang from two inverted-Y concrete pylons about 214 m tall. The course runs from the weight layout of the hybrid deck, the torsional contribution of the inverted-Y pylons, stays and piles, through concrete balanced cantilevers and steel-segment lifting, to on-site wind measurement, long-stay vibration and retrofitted dampers, multi-layer stay corrosion protection and single-strand replacement.
procedure: 諾曼第大橋的主跨 856 m 由三段組成：從塔向河中伸出的 116 m 混凝土懸臂，以及中央 624 m 的鋼箱梁。官方技術資料列出混凝土橋面每公尺約 33 至 50 t，鋼橋面只有約 8 至 11 t。斜張橋主跨的重量對塔的力矩與距離成正比，越遠的重量越「貴」：把輕的鋼梁放在力臂最長的跨中，把重的混凝土放在靠近塔、力臂短的位置，同時讓背跨的混凝土高架橋成為天然壓重。這種配置降低了塔與背跨錨固的需求，是當時能把跨徑大幅推進的關鍵。
兩座塔高約 214 m、各重約 20,000 t，為預力混凝土倒 Y 形，兩肢向內傾斜，使塔以受壓為主。兩個斜索面從橋面兩側向上收斂到塔頂，從橫斷面看，斜索、橋面與塔肢形成三角形，橋面若要扭轉，一側斜索必須伸長、另一側縮短，斜索的軸向勁度因此直接提供扭轉勁度。這對主跨 856 m、寬約 23.6 m 的細長橋面非常重要，因為扭轉頻率與彎曲頻率的比值越高，扭轉顫振越不容易發生。

官方技術資料列出全橋 184 根斜索（8 組 × 23 根），每根由 31 至 53 股直徑 15.7 mm 的鋼絞線組成，長度約 95 m 至 460 m。每股鋼絞線破斷力約 27 t，使用拉力約 10 t。平行鋼絞線斜索的優點是可以逐股安裝與張拉，不需要一次吊起整根數十噸的成品索，日後也可以逐股抽換；缺點是每股之間的力量必須均勻，否則受力最大的那股會先疲勞或鬆弛。斜索在中央鋼梁段與混凝土段的錨固方式不同，錨具要分別配合鋼錨箱與混凝土錨塊。

諾曼第大橋位於塞納河口，表層為軟弱沖積層，塔的巨大垂直力必須以深樁傳到下方承載層。官方技術資料列出塔基礎共 56 根直徑 2.10 m 的樁（表列 4 × 14），總長 2,828 m，深度約 40 至 55 m，每根承載約 3,000 t；南側高架橋墩另有 52 根直徑 1.50 m 的樁。塔肢分開落在兩組樁上，樁群透過厚承台把兩肢的軸力與肢底水平推力整合起來。樁群設計除了承載，還要控制兩肢之間的不均勻沉陷，因為沉陷差會使塔頂偏移並改變斜索力。
主跨兩端的混凝土段由塔向河側伸出約 116 m，向岸側伸出約 96 m，以平衡懸臂方式逐節施作並逐對安裝斜索。混凝土懸臂在施工中持續承受自重與斜索力，彈性變形之外還有收縮與徐變，數年內會繼續下垂或上拱，影響後續鋼梁段的對接高程與完工線形。因此每一節段的模板都要設定預拱值，包含彈性撓度、徐變與收縮的預測，以及後續鋼梁、鋪面荷載造成的變形，讓最終線形符合設計。

中央 624 m 鋼梁由 32 個長約 19.65 m 的標準節段加上中央合龍段組成，官方資料列出鋼橋面約 5,600 t、平均每節約 180 t。每個鋼節段吊上懸臂端後先與前一節焊接，再安裝並張拉對應的一對斜索。合龍前，每座塔的懸臂已伸到主跨一半約 428 m，是當時前所未見的長度：懸臂端在新節段吊掛、斜索尚未張拉時會明顯下沉，在風中也會側向擺動。合龍段必須在兩個懸臂端高程、軸線與溫度都吻合的時段放入，並先以臨時連接鎖定。
法國建築科學技術中心（CSTB）為諾曼第大橋量測了橋址風況並模擬結構的氣動行為。河口開闊、靠近海岸，風速高且紊流明顯；設計時不能只看平均風速，還要知道紊流強度與陣風的空間相關性，因為細長的主梁與長索對短時間的陣風與紊流擾動（抖振）都會反應。現地量測提供平均風速剖面、紊流強度與頻譜，作為風洞試驗流場與抖振分析的輸入；施工期最長懸臂的抗風安全，也依這些統計判斷作業與停工的門檻。
諾曼第大橋通車不久，最長的斜索出現過大的振動，管理單位隨即加裝了多套阻尼系統。長索的固有阻尼非常小（往往只有千分之幾），風雨、渦流或橋面運動只要提供少量能量，振幅就會累積到肉眼可見。加裝在橋面附近的外置阻尼器把索的振動能量轉成熱，可達到的最大附加阻尼大約與阻尼器到錨點距離佔索長的比例成正比，所以阻尼器位置受橋面空間限制時，效果有上限。這次經驗也讓後來的斜張橋在設計階段就預留阻尼器與防振措施。

諾曼第大橋的斜索以蠟與聚乙烯套管保護，外層再包上具氣動外形的護套。現代鋼絞線斜索的防腐通常是多層屏障：每根鋼絲鍍鋅、鋼絞線外包蠟或油脂並擠壓一層個別的 HDPE 護套，整束再穿入外層 HDPE 套管；錨具區另有防水帽與填充材。多層屏障的意義在於任何單一層破損都不會立即讓鋼材暴露，最外層套管受紫外線、風振磨損與車輛撞擊，最內層的鋅則在水分到達時以犧牲方式保護鋼絲。耐久設計因此重在檢查每一層是否仍完整，而不是等到鋼絲生鏽。
平行鋼絞線斜索的一大優點是可以在不拆除整根索的情況下逐股抽換。抽出一股時，它原本承擔的力量會平均轉移到同一根索的其餘鋼絞線，總索力幾乎不變，因此可以在維持交通的情況下進行；新股穿入後以單股千斤頂張拉到與其他股相同的力量。諾曼第大橋由業主公會管理收費與維護，與鄰近的唐卡維爾懸索橋同屬一個營運體系。營運期的交接資料必須讓維護團隊知道每根索的股數、各股原始力量、錨具型號與防護層構造，才能安全規劃抽換。
procedureEn: The 856 m main span of the Pont de Normandie has three parts: a 116 m concrete cantilever reaching out from each pylon and a central 624 m steel box. The official technical sheet lists the concrete deck at about 33 to 50 t per metre and the steel deck at only about 8 to 11 t. Main-span weight acts on the pylon in proportion to its distance, so remote weight is the most costly: placing the light steel girder at mid-span where the lever arm is longest and the heavy concrete near the pylon where it is short, while the concrete back-span viaduct acts as natural ballast, reduces the demand on pylons and back-span anchorage. This layout was key to the large jump in span at the time.

The two pylons are prestressed concrete inverted Y shapes about 214 m tall and about 20,000 t each, with legs leaning inward so the pylon works mainly in compression. The two cable planes rise from both deck edges and converge at the pylon head; in cross-section, stays, deck and pylon legs form a triangle, so twisting the deck requires one plane of stays to lengthen and the other to shorten, and their axial stiffness directly supplies torsional stiffness. This matters greatly for an 856 m main span with a deck only about 23.6 m wide, because the higher the ratio of torsional to bending frequency, the less likely torsional flutter becomes.

The official technical sheet lists 184 stays (8 groups × 23), each made of 31 to 53 strands of 15.7 mm diameter and about 95 m to 460 m long. Each strand has a breaking load of about 27 t and a service tension of about 10 t. Parallel-strand stays can be installed and stressed strand by strand, avoiding lifting a finished cable weighing tens of tonnes, and strands can later be replaced one at a time; the catch is that force must be even among strands, or the most heavily loaded one fatigues or relaxes first. Anchorage differs between the central steel zone and the concrete zones, so anchorages must suit steel anchor boxes and concrete anchor blocks respectively.

The Pont de Normandie stands in the Seine estuary, where soft alluvium overlies the bearing strata, so the pylons’ large vertical forces must travel down deep piles. The official technical sheet lists 56 pylon piles of 2.10 m diameter (tabulated as 4 × 14), 2,828 m in total length, about 40 to 55 m deep and each carrying about 3,000 t; the southern viaduct piers have another 52 piles of 1.50 m. The pylon legs land on separate pile groups, and thick pile caps combine the leg axial forces with the horizontal thrust at the leg bases. Besides capacity, the groups must limit differential settlement between legs, which would tilt the pylon head and change stay forces.

The concrete zones at each end of the main span extend about 116 m from the pylon toward the river and about 96 m toward the shore, built by balanced cantilever segment by segment with stays installed in pairs. The concrete cantilever carries self-weight and stay forces throughout construction, and beyond elastic deformation it shrinks and creeps, continuing to sag or rise for years and affecting the connection level of the steel segments and the final profile. Each segment’s formwork is therefore set to a camber that includes predicted elastic deflection, creep and shrinkage and the deformation from later steel and surfacing loads, so that the final profile matches the design.

The central 624 m steel girder comprises 32 standard segments about 19.65 m long plus a central closure segment; the official sheet gives about 5,600 t of steel deck, about 180 t per segment on average. Each steel segment lifted to the cantilever tip is welded to the previous one before its pair of stays is installed and stressed. Before closure each pylon’s cantilever had reached half the main span, about 428 m, an unprecedented length: the tip drops noticeably while a new segment hangs before its stays are stressed, and it sways sideways in wind. The closure segment must go in when the two tips match in level, alignment and temperature, and be locked first with temporary connections.

France’s building science centre CSTB measured the wind at the Pont de Normandie site and simulated the structure’s aerodynamic behaviour. The open estuary near the coast brings high winds with marked turbulence; design cannot look only at mean wind speed but must know turbulence intensity and the spatial correlation of gusts, because a slender deck and long stays respond to short gusts and turbulent buffeting. Site measurements provide the mean wind profile, turbulence intensity and spectra used as inputs to wind-tunnel flow and buffeting analysis, and the same statistics set working and stop-work limits for the longest construction cantilever.

Shortly after the Pont de Normandie opened, its longest stays showed excessive vibration, and several damping systems were quickly retrofitted. The inherent damping of long stays is very small, often only a few thousandths, so a little energy from wind and rain, vortices or deck motion can build amplitudes visible to the eye. External dampers near the deck convert cable vibration energy into heat, and the maximum added damping is roughly proportional to the damper’s distance from the anchorage as a fraction of cable length, so effectiveness has a ceiling when deck space limits the damper position. The experience led later cable-stayed bridges to provide for dampers and vibration measures from the design stage.

The Pont de Normandie stays are protected by wax and polyethylene sheathing, with an outer cladding of aerodynamic profile. Modern strand stays usually have multi-layer protection: every wire is galvanised, each strand is coated in wax or grease and extruded with its own HDPE sheath, and the bundle runs inside an outer HDPE duct, with waterproof caps and filler at the anchorages. The point of multiple barriers is that no single breach exposes steel at once: the outer duct faces UV, vibration wear and vehicle impact, while the innermost zinc sacrificially protects the wires if water arrives. Durability work therefore focuses on checking that each layer is intact, not on waiting for wires to rust.

A major advantage of parallel-strand stays is that strands can be replaced one at a time without removing the whole cable. When one strand is withdrawn, its force spreads evenly over the remaining strands of the same stay and the total force barely changes, so work can proceed under traffic; the new strand is threaded in and stressed by a mono-strand jack to match the others. The Pont de Normandie’s owner manages tolls and maintenance together with the nearby Tancarville suspension bridge. Handover data must tell the maintenance team each stay’s strand count, original strand forces, anchorage type and protection build-up so that replacements can be planned safely.
evidence: 混合主梁的設計文件應列出每段的設計單位重、容許偏差與量測方式，並把鋼混分界處的重量與勁度變化納入施工控制；重量偏差超過約 3% 時須由設計者重新評估。
塔型選擇報告應同時列出頻率比、顫振臨界風速與塔肢內力的比較；塔肢交會區與錨固區的鋼筋、預力配置要以三維模型檢查施工可行性，避免混凝土澆置不密實。
斜索安裝規範要寫明各股力量容許偏差、量測方法與抽查比例，並規定錨具防水帽與填充材料的施工檢查；每根索的安裝紀錄要能追溯到鋼絞線批號。
樁基施工紀錄應逐根保存並與地層剖面對照，異常樁由設計者評估是否補樁；塔施工期間把兩肢沉陷差列為定期量測項目並設定警戒值。
每節段的預拱表要列出各項組成並由施工控制工程師簽認，量測固定在清晨溫度均勻時進行；混凝土配比或養護條件改變時，須重新試驗彈性模數與徐變。
evidenceEn: Hybrid-deck documents should list each zone’s design unit weight, tolerance and measurement method and include the weight and stiffness change at the steel–concrete boundary in construction control; deviations beyond about 3% require reassessment by the designer.

The pylon-form study should compare frequency ratio, flutter speed and leg forces together; reinforcement and prestress at the leg junction and anchorage zone should be checked for buildability in a 3D model to avoid poorly compacted concrete.

The stay installation specification should state the allowable strand-force deviation, measurement method and sampling rate and require checks on anchorage caps and filler; each stay’s record must trace back to strand lot numbers.

Keep pile records individually and compare with the ground profile, with the designer deciding on extra piles for anomalous ones; make differential settlement between legs a routine measurement with an alert value during pylon construction.

Each segment’s camber table should list its components and be signed by the construction-control engineer, with surveys fixed at dawn when temperature is uniform; any change in mix or curing requires new modulus and creep tests.
pitfalls: 若混凝土段實際重量高於設計（例如超厚或模板變形），塔身與背跨錨固承受額外彎矩，跨中鋼梁的線形也會隨之改變；鋼梁若因設計變更增重而未重算，塔頂偏位與斜索力會偏離預測。
若各股力量不均，受力最大的鋼絞線在活載與風振下承受較大應力幅，可能先在錨口疲勞斷裂，隨後負荷轉移到其他股，形成漸進劣化；錨具夾片咬合不良則可能滑移。
若徐變參數估計錯誤，混凝土懸臂端與後續鋼梁的對接高程出現誤差，需強制頂壓或加配重才能對接；完工後線形持續變化，可能造成伸縮縫與鋪面異常。
若以平滑流風洞試驗代替紊流場，抖振反應會被低估，施工中的大懸臂在中等風速下就出現超出預期的擺動；風速計安裝在受結構遮蔽的位置，則量測值偏低而誤導作業決策。
套管接頭開裂或錨具防水帽失效，雨水沿索流入下錨頭積聚，鋼絞線在錨口附近局部腐蝕，而這個位置正是應力集中與疲勞最嚴重的地方；外層破損若長期未修補，紫外線與水分會逐層破壞內部防護。
pitfallsEn: If concrete segments end up heavier than designed, for example through over-thickness or formwork distortion, pylons and back-span anchorage take extra moment and the steel mid-span profile shifts; added steel weight from design changes not reanalysed pushes pylon-top displacement and stay forces away from prediction.

Uneven strand forces subject the most loaded strand to larger stress ranges under traffic and wind vibration, so it may fatigue at the anchor exit first and shift load to others in progressive deterioration; poorly seated wedges can slip.

Wrong creep parameters leave a level mismatch between the concrete cantilever tip and the following steel segments that must be forced together by jacking or ballast; a profile that keeps changing after completion can distress joints and surfacing.

Testing in smooth flow instead of turbulent flow underestimates buffeting, so the long construction cantilever sways more than expected at moderate wind; anemometers placed in the structure’s wind shadow read low and mislead site decisions.

Cracked duct joints or failed caps let rainwater run down into the lower anchorage and pool, corroding strands right at the anchor exit where stress concentration and fatigue are worst; outer damage left unrepaired lets UV and water strip away the inner layers one by one.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。

Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：皇后渡口大橋
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Queensferry Crossing
guides.concept: 皇后渡口大橋含引橋全長約 2.7 km，三座約 207 m 高的單柱塔支承 221+650+650+221 m 的斜張橋段，通車時為全球最長的三塔斜張橋，也是規模最大、斜索在跨中交叉的斜張橋。本課從中塔缺乏背索錨固的問題、交叉索的勁度、鋼—混凝土組合橋面與塔基沉箱，經平衡懸臂吊裝與兩處合龍，到防風屏障與車輛穩定、約 2,000 個感測器的監測、積冰掉落與營運檢查交接。
guides.conceptEn: The Queensferry Crossing is about 2.7 km long including approaches; three monopole towers about 207 m tall carry a 221+650+650+221 m cable-stayed section, making it, at opening, the world’s longest three-tower cable-stayed bridge and the largest with stays that cross at mid-span. The course runs from the central tower’s lack of back-stay anchorage, the stiffness of crossing stays, the composite steel–concrete deck and tower caissons, through balanced-cantilever lifting and two closures, to wind shielding and vehicle stability, monitoring with about 2,000 sensors, falling ice and operational inspection handover.
procedure: 兩塔斜張橋的每座塔都有一側背跨，背索錨在靠近橋台、由許多橋墩支撐的背跨上，塔頂因此被牢牢拉住。三塔斜張橋的中塔兩側都是 650 m 的主跨，沒有固定的背跨可以錨索：當活載只作用在其中一跨時，那一跨下垂，中塔被拉向該側，另一跨上拱，結構整體變得很柔。若只靠中塔自身的彎曲勁度抵抗，塔必須非常粗大。皇后渡口大橋的解法是讓三座塔的斜索在兩個主跨的跨中互相交叉重疊，相鄰塔的斜索彼此牽制，使中塔頂端的位移受到相鄰塔與橋面的約束。
交叉斜索的作用像一條條斜向的彈簧：當中塔被拉向一側時，從相鄰塔伸到跨中、並錨在重疊區的斜索會被拉長，產生反向的水平分力，把中塔與橋面拉回。每根斜索提供的水平勁度與鋼截面積、彈性模數成正比，與索長成反比，並乘上水平夾角餘弦的平方，所以較平、較短的索效率較好。重疊段越長，參與牽制的索越多，但同一段橋面上兩組斜索的錨固點也越密集，增加錨固與檢修的複雜度。設計者以全橋分析在勁度與構造之間取得平衡。
皇后渡口大橋的橋面寬約 39.8 m，由鋼梁（槽型箱）加上鋼筋混凝土橋面板組成；營運單位說明橋面鋼槽內設有檢修走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km。組合橋面讓混凝土承受壓力與局部輪載，鋼梁承受拉力與整體彎曲，兩者以剪力釘連成一體。斜張橋的組合橋面還要承受斜索水平分力累積的巨大軸壓，越靠近塔軸壓越大；混凝土在軸壓下的徐變與乾縮會把力量逐漸轉移給鋼梁，剪力連接件需承受這種長期重分配的界面剪力。
交通部門的專案通訊指出，南北兩座塔基以臨時鋼沉箱施作，中塔則以圍堰圍住，基礎完成後臨時構造都已移除，讓塔看起來直接從海中升起。鋼沉箱下沉到河床並坐落在岩盤或承載層後，先以水下灌注的封底混凝土封住底部，再抽水在乾燥環境中澆築基礎。封底混凝土的厚度取決於外部水頭：抽乾後，水壓從下方向上推，封底的自重加上與壁面的摩擦必須足以平衡，否則封底會上浮或破裂。
皇后渡口大橋的橋面鋼節段在中國與西班牙製造、海運到場，再從三座塔各向兩側以平衡懸臂吊裝，同時有六個懸臂前緣推進。每個節段吊上後焊接或栓接，安裝對應斜索並張拉，再澆築或安裝橋面板。六個前緣同時作業可縮短工期，但每座塔都必須保持兩側平衡，海灣的潮流、風與航道限制吊裝窗口；某一前緣延誤時，必須檢查其他前緣是否能繼續而不造成過大的不平衡。施工控制團隊要同時管理三組懸臂的幾何與索力。
三塔體系有兩個 650 m 主跨，每跨都在跨中由兩側懸臂會合。由於兩跨共用中塔，一跨合龍時的強制調整會經中塔影響另一跨；而且交叉斜索的錨點在跨中重疊，合龍段附近的斜索力與高程互相牽連。合龍前兩個懸臂端的高差來自製造誤差、溫度差、日照與風，通常以調整附近幾根斜索的索力、加減臨時配重或以千斤頂微調來消除，再以臨時鎖定裝置固定並完成接合。合龍順序與每一步的調整量必須事先模擬。
相鄰的福斯公路大橋在強風時常需限制高側車輛或封橋，影響蘇格蘭東部交通。皇后渡口大橋在兩側車道設置防風屏障，交通部門說明其設計目的是讓大橋在風速達約 115 mph（約 51 m/s）時仍能保持開放。屏障降低車道高度的風速與紊流，減少高側車輛的側向力與翻覆力矩；但屏障本身也增加橋面迎風面積與氣動阻力，並可能改變斷面的渦振特性，因此必須與橋面一起進行風洞試驗，在行車安全與結構風荷載之間取得平衡。
設計團隊公開資料指出，皇后渡口大橋約有 2,000 個感測器即時監測整體行為，資料送入雲端結構健康監測系統。交通部門說明路面在橋上沒有中間伸縮縫，行車因而平順，這代表溫度造成的伸縮集中在兩端的伸縮縫與支承，伸縮縫開口與溫度的關係就成為最直接的健康指標之一：若關係線斜率改變或出現遲滯，可能代表支承卡滯、阻尼器失效或結構約束改變。監測資料也用來比對設計預測的應變、索力與加速度，累積長期基準。
2020 年 2 月 11 日，皇后渡口大橋通車約 30 個月後首次全面封橋，原因是塔上積冰掉落到車道並砸損 8 輛車。高聳的塔與斜索在凍雨、濕雪與低溫高濕的天氣中會結冰，日照或氣溫回升時冰層鬆脫，從百公尺以上高度落下，對車輛與人員構成直接危險。冰塊的質量與墜落高度決定撞擊能量，因此對策包括氣象預警、即時監測積冰狀態、降速或封閉車道，以及長期研究塔與斜索表面的防冰或除冰措施。

交通部門的專案通訊指出，橋面鋼槽內設有走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km，讓檢查人員在不封閉車道的情況下沿橋面內部巡查焊道、剪力連接與排水。斜張橋的長期維護重點包括 288 根斜索的錨具與套管、交叉區的錨固細部、塔內通道、伸縮縫與支承，以及防風屏障。英國公路結構物的檢查制度通常把例行的一般檢查與較深入的主要檢查分開安排，交接時要把每個構件的檢查方法、通道與基準狀態寫清楚，讓營運單位能在數十年內持續執行。
procedureEn: In a two-tower cable-stayed bridge each tower has a back span, and its back stays are anchored near the abutment on a span supported by many piers, so the tower head is held firmly. In a three-tower bridge the central tower has a 650 m main span on both sides and no fixed back span to anchor to: when live load occupies only one span, that span sags, the central tower is pulled toward it, the other span rises and the whole structure is soft. Resisting this by the central tower’s own bending stiffness alone would demand a massive tower. The Queensferry solution is to let stays from adjacent towers cross and overlap at mid-span of both main spans, so neighbouring towers restrain each other and the central tower head is held by the adjacent towers and the deck.

Crossing stays act like inclined springs: when the central tower is pulled to one side, stays from the adjacent tower reaching into the overlap zone at mid-span are stretched and produce an opposing horizontal component that pulls the tower and deck back. Each stay’s horizontal stiffness is proportional to its steel area and modulus, inversely proportional to its length, and multiplied by the square of the cosine of its angle, so flatter and shorter stays are more effective. A longer overlap brings more stays into play but crowds two sets of anchorages on the same stretch of deck, complicating anchorage and maintenance. Designers balance stiffness against detailing with global analysis.

The Queensferry deck is about 39.8 m wide, made of steel girders in tub-box form with a reinforced concrete deck slab; the operator notes walkways inside the steel tubs, one about 2.7 km long. In a composite deck the concrete takes compression and local wheel loads, the steel takes tension and global bending, and shear studs make them act together. A cable-stayed composite deck also carries large axial compression accumulated from the horizontal stay components, highest near the towers; creep and shrinkage of the concrete under this compression gradually transfer force to the steel, and the shear connectors must carry the interface shear from this long-term redistribution.

Project newsletters state that the north and south tower foundations were built inside temporary steel caissons and the central tower inside a cofferdam, with the temporary works removed afterwards so the towers appear to rise straight from the sea. A steel caisson is sunk to the bed and seated on rock or the bearing stratum, the base is sealed with tremie concrete placed underwater, and the water is then pumped out so the foundation can be cast in the dry. The seal thickness depends on the external head: once dewatered, water pressure pushes up from below, and the seal’s self-weight plus friction on the walls must balance it or the seal will lift or crack.

The Queensferry deck segments were made in China and Spain, shipped to site and lifted as balanced cantilevers from each of the three towers in both directions, with six cantilever fronts advancing at once. Each segment is lifted, welded or bolted, its stays installed and stressed, and its deck slab cast or placed. Six fronts shorten the programme, but every tower must stay balanced, and tides, wind and shipping limit lifting windows; when one front falls behind, the team must check whether the others can continue without excessive imbalance. Construction control must manage the geometry and stay forces of three sets of cantilevers at once.

A three-tower system has two 650 m main spans, each closed at mid-span where cantilevers from both sides meet. Because both spans share the central tower, forced adjustments at one closure travel through the tower to the other span, and since crossing stays anchor in the overlap at mid-span, stay forces and levels near the closure are interlinked. Level differences between tips before closure come from fabrication error, temperature, sunshine and wind, and are usually removed by adjusting forces in a few nearby stays, adding or removing temporary ballast or fine jacking, then fixing the tips with temporary locks before joining. The closure order and every adjustment step must be simulated in advance.

The neighbouring Forth Road Bridge often had to restrict high-sided vehicles or close in strong winds, disrupting traffic in eastern Scotland. The Queensferry Crossing has wind shielding along both carriageways, which the transport agency says is designed to keep the bridge open in winds up to about 115 mph (about 51 m/s). The shielding lowers wind speed and turbulence at lane level, reducing side force and overturning moment on high-sided vehicles, but it also adds windward area and drag to the deck and can change the section’s vortex behaviour, so it must be wind-tunnel tested with the deck to balance traffic safety against structural wind load.

The design team states that about 2,000 sensors monitor the Queensferry Crossing’s global behaviour in real time, feeding a cloud-based structural health monitoring system. The transport agency notes there are no intermediate road-level joints on the bridge, giving a smooth ride; this means thermal movement concentrates at the end joints and bearings, so the relation between joint opening and temperature becomes one of the most direct health indicators: a change in slope or new hysteresis may signal seized bearings, failed dampers or changed restraint. The data are also compared with predicted strains, stay forces and accelerations to build long-term baselines.

On 11 February 2020, about 30 months after opening, the Queensferry Crossing closed fully for the first time because ice falling from the towers onto the carriageway damaged eight vehicles. Tall towers and stays accrete ice in freezing rain, wet snow and cold humid weather, and when sunshine or rising temperature loosens it, it falls from heights above 100 m, a direct danger to vehicles and people. Ice mass and fall height determine impact energy, so responses include weather warnings, real-time monitoring of icing, speed restrictions or lane closures, and longer-term study of anti-icing or de-icing measures for tower and stay surfaces.

Project newsletters note walkways inside the steel deck tubs, one about 2.7 km long, letting inspectors patrol welds, shear connection and drainage inside the deck without closing lanes. Long-term maintenance of a cable-stayed bridge centres on the anchorages and ducts of all 288 stays, the anchorage details in the crossing zones, tower access, joints and bearings, and the wind shielding. UK highway-structure inspection regimes usually separate routine general inspections from deeper principal inspections, and handover must record each component’s inspection method, access and baseline condition so the operator can sustain the regime for decades.
evidence: 多塔斜張橋的設計基準要明列單跨加載、棋盤式加載與不對稱風載等工況，並把中塔頂位移列為主要使用性指標；結構體系比選報告應比較交叉索、加勁中塔與穩定索等方案。
交叉區的錨固細部要以局部模型與疲勞評估確認，並為兩組斜索各自保留檢修與更換空間；索力驗收表應把交叉索列為獨立一組，容許偏差可比一般索更嚴格。
組合橋面的施工順序（鋼梁架設、橋面板澆置、斜索張拉）要在施工控制模型中逐步模擬，並規定混凝土齡期與張拉時程的關係；防水層與排水細部須在橋面板完成後立即施作。
沉箱與圍堰屬臨時工程，需有獨立的設計、檢查與簽認；抽水程序要列出分階段水位、量測項目與停止條件，並把封底驗收設為停留檢查點。
節段在工廠要做預拼裝與尺寸驗收，海運前記錄重量與幾何；施工控制計畫應有六個前緣的整體排程、不平衡上限與延誤時的處置規則，並每日更新。
evidenceEn: The design basis for a multi-tower bridge should list single-span, alternate-span and unbalanced wind cases and make central-tower displacement a key serviceability indicator; the system study should compare crossing stays, a stiffened central tower and stabilising cables.

Verify crossing-zone anchorage details with local models and fatigue assessment and keep access and replacement space for both sets of stays; list crossing stays as a separate group in the force acceptance table, possibly with tighter tolerances than other stays.

Model the sequence of steel erection, slab casting and stay stressing step by step in construction control, linking concrete age to the stressing schedule; install waterproofing and drainage details immediately after the slab is complete.

Caissons and cofferdams are temporary works needing their own design, checking and sign-off; the dewatering procedure should list staged water levels, measurements and stop criteria, with acceptance of the seal a hold point.

Pre-assemble and dimensionally accept segments at the factory and record weight and geometry before shipping; the construction-control plan should hold a combined schedule for all six fronts, imbalance limits and rules for delays, updated daily.
pitfalls: 若中塔勁度不足又沒有交叉索或其他穩定措施，單跨重車隊或不對稱風載會使中塔大幅偏擺，主跨撓度與塔底彎矩超出設計，伸縮縫與鋪面受損；斜索力在兩跨之間大幅來回轉移也會加速疲勞。
剪力釘不足或焊接不良時，組合作用喪失，鋼梁承受超出設計的彎矩與軸力；橋面板若因乾縮與溫度產生貫穿裂縫且未處理，除冰鹽會滲入腐蝕鋼筋與鋼梁頂板。
若某座塔兩側進度差太多，塔頂偏位與塔底彎矩超出施工期容許；節段製造誤差未在出廠時檢出，到現場才發現接頭不吻合，會造成延誤與強制對位的殘餘應力。
若屏障孔隙率或高度在施工中更改而未重新試驗，橋面可能出現新的渦振，或屏障後方的減風效果不如預期，高側車在陣風中失控；屏障固定件疲勞斷裂也可能讓面板掉落。
若沒有積冰預警與管制程序，冰塊落下時車輛正常高速通行，可能擊破擋風玻璃造成事故；過度保守的封橋則造成大量交通中斷與經濟損失。
pitfallsEn: A central tower lacking stiffness, with no crossing stays or other stabilisation, sways heavily under a heavy convoy on one span or unbalanced wind, pushing deflections and tower-base moments beyond design and damaging joints and surfacing; large back-and-forth shifts of stay force between spans also accelerate fatigue.

Too few or poorly welded studs lose composite action and overload the steel girder in moment and axial force; through cracks from shrinkage and temperature left untreated let de-icing salt reach and corrode the reinforcement and the top flange.

If one tower’s two sides drift too far apart in progress, tower-head displacement and base moment exceed construction limits; fabrication errors not caught at the factory surface as mismatched joints on site, causing delay and residual stress from forced fit-up.

Changing shielding porosity or height during construction without retesting can introduce new vortex vibration or weaker lane-level shelter, letting high-sided vehicles lose control in gusts; fatigue failure of shield fixings can drop panels.

Without icing warnings and control procedures, ice falls on traffic moving at full speed and can smash windscreens and cause crashes; overly cautious closures cause major disruption and economic loss.

guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 建築造型主導的單塔不對稱斜張橋：彎折鋼塔、背索、開合橋與通車後的斜索雨風振動。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: An architecture-led single-pylon asymmetric bridge: bent steel pylon, back stays, bascule span and post-opening rain–wind stay vibration. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: 全長 802 m，斜張主跨約 284 m
不對稱彎折鋼塔高約 139 m（原構想約 150 m 混凝土塔）
南端開合橋長 89 m，為西歐最大最重的開合橋
橋面寬 33.8 m，通航淨空約 12.5 m
兩根箱形主梁高 2.25 m、寬 1.25 m，橫梁間距 4.9 m、懸臂 6.7 m
公開導覽資料列出前索 32 根、背索 8 根
1993 年 9 月 1 日開工，約 3 年 3 天後於 1996 年 9 月啟用
預算 3.65 億荷蘭盾（1991 年幣值），實際約 3.62 億荷蘭盾（1996 年幣值）
factsEn: Total length 802 m with a cable-stayed main span of about 284 m
The asymmetric bent steel pylon is about 139 m tall (the concept was a concrete pylon of about 150 m)
The south bascule is 89 m long, the largest and heaviest in Western Europe
The deck is 33.8 m wide with about 12.5 m navigation clearance
Two box spines are 2.25 m deep and 1.25 m wide, with cross beams every 4.9 m cantilevering 6.7 m
Public guide material lists 32 front stays and 8 back stays
Construction began on 1 September 1993 and the bridge opened about 3 years and 3 days later in September 1996
The budget was 365 million guilders at 1991 prices, with about 362 million spent at 1996 prices
timeline: 1990　Ben van Berkel 提出受阿拉米略橋啟發的設計構想
1991　11 月市議會確定 139 m 鋼塔加背索的最終塔形
1993　9 月 1 日開工，並在三年多後如期完工
1996　9 月正式啟用，10 月開放交通後出現斜索雨風振動
1996–1997　臨時措施後約一年，主跨斜索加裝永久調諧液壓阻尼器
timelineEn: 1990 — Ben van Berkel proposes a design concept inspired by the Alamillo Bridge
1991 — In November the city council fixes the final 139 m steel pylon with back stays
1993 — Construction begins on 1 September and finishes on schedule just over three years later
1996 — Officially opened in September; rain–wind stay vibration appears after traffic starts in October
1996–1997 — About a year after temporary measures, permanent tuned hydraulic dampers are fitted to main-span stays

NEN 6786 荷蘭活動橋設計規定
fib Bulletin 30 預力鋼斜拉索系統驗收建議

NEN 6786 Dutch rules for the design of movable bridges

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：伊拉斯謨大橋
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Erasmus Bridge
guides.concept: 鹿特丹的伊拉斯謨大橋全長 802 m，以 139 m 高、彎折不對稱的鋼塔支承約 284 m 的斜張主跨，南端另有 89 m 的開合橋；橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根箱形主梁與每 4.9 m 一道的橫梁組成，承載車道、電車軌道與人行自行車道。本課從背索如何降低塔的彎矩、橋面橫向受力、鋼塔焊接、開合橋配重與電車軌伸縮，到 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測、調諧液壓阻尼器、塗裝與開合機械的長期維護。
guides.conceptEn: Rotterdam’s Erasmus Bridge is 802 m long; a bent, asymmetric 139 m steel pylon carries a cable-stayed main span of about 284 m, and an 89 m bascule sits at the south end. The 33.8 m deck, two box spines with cross beams every 4.9 m, carries traffic lanes, tram tracks, footpaths and cycle tracks. The course runs from how back stays cut pylon bending, transverse deck action, pylon welding, bascule counterweighting and tram-rail expansion, to observation of rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening, tuned hydraulic dampers and long-term care of coatings and bascule machinery.
procedure: 伊拉斯謨大橋的最初構想受阿拉米略橋啟發，是一座約 150 m 高、沒有背索、以塔身自重與傾斜平衡主跨的混凝土塔。工程可行性檢討後改為 139 m 的鋼塔並加上背索，原因是城市橋梁的活載變化很大：60 t 級卡車與電車只停在主跨某處時，若沒有背索，主跨斜索拉力的變化全部要由塔身彎曲承受，塔底彎矩隨交通劇烈起伏。背索把塔頂連到岸側錨固點，活載造成的水平力增量大部分由背索的軸力平衡，塔主要承受壓力，彎矩與疲勞應力幅都大幅降低。

伊拉斯謨大橋的橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根高 2.25 m、寬 1.25 m 的箱形主梁承擔縱向彎曲與斜索錨固，四線車道與兩條電車軌道位於兩根主梁之間；橫梁每 4.9 m 一道，並向兩側各懸出 6.7 m 支承人行道與自行車道。電車軌道把集中輪載固定在同一位置反覆通過，對軌道下方的橫梁與主梁連接造成高循環疲勞；懸臂部分雖然荷載較小，但彎矩隨懸出長度平方增加，橫梁根部是應力集中的位置。橫梁也把兩根主梁連成整體，提供抗扭能力。
伊拉斯謨大橋的彎折鋼塔由大量形狀各異的鋼板組成，代爾夫特理工大學的研究指出，當時的電腦輔助設計讓鋼板可以直接由電腦切割，使構件無縫拼合。彎折造型讓每一節塔段的角度與斷面都不同，焊接時的熱收縮會讓每節塔段縮短、扭曲，累積起來可能使塔頂偏離設計位置數公分以上。製造廠必須預估焊接收縮並在下料時預留長度，以夾具與焊接順序控制變形，並在工廠預拼裝確認節段介面吻合，現場接頭才能順利對齊。
伊拉斯謨大橋南端的 89 m 開合橋被描述為西歐最大、最重的開合橋，讓高桅船隻能通過。開合橋繞耳軸旋轉，橋面葉板的重量對耳軸產生很大的力矩；若完全由油壓缸或機械驅動直接抬起，所需動力與構件尺寸將非常龐大。因此在耳軸後方設配重，使葉板與配重對耳軸的力矩接近平衡，驅動系統只需克服少量不平衡、摩擦、風力與慣性。設計時通常保留一點「葉板端偏重」，讓橋在關閉狀態下穩定壓在支承上，不會被風或車輛振動抬起。
不對稱的彎折鋼塔在架設完成、尚未掛索時，自重偏心就會讓塔頂偏向一側；掛上主跨斜索並承受橋面重量後，塔頂又被拉向主跨。施工控制的目標是讓塔在成橋恆載下回到設計幾何，因此通常要先讓塔頂帶著預偏量，並按照預先計算的順序分批張拉前索與背索。每一批張拉都會同時改變塔頂位置、橋面高程與已張拉斜索的力量，必須用施工階段分析預測，並以量測確認後才能進行下一批。
斜張段的鋼橋面隨溫度伸縮，開合橋葉板則必須在每次關閉時準確落回原位，兩者之間的介面同時要容許伸縮、讓車輛平順通過，還要讓電車軌道連續。一般伸縮縫只需處理路面，但電車軌是連續鋼軌，跨越伸縮縫或開合縫時需要軌道伸縮調節器或可分離的軌道接頭，且軌頂高差必須控制在毫米級，否則電車通過時產生衝擊與脫軌風險。介面處的支承、伸縮縫、軌道接頭與鎖定裝置因此必須作為一個系統設計與調整。

伊拉斯謨大橋 1996 年 10 月開放交通後不久，就被觀察到在強風中擺動，隨後主跨斜索出現大振幅的氣動不穩定，被確認為雨風共同作用的振動：雨水在斜索表面形成沿索流下的水線，改變斷面形狀與氣流分離，使原本穩定的圓形斷面在特定風速與風向下吸收能量。代爾夫特理工大學的研究也提到大橋早期在雨、風與結構共同作用下出現擺動並短暫封閉。觀測這類振動要同時記錄斜索加速度、風速風向與降雨，因為只有三者同時符合條件時才會發生。
伊拉斯謨大橋在臨時措施之後約一年，為主跨斜索加裝了永久的調諧液壓阻尼器。阻尼器連接斜索與橋面，裝在靠近錨點的位置；斜索振動時阻尼器的活塞往復運動，把能量轉成熱。阻尼器係數必須「調諧」：太小時活塞幾乎不受阻、消能少；太大時阻尼器像固定點，斜索在阻尼器處形成新的節點，振動照樣發生。最佳係數取決於索力、索的單位質量、阻尼器位置與目標模態，因此每一組索可能需要不同的設定。
伊拉斯謨大橋以淺藍色鋼塔為城市地標，鋼塔、主梁與橫梁都依賴塗裝系統防止腐蝕。馬斯河港區的潮濕空氣、工業與交通排放，以及冬季除冰鹽，會逐年消耗塗層；塗層劣化通常從邊角、焊道、螺栓與排水不良處開始。塗裝維護的經濟性取決於時機：在塗層仍完整、只需補塗面漆時處理，成本與交通影響都遠小於等到底漆失效、鋼材生鏽後全面噴砂重塗。地標橋的顏色與外觀也是業主要維持的價值，維護計畫需同時考慮防蝕與外觀。

開合橋的耳軸、油壓缸、鎖定裝置、煞車與控制系統，是伊拉斯謨大橋除了斜張結構之外的另一個關鍵系統。每次開合都讓耳軸軸承與驅動元件承受一次荷載循環，數十年下來的循環數足以構成疲勞與磨耗問題；控制系統還要與號誌、電車與船舶交通連鎖，確保開合時橋上無車。代爾夫特理工大學的研究也記錄了 2009 至 2010 年冬季冰柱形成、大橋封閉數日的事件，說明營運單位必須同時處理機械、結構與天候風險。完整的運轉紀錄是判斷何時檢修或更換元件的依據。
procedureEn: The Erasmus Bridge concept, inspired by the Alamillo Bridge, began as a concrete pylon about 150 m tall with no back stays, balancing the main span by its own weight and lean. After engineering review it became a 139 m steel pylon with back stays, because urban live load varies greatly: when 60 t trucks or trams stop somewhere on the main span without back stays, the entire change in main-span stay force must be resisted by pylon bending, so the base moment swings sharply with traffic. Back stays tie the pylon head to anchorage on the shore side, balancing most of the live-load horizontal increment by axial force, so the pylon works mainly in compression with much lower bending and fatigue stress ranges.

The Erasmus deck is 33.8 m wide, with two box spines 2.25 m deep and 1.25 m wide carrying longitudinal bending and the stay anchorages; four traffic lanes and two tram tracks sit between the spines, and cross beams every 4.9 m cantilever 6.7 m each side to carry footpaths and cycle tracks. Tram tracks put concentrated wheel loads repeatedly on the same line, causing high-cycle fatigue at cross-beam-to-spine connections beneath the rails; the cantilevers carry lighter loads, but moment grows with the square of the overhang, concentrating stress at the cross-beam roots. The cross beams also tie the two spines together for torsional resistance.

The bent steel pylon of the Erasmus Bridge is assembled from many differently shaped plates, and a Delft University of Technology study notes that the computer-aided design of the time allowed plates to be cut directly by computer so parts fitted seamlessly. The bent form gives each pylon section a different angle and cross-section, and heat shrinkage during welding shortens and distorts each section; accumulated, this can move the pylon head several centimetres or more from its design position. The fabricator must predict weld shrinkage and add length at cutting, control distortion with jigs and welding sequence, and trial-assemble at the shop to confirm section interfaces match before site joints can align.

The 89 m bascule at the south end of the Erasmus Bridge is described as the largest and heaviest in Western Europe, letting tall-masted vessels pass. A bascule rotates about trunnions, and the leaf’s weight creates a large moment about them; lifting it directly with hydraulic cylinders or machinery would need enormous power and members. A counterweight behind the trunnions therefore nearly balances the leaf’s moment, so the drive only overcomes a small imbalance, friction, wind and inertia. Designers usually leave the leaf slightly heavy so the closed bridge sits firmly on its supports and is not lifted by wind or traffic vibration.

An asymmetric bent steel pylon leans to one side under its own eccentric weight before any stays are hung; once main-span stays carry deck weight, the head is pulled toward the main span. Construction control aims to bring the pylon to its design geometry under completed dead load, so the head is usually given a pre-offset and front and back stays are stressed in batches in a pre-computed order. Each batch changes the head position, deck levels and forces in already stressed stays, so it must be predicted by staged analysis and confirmed by measurement before the next.

The steel deck of the cable-stayed part expands and contracts with temperature, while the bascule leaf must return precisely to position each time it closes; the interface between them must allow movement, give vehicles a smooth ride and keep tram rails continuous. An ordinary expansion joint deals only with the road surface, but tram rails are continuous steel, so crossing an expansion or opening gap needs rail expansion devices or separable rail joints with rail-head steps controlled to millimetres, or trams suffer impact and derailment risk. Bearings, joints, rail joints and locking devices at the interface must therefore be designed and adjusted as one system.

Soon after opening to traffic in October 1996, the Erasmus Bridge was seen to sway in strong wind, and the main-span stays then showed large-amplitude aerodynamic instability identified as rain–wind-induced vibration: rainwater forms rivulets running down the stay surface, changing the effective section and flow separation so that a normally stable circular section absorbs energy at certain wind speeds and directions. A Delft University of Technology study also notes that the bridge swayed under the combination of rain, wind and its structure early on and was briefly closed. Observing such vibration requires simultaneous records of stay acceleration, wind speed and direction and rainfall, because it occurs only when all three conditions coincide.

About a year after the temporary measures, permanent tuned hydraulic dampers were fitted to the main-span stays of the Erasmus Bridge. A damper links the stay to the deck near the anchorage; as the stay vibrates, the piston moves back and forth and converts energy into heat. The damping coefficient must be tuned: too low and the piston moves almost freely and dissipates little; too high and the damper acts like a fixed point, creating a new node so vibration continues. The optimum depends on stay force, mass per metre, damper position and target mode, so different stay groups may need different settings.

The light-blue steel pylon is a city landmark, and the pylon, spines and cross beams all depend on coating systems against corrosion. Humid air in the Maas port area, industrial and traffic emissions and winter de-icing salt consume the coating year by year, with breakdown usually starting at edges, welds, bolts and poorly drained spots. The economics of coating maintenance depend on timing: overcoating while the system is still intact costs far less, and disrupts traffic far less, than full blast-cleaning and recoating after the primer fails and steel rusts. The colour and appearance of a landmark bridge are also values the owner must keep, so maintenance plans address both corrosion and appearance.

The bascule’s trunnions, hydraulic cylinders, locks, brakes and controls form a second critical system beside the cable-stayed structure. Each opening applies one load cycle to trunnion bearings and drive components, and over decades the count becomes a fatigue and wear issue; the controls must also interlock with signals, trams and shipping so no vehicle is on the leaf when it moves. A Delft University of Technology study also records icicles forming in the winter of 2009 to 2010 and the bridge closing for several days, showing that the operator must manage mechanical, structural and weather risks together. Complete operating records are the basis for deciding when to overhaul or replace components.
evidence: 以造型為主的橋梁在概念階段就要做活載與疲勞的初步檢核，並把結構需求（例如背索）回饋給建築師；造型變更須由結構設計者重新簽認塔與錨固的計算。
電車軌道與橋面結構的介面（軌道扣件、減振墊、排水）要由軌道與結構工程師共同設計，並在維護手冊中把軌道下方接頭列為優先疲勞檢查區。
製造規範應要求焊接程序評定、收縮預估、預拼裝與三維量測報告，並規定節段介面的容許偏差；預拼裝驗收是吊裝前的停留檢查點，由業主代表與製造廠共同簽認。
任何影響葉板重量的工程（鋪面、欄杆、照明、軌道）都要先計算重量變化並評估配重調整；維護紀錄須保存每次平衡量測結果與配重塊數量。
張拉計畫要列出每批的索號、目標力、預期塔頂位移與橋面高程，以及容許偏差與停止條件；張拉作業由施工控制工程師在場確認量測後才可放行下一批。
evidenceEn: An architecture-led bridge needs preliminary live-load and fatigue checks at concept stage, feeding structural needs such as back stays back to the architect; any change of form requires the structural designer to re-sign pylon and anchorage calculations.

The interface between tram track and deck (fastenings, resilient pads, drainage) should be designed jointly by track and structural engineers, and the maintenance manual should list joints beneath the rails as priority fatigue inspection areas.

The fabrication specification should require welding procedure qualification, shrinkage prediction, trial assembly and 3D survey reports and set interface tolerances; trial-assembly acceptance is a hold point before erection, co-signed by the owner’s representative and the fabricator.

Any work that changes leaf weight (surfacing, railings, lighting, track) must first calculate the weight change and assess counterweight adjustment; maintenance records keep every balance measurement and counterweight block count.

The stressing plan should list each batch’s stay numbers, target forces, expected pylon-head displacement and deck levels, with tolerances and stop criteria; the construction-control engineer confirms measurements on site before releasing the next batch.
pitfalls: 若背索勁度不足或錨固點沉陷，塔在交通荷載下的擺動與彎矩增大，塔身焊道承受較大的疲勞應力幅；背索若鬆弛，主跨在重車通過時下撓加大，行車與電車舒適度變差。
若未預留焊接收縮，塔頂高程與斜索錨點位置偏離，斜索長度與索力需大幅調整；焊接順序不當造成的殘餘應力與變形，可能使塔段介面無法對齊，需現場火焰矯正，增加材料受損與疲勞風險。
若張拉順序錯誤或一次張拉過多，塔頂偏移超出塔的彎曲容量，鋼塔可能局部挫屈或接頭受損；量測受日照影響而未修正，會導致錯誤的索力調整，完工後塔軸與橋面線形都偏離設計。
若只量測風速而沒有降雨紀錄，可能誤判為一般渦振或抖振，選錯對策；若量測位置只在一根索，無法判斷是個別索的問題還是普遍現象，阻尼器的配置也會失準。
若等到大面積生鏽才處理，必須全面噴砂重塗，工程需要大型圍封與長時間交通管制；局部積水或排水孔堵塞造成的腐蝕若未及時發現，可能在主梁或橫梁接頭處削弱斷面。
pitfallsEn: Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds; slack back stays let the main span deflect more under heavy vehicles, degrading ride and tram comfort.

Without shrinkage allowance, pylon-head level and stay anchor positions drift, forcing large changes in stay length and force; poor welding sequence leaves residual stress and distortion that misalign section interfaces and require flame straightening on site, adding risk of material damage and fatigue.

A wrong order or too much force in one batch can push the head beyond the pylon’s bending capacity, causing local buckling or joint damage; uncorrected solar effects in surveys lead to wrong force adjustments, leaving pylon axis and deck profile off design at completion.

Measuring wind without rainfall can misclassify the motion as ordinary vortex shedding or buffeting and lead to the wrong remedy; measuring only one stay cannot tell an individual problem from a general one, misdirecting damper deployment.

Waiting for widespread rust forces full blast-cleaning and recoating with large enclosures and long traffic restrictions; corrosion from ponding or blocked drains, if not caught early, can reduce sections at spine or cross-beam joints.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 從目標索力、影響矩陣、單股等張、振動法量測到允收與再調整，建立斜索索力的計算與量測閉環。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: A closed loop of calculation and measurement for stay forces: target forces, influence matrices, equal-strand stressing, vibration measurement, acceptance and re-tuning. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: 斜索常見使用應力上限約 0.45 GUTS
諾曼第大橋 184 根斜索，每根 31 至 53 股 15.7 mm 鋼絞線
諾曼第大橋每股使用拉力約 10 t、破斷力約 27 t，約 37%
里翁—安提里翁大橋每根斜索 43 至 73 股，鋼絞線保證強度 1,770 MPa
亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋 176 根斜索，最長逾 500 m、151 股、近 120 t
該橋首次採用 1,960 MPa 鋼絞線，製造約 9,000 t
供應商資料建議服役約 10 至 20 年後抽樣檢驗鋼絞線
蘇通大橋最長斜索約 577 m，施工顧問提供斜索安裝模擬
factsEn: Stay service stress is commonly limited to about 0.45 GUTS
The Pont de Normandie has 184 stays of 31 to 53 strands of 15.7 mm each
Each Normandie strand carries about 10 t in service against about 27 t breaking, about 37%
Rion–Antirion stays have 43 to 73 strands with 1,770 MPa guaranteed strength
The Yavuz Sultan Selim Bridge has 176 stays, the longest over 500 m with 151 strands and nearly 120 t
That bridge used 1,960 MPa strand for the first time, about 9,000 t of it
Supplier guidance recommends sampling strands after about 10 to 20 years of service
Sutong’s longest stay is about 577 m, with stay-installation simulations by the construction consultant
timeline: 1955　瑞典 Strömsund 橋完工，被視為第一座現代斜張橋
1995　諾曼第大橋以 184 根平行鋼絞線斜索創下跨徑紀錄

2018–2019　PTI DC45.1-18 與 fib Bulletin 89 更新斜索設計、試驗與驗收要求
timelineEn: 1955 — Sweden’s Strömsund Bridge is completed, regarded as the first modern cable-stayed bridge
1995 — The Pont de Normandie sets a span record with 184 parallel-strand stays
2002 — France’s CIP publishes stay-cable recommendations on testing and installation
2005 — fib Bulletin 30 publishes acceptance recommendations for stay cable systems
2018–2019 — PTI DC45.1-18 and fib Bulletin 89 update stay design, testing and acceptance requirements

fib Bulletin 89 Acceptance of cable systems using prestressing steels (2019)
French CIP stay-cable recommendations (Haubans, 2002)

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：斜張橋斜索張力調整
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning
guides.concept: 斜張橋的線形與內力幾乎完全由斜索索力決定，索力調整是把設計意圖變成實際結構的核心工序。本課以諾曼第大橋、里翁—安提里翁大橋、蘇通大橋與亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋等公開案例為參照，說明成橋目標索力、影響矩陣法、平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉、錨具調整量、施工階段預拱、溫度修正、振動法與舉升試驗量測、長期索力漂移，以及允收準則與營運期再調整的決策流程。
guides.conceptEn: The profile and internal forces of a cable-stayed bridge are set almost entirely by its stay forces, so tuning them is the core operation that turns design intent into the real structure. Referring to public cases such as the Pont de Normandie, Rion–Antirion, Sutong and Yavuz Sultan Selim bridges, the course explains completed-state target forces, the influence-matrix method, strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing, anchorage adjustment, construction-stage camber, temperature correction, vibration and lift-off measurement, long-term force drift, and acceptance criteria and in-service re-tuning decisions.
procedure: 斜張橋的恆載可以有無限多組索力與之平衡，設計者必須選定一組「成橋目標索力」。常見的起點是剛性支承連續梁法：假設每個斜索錨點是一個不會沉陷的支點，把橋面當成多跨連續梁計算恆載下的支點反力，再把反力除以斜索與水平面夾角的正弦，得到每根索的目標力。這樣得到的成橋狀態橋面彎矩很小、受力均勻，塔也接近純壓。之後再依活載、溫度、徐變與塔的彎矩做最佳化微調，使所有構件在各種荷載組合下都合格。

斜張橋是高度超靜定結構，調整一根索會同時改變附近多根索的力量、橋面多處的高程與塔頂位置。影響矩陣法先以結構模型算出「單位索力變化對每個控制點的影響」，排成矩陣 A，實測偏差向量 Δy 與所需索力調整 ΔT 的關係就是 Δy = A·ΔT。當控制點數與調整索數相同時可直接求解；控制點較多時以最小平方法求出整體最佳的調整量，並可加上權重與限制條件（例如任何索力不得超過上限）。這讓工程師一次規劃多根索的調整，而不是逐根試誤。

平行鋼絞線斜索是逐股穿入、逐股張拉的。問題在於：每多張拉一股，整根索的勁度與力量增加，橋面與塔隨之變形，先前已張拉的股就會鬆掉一些。若每股都拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，最後第一股的力量會明顯低於最後一股。Freyssinet 公開說明其專利的等張法會自動調整各股，使整根索的力量均勻：概念上是在第一股（參考股）裝荷重計，之後每一股都拉到「當下參考股的讀數」，由於所有股在同一時刻承受相同的伸長狀態，結構後續變形會讓所有股一起變化，最後各股力量相等。
斜索完成張拉後，日後的索力微調通常不再逐股進行，而是以整束千斤頂把錨頭拉起，再旋轉錨具外的螺紋環或增減墊片，改變錨頭的有效位置。設計時必須預留足夠的調整範圍，涵蓋施工誤差、長期徐變與未來可能的線形修正；若螺紋長度或墊片空間不足，就無法在不換索的情況下調整。調整量與索力變化的關係取決於索本身的軸向勁度，也取決於橋面與塔的柔度：結構越柔，同樣的錨頭位移造成的索力變化越小，需要更大的調整量。
成橋目標索力是最後狀態，但施工中每一步的索力與高程都不同：新節段的重量、吊機位置、臨時荷載、混凝土徐變與鋪面都還沒全部到位。施工控制以正裝分析（依施工順序逐步加載）或倒拆分析（從成橋狀態反推）求出每一步「此時應有」的索力與高程，並把它們寫成施工控制表。現場量測與這張表比較，而不是直接與成橋目標比較。AECOM 公開資料提到其為蘇通大橋提供架設分析、線形控制與斜索安裝模擬，正是這類工作的典型範例。
斜索、鋼梁與混凝土塔對日照的反應速度與吸熱量都不同：深色 HDPE 套管在陽光下升溫快，鋼梁次之，混凝土塔最慢。索比梁熱時索伸長、索力下降、橋面下沉；橋面上下緣溫差又使橋面彎曲。同一根索在一天之內的索力與錨點高程都可能變化數個百分點與數公分，若在午後量測並據以調索，等於把暫時的溫度效應當成永久誤差修正。因此調索與量測通常安排在清晨日出前、溫度最均勻的時段，並同時記錄索、梁、塔與氣溫。
直接以千斤頂量測每一根索的力量既費時又需要接近錨頭，營運期更不方便。振動法在索上裝加速度計，記錄風或人工激勵下的自由振動，從頻譜讀出各階自然頻率，再以張緊弦理論換算索力。長索可直接使用簡化公式；短而粗的索彎曲勁度不可忽略，頻率會因此偏高，需以修正公式扣除；很長的索則需考慮垂度對低階頻率的影響。實務上會用多階頻率一起擬合，同時估計索力與等效彎曲勁度，並以施工期的千斤頂讀數校正每根索的參數。

舉升試驗是索力量測的「直接法」：把千斤頂套在錨頭上逐步加壓，當油壓提供的力剛好等於索力時，錨頭會開始離開承壓面（或螺紋環開始可旋轉），此時的油壓換算成力就是索力。換算需要千斤頂的有效面積與經校正的壓力—力量關係，因為活塞與密封的摩擦會讓同樣油壓產生的實際力略小。舉升判定點要靠位移計或游標尺觀察錨頭的微小移動，並避免一次加壓過頭使錨頭被拉離太多，改變索力本身。這個方法準確但需要接近錨頭與移除防護蓋。
斜索完成後索力並非永遠不變。夾片式錨具在千斤頂卸載時夾片會向錨板內縮入數毫米，這個回縮對短索的影響遠大於長索，因為同樣的長度損失在短索中代表較大的應變。低鬆弛鋼絞線在使用應力約 0.45 GUTS 下的鬆弛損失很小，但混凝土塔與混凝土橋面的徐變與收縮會使錨點逐年移動，索力因此重新分配。營運初期幾年的漂移最明顯，之後趨緩；因此不少斜張橋在通車前或通車後數年安排一次全面複測與再調整。

調索不可能讓每根索都精準等於目標，因此需要明確的允收準則：通常同時規定單根索的容許偏差、同一索組（例如同一塔同一側）的總和偏差，以及橋面線形與塔頂位置的容許誤差。單根偏差反映局部問題，總和偏差反映整體受力是否正確，線形則反映使用性。營運期的再調整則是一個工程決策：要考慮偏差的趨勢、原因、對構件安全的影響、調整的風險（錨具反覆調整、交通管制）與成本。Freyssinet 公開資料把局部再張拉或放鬆列為斜索維護手段之一，並建議服役約 10 至 20 年後抽樣檢驗鋼絞線。
procedureEn: Dead load on a cable-stayed bridge can be balanced by infinitely many sets of stay forces, so the designer must choose a completed-state target set. A common starting point is the rigidly supported continuous beam method: treat each stay anchorage as an unyielding support, compute the reactions of the deck as a multi-span continuous beam under dead load, then divide each reaction by the sine of its stay’s angle to the horizontal to get the target force. The resulting completed state has small, even deck moments and a pylon close to pure compression. Targets are then fine-tuned for live load, temperature, creep and pylon bending so all members pass every load combination.

A cable-stayed bridge is highly indeterminate, and adjusting one stay changes the forces in neighbouring stays, the levels at several deck points and the pylon position at once. The influence-matrix method first computes, from the structural model, the effect of a unit change in each stay force on every control point, forming a matrix A; measured deviations Δy and required adjustments ΔT are then related by Δy = A·ΔT. With as many control points as adjustable stays it can be solved directly; with more points, least squares gives the best overall adjustment, with weights and constraints such as no stay exceeding its limit. Engineers can thus plan several adjustments together instead of trial and error stay by stay.

Parallel-strand stays are threaded and stressed one strand at a time. The difficulty is that each additional stressed strand raises the stay’s stiffness and force, the deck and pylon deform, and previously stressed strands lose some force. Stressing every strand to the same jack reading leaves the first strand clearly lower than the last. Freyssinet states publicly that its patented Isotension process automatically adjusts strands so force is uniform across the cable: conceptually, a load cell sits on the first (reference) strand and each later strand is stressed to the reference strand’s current reading, so all strands share the same elongation state at that moment and later structural deformation changes them together, leaving equal forces at the end.

Once a stay is stressed, later fine adjustments are usually not done strand by strand; instead a multi-strand jack lifts the anchor head and the ring nut outside the anchorage is turned or shims added or removed, changing the head’s effective position. Design must reserve enough adjustment range to cover construction error, long-term creep and possible future profile corrections; with too little thread or shim space, adjustment is impossible without replacing the stay. The relation between adjustment and force change depends on the stay’s axial stiffness and on deck and pylon flexibility: the softer the structure, the less force change a given head movement produces, so more adjustment is needed.

The completed-state targets describe the final condition, but forces and levels differ at every construction step: new segment weight, crane position, temporary loads, concrete creep and surfacing are not yet all in place. Construction control uses forward analysis (adding loads in construction order) or backward analysis (dismantling from the completed state) to find the force and level each step should have, and records them in a control table. Site measurements are compared with this table, not directly with the completed targets. AECOM’s public material on Sutong, describing erection analysis, geometry control and stay-installation simulations, is a typical example of this work.

Stays, steel girders and concrete pylons respond to sunshine at different speeds and with different heat gain: dark HDPE ducts heat fastest, steel next and the concrete pylon slowest. When a stay is warmer than the deck it lengthens, its force falls and the deck drops; a temperature difference through the deck bends it as well. A stay’s force and anchorage level can shift by several percent and several centimetres within a day, and tuning from afternoon readings treats temporary thermal effects as permanent errors. Tuning and measurement are therefore usually scheduled before sunrise, when temperatures are most uniform, with stay, deck, pylon and air temperatures recorded together.

Measuring every stay with jacks is slow and needs access to the anchor head, and is awkward in service. The vibration method fits an accelerometer to the stay, records free vibration under wind or manual excitation, reads natural frequencies from the spectrum and converts them to force with taut-string theory. Long stays can use the simplified formula; short, stocky stays have non-negligible bending stiffness that raises frequencies and must be subtracted with a corrected formula; very long stays need the effect of sag on the lowest modes. In practice several modes are fitted together to estimate force and equivalent bending stiffness, with each stay’s parameters calibrated against construction-stage jack readings.

A lift-off test is the direct way to measure stay force: a jack is fitted over the anchor head and pressure raised gradually until the jack force just equals the stay force, when the head starts to leave its bearing surface or the ring nut can be turned; that pressure converted to force is the stay force. Conversion needs the jack’s effective area and a calibrated pressure–force relation, because piston and seal friction make the actual force slightly less than pressure times area. The lift-off point is detected by watching tiny head movement with a dial gauge or calliper, without overshooting so far that the head is pulled away and the stay force itself changes. The method is accurate but requires access to the anchor head and removal of protective caps.

Stay forces do not stay constant after completion. With wedge anchorages, the wedges draw in a few millimetres when the jack is released, and this matters far more for short stays, since the same length loss is a larger strain. Low-relaxation strand at a service stress of about 0.45 GUTS loses little to relaxation, but creep and shrinkage of concrete pylons and decks move anchor points year by year and redistribute stay forces. Drift is most visible in the first years of service and then slows, so many cable-stayed bridges schedule a full re-measurement and re-tuning before opening or a few years after.

Tuning can never make every stay exactly equal to its target, so clear acceptance criteria are needed: usually an allowable deviation for each stay, a limit on the summed deviation of a stay group such as one side of one pylon, and tolerances on deck profile and pylon position. Single-stay deviation reveals local problems, group sums reveal whether global load sharing is right, and the profile governs serviceability. In service, re-tuning is an engineering decision weighing the trend and cause of deviation, its effect on member safety, the risks of adjustment (repeated anchorage work, traffic management) and cost. Freyssinet’s public material lists partial re-tensioning or de-tensioning as a stay maintenance measure and recommends sampling strands after about 10 to 20 years of service.
evidence: 目標索力表要附上推導方法、採用的模型版本、容許偏差與對應的成橋線形，並由設計者與施工控制單位共同確認為同一份「基準檔」，之後任何修改都要有版本紀錄。
調索作業前要確認模型已更新到現況（重量、邊界、溫度），並設定每根索單次調整上限與總體停止準則；每一輪的輸入、矩陣、計算結果與實測殘差都要存檔備查。
張拉規範要指定逐股張拉方法、荷重計校正週期、各股力量容許離散度與抽驗比例；張拉人員須持有供應商或專業機構的資格，現場由監造確認每根索的張拉紀錄後才可封錨。
交接資料應記錄每根索錨具剩餘的可調範圍與目前位置，維護單位調索前須確認範圍足夠；墊片使用數量、材質與厚度要有上限規定，並由錨具供應商確認。
施工控制表要有版本號、對應的施工順序與荷載假設，並規定任何偏離施工計畫的作業（吊機移位、材料堆放）都需先通知施工控制工程師評估。
evidenceEn: The target force table should state the derivation method, model version, tolerances and the corresponding completed profile, and be confirmed by designer and construction controller as one shared baseline file, with every later change version-controlled.

Before tuning, confirm the model is updated to the current state (weights, boundaries, temperature) and set a per-stay adjustment cap and an overall stop criterion; archive each round’s inputs, matrix, results and measured residuals.

The stressing specification should set the strand-by-strand method, load-cell calibration interval, allowable scatter of strand forces and sampling rate; stressing crews need supplier or professional qualification, and the supervisor confirms each stay’s record before anchorages are capped.

Handover should record each anchorage’s remaining adjustment range and current position, and the maintainer must confirm enough range before tuning; set limits on shim count, material and thickness, confirmed by the anchorage supplier.

The control table needs a version number, the matching construction sequence and load assumptions, and any departure from the plan, such as moving cranes or stockpiling materials, must first be referred to the construction-control engineer.
pitfalls: 若目標索力只追求恆載彎矩最小而忽略活載與徐變，使用中部分斜索可能接近容許上限，另一些卻鬆弛；成橋目標若與施工控制採用的模型不一致，現場永遠調不到「正確」的索力。
若不採用等張或補償程序，同一根索中各股力量差異可達一成以上，受力大的股承受較高的疲勞應力幅，可能先斷裂並引發其他股依序超載；荷重計未校正則整根索的力量系統性偏差。
若現場把施工中的實測索力直接與成橋目標比較並「調到目標」，等後續荷載加上後索力與線形會全面偏離；施工順序臨時改變而未更新分析，也會讓合龍口高差超出可調範圍。
若短索直接套用張緊弦公式而不修正彎曲勁度，索力會被高估，可能誤以為索力足夠；有效長度取錯（例如忽略阻尼器或導管的束制位置），也會造成數個百分點的系統誤差。
若短索未補償夾片回縮，成橋索力可能低於目標數個百分點，橋面局部下沉；長期漂移若沒有被監測，部分索力逐年升高而接近上限，部分卻鬆弛並在風中振動。
pitfallsEn: Targets chosen only to minimise dead-load moment, ignoring live load and creep, can leave some stays near their limit in service and others slack; if the completed-state targets and the construction-control model disagree, the site can never reach the right forces.

Without an equal-tension or compensation procedure, strand forces in one stay can differ by over a tenth, so the most loaded strands see higher fatigue stress ranges and may break first, overloading others in turn; an uncalibrated load cell biases the whole stay’s force.

Comparing mid-construction forces directly with completed targets and tuning to them leaves forces and profile wrong once later loads arrive; changing the sequence on site without updating the analysis can push the closure-gap level difference beyond the adjustable range.

Applying the taut-string formula to short stays without bending correction overestimates force and may falsely suggest adequacy; using the wrong effective length, for example ignoring restraint at a damper or guide pipe, introduces systematic errors of several percent.

Short stays without draw-in compensation can end several percent below target, letting the deck sag locally; unmonitored long-term drift lets some stays creep toward their limit year by year while others slacken and vibrate in wind.
