guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Span-by-span precast bridge erection
guides.concept: 從簡支箱梁的正彎矩與體外預力需求出發，計算架橋機對橋墩的施工荷載，再處理乾接縫與環氧接縫、轉向塊與錨碇橫隔、架橋機推進穩定、整跨荷重轉換與預製場幾何控制，最後以鋼腱振動頻率、接縫監測與可更換性驗收交接，並以佛州 Long Key 橋、Seven Mile 橋與曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路為案例。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the sagging moment and external prestress demand of a simple-span box girder, compute gantry construction loads on the piers, then handle dry and epoxy joints, deviators and anchorage diaphragms, gantry launching stability, whole-span load transfer and casting-yard geometry control, and finally accept and hand over with tendon vibration checks, joint monitoring and replaceability, using Florida's Long Key and Seven Mile bridges and Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway as cases.
procedure: 逐跨工法把一整跨的預鑄節塊（常見 10 至 14 塊）同時懸吊或擱置在架橋機或下承桁架上，調整線形後一次張拉縱向鋼腱，使整跨立刻成為能自承重的簡支梁，再把架橋機推到下一跨。因為所有節塊在張拉前都由臨時結構承托，接縫在施工期不需承受懸臂彎矩，箱梁可以用等高度斷面，最適合跨度約 30 至 45 m、跨數很多的長距離高架橋。鋼腱多採體外配置，沿箱內由錨碇橫隔經轉向塊折線布設，近似拋物線的偏心抵抗跨中正彎矩。
整跨節塊在張拉前全部重量經由架橋機傳到前後兩座橋墩，架橋機自重也一併加上；支腿通常放在墩帽或已完成箱梁的端部，與墩柱軸線有偏心，墩柱在施工期承受營運時不會出現的單側彎矩。架橋機推進時重心沿縱向移動，風力又作用在高聳的主桁與節塊上，所以墩帽承壓、墩柱彎矩、基礎與支承臨時鎖定都要以施工荷載逐一檢核，而不是只套用營運荷載組合。
逐跨工法的節塊在預製場以匹配澆注製作，相鄰節塊端面完全吻合，並設多重剪力鍵。佛州 Long Key 橋與曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路採用乾接縫，完全依靠體外預力壓緊接縫與剪力鍵傳遞剪力；許多新近規範則要求環氧接縫，用以密封接縫、填補微小不平並在架設時潤滑定位。乾接縫施工快、不受天候影響，但接縫沒有任何抗拉能力，也不能防水，因此需要較高的殘餘壓應力與更好的箱內防水。
體外鋼腱位於箱梁內部但不埋在混凝土中，只在端部錨碇橫隔與跨內轉向塊與結構接觸。鋼腱在轉向塊轉折時，會對轉向塊施加向上與向內的集中力，轉向塊必須以鋼筋把這股力吊掛回腹板與頂板；錨碇橫隔則要把整束鋼腱的集中力擴散到整個箱梁斷面。轉向處預埋彎曲鋼管，彎曲半徑與出口喇叭口要能避免鋼絞線在邊緣受到尖角磨損。
架橋機完成一跨後，要把主桁推向下一座橋墩：推進過程中主桁前端有一段很長的懸臂，重心必須始終位於後支點之內，否則整機前傾。推進時通常先把前支腿收起，主桁以後支點與中支點滑移，到達下一墩後放下前支腿，再移動後支腿。推進作業的風速限制、縱坡與彎道造成的側向分力、以及支腿與墩頂的錨定，都是決定能否安全推進的條件。
節塊依序吊掛到架橋機後，先以吊桿或千斤頂調整每一塊的高程、橫坡與接縫間隙，使整跨符合預定的預拱線形；墩頂常留一道現澆濕接縫吸收累積誤差。張拉完成時，梁體因預力上拱而逐漸離開吊桿，荷重從架橋機轉移到永久支承。若轉換過程不同步，部分吊桿突然卸載或過載，梁端支承也可能一端先受力，造成扭轉與支承偏壓。
大量逐跨節塊多在短線法預製台座生產：固定端模不動，前一節塊作為匹配節塊移到相對位置，再澆製新節塊。平面曲線、縱坡與超高都靠每次調整匹配節塊的位置與角度來達成，所以預製場幾何控制其實是在把橋梁的三維線形分解成每一個接縫的微小轉角。Bang Na 高架道路的預製場設有約 100 個澆注台座，月產能約 1,800 個節塊，量測與資料管理的規模與一般工程截然不同。
體外鋼腱在轉向塊之間是一段自由的張緊索，它的橫向自然頻率與張力直接相關，因此可以在張拉後以加速度計輕敲量測頻率，反算每一束的有效力，作為千斤頂讀值與伸長量之外的第三種獨立驗證。這個方法也能在營運期重複使用，追蹤預力損失或發現斷絲。量測需考慮套管與灌漿質量、端部約束與鋼腱抗彎勁度的影響，最好先以舉離試驗校正。
體外鋼腱的優點是看得到、可更換，但它的防蝕完全依賴 HDPE 套管、灌漿或填充材與錨頭保護蓋；套管破裂或灌漿有空洞時，水分與氯離子會在低點積聚，鋼絞線可在多年內腐蝕斷裂。1990 年代末至 2000 年前後，佛州數座分段橋的體外鋼腱曾因灌漿空洞與滲水而發現斷束，促成灌漿材料與施工規範的全面修訂。設計時必須假設某一束可能失效或需要更換，檢查其餘鋼腱是否仍能維持接縫受壓。
逐跨預鑄橋的健康狀態主要反映在接縫：只要接縫保持受壓，梁體就近似一根完整的預力梁；接縫一旦在活載下張開，底緣應變會出現非線性跳增，接縫處的位移計會讀到開口。因此交接時應在代表性跨的跨中接縫裝設應變計與位移計，以已知重量的車輛做一次基準量測，日後定期重測比較，就能判斷預力是否流失或接縫是否開始呼吸。
procedureEn: Span-by-span erection hangs or rests a whole span of precast segments, commonly 10 to 14, on an overhead gantry or underslung truss, aligns them, then stresses the longitudinal tendons in one operation so the span immediately becomes a self-supporting simple beam before the gantry moves on. Because all segments are carried by temporary works until stressing, the joints never carry cantilever moment during construction and the box can have constant depth, ideal for long viaducts with many spans of about 30 to 45 m. Tendons are usually external, running inside the box from anchorage diaphragm to deviators in a polygonal profile whose eccentricity approximates a parabola to resist midspan sagging moment.

Before stressing, the entire weight of a span of segments, plus the gantry's own weight, passes through the gantry to the two piers; legs usually sit on the pier cap or on the end of the completed girder, eccentric to the column axis, so the column carries one-sided bending that never occurs in service. As the gantry launches, its centre of gravity moves along the bridge and wind acts on the tall girders and hanging segments, so pier-cap bearing, column bending, foundations and temporary bearing locks must each be checked for construction loads rather than service combinations alone.

Span-by-span segments are match-cast in the yard, so the faces of adjacent segments fit exactly and carry multiple shear keys. Florida's Long Key Bridge and Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway used dry joints, relying entirely on external prestress to clamp the joints so shear keys transfer shear; many recent specifications require epoxy joints instead, to seal the joint, fill small irregularities and lubricate alignment during erection. Dry joints are fast and weather-independent, but they have no tensile capacity and no water-tightness, so they need higher residual compression and better waterproofing of the box.

External tendons run inside the box but are not embedded in concrete; they touch the structure only at end anchorage diaphragms and intermediate deviators. Where a tendon changes direction at a deviator it pushes upward and inward with a concentrated force that the deviator reinforcement must hang back into the webs and top slab, while the anchorage diaphragm must spread the full tendon force into the whole box section. Deviators contain preformed curved steel pipes whose radius and flared exits prevent strands from being nicked on sharp edges.

After completing a span, the gantry girder must be pushed to the next pier; during launching its front end becomes a long cantilever, and the centre of gravity must always stay inside the rear support or the machine tips forward. The front leg is usually lifted, the girder slides on rear and middle supports, the front leg is lowered on reaching the next pier, and then the rear leg is moved. Wind-speed limits, longitudinal gradient, lateral components on curves and the anchorage of legs to the pier top all decide whether launching is safe.

Segments are hung on the gantry in sequence, and hangers or jacks adjust each one's level, cross-fall and joint gap so the span follows the intended camber; a cast-in-place wet joint at the pier often absorbs accumulated error. As stressing completes, the girder cambers up off the hangers and its weight transfers from the gantry to the permanent bearings. If the transfer is not synchronised, some hangers unload or overload suddenly and one end bearing may pick up load first, causing twist and uneven bearing pressure.

High-volume span-by-span segments are usually produced on short-line casting cells: the bulkhead stays fixed while the previously cast segment is moved into a relative position as the match-cast unit and the new segment is cast against it. Horizontal curves, gradients and superelevation are created by adjusting the position and angle of the match-cast unit each time, so yard geometry control decomposes the bridge's 3D alignment into small rotations at every joint. The Bang Na Expressway yard had about 100 casting cells with a capacity of about 1,800 segments per month, a scale of surveying and data management very different from ordinary jobs.

Between deviators an external tendon is a free taut cable whose lateral natural frequency relates directly to its tension, so after stressing a light tap and an accelerometer give the frequency and hence the effective force of every tendon, a third independent check beyond jack readings and elongation. The same method can be repeated in service to track prestress loss or detect broken wires. The measurement must account for the mass of sheath and grout, end restraint and tendon bending stiffness, ideally calibrated first by a lift-off test.

External tendons are visible and replaceable, but their corrosion protection depends entirely on the HDPE sheath, the grout or filler and the anchor caps; with a cracked sheath or grout voids, water and chlorides collect at low points and strands can corrode and break within years. Around the late 1990s and 2000, failed external tendons were found in several Florida segmental bridges with grout voids and water ingress, prompting broad revisions of grout materials and construction specifications. Design must assume that any one tendon may fail or need replacing and check that the rest still keep the joints in compression.

The health of a span-by-span precast bridge shows mainly at its joints: as long as they stay in compression the girder behaves like a monolithic prestressed beam, but once a joint opens under live load the bottom-fibre strain jumps non-linearly and a displacement gauge across the joint reads an opening. Handover should therefore install strain and displacement gauges at midspan joints of representative spans, take a baseline with vehicles of known weight, and repeat periodically to tell whether prestress has been lost or joints have started to breathe.
evidence: 設計圖說應明列每一跨的節塊編號、鋼腱編號與張拉順序，並註明接縫殘餘壓應力的設計值，作為施工與日後評估的共同基準。
把架橋機支腿位置、最大反力與停機條件（例如風速上限）寫入橋墩設計說明與施工計畫，任何更換架橋機或改變支腿位置都需重新送審。
接縫型式（乾或環氧）、最低殘餘壓應力、剪力鍵修補程序與箱內排水設計應在招標文件中一次訂定，施工中不得以趕工為由由環氧改為乾接縫。
轉向塊與錨碇節塊屬於關鍵節塊，預製時應有專屬檢查表（彎管座標、鋼筋、混凝土強度），並保留量測紀錄隨節塊編號歸檔；彎管出口須有圓滑過渡並經監造逐一確認。
架橋機的組立、首次推進與每次推進列為停留點，須由架橋機設計者提供推進程序與安全係數計算，並由專業技師與監造簽認；颱風季應訂定停機錨定程序與撤離條件。
evidenceEn: Drawings should list segment numbers, tendon numbers and stressing order for every span and state the design residual joint compression, as a shared basis for construction and later assessment.

Write gantry leg positions, maximum reactions and parking conditions, such as a wind-speed limit, into the pier design notes and the construction plan, and require resubmission for any change of gantry or leg position.

Specify joint type (dry or epoxy), minimum residual compression, shear-key repair procedure and box drainage in the tender documents, and forbid switching from epoxy to dry joints during construction to save time.

Deviator and anchorage segments are critical segments that need dedicated checklists in the yard (pipe coordinates, reinforcement, concrete strength), with survey records filed under each segment number; pipe exits must have smooth transitions confirmed one by one by the supervising engineer.

Gantry assembly, first launch and every launch are hold points; the gantry designer must provide the launching procedure and stability calculation, signed off by a qualified engineer and the supervising engineer, and a parking, anchoring and evacuation procedure is set for the typhoon season.
pitfalls: 若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。
剪力鍵在運輸或吊裝時崩角而未修補，接縫局部承壓集中，張拉時可能進一步崩裂；乾接縫若殘餘壓應力不足，重車通過時接縫反覆微開，箱內積水沿底板流向錨碇區，成為腐蝕源頭。
推進時忘記把上一跨的配重或吊具移回後端，或在超過風速限制時強行推進，主桁前傾觸及下一墩或墜落；在彎道或縱坡上推進而未設側向與下滑止擋，也曾導致架橋機滑移出軌。
若預製場只照理論座標擺放匹配節塊而不回饋實測誤差，誤差逐塊累積，到現場整跨無法對準支承或下一跨，只能加大濕接縫或修鑿節塊，甚至報廢重做。
箱內排水不良使雨水在錨碇橫隔前積存，錨頭保護蓋與套管接頭長期泡水，鋼絞線在錨具後方腐蝕斷裂；若設計沒有考慮單束失效，斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力不足，整跨必須限載直到更換完成。
pitfallsEn: Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators.

Shear keys chipped in transport or lifting and left unrepaired concentrate bearing and can spall further during stressing; dry joints with too little residual compression breathe open under heavy trucks, letting water collect inside the box and run along the bottom slab to the anchorages, starting corrosion.

Forgetting to move counterweights or lifting gear back after the previous span, or pushing beyond the wind limit, can tip the girder onto the next pier or drop it; launching on curves or gradients without lateral and downhill stops has also let gantries slide off their rails.

Placing match units by theoretical coordinates without feeding back measured errors lets errors accumulate segment by segment, so on site the span misses its bearings or the next span and needs a wider wet joint, grinding, or even a scrapped segment.

Poor box drainage lets rainwater pond in front of anchorage diaphragms so anchor caps and sheath joints sit in water for years and strands corrode and break behind the anchors; if design did not consider single-tendon loss, the remaining joint compression is insufficient and the whole span must be load-restricted until replacement.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.concept: 以導梁、中心預力、滑移支承與高程控制，讓整條連續梁從橋台後方一段段推過每一座橋墩。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Launching nose, centric prestress, sliding bearings and level control that let a continuous girder be pushed segment by segment over every pier from behind the abutment. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: VSL 1977 報告：頂推工法經濟跨度約 30 至 60 m，端跨不宜超過標準跨的 75%
頂推段長約 15 至 25 m，每週一段，頂推速度約 3 至 6 m/h
導梁長度約為跨度的 60% 至 65%，重約 1 至 2 t/m
頂推梁跨深比通常 12 至 15，不宜超過 17
荷蘭 Ravensbosch 高架橋長 420 m（42 + 6×56 + 42 m），頂推總重約 11,500 t，摩擦穩定在約 5%
Caroní 河橋梁體約 480 m，跨度約 96 m，每跨設臨時墩
Millau 高架橋全長 2,460 m，以約 171 m 的頂推跨由兩側頂推，最高臨時支撐約 175 m
Millau 最後一次頂推重量約 20,000 t，每循環前進約 600 mm、歷時約 4 分鐘
20 世紀全球以頂推工法建造的預力混凝土橋超過 2,500 座
factsEn: VSL's 1977 report gives economic spans of about 30 to 60 m, with end spans not exceeding 75% of the standard span
Launching segments are about 15 to 25 m long, one per week, at launching speeds of about 3 to 6 m/h
Launching noses are about 60% to 65% of the span long and weigh about 1 to 2 t/m
Launched girders usually have span-to-depth ratios of 12 to 15 and not more than 17
The Ravensbosch Viaduct is 420 m long (42 + 6×56 + 42 m), with about 11,500 t launched and friction settling at about 5%
The Caroní River bridge deck was about 480 m long with spans of about 96 m and a temporary pier in each span
The Millau Viaduct is 2,460 m long and was launched from both sides in launch spans of about 171 m, with the tallest temporary support about 175 m
Millau's final launch moved about 20,000 t, each cycle advancing about 600 mm in about 4 minutes
More than 2,500 prestressed concrete bridges were launched worldwide in the 20th century
timeline: 1961–1964　委內瑞拉 Caroní 河橋在橋台後組成梁體並頂推過墩，每跨設臨時墩
1965　奧地利 Kufstein 茵河橋首度採用逐段澆製、整體頂推的真正頂推工法
1977　VSL 技術報告整理頂推工法的跨度、導梁、循環與設備經驗
1997　法國 TGV 高速鐵路首批頂推橋梁完成
2001–2004　Millau 高架橋鋼橋面由兩側頂推，2004 年 5 月合龍、12 月通車
timelineEn: 1961–1964 — Venezuela's Caroní River bridge is assembled behind the abutment and launched over the piers with a temporary pier in each span
1965 — The Inn bridge at Kufstein, Austria, is the first true incremental launch with segments cast behind the abutment
1977 — A VSL technical report summarises spans, noses, cycles and equipment for incremental launching
1997 — The first launched bridges of the French TGV high-speed lines are built
2001–2004 — Millau Viaduct's steel deck is launched from both sides, joined in May 2004 and opened in December 2004

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.

pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：橋梁頂推施工
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Incremental bridge launching
guides.concept: 從頂推過程中每一斷面輪流經過墩頂與跨中所產生的交變彎矩出發，計算導梁長度與中心預力需求，再處理導梁上墩、滑移支承與側向導向、橋台後預製台座的每週循環、臨時墩與鋼橋面頂推，最後以支承反力、頂推力與摩擦監測驗證並完成永久支承安裝與交接，案例涵蓋 Caroní 橋、Kufstein 茵河橋、Ravensbosch 高架橋與 Millau 高架橋。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the alternating moments that arise as every section passes alternately over piers and midspans, compute launching-nose length and centric prestress, then handle nose landing, sliding bearings and lateral guides, the weekly cycle of the casting bed behind the abutment, temporary piers and steel-deck launching, and finally verify with support reactions, launch force and friction monitoring before installing permanent bearings and handing over, with the Caroní, Kufstein Inn, Ravensbosch and Millau bridges as cases.
procedure: 頂推時整條梁在橋墩上滑動，每一個斷面都會輪流經過墩頂（負彎矩）與跨中（正彎矩），所以斷面必須同時承受兩種符號的彎矩，這與一般連續梁每個斷面只承受固定符號的彎矩完全不同。最嚴重的狀態出現在梁前端剛要到達下一座墩之前：前端成為長懸臂，根部負彎矩隨懸臂長度平方增長。輕質鋼導梁接在梁前端，先一步搭上下一座墩，用很輕的重量取代一大段混凝土懸臂，大幅降低這個峰值。
既然每一個斷面都要承受正負兩種彎矩，頂推階段的預力必須放在斷面形心附近，使頂板與底板同時獲得均勻壓應力，稱為中心預力或頂推預力，通常以頂板與底板的直線鋼腱達成。頂推完成、結構成為連續梁後，再張拉沿彎矩分布配置的連續鋼腱（常為體外鋼腱），補足營運需求。因為中心預力在營運時效率較低，設計者會用較小的跨深比、導梁與臨時墩來降低頂推彎矩，從而減少中心預力用量。
導梁通常是兩片鋼板梁或桁架，長度約為跨度的 60% 至 65%，每公尺重量只有混凝土梁的一小部分。導梁本身要夠輕才能降低懸臂彎矩，又要夠勁才能限制前端下垂；到達下一墩時，前端已因混凝土懸臂轉角與導梁自身撓度而低於墩頂，必須靠前端的上墩千斤頂或斜坡把導梁抬上滑板。導梁與混凝土梁的連接處承受很大的彎矩與剪力，是需要特別細部設計與疲勞檢查的節點。
頂推時梁體底板在每座墩頂的臨時滑移支承上滑動：常見作法是不鏽鋼面的混凝土塊或鋼座，上面不斷插入以橡膠加勁的聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑板，滑板隨梁前進，從另一端取出再回送。摩擦力隨溫度、接觸壓力與初始靜摩擦變化，啟動時最大。墩頂兩側還要設側向導向裝置，控制梁體平面位置，曲線橋上導向力更大。梁在縱坡下坡方向頂推時，若摩擦低於坡度分力，梁會自行滑動，必須設制動或拉回裝置。

頂推工法把整座橋的製造集中在橋台後方的固定預製台座：每一段約 15 至 25 m，在同一副模板中澆製並緊貼前一段匹配，張拉中心預力後整條梁向前推一段距離，空出台座再做下一段。這讓施工像工廠一樣重複，常見節奏是每週一段。台座本身的基礎與模板精度極重要：每一段都由同一副模板決定幾何，微小的角度誤差會隨每一段傳到整座橋；VSL 的報告指出，若 19 m 的一段誤差 1 mm，累積到全橋可達約 100 mm。

當永久跨度超過頂推經濟範圍時，可在跨中設臨時墩，把頂推跨度減半。Millau 高架橋的鋼橋面由谷地兩側分別頂推，以臨時支撐把 342 m 主跨分成約 171 m 的頂推跨，最高臨時支撐約 175 m。頂推長而重的梁時，若只在橋台集中施力，各墩頂的摩擦力都會以水平力推動高墩；改在每座墩與臨時墩頂設同步控制的頂推裝置，各點只克服本身摩擦，墩頂水平力大幅降低。鋼橋面頂推還要檢查腹板在滑移點的局部承壓與挫屈。
頂推中的梁是一根很長的連續梁，墩頂滑移面高程只要偏差幾公釐，就會改變各墩反力與梁內彎矩，這也是歐洲規範要求頂推分析必須考慮支承高程偏差的原因。因此在每座墩頂滑移支承下設置油壓千斤頂或荷重計，頂推過程中直接量測反力，比較預測值；若某一墩反力明顯偏高，可能是滑移面過高、梁底局部凸起或台座幾何誤差，須在下一次頂推前調整。
頂推力是頂推過程中最直接的健康指標：它等於所有墩頂摩擦力與坡度分力的總和，若突然增加，代表某處滑板漏放、側向導向卡住或梁底有障礙；若緩慢下降，可能是溫度升高使摩擦降低。把每一次頂推的啟動力與等速力記錄下來，就能反算實際摩擦係數，與設計假設比較。同時以全站儀追蹤導梁前端與梁體平面位置，以應變計觀察關鍵斷面，確認結構行為與分析一致。
梁推到最終位置後，要從臨時滑移支承轉換到永久支承：在每座墩以油壓千斤頂把梁頂起數公釐（VSL 報告記載約 5 至 10 mm），拆除滑移支承，安裝永久支承後再落梁。同時張拉沿彎矩分布的連續鋼腱，必要時拆除或放鬆部分中心預力，使結構轉為營運狀態。頂升過程等同於人為製造支承高程差，所以必須同步、分級並限制相鄰墩的高差，否則會在梁內引起不必要的彎矩。
頂推工法造就的是很長、沒有中間伸縮縫的連續梁，溫度、乾縮與潛變造成的長度變化全部集中在梁端，因此梁端伸縮縫與活動支承的行程必須足夠，固定點（常在一側橋台或中間墩）也要能承受制動力與摩擦力。頂推過程中底板曾在每一座墩頂滑過，滑移區可能留下刮痕、局部修補或滑板殘留物，都要在交接前檢查並處理。交接文件則應保存頂推期間的反力、推力、高程與裂縫紀錄，作為日後評估的基準。
procedureEn: During launching the whole girder slides over the piers, so every section passes alternately over a pier (hogging) and through midspan (sagging) and must resist both signs of moment, unlike an ordinary continuous girder whose sections see one sign. The worst state occurs just before the front reaches the next pier: the front becomes a long cantilever whose root hogging moment grows with the square of its length. A light steel launching nose attached to the front reaches the next pier first, replacing a long concrete cantilever with a light structure and sharply reducing this peak.

Since every section must resist both positive and negative moment, launching prestress is placed near the centroid so the top and bottom slabs both receive uniform compression, called centric or launching prestress and usually provided by straight tendons in the top and bottom slabs. After launching, once the structure is continuous, continuity tendons following the moment diagram, often external, are stressed to meet service demands. Because centric prestress is less efficient in service, designers reduce launching moments with modest span-to-depth ratios, a nose and temporary piers, minimising the centric prestress needed.

A launching nose is usually two steel plate girders or a truss, about 60% to 65% of the span long and weighing a small fraction of the concrete girder per metre. It must be light enough to reduce the cantilever moment yet stiff enough to limit tip sag; on arrival at the next pier its tip lies below the pier top because of the concrete cantilever's rotation and the nose's own deflection, so a tip jack or ramp must lift it onto the sliding pad. The nose-to-girder connection carries large moment and shear and needs special detailing and fatigue checks.

During launching the girder soffit slides over temporary sliding bearings on each pier: commonly concrete blocks or steel seats faced with stainless steel, onto which elastomer-backed PTFE pads are continuously fed so that they travel with the girder and are retrieved at the far end and returned. Friction varies with temperature, contact pressure and initial static breakaway, peaking at start-up. Lateral guides on both sides of each pier control plan position, with larger guide forces on curved bridges. When launching downhill on a gradient, if friction falls below the slope component the girder can run away by itself, so braking or hold-back devices are required.

Incremental launching concentrates the manufacture of the whole bridge on a fixed casting bed behind the abutment: each segment, about 15 to 25 m long, is cast in the same formwork against the previous one, centric prestress is stressed, the whole girder is pushed forward by one segment length, and the bed is freed for the next. Work repeats like a factory, typically at one segment per week. The bed's foundation and form accuracy are critical because one formwork sets the geometry of every segment and small angular errors propagate through the bridge; a VSL report notes that a 1 mm error over one 19 m segment could accumulate to about 100 mm over the bridge length.

When permanent spans exceed the economic launching range, temporary piers at midspan halve the launch span. Millau's steel deck was launched from both sides of the valley with temporary supports dividing the 342 m spans into launch spans of about 171 m, the tallest temporary support being about 175 m high. Pushing a long heavy girder from the abutment alone makes the friction at every pier push the tall piers horizontally; synchronised launching devices on each pier and temporary support let each point overcome only its own friction, sharply reducing horizontal pier forces. Steel decks also need checks of web patch loading and buckling at the sliding points.

A girder being launched is a long continuous beam, and a deviation of a few millimetres in a pier's sliding-surface level changes every reaction and the internal moments, which is why European rules require launching analyses to include support level deviations. Hydraulic jacks or load cells under each pier's sliding bearing therefore measure reactions directly during launching for comparison with predictions; a reaction well above prediction may mean a sliding surface set too high, a local bulge on the soffit or casting-bed geometry error, to be adjusted before the next push.

Launch force is the most direct health indicator during launching: it equals the sum of all pier friction forces and the gradient component, so a sudden rise signals a missing pad, a jammed lateral guide or an obstruction under the soffit, while a slow fall may reflect warmer weather lowering friction. Logging breakaway and steady-motion forces for every push lets engineers back-calculate the real friction coefficient and compare it with design. Meanwhile a total station tracks the nose tip and the girder's plan position, and strain gauges at key sections confirm the structure behaves as analysed.

Once the girder reaches its final position, it must be transferred from temporary sliding bearings to permanent bearings: hydraulic jacks lift it a few millimetres at each pier, about 5 to 10 mm according to a VSL report, the sliding bearings are removed, permanent bearings installed and the girder lowered. Continuity tendons following the moment diagram are stressed and, where needed, part of the centric prestress is removed or released, bringing the structure to its service state. Jacking is effectively an imposed support-level difference, so it must be synchronised, staged and limited in level difference between adjacent piers, or it induces unwanted moments.

Launching produces long continuous girders without intermediate joints, so length changes from temperature, shrinkage and creep all accumulate at the girder ends; end expansion joints and sliding bearings need sufficient travel, and the fixed point, often one abutment or a central pier, must resist braking and bearing friction. During launching the soffit slid over every pier, possibly leaving scoring, local repairs or pad debris that must be inspected and dealt with before handover. Handover documents should keep the reaction, force, level and crack records from launching as the baseline for later assessment.
evidence: 設計文件應附頂推階段彎矩與剪力包絡線、導梁長度與重量假設、每座墩的最大反力，並規定承包商改變導梁或跨配置時必須重新分析並經設計單位同意。
施工計畫應以表格列出每一段的頂推鋼腱、聯結器位置與張拉時機，並規定在張拉完成並確認伸長量之前不得頂推；頂推後的連續鋼腱張拉順序也須經設計單位核定。
導梁在每次頂推前檢查連接栓、焊道與前端千斤頂，每完成若干跨做一次詳細檢查並記錄前端下垂量趨勢；導梁拆除與再利用須經原設計者確認其疲勞紀錄。
每座墩頂指派專人負責滑板插放與觀察，並以對講系統與頂推控制室連線，任何異常可立即停機；下坡頂推的制動與拉回系統須經設計並在首次頂推前試運轉。
預製台座的基礎、底模支撐與量測控制點應有專屬設計與檢查表，每段澆置前的模板高程單由測量工程師簽認；台座附近禁止堆放重物或開挖，避免改變基礎狀態。
evidenceEn: Design documents should attach the launching moment and shear envelopes, the assumed nose length and weight and the maximum reaction at every pier, and require re-analysis and designer approval if the contractor changes the nose or span arrangement.

The construction plan should tabulate launching tendons, coupler locations and stressing times for every segment and forbid launching until stressing is complete and elongations are accepted; the post-launch continuity stressing order must also be approved by the designer.

Inspect nose bolts, welds and the tip jack before every launch, carry out a detailed inspection every few spans and log the tip-sag trend; dismantling and reuse of a nose requires the original designer to review its fatigue record.

Assign a person at every pier to feed pads and observe, linked by intercom to the launch control room so any anomaly stops the push immediately; braking and hold-back systems for downhill launching must be designed and test-run before the first launch.

The casting bed's foundation, soffit supports and survey control need their own design and checklist, with a form-level sheet signed by the survey engineer before every cast; heavy stockpiles and excavation near the bed are forbidden to avoid disturbing its foundation.
pitfalls: 若只檢核完工連續梁的彎矩分布，忽略頂推時每個斷面都會經過墩頂，跨中斷面可能在頂推中承受設計從未考慮的負彎矩，頂板出現橫向裂縫，甚至在導梁搭墩前因懸臂過長而開裂。
導梁與梁體的連接栓在反覆頂推中鬆動或疲勞開裂，前端下垂逐次加大，最終導梁撞上墩頂或滑板邊緣；若上墩千斤頂行程不足而強行頂推，導梁下翼板可能被墩頂撞擊而局部挫屈。
台座基礎不均勻沉陷而未察覺，每一段的底模都帶著相同的微小傾角，梁底成為鋸齒或折線，到了遠端墩頂高差可達數公分，頂推中支承反力重新分配，梁體出現非預期裂縫。
若某座墩滑移面偏高而未調整，該墩反力持續偏大，梁經過時底板局部承壓過高、腹板出現斜裂縫；相鄰墩反力不足則讓滑板滑出或側向導向失效。
各墩頂升不同步，造成某墩瞬間承擔過大反力或梁頂板開裂；永久支承預設偏位忘記考慮安裝時溫度，活動支承在夏季或冬季頂到行程末端，對墩柱產生非預期水平力。
pitfallsEn: Checking only the finished continuous-girder moments, and forgetting that every section passes over a pier during launching, can impose hogging moments on midspan sections that the design never considered, cracking the top slab transversely, or crack the girder when the cantilever grows too long before the nose lands.

Bolts joining the nose to the girder can loosen or crack by fatigue under repeated launches so the tip sags more each time until it strikes the pier top or pad edge; launching on with an insufficient landing-jack stroke can let the pier top hit and locally buckle the nose bottom flange.

Unnoticed differential settlement of the casting bed gives every segment the same small tilt, so the soffit becomes a saw-tooth or kinked line; at distant piers level errors reach several centimetres, reactions redistribute during launching and unexpected cracks appear.

A sliding surface left too high keeps that pier's reaction above prediction, overstressing the soffit locally and cracking webs diagonally as the girder passes; neighbouring piers with too little reaction may let pads slide out or lateral guides lose effect.

Unsynchronised jacking makes one pier momentarily carry an excessive reaction or cracks the top slab; forgetting the installation temperature when presetting bearing offsets drives sliding bearings to the end of travel in summer or winter, imposing unexpected horizontal force on the piers.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：橋梁轉體施工
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Bridge rotation construction
guides.concept: 從平行於鐵路、道路或河道建造、再轉到跨越位置的工法邏輯出發，計算轉體重量、重心偏心與撐腳間隙，再處理球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩、下轉盤局部承壓、牽引系統、到位精調與封鉸，最後以稱重試驗、轉動監測與封固後的沉陷與淨空檢核驗收，並以比利時 Ben-Ahin 斜張橋、塞維亞 Barqueta 拱橋的浮力旋轉與石板坡鋼箱梁的轉向對照。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the logic of building parallel to a railway, road or river and then swinging into the crossing position, compute rotating weight, centre-of-gravity eccentricity and support-leg gaps, then handle spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque, local bearing in the lower turntable, the traction system, final positioning and hinge encasement, and finally accept with a weighing test, rotation monitoring and post-encasement settlement and clearance checks, contrasting Belgium's Ben-Ahin cable-stayed bridge, the floating swing of Seville's Barqueta arch and the turning of the Shibanpo steel box.
procedure: 轉體施工把橋梁上部結構先在不影響交通或河道的位置（通常平行於鐵路或河岸）以支架、懸臂或預製方式建好，再以橋墩頂或承台中的轉動中心旋轉到設計軸線。水平轉體最常見：一座平衡懸臂 T 構或斜張橋半跨坐在球鉸上，繞豎軸旋轉數十度；豎向轉體則把拱肋半跨先豎直或平躺建造，再繞拱腳的水平軸轉下或轉起；另有以浮箱支撐一端、繞另一端旋轉的浮運轉體。其核心價值是把跨越營運中鐵路或航道的高風險時段，壓縮成一次可控的數小時作業。

水平轉體時，整個上部結構與上轉盤只靠中心球鉸承重，周圍一圈撐腳與環形滑道保持數公釐到數十公釐的間隙，只在結構傾斜時接觸，作為防傾的保險。理論上兩側懸臂重量相等，但混凝土實際密度、斷面尺寸、預力與施工殘留物都會造成重心偏離球鉸中心，形成不平衡力矩。若不平衡力矩過大，撐腳會壓在滑道上摩擦，使牽引力暴增；因此設計常要求先量出偏心，再以配重調整，或刻意保留很小的縱向偏心，使結構穩定地以球鉸加一側撐腳轉動。
球鉸由上下兩片球面鋼板組成：下球面板固定在下轉盤，上球面板固定在上轉盤，兩者之間嵌入聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑片並塗抹潤滑脂。球面讓結構在豎直力作用下自動對中，也允許少量傾斜；滑片把接觸應力限制在材料容許範圍，並提供低而穩定的摩擦。轉動時的阻力主要是球鉸摩擦力矩，它與總重、摩擦係數與球鉸半徑成正比，所以球鉸做得越大，接觸應力越低，但摩擦力矩反而越大，這是球鉸尺寸設計的核心取捨。
球鉸把數萬噸的力量集中在直徑數公尺的範圍內，下轉盤（承台頂部）必須把這股集中力擴散到下方的樁基，同時抵抗局部壓碎與劈裂；上轉盤則把橋墩傳下的力量收攏到球鉸上，承受很大的徑向拉力。兩者都需密集配置環向與徑向鋼筋及多層鋼筋網。撐腳常為鋼管混凝土，底部有滑靴，環形滑道則是嵌入下轉盤的不鏽鋼板，平整度直接影響撐腳一旦接觸時的摩擦與衝擊。
水平轉體通常在上轉盤外圍纏繞鋼絞線牽引索，兩端分別接到對稱布置的兩台連續千斤頂，形成一對力偶推動結構旋轉，力偶不會對球鉸產生側向力。連續千斤頂以前後兩組夾持器交替工作，使牽引索連續前進而不需反覆換索。啟動瞬間要克服較大的靜摩擦，常另設助推千斤頂頂在撐腳或上轉盤上幫助啟動；轉動中則以較低的動摩擦力矩運行，並由電腦同步兩台千斤頂的行程與力量。
萬噸級結構以每分鐘幾公分的角速度轉動，動能其實很小，真正難的是精度：接近設計軸線時改為點動，每次只移動很小的距離，並在轉盤設置限位塊防止超轉。到位後以千斤頂微調軸線、高程與橫坡，接著以鋼楔或鋼支撐把上轉盤與下轉盤臨時鎖死，再在球鉸與撐腳周圍澆置封鉸混凝土，使轉動機構變成固結的墩底，最後與相鄰跨進行合龍。
拆除臨時支撐、讓結構完全落在球鉸上之後，要做稱重試驗：在撐腳附近兩側以千斤頂分別向上頂，量測千斤頂力與位移，找出位移突然增加的轉折點，代表結構開始繞球鉸轉動。由兩側的轉折點力量，可以同時解出重心偏心造成的不平衡力矩與球鉸的摩擦力矩，進而決定配重量與牽引力。這是轉體前唯一能直接量到真實狀態的機會，數據品質決定了後續所有判斷。
轉動期間結構處於一個與完工或施工階段都不同的臨時狀態：只有中心一點支承、兩側長懸臂、撐腳懸空。監測重點包括轉角與端點座標、兩懸臂端高程差、撐腳與滑道間隙、牽引力、墩身或轉盤應變，以及現場風速。風對長懸臂的影響主要不是水平扭轉，而是兩側不對稱的上揚或下壓力造成傾斜，可能使撐腳接觸滑道。每一項都必須事先設定警戒值與停止值。
轉體期間全部重量集中在球鉸，再由下轉盤擴散到承台與樁基；封鉸後球鉸、撐腳與封固混凝土共同成為墩底，結構體系由單點支承轉為固結。接著與相鄰跨合龍，懸臂成為連續梁的一部分，潛變使內力逐漸重分配。因為整座 T 構只坐在一個承台上，承台的不均勻沉陷會直接轉為懸臂端的高程變化；跨越鐵路時，這個變化還關係到下方淨空與相鄰跨的接縫。
轉體橋多半跨越營運中的鐵路或道路，完工後下方仍有列車與電車線，所以梁底淨空不能只在完工當天符合，而要在整個使用年限內符合：潛變下垂、承台沉陷、未來鋪面加鋪與鐵路軌道抬升都會吃掉淨空。交接時必須把這些因素做成淨空預算，並說明實測基準；同時把轉體期間的全部紀錄（稱重、試轉、轉動監測、封鉸）整理為工程檔案，因為日後的任何評估都需要知道這座橋曾經承受過的特殊臨時狀態。
procedureEn: Rotation construction builds the superstructure where it does not obstruct traffic or navigation, usually parallel to a railway or riverbank, by falsework, cantilevering or prefabrication, then swings it onto the design axis about a pivot in the pier top or pile cap. Horizontal rotation is most common: a balanced-cantilever T-frame or half of a cable-stayed bridge sits on a spherical hinge and turns tens of degrees about a vertical axis. Vertical rotation builds arch-rib halves upright or lying down and turns them about a horizontal axis at the springing; floating rotation supports one end on pontoons and pivots about the other. Its core value is compressing the high-risk period over a live railway or waterway into one controlled operation of a few hours.

In horizontal rotation the whole superstructure and upper turntable rest only on the central spherical hinge, while a ring of support legs keeps a gap of a few to tens of millimetres above an annular slideway and touches it only if the structure tilts, as an anti-overturning safeguard. In theory the two cantilevers weigh the same, but actual concrete density, section sizes, prestress and construction leftovers shift the centre of gravity off the hinge, creating an unbalanced moment. If it is large, legs bear on the slideway and friction greatly increases the traction needed, so designs usually require the eccentricity to be measured and corrected with ballast, or a very small longitudinal eccentricity kept on purpose so the structure turns steadily on the hinge plus one leg pair.

A spherical hinge consists of two spherical steel plates: the lower one fixed in the lower turntable and the upper one in the upper turntable, with greased PTFE pads inset between them. The spherical shape self-centres the structure under vertical load and permits a little tilt, while the pads keep contact stress within material limits and give low, stable friction. Rotation resistance is mainly the hinge friction torque, proportional to total weight, friction coefficient and hinge radius; a larger hinge lowers contact stress but raises friction torque, the central trade-off in sizing the hinge.

The hinge concentrates tens of thousands of tonnes onto an area a few metres across, so the lower turntable on top of the pile cap must spread this force into the piles while resisting local crushing and splitting; the upper turntable gathers pier forces onto the hinge and carries large radial tension. Both need dense hoop and radial reinforcement and several layers of mesh. Support legs are often concrete-filled steel tubes with sliding shoes, and the annular slideway is a stainless steel plate set into the lower turntable whose flatness governs friction and impact if a leg touches.

Horizontal rotation usually wraps strand traction cables around the upper turntable, each end connected to one of two symmetrically placed continuous jacks, forming a force couple that turns the structure without pushing the hinge sideways. Continuous jacks alternate front and rear grippers so the strands advance continuously without re-anchoring. At start-up the larger static friction must be overcome, often with auxiliary push jacks bearing on a leg or the upper turntable; during the turn the lower running friction torque applies, and a computer synchronises the strokes and forces of both jacks.

A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes turning at a few centimetres per minute has very little kinetic energy; the difficulty is precision. Near the design axis the jacks switch to inching, moving a tiny distance each time, and stop blocks on the turntable prevent over-rotation. On arrival, jacks fine-tune axis, level and cross-fall, steel wedges or struts temporarily lock the upper turntable to the lower, and encasement concrete is cast around the hinge and legs so the mechanism becomes a fixed pier base before closure with the adjacent spans.

After temporary supports are removed and the structure rests fully on the hinge, a weighing test is carried out: jacks near the legs on each side push upward in turn while force and displacement are measured, and the point where displacement suddenly increases marks the start of rotation about the hinge. The turning-point forces from both sides solve simultaneously for the unbalanced moment due to eccentricity and the hinge friction moment, which then set the ballast and traction force. It is the only chance before rotation to measure the real state directly, and its data quality governs every later decision.

During rotation the structure is in a temporary state unlike both construction and service: supported at a single central point with two long cantilevers and legs in the air. Monitoring covers rotation angle and tip coordinates, level difference between the tips, leg-to-slideway gaps, traction forces, pier or turntable strains and site wind speed. Wind acts on long cantilevers less through horizontal twisting than through unequal uplift or downward pressure on the two sides, which tilts the structure and can bring legs onto the slideway. Every quantity needs alert and stop values set in advance.

During rotation all the weight passes through the hinge and spreads through the lower turntable into the pile cap and piles; after encasement the hinge, legs and encasement concrete together form the pier base and the system changes from a single-point support to a fixed base. Closure with adjacent spans then makes the cantilevers part of a continuous girder, and creep gradually redistributes forces. Because the whole T-frame stands on one pile cap, differential settlement of that cap translates directly into tip-level changes, which over a railway also affect the clearance below and the joints with adjacent spans.

Rotated bridges usually cross live railways or roads, so trains and catenary remain below after completion, and soffit clearance must hold not just on opening day but throughout the service life: creep sag, pile-cap settlement, future resurfacing and track lifting all consume clearance. Handover must therefore present a clearance budget with measured baselines, and compile every rotation record, from weighing, trial turn and rotation monitoring to encasement, into the engineering file, because any later assessment needs to know the unusual temporary states the bridge has experienced.
evidence: 可行性研究階段就與鐵路或航道主管機關確認封鎖時段長度、轉動弧內的淨空要求與緊急恢復程序，並把這些條件寫入設計基準，而不是留給承包商在施工前才協調。
施工中持續累計兩側懸臂的實際重量（含預力、護欄預埋件與殘留模板），並在設計文件中訂明容許偏心與配重調整程序；配重的重量與位置由設計單位核定。
球鉸的製造、運輸、安裝與保護（防塵、防雨、防焊渣）應有專屬程序，安裝完成至轉動前以保護罩覆蓋；滑片材料與潤滑脂須有出廠檢驗與摩擦試驗報告。
下轉盤與球鉸區應以實體模型或三維鋼筋圖預先檢查可施工性，必要時改用自充填混凝土；撐腳、滑道與球鉸的安裝精度列為停留點，由監造與設計單位共同驗收。
牽引系統設計、試運轉與試轉都列為停留點，由專業技師與設計單位簽認；轉動指揮由單一總指揮下令，每一個監測點都能直接下達停止指令。
evidenceEn: At feasibility stage, agree possession length, clearances along the swept arc and emergency recovery procedures with the railway or waterway authority and write them into the design basis rather than leaving them to the contractor just before construction.

Keep a running tally of the actual weight of each cantilever during construction, including prestress, barrier embedments and leftover formwork, and state the allowable eccentricity and ballast procedure in the design documents; ballast weight and position are approved by the designer.

Hinge fabrication, transport, installation and protection from dust, rain and weld spatter need a dedicated procedure, with a protective cover from installation until rotation; pad material and grease require mill certificates and friction test reports.

Check constructability of the lower turntable and hinge zone with a mock-up or 3D reinforcement model, using self-compacting concrete if needed; installation accuracy of legs, slideway and hinge is a hold point accepted jointly by the supervising engineer and designer.

Traction design, unloaded trial and trial turn are hold points signed by a qualified engineer and the designer; the rotation is commanded by a single director, and every monitoring post can order an immediate stop.
pitfalls: 若規劃時只看起點與終點位置，忽略轉動弧線中段的淨空，懸臂端可能在轉動途中逼近電車線或鄰近結構，只能中途停止，讓結構停在既非施工位置也非設計位置的不利狀態。
下球面板在澆置時偏移或傾斜，上下球面無法密貼，接觸集中在局部，滑片被擠出或磨損，摩擦力矩遠大於設計值；潤滑脂混入砂土同樣會使摩擦暴增，轉動時出現停頓跳動。
兩台千斤頂不同步時，力偶變成合力，對球鉸施加水平推力，結構偏離中心或撐腳單側受壓；牽引索在轉盤槽內交疊或跳槽，會使牽引力突然下降，結構在慣性與風力下產生非預期擺動。
若稱重時臨時支撐或砂箱未完全拆除，部分重量仍由支撐承擔，量到的摩擦力矩偏低、偏心判斷錯誤，正式轉動時牽引力不足或結構突然傾向一側。
若只在轉動前後量測，忽略封鉸與合龍後的長期沉陷，數年後懸臂端下沉、伸縮縫錯台，跨鐵路段淨空逐漸減少；封鉸混凝土與既有轉盤之間若形成冷縫且未處理，雨水滲入使球鉸鋼板與錨筋腐蝕。
pitfallsEn: Planning only the start and end positions and ignoring clearance along the middle of the arc can bring a tip close to catenary or a neighbouring structure mid-turn, forcing a stop that leaves the structure in neither its construction nor its design position.

If the lower plate shifts or tilts during casting, the spheres do not seat, contact concentrates locally, pads extrude or wear and friction torque far exceeds design; grease contaminated with sand also sharply raises friction, causing stick-slip jumps during rotation.

Unsynchronised jacks turn the couple into a net force that pushes the hinge sideways, shifting the structure off-centre or loading legs on one side; strands overlapping or jumping out of the turntable groove cause a sudden loss of traction and unplanned swinging under wind.

If temporary supports or sand boxes are not fully removed, part of the weight bypasses the hinge, so measured friction is too low and eccentricity is misjudged; during the actual rotation traction proves insufficient or the structure suddenly leans to one side.

Surveying only around the rotation and ignoring long-term settlement after encasement and closure lets the tips drop and joints step over the years while clearance over the railway shrinks; an untreated cold joint between encasement and turntable lets rainwater reach the hinge plates and anchors, corroding them.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：正交異性鋼橋面板製作
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Orthotropic steel deck fabrication
guides.concept: 從輪載經面板、縱肋、橫梁到主梁的局部與整體傳力出發，以疲勞為主控計算面板厚度，再處理 U 形肋冷彎、肋—面板部分滲透焊、面板單元焊接變形、工地拼接收縮、非破壞檢測與試拼裝，最後以鋪面協同、疲勞熱點檢查與裂縫成長評估交接，並以金門大橋 1982 至 1986 年換裝鋼橋面、Lions Gate 橋與 Millau 高架橋為案例。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the local and global load path from wheel to deck plate, ribs, floorbeams and main girders, size the deck plate with fatigue governing, then handle cold-formed U-ribs, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, panel welding distortion, site-splice shrinkage, non-destructive testing and trial assembly, and finally hand over with surfacing interaction, fatigue hot-spot inspection and crack-growth assessment, using the Golden Gate Bridge's 1982–1986 redecking, Lions Gate and Millau as cases.
procedure: 正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。輪載先使面板在相鄰肋腹板之間局部受彎，再由縱肋把荷重以連續梁方式傳到橫梁，橫梁再傳到主梁或箱梁腹板；同時整片面板與縱肋又是主梁的上翼板，承受整體彎曲的縱向應力。這種一板多用的設計使橋面重量遠低於混凝土橋面，因此長跨懸索橋、斜張橋與活動橋普遍採用，但也意味著每一處焊接細部都承受局部與整體應力的疊加。
正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。焊接細部的疲勞壽命依 S–N 曲線與應力幅的三次方成反比，而面板局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比，所以面板稍微加厚，壽命就大幅增加。FHWA 2012 年手冊把面板最小厚度提高到 14 至 16 mm 列為近年改進之一，正是早期薄面板疲勞經驗的反映。
現代正交異性橋面多採閉口梯形或 U 形縱肋，由 6 至 10 mm 鋼板冷彎成型，抗扭勁度高，能把輪載分散到相鄰肋，且每延公尺需要的焊縫比開口肋少。冷彎時外緣纖維產生很大的塑性應變，會降低鋼材韌性並可能出現微裂，因此彎曲內半徑、鋼材的韌性等級與彎後檢查都要事先規定。閉口肋內部無法進入，所以肋的兩端要封閉或做好防蝕，肋本身的直線度與開口寬度也直接決定日後與面板的組裝間隙。
閉口肋只能從外側焊接，所以肋—面板焊縫是單面部分滲透焊：熔深太淺，未熔合的根部像一道預存裂縫，在輪載反覆下由根部向面板或焊趾成長；熔深太深則燒穿，在肋內形成焊瘤與缺口。FHWA 手冊強調此焊縫須控制熔深且不得燒穿。肋穿過橫梁時，橫梁腹板常在肋底部留下開孔，讓肋在輪載下能有限度地轉動，降低肋—橫梁焊縫的拘束應力；開孔形狀、焊縫包角與切割面品質都是疲勞敏感處。
面板單元通常是數公尺寬、十餘公尺長的面板配上數根 U 肋，大量長焊縫集中在面板一側，焊後冷卻收縮會使面板縱向彎曲並在肋間產生橫向角變形。若不控制，面板單元在組成箱梁時無法密合，工地拼接間隙不均，鋪面也難以平整。工廠常用反變形胎架把面板預先彎成與焊接收縮方向相反的形狀，配合對稱焊接順序與夾具，使焊後回彈到設計形狀；必要時再以火焰矯正，但火焰矯正溫度須受控，以免改變鋼材性質。
面板單元在工廠組成箱梁節段後，於工地或預拼場對接：面板以單面焊加陶瓷襯墊做全滲透對接焊，縱肋則因無法從內部焊接，常以一段短的嵌補肋在兩端與既有肋對接，或改用高強度螺栓拼接板。每一道橫向對接焊冷卻時都會縮短一點，數十道累積起來就可能讓整跨鋼梁長度不足，因此節段製作長度必須預留收縮量。拼接順序也很關鍵：先焊面板再焊縱肋，或反之，會產生不同的拘束應力。
正交異性橋面的焊縫數量以公里計，檢測策略必須分級：面板與主要對接焊做全長超音波或射線檢測；肋—面板部分滲透焊因為根部本來就不熔合，傳統超音波難以區分刻意的未熔合與缺陷，所以需要相位陣列超音波量測熔深，並以巨觀蝕刻試片校正；角焊縫與開孔端部則以目視與磁粉檢測表面裂紋。檢測結果必須與焊接參數紀錄連結，才能找出系統性問題，例如某一台焊機或某一班次的熔深偏低。
鋼箱梁節段離開工廠前，常把相鄰兩至三個節段在預拼場依設計線形擺放，確認端面間隙、面板錯邊、縱肋對位、拼接板孔位與整體預拱，必要時在工廠內修正，避免到了海上或高空才發現對不上。正交異性橋面的關鍵是縱肋與面板在拼接處的錯邊：對接處的偏心會使局部應力集中，直接縮短疲勞壽命。三維雷射掃描或全站儀量測把每一節段的實際幾何建成數位模型，供架設時模擬閉合。
正交異性橋面的鋪面不只是行車表面：它把輪載分散到較大面積，並在低溫時與鋼面板部分合成，顯著降低面板與焊縫的應力幅；同時保護鋼面板免受水與鹽侵蝕。金門大橋 1980 年代換裝的鋼橋面採用約 2 吋（約 50 mm）的環氧瀝青鋪面。鋪面的勁度隨溫度大幅改變，夏季高溫時合成效果降低，面板應力上升；鋪面開裂或與鋼板脫層，則同時失去分散荷載與防水兩種功能。
正交異性橋面的疲勞裂縫集中在少數已知位置：肋—面板焊縫根部向面板內成長、肋—橫梁連接與開孔端部、嵌補肋拼接焊縫、面板對接焊。根部向面板成長的裂縫從上方被鋪面遮住、從箱內看不到焊縫內部，往往要到鋪面沿肋線開裂才被發現。因此交接時必須提供以熱點為主的檢查清單、箱內通行路線、可用的超音波檢測方法，以及依裂縫成長速度訂定的檢查週期；修復可用止裂孔、螺栓補強板或橋面加鋪高性能混凝土層。
procedureEn: An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name. A wheel load first bends the deck plate locally between adjacent rib webs; the ribs then carry the load as continuous beams to the floorbeams, which pass it to the main girders or box webs. At the same time the deck plate and ribs act as the top flange of the main girder, carrying longitudinal stress from global bending. This multiple use makes the deck far lighter than concrete, so long suspension, cable-stayed and movable bridges widely adopt it, but it also means every welded detail sees local and global stresses superimposed.

Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century. Welded-detail fatigue life is inversely proportional to the cube of stress range on the S–N curve, while local plate bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness, so a slightly thicker plate greatly extends life. FHWA's 2012 manual lists raising the minimum deck-plate thickness to 14 to 16 mm among recent improvements, reflecting the fatigue experience of early thin plates.

Modern orthotropic decks mostly use closed trapezoidal or U-shaped ribs cold-bent from 6 to 10 mm plate, with high torsional stiffness that spreads wheel loads to neighbouring ribs and fewer welds per metre than open ribs. Cold bending puts large plastic strain in the outer fibres, which reduces toughness and can cause micro-cracks, so the inner bend radius, the steel's toughness grade and post-bending inspection must be specified in advance. The inside of a closed rib is inaccessible, so its ends must be sealed or protected against corrosion, and the rib's straightness and opening width directly govern the later fit-up gap to the deck plate.

A closed rib can only be welded from outside, so the rib-to-deck weld is a one-sided partial-penetration weld: too shallow and the unfused root acts as a built-in crack that grows under repeated wheel loads into the deck plate or toe; too deep and it melts through, leaving drop-through and notches inside the rib. FHWA's manual stresses controlled penetration with no melt-through. Where ribs pass through floorbeams, the floorbeam web usually has a cut-out below the rib so the rib can rotate a little under wheel loads, reducing restraint stresses in the rib-to-floorbeam weld; cut-out shape, weld wrap-around and cut-edge quality are all fatigue-sensitive.

A panel unit is usually a deck plate a few metres wide and over ten metres long with several U-ribs, concentrating many long welds on one side; cooling shrinkage bows the panel longitudinally and causes angular distortion between ribs. Uncontrolled, panels will not fit when assembled into box girders, site-splice gaps become uneven and the surfacing is hard to finish flat. Shops use pre-cambered jigs that bend the panel opposite to the weld shrinkage, together with symmetrical welding sequences and clamps, so it springs back to the design shape; flame straightening may follow if needed, but its temperature must be controlled so the steel's properties are not altered.

Panels are assembled into box segments in the shop and joined on site or in a pre-assembly yard: the deck plate gets one-sided full-penetration butt welds on ceramic backing, while ribs, which cannot be welded from inside, are usually joined with a short insert rib welded at both ends to the existing ribs, or with high-strength bolted splice plates. Each transverse butt weld shortens a little as it cools, and dozens of them can leave a whole span short, so segment fabrication lengths must include a shrinkage allowance. Splice sequence also matters: welding the deck plate first or the ribs first produces different restraint stresses.

Welds on an orthotropic deck run to kilometres, so inspection must be graded: deck-plate and main butt welds get full-length ultrasonic or radiographic testing; rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds have an intentionally unfused root that conventional ultrasonics struggle to distinguish from defects, so phased-array ultrasonics measure penetration, calibrated against macro-etch specimens; fillet welds and cut-out ends are checked visually and by magnetic particle for surface cracks. Results must be linked to welding-parameter records to reveal systematic problems such as low penetration from a particular machine or shift.

Before leaving the shop, two or three adjacent box segments are often laid out in the pre-assembly yard on the design alignment to check end gaps, deck-plate misalignment, rib registration, splice-plate hole positions and overall camber, correcting problems in the shop rather than discovering them at sea or at height. For orthotropic decks the key item is misalignment of ribs and plates at splices: eccentricity at a butt joint concentrates local stress and directly shortens fatigue life. 3D laser scanning or total-station surveys build a digital model of each segment's real geometry for simulating closure during erection.

The surfacing on an orthotropic deck is more than a running surface: it spreads wheel loads over a larger area and, when cold, acts partly compositely with the steel plate, markedly reducing stress ranges in the plate and welds, while protecting the plate from water and salt. The Golden Gate Bridge's 1980s steel deck received about 2 inches (about 50 mm) of epoxy asphalt. Surfacing stiffness changes greatly with temperature, so composite action drops in hot summers and plate stresses rise; cracking or debonding of the surfacing loses both load spreading and waterproofing.

Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds. Root cracks growing into the plate are hidden by surfacing from above and invisible inside the weld from within the box, so they are often found only when the surfacing cracks along rib lines. Handover must therefore supply a hot-spot inspection checklist, access routes inside the box, suitable ultrasonic methods and inspection intervals based on crack-growth rates; repairs include stop holes, bolted doubler plates or an overlay of high-performance concrete on the deck.
evidence: 設計報告須同時提供整體與局部模型的關鍵細部應力表，並標示重車道與輪跡位置；製造廠的焊接程序與檢驗計畫必須依這些關鍵細部分級，而不是對所有焊縫一視同仁。
業主規範應明訂面板最小厚度、縱肋最小厚度與關鍵細部的疲勞類別，並要求新細部須有試驗依據；設計審查時把疲勞計算列為必審項目，而不是附錄。
採購規格須訂明肋用鋼材的韌性等級、最小彎曲內半徑與彎後檢查頻率；每批肋件以批號追蹤到面板單元，確保發現問題時能回溯。
肋—面板焊接應以自動化設備、固定姿勢與經評定的參數施焊，組裝間隙在焊前逐段檢查並記錄；開孔以數控切割並規定表面粗糙度與研磨要求，關鍵焊縫的焊工資格與參數紀錄須可追溯。
製造計畫須包含胎架設計、焊接順序圖、變形量測點與允差、火焰矯正溫度上限與方法，並經業主審查；變形量測結果應建檔，作為後續批次修正的依據。
evidenceEn: The design report must give tables of key detail stresses from both global and local models and mark heavy lanes and wheel paths; the fabricator's welding procedures and inspection plan must be graded by these key details rather than treating every weld alike.

Owner specifications should set minimum deck-plate and rib thicknesses and fatigue categories for key details, require test evidence for new details, and treat fatigue calculations as a mandatory review item rather than an appendix.

Procurement must specify the rib steel's toughness grade, minimum inner bend radius and post-bending inspection frequency; each batch of ribs is traced by lot number to its panels so any problem can be traced back.

Rib-to-deck welds should be made with automated equipment in a fixed position with qualified parameters, with fit-up gaps checked and recorded section by section before welding; cut-outs are CNC cut with specified roughness and grinding, and welder qualifications and parameter records for key welds must be traceable.

The fabrication plan must include jig design, welding-sequence drawings, distortion measuring points and tolerances, and flame-straightening temperature limits and methods, reviewed by the owner; distortion records are filed as the basis for correcting later batches.
pitfalls: 只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。
內半徑過小或鋼材韌性不足，彎角外側出現微裂紋，日後在交通載重下成為疲勞起始點；肋開口寬度超差，與面板組裝時間隙不均，部分滲透焊的熔深隨之忽深忽淺。
未使用反變形或焊接順序不對稱，面板單元扭曲成馬鞍形，組裝箱梁時以強力拉合，留下很大的殘餘應力；過度火焰矯正則使局部鋼材過熱，韌性下降，日後成為脆性破壞或疲勞的起點。
只以目視檢查外觀良好的肋—面板焊縫，無法發現熔深不足，問題要到通車多年後鋪面沿肋線開裂才浮現；檢測資料與焊接紀錄分開保存，則無法判斷缺陷是個別偶發還是整批參數錯誤。
鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。
pitfallsEn: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above.

Too small a bend radius or insufficient toughness creates micro-cracks on the outside of bends that later initiate fatigue under traffic; ribs with out-of-tolerance opening widths give uneven gaps at fit-up, so the penetration of the partial-penetration weld varies along the rib.

Without pre-camber or with unsymmetrical welding, panels twist into a saddle shape and are forced together during box assembly, locking in large residual stresses; excessive flame straightening overheats the steel locally, lowering toughness and creating a starting point for brittle fracture or fatigue.

Visual checks of a neat-looking rib-to-deck weld cannot reveal shallow penetration, which surfaces only years after opening as surfacing cracks along the rib lines; keeping inspection data apart from welding records makes it impossible to tell an isolated defect from a whole batch welded with wrong parameters.

Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

factsEn: FHWA manual: an SPMT axle line carries a maximum of about 26 to 33 US tons (24 to 30 t), depending on width
Each axle line exerts a maximum ground pressure of about 1,500 to 2,000 pounds per square foot
Loaded SPMTs typically travel at about 3 mph (4.8 km/h) and handle about 18 inch surface variations and about 8% grades
Available hydraulic stroke is at least about 24 inches, with 16 to 20 inches assumed in operations; dynamic allowance is at least 15% of dead load
Florida's I-4/Graves Avenue (2006) new spans were about 143 ft (43.5 m) and about 1,300 US tons, each driven to site in about 30 minutes
The Badhoevedorp A4/A5 two-span bridge, about 390 ft (118.8 m) and over 3,600 US tons, moved on 134 axle lines in 2 hours
Chicago's Wells Street bridge received a 111 ft, 425 US ton steel truss by SPMT over one weekend in 2002
France's PRA 13 09 railway bridge moved 146 ft at about 8 inches per minute with a rail closure of only 48 hours

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。

procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.

Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：自行式模組運輸車換橋
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: SPMT bridge replacement
guides.concept: 從整跨上部結構改由運輸車支承時的彎矩反轉出發，計算動態放大、軸線數量、臨時支撐塔穩定與行駛路徑地盤承載，再處理封閉時段時程、落梁行程與支承對位、移動中的應變與水平監測、地盤預壓試驗，最後檢核既有下部結構、評估用路人成本並交接，案例取自 FHWA 手冊中的佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue、荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 與芝加哥 Wells Street 換橋。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the moment reversal when a whole span is carried by transporters, compute dynamic allowance, axle-line count, temporary-tower stability and travel-path bearing, then handle the closure timeline, set-down stroke and bearing alignment, strain and level monitoring during the move and ground proof testing, and finally check the existing substructure, evaluate user costs and hand over, with cases from the FHWA manual: Florida's I-4/Graves Avenue, the Netherlands' Badhoevedorp A4/A5 and Chicago's Wells Street replacements.
procedure: 以自行式模組運輸車（SPMT）換橋時，新橋整跨先在附近的預製區臨時支架上完成，再由運輸車從梁下頂起、開到橋位、降落到支承上；舊橋則以相反流程移走。運輸車的支承點通常位於梁端內側數公尺，而不是永久支承位置，所以運輸期間梁成為兩端外伸的簡支梁：跨中正彎矩略減，但梁端出現營運時不存在的負彎矩。預力梁端部頂緣在營運時本來就受預力拉應力，再加上外伸負彎矩，可能開裂，因此支承點位置必須由設計者決定，而不是由運輸商依車輛配置自行選擇。
SPMT 由多個六軸或四軸模組拼接，每一軸線有額定承載，懸吊為液壓式：同一液壓群組內各軸壓力相等，因此可以把整組車輛分成三個液壓群組，形成靜定的三點支承。這樣地面起伏或坡度變化只讓橋體整體傾斜，不會強迫橋體扭曲；若誤設成四點以上的獨立群組，地面一處下陷就會讓某一角卸載、對角加載，在橋面產生扭轉。FHWA 手冊建議運輸時至少加上 15% 的自重動態放大，並且不允許暫時超應力。
橋梁支承面通常比運輸車平台高出數公尺，所以運輸車上要架設臨時支撐塔或疊木，把橋體頂到所需高度。這些支撐塔在行駛中承受加速、煞車、坡度與轉向造成的水平力，又坐在會微小起伏的液壓平台上，橫向穩定與塔頂和梁底的接觸都必須設計：接觸點應對準橫隔梁或腹板，並以墊板分散壓力；塔身需交叉斜撐，塔頂與梁體要有防滑與限位。

SPMT 把數千噸的力量分散在大量輪胎上，每一軸線的接地壓力不高，但整個車隊下方的地盤承受大面積、長時間的荷載，地面的沉陷差會讓橋體傾斜，局部軟弱點甚至讓單一軸線陷落。FHWA 手冊指出每一軸線最大接地壓力約為每平方英尺 1,500 至 2,000 磅，車輛可吸收約 18 吋的地面起伏、爬升約 8% 的坡度。行駛路徑下方的箱涵、管線與擋土牆必須逐一檢核，路面還要有足夠平整度與排水，避免雨水使路基軟化。

SPMT 換橋的價值在於把現場對交通的影響從數月縮短到數小時或一個週末：新橋在預製區與交通隔離的條件下施工，舊橋在封閉開始後被整跨移走，支承座與台帽在短時間內整修，新橋開到位、落梁，接著完成引道與接縫，最後恢復通車。FHWA 手冊的佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue 案例中，每跨新橋從預製區運到橋位約 30 分鐘，但手冊也提醒，道路與引道工程必須跟上橋梁的速度，否則封閉時間會被非橋梁工項拖長。
SPMT 以液壓懸吊升降，行程有限：FHWA 手冊指出可用垂直行程至少約 24 吋，作業時宜只假設 16 至 20 吋。這段行程要同時應付頂起時越過支承座的淨空、行駛中的地面起伏，以及落梁時支點由運輸點移到永久支承所造成的撓度改變。落梁時先粗對位，再以液壓微調平面與高程，最後慢慢下降使梁平均坐上支承；任何一個支承懸空或偏壓，都會讓梁體以三點支承並在活載下搖動。
運輸期間橋體處於非設計狀態，監測可把這段風險轉為可量測的數據：在運輸支點附近梁端頂緣與跨中底緣貼應變計，在橋面設傾斜儀或水準點監看縱橫向傾斜，並記錄每一液壓群組壓力與車速。運輸商的控制系統本身會保持平台水平，但只有在橋體上量測，才能知道橋體實際承受的應力與扭轉。每一項都要有預先設定的警戒值與停止值，並由專人負責通報。
地盤調查只能抽樣，真正的驗證是讓路徑在接近實際荷載下表現一次：先以平鈑載重試驗取得路基模數，估算車隊下的沉陷；再以配重或空車試行全路徑，量測沉陷、找出軟弱點並演練轉向、加減速與通訊。FHWA 手冊的荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 案例以 134 軸線移動逾 3,600 噸的兩跨橋，手冊特別指出成功依靠良好的地盤準備與平整路面。

SPMT 換橋常保留既有橋台與橋墩，只更換上部結構，但新橋可能更長、更寬或更重：FHWA 手冊的 Graves Avenue 案例中，新跨約 143 ft、重約 1,300 噸，取代的舊中跨僅約 70.5 ft、約 250 噸。下部結構必須以新反力重新評估承載、耐震與耐久，包括混凝土劣化、鋼筋腐蝕、基礎沖刷與支承座強度。新舊混凝土的接縫、伸縮縫與排水細部也要重新設計，否則換了新橋，水仍沿舊縫滲入下部結構。
SPMT 換橋的設備與預製成本通常較高，其合理性來自用路人延滯、繞道與施工區安全風險的大幅降低，所以工程結束後應以實際封閉時間、交通量與事故紀錄評估成效，作為下一個專案的決策依據。交接時除了新橋的竣工資料，還要保存運輸階段計算、監測資料、地盤試驗與落梁紀錄，因為新橋曾經歷一次與設計不同的受力狀態，日後若在梁端發現裂縫，這些資料是判斷成因的關鍵。
procedureEn: In an SPMT replacement, the new span is completed on temporary supports in a nearby staging area, lifted from below by self-propelled modular transporters, driven to site and lowered onto its bearings, while the old span is removed by the reverse process. The transporter support points usually lie a few metres inside the girder ends rather than at the permanent bearings, so during transport the girder becomes a simple beam with overhangs: midspan sagging moment drops slightly, but the ends see hogging moment that never occurs in service. At prestressed girder ends the top fibre already carries tension from prestress, and the overhang moment can crack it, so support positions must be set by the designer, not chosen by the transport contractor to suit the vehicle layout.

SPMTs are assembled from six- or four-axle modules, each axle line with a rated capacity, and their suspension is hydraulic: pressures are equal within a hydraulic group, so the fleet can be divided into three groups to form a statically determinate three-point support. Ground undulations or grade changes then merely tilt the span as a whole without forcing it to twist; set up wrongly as four or more independent groups, a dip under one corner unloads it and overloads the diagonal, twisting the deck. The FHWA manual recommends a dynamic allowance of at least 15% on dead load during the move and allows no temporary overstress.

Bridge seats are usually several metres above the transporter decks, so temporary towers or cribbing on the transporters raise the span to the required height. During travel these towers take horizontal forces from acceleration, braking, grade and steering while standing on hydraulic platforms that move slightly, so their lateral stability and the contact between tower head and girder must be designed: contact points should align with diaphragms or webs with spreader plates, towers need cross-bracing, and the head needs anti-slip and restraint devices against the span.

SPMTs spread thousands of tonnes over many tyres, so pressure under each axle line is modest, but the ground beneath the whole fleet carries a large area for a long time; differential settlement tilts the span and a local soft spot can sink a single axle line. The FHWA manual gives a maximum ground pressure per axle line of about 1,500 to 2,000 pounds per square foot, with surface variations of about 18 inches and grades of about 8% manageable by the vehicles. Culverts, utilities and retaining walls under the travel path must each be checked, and the surface needs enough flatness and drainage so rain does not soften the subgrade.

The value of an SPMT replacement lies in shrinking the traffic impact from months to hours or a weekend: the new span is built in a staging area away from traffic, the old span is carried off whole once the closure starts, bearing seats and caps are refurbished quickly, the new span is driven in and set, approaches and joints are completed and traffic resumes. In the FHWA manual's Florida I-4/Graves Avenue case each new span took about 30 minutes to travel from the staging area to the bridge, but the manual also warns that roadwork must keep pace with the bridge or non-bridge items will stretch the closure.

SPMTs raise and lower through hydraulic suspension with limited stroke: the FHWA manual gives a minimum available vertical stroke of about 24 inches and advises assuming only 16 to 20 inches in operations. This stroke must cover the clearance over the bearing seats at lift-off, ground undulations on the route, and the change in deflection when support moves from the transport points to the permanent bearings at set-down. Set-down starts with rough alignment, then hydraulic fine adjustment in plan and level, and finally a slow descent so the girders seat evenly; any bearing left unloaded or overloaded leaves the span rocking on three supports under traffic.

During the move the span is in a non-design state, and monitoring turns that risk into measurable data: strain gauges on the top fibre near the transport supports and on the bottom fibre at midspan, tilt sensors or level points on the deck for longitudinal and transverse tilt, and logs of every hydraulic group's pressure and the travel speed. The transporter's control system keeps its platform level, but only measurements on the span show the stresses and twist it actually experiences. Every quantity needs pre-set alert and stop values and a person responsible for reporting.

Ground investigation only samples; the real proof is letting the path perform once under near-actual load: a plate-load test first gives the subgrade modulus for estimating settlement under the fleet, then a ballasted or empty trial run over the full route measures settlement, finds soft spots and rehearses steering, acceleration, braking and communications. In the FHWA manual's Badhoevedorp A4/A5 case in the Netherlands, 134 axle lines moved a two-span bridge of more than 3,600 tons, and the manual notes that success depended on good ground preparation and level surfaces.

SPMT replacements often keep the existing abutments and piers and replace only the superstructure, but the new span may be longer, wider or heavier: in the FHWA manual's Graves Avenue case the new spans were about 143 ft long and about 1,300 tons, replacing an old middle span of about 70.5 ft and about 250 tons. The substructure must be re-assessed for the new reactions in capacity, seismic performance and durability, including concrete deterioration, reinforcement corrosion, foundation scour and seat strength. Joints between new and old concrete, expansion joints and drainage must also be redesigned, or water will keep seeping along old joints into the substructure under the new span.

SPMT replacements usually cost more in equipment and prefabrication; their justification lies in large reductions in user delay, detours and work-zone safety risk, so after completion the actual closure time, traffic volumes and incident records should be used to evaluate the benefit and inform the next project's decision. Handover should keep not only the new bridge's as-built data but also the transport-stage calculations, monitoring data, ground tests and set-down records, because the span once experienced a load state different from its design, and these data are key to explaining any cracking found later at the girder ends.
evidence: 合約圖說應明訂運輸與暫置期間的容許支承區域、最大外伸長度與動態放大假設，並要求承包商提送運輸階段計算，經設計單位審查同意後才可施作。
運輸前以實際稱重或液壓讀值確認橋體重量與重心，群組設定與利用率上限由運輸工程師簽認並經設計單位確認；任何臨時增加的材料都必須登記並重算。
臨時支撐塔與梁體連接細部屬於停留點，須由專業技師設計簽認並在頂升前檢查；行駛速度、轉向半徑與緊急煞車程序寫入運輸計畫，並與支撐塔設計採用的水平係數一致。
行駛路徑設計須包括地盤調查、地下設施清單與保護措施、平整度與排水要求，並在運輸前一天做最後巡查；天候不佳時依事先訂定的條件延期，而不是冒險移動。
合約以封閉時段為核心訂定獎懲，要求承包商事先調查並預修支承座、預製引道版或採用早強材料，並準備備用設備；封閉開始的放行條件（設備、天候、人員）由業主與承包商共同簽認。
evidenceEn: Contract drawings should define permitted support zones, maximum overhang and the dynamic allowance for transport and storage, and require the contractor to submit transport-stage calculations accepted by the designer before work.

Before the move, confirm span weight and centre of gravity by weighing or hydraulic readings; the group configuration and utilisation limit are signed by the transport engineer and confirmed by the designer, and any added material is logged and recalculated.

Temporary towers and their connection to the span are a hold point, designed and signed by a qualified engineer and inspected before lifting; travel speed, turning radius and emergency braking procedures go into the transport plan consistent with the horizontal coefficient used for the towers.

The travel-path design must include ground investigation, a buried-services register with protection measures, and flatness and drainage requirements, with a final walk-down the day before; in bad weather postpone by pre-agreed criteria instead of risking the move.

Contracts build incentives and penalties around the closure window, require the contractor to investigate and pre-repair bearing seats, prefabricate approach slabs or use rapid-strength materials and keep standby equipment; release to start the closure (equipment, weather, crews) is signed jointly by owner and contractor.
pitfalls: 運輸商為了配合車輛長度把支點往內移，梁端外伸變長，預力梁端部頂緣在運輸中開裂；若支點落在沒有橫隔梁的位置，梁底局部承壓過大，造成翼板破損或鋼梁腹板局部挫屈。
支撐塔沒有足夠斜撐，在轉彎或緊急煞車時側傾，橋體滑落；接觸點偏離橫隔梁，梁底翼板或鋼梁下翼板在集中力下局部破壞，被迫中止運輸。
橋梁本身準時就位，但引道版混凝土強度未達或鋪面機具故障，封閉被迫延長，抵銷了 SPMT 換橋的效益；舊橋移除後才發現支承座嚴重劣化，需要的修復時間遠超過預算。
沒有橋體監測時，運輸車平台雖然保持水平，但臨時支撐塔沉陷或接觸點滑移使橋體扭轉，直到落梁後才在梁端發現裂縫；監測資料若未與位置同步，事後無法判斷問題發生在路徑哪一段。
只檢查支承座外觀就沿用舊橋台，新橋反力使老化的台帽在支承下方開裂；舊伸縮縫位置沒有改善排水，數年後台帽與支承仍持續劣化，新上部結構的壽命被舊下部結構拖累。
pitfallsEn: A transport contractor moving support points inward to suit vehicle length lengthens the overhangs and cracks prestressed girder ends at the top during transport; supports placed away from diaphragms overload the soffit locally, breaking flanges or buckling steel webs.

Under-braced towers lean over during a turn or emergency stop and the span slides off; contact points away from diaphragms crush the soffit flange or buckle a steel bottom flange locally, forcing the move to stop.

The span itself is set on time, but approach-slab concrete is not strong enough or paving plant breaks down, so the closure overruns and cancels the benefit of the SPMT move; finding severely deteriorated bearing seats only after removing the old span needs repair time far beyond the budget.

Without monitoring on the span, the transporter platforms stay level but a settling tower or slipping contact twists the span, and cracks at the girder ends are found only after set-down; monitoring not synchronised with position cannot show afterwards where along the route the problem occurred.

Reusing an old abutment after only a visual check of the seats lets the heavier new reactions crack the aged cap under the bearings; leaving drainage at the old joint unimproved means cap and bearings keep deteriorating, so the old substructure limits the life of the new superstructure.
