guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：橋墩纖維複材耐震補強
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers
guides.concept: 從舊橋墩的剪力、圍束與柱底搭接三種缺陷出發，說明纖維複材套管為何只沿環向布纖維、如何以側向圍束壓力與有效應變計算層數與剪力貢獻，再處理表面處理、露點與圓角、濕式積層、拉拔與脫層檢驗、補強前後反覆載重驗證、紫外線與撞擊耐久以及震後量測，並以賓州 I-84 跨越橋 1995 年的塑鉸區包覆與舊金山碼頭 250 支沉箱套管為例。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the three deficiencies of old piers — shear, confinement and base lap splices — explain why FRP jackets place fibres only in the hoop direction and how confining pressure and effective strain set ply count and shear contribution, then cover surface preparation, dew point and corner rounding, wet lay-up, pull-off and delamination checks, cyclic validation before and after retrofit, UV and impact durability and post-earthquake measurement, using the 1995 plastic-hinge wrapping of a Pennsylvania I-84 overpass and jackets on about 250 caissons of a San Francisco pier.
procedure: 1970 年代以前設計的橋墩，箍筋常為小直徑、大間距的開口箍，柱底主筋以短搭接接到基礎預留筋，剪力強度也只依彈性地震力計算。地震時這三種缺陷分別導致脆性剪力破壞、保護層剝落後核心壓碎與主筋挫屈，以及柱底搭接滑脫。纖維複材套管的策略是在柱外包覆以環向為主的纖維，像額外的箍筋一樣抑制斜裂縫張開、圍束核心混凝土並夾緊搭接段，而不增加縱向彎矩強度。
補強的目的是讓塑鉸能在柱端形成並延展，而不是把柱變得更強：若套管增加了柱的彎矩強度，地震時傳到基礎、帽梁與樁的力隨之增加，原本沒有問題的構件可能變成新的弱點。因此纖維主要沿環向布置，套管兩端通常與基礎頂面及帽梁底面留一小段間隙，避免套管直接承壓而增加斷面抗彎。圍束後的核心混凝土強度提高會讓塑性彎矩小幅上升，設計者必須以補強後的超強度彎矩重新檢核能力保護構件。
橋墩補強常用碳纖維或玻璃纖維織物，以環氧樹脂含浸後積層，或採工廠預製殼片。纖維在破斷前近乎線彈性、沒有降伏平台，因此設計不以強度而以「有效應變」控制：實際套管在圓角、搭接與混凝土不均勻膨脹處會提早破斷，所以只取材料破斷應變的一部分。長期環境（濕熱、鹼性、紫外線）又會降低性能，玻璃纖維對鹼與濕氣較敏感，故設計值要再乘以環境折減係數。
混凝土受壓後橫向膨脹，環向纖維被拉緊而對核心施加側向圍束壓力，壓力大小與纖維勁度、層數及有效應變成正比、與柱徑成反比，因此大直徑橋柱需要更多層。圍束壓力太低時，混凝土強度與極限應變的提升不明顯，設計指引因此設下最小圍束比。同一套管也提供剪力強度：斜裂縫張開時，跨越裂縫的環向纖維受拉抵抗，但為了保持骨材互鎖，剪力計算的纖維應變上限比圍束更嚴。
纖維套管的效果建立在纖維緊貼混凝土上：圍束型套管靠接觸傳力，剪力與搭接夾持則需要良好黏結。施工前要清除劣化混凝土、修補剝落並灌注裂縫，以研磨去除表面浮漿與油污；矩形斷面的角隅必須磨圓，否則纖維在尖角處應力集中而提早斷裂。樹脂對濕氣與溫度敏感，混凝土表面若有凝結水，黏結會失效，因此施工時要量測表面溫度、氣溫、相對濕度與露點。

濕式積層是在現場把樹脂含浸的纖維織物一層層繞柱包覆，每一圈末端以規定長度搭接，讓纖維拉力能經由樹脂傳遞；纖維方向偏斜、皺摺或氣泡都會降低效果。預製殼片則在工廠成型，現場套在柱外並以灌漿填滿殼片與柱之間的間隙。舊金山一座碼頭約 250 支直徑 4 呎的沉箱，就以預製套管留出約 2 吋間隙、外加濕式積層並灌入無收縮砂漿完成補強。包覆範圍至少要涵蓋可能的塑鉸區，例如賓州 I-84 跨越橋在每支柱頂與柱底各取 5 呎塑鉸區。
套管施工品質無法從外觀判斷，必須以試驗確認：拉拔試驗把圓形拉拔頭黏在硬化後的積層上、切穿至混凝土後垂直拉起，破壞面應在混凝土內，表示黏結強於基材；敲擊或紅外線熱影像可找出積層與混凝土之間的空鼓與脫層；見證試片則與現場同條件製作，送驗拉伸強度與彈性模數。這些結果與設計值比較，決定接受、修補或重做。
纖維套管補強設計公式之所以可信，是因為研究機構以接近實尺寸的舊式配筋橋柱，在固定軸力下做補強前後的反覆載重比較試驗：未補強柱常在小漂移比時剪力破壞或搭接滑脫，補強柱則能發展穩定的彎曲遲滯迴圈並達到數倍的位移韌性。1990 年代加州大學聖地牙哥分校等實驗室的系列試驗，使複材套管成為鋼板套管以外的補強選項。試驗也揭示了限制：套管可能遮蔽損傷、端部間隙不當會改變塑鉸位置。
環氧樹脂暴露於紫外線會粉化，因此戶外套管需要面塗；長期濕熱與鹼性環境會降低樹脂與纖維界面的性能，玻璃纖維尤其敏感。橋墩位於河道或路旁時，還要面對漂流物、砂石磨耗與車輛撞擊，局部損傷會切斷環向纖維的連續性。碳纖維與鋼構件直接接觸可能引起電化學腐蝕，需以絕緣層隔開。賓州 I-84 跨越橋 1995 年完成的套管，在約 17 年後仍未見脫層，說明正確的材料選擇與保護可以提供長期性能。
套管把混凝土包起來，也把地震損傷藏起來：震後檢查員無法直接看到裂縫與剝落，只能從套管的鼓脹、皺褶、纖維斷裂、樹脂白化與底部碎屑判斷。量測套管周長變化是簡單有效的方法，因為核心混凝土膨脹會使套管環向伸長，換算的環向應變可與設計有效應變比較。因此交接時要留下每支柱的周長、厚度、熱影像基準與試驗結果，震後才能比較；判斷結果決定繼續使用、加層補強或拆除重做。
procedureEn: Piers designed before the 1970s often have small, widely spaced open hoops, column bars lapped onto short footing starter bars at the base, and shear strength sized only for elastic seismic forces. In an earthquake these three deficiencies lead respectively to brittle shear failure, core crushing and bar buckling after cover spalling, and slip of the base lap splice. The FRP jacket strategy wraps the column with mainly hoop-direction fibres that act like extra hoops, restraining diagonal crack opening, confining the core and clamping the splice zone, without adding longitudinal flexural strength.

The goal of retrofit is to let the plastic hinge form and deform at the column end, not to make the column stronger: if the jacket increases flexural strength, the forces delivered to footing, cap beam and piles rise in an earthquake and members that were adequate can become new weak links. Fibres are therefore placed mainly in the hoop direction, and the jacket usually stops a small gap short of the footing top and cap-beam soffit so it does not bear directly and add flexural capacity. Confined core concrete still raises the plastic moment slightly, so the designer must recheck capacity-protected members with the retrofitted overstrength moment.

Pier retrofits commonly use carbon or glass fabrics saturated with epoxy and laminated, or factory-made prefabricated shells. The fibres are nearly linear-elastic to rupture with no yield plateau, so design is controlled by effective strain rather than strength: real jackets rupture early at corners, overlaps and where the concrete dilates unevenly, so only part of the material's rupture strain is used. Long-term environment (moisture, heat, alkalinity and UV) also reduces performance, and glass fibre is more sensitive to alkali and moisture, so design values are multiplied by an environmental reduction factor.

When compressed concrete expands laterally, the hoop fibres tighten and apply confining pressure to the core; the pressure is proportional to fibre stiffness, ply count and effective strain and inversely proportional to column diameter, so large bridge columns need more plies. With too little pressure the gains in concrete strength and ultimate strain are insignificant, so guidance sets a minimum confinement ratio. The same jacket also supplies shear strength: as diagonal cracks open, hoop fibres crossing them resist in tension, but the strain limit for shear is stricter than for confinement to preserve aggregate interlock.

A jacket works only if the fibres sit tight on the concrete: confinement jackets transfer force by contact, while shear and splice clamping need good bond. Before application, deteriorated concrete is removed, spalls repaired and cracks injected, and the surface ground to remove laitance and oil; corners of rectangular sections must be rounded, or fibres concentrate stress at sharp edges and rupture early. Resins are sensitive to moisture and temperature, and condensation on the concrete defeats bond, so surface temperature, air temperature, relative humidity and dew point are measured during application.

Wet lay-up wraps resin-saturated fabric around the column ply by ply on site, each ply ending in a specified overlap so fibre tension passes through the resin; misaligned fibres, wrinkles or air pockets reduce performance. Prefabricated shells are formed in the factory, placed around the column and the gap filled with grout. About 250 caissons, 4 ft in diameter, of a San Francisco pier were strengthened with prefabricated jackets set with an approximately 2 inch gap, additional wet lay-up and non-shrink grout. The wrapped extent must cover the potential hinge zones; on a Pennsylvania I-84 overpass, 5 ft hinge zones were taken at the top and bottom of each column.

Jacket quality cannot be judged by appearance and must be confirmed by tests: in a pull-off test a circular dolly is bonded to the cured laminate, cored through to the concrete and pulled perpendicular, and the failure surface should lie in the concrete, showing the bond is stronger than the substrate; tapping or infrared thermography finds voids and delaminations between laminate and concrete; witness panels made under site conditions are tested for tensile strength and modulus. Results are compared with design values to decide acceptance, repair or rework.

FRP retrofit formulas are credible because research laboratories tested near full-scale columns with old-style detailing under constant axial load, before and after retrofit: unretrofitted columns often failed in shear or by splice slip at small drift, while retrofitted ones developed stable flexural hysteresis and several times the displacement ductility. Test series in the 1990s at laboratories such as the University of California, San Diego made composite jackets an alternative to steel jackets. The tests also exposed limits: jackets can hide damage, and improper end gaps change where the hinge forms.

Epoxy chalks under UV, so exterior jackets need a topcoat; long-term moisture, heat and alkalinity degrade the resin–fibre interface, glass fibre especially. Piers in rivers or beside roads also face debris, sediment abrasion and vehicle impact, and local damage breaks the continuity of hoop fibres. Carbon fibre in direct contact with steel can cause galvanic corrosion and needs an insulating layer. The jackets placed on the Pennsylvania I-84 overpass in 1995 showed no delamination about 17 years later, showing that correct material choice and protection can deliver long-term performance.

A jacket encloses the concrete and also hides earthquake damage: inspectors cannot see cracks and spalling directly and must read jacket bulging, wrinkles, broken fibres, resin whitening and debris at the base. Measuring the change in jacket circumference is simple and effective, because core dilation stretches the jacket in the hoop direction and the resulting hoop strain can be compared with the design effective strain. Handover must therefore record each column's circumference, thickness, thermography baseline and test results so post-earthquake comparison is possible; the judgement decides continued use, added plies or removal and rework.
evidence: 補強設計報告須列出每一座橋墩的缺陷類型、控制破壞模式、補強目標（剪力、圍束、搭接夾持）與未處理的其他弱點，並由審查工程師確認補強範圍與優先順序。
補強計算書要包含補強前後 M_p、M_o 的對照與能力保護檢核；施工規範明定端部間隙尺寸，施工期間不得以砂漿或樹脂填滿，並在竣工檢查中逐柱確認。
規格書要指定纖維系統的性質以「淨纖維面積」或「積層厚度」哪一種定義，並與設計計算一致；不得在施工中更換不同系統，除非重新計算並經設計者核准。
大長寬比矩形墩宜考慮以混凝土補成橢圓或圓形斷面後再包覆，或改用其他補強方式；計算書明列每一段的層數、包覆高度與採用的應變上限，並說明圍束比是否滿足最小值。
施工計畫列出可施作的環境條件與停止條件，每日由施工與監造共同簽認環境紀錄；基面處理完成列為停留點，經檢查圓角、修補與清潔後才可開始積層。
evidenceEn: The retrofit design report lists, for each pier, the deficiency type, governing failure mode, retrofit target (shear, confinement or splice clamping) and any other weaknesses left untreated, with the checking engineer confirming scope and priority.

Retrofit calculations compare M_p and M_o before and after and include capacity-protection checks; the specification fixes the end-gap size, which must not be filled with mortar or resin during construction and is confirmed column by column at final inspection.

The specification states whether system properties are defined on net-fibre area or laminate thickness, consistent with the design calculation; switching to a different system during construction is not allowed without recalculation and designer approval.

For elongated rectangular piers consider building the section out to an oval or circle with concrete before wrapping, or use another retrofit method; calculations list ply count, wrap height and strain limit for each zone and state whether the minimum confinement ratio is met.

The work plan lists allowable conditions and stop conditions, with the contractor and inspector co-signing daily environmental records; completed substrate preparation is a hold point, and lay-up begins only after corners, repairs and cleanliness are inspected.
pitfalls: 若只看到柱身裂縫就全面包覆而未判斷缺陷類型，可能把纖維用在不需要的位置，而真正的弱點（例如帽梁接頭或基礎）仍未處理；包覆後外觀完整，反而讓管理單位誤以為橋墩已符合耐震要求。
若直接以產品型錄的破斷應變設計而忽略有效應變與環境折減，計算的圍束壓力與剪力貢獻被高估，地震時套管在圓角或搭接端提早破斷，核心混凝土突然失去圍束。
在清晨潮濕或雨後表面未乾時施作，樹脂與混凝土之間形成水膜，外觀看似完整，實際黏結強度很低；未磨圓的角隅讓纖維在地震前就因應力集中斷絲，套管的圍束能力在最需要時不存在。
只做外觀檢查而未拉拔與敲擊，脫層與含浸不良被面塗掩蓋；地震時脫層區無法傳遞剪力與夾持搭接，而見證試片若在室內理想條件製作，也無法代表現場品質。
未做面塗的套管數年後樹脂粉化、纖維外露，濕氣沿裂紋侵入；套管底部若密封不當，雨水積在套管與混凝土之間無法排出，混凝土與鋼筋在套管內持續劣化卻無法被看見。
pitfallsEn: Wrapping every cracked column without identifying the deficiency type can put fibres where they are not needed while the real weakness, such as the cap-beam joint or footing, remains untreated; the intact appearance after wrapping can then mislead the owner into believing the pier now meets seismic requirements.

Designing directly with catalogue rupture strain while ignoring effective strain and environmental reduction overestimates confining pressure and shear contribution, so in an earthquake the jacket ruptures early at a corner or overlap end and the core suddenly loses confinement.

Applying on a damp early morning or before the surface dries after rain leaves a water film between resin and concrete that looks intact but has very low bond; unrounded corners let fibres break filament by filament at stress concentrations, so confinement is missing when it is needed most.

Visual inspection without pull-off and sounding lets delamination and poor saturation hide under the topcoat; in an earthquake debonded areas cannot transfer shear or clamp the splice, and witness panels made indoors under ideal conditions do not represent site quality.

Without a topcoat, the resin chalks and fibres become exposed within a few years, letting moisture in along cracks; a poorly sealed jacket base traps rainwater between jacket and concrete, so concrete and reinforcement keep deteriorating inside the jacket unseen.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：橋梁基礎沖刷監測
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Bridge-foundation scour monitoring
guides.concept: 從長期河床降低、束縮沖刷與橋墩局部沖刷三個分量出發，以 HEC-18 公式估算沖刷深度並評估擴展基礎與樁基的暴露後果，再處理拋石保護、聲納與磁性滑環等固定式監測儀的安裝、施工期河道束縮、即時警戒值、振動頻率識別、行動計畫與洪後檢查，並以 1987 年紐約 Schoharie 溪橋、2000 年高屏大橋與 2008 年后豐大橋的斷橋為鑑。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the three components of long-term degradation, contraction scour and local pier scour, estimate scour depth with the HEC-18 equation and assess the consequences of exposure for spread footings and piles, then cover riprap protection, installation of fixed monitors such as sonar and magnetic sliding collars, construction-stage channel contraction, real-time alarm levels, vibration-based detection, plans of action and post-flood inspection, learning from the bridge failures of Schoharie Creek in New York (1987), Kaoping (2000) and Houfeng (2008).
procedure: 洪水對橋梁的威脅多半不是水流把橋推倒，而是把基礎下方的土砂帶走：長期河床降低來自上游攔砂、河道整治或採砂造成的輸砂失衡；束縮沖刷發生在橋孔縮窄、流速升高的斷面；局部沖刷則是水流撞到墩柱時，向下的潛流與墩前馬蹄形渦流把墩旁床料掏空。三者疊加後，若沖刷面低於擴展基礎底或使樁失去足夠的側向支撐，橋墩就會沉陷、傾斜或倒塌。台灣河川坡陡、颱風洪峰短而急，三個分量都可能在一次洪水中同時發展。
局部沖刷深度主要取決於墩寬、上游水深與流速（以福祿數表示）、墩頭形狀、墩軸與水流的夾角以及床況。美國聯邦公路總署 HEC-18（第 5 版，2012 年）採用的 CSU 公式以這些參數的冪次關係表示沖刷深度與墩寬之比，屬於保守的包絡估計。其中最容易被低估的是夾角：長形墩斜交水流時，有效擋水寬度大增，沖刷深度可增加五成以上；颱風洪水夾帶的漂流木堆積在墩前，也等於加寬了墩體。
沖刷對不同基礎的後果不同：擴展基礎一旦底下的土被掏空，承載面積驟減，基礎會傾斜或突然下陷，幾乎沒有預警；沉箱與樁基則在沖刷後失去上段土壤的側向支撐，自由長度變長，水平勁度、彎矩容量與挫屈能力都下降，且承受的流水壓力與漂流物撞擊力增加。1987 年紐約州高速公路 Schoharie 溪橋就是三號墩擴展基礎被淘空掉入沖刷坑而崩塌，造成 10 人死亡；調查也指出拋石過輕且保護、檢查與維護不足。
沖刷保護分為水理與結構兩類：拋石、混凝土塊、蛇籠或袋裝混凝土在墩周形成抗沖護坦，下方需要濾層或土工織物防止細料被吸出；河床保護工（固床工、潛壩）則穩定整段河床、防止長期降低。拋石大小取決於局部流速的平方，墩前流速受加速影響必須放大；保護範圍要涵蓋墩寬的數倍，否則沖刷坑會從護坦邊緣向內侵蝕。固床工若在下游形成落差，又可能在其下方引發新的沖刷，后豐大橋的水躍即是例證。

固定式監測儀在洪水期間持續量測墩旁河床高程：聲納裝在墩身水面下向下發射聲波量測水深；磁性滑環套在打入河床的導管上，河床下降時滑環隨之下滑並觸發磁性開關；浮出式感測器預先埋在不同深度，被沖出時發出訊號；傾斜計與加速度計則量測墩體的反應。美國 NCHRP 第 396 號報告（1997 年）在多州實地測試這些儀器，磁性滑環以 0.3 m 磁鐵間距可達約 ±0.15 m 精度。選擇儀器要考慮河床材料、漂流物、流速、維護可及性與資料傳輸。
新建或改建橋梁時，圍堰、施工便橋、工作平台與堆置的土方都會佔用河道，使通水寬度縮窄、流速升高，在汛期造成比完工後更嚴重的束縮沖刷，危及既有橋墩與尚未完成的新基礎。施工計畫因此要以汛期洪水檢核臨時工程，必要時在汛期前撤除或降低圍堰。河道上的採砂也會使床面長期下降；高屏大橋所在河段在 1995 年就已撤除採砂船，顯示採砂對橋基的長期影響早受關注。
聲納以聲波往返時間換算到河床的距離，原理簡單，但洪水時的實際困難很多：水中夾帶大量氣泡或高濃度泥沙會吸收與散射聲波，造成訊號遺失；漂流物經過會產生假的淺值；長期浸水的換能器會被生物附著。NCHRP 第 396 號報告的實地測試就記錄到高含氣水流時訊號遺失、佛羅里達潮汐橋墩第二年出現藤壺附著影響讀值。因此即時資料必須經過濾波與合理性檢查，並以多儀器、多指標共同判斷，而不是單一讀值觸發封橋。
直接量測河床的儀器容易在洪水中失效，因此也可以量測橋墩本身的反應：基礎周圍土壤被沖走後，墩—基礎系統的側向勁度降低，自然頻率隨之下降；擴展基礎或淺基礎局部被淘空時，墩體會出現傾斜或沉陷。加速度計與傾斜計裝在水面以上，不受洪水直接破壞，維護也較容易。但頻率同時受溫度、水位附加質量與上部結構影響，必須先建立正常狀態的基準與變化範圍，才能從中辨識沖刷造成的偏移。

監測只是工具，真正保護用路人的是事先寫好的行動計畫：美國聯邦法規要求每座被列為沖刷危急的橋梁都必須有行動計畫，內容包括檢查與監測的方式和頻率、封橋與重新開放的條件、繞道路線、責任人與聯絡方式，以及設計和施作永久保護工的時程。HEC-23 第 3 版（2009 年）也強調，監測本身不能讓橋梁脫離沖刷危急的分類，只能爭取時間或在特定情況下作為對策。台灣的公路主管機關也採用分級預警封橋，例如 2026 年 6 月公告台 9 線萬里溪橋將隨上游堰塞湖警戒層級提升辦理預警性封閉。
洪峰時沖刷坑最深，退水期間上游來砂又會回填沖刷坑，因此洪後測深看到的河床可能比洪峰時高出許多，回填的鬆散砂土也沒有原土的承載與側向支撐能力。只依洪後測量判斷，會低估基礎曾經暴露的程度。洪後檢查要結合監測紀錄的最低河床、潛水或水下聲納掃描、基礎外觀與墩體傾斜量測，並把結果寫入每座橋的沖刷歷史，作為下一次行動計畫與保護工設計的依據。
procedureEn: A flood rarely threatens a bridge by pushing it over; it removes the soil beneath the foundations. Long-term degradation comes from sediment imbalance caused by upstream dams, channel works or mining; contraction scour occurs where the waterway narrows and velocity rises; local scour occurs as flow strikes a pier, where downflow and the horseshoe vortex at the nose excavate the bed beside it. When the three add up so that the scoured bed falls below a spread footing or piles lose enough lateral support, the pier settles, tilts or collapses. Taiwan's steep rivers and short, intense typhoon floods can develop all three components in a single event.

Local scour depth depends mainly on pier width, approach depth and velocity (expressed as Froude number), nose shape, the angle between pier and flow and bed condition. The CSU equation adopted in the U.S. Federal Highway Administration's HEC-18 (5th edition, 2012) expresses scour depth over pier width as a power function of these parameters and is a conservative envelope. The most easily underestimated factor is skew: an elongated pier at an angle to the flow presents a much wider obstruction, raising scour depth by 50% or more; debris rafts lodged against a pier in a typhoon flood also effectively widen it.

Scour affects foundation types differently. Once soil beneath a spread footing is removed, the bearing area shrinks abruptly and the footing tilts or drops suddenly with almost no warning; caissons and piles lose lateral support from the upper soil, so their free length increases and lateral stiffness, moment capacity and buckling resistance fall while flow pressure and debris impact grow. The 1987 Schoharie Creek Bridge collapse on the New York State Thruway began when pier 3, on an undermined spread footing, dropped into a scour hole, killing 10 people; investigators also found the riprap too light and protection, inspection and maintenance inadequate.

Countermeasures are hydraulic or structural: riprap, concrete blocks, gabions or grout bags form an erosion-resistant apron around the pier, with a filter layer or geotextile beneath to stop fines being drawn out; bed-protection works such as check dams stabilise a reach and stop long-term degradation. Riprap size depends on the square of local velocity, which must be amplified for acceleration around the pier; the apron must extend several pier widths, or the scour hole eats inward from its edge. A bed-protection structure that creates a drop can trigger new scour below it, as the hydraulic jump at the Houfeng Bridge showed.

Fixed instruments measure the bed elevation beside a pier continuously during a flood: a sonar mounted on the pier below water sends acoustic pulses down to measure depth; a magnetic sliding collar rides on a pipe driven into the bed and slides down as the bed drops, tripping magnetic switches; float-out sensors buried at several depths signal when they are washed out; tilt meters and accelerometers measure pier response. NCHRP Report 396 (1997) field-tested such instruments in several states, with the magnetic sliding collar reaching about ±0.15 m accuracy at 0.3 m magnet spacing. Selection must consider bed material, debris, velocity, maintenance access and data transmission.

During construction or replacement, cofferdams, temporary trestles, work platforms and stockpiles occupy the channel, narrowing the waterway and raising velocity, so in the flood season contraction scour can be worse than after completion, endangering existing piers and unfinished new foundations. The construction plan must therefore check temporary works against flood-season discharges, removing or lowering cofferdams before the season where needed. Mining in the channel also lowers the bed over time; on the reach of the Kaoping Bridge, sand-dredging boats had already been removed in 1995, showing how long mining's effect on foundations has been a concern.

Sonar converts the round-trip time of an acoustic pulse into distance to the bed. The principle is simple, but floods bring many practical problems: heavy air entrainment or high sediment concentration absorbs and scatters sound and causes signal loss, passing debris produces false shallow readings, and transducers submerged for long periods foul with marine growth. Field tests in NCHRP Report 396 recorded signal loss in highly air-entrained flow and barnacle growth affecting a Florida tidal pier unit in its second year. Real-time data must therefore be filtered and sanity-checked, and decisions made from several instruments and indicators rather than a single reading triggering closure.

Instruments that measure the bed directly tend to fail in floods, so engineers can measure the pier's own response instead: once soil around the foundation is removed, the lateral stiffness of the pier–foundation system falls and its natural frequency drops; when a spread or shallow footing is partly undermined, the pier tilts or settles. Accelerometers and tilt meters sit above water, out of direct reach of the flood, and are easier to maintain. Frequency, however, also varies with temperature, added water mass and the superstructure, so a baseline and normal range must be established before a scour-induced shift can be recognised.

Monitoring is only a tool; what protects road users is a plan of action written in advance. U.S. federal regulations require every bridge coded scour-critical to have one, covering inspection and monitoring type and frequency, closure and reopening criteria, detour routes, responsible staff and contacts, and the schedule for designing and building permanent countermeasures. HEC-23 (3rd edition, 2009) stresses that monitoring alone does not remove a bridge from the scour-critical category; it buys time or serves as a countermeasure in specific cases. Taiwan's highway authority also uses tiered pre-emptive closure, for example announcing in June 2026 that the Route 9 Wanli Creek Bridge would be closed as the alert level of an upstream barrier lake rises.

Scour holes are deepest at the flood peak, and on the falling limb incoming sediment refills them, so a post-flood sounding can show the bed much higher than at the peak, and the loose refill lacks the bearing and lateral support of the original soil. Judging only from post-flood surveys underestimates how far the foundation was exposed. Post-flood inspection must combine the minimum bed elevation from monitoring records, diver or underwater sonar scans, foundation condition and pier tilt measurements, and enter the results into each bridge's scour history as the basis for the next plan of action and countermeasure design.
evidence: 沖刷評估報告要把三個分量分別列出並附上依據，標示每座橋墩的基礎底高程、臨界沖刷高程與目前河床高程；上下游的河床落差、攔河構造物與採砂紀錄須一併納入。
河中墩優先採用圓形或圓頭斷面以降低對流向的敏感度，墩軸對齊洪水主流而非低水流向；設計報告列出不同夾角下的沖刷深度敏感度，並說明漂流木的處理假設。
沖刷危急橋梁的評估要同時算出擴展基礎的臨界沖刷高程與樁基在暴露狀態下的承載與穩定，並把結果寫成可供現場使用的「臨界河床高程」表；未知基礎的舊橋暫以保守假設列為高風險。
保護工設計要附上石塊尺寸、級配、厚度、濾層、平面範圍與預期壽命，並把洪後補充列入維護計畫；採用固床工時，同步評估下游落差可能引起的沖刷，並與水利主管機關協調。
監測位置以沖刷計算最深、基礎最淺的墩與墩頭為優先，至少兩種原理不同的儀器互相備援；纜線走在墩身凹槽或保護管內，設計時就預留維修通道與枯水期更換程序。
evidenceEn: The scour evaluation report lists the three components separately with their basis and marks, for each pier, foundation base elevation, critical scour elevation and current bed elevation; upstream and downstream bed drops, weirs and mining records are included.

Prefer circular or round-nosed piers in the river to reduce sensitivity to flow direction, align them with flood flow rather than low flow, and list scour sensitivity to skew angle and the debris assumptions in the design report.

Assessments of scour-critical bridges compute the critical scour elevation for spread footings and the capacity and stability of exposed piles, writing the results as a critical bed-elevation table usable in the field; old bridges with unknown foundations are treated conservatively as high risk.

Countermeasure design states stone size, gradation, thickness, filter, plan extent and expected life, with post-flood replenishment in the maintenance plan; when using bed-protection structures, assess scour from any downstream drop and coordinate with the water-resources authority.

Prioritise piers and pier noses with the deepest computed scour and shallowest foundations, using at least two instruments of different principle as backup; route cables in pier recesses or protective conduits, and provide maintenance access and a dry-season replacement procedure from design.
pitfalls: 2008 年 9 月 14 日辛樂克颱風期間，台中大甲溪上的后豐大橋斷落，調查認為河床落差與埋管造成約 4 至 5 m 的落差引發水躍，持續沖刷橋墩使基樁裸露；只計算局部沖刷而忽略河床落差與長期降低，會嚴重低估基礎暴露。
擴展基礎淘空時，橋墩可能在洪峰中毫無徵兆地沉陷，Schoharie 溪橋的上部結構隨墩下落，後續又因殘骸阻塞河道使相鄰墩流速升高；樁基裸露過長則在水流與漂流木撞擊下彎曲破壞或整體傾斜。
感測器只裝在一座墩或裝在墩的下游側，最深的沖刷坑發生在未監測的上游墩頭，警報沒有觸發；纜線沿墩身外露，第一場颱風就被漂流木扯斷，系統在最需要時沒有資料。
未過濾的聲納資料在洪峰時因氣泡頻繁跳到極淺或極深，值班人員對誤報麻木而忽略真警報；或系統在訊號遺失時沿用最後一筆正常值，洪峰期間顯示「穩定」，實際河床正在快速下降。
2000 年 8 月 27 日碧利斯颱風後，高屏大橋 P22、P23 橋墩被洪水沖毀，17 輛車墜落、22 人受傷；沒有可執行的封橋門檻與即時資訊時，車輛仍在洪峰期間通行，基礎破壞直接變成人員傷亡。
pitfallsEn: During Typhoon Sinlaku on 14 September 2008, the Houfeng Bridge over the Dajia River in Taichung collapsed; investigators considered that a bed drop of about 4 to 5 m associated with a buried water pipe created a hydraulic jump that kept scouring the pier and exposed the piles. Computing only local scour while ignoring bed drops and long-term degradation badly underestimates foundation exposure.

An undermined spread footing can drop without warning at the flood peak; at Schoharie Creek the superstructure fell with the pier, and wreckage partly blocking the river may have raised velocities at the adjacent pier. Overexposed piles bend to failure or tilt as a group under flow and debris impact.

Sensors on only one pier, or on the downstream face, miss the deepest scour at an unmonitored upstream nose, so no alarm is raised; cables run exposed down the pier are torn off by debris in the first typhoon, leaving no data when it matters most.

Unfiltered sonar data jumping to very shallow or very deep values in aerated flow make duty staff numb to false alarms so they ignore a real one; or a system that holds the last good value during signal loss shows stable readings through the peak while the bed is actually dropping fast.

After Typhoon Bilis, on 27 August 2000, floodwater washed out piers P22 and P23 of the Kaoping Bridge, dropping 17 vehicles and injuring 22 people; without enforceable closure thresholds and real-time information, traffic keeps crossing at the flood peak and foundation failure turns directly into casualties.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.conceptEn: Design wind speed, similitude and section and full-bridge model tests that confirm long-span bridges keep enough margin against vortex shedding, galloping and flutter. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.

factsEn: The Tacoma Narrows Bridge opened on 1 July 1940 and collapsed on 7 November 1940, with a main span of about 853 m (2,800 ft)
Tacoma Narrows was stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders on a deck about 39 ft wide and fell in a wind of about 40 mph
Farquharson studied the Tacoma Narrows motion with a 1:200 full model and a 1:20 section model
The replacement Tacoma Narrows Bridge opened on 14 October 1950 after 29 months of construction
The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge has a 1,991 m main span and 3,911 m total length, built from May 1988 to April 1998
The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge uses a 46 m/s basic wind speed, with design speeds of 60 m/s for the girder and 67 m/s for the towers
The Volgograd Bridge was closed for wind-induced oscillation on 20 May 2010 and reopened on 25 May
Twelve semi-active tuned mass dampers of 5,200 kg each were installed on the Volgograd Bridge in autumn 2011
Section models commonly use length scales of about 1/40 to 1/80, and full aeroelastic models are usually scaled by Froude similitude

2010–2011　伏爾加格勒大橋因強風振動封橋，其後加裝 12 組半主動調諧質量阻尼器
timelineEn: 1940 — The Tacoma Narrows Bridge opens in July and collapses in torsional motion in a wind of about 40 mph in November
1950 — The replacement Tacoma Narrows Bridge opens as wind-tunnel testing becomes standard for long spans
1971 — Scanlan and Tomko introduce flutter derivatives to describe self-excited forces on bridge decks
1998 — The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge, whose wind design was verified by full-model wind-tunnel tests, is completed
2010–2011 — The Volgograd Bridge closes after wind-induced oscillation, then receives 12 semi-active tuned mass dampers

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing
guides.concept: 從 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋的扭轉顫振崩塌出發，建立橋面設計風速、氣動現象分類、斷面外形與扭轉勁度、Scruton 數等結構參數，再處理施工懸臂階段的抗風、節段模型的彈簧懸吊試驗與縮尺換算、全橋氣動彈性模型、營運期渦振與阻尼器改善以及改裝前的風洞複核，並以明石海峽大橋的全橋模型風洞試驗與伏爾加格勒大橋 2010 年振動事件為例。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the torsional flutter collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940, establish deck design wind speed, the classes of aeroelastic phenomena, section shape and torsional stiffness and structural parameters such as the Scruton number, then cover wind resistance during cantilever erection, spring-mounted section-model tests and scaling, full aeroelastic models, in-service vortex vibration and damper retrofits and aerodynamic rechecks before modifications, using the full-model wind-tunnel tests of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge and the 2010 vibration event on the Volgograd Bridge.
procedure: 風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。海峽與河口地形開闊、粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加較慢但基本值高；山谷地形則可能產生局部加速與強烈紊流。除平均風速外，還要給出紊流強度與積分尺度，因為它們決定了陣風抖振的大小，也影響模型試驗中紊流場的重現。
風對長跨橋面造成四類動力問題：渦流脫落在特定風速鎖定結構頻率，引起有限振幅的渦振，常在低風速出現而影響舒適與疲勞；馳振是鈍形斷面在單一方向的自激振動，振幅隨風速無限增長；顫振是彎曲與扭轉耦合（或純扭轉）的自激振動，一旦超過臨界風速，氣動力持續輸入能量而發散；抖振則是紊流造成的隨機強迫振動，不會發散但控制強度與疲勞。風洞試驗要分別找出前三者的發生風速，並量測抖振的反應大小。
橋面斷面決定了氣流如何分離與再附著：寬而淺、兩端尖削的流線箱梁能讓氣流平順通過，顫振臨界風速高；開口板梁或鈍形斷面則在前緣強烈分離，容易產生渦流與扭轉自激。塔科馬海峽橋寬約 39 呎、梁深 8 呎，寬深比低又是開口斷面，扭轉勁度極小。改善方法包括閉合箱梁、加導流板（整流罩）、中央開槽或格柵，以及加深的桁架加勁梁；閉合斷面的扭轉勁度遠高於開口斷面，使扭轉頻率與彎曲頻率分開，提升顫振風速。
同一個斷面外形，振動大小還取決於結構本身的質量與阻尼：每延公尺質量越大、阻尼越高，風輸入的能量越難把結構推動。Scruton 數把質量、對數衰減率與空氣密度、斷面深度合成一個無因次參數，渦振振幅大致隨 Scruton 數增加而減小。鋼橋的結構阻尼通常很低，混凝土橋較高；施工中或完工後的實際阻尼常與設計假設不同，因此試驗時要以合理偏低的阻尼檢核，並在完工後實測。
橋梁在施工中往往比完工後更怕風：斜張橋單側或雙側懸臂伸出時，沒有另一端的支撐，彎曲與扭轉頻率都比完工狀態低；懸索橋在加勁梁分段吊裝、接頭尚未全部鎖固時，扭轉勁度特別小。施工階段的風速檢核可以採用較短的回歸期，但因為頻率降低、阻尼不確定，渦振與顫振的臨界風速可能落入常見範圍。因此風洞試驗必須涵蓋關鍵施工階段，而不只是完工狀態。
施工期的抗風措施分為結構與作業兩類：結構措施包括臨時穩定索把懸臂端拉到地面或墩上、臨時支墩縮短懸臂長度、在懸臂端加裝臨時調諧質量阻尼器，以及調整吊裝順序讓扭轉勁度較早形成；作業措施則是以現地風速計即時監控，超過門檻時停止吊裝、鎖固吊具與梁段。懸臂越長，橫向風力在塔或墩底產生的彎矩越大，臨時措施也要能承受颱風等級的風力。

節段模型是把橋面一段做成剛性縮尺模型（常見 1/40 至 1/80），以彈簧懸吊在風洞中，使其具有與原型對應的豎向與扭轉頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼。相似的關鍵是折減風速 U/(f·B) 相同，因此可以自由選擇模型頻率，再由頻率比與長度縮尺換算風速縮尺。試驗可直接觀察渦振與顫振，也可量測靜力係數與顫振導數，供全橋顫振與抖振分析使用；塔科馬海峽橋崩塌前，Farquharson 已在華盛頓大學以 1/20 節段模型與 1/200 全橋模型進行研究。

節段模型假設氣流沿橋軸二維、振型均勻，無法反映懸索與斜張橋的三維振型、主纜與吊索的重力勁度、斜風與塔的互制以及紊流的空間相關性。全橋氣動彈性模型以 Froude 相似律縮放（使重力勁度正確），在大型邊界層風洞中重現紊流風場，直接觀察整座橋在不同風向下的反應。明石海峽大橋（主跨 1,991 m，1988 至 1998 年建造）即以全橋模型風洞試驗驗證其抗風性能，加勁梁設計風速為 60 m/s、橋塔為 67 m/s。

風洞試驗不能保證完工後絕不振動：實際阻尼、附屬物、臨時設施或風場都可能與試驗不同。2010 年 5 月俄羅斯伏爾加格勒大橋在強風中出現明顯振動，當局在 5 月 20 日封閉全部車流、5 月 25 日重新開放，之後由 MAURER 與瑞士 Empa 等合作開發半主動調諧質量阻尼器，於 2011 年秋季安裝 12 組、每組質量 5,200 kg。營運期的改善手段包括加裝阻尼器、導流板或整流罩，以及移除改變氣流的附屬物，但每一項都要先以監測資料確認振動型態。
橋梁在數十年營運中會加裝防風牆、隔音牆、管線、照明、檢修車軌道或更換欄杆，這些都改變斷面外形與阻力，可能讓渦振重新出現或降低顫振風速。交接文件因此要保存風洞試驗的斷面幾何、試驗條件、靜力係數、顫振導數與允收結果，並規定任何外形變更都需氣動複核。營運面則要訂定依風速分級的交通管制，例如強風時限制高車身車輛或封橋，並把風速監測與管制程序連結。
procedureEn: The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness. Open straits and estuaries have low roughness, so speed grows slowly with height but the base value is high; valleys can produce local speed-up and strong turbulence. Besides mean speed, turbulence intensity and integral length scales must be specified, because they control buffeting response and must be reproduced in model tests.

Wind causes four classes of dynamic problems on long-span decks: vortex shedding locks onto a structural frequency at particular speeds and causes limited-amplitude vortex-induced vibration, often at low speed and affecting comfort and fatigue; galloping is a single-direction self-excited motion of bluff sections whose amplitude grows without limit with speed; flutter is self-excited coupled bending–torsion or pure torsion that diverges beyond a critical speed as the airflow keeps feeding energy; buffeting is random forced vibration from turbulence that does not diverge but governs strength and fatigue. Wind-tunnel tests must find the onset speeds of the first three and measure buffeting response.

The deck section governs how flow separates and reattaches: a wide, shallow streamlined box with tapered edges lets air pass smoothly and has a high flutter speed, while an open plate-girder or bluff section separates strongly at the leading edge and readily sheds vortices and self-excites in torsion. The Tacoma Narrows deck was about 39 ft wide and 8 ft deep, a low width-to-depth ratio on an open section with tiny torsional stiffness. Remedies include closed boxes, fairings, central slots or gratings and deeper truss stiffening girders; a closed section is far stiffer in torsion than an open one, separating torsional from bending frequency and raising flutter speed.

For a given section shape, response size also depends on the structure's mass and damping: the greater the mass per metre and the higher the damping, the harder it is for wind energy to drive the structure. The Scruton number combines mass, logarithmic decrement, air density and section depth into one dimensionless parameter, and vortex amplitude falls roughly as it rises. Steel bridges usually have very low structural damping and concrete bridges more; actual damping during and after construction often differs from design assumptions, so tests use a reasonably low damping value and damping is measured after completion.

Bridges are often more vulnerable to wind during construction than when complete: a cable-stayed cantilever reaching out on one or both sides has no support at its far end, so bending and torsional frequencies are lower than in the finished state; a suspension bridge whose deck segments are being lifted with joints not yet locked has particularly low torsional stiffness. Construction-stage wind checks may use a shorter return period, but with reduced frequencies and uncertain damping the vortex and flutter onset speeds can fall into the common range. Wind-tunnel tests must therefore cover the critical construction stages, not only the completed state.

Erection-stage wind measures are structural and operational. Structural measures include temporary stays tying the cantilever tip down to the ground or a pier, temporary supports that shorten the cantilever, temporary tuned mass dampers at the tip and erection sequences that build torsional stiffness earlier; operational measures use site anemometers for real-time monitoring, stopping lifts and securing lifting gear and segments above set thresholds. The longer the cantilever, the larger the moment that lateral wind creates at the pylon or pier base, and temporary measures must also resist typhoon-level wind.

A section model reproduces a length of deck as a rigid scaled model, commonly 1/40 to 1/80, mounted on springs in the tunnel so its vertical and torsional frequencies, mass, inertia and damping correspond to the prototype. The key similarity is equal reduced velocity U/(f·B), so the model frequency can be chosen freely and the velocity scale follows from the frequency ratio and length scale. Tests observe vortex shedding and flutter directly and measure static coefficients and flutter derivatives for full-bridge flutter and buffeting analysis; before the Tacoma Narrows collapse, Farquharson at the University of Washington was already studying a 1:20 section model and a 1:200 full model.

Section models assume two-dimensional flow along the deck and a uniform mode shape, so they cannot capture the three-dimensional modes of suspension and cable-stayed bridges, the gravity stiffness of cables and hangers, skewed wind and tower interaction or the spatial correlation of turbulence. A full aeroelastic model is scaled by Froude similitude so that gravity stiffness is correct and tested in a large boundary-layer tunnel that reproduces turbulent wind, directly observing the whole bridge's response at different wind directions. The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge (main span 1,991 m, built 1988 to 1998) was verified by full-model wind-tunnel testing, with design wind speeds of 60 m/s for the stiffening girder and 67 m/s for the towers.

Wind-tunnel testing cannot guarantee a finished bridge will never vibrate: actual damping, attachments, temporary fittings or the wind field may differ from the test. In May 2010 the Volgograd Bridge in Russia vibrated noticeably in strong wind; authorities closed it to all motor traffic on 20 May and reopened it on 25 May, and semi-active tuned mass dampers were then developed by MAURER with partners including the Swiss laboratory Empa, with 12 units of 5,200 kg each installed in autumn 2011. In-service remedies include added dampers, guide vanes or fairings and removal of attachments that alter the flow, but each must start from monitoring data that confirm the vibration pattern.

Over decades of service a bridge acquires wind screens, noise barriers, utilities, lighting, gantry rails or new railings, all of which change section shape and drag and can revive vortex shedding or lower flutter speed. Handover documents must therefore keep the tested section geometry, test conditions, static coefficients, flutter derivatives and acceptance results, and require aerodynamic review of any change in shape. Operationally, wind-speed-graded traffic control, such as restricting high-sided vehicles or closing the bridge in strong wind, must be defined and linked to wind monitoring.
evidence: 風工程報告的第一章要列出基本風速、回歸期、地況分類、橋面與塔頂設計風速、紊流強度與積分尺度，並說明資料來源；後續所有試驗與分析都引用同一組參數，變更時須全面更新。
設計審查要求風工程報告分別列出渦振、馳振、顫振的檢核結果與抖振反應，並說明每一項採用的允收準則；任何一項無法以計算確認時，必須以風洞試驗驗證。
風洞模型必須包含欄杆、防風牆、排水溝、檢修車軌道等外露附屬物的正確幾何；設計凍結後，任何改變外形的變更都要經風工程師書面評估，必要時重新試驗。
風洞報告要明示試驗採用的阻尼值及其依據，並提供不同阻尼下的振幅敏感度；合約中預留完工後實測阻尼與必要時加裝阻尼器的條款與空間。
施工計畫要列出每個關鍵階段的容許風速、臨時穩定措施與颱風來臨前的固定程序，並經風工程師與設計者確認；最大懸臂階段盡量避開颱風季。
evidenceEn: The first chapter of the wind-engineering report lists basic speed, return period, terrain category, deck and tower-top design speeds, turbulence intensity and integral scales with their sources; every later test and analysis cites the same set, and any change triggers a full update.

Design review requires the wind report to list results for vortex shedding, galloping and flutter and the buffeting response separately, with the acceptance criterion for each; any item that cannot be confirmed by calculation must be verified by wind-tunnel test.

Wind-tunnel models must include the correct geometry of railings, wind screens, gutters and gantry rails; after design freeze, any change to the external shape requires the wind engineer's written assessment and, if needed, retesting.

The wind report states the damping used and its basis and gives amplitude sensitivity to damping; the contract reserves post-completion damping measurement and the space and provisions to add dampers if needed.

The construction plan lists allowable wind speeds, temporary stabilising measures and pre-typhoon securing procedures for each critical stage, confirmed by the wind engineer and designer; schedule the longest cantilever outside the typhoon season where possible.
pitfalls: 以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。
設計後期為了景觀或施工方便把箱梁兩端改鈍、或在邊緣加裝實心欄杆，未重新試驗，結果渦振振幅與顫振風速都與原試驗不同；細小的附屬物也可能決定氣流分離位置。
只做完工狀態的風洞試驗，施工時最長懸臂在中等強風下出現大幅扭轉振動，迫使停工並緊急加設臨時穩定索；若振動造成吊裝設備或臨時接頭損壞，後果可能比完工後更嚴重。
模型的質量慣性矩或扭轉頻率比未正確縮尺，試驗得到的顫振風速與原型不符；只做 0° 攻角而忽略地形造成的上升或下沉氣流，可能錯過最不利的顫振風速。
未先辨識振動模態就安裝阻尼器，阻尼器調到錯誤頻率而幾乎無效；或為了趕快恢復通車只加裝導流板而未經試驗，結果改變了扭轉氣動特性，反而降低顫振餘裕。
pitfallsEn: Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target; wrong turbulence parameters distort buffeting response and fatigue assessment.

Late changes that blunt the box edges for appearance or buildability, or add solid parapets at the edges, without retesting change both vortex amplitudes and flutter speed from the original test; small attachments can decide where flow separates.

Testing only the completed state lets the longest cantilever twist heavily in a moderate gale during construction, forcing a stop and emergency temporary stays; if the motion damages lifting equipment or temporary joints, the consequences can exceed anything in service.

Mis-scaled mass moment of inertia or torsion-to-bending frequency ratio makes the measured flutter speed unrepresentative; testing only at 0° attack while ignoring terrain-induced updraft or downdraft can miss the worst flutter speed.

Installing dampers before identifying the mode tunes them to the wrong frequency and makes them nearly useless; adding untested guide vanes to reopen quickly can change torsional aerodynamics and reduce the flutter margin.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 以超高性能混凝土的短搭接、介面處理與品質驗收，讓預鑄橋面板接縫窄、快且不漏水。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Short lap splices, interface preparation and acceptance testing that make UHPC joints between precast deck elements narrow, fast and watertight. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: FHWA 定義 UHPC 抗壓強度大於 21.7 ksi（150 MPa）、持續開裂後拉力強度大於 0.72 ksi（5 MPa）、水膠比低於 0.25
現澆 UHPC 常用 2% 體積比鋼纖維，直徑 0.2 mm、長 13 mm、抗拉強度至少 2,000 MPa
FHWA 數據：現澆 UHPC 28 天抗壓平均約 165 MPa，直接拉伸開裂約 8.5 MPa，彈性模數約 48 GPa
FHWA 建議直線搭接 ℓ_s ≥ 0.75ℓ_d，ℓ_d 在 8 號以下、f_y ≤ 75 ksi、保護層 ≥ 3d_b 時取 8d_b

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：橋面超高性能混凝土接縫
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: UHPC bridge-deck closure joints
guides.concept: 從快速橋梁施工中預鑄橋面板接縫的荷載路徑出發，說明超高性能混凝土為何能以約 150 mm 寬的接縫完成鋼筋非接觸搭接，量化介面應力、收縮約束、搭接長度與鋼纖維用量，再處理介面粗糙化、模板密封與溢流、流度與強度驗收、接縫性能監測、氯離子耐久與交接維修，並以紐約州 2009 年首批現澆 UHPC 接縫與 2013 年 I-81 雪城四座橋的 10 天封路更換為例。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the load path through joints between precast deck elements in accelerated bridge construction, explain why ultra-high-performance concrete completes non-contact lap splices in joints about 150 mm wide, quantify interface stress, restrained shrinkage, lap length and steel-fibre content, then cover interface roughening, form sealing and overfill, flow and strength acceptance, joint performance monitoring, chloride durability and handover and repair, using New York's first field-cast UHPC connections in 2009 and the 2013 replacement of four I-81 bridges in Syracuse under 10-day closures.
procedure: 快速橋梁施工把橋面拆成預鑄全深度橋面板或帶翼板的預鑄梁，在工廠製作、現場吊裝，再以現澆接縫把它們連成連續的橋面。接縫必須把車輪荷重造成的彎矩與剪力從一塊板傳到下一塊，並長期不透水；傳統做法需要寬接縫讓鋼筋長距離搭接，或以後拉預力壓緊接縫。超高性能混凝土的強度與握裹力極高，使接縫可窄到約 150 mm，鋼筋只需短距離非接觸搭接。但接縫最弱的地方往往不是 UHPC 本身，而是它與預鑄混凝土之間的介面。
UHPC 水膠比低於 0.25、膠結材含量高，自體收縮比一般混凝土大，長期收縮可達數百微應變；而相鄰的預鑄板早已完成大部分收縮，於是新澆的 UHPC 被兩側舊混凝土約束，在介面產生拉應力。水化熱也使窄接縫在初期溫度較高，冷卻時再增加收縮。若介面黏結不足，這些約束應力會讓介面在通車前就脫開，形成貫穿板厚的細縫，成為日後滲水路徑。

接縫中的鋼筋不需要互相接觸，而是由兩側伸出的鋼筋交錯排列，拉力經由周圍 UHPC 的握裹與纖維橋接傳到另一側鋼筋。FHWA 2014 年的技術說明建議：在 2% 鋼纖維、抗壓強度至少 14 ksi、保護層至少 3 倍筋徑、鋼筋不大於 8 號且降伏強度不超過 75 ksi 時，伸展長度 ℓ_d 取 8 倍筋徑，搭接長度 ℓ_s 至少 0.75ℓ_d；鋼筋強度在 75 至 100 ksi 時取 10 倍，保護層只有 2 至 3 倍筋徑時再加 2 倍筋徑，且相鄰搭接筋的淨距不得超過 ℓ_s。接縫寬度則要在搭接長度外保留製造與安裝允差。

UHPC 以級配最佳化的細顆粒（水泥、矽灰、細砂與填料）、低於 0.25 的水膠比、高效減水劑與大量短鋼纖維組成，不含粗骨材。緻密的基材使抗壓強度超過 150 MPa、氯離子滲透極低；鋼纖維在開裂後跨越裂縫持續傳遞拉力，使材料具有超過 5 MPa 的持續開裂後拉力強度，這也是短搭接成立的關鍵。FHWA 的現澆 UHPC 試驗數據顯示 28 天抗壓強度平均約 165 MPa、直接拉伸開裂強度約 8.5 MPa、彈性模數約 48 GPa。
UHPC 與預鑄混凝土之間的黏結決定接縫能否不開裂、不滲水。FHWA 的研究顯示，外露骨材面黏結最好，噴砂面次之，原模板面最差；建議預鑄介面粗糙化到約 6.4 mm 的凹凸幅度，最常用的方法是在預鑄時於模板塗緩凝劑、脫模後沖洗露出骨材。澆置前預鑄面要預濕到飽和面乾（SSD），避免乾燥的舊混凝土吸走 UHPC 介面的水分，但表面不得有積水。
UHPC 流動性極高、顆粒極細，任何一般混凝土可接受的模板縫隙都可能漏漿，造成接縫內部空洞與表面下陷；它也會在模板上產生接近液體的側壓。FHWA 建議模板要比一般混凝土更密實、讓空氣有排出路徑，並在高處設置「煙囪」提供額外液壓頭，補償澆置後的沉降；有些承包商以注水測試模板是否漏水。可見的水平表面常刻意溢流，硬化後研磨到與兩側齊平，但研磨太早會撕裂 UHPC、太晚則磨耗設備。

UHPC 的現場驗收比一般混凝土更依賴試驗：每一盤都要以流度試驗確認工作性，因為流度太低會包住空氣、太高可能代表加水或纖維沉降；抗壓試體則決定何時可拆模、何時可承載。FHWA 建議的驗收項目包括流度約 178 至 254 mm、4 天抗壓大於 14 ksi、28 天大於 21 ksi、氯離子滲透 28 天不超過 250 庫侖、凍融 300 次後相對動彈性模數至少 95%、28 天收縮不超過 800 微應變，抗壓試體至少每 19 m³ 或每 12 小時班次取一次。
UHPC 接縫的設計規則來自實驗室中對接縫試體的靜載與反覆載重試驗，但每座橋仍需在現場確認接縫的實際表現：通車前做噴水或灑水檢查介面是否滲漏；通車後以跨縫應變計、裂縫寬度量測與定期目視比較接縫與兩側板的行為。紐約州 2013 年在雪城 I-81 以全深度預鑄橋面板加 6 吋 UHPC 接縫更換四座州際公路橋，不使用後拉預力，南北向各以 10 天封路完成，為此類監測提供了典型對象。
橋面接縫是除冰鹽與雨水最容易進入結構的位置：一般現澆接縫因收縮與荷載開裂，氯離子沿裂縫與孔隙到達鋼筋，引起腐蝕與剝落。UHPC 的孔隙不連通，FHWA 數據顯示 28 天氯離子滲透僅約 360 庫侖、凍融 600 次後相對動彈性模數仍約 99%，本體幾乎不讓氯離子進入；因此長期耐久的瓶頸轉到介面與兩側預鑄板。耐久設計要同時處理介面開裂、鋪面層與防水層，以及接縫下方排水。
UHPC 接縫的維修與日後改建需要事先規劃：它比一般混凝土硬得多，局部打除、水刀或鋸切都較困難，橋面拓寬或更換板時要預先決定切割位置；鋪面研磨與更換也要避免傷及接縫。滲水量對裂縫寬度極為敏感，因此維修門檻應以裂縫寬度表示，小裂縫及早封護遠比等到鏽水出現再處理便宜。交接文件要讓後續管理者知道每道接縫的位置、材料、試驗與監測基準。
procedureEn: Accelerated bridge construction splits the deck into full-depth precast panels or precast girders with integral flanges, made in a plant and lifted into place, then joined into a continuous deck with field-cast joints. The joints must pass wheel-load moments and shears from one element to the next and stay watertight for decades; conventional practice needs wide joints for long bar laps or post-tensioning to clamp the joint. UHPC's very high strength and bond allow joints only about 150 mm wide with short non-contact lap splices. Yet the weakest part of the joint is often not the UHPC itself but its interface with the precast concrete.

UHPC has a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25 and a high binder content, so its autogenous shrinkage exceeds that of ordinary concrete and long-term shrinkage reaches several hundred microstrain; the adjacent precast panels have already completed most of their shrinkage, so the new UHPC is restrained by older concrete on both sides and tension develops at the interface. Heat of hydration also warms the narrow joint early, adding shrinkage as it cools. If bond is inadequate, these restraint stresses open the interface before traffic is even applied, forming a fine through-thickness crack that becomes a future leakage path.

Bars in the joint need not touch; bars projecting from each side interleave, and tension passes through bond in the surrounding UHPC and fibre bridging to the bars opposite. FHWA's 2014 TechNote recommends that, with 2% steel fibre, compressive strength of at least 14 ksi, cover of at least three bar diameters, bars no larger than No. 8 and yield strength up to 75 ksi, the development length ℓ_d be 8 bar diameters and the lap ℓ_s at least 0.75ℓ_d; bars of 75 to 100 ksi take 10 diameters, cover of only 2 to 3 diameters adds 2 diameters, and clear spacing to the nearest spliced bar may not exceed ℓ_s. Joint width must then add fabrication and erection tolerance to the lap length.

UHPC combines optimally graded fine particles (cement, silica fume, fine sand and fillers), a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25, high-range water reducer and a large dose of short steel fibres, with no coarse aggregate. The dense matrix gives compressive strength above 150 MPa and very low chloride penetrability; the fibres keep carrying tension across cracks after cracking, giving a sustained post-cracking tensile strength above 5 MPa, which is what makes short laps work. FHWA data for field-cast UHPC show an average 28-day compressive strength of about 165 MPa, direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa and an elastic modulus of about 48 GPa.

Bond between UHPC and precast concrete decides whether the joint stays uncracked and watertight. FHWA research shows exposed-aggregate surfaces bond best, sandblasted surfaces next and as-cast form faces worst, and recommends roughening precast interfaces to an amplitude of about 6.4 mm, most often by applying retarder to the form at casting and washing the surface after stripping to expose aggregate. Before placement the precast face is prewetted to saturated surface-dry (SSD) so dry old concrete does not draw water from the UHPC at the interface, but no standing water may remain.

UHPC is highly fluid with very fine particles, so form gaps acceptable for ordinary concrete can leak paste, leaving voids inside the joint and a sunken surface; it also exerts near-hydrostatic pressure on the forms. FHWA advises forms tighter than for ordinary concrete, an exit path for air and a raised chimney that provides extra head to offset subsidence after placement; some contractors water-test the forms for leaks. Visible horizontal surfaces are often overfilled and ground flush with the adjacent deck after hardening, but grinding too early tears the UHPC and too late wears out the equipment.

Site acceptance of UHPC relies on testing even more than for ordinary concrete: every batch is flow-tested for workability, because low flow traps air and high flow may mean added water or fibre settlement, while compressive specimens decide when forms come off and when load may be applied. FHWA-recommended acceptance covers flow of about 178 to 254 mm, compressive strength above 14 ksi at 4 days and above 21 ksi at 28 days, chloride penetrability of at most 250 coulombs at 28 days, relative dynamic modulus of at least 95% after 300 freeze–thaw cycles and 28-day shrinkage of at most 800 microstrain, with compressive specimens taken at least once per 19 m³ or per 12-hour shift.

Design rules for UHPC joints come from static and cyclic laboratory tests on joint specimens, yet each bridge still needs field confirmation of joint behaviour: before opening, spray or flood the joints to check for interface leaks; after opening, compare joint and panel behaviour with cross-joint strain gauges, crack-width measurements and periodic visual inspection. In 2013 New York replaced four interstate bridges on I-81 in Syracuse with full-depth precast panels and 6 inch UHPC joints, without post-tensioning, completing each direction under a 10-day closure, a typical subject for such monitoring.

Deck joints are where de-icing salt and rain most easily enter a structure: ordinary field-cast joints crack from shrinkage and load, and chlorides travel through cracks and pores to the bars, causing corrosion and spalling. UHPC's pore structure is discontinuous; FHWA data show only about 360 coulombs of chloride penetrability at 28 days and a relative dynamic modulus of about 99% after 600 freeze–thaw cycles, so the material itself admits almost no chloride, and the long-term bottleneck shifts to the interface and the adjacent precast panels. Durability design must address interface cracking, the wearing surface and waterproofing, and drainage below the joint.

Repair and later modification of UHPC joints need planning: UHPC is much harder than ordinary concrete, so local breakout, hydrodemolition or saw-cutting is more difficult, and cut lines for future widening or panel replacement should be decided in advance; overlay milling and replacement must also avoid damaging the joints. Leakage is extremely sensitive to crack width, so repair thresholds should be expressed in crack width, and early sealing of small cracks is far cheaper than waiting for rust stains. Handover documents must tell future managers where every joint is and its materials, tests and monitoring baselines.
evidence: 接縫設計要分別列出 UHPC 本體、介面與相鄰預鑄板的應力檢核，並說明介面開裂後的傳力假設；接縫位置與方向在預鑄板分割時就與設計者協調，不得由施工方任意調整。
規格書要列出 UHPC 收縮上限、澆置時的氣溫與預鑄板表面溫度範圍、初期養護方式（封閉保濕至初凝），並禁止以熱風直吹新澆表面；接縫監測計畫在設計時就納入。
伸出筋的位置允差、接縫寬度與最小搭接長度要寫在預鑄板製造圖上，鋼筋切割或彎折一律須經設計者書面同意；紐約州 CR47 案例即把接縫做成 8 吋寬，比 6 吋搭接多留 2 吋現場允差。
採用的 UHPC 產品要有完整的材料試驗與工程使用紀錄，替代產品須重新提出全部試驗資料並經設計者核可；拌合機型式、拌合時間與纖維投入順序依供應商程序並寫入施工計畫。
把介面處理寫進預鑄板製造規範並列為出廠檢查項目，現場再設「介面清潔與 SSD 確認」停留點；不合格的介面以噴砂或水刀補做粗糙化後重新檢查。
evidenceEn: Joint design lists stress checks for the UHPC, the interface and the adjacent precast panel separately and states the load-transfer assumption after interface cracking; joint location and direction are coordinated with the designer when panels are divided and may not be changed by the contractor.

The specification lists the UHPC shrinkage limit, air and panel-surface temperature ranges for casting and early curing (sealed and moist until initial set), and forbids forced hot air on fresh surfaces; joint monitoring is planned at design.

Projecting-bar tolerances, joint width and minimum lap length go on the panel shop drawings, and any cutting or bending of bars needs the designer's written approval; New York's CR47 project made its joint 8 inches wide, leaving 2 inches of field tolerance beyond a 6 inch lap.

The chosen UHPC product must have full material test data and a field record; any substitute needs a complete new test submittal and designer approval, and mixer type, mixing time and fibre addition sequence follow the supplier's procedure in the method statement.

Write interface treatment into the precast fabrication specification as a factory inspection item, and add a site hold point for interface cleaning and SSD confirmation; nonconforming interfaces are roughened by abrasive blasting or water jetting and reinspected.
pitfalls: 傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。
預鑄板伸出筋位置偏差，吊裝時兩側鋼筋互相頂住，現場把鋼筋彎折或切短以便就位，實際搭接長度低於要求；或接縫寬度剛好等於搭接長度，任何吊裝偏差都讓搭接不足。
預鑄廠漏做緩凝劑處理，介面只是光滑的模板面，或澆置前介面乾燥吸水，UHPC 與舊混凝土之間黏結薄弱；通車後介面在收縮與車輛荷重下脫開，形成沿接縫兩側的兩條滲水裂縫。
以一般混凝土實驗室的試驗機與未研磨端面測試 UHPC，量到的強度偏低或試驗機容量不足；或只取 28 天試體，沒有早期強度資料，結果為趕工在未達要求強度時就拆模開放，接縫在早期就受損。
管理單位以為 UHPC 接縫永不需要維護而省略鋪面防水，介面細縫多年持續滲入鹽水，兩側預鑄板邊緣鋼筋腐蝕膨脹、混凝土剝落，最終必須局部打除重做接縫與板邊。
pitfallsEn: Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate.

Projecting bars out of position clash during erection, and site crews bend or cut them to make the panels fit, leaving laps below the requirement; or a joint exactly as wide as the lap length means any erection deviation produces an inadequate lap.

If the plant skips the retarder treatment, leaving a smooth form face, or the interface is dry and absorbent at casting, bond between UHPC and old concrete is weak; after opening the interface separates under shrinkage and traffic, forming two leakage cracks along both sides of the joint.

Testing UHPC on an ordinary concrete lab machine with unground ends gives low strengths or exceeds machine capacity; taking only 28-day specimens leaves no early-strength data, so forms are stripped and traffic admitted to meet the schedule before the required strength, damaging the joint early.

An owner that assumes UHPC joints never need maintenance and omits overlay waterproofing lets brine seep through interface cracks for years; bars at the panel edges corrode and expand, the concrete spalls and the joint and panel edges must eventually be broken out and recast.

factsEn: The Ynys-y-Gwas bridge, a single-span precast segmental post-tensioned bridge built in 1953, collapsed suddenly in 1985 from tendon corrosion at its joints
Britain's Highways Agency halted new internally grouted post-tensioned bridges in 1992 for a five-year inspection programme and lifted the halt in 1996

PTI, ACI and AASHTO cap acid-soluble chloride in grout at 0.08% by cement weight, while the European standard uses 0.10%

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：預力混凝土孔道灌漿
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Prestressing-duct grouting
guides.concept: 從 1985 年威爾斯 Ynys-y-Gwas 橋的突然崩塌與英國 1992 年暫停新建灌漿後拉橋的決定出發，說明灌漿如何同時提供防蝕與握裹，量化鋼腱斷絲的預力損失、高點泌水、氯離子含量與孔道面積比，再處理灌漿壓力與流速、錨頭封護與真空補灌、流度泌水與密度試驗、空洞非破壞檢測、硫酸鹽與氯離子劣化以及灌漿紀錄與風險分級，並以 2000 年夏洛特賽車場人行橋與倫敦漢默史密斯高架橋為鑑。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the sudden 1985 collapse of the Ynys-y-Gwas bridge in Wales and Britain's 1992 halt on new grouted post-tensioned bridges, explain how grout provides both corrosion protection and bond, quantify force loss from broken strands, bleed at high points, chloride content and duct area ratio, then cover grouting pressure and rate, anchorage protection and vacuum regrouting, fluidity, bleed and density testing, non-destructive void detection, sulfate and chloride deterioration and grouting records and risk ranking, learning from the 2000 Charlotte Motor Speedway footbridge and London's Hammersmith Flyover.
procedure: 後拉預力鋼腱在張拉錨定後，孔道內必須以水泥系灌漿完全填滿：灌漿的高鹼性使鋼絞線表面鈍化而不鏽蝕，硬化後又把鋼腱與周圍混凝土握裹在一起，使預力不再只依賴兩端錨頭，局部斷絲時力量也能在短距離內重新傳回混凝土。一旦孔道留下空洞、泌水或灌漿受氯離子汙染，鋼絞線在看不見的地方腐蝕，強度高、斷面小的鋼絲對蝕坑特別敏感，可能在沒有明顯預兆下斷裂。威爾斯 1953 年建成的 Ynys-y-Gwas 單跨預鑄節塊後拉橋，就因節塊間現澆接縫處保護不足的鋼腱腐蝕，在 1985 年突然崩塌。
連續梁的鋼腱線形在墩頂向上彎、在跨中向下彎，灌漿沿孔道流動時，空氣與泌水會往高點聚集；鋼絞線束在孔道內形成細小通道，會像燈芯一樣把水往上吸，使高點與錨頭附近更容易留下水層與空洞。水分之後被吸收或蒸發，留下的就是空洞，而鋼絞線正好暴露在潮濕空氣中。FHWA 的研究指出，美國在 1999 年起陸續發現的鋼腱耐久問題，多與灌漿空洞、泌水以及錨頭與高點處的鋼絞線腐蝕有關。

現代後拉灌漿多採工廠預拌包裝的材料，美國 PTI M55.1 把灌漿分為 A 至 D 四級（A 非侵蝕環境、B 侵蝕環境、C 預拌產品適用兩者、D 由工程師決定），規定水泥種類、礦物摻料與最大水膠比 0.45，並禁止使用緻密化矽灰。灌漿中的氯離子與硫酸鹽會破壞鋼材鈍化膜，美國 PTI、ACI 與 AASHTO 以水泥重量 0.08% 作為酸溶性氯離子上限，歐洲標準則為 0.10%。2001 年後預拌觸變性灌漿普及，但 FHWA 調查顯示部分新橋仍因材料離析、軟化與高氯、高硫酸鹽而腐蝕，說明材料管理與現場拌合同樣重要。
孔道必須夠大，讓鋼絞線穿索後仍留有足夠空間讓灌漿流過並包覆每一股；密封的塑膠波紋管比鍍鋅鋼管更能阻絕外部水分與氯離子，但接頭、耦合器與節塊接縫處必須確實密封。灌漿口與排氣管的內徑也有下限，FHWA 手冊建議鋼絞線鋼腱的進出口內徑至少 20 mm，以免灌漿阻塞。錨頭是最容易進水的位置，需以永久封蓋灌滿，再以混凝土封頭與防水層保護。
灌漿要從最低點的灌漿口以連續、穩定的流量推進，讓灌漿前緣把空氣與水推向排氣口；每個排氣口在流出與進料一致、無氣泡的灌漿後才依序關閉，直到最後出漿口確認後再加壓保持一段時間。推進太快會讓灌漿越過鋼絞線間的空氣而形成空洞，太慢或中斷則讓灌漿在孔道內開始凝結。壓力要控制在孔道與錨頭可承受範圍內，垂直或高差大的鋼腱還要考慮靜水壓與雙閥門。
灌漿完成並初凝後，要檢查高點與錨頭是否因沉降或泌水被吸收而出現空洞：常見做法是在高點排氣管與錨頭封蓋處開孔，以探針或內視鏡觀察，必要時以真空輔助補灌。真空補灌先把空洞抽成低壓，再讓灌漿被吸入，能填入細小且彎曲的空間；以已知容積的儲氣槽連接空洞並觀察壓力平衡，即可依波以耳定律估算空洞體積，進而確認補灌量。錨頭最後以永久封蓋、封頭混凝土與防水塗層多層保護。
灌漿品質要以試驗證明：流錐試驗（ASTM C939 標準或改良式）量測一定體積灌漿流出的時間，反映流動性；燈芯泌水試驗把鋼絞線插入灌漿柱，模擬鋼絞線吸水造成的泌水；加壓泌水試驗以過濾漏斗在壓力下量測水分分離，反映高差大的鋼腱中灌漿是否會被擠出水分；傾斜管試驗則以實尺寸傾斜孔道檢查高點空洞。現場還可用泥漿密度計快速檢查是否多加了水。重要工程先做實尺寸試灌，剖開確認填充品質。
完工後或既有橋梁的灌漿狀態只能間接判斷：透地雷達先定位內部鋼腱，敲擊回音法以應力波在混凝土中反射的頻率判斷孔道處是否有空洞，超音波斷層掃描可建立斷面影像，放射線攝影則能直接看見孔道內部但受安全與厚度限制。非破壞結果有疑問時，再以小孔鑽入孔道、用內視鏡觀察並取樣檢驗灌漿的氯離子與硫酸鹽。FHWA 2013 年的指引提醒，侵入式檢測本身會製造腐蝕通道，取樣數量應盡量少並確實修復。
灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕通常是慢性的：空洞中的潮濕空氣、泌水留下的水分、離析後柔軟且鹼性不足的灌漿，以及氯離子或硫酸鹽，都會讓鋼絞線局部去鈍化並形成蝕坑。蝕坑比均勻腐蝕危險，因為鋼絲在蝕坑處應力集中、斷面驟減，在仍有高預力的情況下可能突然斷裂。外部來源同樣重要：倫敦漢默史密斯高架橋在 2011 年因除冰鹽造成鋼腱腐蝕而緊急處理，後來以外置預力補強，2015 年完成修復。

灌漿缺陷無法在完工後直接看到，因此施工紀錄是日後判斷風險的主要依據：每條鋼腱的材料批號、試驗結果、灌注量、壓力歷程與排氣順序都要保存。FHWA 2013 年的指引把風險定義為缺陷機率指標乘以破壞後果指標，各以 1 到 5 分評估，沒有紀錄的工程被直接給予最高的機率分數。英國在 1985 年 Ynys-y-Gwas 崩塌後，1992 年暫停新建內部灌漿後拉橋並進行五年檢查，1996 年才解除，說明紀錄、檢查與可更換設計對業主決策的重要性。
procedureEn: After a post-tensioning tendon is stressed and anchored, its duct must be completely filled with cementitious grout: the grout's high alkalinity passivates the strand surface against rusting, and once hardened it bonds tendon to concrete so the prestress no longer depends only on the end anchorages and a local wire break can re-transfer force to the concrete within a short length. Voids, bleed water or chloride-contaminated grout let strands corrode out of sight, and high-strength wires with small sections are especially sensitive to pits, so they can fracture without obvious warning. The single-span precast segmental Ynys-y-Gwas bridge in Wales, built in 1953, collapsed suddenly in 1985 because tendons corroded at the in-situ joints between segments, where they were inadequately protected.

A continuous girder's tendon rises over the piers and dips at midspan; as grout flows along the duct, air and bleed water collect at high points, and the strand bundle forms fine channels that wick water upward like a lamp wick, so water lenses and voids are more likely at crests and near anchorages. The water is later absorbed or evaporates, leaving a void with strands exposed to damp air. FHWA research notes that the tendon durability problems found in the United States from 1999 onward were associated with grout voids, bleed water and strand corrosion at anchorages and crests.

Modern post-tensioning grouts are mostly factory pre-bagged; PTI M55.1 in the United States defines classes A to D (A for non-aggressive, B for aggressive, C pre-bagged for either, D as specified by the engineer), sets cement types, supplementary materials and a maximum water-to-cementitious ratio of 0.45, and prohibits densified silica fume. Chlorides and sulfates in grout break down the steel's passive film, and PTI, ACI and AASHTO limit acid-soluble chloride to 0.08% by weight of cement, while the European standard uses 0.10%. Pre-bagged thixotropic grouts spread after 2001, yet FHWA investigations found some newer bridges still corroding because of segregated, soft grout with high chloride and sulfate, showing that material control matters as much as field mixing.

Ducts must be large enough to leave space for grout to flow around every strand after threading; sealed corrugated plastic ducts block external water and chlorides better than galvanised steel, but joints, couplers and segment interfaces must be properly sealed. Inlets and vents also have minimum sizes; the FHWA manual recommends at least 20 mm internal diameter for strand-tendon ports so grout does not block them. Anchorages are the easiest entry point for water and need permanent caps filled with grout, then concrete pour-backs and waterproofing.

Grout is pumped from the lowest inlet at a continuous, steady rate so the grout front pushes air and water toward the vents; each vent is closed in sequence only once grout of the same consistency as the feed, free of bubbles, flows from it, and after the final outlet is confirmed the system is held under pressure for a period. Advancing too fast lets grout bypass air between strands and leave voids; too slow, or interrupted, lets grout begin to set inside the duct. Pressure must stay within what ducts and anchorages can take, and vertical or steep tendons must also consider static head and double valves.

After grouting and initial set, high points and anchorages are checked for voids caused by settlement or bleed reabsorption: vents at crests and anchorage caps are opened and probed or viewed with a borescope, and vacuum-assisted regrouting is used where needed. Vacuum regrouting first evacuates the void, then lets grout be drawn in, filling small and tortuous spaces; connecting a reservoir of known volume to the void and observing the pressure equalisation estimates the void volume by Boyle's law, confirming the regrout quantity. The anchorage is finally protected in layers by a permanent cap, a concrete pour-back and a waterproof coating.

Grout quality must be proven by testing: the flow-cone test (ASTM C939 standard or modified) times the efflux of a fixed volume to reflect fluidity; the wick-induced bleed test inserts strand into a grout column to mimic water drawn along strands; the bleed-under-pressure test uses a filtration funnel to measure water separation under pressure, reflecting whether grout in tall tendons will be squeezed dry; and the inclined-tube test checks high-point voids in a full-size inclined duct. On site a mud balance quickly checks whether extra water was added. Important projects first grout a full-size mock-up and cut it open to confirm filling.

The grout condition of completed or existing bridges can only be judged indirectly: ground-penetrating radar first locates internal tendons, impact-echo uses the frequency of stress waves reflected in the concrete to judge whether a duct contains voids, ultrasonic tomography builds section images, and radiography sees inside ducts directly but is limited by safety and thickness. Where non-destructive results are doubtful, a small hole is drilled into the duct, inspected with a borescope and the grout sampled for chloride and sulfate. FHWA's 2013 guidance warns that invasive testing itself creates corrosion paths, so the number of samples should be minimised and every hole properly repaired.

Corrosion from grout defects is usually chronic: damp air in voids, water left by bleed, segregated grout that is soft and less alkaline, and chlorides or sulfates depassivate strands locally and form pits. Pitting is more dangerous than uniform corrosion, because stress concentrates and the section drops sharply at the pit while the wire still carries high prestress, so it can snap suddenly. External sources matter too: London's Hammersmith Flyover required emergency action in 2011 when de-icing salts corroded its tendons, and was later strengthened with external post-tensioning, with repairs completed in 2015.

Grout defects cannot be seen after completion, so construction records are the main basis for later risk judgements: each tendon's material lots, test results, injected volume, pressure history and venting sequence must be kept. FHWA's 2013 guidance defines risk as a probability-of-defect indicator times a consequence-of-failure indicator, each scored 1 to 5, and projects with no records are given the highest probability score outright. After the Ynys-y-Gwas collapse of 1985, Britain halted new internally grouted post-tensioned bridges in 1992 for a five-year inspection programme and lifted the moratorium only in 1996, showing how records, inspection and replaceable design shape owners' decisions.
evidence: 設計階段就把節塊接縫、耦合器與錨頭列為防蝕重點，採用多層保護（密封塑膠孔道、完整灌漿、錨頭封蓋與防水），並在圖面上標示每條鋼腱的灌漿與排氣口位置。
孔道配置圖要列出每個高點、低點與錨頭的排氣或灌漿口，並規定高點排氣管延伸到高於孔道的位置以便觀察；施工前由設計者與專業承包商共同確認配置。
規格書明定灌漿等級、核可產品與禁止事項（禁止現場添加任何未經核准的外加劑、禁止使用含氯材料），任何材料替換都須重新提交試驗並經設計者書面核准。
把孔道氣密試驗與通孔確認列為澆置混凝土與灌漿前的兩個停留點；錨頭封蓋、封頭混凝土與防水細部在施工圖中逐一繪出，不得留待現場決定。
灌漿作業由取得專業認證的人員執行並由監造全程見證，每條鋼腱的灌漿紀錄當場簽認；中斷時依事先核准的應變程序（例如立即以水沖洗或改由另一灌漿口完成）處理，不得臨場自行判斷。
evidenceEn: At design make segment joints, couplers and anchorages corrosion-protection priorities with multilayer protection (sealed plastic ducts, complete grouting, anchorage caps and waterproofing), and show every tendon's grout inlets and vents on the drawings.

The duct layout drawing lists the vent or inlet at every crest, low point and anchorage and requires crest vents to rise above the duct for observation; the designer and the specialist contractor confirm the layout together before construction.

The specification fixes grout class, approved products and prohibitions (no unapproved admixtures added on site, no chloride-bearing materials), and any substitution requires a new test submittal and the designer's written approval.

Make duct airtightness testing and clear-passage confirmation hold points before concreting and before grouting; draw anchorage caps, pour-backs and waterproofing details individually on the shop drawings rather than leaving them to site decisions.

Grouting is carried out by certified specialists and witnessed throughout by the inspector, with each tendon's record signed on the spot; interruptions follow a pre-approved contingency (for example immediate flushing or completion from another inlet), never improvisation.
pitfalls: Ynys-y-Gwas 橋崩塌前外觀沒有明顯警訊；鋼腱在接縫處腐蝕斷裂，結構在沒有超載的情況下突然倒塌。這類破壞的特徵正是灌漿缺陷與鋼腱腐蝕都藏在混凝土內，日常目視檢查難以發現。
2000 年美國北卡羅來納州夏洛特賽車場的人行橋（1995 年建成）因灌漿中添加了未經核准的化學品，造成鋼絞線腐蝕，一跨突然斷落，多名觀眾受傷；材料的一個未授權變更就足以摧毀整套防蝕系統。
灌漿中途幫浦故障而沒有備用設備，孔道內灌漿停留過久開始凝結，再次啟動時壓力暴增而無法完成，留下半段空孔道；或排氣口一見到灌漿就關閉，前緣夾帶的水與空氣被封在孔道內。
現場為了讓灌漿好打而多加水，流錐時間變短看似「更順」，但泌水大增，高點留下水層與空洞；若只在開工第一天做試驗，之後的材料批號變化或拌合時間不足都不會被發現。
FHWA 調查指出，美國有 10 個州回報過與灌漿缺陷或過量氯離子有關的鋼腱問題，部分是 2001 年後採用預拌灌漿的新橋；若只把問題視為舊橋專屬，新橋的離析或高硫酸鹽灌漿就會被忽略，直到斷絲才被發現。
pitfallsEn: The Ynys-y-Gwas bridge showed no obvious warning before it fell; tendons corroded through at the joints and the structure collapsed suddenly without overload. The hallmark of such failures is that both grout defects and tendon corrosion are hidden inside the concrete, beyond routine visual inspection.

In 2000 a span of the pedestrian bridge at Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina, built in 1995, collapsed suddenly, injuring many spectators, because an unauthorised chemical added to the tendon grout had corroded the strands; a single unapproved change to the material can defeat the whole corrosion-protection system.

A pump failure mid-tendon with no standby leaves grout standing until it begins to set, so restarting spikes the pressure and the tendon cannot be completed, leaving half the duct empty; closing vents as soon as any grout appears traps the water and air carried at the front inside the duct.

Adding water on site to ease pumping shortens the flow-cone time and seems smoother, but bleed rises sharply and crests are left with water lenses and voids; testing only on the first day lets later batch changes or short mixing times go unnoticed.

FHWA reported that 10 states had tendon problems linked to grout deficiencies or excess chloride, some on newer bridges built with pre-bagged grouts after 2001; treating the problem as confined to old bridges lets segregated or high-sulfate grout in new bridges go unnoticed until wires break.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

facts: Mid-Bay 大橋全長約 5.8 km（19,265 ft），1993 年通車，典型跨徑約 136 ft、主跨 225 ft
Mid-Bay 每條外置鋼腱為 19 股 0.6 in（15.2 mm）、270 ksi 鋼絞線，置於 4 in 聚乙烯套管內，每跨 6 條
2000 年事件後 FDOT 以內視鏡檢查全部 1,728 個錨頭，並更換 846 條鋼腱中的 11 條
Mid-Bay 第 28 跨一條鋼腱 19 股中有 6 股被腐蝕切斷，殘餘力估計約 500 kips（約 2,220 kN）
Ringling 堤道橋 2003 年完工，132 條 22 股外置鋼腱中有 2 條在不到 8 年內失效，最終更換 17 條
Wando River 橋 2018 年失效的鋼腱 133 根鋼絲中約 80.5% 因腐蝕斷裂，西行橋封閉近 3 週
FHWA-HIF-19-067 建議 19 股鋼腱最小轉向半徑約 9.8 ft，擴口出口角取轉向角加 3°
AASHTO LRFD 節塊橋修訂條文（預定納入第 10 版）要求臨時預力容量不少於總預力的 5%，未來追加鋼腱選項為 10%
factsEn: Mid-Bay Bridge is about 5.8 km (19,265 ft) long, opened in 1993, with typical spans of about 136 ft and a 225 ft main span
Each Mid-Bay external tendon has 19 strands of 0.6 in (15.2 mm), 270 ksi steel in a 4 in polyethylene duct, six tendons per span
After the 2000 event FDOT borescoped all 1,728 anchorages and replaced 11 of 846 tendons
One Mid-Bay span 28 tendon had 6 of 19 strands severed by corrosion and an estimated residual force of about 500 kips (about 2,220 kN)
Ringling Causeway Bridge, completed in 2003, had 2 of its 132 external 22-strand tendons fail within 8 years, and 17 were eventually replaced
In the tendon that failed at Wando River Bridge in 2018, about 80.5% of 133 wires had ruptured by corrosion, and the westbound bridge closed for nearly 3 weeks
FHWA-HIF-19-067 recommends a minimum deviator radius of about 9.8 ft for 19-strand tendons and a diabolo exit angle of the deviation angle plus 3°
Revised AASHTO LRFD segmental provisions (slated for the 10th edition) require provisional capacity of at least 5% of total prestress, with a 10% option for future tendons

timelineEn: 1993 — Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge opens as a precast segmental box girder with external tendons
1999 — Florida's Niles Channel Bridge suffers the first confirmed corrosion-caused tendon failure in the United States, and the tendon is replaced
2000 — Broken tendons are found at Mid-Bay; FDOT detensions strand by strand and replaces 11 tendons
2011 — Two external tendons fail at Ringling Causeway Bridge, and 17 are replaced after a full investigation
2019 — FHWA publishes FHWA-HIF-19-067 on replaceable grouted external tendons, proposing double-envelope and diabolo details
2024 — FHWA publishes FHWA-HRT-24-148, compiling major corrosion-induced tendon failures in the United States

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.
