guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：清水混凝土模板與澆置
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting
guides.concept: 清水混凝土的表面就是建築完成面，不能事後粉刷遮蓋，因此模板分割、繫桿孔排列、面板材料、脫模劑、配比與骨材一致性、澆置速度與振搗、樣板牆與驗收距離都必須在施工前定案。本課以安藤忠雄的光之教會與路易斯．康的沙克研究所為例，並以 ACI 347.3R 的成形面等級 CSC1 至 CSC4 與 ACI 301 第 6 節建築混凝土為框架，說明清水混凝土從設計意圖到長期維護的工程判斷。
guides.conceptEn: In exposed architectural concrete the surface is the finished building face and cannot be covered later, so panel layout, tie-hole pattern, facing material, release agent, mix and aggregate consistency, placing rate and vibration, mock-ups and viewing distance must all be settled before casting. Using Tadao Ando's Church of the Light and Louis Kahn's Salk Institute, framed by the ACI 347.3R formed-surface categories CSC1 to CSC4 and ACI 301 Section 6 Architectural Concrete, the course explains engineering judgement from design intent to long-term maintenance.
procedure: 清水混凝土的第一個工程問題是「要多好」。ACI 347.3R 把成形混凝土表面分為 CSC1 到 CSC4 四級：CSC1 用於地下室牆等不重視外觀的位置，CSC3 可用於一般商業建築外牆，CSC4 則用於紀念性或地標建築；每一級對模板面材、表面孔洞比例與顏色均勻度的要求不同。ACI 301 第 6 節建築混凝土只有在契約文件指定時才適用，所以設計者必須在圖說中明確寫出哪些面是清水面、要求哪一級，否則承包商只會按一般結構混凝土施作。等級越高，模板、配比、人力與樣板成本都越高。
在清水混凝土中，模板拼縫與繫桿孔不是缺陷，而是建築語彙：它們的位置、間距與對齊方式會永久留在表面上。安藤忠雄的作品常以約 910×1,820 mm 的模板與規則排列的繫桿孔構成立面節奏，路易斯．康在沙克研究所也讓模板接縫與繫桿孔成為表面的秩序。因此模板分割必須在建築設計階段與牆長、開口、樓層高度與轉角一起決定，並把繫桿孔放在面板上對稱的位置；若牆長不是面板寬度的整數倍，就會出現難看的窄條板。

混凝土表面會忠實複製模板面材的質感與吸水性：覆膜合板得到光滑均勻的表面，未處理木板留下木紋，吸水性不同的面板會讓表層水灰比不同而產生色差。ACI 347.3R 把模板面材特性列為成形面等級的三大分類之一。脫模劑塗太多會流淌並在表面留下深色斑痕或孔洞，塗太少則混凝土黏模；不同廠牌或批次的脫模劑也可能造成顏色差異。面材重複使用時表面磨損、吸水性改變，也會逐次改變混凝土顏色，所以高等級清水面要限制面材使用次數。
清水混凝土的顏色由水泥、礦物摻料、細骨材的顏色與表層水灰比共同決定，所以整個工程應使用同一水泥廠、同一摻料來源與同一砂石來源，避免批次變化。沙克研究所的混凝土採用含火山灰的配比，產生偏暖的色調，康並在地下室以不同顏色的試驗牆比較配比；這說明配比本身就是外觀設計的一部分。最常被忽視的變數是骨材含水率：砂的含水率變動會改變實際用水量，表層水灰比升高時顏色變淺且孔洞增加。
清水面要平整、拼縫要乾淨，模板必須夠剛且密封良好。新鮮混凝土的側壓使面板在支撐間撓曲，撓曲量若超過肉眼在斜光下可辨識的程度，牆面就會出現波浪；拼縫若有縫隙，水泥漿在壓力下從縫隙流失，留下砂紋、深色漏漿痕或粗糙的蜂窩帶。因此清水模板常比結構模板有更密的背楞、更厚的面板，拼縫以密封條或膠帶處理，牆角與施工縫以倒角或凹槽把無法避免的接縫變成刻意的線條。

清水牆的澆置要控制「上升速度」，也就是單位時間內混凝土在模板中升高的高度；它同時決定模板側壓、分層結合與表面氣泡。上升太快時側壓接近液壓，模板撓曲與漏漿增加，下層混凝土也來不及排出氣泡；太慢則兩層之間可能形成顏色不同的層線。振搗要讓氣泡沿模板面上升排出，但過度振搗會使漿體上浮、骨材下沉，造成上下顏色不同；振動棒碰觸模板面會在表面留下磨痕。ACI 347.3R 把表面孔洞比例作為成形面等級的分類依據之一，振搗正是控制孔洞的關鍵。
清水混凝土的驗收離不開樣板牆。ACI 347.3R 把樣板定義為依契約文件製作的構件樣本，用來建立預期的表面完成度；它同時驗證模板、配比、脫模劑、澆置與振搗的組合，並成為整個工程的比對基準。樣板牆應包含真實的拼縫、繫桿孔、轉角、施工縫與開口邊緣，並在與正式工程相同的季節與條件下製作。驗收時還必須規定觀看距離與光線條件：同一面牆在 1 m 與 10 m 外看，可接受的缺陷完全不同。
清水混凝土的驗收若只靠主觀印象，很容易產生爭議，因此應盡量把外觀指標量化：以色差儀或標準灰卡量測表面明度與色差，以直尺或數位平整度儀量測平整度，以檢查框與影像分析量測孔洞比例。量測要在混凝土乾燥程度相近時進行，因為潮濕表面顏色較深；同一面牆的量測點應涵蓋不同澆置批次與樓層，才能看出系統性的變化。這些數據也能回饋到施工，例如發現下層顏色偏深時檢討振搗與漿體上浮。
清水混凝土沒有塗裝保護，表面毛細孔會吸水，雨水帶著灰塵與微生物進入表層，形成流痕與黑斑；吸水也會加速凍融、碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕。常見作法是在完工後施作滲透型撥水劑（如矽烷或矽氧烷），降低表面吸水但不改變外觀與透氣性。修補是清水混凝土最難的工作：修補砂漿必須與周圍顏色、質感一致，而且新舊材料的顏色會隨時間以不同速度變化，所以修補配方要在樣板牆上試驗並放置一段時間觀察。
清水混凝土的外觀會隨時間演變：表面碳化使顏色略變，雨水流路形成污痕，綠藻在背陽面生長，繫桿孔塞頭可能鬆脫。沙克研究所於 1991 年被指定為歷史地標，其混凝土與柚木的保存工作顯示，清水建築的維護需要了解原始材料與工法。交接時應移交原配比、面材與脫模劑資料、撥水劑產品與施作紀錄、修補配方與樣本、樣板牆照片與量測基準，並規定可接受的清潔方法；高壓水柱或酸洗會改變表面質感，必須先試驗。
procedureEn: The first engineering question for exposed concrete is how good it must be. ACI 347.3R divides formed concrete surfaces into four categories, CSC1 to CSC4: CSC1 for places such as basement walls where appearance matters little, CSC3 for ordinary commercial exteriors and CSC4 for monumental or landmark structures, each with different requirements for form facing, surface void ratio and colour uniformity. ACI 301 Section 6 Architectural Concrete applies only when the contract documents designate it, so the designer must state explicitly which faces are exposed and to what category, or the contractor will simply build ordinary structural concrete. Higher categories cost more in formwork, mix control, labour and mock-ups.

In exposed concrete, form joints and tie holes are not defects but architectural vocabulary: their position, spacing and alignment stay on the surface permanently. Tadao Ando's work often uses forms of about 910×1,820 mm with regularly spaced tie holes to give elevations their rhythm, and Louis Kahn at the Salk Institute likewise let form joints and tie holes order the surface. Panel layout must therefore be settled at architectural design stage together with wall lengths, openings, storey heights and corners, with tie holes placed symmetrically on each panel; if a wall length is not a whole multiple of the panel width, an awkward narrow filler panel appears.

Concrete faithfully reproduces the texture and absorbency of the form facing: film-faced plywood gives a smooth, even surface, untreated boards leave wood grain, and facings of different absorbency change the surface water–cement ratio and cause colour differences. ACI 347.3R lists form-facing characteristics as one of its three surface-finish categories. Too much release agent runs and leaves dark stains or bugholes, too little lets concrete stick; different brands or batches of release agent can also change colour. Reused facings wear and change absorbency, gradually altering colour from use to use, so higher categories limit how many times a facing may be used.

The colour of exposed concrete comes from the cement, supplementary materials, fine aggregate and surface water–cement ratio together, so the whole job should use one cement plant, one supplementary-material source and one aggregate source to avoid batch variation. The Salk Institute used a mix containing volcanic ash that gives a warm tone, and Kahn compared mixes in differently coloured trial walls in the basement, showing that the mix itself is part of the visual design. The most overlooked variable is aggregate moisture: changes in sand moisture alter the actual water content, and a higher surface water–cement ratio lightens colour and increases voids.

For a flat face and clean joints, forms must be stiff and well sealed. Fresh-concrete pressure bends facings between supports, and if deflection exceeds what the eye detects in raking light the wall shows waves; any gap at a joint lets paste escape under pressure, leaving sand streaks, dark grout-loss lines or rough honeycomb bands. Exposed-concrete forms therefore often have closer studs and thicker facings than structural forms, joints sealed with gaskets or tape, and chamfers or reveals at corners and construction joints that turn unavoidable joints into deliberate lines.

Placing exposed walls means controlling the rate of rise, how fast concrete climbs in the form, which governs form pressure, bonding between layers and surface bubbles. Too fast and pressure approaches hydrostatic, form deflection and leaks increase and lower layers cannot release air; too slow and colour lines may form between layers. Vibration must drive bubbles up and out along the form face, but over-vibration floats paste up and sinks aggregate, giving different colours top and bottom, and a vibrator touching the facing scuffs the surface. ACI 347.3R uses surface void ratio as one of its classification criteria, and vibration is the key to controlling voids.

Acceptance of exposed concrete depends on the mock-up. ACI 347.3R defines a mock-up as a sample of a building component made as specified in the contract documents to establish the expected surface finish; it proves the combination of forms, mix, release agent, placing and vibration and becomes the reference for the whole job. A mock-up should include real panel joints, tie holes, a corner, a construction joint and an opening edge, and be cast in the same season and conditions as the work. Acceptance must also state viewing distance and light: the same wall seen from 1 m and from 10 m tolerates entirely different defects.

Acceptance by subjective impression alone invites disputes, so appearance criteria should be quantified where possible: measure surface lightness and colour difference with a colorimeter or standard grey cards, flatness with a straightedge or digital flatness gauge, and void ratio with an inspection frame and image analysis. Measure when the concrete is similarly dry, because damp surfaces look darker, and spread points on each wall across different batches and storeys to reveal systematic changes. The data also feed back into construction; for example, a darker lower zone prompts a review of vibration and paste flotation.

Exposed concrete has no paint, so surface capillaries absorb water and rain carries dust and micro-organisms into the surface layer, forming streaks and dark patches; absorption also accelerates freeze–thaw, carbonation and bar corrosion. A common measure is a penetrating water repellent such as silane or siloxane after completion, reducing absorption without changing appearance or breathability. Repair is the hardest job in exposed concrete: repair mortar must match the surrounding colour and texture, and new and old materials change colour at different rates over time, so repair recipes are trialled on the mock-up and left to weather before use.

Exposed concrete changes with time: surface carbonation shifts colour slightly, rain paths form streaks, algae grow on shaded faces and tie-hole plugs may loosen. The Salk Institute, designated a historic landmark in 1991, shows through its concrete and teak conservation work that maintaining exposed buildings requires knowing the original materials and methods. Handover should deliver the original mix, facing and release-agent data, water-repellent product and application records, repair recipes and samples, mock-up photographs and measurement baselines, and specify acceptable cleaning methods; high-pressure water or acid washing changes surface texture and must be trialled first.
evidence: 在契約中引用 ACI 301 第 6 節或對應規範，逐面指定 ACI 347.3R 等級、孔洞比例、色差與平整度要求，以及樣板牆與觀看距離；這些要求要在投標前提供，讓承包商能正確估價。
把模板分割展開圖列為建築設計圖的一部分，施工縫、繫桿孔與拼縫的位置與構造詳圖（例如倒角、凹槽、繫桿錐形套）都要在開工前定案；任何現場調整須經建築師書面同意。
規格中指定面材種類、使用次數上限與修補方式，以及脫模劑廠牌、用量與施作方法；同一可見面應使用同一批面材與同一批脫模劑，並在面板背面標記使用次數。
清水混凝土的配比、水泥與骨材來源應在樣板牆核定後鎖定，供應契約中規定材料庫存與不可替換條款；任何變更都要重做樣板並經建築師同意。
清水模板的撓度限值、拼縫密封方式與倒角凹槽詳圖要寫入模板設計規範，並由模板設計者出具計算書；第一次使用的模板系統必須先在樣板牆上驗證。
evidenceEn: Cite ACI 301 Section 6 or an equivalent in the contract, specify ACI 347.3R category, void ratio, colour and flatness face by face, along with the mock-up and viewing distance, and issue these before tender so contractors can price correctly.

Make the developed formwork elevations part of the architectural drawings, and settle construction joints, tie holes and joint details such as chamfers, reveals and tie cones before work starts; any site adjustment needs the architect's written approval.

Specify facing type, maximum uses and repair method, and release-agent brand, dosage and application in the specification; use one batch of facing and one batch of release agent for each visible face, and mark use counts on the back of each panel.

Lock the mix, cement and aggregate sources once the mock-up is approved, require stockpiles and no-substitution clauses in the supply contract, and redo the mock-up with the architect's approval for any change.

Write deflection limits, joint-sealing methods and chamfer and reveal details for exposed-concrete forms into the formwork specification, with calculations from the formwork designer, and prove any formwork system on the mock-up before first use.
pitfalls: 圖說只寫「清水混凝土」而未指定等級與驗收方法，完工後業主以地標級標準要求、承包商以一般結構標準施作，雙方對孔洞與色差爭執不下，最後只能大面積修補或塗裝，失去清水的意義。
同一面牆混用新舊面材，新面板吸水多，牆面出現與面板分割相同的明暗格子；脫模劑過量在下方積聚，牆腳一帶出現深色斑塊與密集小孔，無法以清洗去除。
為節省材料放寬背楞間距，拆模後在斜光下牆面出現規則的波浪；拼縫未密封，每一道拼縫兩側都有砂紋與深色漏漿線，牆腳因壓力最大而出現連續蜂窩帶。
樣板牆只做一片光滑小面，沒有拼縫、繫桿孔或施工縫，正式工程出現的問題在樣板上從未被驗證；未約定觀看距離，業主以手電筒貼近檢查每一個小孔，導致無止境的修補要求。
使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。
pitfallsEn: Drawings that say only exposed concrete without a category or acceptance method lead the owner to expect landmark quality while the contractor builds to ordinary structural standards, and the two sides argue over voids and colour until extensive patching or painting defeats the purpose of exposed concrete.

Mixing new and used facings on one wall makes the more absorbent new panels show as a chequerboard of light and dark matching the panel layout; excess release agent pooling at the bottom leaves dark patches and dense small voids at the wall base that cannot be washed off.

Widening stud spacing to save material leaves regular waves visible in raking light after stripping; unsealed joints leave sand streaks and dark leak lines along every joint, and the wall base, where pressure is greatest, shows a continuous honeycomb band.

A mock-up that is only a small smooth panel without joints, tie holes or construction joints never tests the problems that appear on the real work; with no agreed viewing distance, the owner inspects every pinhole with a torch at close range and repair demands never end.

Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture; repair mortar that matches on the day turns noticeably lighter or darker a year later, leaving the wall covered in patches.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.concept: 依腐蝕環境選擇塗裝系統，以表面處理、露點與膜厚控制施工品質，並以狀態評估決定局部修補或全面重塗。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Selecting coating systems by corrosivity, controlling quality through surface preparation, dew point and film thickness, and using condition surveys to choose spot repair or full repainting. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: 金門大橋原始塗料為含鉛底漆與面漆，含鉛塗料移除計畫於 1995 年完成

金門大橋 1990 年為符合 VOC 空氣品質規定，面漆由乙烯系改為壓克力乳膠

金門大橋國際橘的 CMYK 為 C 0%、M 69%、Y 100%、K 6%

factsEn: The Golden Gate Bridge was first painted with lead primer and topcoat, and the lead-paint removal program was completed in 1995
The Golden Gate Bridge's original lead paint was about 68% red lead paste in a linseed oil carrier
In 1990 the Golden Gate Bridge topcoat changed from vinyl to acrylic emulsion to meet VOC air-quality rules
The Golden Gate Bridge keeps 28 painters, 5 painter laborers, 13 ironworkers and 3 pusher ironworkers
Golden Gate Bridge International Orange is CMYK C 0%, M 69%, Y 100%, K 6%
The Forth Bridge's first full repaint covered about 255,000 m² using about 240,000 L of paint
The Eiffel Tower has been repainted 20 times in 136 years, each time with about 60 t of paint over about 250,000 m² by about 50 painters
About 15 t of paint is estimated to erode from the Eiffel Tower between campaigns
In ISO 12944, C5 environments correspond to a first-year carbon-steel loss of about 80 to 200 μm

timelineEn: 1899 — After this campaign the Eiffel Tower adopts a repainting cycle of about every seven years
1965–1995 — The Golden Gate Bridge removes its original lead-based paint and adopts an inorganic zinc silicate primer system
1990 — The Golden Gate Bridge switches its topcoat to acrylic emulsion to meet VOC rules
2002–2011 — The Forth Bridge undergoes its first full repaint since opening, covering about 255,000 m²
2019 — The Eiffel Tower's 20th repainting campaign begins, for the first time including stripping of parts of the structure

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：大型鋼構防蝕塗裝
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Protective coating of large steel structures
guides.concept: 從大氣腐蝕環境與 ISO 12944 腐蝕性分級出發，說明鋅底漆、中塗與面漆的防蝕機制、噴砂清潔度與錨紋、露點與施工環境、構件細部與邊緣膜厚、濕膜與乾膜厚度驗收、附著力檢測、劣化分級與維護策略，並以舊金山金門大橋的持續修補、蘇格蘭福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗與艾菲爾鐵塔每約七年一次的重塗為實例。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from atmospheric corrosivity and the ISO 12944 categories, explain how zinc primers, intermediate coats and topcoats protect steel, then cover blast-cleaning grade and surface profile, dew point and site conditions, detailing and edge film build, wet- and dry-film thickness acceptance, adhesion testing, degradation rating and maintenance strategy, using the continuous touch-up of San Francisco's Golden Gate Bridge, the first full repaint of Scotland's Forth Bridge and the roughly seven-yearly repainting of the Eiffel Tower.
procedure: 鋼材在大氣中腐蝕需要水膜與氧，速率主要取決於表面潮濕時間、氯鹽沉積與硫化物；海邊的霧與鹽風會讓腐蝕速率比內陸高出數倍。ISO 12944 依碳鋼第一年腐蝕損失把環境分成 C1 至 C5 與 CX 等類別，作為選擇塗裝系統與耐久等級的依據。同一座結構內也有微環境差異：遮蔽的下翼板、積水的接頭與縫隙、浪花飛濺區，往往比外露迎風面腐蝕更快。金門大橋的維護人員就描述他們要對抗風、海氣與霧造成的鋼材腐蝕。
大型鋼構常用三層系統：富鋅底漆以鋅粉的犧牲陽極作用保護鋼材，即使塗膜有小傷口，鋅也會先腐蝕；中塗（常為環氧）提供膜厚與阻隔，延長水氣與離子滲透到鋼面的路徑；面漆（聚氨酯、壓克力等）抵抗紫外線並保持顏色。金門大橋在移除原有含鉛塗料後改用無機鋅矽酸鹽底漆加面漆；艾菲爾鐵塔每次重塗也採防鏽底漆、防鏽加強層與面漆三層；福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗則使用源自北海石油工業的三層系統。
塗裝壽命很大部分在塗第一層之前就已決定：噴砂必須除去軋鋼皮、鏽與舊塗層，達到 ISO 8501-1 規定的清潔等級（例如 Sa 2½），並形成適當深度的錨紋讓底漆咬合；表面殘留的可溶性鹽類會在塗膜下吸水起泡，因此海邊結構還要檢測氯鹽。施工時鋼面溫度必須高於露點至少 3°C，否則表面凝結的薄水膜會使新噴砂面立即返鏽，並降低附著力。
塗料在銳邊因表面張力而縮離，邊緣膜厚常只有平面的一半甚至更少，所以生鏽多從邊緣、螺栓頭與焊道開始。良好的防蝕細部包括：把銳邊磨圓、避免無法塗裝的窄縫與背對背角鋼、在可能積水處設排水孔、讓箱形構件完全密封或可進入維護，並預留塗裝工具與人員的作業空間。金門大橋的鐵工必須拆下板件，才能讓塗裝工進入柱與弦桿內部作業；該橋自 1970 年起也以高強度螺栓逐步取代鉚釘。

大型既有結構的維護塗裝是在高空、風雨與交通中進行：需要搭設包覆式施工架或吊籃，以圍封收集噴砂粉塵與舊塗層碎屑，必要時以除濕機控制施工環境；每一層須在最短與最長覆塗間隔內完成下一層，否則附著不良。艾菲爾鐵塔一次重塗需 18 個月到三年以上，約 50 名塗裝工使用總長約 55 km 的安全索，並以防護網收集漆片；福斯鐵橋 2002 年起的首次全面重塗覆蓋約 255,000 m²、用漆約 240,000 L。
膜厚是塗裝規格中最直接可量測的品質指標：太薄則阻隔不足、提早生鏽，太厚則可能龜裂、殘留溶劑或附著不良。施工中以濕膜梳即時檢查，由固含量換算乾膜；乾燥後以磁性或渦電流測厚儀量測乾膜厚，在粗糙的噴砂面上要依 ISO 19840 扣除粗糙度修正值。驗收常採「80-20 規則」：平均值不低於標稱膜厚、低於標稱值的讀數不超過 20%，且沒有任何讀數低於標稱值的 80%，同時不得超過產品允許的最大膜厚。
膜厚合格不代表塗層黏得住。附著力常以 ISO 4624 拉拔試驗量測：把金屬拉拔頭黏在塗膜上，切開周圍塗膜，以拉拔器施力直到破壞，記錄破壞強度與破壞位置（底材與底漆之間、層間或塗層內聚破壞）。破壞位置往往比數值更有意義：若破壞在底漆與鋼面之間，代表表面處理有問題；若在層間，則可能是覆塗間隔或污染。塗膜還要以目視與針孔檢測找出流掛、乾噴、針孔與漏塗。

維護決策要以量化的狀態評估為基礎：ISO 4628 以標準圖比對生鏽、起泡、龜裂、剝落與粉化程度，例如生鏽等級 Ri 1 至 Ri 5 對應約 0.05% 至 40% 至 50% 的生鏽面積。金門大橋的塗裝工作依檢查結果決定在哪裡腐蝕正在擴大；艾菲爾鐵塔每次重塗也從找出並暴露最嚴重的腐蝕區開始，並估計兩次重塗之間約有 15 t 塗料被侵蝕。把評估結果畫在構件分區圖上，就能看出劣化是隨機分布還是集中於特定細部。

維護策略有三種：局部修補只處理生鏽點，成本低但須及早進行；覆塗是在附著良好的舊塗層上加塗，延長壽命；全面重塗則把舊塗層全部去除，成本最高但可重建完整系統。金門大橋採持續修補，官方強調重塗不是每七年一次、也不是每年從頭塗到尾；它在 1965 年起移除含鉛塗料並改用鋅矽酸鹽系統，至 1995 年完成。福斯鐵橋在 1890 年通車後直到 2002 年才開始第一次全面重塗；艾菲爾鐵塔 2019 年起的第 20 次重塗首次包含局部除漆。
大型鋼構的塗裝會經歷數十年與多個世代的產品與法規：金門大橋的原始塗料是約含 68% 紅丹膏的亞麻仁油含鉛漆，後來為了符合揮發性有機物空氣品質規定，在 1990 年把面漆由乙烯系改為壓克力乳膠；其國際橘的色彩規格也被精確記錄，由 Sherwin-Williams 供應塗料。交接文件要記錄每一區的系統、產品與批號、表面處理等級、膜厚圖、附著力試驗、環境紀錄與修補履歷，讓下一次維護知道底下是什麼。
procedureEn: Steel corrodes in air when a moisture film and oxygen are present, at a rate governed mainly by time of wetness, chloride deposition and sulfur compounds; coastal fog and salt-laden wind can multiply the rate several times over inland values. ISO 12944 groups environments into categories C1 to C5 and CX by the first-year corrosion loss of carbon steel, the basis for choosing coating systems and durability ranges. A single structure also has microclimates: sheltered bottom flanges, water-trapping joints and crevices, and splash zones often corrode faster than exposed windward faces. Golden Gate Bridge maintenance crews describe battling wind, sea air and fog that corrode the steel.

Large steel structures commonly use a three-coat system: a zinc-rich primer protects steel sacrificially, with zinc corroding first even at small breaks in the film; an intermediate coat, often epoxy, adds thickness and barrier, lengthening the path for moisture and ions to reach the steel; and a topcoat such as polyurethane or acrylic resists ultraviolet light and holds colour. After removing its original lead-based paint, the Golden Gate Bridge moved to an inorganic zinc silicate primer with a topcoat; each Eiffel Tower campaign applies an anti-rust primer, an anti-rust reinforcement coat and a finish coat; and the Forth Bridge's first full repaint used a three-coat system derived from the North Sea oil industry.

Much of a coating's life is settled before the first coat: blasting must remove mill scale, rust and old coatings to the cleanliness grade of ISO 8501-1, for example Sa 2½, and create an anchor profile deep enough for the primer to key into; soluble salts left on the surface draw water under the film and cause blisters, so coastal structures are also tested for chloride. During work the steel temperature must be at least 3°C above the dew point, or a thin condensed film will flash-rust freshly blasted steel and reduce adhesion.

Paint pulls back from sharp edges by surface tension, so edge film is often half or less of the flat-surface thickness, which is why rust usually starts at edges, bolt heads and welds. Good anti-corrosion detailing rounds sharp edges, avoids uncoatable narrow gaps and back-to-back angles, adds drain holes where water could collect, makes box members either fully sealed or accessible, and leaves working space for tools and painters. On the Golden Gate Bridge, ironworkers must remove plates so painters can reach the interiors of columns and chords, and since 1970 rivets have progressively been replaced with high-strength bolts.

Maintenance painting of large existing structures happens at height, in wind, rain and traffic: encapsulated scaffolds or cradles are needed to contain blast dust and old coating debris, with dehumidifiers controlling the environment where needed, and each coat must be overcoated within its minimum and maximum recoat window or adhesion suffers. An Eiffel Tower campaign takes 18 months to over three years, with about 50 painters using about 55 km of safety lines and nets catching paint flakes; the Forth Bridge's first full repaint from 2002 covered about 255,000 m² with about 240,000 L of paint.

Film thickness is the most directly measurable quality indicator in a coating specification: too thin gives poor barrier and early rust, too thick can crack, trap solvent or adhere poorly. During application a wet-film comb gives immediate checks, converted to dry film by volume solids; after drying, magnetic or eddy-current gauges measure dry film, with a roughness correction deducted on blasted surfaces per ISO 19840. Acceptance commonly uses the 80-20 rule: the mean is at least the nominal thickness, no more than 20% of readings fall below nominal, no reading is below 80% of nominal, and the product's maximum thickness is not exceeded.

Correct thickness does not prove the coating sticks. Adhesion is commonly measured by the ISO 4624 pull-off test: a metal dolly is glued to the film, the coating around it scored, and a tester pulls until failure, recording the stress and where it failed, between steel and primer, between coats or cohesively within a coat. The failure location often matters more than the value: failure at the primer–steel interface points to surface preparation, failure between coats to recoat timing or contamination. The film is also checked visually and with holiday detectors for runs, dry spray, pinholes and misses.

Maintenance decisions should rest on quantified condition surveys: ISO 4628 compares rusting, blistering, cracking, flaking and chalking with reference images, rust grades Ri 1 to Ri 5 corresponding to about 0.05% up to 40 to 50% rusted area. Golden Gate Bridge painting is planned from inspections that show where corrosion is advancing, and each Eiffel Tower campaign begins by finding and exposing the worst corrosion, with about 15 t of paint estimated to erode between campaigns. Mapping survey results onto member zones shows whether deterioration is random or concentrated at particular details.

There are three maintenance strategies: spot repair treats only rusted spots, cheaply, but must be done early; overcoating adds coats over well-adhered old paint to extend its life; full repainting removes all old coating at the highest cost but rebuilds a complete system. The Golden Gate Bridge relies on continuous touch-up, and its owner stresses that it is neither repainted every seven years nor painted end to end each year; from 1965 it removed its lead-based paint for a zinc silicate system, a program completed in 1995. The Forth Bridge, opened in 1890, began its first full repaint only in 2002, and the Eiffel Tower's 20th campaign from 2019 included stripping parts of the structure for the first time.

Coatings on large steel structures span decades and several generations of products and regulations: the Golden Gate Bridge's original paint was a lead-based linseed-oil paint of about 68% red lead paste, and in 1990 its topcoat changed from vinyl to acrylic emulsion to meet air-quality rules on volatile organic compounds; its International Orange is precisely specified, with paint supplied by Sherwin-Williams. Handover documents must record, zone by zone, the system, products and batches, preparation grade, thickness maps, adhesion tests, environmental logs and repair history, so the next maintenance team knows what lies beneath.
evidence: 塗裝規格書應以腐蝕性分區圖指定每一區的系統、總膜厚與耐久等級，並把高風險區列為加強塗裝（例如加一道中塗或條塗）；分區圖由結構與塗裝工程師共同簽認。
塗裝系統應以整套方式指定與採購，不允許承包商任意混用不同廠牌的單一層；任何替代產品都須提出相容性與性能證明，並經業主的塗裝顧問核准後才可使用。
把表面處理完成後的檢查列為塗底漆前的停留點，由檢驗員簽認清潔度、錨紋、鹽分與環境紀錄；噴砂面須在規定時間內塗上底漆，超過時間或出現返鏽就必須重新處理。
結構設計階段就要邀請塗裝顧問審查細部，把可塗裝性與可檢查性列入設計審查清單；箱形構件須明確標示為密封（並檢查焊縫氣密）或可進入（並設置人孔與照明），不可介於兩者之間。
施工計畫須包含圍封與廢棄物處理、環境監測、每一層的覆塗間隔與天候停工條件，並由業主核准；高空與圍封施工涉及墜落與粉塵風險，作業許可須依職業安全規定辦理，本課只說明品質控制邏輯。
evidenceEn: The coating specification should use a corrosivity zoning drawing to assign system, total film thickness and durability range to each zone, with high-risk zones upgraded, for example by an extra intermediate or stripe coat; structural and coating engineers sign the zoning drawing together.

Specify and procure the coating as a complete system and do not let contractors mix single coats from different makers; any substitute product needs evidence of compatibility and performance and approval by the owner's coating consultant before use.

Make post-preparation inspection a hold point before priming, with the inspector signing for cleanliness, profile, salts and environmental records; blasted steel must be primed within the specified time, and any surface that exceeds it or flash-rusts must be re-prepared.

Invite the coating consultant to review details at the structural design stage and add coatability and inspectability to the design review checklist; box members must be clearly designated either sealed, with airtight welds checked, or accessible, with manholes and lighting, never something in between.

The work plan must cover containment and waste handling, environmental monitoring, recoat windows for each coat and weather stop criteria, approved by the owner; work at height and inside containment carries fall and dust hazards and needs permits under occupational-safety rules, and this course explains quality-control logic only.
pitfalls: 若整座海邊橋梁以單一較低的腐蝕性類別設計塗裝，迎風外露面表現尚可，但下翼板、支承附近與排水不良的節點在數年內就出現大面積生鏽與層狀剝落，修補需要搭設困難的懸吊架。
清晨在接近露點的鋼面上噴砂並立刻塗底漆，看似完成，數月後塗膜下出現點狀返鏽與起泡；海邊結構若只看清潔度照片而不測鹽分，殘留氯鹽會讓新塗膜在一兩年內大面積起泡。
圍封不完整讓含鉛舊漆碎屑落入河道或人行道，工程被環保單位勒令停工；超過最長覆塗間隔才塗面漆，層間附著不良，數年後面漆大片剝落，必須再次全面處理。
附著力試驗只在工廠試板上做一次，現場在潮濕或有灰塵的狀態下塗裝，實際附著力遠低於試板，塗層在第一個冬季就成片剝落；高壓針孔檢測電壓過高，反而擊穿合格塗膜造成新缺陷。
在附著力已不足的舊塗層上直接覆塗，新塗層的收縮把舊塗層一起拉起，整片剝落；錯過局部修補時機，原本只需處理數百平方公尺的生鏽點，演變成全面重塗。
pitfallsEn: Designing a whole coastal bridge's coating for one lower corrosivity category leaves exposed windward faces fine, but bottom flanges, areas near bearings and poorly drained nodes rust widely and delaminate within a few years, and repair needs difficult suspended access.

Blasting and priming early in the morning on steel near the dew point looks finished, but spot rust and blisters appear under the film within months; on coastal structures, judging only by cleanliness photographs without salt testing lets residual chloride blister large areas of new coating within a year or two.

Incomplete containment lets lead-bearing debris fall into the river or onto walkways and environmental authorities halt the work; topcoating after the maximum recoat window leaves poor intercoat adhesion, so large sheets of topcoat peel within a few years and everything must be redone.

Testing adhesion once on shop panels while site coats go on damp or dusty steel leaves actual adhesion far below the panels, and the coating peels in sheets the first winter; setting high-voltage holiday detection too high punctures sound film and creates new defects.

Overcoating old paint that has already lost adhesion lets the new coat's shrinkage lift both layers off together in sheets; missing the spot-repair window turns a few hundred square metres of rust spots into a full repaint.

factsEn: Ronan Point, a 22-storey precast large-panel block, partly collapsed on 16 May 1968 after a gas explosion in an 18th-floor corner flat, killing 4
Interim UK measures in 1968 required new buildings over five storeys to resist an explosion pressure of 34 kPa
World Trade Center 7 had 47 storeys and collapsed at about 5:21 p.m. on 11 September 2001 after roughly 7 hours of fire
NIST issued the World Trade Center 7 final report, NCSTAR 1A, in November 2008
Champlain Towers South, a 12-storey condominium with penthouse built in 1981, partly collapsed on 24 June 2021, killing 98
NIST found that Champlain Towers South began with punching shear failures at 2 garage columns about 3 weeks before the collapse
UFC 4-023-03 sets the internal tie force F_i = 3·w_F·L₁, with w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L
UFC 4-023-03 requires members carrying tie forces to sustain a rotation of 0.20 rad (about 11.3°)
Eurocode EN 1991-1-7 limits local damage to 15% of the floor area or 100 m², whichever is smaller
timeline: 1968　倫敦 Ronan Point 因瓦斯爆炸發生角落連鎖倒塌

timelineEn: 1968 — A gas explosion causes the progressive corner collapse of Ronan Point in London
1970 — UK building regulations add requirements against disproportionate collapse
2001 — World Trade Center 7 collapses in fire, becoming the reference case of fire-induced progressive collapse
2008 — NIST issues its final report on World Trade Center 7, identifying thermal expansion as the cause of the critical column failure
2009 — The US Department of Defense issues UFC 4-023-03 with tie-force, alternate-path and enhanced local resistance rules
2021–2026 — Champlain Towers South partly collapses, and NIST releases technical findings in 2026 identifying punching shear as the initiating failure

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：結構抗連鎖倒塌設計
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design
guides.concept: 從 Ronan Point、世界貿易中心 7 號大樓與 Champlain Towers South 的教訓出發，建立異常荷載的風險觀念與拆柱後的荷載重分配，學習拉結力法、板柱穿孔剪力與完整性鋼筋、懸鏈作用與接頭轉角，再談施工符合性、子結構試驗與能量法、既有建築腐蝕評估、火災熱膨脹觸發的倒塌，以及使用期間的荷載變更管理與交接。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the lessons of Ronan Point, World Trade Center 7 and Champlain Towers South, build the risk view of abnormal loads and the load redistribution after column loss, learn the tie-force method, slab–column punching shear and integrity reinforcement, catenary action and connection rotation, then cover construction conformance, subassembly tests and the energy method, corrosion assessment of existing buildings, fire-triggered collapse through thermal expansion, and load-change management and handover in service.
procedure: 連鎖倒塌（不成比例倒塌）是指一個局部破壞，例如一根柱或一片承重牆因爆炸、撞擊、火災或施工錯誤失效，沿著荷載路徑擴散，最後造成與起因不成比例的大範圍倒塌。1968 年倫敦 22 層預鑄大板住宅 Ronan Point 在 18 樓角落發生瓦斯爆炸，吹出一片承重牆，上方樓層失去支承後連續塌落，促成英國建築法規加入不成比例倒塌條文。設計目標不是讓結構在任何事件中毫髮無傷，而是把損壞限制在可接受範圍，例如 Eurocode 以樓層面積 15% 或 100 m² 取小者為限。
替代路徑法假設某一根柱突然消失，檢查上方結構能否把荷載繞到相鄰柱。原本兩跨各自受力的梁變成跨度加倍的單跨梁，支承處負彎矩與跨中正彎矩都大幅增加，原本柱頂的負彎矩區甚至反轉為正彎矩，因此下層鋼筋必須連續。柱是瞬間失效而非緩慢卸載，結構會往下衝過靜力平衡位置；對線彈性系統而言，突然施加的荷載使最大變形約為靜態的兩倍，所以線性靜力分析常需乘上荷載放大係數。
拉結力法是一種間接設計：不必模擬特定事件，而是要求樓板與梁在縱向、橫向、周邊與垂直方向都有足夠的連續受拉鋼筋，使局部失去支承時，樓板能像薄膜或懸鏈一樣把荷載拉回相鄰構件。UFC 4-023-03 以樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L 與跨度決定內部拉結力，並要求承受拉結力的構件能承受 0.20 rad 的轉角。拉結筋的價值在於連續與錨定：一根在柱邊斷開的鋼筋，帳面面積再大也無效。

無梁版的柱頭是連鎖倒塌的弱點：穿孔剪力破壞屬脆性，一旦柱頭周圍的混凝土錐體被剪斷，板失去支承，荷載轉給相鄰柱頭，若它們也接近極限，破壞就沿樓板擴散。NIST 於 2026 年發布的 Champlain Towers South 技術結論指出，崩塌始於 2021 年 6 月初泳池平台下兩處停車場柱的穿孔剪力破壞，荷載重分配給無法承受的相鄰接頭，而原始設計與施工的偏差使安全餘裕從一開始就太小。穿過柱核心的連續下層完整性鋼筋，能在穿孔後把板懸吊在柱上，防止破壞擴散。
當梁或樓板在拆柱後下垂到抗彎強度不足以承受荷載時，構件會轉為受拉的懸鏈線，以軸向拉力把荷載掛到相鄰柱上。這需要三個條件：接頭能承受大轉角而不斷裂、構件與接頭能傳遞軸向拉力、相鄰柱與外圍構件能承受向內拉的水平力。梁柱接頭若只設計成傳遞剪力的簡單接頭，螺栓或剪力板常在轉角增加時先撕裂，懸鏈作用根本建立不起來。

抗連鎖倒塌設計常仰賴少數關鍵鋼筋與接頭，施工偏差對它們的影響遠大於一般構件。上層筋被踩低使有效深度變小、拉結筋搭接長度不足、續接器未鎖緊、預鑄接頭灌漿不實，都會讓計算上的替代路徑在現場不存在。NIST 對 Champlain Towers South 的結論同時提到施工與設計圖說不符、使用期間增加的荷載以及長期腐蝕，共同壓縮了本來就不足的餘裕；因此施工階段的停止點檢查，本身就是抗連鎖倒塌設計的一部分。
接頭在大轉角下的拉力與轉角能力很難只靠計算，需要以實尺度梁柱子結構試驗驗證：把中間柱向下推，記錄力—位移曲線、接頭轉角、梁軸力與破壞模式。靜力推覆曲線可用能量法換算為突然拆柱時的動力容量：結構到某位移時吸收的應變能，必須等於重力荷載在該位移所做的功，因此動力容量低於靜力最大值。
既有建築的抗倒塌能力會隨時間下降：防水失效使鋼筋腐蝕、混凝土剝落，附加設備與鋪面增加荷載，改裝則移除牆或開孔。Champlain Towers South 約 40 年使用期間的增加荷載與長期腐蝕，都被 NIST 列為壓縮安全餘裕的因素。評估要結合文件回顧、現場調查、非破壞檢測與取樣試驗，找出需求比已接近 1 的柱頭或接頭，再以替代路徑分析決定補強優先順序。
火災是常被低估的觸發事件。NIST 對世界貿易中心 7 號大樓的調查指出，這棟 47 層建築因灑水系統水源中斷，下層樓層火災失控約七小時，樓板梁受熱膨脹使第 13 層一根大梁脫離與 79 號柱的接合，樓板逐層塌落使 79 號柱失去側向支撐而挫屈，最後演變成整棟倒塌；NIST 稱這是第一棟主要因不受控火災而倒塌的高樓。教訓是熱膨脹會在長跨樓板與接頭中產生常溫設計沒有考慮的推力與位移。

抗連鎖倒塌能力在交接後最容易被不知情地削弱：增設屋頂設備、廣場鋪面與植栽、拆除隔間牆、在樓板開孔或切斷拉結筋，每一項單看都不大，累積起來卻可能讓關鍵接頭的需求比超過 1。NIST 指出 Champlain Towers South 使用期間包括泳池平台改變在內的增加荷載，進一步壓縮了餘裕。因此交接文件必須清楚標示哪些構件是替代路徑的關鍵、哪些區域的附加荷載有上限，讓管理單位在改裝前知道必須找結構技師。
procedureEn: Progressive or disproportionate collapse occurs when local damage, such as a column or load-bearing wall lost to explosion, impact, fire or construction error, spreads along the load path until the collapse is out of proportion to its cause. In 1968 a gas explosion in a corner flat on the 18th floor of Ronan Point, a 22-storey precast large-panel block in London, blew out a load-bearing wall, and the floors above, having lost support, fell in sequence; the event led UK building regulations to adopt disproportionate-collapse provisions. The design goal is not to survive every event unscathed but to confine damage to an acceptable extent, for example the Eurocode limit of 15% of the floor area or 100 m², whichever is smaller.

The alternate-path method assumes a column suddenly disappears and checks whether the structure above can route its load to adjacent columns. Two beams that worked as separate spans become one beam of double span, so hogging moments at supports and sagging moments at midspan rise sharply, and the former hogging zone over the lost column reverses into sagging, which is why bottom reinforcement must be continuous. Because the column fails instantly rather than unloading slowly, the structure overshoots its static equilibrium; for a linear elastic system a suddenly applied load produces about twice the static deformation, so linear static analysis usually applies a load increase factor.

The tie-force method is an indirect design approach: instead of modelling specific events, it requires enough continuous tension reinforcement in floors and beams in the longitudinal, transverse, peripheral and vertical directions that, when local support is lost, the floor can pull the load back to adjacent members as a membrane or catenary. UFC 4-023-03 sets internal tie forces from the floor load w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L and the span, and requires members carrying ties to sustain a rotation of 0.20 rad. The value of a tie lies in continuity and anchorage: a bar cut at the column face is useless however large its area on paper.

Flat-plate column heads are a weak point for progressive collapse: punching shear is brittle, and once the concrete cone around a column is sheared through, the slab loses support and its load passes to neighbouring column heads, which, if also near their limit, spread the failure across the floor. Technical findings released by NIST in 2026 on Champlain Towers South state that the collapse began in early June 2021 with punching shear failures at two garage columns under the pool deck, that load redistributed to adjacent connections unable to carry it, and that deviations in the original design and construction left margins too narrow from the start. Continuous bottom integrity bars passing through the column core can hang the slab on the column after punching and stop the spread.

When a beam or slab sags after column loss until its flexural strength can no longer carry the load, it turns into a tension catenary that hangs the load from adjacent columns by axial force. This requires three things: connections that sustain large rotations without fracturing, members and connections that transfer axial tension, and adjacent columns and perimeter members that resist the inward horizontal pull. Simple shear connections often tear at their bolts or shear tabs as rotation grows, so catenary action never develops.

Progressive-collapse resistance often rests on a few key bars and connections, and construction deviations affect them far more than ordinary members. Top bars trodden down to a smaller effective depth, short tie laps, couplers not tightened and poorly grouted precast joints all mean the calculated alternate path does not exist on site. NIST's findings on Champlain Towers South cite construction that deviated from the drawings, loads added in service and long-term corrosion as jointly eroding margins that were already too small; hold-point inspection during construction is therefore part of progressive-collapse design itself.

The tension and rotation capacity of connections at large rotations is hard to establish by calculation alone and is verified by full-scale beam–column subassembly tests: the middle column is pushed down while the force–displacement curve, connection rotations, beam axial forces and failure mode are recorded. The static push-down curve converts to a dynamic capacity for sudden column loss by the energy method: the strain energy absorbed up to a displacement must equal the work done by gravity load over that displacement, so dynamic capacity is lower than the static peak.

Collapse resistance of existing buildings declines over time: failed waterproofing corrodes reinforcement and spalls concrete, added equipment and paving raise loads, and renovations remove walls or cut openings. NIST lists both the loads added and the long-term corrosion over the roughly 40-year life of Champlain Towers South as factors that eroded its margins. Assessment combines document review, site survey, non-destructive testing and sampling to find column heads or connections whose demand ratio is approaching 1, then uses alternate-path analysis to rank strengthening priorities.

Fire is an underrated trigger. NIST's investigation of World Trade Center 7 found that in this 47-storey building, with the sprinkler water supply lost, fires on lower floors burned uncontrolled for about seven hours; thermal expansion of floor beams caused a girder on floor 13 to lose its connection to Column 79, cascading floor failures left Column 79 without lateral support until it buckled, and the whole building collapsed, which NIST calls the first known tall building brought down primarily by uncontrolled fire. The lesson is that thermal expansion produces thrusts and displacements in long-span floors and connections that ambient-temperature design never considered.

Collapse resistance is most easily weakened unknowingly after handover: added roof equipment, plaza paving and planters, removed partitions, slab openings or cut ties each look minor, yet together they can push a key connection's demand ratio above 1. NIST notes that loads added during the life of Champlain Towers South, including pool deck modifications, further reduced its margins. Handover documents must therefore show clearly which members are critical to alternate paths and which areas have added-load limits, so that managers know to call a structural engineer before renovating.
evidence: 設計基準書要列出採用的抗連鎖倒塌準則、風險類別、假設移除的構件範圍與允許破壞面積，並由業主、建築師與結構技師共同簽認，避免後續設計變更時被忽略。
梁與樓板的下層鋼筋應以搭接或續接器穿越柱線連續，並在圖說標示為拆柱情境必要的連續筋，避免施工時被當作一般鋼筋而在柱頂截斷。
拉結筋的搭接與續接位置應避開預期的高轉角區，並採能發展鋼筋全強度的續接器；設計變更若移動開口或伸縮縫，須重新檢查拉結路徑並經結構技師核可。
柱頭區不得任意開孔或埋管，泳池、植栽與廣場鋪面等重荷載區要在圖說標示允許附加荷載；需求比偏高的柱頭應加設柱頭版、剪力鋼筋或剪力栓釘，並由結構技師簽認。
需要替代路徑的鋼構接頭，應採用經試驗驗證、能在大轉角下傳遞拉力的型式，並在圖說註明不得任意以其他接頭替代；替代方案須提出同等轉角與拉力能力的試驗或分析證明。
evidenceEn: The design basis should list the progressive-collapse criteria adopted, the risk class, the assumed removal scenarios and the allowable damage area, signed by owner, architect and structural engineer so that later design changes cannot quietly ignore them.

Bottom bars in beams and slabs should run continuously through column lines with laps or couplers, and drawings should flag them as continuity bars required for column-loss scenarios so that site crews do not treat them as ordinary bars and stop them at the column.

Locate tie laps and couplers away from expected high-rotation zones and use couplers that develop the full bar strength; any design change that moves openings or movement joints requires the tie paths to be rechecked and approved by the structural engineer.

Forbid unplanned openings and embedded pipes near column heads, mark the allowable added load on drawings for heavy zones such as pools, planters and plaza paving, and give column heads with high demand ratios drop panels, shear reinforcement or shear studs signed off by the structural engineer.

Steel connections relied on for alternate paths should be tested types able to carry tension at large rotations, and drawings should forbid substitution; any alternative must be backed by tests or analysis showing equal rotation and tension capacity.
pitfalls: 若只依一般重力與地震規範設計，構件接合只滿足正常傳力方向，一旦承重牆或柱失效，樓板無法改以懸吊或懸臂方式傳力，上方樓層逐層塌落；Ronan Point 的調查即指出樓板與牆板接合未考慮荷載方向改變。
預鑄或疊合樓板若只靠支承長度擱置而無拉結筋，下方支承失效時板件會直接滑落；拉結筋若在伸縮縫或後澆帶處未續接，計算上連續的拉結線在現場其實是斷開的。
接頭轉角能力不足時，懸鏈線在形成前就斷裂，失去最後一道防線；外柱若未檢核內拉力，懸鏈作用會把外柱拉向內側並引起挫屈，使破壞擴大到相鄰跨。
若直接以靜力推覆的最大力判定合格，會高估約三分之一的實際動力容量；試驗若未正確模擬邊界的水平約束，懸鏈作用被高估或低估，都會讓設計失真。
灑水系統失效而防火被覆又有缺損時，長跨樓板梁膨脹推動大梁，接頭剪斷或大梁脫離柱座，樓板塌落後柱的無支撐長度變成數層，承載力驟降，局部火災演變成整體倒塌。
pitfallsEn: Designing only to ordinary gravity and seismic rules leaves connections able to transfer load in the normal direction only; once a wall or column is lost, floors cannot switch to hanging or cantilever action and the storeys above collapse one by one, and the Ronan Point inquiry found that slab-to-wall joints had not considered such load reversal.

Precast or composite planks that merely sit on their bearings without ties drop straight off when the support below fails; ties left unspliced at movement joints or pour strips are continuous on paper but broken on site.

With too little rotation capacity, connections fracture before the catenary forms and the last line of defence is lost; perimeter columns not checked for the inward pull are dragged inwards and buckle, spreading the failure into adjacent bays.

Accepting the static push-down peak directly overstates the real dynamic capacity by about a third; tests that misrepresent horizontal restraint at the boundaries overstate or understate catenary action and distort the design either way.

When sprinklers fail and fireproofing is damaged, expanding long-span floor beams push girders until connections shear or girders walk off their seats; once floors fall, columns become unbraced over several storeys, their capacity collapses and a local fire becomes total collapse.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.concept: 以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Period lengthening, load-transfer members, staged jacking and property bounds that protect historic buildings from earthquake damage. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.

舊金山市政府建於 1912 年，面積約 550,000 平方呎（約 51,000 m²），1989 年 Loma Prieta 地震受損

猶他州議會大廈 1916 年完工，外穹頂高出地面約 235 ft（約 72 m）
Forell/Elsesser 表示已為 30 棟以上建築提供隔震可行性研究或設計
factsEn: The Salt Lake City and County Building was built in 1891 to 1894 with a clock tower about 78 m (256 ft) high and reopened in 1989 after its isolation retrofit
The Salt Lake City and County Building needed only minor repairs after a magnitude 5.7 earthquake in 2020
San Francisco City Hall, built in 1912 with about 550,000 sq ft (about 51,000 m²), was damaged in the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake
The San Francisco City Hall retrofit cut and temporarily jacked about 530 columns and about 1,500 ft (about 457 m) of brick walls
The Utah State Capitol sits on 256 isolators able to move about 24 in (about 610 mm) in any direction
The Utah State Capitol retrofit transferred about 28,000,000 lb (about 125 MN) through post-tensioned girders spanning about 51 ft (about 15.5 m)
The Utah State Capitol was completed in 1916, with its outer dome about 235 ft (about 72 m) above ground
Forell/Elsesser reports base-isolation feasibility studies or designs for more than 30 buildings
timeline: 1980s　Forell/Elsesser 在 1980 年代初期開始把基礎隔震用於建築
1989　鹽湖城市郡大樓完成全球首例既有建築基礎隔震改造並重新開放

2020　鹽湖城附近規模 5.7 地震，隔震改造的市郡大樓只需輕微修復
timelineEn: 1980s — Forell/Elsesser begins applying base isolation to buildings in the early 1980s
1989 — The Salt Lake City and County Building reopens after the world's first base-isolation retrofit of an existing building
1989 — The Loma Prieta earthquake damages San Francisco City Hall, leading to its later isolation retrofit
2000s — The Utah State Capitol is retrofitted with 256 isolators and post-tensioned transfer girders
2020 — A magnitude 5.7 earthquake near Salt Lake City leaves the isolated City and County Building needing only minor repairs

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：既有建築基礎隔震改造
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings
guides.concept: 從鹽湖城市郡大樓、舊金山市政府與猶他州議會大廈的隔震改造出發，計算隔震後的週期、位移與扭轉放大，設計鉛心橡膠支承與後拉預力托換梁，再處理切柱頂升的荷載轉移、施工期間的地震風險、原型與出廠試驗、強震監測，最後談性質變化的上下限分析、隔震縫維護與交接。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the isolation retrofits of the Salt Lake City and County Building, San Francisco City Hall and the Utah State Capitol, compute isolated period, displacement and torsional amplification, design lead-rubber bearings and post-tensioned transfer girders, then handle load transfer by cutting and jacking, earthquake risk during construction, prototype and production tests and strong-motion monitoring, and finally upper- and lower-bound property analysis, moat maintenance and handover.
procedure: 許多既有建築，尤其是無筋磚造或石造的歷史建築，強度與韌性都不足，以傳統方式加剪力牆或斜撐，會大量破壞內部裝飾與空間。基礎隔震改從需求端下手：在建築下方插入水平柔軟的隔震層，把系統週期由約 0.5 s 延長到 2 至 3 s 以上，地震加速度大幅降低，上部結構幾乎以剛體平移，變形集中在隔震層。代價是隔震層要容納數十公分的位移，並需處理建築周邊的隔震縫與穿越管線。Forell/Elsesser 指出，鹽湖城市郡大樓是全球第一個以基礎隔震改造的既有建築。
改造時隔震面的位置決定了工程難度：放在地下室底部要開挖並托換基礎，放在地下室柱頂則地下室仍隨地盤運動。隔震面正上方必須有一層剛性樓板或格梁，把各柱連成整體，讓所有隔震器同步變形。建築的質心與隔震層勁度中心若不重合，扭轉會使角落隔震器的位移大於中心，所以隔震縫寬度要按最大總位移而非平均位移設計，並保留所有穿越管線與通道的可動接頭。
鉛心橡膠支承由多層薄橡膠與鋼板交錯硫化而成，中心插入鉛棒：鋼板限制橡膠的側向膨脹，使支承在垂直方向很硬、水平方向很軟；鉛心在小位移時提供初始勁度與抗風強度，降伏後以塑性變形耗能，力—位移關係近似雙線性。設計參數包括鉛心特性強度 Q_d、降伏後勁度 K_d（由橡膠剪力模數、面積與總厚度決定）、有效勁度與等效阻尼比，這些值都隨位移改變。

改造的關鍵是如何在不移除建築的前提下，把每根柱或每道牆的重量從原基礎轉到新隔震器上。常見做法是在柱或牆兩側澆置新的混凝土托換梁或夾套，以後拉預力把新舊混凝土夾緊，靠摩擦與剪力榫把荷載傳入新構件，再由新構件坐在隔震器上。Forell/Elsesser 的猶他州議會大廈改造即以環繞既有墩基礎的後拉預力混凝土大梁形成複合斷面，跨距約 51 ft，把約 28,000,000 lb 的荷載轉到新隔震器，避免在既有基礎下方開挖。
隔震器就位前，柱或牆必須被切斷，荷載暫時由千斤頂與臨時支撐承擔，再把千斤頂壓力轉到隔震器上。舊金山市政府的改造中，約 530 根柱與約 1,500 ft 的厚重磚牆被切斷並暫時頂撐，才能安裝隔震器。歷史建築對差異沉陷極為敏感，數毫米的差異就可能使灰泥裝飾開裂，因此要以千斤頂預壓抵銷隔震器受壓後的垂直變形，並按事先排定的順序逐柱施作。
改造期間建築處在最脆弱的狀態：部分柱已切斷、隔震器尚未全部就位、隔震縫還沒完成，原本的基礎與新系統都只是半套。Forell/Elsesser 說明舊金山市政府的施工排序，目的之一就是在施工期間萬一發生地震時仍維持結構穩定。設計者必須把每個施工階段當成一個暫態結構，決定其要承受的地震水準，並以臨時側向束制、限制同時施工範圍或分區施作來控制風險。
隔震器的性質必須在接近實際的軸壓、速度與位移下試驗，因為鉛心在快速大位移下會發熱、特性強度下降，橡膠性質也受速度與溫度影響。原型試驗在多個位移與軸壓組合下做反覆加載，確認穩定性與耗能；出廠試驗則對每個支承做壓縮與壓剪試驗，確認與原型一致。台灣國家地震工程研究中心的雙軸向動態測試系統（BATS）是少數能同時施加高軸壓與快速水平運動的設備，常用於隔震元件試驗。
隔震建築應在隔震層下方、上方與屋頂設置強震儀，並在隔震層設位移計，才能在地震後判斷隔震是否如預期作用。中小地震時鉛心可能未完全降伏，系統較硬、週期較短，加速度折減不如設計地震明顯，判讀時不能用設計週期直接比較。鹽湖城市郡大樓在 2020 年規模 5.7 地震後只需輕微修復，這類實際事件與紀錄是隔震改造最有說服力的驗證。
隔震器的性質不是固定值：橡膠會隨時間硬化、低溫時變硬，鉛心在連續大位移中發熱而強度下降，製造批次也有變異。因此設計不採用單一性質，而以性質修正係數產生上限與下限兩組性質分別分析：下限性質（較軟、阻尼較低）決定最大位移與隔震縫寬度，上限性質（較硬、強度較高）決定上部結構與托換構件的設計力。改造案的上部結構往往只有有限的強度，對上限力特別敏感。
隔震改造完成後，最常見的失效不是支承本身，而是隔震縫被逐漸填滿：新增的花台、儲藏物、管線支架、甚至修繕時加砌的牆，都可能在多年後把建築與地盤重新卡在一起。穿越隔震面的水管、瓦斯管、電纜與排水管也必須保留足夠的可動長度。因此交接文件與日常維護必須把隔震縫當成結構構件管理，並在每次地震後檢查支承、可動接頭與隔震縫是否完整。
procedureEn: Many existing buildings, especially unreinforced masonry or stone landmarks, lack strength and ductility, and conventional strengthening with shear walls or braces would destroy much of their interior fabric. Base isolation attacks demand instead: a laterally flexible isolation layer inserted beneath the building lengthens the period from about 0.5 s to 2 to 3 s or more, sharply reducing earthquake acceleration so that the superstructure moves almost as a rigid body while deformation concentrates in the isolation layer. The price is that the layer must accommodate tens of centimetres of displacement, with a moat around the building and flexible utility crossings. Forell/Elsesser describes the Salt Lake City and County Building as the world's first base-isolation retrofit of an existing building.

The location of the isolation plane governs the difficulty of a retrofit: at the base of the basement it requires excavation and underpinning, while at basement column tops the basement still moves with the ground. A stiff diaphragm or grid of beams is needed directly above the isolators to tie the columns together so that all isolators deform together. If the centre of mass does not coincide with the centre of isolator stiffness, torsion makes corner isolators move more than central ones, so the moat must be sized for the total maximum displacement rather than the average, with movable joints for every utility and access crossing.

A lead-rubber bearing is built from thin rubber layers vulcanised between steel shims with a lead plug at its centre: the shims restrain lateral bulging so the bearing is very stiff vertically and soft horizontally, while the lead core provides initial stiffness and wind resistance at small displacement and, after yielding, dissipates energy by plastic deformation, giving a roughly bilinear force–displacement curve. Design parameters are the characteristic strength Q_d of the lead, the post-yield stiffness K_d set by rubber shear modulus, area and total thickness, the effective stiffness and the equivalent damping ratio, all of which vary with displacement.

The key to a retrofit is moving the weight of every column or wall from the old foundation onto new isolators without removing the building. A common method casts new concrete transfer beams or jackets on both sides of a column or wall and clamps new to old concrete with post-tensioning, so that friction and shear keys carry the load into the new members, which then sit on the isolators. In the Utah State Capitol retrofit, Forell/Elsesser wrapped the existing pier footings with post-tensioned concrete girders forming composite sections, spanning about 51 ft, to transfer about 28,000,000 lb onto new isolators without excavating beneath the old footings.

Before an isolator goes in, a column or wall must be cut, its load carried temporarily by jacks and shoring, and the jack pressure then transferred onto the isolator. In the San Francisco City Hall retrofit about 530 columns and about 1,500 ft of massive brick walls were cut and temporarily jacked so that isolators could be installed. Historic buildings are very sensitive to differential settlement, where a few millimetres can crack plaster ornament, so jacks preload to offset the isolator's vertical compression, and columns are done one by one in a planned sequence.

During a retrofit the building is at its most vulnerable: some columns are cut, not all isolators are in place and the moat is unfinished, so neither the old foundation nor the new system is complete. Forell/Elsesser explains that construction sequencing at San Francisco City Hall aimed, among other things, to keep the structure stable should an earthquake strike during the work. Designers must treat each construction stage as a temporary structure, choose the earthquake level it must resist, and control risk with temporary lateral restraints, limits on simultaneous work areas or zoned construction.

Isolator properties must be tested under realistic axial load, velocity and displacement, because the lead core heats and loses characteristic strength in fast large cycles, and rubber properties depend on rate and temperature. Prototype tests apply repeated cycles at several displacement and axial-load combinations to confirm stability and dissipation; production tests apply compression and combined compression–shear to every bearing to confirm consistency with the prototype. The Bi-Axial Testing System (BATS) at Taiwan's National Center for Research on Earthquake Engineering is one of the few facilities able to apply high axial load with fast horizontal motion and is commonly used for isolator testing.

An isolated building should carry strong-motion instruments below and above the isolation layer and at the roof, with displacement transducers in the isolation layer, so that engineers can judge after an earthquake whether isolation worked as intended. In small and moderate events the lead cores may not fully yield, so the system is stiffer with a shorter period and acceleration reduction is less marked than in the design earthquake; records must not be compared directly with the design period. After a magnitude 5.7 earthquake in 2020 the Salt Lake City and County Building needed only minor repairs, and such real events and records are the most convincing verification of an isolation retrofit.

Isolator properties are not fixed: rubber stiffens with age and at low temperature, lead cores heat and lose strength in repeated large cycles, and production batches vary. Design therefore uses property modification factors to create upper- and lower-bound property sets analysed separately: the lower bound, softer with less damping, governs maximum displacement and moat width, while the upper bound, stiffer and stronger, governs forces on the superstructure and transfer members. In a retrofit the superstructure often has limited strength and is especially sensitive to upper-bound forces.

After an isolation retrofit, the most common failure is not the bearings but the moat gradually filling up: new planters, storage, pipe supports or even walls added during repairs can lock the building to the ground again years later. Water, gas, power and drainage lines crossing the isolation plane must also keep enough movable length. Handover documents and routine maintenance must therefore manage the moat as a structural element, and after every earthquake inspect bearings, flexible joints and moat clearance.
evidence: 可行性研究階段就要比較隔震與傳統補強在文化資產衝擊、停用期間、造價與性能目標上的差異，並把性能目標（例如震後立即使用）寫進設計基準由業主確認。
隔震縫的蓋板、伸縮踏板與管線可動接頭應列入圖說與驗收項目，並在現場以油漆或標牌標示「隔震縫內不得堆放或施作」；任何穿越隔震面的新設施都須經結構技師核可。
規格書要列出每種支承在設計與最大位移下的 K_eff、EDC 與允收偏差，並要求每個支承有序號與試驗紀錄；同一隔震層盡量減少支承種類，避免安裝時錯置。
荷載轉移構件的界面處理、剪力榫、預力束配置與量測紀錄表都應列為停止點，並由結構技師現場確認後才可進行下一步切柱或頂升。
施工計畫要列出切柱順序、同時切斷柱數上限、千斤頂預壓值、沉陷與裂縫的停止條件，以及臨時支撐的側向設計，由結構技師簽認並設為每一柱的停止點；這些步驟是工程推理與檢核，不是現場操作許可。
evidenceEn: At feasibility stage compare isolation with conventional strengthening for heritage impact, closure time, cost and performance, and write the performance objective, for example immediate occupancy after the earthquake, into the design basis for the owner to confirm.

Moat covers, sliding treads and flexible utility joints should be shown on drawings and included in acceptance, and the moat should be marked on site as a no-storage, no-construction zone; any new item crossing the isolation plane needs the structural engineer's approval.

The specification should list K_eff, EDC and tolerances at design and maximum displacement for each bearing type, with a serial number and test record for every bearing; keep the number of bearing types in one isolation layer small to avoid mix-ups during installation.

Interface preparation, shear keys, tendon layout and measurement sheets for transfer members should be hold points, confirmed on site by the structural engineer before any column cutting or jacking proceeds.

The construction plan should list the cutting sequence, the maximum number of columns cut at once, jack preloads, stop criteria for settlement and cracking, and the lateral design of shoring, signed by the structural engineer as a hold point for every column; these steps are engineering reasoning and checks, not a field operating permit.
pitfalls: 若在軟弱土層上隔震而未做場址分析，地動的長週期能量正好落在隔震週期附近，位移遠超過預期，撞擊隔震縫邊牆；若上部結構過於柔軟或有軟弱層，變形不會只集中在隔震層，仍可能損傷。
若支承在最大位移下的重疊面積太小，加上大軸力，橡膠層會失穩或撕裂；鋼板與橡膠的黏結不良，則在反覆剪力下逐層剝離，支承勁度與承載力下降。
若一次切斷太多相鄰柱或千斤頂壓力不一致，荷載在臨時系統中重分配，部分柱瞬間下沉，造成磚牆與拱頂開裂；臨時支撐若只承受垂直力，施工中的地震或施工機具撞擊可能使其側向失穩。
若原型試驗只做慢速試驗，鉛心發熱造成的強度下降未被量到，分析高估了阻尼，實際位移超過隔震縫；出廠試驗若只抽樣，個別支承的黏結缺陷可能在地震中才暴露。
若只以名目性質分析，橡膠多年硬化後實際傳入上部結構的力比設計高一至兩成，脆弱的磚牆或石材裝飾可能在設計地震中受損；低溫地區若忽略橡膠硬化，冬季地震的隔震效果也會打折。
pitfallsEn: Isolating on soft soil without site analysis can put long-period ground-motion energy right at the isolated period, so displacement far exceeds expectations and the building strikes the moat wall; a flexible superstructure or soft storey keeps deformation from concentrating in the isolation layer and still allows damage.

If the overlap area at maximum displacement is too small under high axial load, the rubber layers can become unstable or tear; poor bonding between shims and rubber leads to layer-by-layer delamination under cyclic shear, reducing stiffness and capacity.

Cutting too many adjacent columns at once or uneven jack pressures redistribute load within the temporary system, so some columns drop suddenly and crack masonry walls and vaults; shoring designed only for vertical load can become laterally unstable under a construction-period earthquake or equipment impact.

Slow-only prototype tests miss the strength loss from lead heating, so analysis overstates damping and real displacement exceeds the moat; sampling instead of testing every production bearing can leave individual bonding defects to reveal themselves in an earthquake.

Analysing only nominal properties means that after years of rubber stiffening the forces reaching the superstructure are 10% to 20% above design, so brittle masonry or stone ornament can be damaged in the design earthquake; ignoring low-temperature stiffening in cold climates also reduces isolation in a winter earthquake.

guides.concept: 以核心降伏力、層間變位換算的核心應變、安裝時機與配合誤差控制，確保挫屈束制支撐只在地震時才降伏耗能。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Core yield force, drift-to-core-strain conversion, installation timing and fit-up control that keep buckling-restrained braces yielding only in earthquakes. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.

guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Buckling-restrained brace installation
guides.concept: 從挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑與層間變位換算核心應變出發，檢查核心、套管與脫層材及節點板的設計，再把重點放在安裝：重力荷載與安裝時機造成的預壓、現場配合誤差與螺栓鎖固，接著談 AISC 341 資格試驗與震後評估、防火與熱膨脹，最後是更換與交接，並以 One Rincon Hill、鹽湖城國際機場與日本製鐵工程的無黏結支撐公開資料對照。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the load path of buckling-restrained braced frames and the conversion of storey drift into core strain, check the core, casing, unbonding layer and gusset design, then focus on installation: preload from gravity loads and installation timing, fit-up misfit and bolt tightening, followed by AISC 341 qualification tests and post-earthquake assessment, fire and thermal expansion, and finally replacement and handover, compared with public information on One Rincon Hill, Salt Lake City International Airport and Nippon Steel Engineering's unbonded brace.
procedure: 挫屈束制支撐（BRB）由一根可降伏的鋼核心與包覆它的鋼套管及砂漿組成，套管防止核心在受壓時整體挫屈，使核心在拉與壓兩個方向都能降伏並形成飽滿的遲滯迴圈。這讓支撐像一個以鋼材塑性耗能的阻尼器：地震力經樓板傳到梁，再由節點板進入支撐，核心降伏限制了傳入構架的最大力，梁、柱與節點板則依支撐可能的最大力做容量設計，保持彈性。日本製鐵工程公開說明，其無黏結支撐自上市 30 餘年來已交付超過 10 萬支。
支撐的變形需求來自層間變位：樓層水平位移在斜撐方向的分量就是支撐伸縮量，而這個伸縮量主要集中在核心的降伏段，兩端的加勁連接段幾乎不變形。降伏段越短，同樣的層間變位就造成越大的核心應變，低週疲勞壽命也越短；降伏段越長，支撐越柔、層間變位越大。因此核心降伏段長度是在構架勁度與核心應變之間取捨，必須與製造商的試驗應變範圍對照。
核心受壓時會產生高階挫屈波形並推擠周圍砂漿，套管與砂漿必須有足夠勁度把核心限制在直線上；同時核心與砂漿之間要有脫層材或微小間隙，一方面讓核心受壓時因泊松效應的橫向膨脹有空間，另一方面避免軸力經摩擦傳入套管。間隙太小，套管分擔軸力而使受壓強度遠高於受拉；間隙太大，核心高階挫屈振幅過大而局部受損。日本製鐵工程的無黏結支撐即以鋼管與砂漿約束中心鋼材，並以特殊緩衝材使鋼管與砂漿不承受軸力。
支撐兩端的連接段必須在支撐最大拉壓力下保持彈性，包括耳板、螺栓、節點板與梁柱接合。節點板受壓時可能面外挫屈，帶動支撐端部轉動，使支撐整體失穩；另外構架在層間變位時，梁柱夾角會開合，節點板被反覆擠壓與拉開，即所謂構架作用，可能在節點板邊緣產生裂縫。CoreBrace 提供螺栓耳板、銷接與焊接三種接頭，螺栓耳板的現場容許誤差較大，銷接的安裝容許誤差較小，選擇時要同時考慮力量傳遞與現場施工性。
挫屈束制支撐是為地震而設，不應在平時承受明顯的重力荷載。若支撐在上方樓層、樓板或外牆尚未施作前就鎖固，之後增加的自重會使柱縮短、梁下垂，支撐跟著受壓，預先用掉一部分降伏容量；倒 V 形配置的支撐尤其會分擔梁的重力。因此許多設計要求支撐在主要靜載施加後才最終鎖固，或先以長圓孔暫時固定。支撐也不應被當作施工期間的臨時穩定斜撐，除非經過設計者核算。
支撐在工廠依工作點長度製造，但現場的柱垂直度、梁高程與節點板位置都有誤差，兩端螺栓孔對不上時，常見的錯誤做法是用千斤頂或吊車把支撐硬拉或硬壓進去，這會在支撐中留下預力。正確做法是先量測兩端節點板實際距離，在允許範圍內以長圓孔、墊片或現場擴孔處理，超出範圍則由製造商與設計者決定更換或修改。螺栓鎖固則依規定的預拉方法（例如轉角法）並逐一做記號檢查。

挫屈束制支撐沒有通用的計算公式能保證性能，因此規範要求以試驗證明：AISC 341 規定以子結構試驗與單軸試驗驗證支撐在逐級增加的變形下（至設計變形的兩倍）穩定，並達到足夠的累積非彈性變形，同時由試驗求出應變硬化係數 ω 與受壓強度調整係數 β，供容量設計使用。One Rincon Hill 的報導提到其支撐曾在柏克萊加州大學做實尺度試驗。試驗是產品與連接型式的資格，實際工程的支撐必須落在試驗涵蓋的尺寸與變形範圍內。
挫屈束制支撐的損傷藏在套管內，外觀很難判斷核心累積了多少塑性變形。完工時要建立基準：每支支撐的序號、實際長度、螺栓狀態與照片；地震後則量測殘留層間變位與支撐長度變化，並以分析或量測紀錄估算核心累積的非彈性變形，判斷剩餘能力。CoreBrace 推出可記錄支撐變形歷程的裝置，目的就是協助震後評估剩餘能力。
挫屈束制支撐是主要抗側力構件，必須依建築耐火時效做防火被覆；砂漿雖能延緩核心升溫，但不等於合格的防火保護。火災時被兩端構架束制的支撐受熱膨脹，因核心降伏應變很小，溫升不大就會在受壓方向降伏，降伏後力量受限，反而保護了構架；冷卻時則反向受拉。使用期間也要防止在套管上焊接或吊掛設備、管線，因為那會改變套管受力並破壞防火被覆。
挫屈束制支撐的優點之一是損傷集中在可更換的支撐上，而不是梁柱。這個優點只有在設計時就保留更換條件才成立：採用螺栓耳板或銷接而非現場全焊，保留搬運與吊掛的空間與路徑，並考慮更換期間該樓層的抗側力暫時降低。日本製鐵工程與 CoreBrace 等製造商都以標準化產品供應大量支撐，交接時把每支支撐的身分資料與試驗紀錄完整留下，才能在數十年後找到相同性能的替換品。
procedureEn: A buckling-restrained brace (BRB) consists of a yielding steel core enclosed by a steel casing and mortar; the casing prevents overall buckling of the core in compression, so the core yields in both tension and compression with full hysteresis loops. The brace thus acts as a damper dissipating energy through steel plasticity: earthquake force passes from the slab into the beam, through the gusset into the brace, and core yielding caps the force entering the frame, while beams, columns and gussets are capacity-designed for the maximum brace force and remain elastic. Nippon Steel Engineering states that more than 100,000 of its unbonded braces have been delivered in over 30 years on the market.

A brace's deformation demand comes from storey drift: the component of horizontal storey displacement along the brace axis is the brace elongation or shortening, concentrated in the yielding zone of the core while the stiffened end zones barely deform. A shorter yielding zone gives larger core strain for the same drift and shorter low-cycle fatigue life; a longer one makes the brace more flexible and increases drift. The yielding-zone length is therefore a trade-off between frame stiffness and core strain and must be checked against the manufacturer's tested strain range.

In compression the core develops higher-mode buckling waves that push against the surrounding mortar, so the casing and mortar must be stiff enough to keep the core straight; at the same time an unbonding layer or small gap between core and mortar gives room for the core's Poisson expansion in compression and stops axial force passing into the casing by friction. Too small a gap lets the casing share axial load so compression strength far exceeds tension; too large a gap allows large higher-mode buckling amplitudes and local damage. Nippon Steel Engineering's unbonded brace restrains its central steel with a steel tube and mortar, using a special cushioning material so that the tube and mortar carry no axial force.

The end connections must stay elastic under the maximum brace tension and compression, including lugs, bolts, gussets and the beam–column joint. A gusset in compression can buckle out of plane and rotate the brace end, destabilising the whole brace; moreover, as the frame drifts the beam–column angle opens and closes, repeatedly squeezing and pulling the gusset, the so-called frame action, which can crack gusset edges. CoreBrace offers bolted-lug, pinned and welded connections: the bolted lug tolerates more field misfit while the pinned connection has tighter erection tolerances, so the choice weighs force transfer against constructability.

Buckling-restrained braces are meant for earthquakes and should not carry significant gravity load in service. If a brace is fully connected before the floors, slabs or façade above are built, the added self-weight shortens columns and deflects beams and the brace is compressed, using up part of its yield capacity in advance; chevron braces in particular pick up beam gravity load. Many designs therefore require final connection only after the main dead loads are applied, or temporary fixing through slotted holes first. Braces should not serve as temporary construction bracing unless the designer has checked it.

Braces are made to work-point length in the factory, but column plumbness, beam elevation and gusset positions all deviate on site; when bolt holes at the two ends do not line up, a common mistake is to jack or crane the brace into place, locking in prestress. The correct approach is to measure the actual distance between gussets first, accommodate deviations within tolerance with slotted holes, shims or field reaming, and refer larger deviations to the manufacturer and designer for replacement or modification. Bolts are tightened by the specified pretensioning method, such as turn-of-nut, with every bolt marked and checked.

No general formula guarantees BRB performance, so codes require proof by testing: AISC 341 requires subassemblage and uniaxial tests showing stable behaviour as deformation increases in steps up to twice the design deformation, with sufficient cumulative inelastic deformation, and uses the tests to derive the strain-hardening factor ω and compression adjustment factor β for capacity design. Reports on One Rincon Hill mention full-scale testing of its braces at the University of California, Berkeley. Tests qualify a product and connection type, and project braces must fall within the sizes and deformations the tests cover.

BRB damage is hidden inside the casing, and appearance tells little about how much plastic deformation the core has accumulated. At completion, establish a baseline: serial number, actual length, bolt condition and photographs of every brace; after an earthquake, measure residual drift and changes in brace length, and estimate the core's cumulative inelastic deformation by analysis or recorded data to judge remaining capacity. CoreBrace offers a device that records brace deformation history precisely to support post-event assessment of remaining capacity.

A BRB is a primary lateral-force member and must be fireproofed to the building's fire-resistance rating; the mortar slows core heating but is not a qualified fire protection. In a fire a brace restrained by the frame at both ends expands, and since the core's yield strain is small, a modest temperature rise makes it yield in compression, after which its force is capped, which actually protects the frame; on cooling it reverses into tension. In service, welding or hanging equipment and pipes on the casing must be prevented, because that alters casing forces and damages the fireproofing.

One advantage of BRBs is that damage concentrates in replaceable braces rather than beams and columns. This holds only if replacement is planned in design: bolted lugs or pins rather than full field welds, space and routes for handling and lifting, and consideration of the temporary loss of lateral strength on that floor during replacement. Manufacturers such as Nippon Steel Engineering and CoreBrace supply large numbers of standardised braces, and only complete identity and test records at handover make it possible to source replacements of equal performance decades later.
evidence: 規格書應規定核心鋼材的降伏強度範圍（上下限），並要求每批鋼板試片報告；容量設計所用的 ω 與 β 必須取自該產品的資格試驗，不可直接沿用其他廠牌數值。
支撐訂購表要列出每支支撐的工作點長度、降伏段長度、設計變形與最大變形，由製造商確認落在其資格試驗範圍內；設計變更影響樓高或柱距時，須重新計算核心應變。
核心降伏段不得在現場焊接或鑽孔，套管上也不得焊接附掛物；運輸與吊裝時以吊帶支撐套管兩點，避免彎曲損傷砂漿，運抵現場須檢查套管凹損並記錄。
節點板的自由邊應設加勁板或限制長度，並在圖說中標示支撐中心線、工作點與允許偏差；接頭型式若由螺栓改為銷接或焊接，須重新檢查安裝誤差與連接設計。
安裝說明書要寫明暫時固定方式、最終鎖固的前置條件（例如上方若干樓層樓板與外牆完成）、鎖固順序與停止點，並由結構設計者確認；任何提前鎖固的要求都須提出施工階段分析。
evidenceEn: The specification should set an upper and lower bound on core yield strength and require coupon reports for every plate heat; the ω and β used in capacity design must come from that product's qualification tests, not from another manufacturer's values.

The brace schedule should list work-point length, yielding-zone length, design and maximum deformation for every brace, confirmed by the manufacturer to lie within its qualification range; any change to storey height or bay width requires recalculating core strain.

Never weld or drill the core yielding zone on site, and do not weld attachments to the casing; during transport and lifting, support the casing at two points with slings to avoid bending damage to the mortar, and inspect and record casing dents on arrival.

Stiffen or limit the free edges of gussets, and show brace centrelines, work points and tolerances on drawings; switching from bolted to pinned or welded connections requires a fresh check of erection tolerance and connection design.

Installation instructions should state the temporary fixing method, the preconditions for final connection (for example slabs and façade completed for a number of floors above), the connection sequence and hold points, confirmed by the structural designer; any request to connect earlier must be backed by construction-stage analysis.
pitfalls: 若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。
砂漿灌注不實留下空洞時，核心在該處的高階挫屈振幅增大，局部彎曲使核心提早斷裂；脫層材破損或遺漏時，核心與砂漿黏結，套管分擔軸力，受壓強度大幅提高，使連接與構架超載。
若支撐在結構體剛立起時就最終鎖固，完工後部分支撐已承受約三成的降伏力，地震時在受壓方向提早降伏，構架反應不對稱，殘留變位增加；把支撐當臨時斜撐承受施工荷載，也可能使核心在使用前就產生塑性變形。
若工程支撐的核心應變或尺寸超出試驗範圍，卻沿用既有報告，實際支撐可能在比試驗少的循環就斷裂；β 過大代表套管分擔軸力，若未反映在容量設計中，節點板與柱會在受壓循環超載。
後續裝修在支撐套管上焊接吊架或鑽孔固定管線，局部高溫或孔洞破壞砂漿約束，地震時該處核心局部挫屈；防火被覆被拆除未補，火災時連接段先失去強度，支撐脫落，構架失去抗側力。
pitfallsEn: If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first; a core that is too weak yields in minor earthquakes and accumulates damage.

Voids left by poorly placed mortar let higher-mode buckling grow at that spot, and local bending fractures the core early; damaged or missing unbonding material bonds core to mortar, the casing shares axial force and compression strength rises sharply, overloading connections and frame.

If braces are finally connected as soon as the frame is erected, some already carry about 30% of their yield force at completion, yield early in compression during an earthquake, and produce asymmetric response with larger residual drift; using braces as temporary bracing under construction loads can even yield the core before service.

Using an existing report for project braces whose core strain or size lies outside its range means real braces may fracture in fewer cycles than tested; a large β signals that the casing shares axial load, and if capacity design ignores it, gussets and columns are overloaded in compression cycles.

Later fit-out welding hangers or drilling pipe fixings into a casing damages the mortar restraint with local heat or holes, so the core buckles locally there in an earthquake; fireproofing removed and not reinstated lets the end connections lose strength first in a fire, the brace drops out and the frame loses lateral resistance.
